companies.name: Amazon
companies.description: Amazon.com, Inc. is an American multinational conglomerate founded in 1994 by Jeff Bezos in Bellevue, Washington. It operates in e-commerce, retail, cloud computing, online advertising, digital streaming, entertainment, supermarkets, and artificial intelligence. The company started as an online book marketplace and expanded to include virtually all consumer products.

companies.name: Accenture
companies.description: Accenture plc is a technology consulting company headquartered in Dublin, Ireland. Founded in 1989 in the United States, it provides information technology and management consulting services across 120 countries globally.

companies.name: ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih
companies.description: ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih is a Ukrainian steelworks located in Kryvyi Rih, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast. Founded in 1931 as Krivorozhstal, it was destroyed during World War II and later reconstructed and expanded. It was named after Vladimir I. Lenin following its reconstruction.

companies.name: Volkswagen Group
companies.description: Volkswagen Group is a German multinational automotive manufacturing group headquartered in Wolfsburg, Lower Saxony, Germany. It is one of the world's largest automakers by vehicle sales and the largest in Europe.

companies.name: G4S
companies.description: G4S is a British multinational private security company headquartered in London, England. It was formed in July 2004 by the amalgamation of London-based Securicor and Danish firm Group 4 Falck. G4S is a subsidiary of Allied Universal.

companies.name: Tata Consultancy Services
companies.description: Tata Consultancy Services Limited (TCS) is an Indian multinational technology company specializing in IT services and consulting. Headquartered in Mumbai, it is part of the Tata Group and operates in 150 locations across 46 countries. Tata Sons owns a majority stake in TCS.

companies.name: DHL Group
companies.description: DHL Group is a German multinational package delivery and supply chain management company headquartered in Bonn, Germany. It is one of the world's largest courier companies and includes the postal division Deutsche Post, which is Europe's largest postal company.

companies.name: PetroChina Company Limited
companies.description: PetroChina Company Limited is a Chinese oil and gas company headquartered in Dongcheng District, Beijing. It is the listed arm of state-owned China National Petroleum Corporation and is Asia's largest oil and gas producer. It is traded in Hong Kong and New York.

companies.name: Aviation Industry Corporation of China, Ltd.
companies.description: The Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC) is a Chinese state-owned aerospace and defense conglomerate headquartered in Beijing. It has over 100 subsidiaries, 27 listed companies, and 500,000 employees globally. AVIC is the sixth largest defense contractor worldwide as of 2022.

companies.name: Agricultural Bank of China
companies.description: The Agricultural Bank of China (ABC) is a largely state-owned multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Beijing, China. Founded in 1951, it is one of the "big four" banks in China and the second largest bank in the world by total assets. ABC has branches in major cities worldwide including Hong Kong, London, and New York.

companies.name: Carrefour Group
companies.description: Carrefour Group is a French multinational retail and wholesaling corporation headquartered in Massy, France. It operates a chain of hypermarkets, grocery stores, and convenience stores. By 2024, Carrefour had 14,000 stores in 40 countries and was the seventh-largest retailer in the world by revenue.

companies.name: Gazprom
companies.description: PJSC Gazprom is a Russian state-owned multinational energy corporation headquartered in the Lakhta Center in Saint Petersburg. The company is named as a contraction of the Russian words for gas industry. In December 2024, Gazprom ranked fifth among the largest companies in Russia by market capitalization.

companies.name: Jardine Matheson
companies.description: Jardine Matheson Holdings Limited is a multinational conglomerate based in Hong Kong, domiciled in Bermuda, and listed on the London Stock Exchange. It also has secondary listings on the Singapore Exchange and Bermuda Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China
companies.wiki: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China
companies.description: The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) is a partially state-owned multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Beijing, China. It is the largest of the "big four" banks in China and the largest bank in the world by total assets. ICBC was created in 1984 from the commercial banking operations of the People's Bank of China.

companies.name: Kroger
companies.description: The Kroger Co. is an American retail corporation headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio. It operates supermarkets and multi-department stores throughout the United States.

companies.name: Sodexo
companies.description: Sodexo is a French food services and facilities management company headquartered in Issy-les-Moulineaux, a suburb of Paris. It operates in 43 countries, serving 80 million customers daily across 27,000 sites. Sodexo is the largest France-based private employer worldwide.

companies.name: Yum China
companies.description: Yum China Holdings, Inc. is a Chinese Fortune 500 fast-food restaurant company based in Shanghai, China. It operates 18,737 restaurants worldwide and was spun off from Yum! Brands in 2016. Yum China has a workforce of 290,000 employees and maintains an office in Plano, Texas for SEC filings.

companies.name: McDonald's
companies.description: McDonald's Corporation is an American multinational fast food restaurant chain founded in 1940 in San Bernardino, California. By the end of 2025, it operated 45,356 restaurants in over 100 countries, with approximately 95% run by franchisees.

companies.name: Target Corporation
companies.description: Target Corporation is an American retail corporation and discount department store chain headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota. It operates small-format and large-format retail stores and hypermarkets. Target is the eighth-largest retailer in the U.S. and is a component of the S&P 500 Index.

companies.name: SF Express
companies.description: SF Express is a Chinese multinational delivery services and logistics company based in Shenzhen, Guangdong. It is the largest courier in China and provides domestic and international express delivery. The company operates a fleet of cargo aircraft owned by its subsidiary SF Airlines.

companies.name: The Home Depot
companies.description: The Home Depot is an American multinational home improvement retail corporation headquartered in Cobb County, Georgia. It sells tools, construction products, building materials, appliances, and services including fuel and transportation rentals. It is the largest home improvement specialty retailer in the United States.

companies.name: Reliance Industries Limited
companies.description: Reliance Industries Limited is an Indian multinational conglomerate headquartered in Mumbai. Its businesses include energy, petrochemicals, natural gas, retail, entertainment, telecommunications, mass media, and textiles. It is the largest public company in India by market capitalization and revenue.

companies.name: Starbucks
companies.description: Starbucks Corporation is an American multinational chain of coffeehouses and roastery reserves headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Founded in 1971, it started as a coffee bean wholesaler and later expanded into a coffee shop serving espresso-based drinks. It grew significantly under CEO Howard Schultz.

companies.name: IBM
companies.description: International Business Machines Corporation (IBM) is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Armonk, New York, with presence in over 175 countries. It is the largest industrial research organization globally, holding the record for most annual U.S. patents generated by a business for 29 consecutive years.

companies.name: Porsche Automobil Holding SE
companies.description: Porsche Automobil Holding SE is a German multinational corporation headquartered in Zuffenhausen, Stuttgart. It is primarily known as a holding company of Volkswagen Group with investments in the automotive industry. The company was founded in 1931 by Ferdinand Porsche and Anton Piëch.

companies.name: X5 Retail Group
companies.description: X5 Group is Russia's largest food retailer. The original organization of X5-Retail Group LLC was liquidated in 2012, and X5 Group LLC was opened in 2018.

companies.name: China Construction Bank
companies.description: China Construction Bank is a Chinese partially state-owned multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Beijing. It is one of the "big four" banks in China and the third largest bank in the world by total assets. The bank has numerous domestic and overseas branches.

companies.name: Ping An Insurance
companies.description: Ping An Insurance is a Chinese financial services holding company headquartered in Shenzhen. Founded in 1988, its subsidiaries provide insurance, banking, asset management, and other financial services. The name "Ping An" means "safe and well."

companies.name: Toyota
companies.description: Toyota Motor Corporation is a Japanese multinational automotive manufacturer headquartered in Toyota City, Aichi. Founded in 1937 by Kiichiro Toyoda, it is the largest automobile manufacturer in the world, producing about 10 million vehicles per year.

companies.name: Sinopec
companies.description: China Petroleum and Chemical Corporation, or Sinopec Group, is a Chinese oil and gas enterprise based in Chaoyang District, Beijing. It is a state-owned enterprise administered by the SASAC for the benefit of the State Council of China. Sinopec Group is the world's largest oil refining conglomerate and operates a publicly traded subsidiary listed in Hong Kong and Shanghai.

companies.name: Ford Motor Company
companies.description: The Ford Motor Company is an American multinational automobile manufacturer headquartered in Dearborn, Michigan. Founded by Henry Ford in 1903, it sells automobiles and commercial vehicles under the Ford brand and luxury cars under Lincoln. The company is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and controlled by the Ford family.

companies.name: Rosneft
companies.description: Rosneft Oil is a Russian public joint-stock integrated energy company based in Moscow. It specializes in exploration, extraction, production, refining, transport, and sale of petroleum, natural gas, and petroleum products. The company is state-owned through its parent company Rosneftegaz.

companies.name: Sberbank
companies.description: The Public JSC Sberbank is a Russian majority state-owned banking and financial services company headquartered in Moscow. It is the successor entity of the State Labor Savings Banks System of the USSR. The company shortened its brand to Sber in 2020.

companies.name: Infosys limited
companies.description: Infosys Limited is an Indian multinational technology company headquartered in Bengaluru. Founded in 1981 by seven engineers, it offers information technology, business consulting, and outsourcing services. It is considered one of the Big Six Indian IT companies.

companies.name: Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA
companies.description: Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA is a German multinational health care company based in Bad Homburg vor der Höhe. It provides dialysis products and services, inpatient and outpatient medical care, hospital management, and engineering services for medical centers. The company was ranked 411th in the 2023 Forbes Global 2000 list.

companies.name: Costco
companies.description: Costco Wholesale Corporation is an American multinational corporation operating membership-only big-box warehouse club retail stores. It is the third-largest retailer in the world and the largest retailer of beef, poultry, organic produce, and wine as of 2024. Costco ranks 12th on the Fortune 500 list as of 2026.

companies.name: China Telecommunications Corporation
companies.description: China Telecommunications Corporation is a Chinese state-owned telecommunication conglomerate. It is the principal landline telecommunication provider and the second-largest mobile telecommunication provider in China.

companies.name: Hewlett-Packard
companies.description: The Hewlett-Packard Company, commonly known as HP, was an American multinational information technology company founded in 1939 in Palo Alto, California. It developed and provided hardware, software, and related services to consumers, SMBs, large companies, and government sectors. The company split into Hewlett Packard Enterprise and HP Inc. in 2015.

companies.name: Teleperformance
companies.description: TP, formerly Teleperformance, is a French multinational business process outsourcing company founded in 1978 with headquarters in France. It provides services including debt collection, telemarketing, customer relationship management, content moderation, and communication.

companies.name: CVS Health
companies.description: CVS Health Corporation is an American multinational healthcare company that owns CVS Pharmacy, CVS Caremark, and Aetna. It is the world's second largest healthcare company and was founded in Lowell, Massachusetts. The name CVS originally stood for Consumer Value Stores.

companies.name: Magnit
companies.description: Magnit is one of Russia's largest food retailers, founded in 1994 in Krasnodar by Sergey Galitsky. The company operates thousands of stores including convenience stores, hypermarkets, and cosmetics stores. It has a significant presence across many locations in Russia.

companies.name: CITIC Limited
companies.description: CITIC Limited is a Hong Kong-based conglomerate listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and part of the Hang Seng Index. The Chinese state-owned CITIC Group owns 58% of its shares. It operates as a diversified holding company.

companies.name: China Railway Group Limited
companies.description: China Railway Group Limited (CREC) is a Chinese construction company traded on the Shanghai and Hong Kong stock exchanges. Its major shareholder is the state-owned China Railway Engineering Corporation. The company operates primarily in construction.

companies.name: China Telecom
companies.description: China Telecom Corporation Limited, known as China Telecom, is a major Chinese telecommunications company. It is the principal landline service provider and the second-largest mobile telecommunication provider in China.

companies.name: AT&T
companies.description: AT&T Inc. is an American multinational telecommunications holding company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It is the third-largest telecommunications company by revenue globally and the largest fiber internet provider in the United States.

companies.name: Cognizant Technology Solutions
companies.description: Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation is an American domiciled Indian multinational IT services and outsourcing company headquartered in Teaneck, New Jersey. It was founded in Chennai, India in 1994 as part of Dun & Bradstreet and went public in 1998.

companies.name: China Railway Construction Corporation Limited
companies.description: China Railway Construction Corporation Limited is a Beijing-based listed construction enterprise. It was the second largest construction and engineering company in the world by revenue in 2014.

companies.name: Panasonic Holdings Corporation
companies.description: Panasonic Holdings Corporation is a Japanese multinational electronics manufacturer headquartered in Kadoma, Osaka. It produces consumer electronics, batteries, automotive and avionic systems, and industrial equipment. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and other indices.

companies.name: Citigroup
companies.description: Citigroup Inc., or Citi, is an American multinational investment bank and financial services company based in New York City. It was formed in 1998 by the merger of Citicorp and Travelers, with Travelers spun off in 2002.

companies.name: Albertsons
companies.description: Albertsons Companies, Inc. is an American grocery company founded and headquartered in Boise, Idaho. It operates in the retail industry, focusing on grocery products.

companies.name: Continental AG
companies.description: Continental AG is a German multinational manufacturer of tires and industrial rubber and thermoplastic products. Founded in 1871, it is headquartered in Hanover, Lower Saxony, and ranked fourth worldwide by tire sales in 2025.

companies.name: FGC UES
companies.description: SOE FGC UES is a state-owned energy company based in Moscow, Russia. It is Russia's largest supplier of electrical power, operating in the electric power industry.

companies.name: The Walt Disney Company
companies.description: The Walt Disney Company is an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate headquartered in Burbank, California. Founded in 1923, it became a leader in animation with the 1928 release of Steamboat Willie, popularizing Mickey Mouse.

companies.name: LG Group
companies.description: LG Corporation is a South Korean multinational conglomerate headquartered in Seoul. Founded in 1947, it develops, manufactures, and markets electronics, chemicals, household appliances, and telecommunications products through subsidiaries worldwide.

companies.name: Veolia
companies.description: Veolia Environnement S.A. is a French transnational company headquartered in Aubervilliers. It operates in water management, waste management, and energy services, traditionally managed by public authorities.

companies.name: Walgreens
companies.description: Walgreens is an American pharmacy store chain headquartered in Deerfield, Illinois. It is the second largest pharmacy chain in the U.S., offering pharmacy and photo services across thousands of stores.

companies.name: SAIC Motor
companies.description: SAIC Motor Corp., Ltd. is a Chinese state-owned automobile manufacturer headquartered in Anting, Shanghai. Founded in 1955, it is the largest of China's "Big Four" state-owned car manufacturers.

companies.name: China North Industries Group Corporation Limited
companies.description: China North Industries Group Corporation Limited, known as Norinco Group, is a Chinese state-owned defense corporation manufacturing commercial and military products. It is one of the world's largest defense contractors.

companies.name: Honda
companies.description: Honda Motor Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational conglomerate automotive manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It operates in the industrial manufacturing sector.

companies.name: HCA Healthcare
companies.description: HCA Healthcare, Inc. is an American for-profit operator of health care facilities founded in 1968 and based in Nashville, Tennessee. It owns and operates hospitals and various care sites in the US and the UK. The company faced legal issues in the 1990s resulting in over $2 billion in fines and the CEO's dismissal.

companies.name: Canon Inc.
companies.description: Canon Inc. is a Japanese multinational corporation headquartered in Ōta, Tokyo. It specializes in optical, imaging, and industrial products including cameras, lenses, medical equipment, scanners, printers, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

companies.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise
companies.description: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company is an American multinational IT company based in Spring, Texas. It focuses on servers, storage, networking, AI, containerization software, consulting, and support. It is a business-focused organization.

companies.name: Santander Group
companies.description: Banco Santander S.A., trading as Santander Group, is a Spanish multinational financial services company based in Santander. It is Europe's fourth largest bank by assets and operates across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.

companies.name: Luxottica
companies.description: Luxottica Group S.p.A. was an Italian eyewear multinational headquartered in Milan. It designs, manufactures, distributes, and retails eyewear brands and is the largest eyewear company globally. Since 2018, it has been a subsidiary of EssilorLuxottica after a merger.

companies.name: América Móvil
companies.description: América Móvil, S.A.B. de C.V. is a Mexican telecommunications corporation headquartered in Mexico City. It is the seventh largest mobile network operator worldwide by equity subscribers and a Forbes Global 2000 company.

companies.name: Rosseti
companies.description: PAO Rosseti is a Russian power company comprising interregional and regional distribution grid companies, research and development institutes, and construction entities. It has 97 subsidiaries across 69 Russian regions and was formed from the reorganization of RAO UES.

companies.name: CRRC
companies.description: CRRC Corporation Limited is a Chinese state-owned and publicly traded rolling stock manufacturer. It is the world's largest rolling stock manufacturer by revenue, surpassing competitors like Alstom and Siemens.

companies.name: Renault
companies.description: Renault S.A., known as Groupe Renault, is a French multinational automobile manufacturer established in 1899. It produces cars and vans and has historically manufactured trucks, tractors, tanks, buses, aircraft, and autorail vehicles.

companies.name: Allianz SE
companies.description: Allianz SE is a German multinational financial services company headquartered in Munich. Its core businesses are insurance and asset management.

companies.name: Sumitomo Electric Industries
companies.description: Sumitomo Electric Industries, Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of electric wire and optical fiber cables headquartered in Chūō-ku, Osaka. The company is publicly traded on the Tokyo, Nagoya, and Fukuoka Stock Exchanges. It reported consolidated sales of US$26.5 billion for the period ending March 2021.

companies.name: Verizon
companies.description: Verizon Communications Inc. is an American telecommunications company headquartered in New York City. It is the world's second-largest telecommunications company by revenue and operates the largest wireless carrier network in the United States. The company was founded as Bell Atlantic Corporation and renamed Verizon in 2000 after merging with GTE.

companies.name: H&M
companies.description: H&M Hennes & Mauritz AB is a Swedish multinational clothing company headquartered in Stockholm. It operates thousands of stores across 75 geographical markets and sells apparel, accessories, and homeware. The company employs over 171,000 people worldwide.

companies.name: Prosegur
companies.description: Prosegur Compañía de Seguridad, S.A. is a multinational security company headquartered in Madrid, Spain. It operates in the cash-in-transit industry providing security services internationally.

companies.name: Macy's, Inc.
companies.description: Macy's, Inc. is an American holding company of department stores. Established in 1929 as Federated, it acquired Macy's in 1994, a department store chain originally founded in 1858. The company has a history of acquisitions and divestitures involving various regional department store chains.

companies.name: Saint-Gobain
companies.description: Compagnie de Saint-Gobain S.A. is a French multinational corporation founded in 1665 and headquartered near Paris. Originally a mirror manufacturer, it now produces a variety of construction and performance materials. Saint-Gobain operates in 76 countries and employs over 170,000 people as of 2022.

companies.name: Golden Agri-Resources
companies.description: Golden-Agri Resources (GAR) is a Singaporean palm oil company listed on the Singapore Stock Exchange since 1999. It is led by CEO Franky Widjaja of the Sinar Mas family. The company has subsidiaries including Alnoor and board members with political backgrounds.

companies.name: DXC Technology
companies.description: DXC Technology Company is an American multinational information technology services and consulting company headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia. It operates in the quaternary sector of the economy providing IT solutions globally.

companies.name: Anheuser-Busch InBev
companies.description: Anheuser-Busch InBev SA/NV, known as AB InBev, is an American-Belgian multinational drink and brewing company based in Leuven, Belgium. It is the largest brewer in the world and was ranked 72nd in the Forbes Global 2000 in 2023.

companies.name: thyssenkrupp AG
companies.description: ThyssenKrupp AG is a German industrial engineering and steel production company formed by the 1999 merger of Thyssen AG and Krupp. Headquartered in Duisburg and Essen, it is one of the largest steel producers worldwide. Its products include machines, industrial services, high-speed trains, elevators, shipbuilding, and naval vessels.

companies.name: Dell, Inc.
companies.description: Dell Inc. is an American technology company based in Round Rock, Texas. It develops, sells, repairs, and supports personal computers, servers, data storage devices, network switches, software, and computer peripherals including printers and webcams.

companies.name: Oracle Corporation
companies.description: Oracle Corporation is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Austin, Texas. Founded in 1977 in Santa Clara, California, it is among the 50 largest companies in the world by market capitalization.

companies.name: Nissan
companies.description: Nissan Motor Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational automobile manufacturer headquartered in Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan. It sells vehicles under the Nissan and Infiniti brands and has in-house performance tuning products under the Nismo and Autech brands.

companies.name: ArcelorMittal
companies.description: ArcelorMittal S.A. is a multinational steel manufacturing corporation headquartered in Luxembourg City. It operates in iron ore and coke mining as well as scrap recycling and was the largest steelmaker worldwide until 2019.

companies.name: Gap Inc.
companies.description: The Gap, Inc., headquartered in San Francisco, California, is an American multinational clothing and accessories retailer. It operates four primary divisions: Gap, Banana Republic, Old Navy, and Athleta, and is one of the largest apparel retailers in the United States.

companies.name: The Coca-Cola Company
companies.description: The Coca-Cola Company is an American multinational corporation founded in 1892 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It manufactures, sells, and markets soft drinks including Coca-Cola and other non-alcoholic beverage concentrates and syrups.

companies.name: BYD Electronic
companies.description: BYD Company Limited is a Chinese multinational manufacturing conglomerate headquartered in Shenzhen, Guangdong. It is vertically integrated with subsidiaries including BYD Auto and BYD Electronics, producing automobiles, electronic parts, and electric vehicle batteries.

companies.name: Lukoil
companies.description: PJSC Lukoil is a Russian multinational energy corporation headquartered in Moscow. It specializes in extraction, production, transport, and sale of petroleum, natural gas, petroleum products, and electricity.

companies.name: Credit Agricole Group
companies.description: Crédit Agricole Group is a French international banking group known as La banque verte. It is the world's largest cooperative financial institution.

companies.name: BMW
companies.description: Bayerische Motoren Werke AG, trading as BMW Group, is a German multinational manufacturer of luxury vehicles and motorcycles headquartered in Munich. The BMW name originated in 1917 and was transferred to Bayerische Flugzeugwerke AG in 1922.

companies.name: Flex Ltd.
companies.description: Flex Ltd. is a Singaporean multinational manufacturing company specializing in electronics manufacturing services and original design manufacturing. It is the world's third largest EMS and ODM company by revenue. The company has its U.S. corporate headquarters in Austin, Texas, and manufacturing operations in over 30 countries.

companies.name: ABB Group
companies.description: ABB Group is a Swedish-Swiss technology company operating in electrification and automation. It was formed in 1988 from the merger of ASEA of Sweden and Brown, Boveri & Cie of Switzerland. The company focuses on technology solutions in its sectors.

companies.name: METRO Group
companies.description: Metro AG is a German multinational food wholesaler based in Düsseldorf. It supplies hotels, restaurants, caterers, and independent retailers through cash-and-carry stores and direct delivery. Its stores mainly operate under the Metro and Makro brands across 21 countries.

companies.name: Société Générale
companies.description: Société Générale S.A. is a French multinational universal bank and financial services company founded in 1864. It is registered in Paris and headquartered in La Défense. The company operates in the financial services sector globally.

companies.name: Dollar Tree
companies.description: Dollar Tree, Inc. is an American discount variety store chain headquartered in Chesapeake, Virginia. It operates over 9,000 stores across the contiguous U.S. and Canada, supported by a nationwide logistics network of 24 distribution centers.

companies.name: Lufthansa Group
companies.description: Deutsche Lufthansa AG, trading as Lufthansa Group, is a German aviation holding company. Its principal airline, Lufthansa German Airlines, is the flag carrier of Germany. Lufthansa Group is a founding member of Star Alliance, the world's largest airline alliance.

companies.name: Xerox
companies.description: Xerox Holdings Corporation is an American company selling printers and digital document products worldwide. It pioneered the photocopier market with the Xerox 914 in 1959. The company is headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut, with its largest employee base around Rochester, New York.

companies.name: Tyson Foods
companies.description: Tyson Foods, Inc. is an American multinational food industry corporation based in Springdale, Arkansas. It is the world's second-largest processor and marketer of chicken, beef, and pork. The company operates major food brands including Tyson, Jimmy Dean, and Hillshire Farm.

companies.name: Telefónica
companies.description: Telefónica, S.A. is a Spanish multinational telecommunications company headquartered in Madrid. It is one of the largest telephone operators and mobile network providers globally. Telefónica provides fixed and mobile telephony, broadband, and subscription television services in Europe and the Americas.

companies.name: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria
companies.description: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A. (BBVA) is a Spanish multinational financial services company headquartered in Bilbao with offices in Madrid. It is one of the largest financial institutions globally, with core markets in Spain, Mexico, South America, and Turkey.

companies.name: Itaúsa
companies.description: Itaúsa is a Brazilian multinational conglomerate holding company headquartered in São Paulo. Founded in 1966, it controls several companies active in finance, real estate, industrial, health, chemical, and fashion sectors. Notably, Itaúsa controls Itaú Unibanco, Duratex, and Alpargatas S.A.

companies.name: Fresenius Medical Care
companies.description: Fresenius Medical Care AG & Co. KGaA is a German healthcare company providing kidney dialysis services through a network of outpatient centers. It primarily treats end-stage renal disease requiring lifelong dialysis. The company operates 4,171 dialysis centers serving over 345,000 patients.

companies.name: Geely Auto
companies.description: Geely Automobile Holdings Limited, known as Geely Auto, is a publicly traded automotive company incorporated in the Cayman Islands. Predominantly owned by Zhejiang Geely Holding, it owns the Geely Auto brand and partly owns Lynk & Co, Proton Cars, and Zeekr brands. It is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Evergrande Group
companies.description: The China Evergrande Group was a Chinese property development company and the second largest property developer in China by sales before its dissolution in 2024. It was the most valuable real estate company worldwide and its collapse in 2021 triggered the ongoing Chinese property sector crisis.

companies.name: Johnson Controls
companies.description: Johnson Controls International plc is an American multinational conglomerate headquartered in Cork, Ireland. It produces fire, HVAC, and security equipment for buildings and employed 105,000 people across six continents as of 2019. The company was listed in the Fortune Global 500 in 2017.

companies.name: Atos SE
companies.description: Atos SE is a European multinational IT service and consulting company headquartered in Bezons, France. It specializes in hi-tech transactional services, unified communications, cloud, big data, and cybersecurity. The company operates worldwide under the brands Atos, Syntel, and Eviden.

companies.name: Bridgestone
companies.description: Bridgestone Corporation is a Japanese multinational tire and rubber manufacturing company based in Kyōbashi, Tokyo. Founded in 1931, it manufactures tires for automobiles, bicycles, motorcycles, and airplanes, as well as golf equipment. The company name is derived from a translation of the founder's surname.

companies.name: Life Insurance Corporation of India
companies.description: The Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) is an Indian public sector life insurance company headquartered in Mumbai. It is India's largest insurance company and institutional investor, owned by the Government of India and under the Ministry of Finance's control.

companies.name: Surgutneftegas
companies.description: Surgutneftegas is a Russian oil and gas company headquartered in Surgut, Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug. It was created by merging several state-owned companies with large oil and gas reserves in Western Siberia. In 2020, it was ranked as the 251st-largest public company globally by Forbes.

companies.name: Bank of Brazil
companies.description: Banco do Brasil S.A. is a Brazilian financial services company headquartered in Brasília. Founded in 1808, it is the oldest bank in Brazil and among the oldest in continuous operation worldwide. It is the second largest banking institution in Brazil and Latin America, controlled by the Brazilian government.

companies.name: WPP plc
companies.description: WPP plc is a British multinational holding company specializing in communications, advertising, public relations, technology, and commerce. Headquartered in London, it is the world's largest advertising company as of 2023 and owns numerous advertising and media agencies including Ogilvy and EssenceMediacom.

companies.name: Meituan
companies.description: Meituan is a Chinese technology company based in Beijing that operates a platform for local services such as on-demand food delivery, in-store services, hotel and travel bookings, and instant retail. Founded in 2010, it launched its initial public offering on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2018.

companies.name: Jerónimo Martins
companies.description: Jerónimo Martins SGPS, SA is a Portuguese corporate group operating in food distribution and specialized retail. It manages more than 6,500 stores across Portugal, Poland, Slovakia, and Colombia.

companies.name: Magna International
companies.description: Magna International Inc. is a Canadian automotive supplier and one of the largest companies in Canada. It is the largest manufacturer of original equipment automobile parts in North America and supplies major automakers including General Motors, Ford, BMW, and Tesla.

companies.name: Nippon Steel Corporation
companies.description: Nippon Steel Corporation is a Japanese steel manufacturing company headquartered in Tokyo. It operates in steelmaking, engineering, chemicals, and systems solutions, and is the largest producer of crude steel in Japan and the fourth largest worldwide.

companies.name: Michelin
companies.description: Compagnie Générale des Établissements Michelin SCA, known as Michelin, is a French multinational tyre manufacturer based in Clermont-Ferrand, France.

companies.name: Procter & Gamble
companies.description: The Procter & Gamble Company (P&G) is an American multinational consumer goods corporation headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio. It was founded in 1837 by William Procter and James Gamble.

companies.name: Traton
companies.description: Traton SE is a subsidiary of Volkswagen Group and one of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers. It owns brands such as Scania, MAN, and Volkswagen Truck & Bus, producing light to heavy-duty trucks, vans, and buses, and offers digital services under the RIO brand.

companies.name: Ericsson
companies.description: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson is a Swedish multinational networking and telecommunications company headquartered in Stockholm. It is a leader in 5G technology and holds over 57,000 patents, including the invention of Bluetooth technology.

companies.name: BT Group
companies.description: BT Group plc is a British multinational telecommunications holding company headquartered in London. It operates in around 180 countries and is the largest provider of fixed-line, broadband, and mobile services in the UK, also offering subscription television and IT services.

companies.name: Caterpillar Inc.
companies.description: Caterpillar Inc. is an American manufacturer specializing in construction, mining, and other engineering equipment. It is recognized as the world's largest manufacturer of construction equipment. The company is also a component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average.

companies.name: Associated British Foods
companies.description: Associated British Foods plc is a British multinational company headquartered in London. It operates in the food processing and retailing industry. The company is known for its diverse food-related businesses.

companies.name: AB Volvo
companies.description: Volvo Group is a Swedish multinational manufacturing corporation based in Gothenburg. It produces and sells trucks, buses, and construction equipment, and also supplies marine and industrial drive systems and financial services. In 2016, it was the world's second-largest manufacturer of heavy-duty trucks.

companies.name: Deutsche Bank
companies.description: Deutsche Bank AG is a German multinational banking institution headquartered in Frankfurt. It is dual-listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and the New York Stock Exchange. The bank provides a wide range of financial services globally.

companies.name: Publicis
companies.description: Publicis Groupe S.A. is a French multinational advertising and public relations company based in Paris. It is the largest advertising company in the world by revenue as of 2024. The company provides digital and traditional advertising, media, and marketing services.

companies.name: Aisin Seiki
companies.description: Aisin Corporation is a Japanese company that develops and produces automotive components and systems. It is a member of the Toyota Group and was ranked 359 on the Fortune Global 500 in 2020. The company serves the automotive industry worldwide.

companies.name: China Life Insurance Company
companies.description: China Life Insurance Company Limited is a life insurance provider headquartered in Beijing, China. It is the largest life insurer in China by market share as of April 2023 and was ranked 62nd in the Forbes Global 2000 in 2023. The company offers life insurance and annuity products.

companies.name: Fujitsu
companies.description: Fujitsu Limited is a Japanese multinational information and communications technology company headquartered in Kawasaki, Kanagawa. Established in 1935, it is the world's sixth-largest IT services provider by revenue and the largest in Japan as of 2021.

companies.name: DuPont
companies.description: DuPont de Nemours, Inc. is a Delaware-headquartered company producing products for healthcare, water, construction, and industrial markets. Founded in 1802 by Éleuthère Irénée du Pont de Nemours, it has a long history in chemical production and innovation.

companies.name: Kodak
companies.description: Eastman Kodak Company is an American public company headquartered in Rochester, New York, and incorporated in New Jersey. It produces products related to its historic roots in film photography and is best known for bringing photographic film products to the mass market.

companies.name: VTB Bank
companies.description: VTB Bank is a Russian majority state-owned bank with headquarters in various federal districts of Russia and a legal address in Saint Petersburg. Over 90% of its capital stock was owned by three Russian agencies as of 2022. It operates in the financial sector.

companies.name: Webuild
companies.description: Webuild S.p.A. is an Italian industrial group specializing in construction and civil engineering. Founded in 2014 through the merger of Salini and Impregilo, it is one of the largest Italian construction groups. The company operates in the construction industry.

companies.name: Bath & Body Works, Inc.
companies.description: Bath & Body Works, Inc. is an American specialty retail company based in Columbus, Ohio. It owns the Bath & Body Works brand and was listed on the 2024 Fortune 500 list of largest US companies by revenue. The company operates in the retail sector.

companies.name: Eaton Corporation
companies.description: Eaton Corporation plc is an American-Irish multinational power management company headquartered in Dublin with a primary administrative center in Beachwood, Ohio. It sells products to customers in more than 175 countries and employs over 85,000 people. Eaton operates in industrial manufacturing.

companies.name: Whole Foods Market
companies.description: Whole Foods Market, Inc. is an American multinational supermarket chain headquartered in Austin, Texas. It sells whole food products free from hydrogenated fats and artificial additives and is a USDA Certified Organic grocer in the US. The company operates in the food industry.

companies.name: LG Electronics
companies.description: LG Electronics Inc. is a South Korean multinational major appliance and consumer electronics corporation headquartered in Seoul. It is part of LG Corporation and comprises four business units including Home Appliance and Media Entertainment Solutions. The company operates in wholesale trade of household appliances.

companies.name: CGI Group
companies.description: CGI is a multinational information technology consulting and software development company headquartered in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. It went public in 1986 and is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and New York Stock Exchange. CGI operates in information technology consulting.

companies.name: Yum! Brands
companies.description: Yum! Brands, Inc. is an American multinational fast food corporation based in Louisville, Kentucky. It operates KFC, Taco Bell, Habit Burger & Grill, and several technology companies. It is the world's second largest fast food restaurant chain by gross revenues as of 2024.

companies.name: Bank Rakyat Indonesia
companies.description: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk, known as Bank BRI, is one of the largest banks in Indonesia. It specializes in small scale and microfinance borrowing and lending through over 8,600 branches and service posts. As of 2022, it is the second largest bank in Indonesia by asset.

companies.name: KazMunayGas
companies.description: KazMunayGas is the state-owned oil and gas company of Kazakhstan. Founded in 2002, it was created by merging CJSC Kazakhoil and CJSC Oil&Gas Transportation. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

companies.name: China Shenhua Energy Company
companies.description: China Shenhua Energy Company Limited is the largest state-owned coal mining enterprise in mainland China and the world. It operates coal mines, an integrated railway network, a seaport, and power plants primarily in the People's Republic of China. It is a subsidiary of Shenhua Group.

companies.name: Scotiabank
companies.description: Scotiabank, officially The Bank of Nova Scotia, is a Canadian multinational banking and financial services company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. It is one of Canada's Big Five banks and offers personal, commercial, wealth management, corporate, and investment services globally.

companies.name: E.ON
companies.description: E.ON SE is a German multinational electric utility company based in Essen, Germany. It is one of the world's largest investor-owned electric utility service providers and is a component of the DAX stock index.

companies.name: Anglo American plc
companies.description: Anglo American plc is a British multinational mining company headquartered in London, England. It is the world's largest producer of platinum and also produces diamonds, copper, nickel, iron ore, polyhalite, and steelmaking coal. The company operates across multiple continents.

companies.name: Cisco
companies.description: Cisco Systems, Inc., known as Cisco, is an American multinational technology conglomerate headquartered in San Jose, California. It develops, manufactures, and sells hardware, software, telecommunications equipment, and other high-technology products focused on networking, cybersecurity, and AI.

companies.name: Air France-KLM
companies.description: Air France–KLM S.A. is a French–Dutch multinational airline holding company headquartered in Paris, France. It was formed by the 2004 merger of Air France and KLM and operates major hubs at Paris–Charles de Gaulle, Paris Orly, and Amsterdam Schiphol airports.

companies.name: Standard Chartered
companies.description: Standard Chartered PLC is a British multinational bank that operates in wealth management, corporate and investment banking, and treasury services. It is headquartered in the United Kingdom.

companies.name: Medtronic plc
companies.description: Medtronic plc is an international medical device company with legal and executive headquarters in Ireland and operational headquarters in Minneapolis, Minnesota. It develops and manufactures healthcare technologies and therapies and operates in more than 150 countries.

companies.name: Marks & Spencer
companies.description: Marks and Spencer p.l.c. is a major British multinational retailer based in London, England. It specializes in clothing, beauty, home, and food products and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: U.S. Steel
companies.description: United States Steel Corporation is a Japanese-owned American steel company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It produces and sells steel products including flat-rolled and tubular products for various industries. In 2025, it was acquired by Nippon Steel in a deal arranged with the US government.

companies.name: Audi AG
companies.description: Audi AG is a German automotive manufacturer of luxury vehicles headquartered in Ingolstadt, Bavaria. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Volkswagen Group and operates nine production facilities worldwide.

companies.name: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Limited
companies.description: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited (CATL) is a Chinese battery manufacturer founded in 2011, specializing in lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage systems. It is the largest EV and energy storage battery manufacturer globally, headquartered in Ningde, Fujian province.

companies.name: Thales Group
companies.description: Thales Group is a French multinational aerospace and defence corporation specializing in electronics. It designs and manufactures aerospace and military systems and operates in cybersecurity. The company is headquartered in Paris' La Défense business district.

companies.name: TE Connectivity
companies.description: TE Connectivity plc is an Irish-incorporated multinational company that designs and manufactures electrical connectors, sensors, and electronic components. Its products serve automotive, aerospace, defence, medical, energy, industrial automation, and data center industries.

companies.name: Great Wall Motor
companies.description: Great Wall Motor Company Limited (GWM) is a Chinese automobile manufacturer headquartered in Baoding, Hebei. It produces SUVs, pick-up trucks, and trucks, ranking among the top ten Chinese automobile manufacturers.

companies.name: Hochtief
companies.description: Hochtief AG is a global provider of infrastructure technology and construction services based in Essen, Germany. It operates primarily in high tech, energy transition, and sustainable infrastructure, with international projects accounting for 95% of its revenue.

companies.name: Linde Group
companies.description: Linde plc is a global multinational chemical company and the world's largest industrial gas supplier. Founded in 1879 in Germany, it is now headquartered in Woking, UK, and registered in Ireland. Linde plc was formed in 2018 through the merger of Linde AG and Praxair.

companies.name: Philip Morris International
companies.description: Philip Morris International Inc. is an American publicly traded tobacco company with products sold in over 180 countries. Marlboro is its most recognized brand, and Iqos generated the greatest revenue in late 2023. It is considered part of Big Tobacco.

companies.name: Tata Steel
companies.description: Tata Steel Limited is an Indian multinational steel company headquartered in Mumbai and part of the Tata Group. Established in 1907 in Jamshedpur, it was formerly known as Tata Iron and Steel Company Limited (TISCO).

companies.name: Morgan Stanley
companies.description: Morgan Stanley is an American multinational banking institution headquartered in New York City. It is the sixth-largest bank in the United States and operates regional offices in 42 countries worldwide. The bank is considered a systemically important financial institution by the Financial Stability Board.

companies.name: TCL Technology
companies.description: TCL Technology Group Corp. is a Chinese partially state-owned electronics company headquartered in Huizhou, Guangdong province. It develops, manufactures, and sells consumer electronics including televisions, mobile phones, and home appliances. TCL was the second-largest television manufacturer by market share in 2022 and 2023.

companies.name: Kyocera
companies.description: Kyocera Corporation is a Japanese multinational ceramics and electronics manufacturer headquartered in Kyoto, Japan. Founded in 1959 as Kyoto Ceramic Company, Limited, it was renamed Kyocera in 1982. The company operates in the ceramics and electronics industry.

companies.name: Gazprom Neft
companies.description: Gazprom Neft is the third largest oil producer in Russia and ranks third in refining throughput. It is a subsidiary of Gazprom, which owns about 96% of its shares. The company is registered and headquartered in St. Petersburg after relocating its central offices from Moscow in 2011.

companies.name: Lenovo
companies.description: Lenovo Group Limited is a Hong Kong–based Chinese multinational technology company specializing in designing, manufacturing, and marketing consumer electronics, personal computers, and enterprise infrastructure solutions. Its global headquarters are in Beijing, China, and Morrisville, North Carolina, USA. Lenovo owns the smartphone brand Motorola.

companies.name: Nike
companies.description: Nike, Inc. is an American athletic footwear and apparel corporation headquartered near Beaverton, Oregon. It is the world's largest supplier of athletic shoes and apparel and a major manufacturer of sports equipment.

companies.name: Western Digital
companies.description: Western Digital Corporation, known as WD, is an American data storage company headquartered in San Jose, California. Established in 1970, it is one of the world's largest manufacturers of hard disk drives (HDDs).

companies.name: Aeon
companies.description: Aeon Co., Ltd., formerly Jusco Co., Ltd., is a Japanese diversified retail holding company. It owns Aeon hypermarkets, shopping malls, supermarkets, convenience stores, drugstores, movie theaters, and a bank, making it one of the largest retail companies in Japan.

companies.name: Fujifilm Corporation
companies.description: Fujifilm Holdings Corporation, trading as Fujifilm, is a Japanese multinational conglomerate headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It operates in photography, optics, office and medical electronics, biotechnology, and chemicals.

companies.name: China Taiping Insurance Holdings
companies.description: China Taiping Insurance Holdings Company Limited is a Chinese insurance conglomerate incorporated in Hong Kong with strong Chinese Central Government background. It is considered a red chip company.

companies.name: Lloyds Banking Group
companies.description: Lloyds Banking Group plc is a British financial institution formed in 2009 through the acquisition of HBOS by Lloyds TSB. It is one of the UK's largest financial services organizations, with roots dating back to 1695 through the Bank of Scotland.

companies.name: Assicurazioni Generali
companies.description: Assicurazioni Generali S.p.A., known as Generali Group, is an Italian insurance company based in Trieste. It is the largest insurance company in Italy and ranks among the world's largest by net premiums and assets.

companies.name: Seiko Epson
companies.description: Seiko Epson Corporation, commonly known as Epson, is a Japanese multinational headquartered in Suwa, Nagano. It is one of the world's largest manufacturers of printers and imaging-related equipment, producing a wide range of electronic components and devices.

companies.name: International Airlines Group
companies.description: International Consolidated Airlines Group S.A. (IAG) is an Anglo-Spanish multinational airline holding company with offices in Madrid and London. It was formed in 2011 after a merger between British Airways and Iberia, which became wholly owned subsidiaries.

companies.name: Novo
companies.description: Novo Nordisk A/S, operating as Novo, is a Danish multinational pharmaceutical company. It was created in 1989 through a merger of two Danish pharmaceutical companies and focuses on obesity and diabetes medications and devices.

companies.name: The Cigna Group
companies.description: The Cigna Group is an American multinational managed healthcare and insurance company based in Bloomfield, Connecticut. It provides medical, dental, disability, life, and accident insurance products primarily through employers and groups.

companies.name: Nornickel
companies.description: Norilsk Nickel, or Nornickel, is a Russian nickel and palladium mining and smelting company. Its largest operations are near the Yenisei River in Siberia, with additional holdings in Finland, South Africa, and the Kola Peninsula.

companies.name: WSP Global
companies.description: WSP is a Canadian engineering and professional services consulting firm providing technical and advisory services for built and natural environment projects. It is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and part of major Canadian stock indices.

companies.name: Nordstrom
companies.description: Nordstrom, Inc. is an American upmarket department store chain headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Founded in 1901 as a shoe store, it expanded into clothing and off-price retailing, operating full-line and off-price divisions across the United States.

companies.name: ZTE
companies.description: ZTE Corporation is a Chinese partially state-owned technology company specializing in telecommunications. Founded in 1985, it is listed on the Hong Kong and Shenzhen Stock Exchanges.

companies.name: Strabag
companies.description: Strabag is an Austrian international technology group for the built environment headquartered in Vienna. It is the largest construction company in Austria and operates in various European countries, the Arabian Peninsula, Australia, Canada, Chile, China, India, and Africa. The company has subsidiaries or operates on a project basis in these markets.

companies.name: CRH
companies.description: CRH plc is an American-Irish building materials provider headquartered in Dublin and New York. It produces construction materials such as aggregates, cement, ready-mixed concrete, and asphalt concrete. CRH operates nearly 4,000 locations across 28 countries including North America, Europe, Australia, and the Philippines.

companies.name: Sistema
companies.description: AFK Sistema PAO is a large Russian conglomerate founded by Vladimir Yevtushenkov. In April 2022, Yevtushenkov's shareholding decreased to 49.2% and he stepped down from the board of directors. The company is based in Russia and operates as a diversified conglomerate.

companies.name: Maanshan Iron & Steel Company Limited
companies.industry: iron and steel industry in communist china
companies.description: Maanshan Iron & Steel Company Limited, known as Masteel, is a Chinese steel manufacturing company based in Ma'anshan, Anhui province. Established in 1993, it was controlled by Chinese governments and since June 2019 is indirectly owned by China Baowu Steel Group. The company is listed and operates in the steel industry.

companies.name: Mechel
companies.description: Mechel is a Russian mining and metals company headquartered in Moscow. It produces coal, iron ore concentrate, steel, and rolled steel products. The company sells its products domestically and internationally and is formally known as Public Joint Stock Company Mechel.

companies.name: SABMiller
companies.description: SABMiller plc was an Anglo–South African multinational brewing and beverage company headquartered in Woking, England. It was the world's second-largest brewer by revenue and a major Coca-Cola bottler. The company operated in 80 countries and was acquired by AB InBev in 2016.

companies.name: Country Garden
companies.description: Country Garden is a real estate development company headquartered in Shunde, Foshan, Guangdong, China. It is owned by the family of Yang Guoqiang. The company operates in the real estate sector in China.

companies.name: Halliburton
companies.description: Halliburton Company is an American multinational corporation and the world's second-largest oil service company. It is responsible for most of the world's fracking operations and has dual headquarters in Houston and Dubai. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

companies.name: T-Bank
companies.description: T-Bank, formerly Tinkoff Bank, is a Russian commercial bank based in Moscow founded in 2006 by Oleg Tinkov. It operated as a neobank without branches until 2024 and is the second largest credit card provider in Russia. It is one of the world's largest digital banks by customer count.

companies.name: RusHydro
companies.description: RusHydro is a Russian hydroelectricity company headquartered in Moscow. It was the world's second-largest hydroelectric power producer in 2009 and is Russia's largest power-generating company. The company underwent major consolidation starting in 2007 and is partly government-owned.

companies.name: Virgin Group
companies.description: Virgin Group Limited is a British multinational venture capital conglomerate based in London, England. Founded by Richard Branson and Nik Powell in February 1970, it is classified as a holding company with commercial activities dating back to the 1970s.

companies.name: Quanta Computer
companies.description: Quanta Computer Incorporated is a Taiwanese contract manufacturer of electronic hardware. It operates in the information technology sector and is based in Taiwan.

companies.name: Suzuki Motor Corporation
companies.description: Suzuki Motor Corporation is a Japanese multinational mobility manufacturer headquartered in Hamamatsu, Shizuoka. It produces automobiles, motorcycles, ATVs, outboard marine engines, wheelchairs, and various small internal combustion engines.

companies.name: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries
companies.description: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Ltd. is a Japanese multinational engineering, electrical equipment, and electronics corporation headquartered in Tokyo. It is a core company of the Mitsubishi Group and its automobile division preceded Mitsubishi Motors.

companies.name: U.S. Bancorp
companies.description: U.S. Bancorp is an American multinational banking institution headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, and incorporated in Delaware. It is the parent company of U.S. Bank National Association and provides banking, investment, mortgage, trust, and payment services.

companies.name: McKesson Corporation
companies.description: McKesson Corporation is an American publicly traded company headquartered in Irving, Texas. It distributes pharmaceuticals and provides health information technology, medical supplies, and health management tools, delivering a third of all pharmaceutical products used in North America.

companies.name: Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc.
companies.description: Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is an American life science and clinical research company based in Waltham, Massachusetts. It supplies analytical instruments, clinical development solutions, specialty diagnostics, and biotechnology services, formed through a 2006 merger.

companies.name: Sysco
companies.description: Sysco is an American multinational corporation headquartered in Houston, Texas. It sells, markets, and distributes food products and foodservice supplies to restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, sports stadiums, and other venues.

companies.name: Bureau Veritas
companies.description: Bureau Veritas S.A. is a French company specializing in testing, inspection, and certification, founded in 1828. It operates across sectors including building, agri-food, marine, industry, certification, consumer products, and education.

companies.name: Northrop Grumman Corporation
companies.description: Northrop Grumman Corporation is an American aerospace and defense company headquartered in West Falls Church, Virginia. It designs and manufactures systems for aeronautics, defense, missions, and space, and is the fifth-largest contractor of the U.S. federal government.

companies.name: TSMC
companies.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited is a Taiwanese multinational semiconductor contract manufacturing and design company headquartered in Hsinchu Science Park. It holds about 70% of the global semiconductor foundry market share and is the main supplier for major tech companies like Nvidia and Apple. The company has grown rapidly due to the AI boom.

companies.name: Aon plc
companies.description: Aon plc is an international professional services firm based in the United Kingdom. It has two divisions: Risk Capital, offering brokerage and consulting for risk management and insurance, and Human Capital, providing services related to health insurance, retirement, and talent advisory.

companies.name: Mahindra & Mahindra
companies.description: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited is an Indian automobile manufacturer headquartered in Mumbai. Established in 1945, it is part of the Mahindra Group and is one of the largest SUV manufacturers in India. It also leads globally in tractor production and manufactures commercial vehicles through subsidiaries.

companies.name: Sprint Corporation
companies.description: Sprint Corporation was an American telecommunications company and the fourth-largest mobile network operator in the US before its acquisition by T-Mobile US in 2020. It provided wireless voice, messaging, and broadband services through subsidiaries like Boost Mobile and Open Mobile.

companies.name: Rusal
companies.description: United Company Rusal is a Russian aluminum company and was the world's largest primary aluminum producer until 2016. It accounts for nearly 9% of global primary aluminum and alumina production and was founded by industrialist Oleg Deripaska.

companies.name: American Express
companies.description: American Express Company is an American multinational financial services corporation specializing in payment cards. It is headquartered at 200 Vesey Street in Lower Manhattan and announced plans in 2026 to develop and occupy the new 2 World Trade Center skyscraper.

companies.name: Japan Tobacco
companies.description: Japan Tobacco Inc. is a Japanese diversified tobacco company and parent to Japan Tobacco International, one of the largest global tobacco manufacturers. Established in 1985, it also operates in pharmaceuticals and food and beverage sectors, acquiring food manufacturer Katokichi in 2008.

companies.name: Lafarge
companies.description: Lafarge is a French industrial company specializing in cement, construction aggregates, and concrete. Founded in 1833, it is the world's largest cement manufacturer and is part of the Holcim Group.

companies.name: Mobile TeleSystems
companies.description: Mobile TeleSystems (MTS) is the largest telecommunications company and mobile network operator in Russia and Belarus, headquartered in Moscow. It operates on GSM, UMTS, LTE, and 5G standards and offers various services including local telephone, broadband, and multiple television formats.

companies.name: Pilgrim's Corp
companies.description: Pilgrim's Pride Corporation is an American multinational food company and one of the largest chicken producers in the US and Puerto Rico, as well as the second-largest in Mexico. It emerged from bankruptcy in 2009, relocated its US headquarters to Colorado in 2011, and is majority-owned by Brazilian JBS S.A.

companies.name: Goodyear Tire and Rubber Company
companies.description: The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company is an American multinational tire manufacturer headquartered in Akron, Ohio. It produces tires for various vehicles including automobiles, motorcycles, trucks, and aviation. The company also licenses its brand to bicycle tire manufacturers, resuming production after a break from 1976 to 2015.

companies.name: Commerzbank AG
companies.industry: financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
companies.description: Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft is a European banking institution headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, Germany. It provides financial services to private, business, and corporate customers. The Commerzbank Group includes the Polish subsidiary mBank.

companies.name: Eurofins Scientific
companies.description: Eurofins Scientific SE is a French group of laboratories headquartered in Luxembourg. It offers testing and support services to industries such as pharmaceutical, food, environmental, agriscience, consumer products, and governments.

companies.name: JD.com
companies.description: JD.com, Inc., also known as Jingdong Group, is a Chinese multinational technology company specializing in e-commerce, retail, internet, and technology. Headquartered in Beijing, it is one of China's largest online retailers and competes with Alibaba's Tmall. Its business spans retail, technology, logistics, healthcare, industrials, property management, private label, insurance, and international business.

companies.name: Baxter International
companies.description: Baxter International Inc. is an American multinational healthcare company headquartered in Deerfield, Illinois. It operates in the medical equipment industry.

companies.name: Alcoa
companies.description: Alcoa Corporation is an American industrial corporation producing aluminum. It operates in 10 countries and is involved in mining, refining, smelting, fabricating, and recycling aluminum products. It is among the largest aluminum producers globally.

companies.name: Fast Retailing
companies.description: Fast Retailing Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational retail holding company. It owns several brands including Uniqlo, J Brand, Comptoir des Cotonniers, GU, Princesse tam.tam, and Theory.

companies.name: Indra Sistemas
companies.description: Indra Sistemas, S.A., also known as Indra Group, is a Spanish company specializing in information technology, transport technology, and defense. It is listed on the Bolsa de Madrid and is part of the IBEX 35 index.

companies.name: Mobile World Investment Corporation
companies.description: Mobile World Investment Corporation is a Vietnamese publicly listed retailer operating nationwide chains including thegioididong.com, Dien May Xanh, Bach Hoa Xanh grocery, and An Khang pharmacies. It is listed on the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange since 2014.

companies.name: Tatneft
companies.description: Tatneft is a Russian vertically integrated oil and gas company headquartered in Almetyevsk, Republic of Tatarstan. It is the fifth largest oil company in Russia and was ranked 539th in the 2020 Forbes Global 2000 list.

companies.name: Baker Hughes
companies.description: Baker Hughes Company is an American global energy technology company co-headquartered in Houston, Texas and London, UK. It provides products and services to the oil and gas industry for exploration and production, as well as other energy and industrial applications. The company operates in over 120 countries worldwide.

companies.name: Boston Scientific
companies.description: Boston Scientific Corporation is an American biotechnology and biomedical engineering firm that manufactures medical devices used in various interventional medical specialties. These include interventional radiology, cardiology, neuromodulation, and oncology among others. It is a multinational company based in the United States.

companies.name: International Paper
companies.description: The International Paper Company is an American pulp and paper company headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee. It is the largest pulp and paper company in the world. The company employs approximately 39,000 people.

companies.name: Seagate Technology
companies.description: Seagate Technology Holdings plc is an American multinational data storage company incorporated in Dublin, Ireland since 2010. It was originally incorporated as Shugart Technology in 1978 and began business in 1979. Its operational headquarters are in Fremont, California, United States.

companies.name: Acciona
companies.description: Acciona, S.A. is a Spanish multinational conglomerate focused on infrastructure development and renewable energy management. Through its subsidiary Acciona Energía, it produces 21 terawatt-hours of renewable electricity annually. The company is based in Spain.

companies.name: Korian
companies.industry: accommodation facility for dependent elderly people
companies.description: Korian is a French company specializing in nursing home care for the elderly, known as EHPAD in France. It operates nursing homes in six European countries. The company is based in France.

companies.name: Parker Hannifin
companies.description: Parker-Hannifin Corporation is an American multinational industrial manufacturing company specializing in motion and control technologies. Founded in 1917, it is headquartered in Mayfield Heights, Ohio. The company employs about 61,000 people globally and is one of the largest in its sector.

companies.name: JFE Holdings
companies.description: JFE Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese corporation headquartered in Tokyo, formed in 2002 by the merger of NKK and Kawasaki Steel Corporation. It owns JFE Steel, JFE Engineering, and Japan Marine United. The company is part of the iron and steel industry.

companies.name: Baoshan Iron & Steel
companies.description: Baoshan Iron & Steel Co., Ltd., also known as Baosteel, is a steel manufacturer based in Shanghai, China. It is a subsidiary of the state-owned China Baowu Steel Group and is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Skanska
companies.description: Skanska AB is a multinational construction and development company based in Sweden. It was established in 1887 originally as a concrete product manufacturer. The company operates in the construction industry.

companies.name: Seven & I Holdings Co.
companies.description: Seven & I Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japanese diversified retail holdings company headquartered in Tokyo. It was established in 2005 by integrating Ito-Yokado, Seven-Eleven Japan, and Denny's Japan to create a holding company for these entities. The formation was driven by the contrasting performance of its parent and subsidiary companies.

companies.name: MAN SE
companies.description: MAN SE was a manufacturing and engineering company based in Munich, Germany. It specialized in commercial vehicles and diesel engines through its divisions MAN Truck & Bus and MAN Latin America, and had a stake in the manufacturer Sinotruk.

companies.name: Yamaha Motor Company
companies.description: Yamaha Motor Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational mobility manufacturer founded in 1955. It produces a wide range of motorized products including motorcycles, motorboats, outboard motors, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

companies.name: HP Inc.
companies.description: HP Inc. is an American multinational information technology company headquartered in Palo Alto, California. It develops personal computers, printers, related supplies, and 3D printing services. It ranks as the world's second-largest personal computer vendor by unit sales as of 2024.

companies.name: Jacobs Engineering Group
companies.description: Jacobs Solutions Inc. is an American international technical professional services firm based in Dallas. It offers engineering, technical, professional, construction, scientific, and specialty consulting services globally. The company has been ranked No. 1 on Engineering News-Record's Top 500 Design Firms for multiple years.

companies.name: MinebeaMitsumi
companies.description: MinebeaMitsumi, Inc. is a Japanese multinational manufacturer of mechanical components and electronic devices. Its headquarters are in Higashi-Shinbashi, Minato, Tokyo, with a registered office in Miyota, Nagano.

companies.name: Iran Khodro
companies.description: Iran Khodro, branded as IKCO, is an Iranian automaker headquartered in Tehran. Founded in 1962 as Iran National, it manufactures vehicles including Samand, Peugeot, Renault cars, trucks, minibuses, and buses.

companies.name: TDK
companies.description: TDK Corporation is a Japanese multinational electronics corporation that manufactures electronic components and recording and data-storage media. The company operates under the motto "Contribute to culture and industry through creativity."

companies.name: Heidelberg Materials
companies.description: Heidelberg Materials is a German multinational building materials company headquartered in Heidelberg. Formerly HeidelbergCement AG, it rebranded in 2022 and is one of the world's largest building materials companies. It acquired a 45% share in Italcementi in 2016, becoming a leading producer in construction aggregates and cement.

companies.name: Motorola
companies.description: Motorola, Inc. was an American multinational telecommunications company based in Schaumburg, Illinois. Founded in 1928 as Galvin Manufacturing Corporation, it produced radio-related communication equipment and was split into Motorola Solutions and Motorola Mobility in 2011.

companies.name: Zurich Insurance Group
companies.description: Zurich Insurance Group Ltd. is a Swiss insurance company headquartered in Zürich. It is the largest insurer in Switzerland and was ranked 98th in Forbes' Global 2000s list in 2024. The company was also ranked 94th in Interbrand's top 100 brands in 2011.

companies.name: PNC Financial Services
companies.description: The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. is an American bank holding company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Its subsidiary, PNC Bank, operates in 27 states and the District of Columbia with thousands of branches and ATMs. It is one of the largest banks in the US by assets and branch network.

companies.name: T Plus
companies.description: T Plus is a Russian electricity generation company that is part of the Renova Group. It was formerly known as IES Holding until 2014. The company operates in the power engineering industry in Russia.

companies.name: Henkel KGaA
companies.description: Henkel AG & Co. KGaA, commonly known as Henkel, is a German multinational chemical and consumer goods company headquartered in Düsseldorf. Founded in 1876, it operates two global business units and is known for brands like Loctite and Persil.

companies.name: BCE Inc.
companies.description: BCE Inc. is a Canadian publicly traded holding company for Bell Canada, including telecommunications and mass media assets under Bell Media Inc. Founded in 1983 through a corporate reorganization, it is one of Canada's largest corporations headquartered in Montreal, Quebec.

companies.name: Humana
companies.description: Humana Inc. is an American for-profit health insurance company based in Louisville, Kentucky. In 2024, it ranked 92 on the Fortune 500 list and is the fourth largest health insurance provider in the United States.

companies.name: Inventec
companies.description: Inventec Corporation is a Taiwan-based Original Design Manufacturer producing notebook computers, servers, and mobile devices. Established in 1975 initially for electronic calculators, its major customers include Hewlett-Packard, Toshiba, Acer, and Fujitsu-Siemens.

companies.name: Delivery Hero
companies.description: Delivery Hero SE is a German multinational online food ordering and delivery company headquartered in Berlin. Founded in 2011, it operates in over 60 countries and has expanded into quick commerce for rapid delivery of small orders and groceries.

companies.name: Illinois Tool Works
companies.description: Illinois Tool Works Inc. is an American Fortune 500 company producing engineered fasteners, components, equipment, and specialty products. Founded in 1912, it has grown through a strategy focused on decentralization, simplicity, innovation, and acquisitions.

companies.name: Wistron
companies.description: Wistron Corporation is a Taiwan-based electronics manufacturer formerly part of Acer Inc. It designs and manufactures products such as computers, servers, storage, LCD TVs, handheld devices, and medical equipment for other companies to sell under their brands.

companies.name: Takata Corporation
companies.description: Takata Corporation was a Japanese automotive parts company with production facilities on four continents and European headquarters in Germany. It became known for a massive recall of defective airbag inflators linked to numerous deaths and injuries. The company filed for bankruptcy in 2017 and was acquired by Key Safety Systems.

companies.name: Lenta
companies.description: Lenta is a Russian retail chain operating super- and hypermarkets with 149 locations across Russia. It is one of the country's largest retail chains and the second largest hypermarket chain. The company is based in Russia.

companies.name: D'Ieteren Group
companies.description: D'Ieteren Group SA/NV is a Belgian company engaged in automobile distribution and vehicle glass repair and replacement. It also conducts other industrial activities related to spare parts. The company is based in Belgium.

companies.name: Sharp Corporation
companies.description: Sharp Corporation is a Japanese electronics company headquartered in Sakai, Osaka. Founded in 1912, it was established as Hayakawa Metal Works Institute in 1924. Since 2016, it has been majority owned by Taiwan-based Foxconn.

companies.name: Trubnaya Metallurgicheskaya Kompaniya
