companies.description: TMK is a global manufacturer and supplier of steel pipes and tubular solutions for the oil and gas industry, as well as specialty products for nuclear, chemical, and construction sectors. It operates production assets in Russia, Kazakhstan, Romania, and the Czech Republic, with R&D centers in Russia. The company is based in Moscow, Russia.

companies.name: Sopra Steria
companies.description: Sopra Steria is a European consulting, digital services, and software development company headquartered in Paris. It employs 50,000 consultants and operates in several Western European countries.

companies.name: Raiffeisen Bank International
companies.description: Raiffeisen Bank International is a key entity of the decentralized Raiffeisen Banking Group in Austria. It acts as the group's domestic central financial entity and holding company for operations outside Austria. The bank's major shareholders are eight regional Raiffeisen banks.

companies.name: Air China
companies.description: Air China Limited is the flag carrier airline of the People's Republic of China, headquartered in Shunyi, Beijing. It offers domestic and international flights to various destinations within China and worldwide.

companies.name: Severstal
companies.description: Severstal is a Russian company operating mainly in the steel and mining industry, headquartered in Cherepovets. It is the largest steel company in Russia and is listed on the Moscow Exchange and LSE. The company is majority-owned by Alexey Mordashov.

companies.name: BorgWarner
companies.description: BorgWarner Inc. is an American automotive and e-mobility supplier headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan. It operates 92 production facilities in 24 countries and is among the 25 largest automotive suppliers worldwide. Joseph F. Fadool became CEO in February 2025.

companies.name: Mazda
companies.description: Mazda Motor Corporation is a Japanese multinational automotive manufacturer headquartered in Fuchū, Hiroshima, Japan. Founded in 1920 as a cork-making factory, it started producing vehicles in 1931. The company was originally named Toyo Cork Kogyo Co., Ltd. before changing to Toyo Kogyo Co., Ltd.

companies.name: PJSC Inter RAO
companies.description: Joint Stock Company Inter RAO UES is a diversified energy holding company headquartered in Moscow, Russia. It operates in power and heat generation, electricity supply, international energy trading, and electric power infrastructure development. The company holds a monopoly on electricity export and import in Russia.

companies.name: China Unicom
companies.description: China United Network Communications Group Co., Ltd., known as China Unicom, is a Chinese state-owned telecommunications operator founded in 1994. It provides mobile network, calling, data communication, internet services, digital television, and IP telephony. It is the third-largest wireless carrier in China and sixth largest worldwide.

companies.name: Electrolux
companies.description: Electrolux AB is a Swedish multinational home appliance manufacturer headquartered in Stockholm. It is ranked as the world's second largest appliance maker by units sold, following Whirlpool. The company specializes in producing a wide range of home appliances.

companies.name: Gerdau
companies.description: Gerdau S.A. is the largest producer of long steel in the Americas and the 33rd largest steelmaker worldwide. The company uses mini mills, integrated mills, and direct reduced iron plants, with 71% of its steel made from recycled scrap. In 2023, sales were evenly split between Brazil and North America.

companies.name: Hanwha Group
companies.description: Hanwha Group is a South Korean business conglomerate founded in 1952 as Korea Explosives Co. It has diversified holdings across explosives, energy, materials, aerospace, mechatronics, finance, retail, and lifestyle services. The company adopted the name Hanwha in 1992.

companies.name: Toyota Boshoku
companies.description: Toyota Boshoku Corporation is a Japanese automotive component manufacturer and a member of the Toyota Group. The company expanded into the North American market through Toyota Boshoku America. It specializes in automotive supplier products.

companies.name: Corning Inc.
companies.description: Corning Incorporated is an American multinational technology company specializing in glass, ceramics, and related materials for industrial and scientific applications. Founded in 1851 as Corning Glass Works, it was known for consumer products like CorningWare and Pyrex before divesting these lines in 1998.

companies.name: Willis Towers Watson
companies.description: Willis Towers Watson plc is a British-American multinational company providing advisory, broking, and solutions services. Its operations include commercial insurance brokerage, risk advisory, employee benefits consulting, retirement and actuarial services, and investment advice for pension funds and institutional investors.

companies.name: Chipotle Mexican Grill
companies.description: Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. is an American multinational fast casual restaurant chain specializing in bowls, tacos, and Mission burritos made to order. The name Chipotle comes from the Nahuatl word for a smoked and dried jalapeño chili pepper. As of December 2025, it operates 4,000 locations.

companies.name: Vivendi
companies.description: Vivendi SE is a French investment company headquartered in Paris. It wholly owns Gameloft and holds investments primarily in content, entertainment, media, and telecommunications companies.

companies.name: TechnipFMC
companies.description: TechnipFMC plc is a UK-domiciled global oil and gas company with French-American origins. It was formed by the merger of FMC Technologies and Technip, announced in 2016 and completed in 2017, providing services for the energy industry.

companies.name: Cencora
companies.description: Cencora, Inc., formerly AmerisourceBergen, is an American drug wholesale and distribution company and contract research organization. Headquartered in Conshohocken, Pennsylvania, it distributes generic pharmaceuticals, over-the-counter healthcare products, and home healthcare supplies.

companies.name: Huntington Ingalls Industries
companies.description: Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc. is the largest military shipbuilding company in the United States. It also provides professional services to government and industry partners and was formed in 2011 as a divestiture from Northrop Grumman.

companies.name: Fluor Corporation
companies.description: Fluor Corporation is an American engineering and construction firm headquartered in Irving, Texas. It operates through subsidiaries in oil and gas, industrial and infrastructure, government, and power sectors.

companies.name: LATAM Airlines Group
companies.description: LATAM Airlines is a Chilean multinational airline headquartered in Santiago, Chile. It is the largest airline holding company in Latin America with subsidiaries in Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Paraguay, and Peru.

companies.name: Volvo Cars
companies.description: Volvo Car AB, trading as Volvo Cars, is a Swedish multinational manufacturer of luxury vehicles headquartered in Torslanda, Gothenburg. The company produces SUVs, station wagons, and sedans.

companies.name: Waste Management, Inc
companies.description: Waste Management, Inc., doing business as WM, is an American waste management company operating in North America. Founded in 1968, it is headquartered in the Bank of America Tower in Houston, Texas.

companies.name: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd.
companies.description: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. is an Israeli multinational pharmaceutical company specializing primarily in generic drugs. Its business also includes branded drugs, active pharmaceutical ingredients, contract manufacturing, and out-licensing.

companies.name: Mitsubishi Motors
companies.description: Mitsubishi Motors Corporation is a Japanese multinational automobile manufacturer headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It was the sixth-largest Japanese automaker in 2011 and joined the Renault–Nissan–Mitsubishi Alliance in 2016.

companies.name: China Hongqiao
companies.description: China Hongqiao Group Limited is one of the world's largest producers of primary aluminium. It is headquartered in Binzhou, Shandong Province, China, and registered in Hong Kong. The company grew from a textile background in the 1990s to become the second largest aluminium producer globally since 2015.

companies.name: Huaneng Power International
companies.description: Huaneng Power International, Inc. is a Chinese electric power company established in 1994 by the China Huaneng Group. It is one of the five largest power producers in China and focuses on the development, construction, and operation of large power plants.

companies.name: All Nippon Airways
companies.description: All Nippon Airways (ANA) is a Japanese airline headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It operates over 100 domestic and international destinations with main hubs at Haneda and Narita airports. ANA is Japan's largest airline and has been a Star Alliance member since 1999.

companies.name: Smurfit Westrock Group
companies.description: Smurfit Westrock plc is an Irish company based in Dublin that manufactures corrugated and paper-based packaging. It is publicly traded on both the New York Stock Exchange and the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Hella
companies.description: Hella GmbH & Co. KGaA is a German automotive parts supplier headquartered in Lippstadt, North Rhine-Westphalia. The company develops and manufactures lighting, electronic components, and systems for the automotive industry and operates a large trade organization for automotive parts in Europe.

companies.name: Kubota
companies.description: Kubota Corporation is a Japanese multinational based in Osaka, established in 1890. It manufactures a wide range of products including tractors, agricultural machinery, construction equipment, engines, and water treatment equipment.

companies.name: PGE Polska Grupa Energetyczna
companies.description: PGE Polska Grupa Energetyczna S.A. is a state-owned public power company and the largest power producer in Poland. It is listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange and is part of the WIG30 index.

companies.name: Interpublic Group of Companies
companies.description: The Interpublic Group of Companies, Inc. was an American advertising company based in New York City. It included major networks such as FCB and McCann Worldgroup and was one of the 'Big Four' agency companies before being acquired by Omnicom in 2025.

companies.name: Iberdrola
companies.description: Iberdrola, S.A. is a Spanish multinational electric utility company headquartered in Bilbao, Spain. It employs around 40,000 people and serves approximately 30 million customers.

companies.name: ENEOS Holdings
companies.description: ENEOS Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese global petroleum and metals conglomerate headquartered in Tokyo. It is part of the Mitsubishi Group and was among the largest companies worldwide by revenue in 2013.

companies.name: OPmobility
companies.description: OPmobility is a French automotive supplier that operated under the name Plastic Omnium until March 27, 2024. It is based in France and serves the automotive industry.

companies.name: Textron
companies.description: Textron Inc. is an American industrial conglomerate based in Providence, Rhode Island. Founded in 1923 as the Special Yarns Company, its subsidiaries include Bell Textron, Kautex, Textron Aviation, and Lycoming Engines.

companies.name: Centrica
companies.description: Centrica plc is a British multinational energy and services company headquartered in Windsor, Berkshire, England. It operates in the energy supply industry.

companies.name: Barnes & Noble
companies.description: Barnes & Noble Booksellers is an American bookseller with the largest number of retail outlets in the United States. The company operates approximately 600 retail stores across the country.

companies.name: Mastercard
companies.description: Mastercard Inc. is an American multinational payment card services corporation headquartered in Purchase, New York. It processes payments between banks of merchants and card-issuing banks or credit unions globally.

companies.name: Yanzhou Coal Mining Company
companies.description: Yankuang Energy Group Company Limited, formerly Yanzhou Coal Mining Company Limited, is a Chinese energy company engaged in coal and potash mining, chemical production, power generation, and logistics. It is majority-owned by Shandong Energy Group.

companies.name: Kazakhmys
companies.description: Kazakhmys is a vertically integrated holding company focused on mining and non-ferrous metallurgy. Established in 1997 in Kazakhstan, it was divided in 2014 into Kazakhmys Corporation LLP and KAZ Minerals Plc.

companies.name: Munich Re
companies.description: Munich Re Group is a German multinational insurance company based in Munich. It is the world's largest reinsurer and includes ERGO as its primary insurance arm. Munich Re is publicly listed and part of several stock indices.

companies.name: J. B. Hunt
companies.description: J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc. is an American transportation and logistics company based in Lowell, Arkansas. Founded in 1961, it operates semi-trailer trucks providing transportation services across the US, Canada, and Mexico.

companies.name: Carlsberg Group
companies.description: Carlsberg A/S is a Danish multinational brewer headquartered in Copenhagen. Founded in 1847, it is majority-owned by the Carlsberg Foundation and is the seventh largest brewery in the world by revenue.

companies.name: The Cheesecake Factory
companies.description: The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated is a United States-based restaurant chain and cheesecake distributor. It operates 370 full-service restaurants under various brands and has bakery production facilities in California and North Carolina.

companies.name: Kraft Heinz
companies.description: The Kraft Heinz Company is an American multinational food company co-headquartered in Chicago and Pittsburgh. It was formed in 2015 through the merger of Kraft Foods Group and the H.J. Heinz Company and markets packaged foods and beverages under several well-known brands.

companies.name: Sun Microsystems
companies.description: Sun Microsystems, Inc. was an American technology company from 1982 to 2010 that developed and sold computers, hardware, software, and IT services. It contributed to key computing technologies and was headquartered in Santa Clara, California.

companies.name: EnBW
companies.description: EnBW Energie Baden-Württemberg AG is a publicly traded energy company headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany. It is the third-largest energy company in Germany and serves approximately 5.5 million customers.

companies.name: Dia
companies.description: Distribuidora Internacional de Alimentación, S.A. (DIA) is a Spanish multinational discount supermarket chain founded in 1979.

companies.name: Eli Lilly and Company
companies.description: Eli Lilly and Company is an American multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, with offices in 36 countries. Founded in 1876 by Eli Lilly, it markets products in approximately 90 countries.

companies.name: The Hertz Corporation
companies.description: Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. is an American car rental company based in Estero, Florida. It operates the Hertz brand along with Dollar Rent A Car, Firefly Car Rental, and Thrifty Car Rental.

companies.name: AUO Corporation
companies.description: AUO Corporation is a Taiwanese company specializing in optoelectronics, formed in 2001 by merging Acer Display Technology and Unipac Optoelectronics. It offers display panels and has expanded into smart retail, transportation, health, solar energy, circular economy, and smart manufacturing.

companies.name: Kalleh Dairy
companies.description: Kalleh Dairy is an Iranian dairy, food, and drink company headquartered in Amol, Iran.

companies.name: T-Mobile US
companies.logo_file: T-Mobile US Logo 2020 RGB Magenta on Transparent.svg
companies.description: T-Mobile US, Inc. is an American wireless network operator headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. It is majority-owned by the German telecommunications company Deutsche Telekom and is the second largest wireless carrier in the United States.

companies.name: Minor Food Group
companies.description: Minor Food Group is a subsidiary of Minor International and one of the largest restaurant chains in the Asia Pacific region. Founded in 1980 by William E. Heinecke, it is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. The company operates casual dining, quick service restaurants, food service, and delivery.

companies.name: Dai Nippon Printing
companies.description: Dai Nippon Printing is a Japanese printing company established in 1876. It operates in three main areas: information communications, lifestyle and industrial supplies, and electronics. The company is based in Japan.

companies.name: Legrand
companies.description: Legrand S.A. is a French industrial group historically based in Limoges, Nouvelle-Aquitaine region. It operates in the industrial sector and is headquartered in France.

companies.name: POSCO
companies.description: POSCO is a South Korean steel manufacturer headquartered in Pohang, South Korea. It was the world's largest steel manufacturing company by market value in 2010 and ranked as the seventh-largest steelmaker by output in 2015.

companies.name: Avon Products Inc.
companies.description: Avon Products, Inc., known as Avon, is an Anglo-American multinational company selling cosmetics, skin care, perfume, and personal care products. It operates as a multi-level marketing company based in London.

companies.name: Telstra
companies.description: Telstra Group Limited is an Australian telecommunications company that builds and operates networks and markets related products and services. It is Australia's largest telecommunications company by market share.

companies.name: KBC Group
companies.description: KBC Group N.V. is a Belgian universal multi-channel bank-insurer focusing on private clients and SMEs in Belgium, Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Hungary, and Slovakia. It was formed in 1998 through a merger of several banks and insurance companies.

companies.name: Konica Minolta
companies.description: Konica Minolta, Inc. is a Japanese multinational technology company headquartered in Tokyo. It manufactures business and industrial imaging products, optical devices, medical imaging products, and textile printers. The company sold its camera and photo operations to Sony in 2006.

companies.name: Avery Dennison
companies.description: Avery Dennison Corporation is an American multinational manufacturer and distributor of pressure-sensitive adhesive materials, apparel branding labels, RFID inlays, and specialty medical products. It is headquartered in Mentor, Ohio and is a Fortune 500 company.

companies.name: Akindo Sushiro
companies.description: Akindo Sushiro is a Japanese multinational conveyor belt sushi specialty store headquartered in Suita, Osaka. It operates in the restaurant industry.

companies.name: Dole plc
companies.description: Dole plc is an Irish agricultural multinational corporation headquartered in Dublin. It is one of the world's largest producers of fruit and vegetables, operating in 75 countries with 38,500 employees. The company supplies around 300 products globally.

companies.name: Telefônica Brasil
companies.description: Telefônica Brasil, trading as Vivo, is a Brazilian telecommunications group and a subsidiary of the Spanish company Telefónica. It operates in the telecommunications industry in Brazil.

companies.name: Hanwha Ocean
companies.description: Hanwha Ocean Co., Ltd., formerly Daewoo Shipbuilding & Marine Engineering, is a major South Korean shipbuilder. It is considered one of the 'Big Three' shipbuilders in South Korea alongside Hyundai and Samsung.

companies.name: Liberty Global
companies.description: Liberty Global Ltd. is a multinational telecommunications company domiciled in Bermuda with headquarters in London, Amsterdam, and Denver. It was formed in 2005 by merging Liberty Media's international arm and UnitedGlobalCom.

companies.name: General Mills
companies.description: General Mills, Inc. is an American multinational manufacturer and marketer of branded consumer foods. Founded in Minneapolis, it is headquartered in Golden Valley, Minnesota, and originally gained fame as a large flour miller.

companies.name: S&P Global
companies.description: S&P Global Inc. is an American publicly traded corporation headquartered in Manhattan, New York. It provides financial information, analytics, and energy and commodities intelligence, and owns several subsidiaries including S&P Global Ratings and CRISIL.

companies.name: Tenaga Nasional
companies.description: Tenaga Nasional Berhad is a Malaysian multinational electricity company and the primary electric utility in Peninsular Malaysia. It serves over 10 million customers and is the largest publicly listed power company in Southeast Asia.

companies.name: Asahi Kasei
companies.description: Asahi Kasei Corporation is a multinational Japanese chemical company. Its main products include chemicals and materials.

companies.name: eBay
companies.description: eBay Inc. is an American multinational e-commerce company based in San Jose, California. It operates online marketplaces in 190 markets worldwide, allowing users to buy and sell items via auctions or instant sales.

companies.name: ALROSA
companies.description: Alrosa is a Russian group of diamond mining companies specializing in exploration, mining, manufacture, and sale of diamonds. It leads the world in diamond mining by volume and accounts for 95% of Russian diamond production.

companies.name: Sika AG
companies.description: Sika AG is a Swiss multinational specialty chemical company headquartered in Baar, Switzerland. It supplies products and systems for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protecting to the building and motor vehicle industries. The company operates over 400 factories and has subsidiaries in more than 102 countries worldwide.

companies.name: VMware
companies.description: VMware LLC is an American cloud computing and virtualization technology company headquartered in Palo Alto, California. It was the first commercially successful company to virtualize the x86 architecture. In 2023, Broadcom acquired VMware in a cash-and-stock transaction, and its end-user computing division was sold and rebranded to Omnissa.

companies.name: AMC Theatres
companies.description: AMC Entertainment Holdings, Inc., known as AMC Theatres, is an American movie theater chain headquartered in Leawood, Kansas. It is the largest movie exhibition company globally, with approximately 860 theaters and 9,600 screens worldwide. Founded in 1920, AMC expanded significantly through acquisitions including Odeon Cinemas and Carmike Cinemas.

companies.name: Victoria’s Secret
companies.description: Victoria's Secret is an American lingerie, clothing, and beauty retailer founded in 1977. The company expanded rapidly under Les Wexner after 1982, growing to 350 stores nationally and becoming the largest lingerie retailer in the United States by the early 1990s.

companies.name: Vertiv
companies.description: Vertiv Holdings Co. is an American provider of infrastructure and services for data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial environments. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, Vertiv operates in more than 40 countries with around 34,000 employees and 30 manufacturing and assembly facilities.

companies.name: Petronas
companies.description: Petroliam Nasional Berhad, known as Petronas, is a Malaysian multinational oil and gas company headquartered in Kuala Lumpur. Established in 1974, it holds all oil and gas resources in Malaysia and is responsible for developing and adding value to these resources.

companies.name: State Street Corporation
companies.description: State Street Corporation is an American multinational financial services and bank holding company headquartered in Boston. It is the second-oldest continuously operating U.S. bank, tracing its roots to 1792. State Street is one of the world's largest asset managers and custodians.

companies.name: ČEZ Group
companies.description: ČEZ Group is an energy group headquartered in Prague and the largest electricity producer in the Czech Republic. Established in 1992, it is majority-owned by the Czech government and its shares trade on the Prague and Warsaw stock exchanges.

companies.name: Kellogg's
companies.description: The Kellogg Company, known as Kellogg's, was an American multinational food manufacturing company headquartered in Battle Creek, Michigan. It produced breakfast cereals and convenience foods marketed under brands such as Corn Flakes, Rice Krispies, and Pringles.

companies.name: KGHM Polska Miedź
companies.description: KGHM Polska Miedź S.A. is a Polish multinational mining corporation headquartered in Lubin, Poland. Founded in 1961 as a state enterprise, it is a major global producer of copper and silver and has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 1997.

companies.name: Orange Polska
companies.description: Orange Polska SA is a Polish telecommunications provider established in December 1991. It offers services including PSTN, ISDN, GSM networks, ADSL, FTTH fibre Internet, and others. The company is publicly traded on the Warsaw Stock Exchange with a controlling stake owned by Orange S.A.

companies.name: Knorr-Bremse
companies.description: Knorr-Bremse AG is a German manufacturer specializing in braking systems for rail and commercial vehicles since 1905. Its product range also includes intelligent door systems, control components, air conditioning systems for rail vehicles, and transmission control systems. The company is headquartered in Germany.

companies.name: Marfrig
companies.description: Marfrig S.A. is a Brazilian food processing company headquartered in São Paulo. It operates 33 production units worldwide and exports to over 100 countries. The company produces and distributes food based on animal protein and is one of the largest beef producers globally.

companies.name: Olympus Corporation
companies.description: Olympus Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of optics and reprography products headquartered in Hachioji, Tokyo. Founded in 1919 as Takachiho Seisakusho, it initially specialized in microscopes and thermometers before expanding into imaging. The company adopted its current name in 2003.

companies.name: Prysmian Group
companies.description: Prysmian S.p.A. is an Italian multinational company headquartered in Milan, specializing in electrical and optical cables for digital connections. It operates 109 plants worldwide, including locations in North America, LATAM, and EMEA. The company focuses on production, installation, and maintenance of cables.

companies.name: Bolloré
companies.industry: manufacture of plates, sheets, tubes and profiles in plastic materials
companies.description: Bolloré S.E. is a French conglomerate headquartered in Puteaux, near Paris. Founded in 1822, it started in fine paper and plastic film and later diversified into freight transport, oil storage, batteries, access control, palm oil, rubber, olive groves, and wine production. It also expanded into advertising, media, and communications.

companies.name: Kawasaki Heavy Industries
companies.description: Kawasaki Heavy Industries Ltd. is a Japanese multinational corporation headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It manufactures motorcycles, engines, heavy equipment, aerospace and defense equipment, rolling stock, ships, industrial robots, gas turbines, pumps, and boilers. The company is one of Japan's three major heavy industrial manufacturers.

companies.name: Archer Daniels Midland
companies.description: The Archer-Daniels-Midland Company (ADM) is an American multinational food processing and commodities trading corporation founded in 1902. It is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. ADM operates in the food processing industry.

companies.name: Currys plc
companies.description: Currys plc is a British multinational retailer and services company specializing in electrical and telecommunications products. Headquartered in Newark-on-Trent, England, it was formed in 2014 by merging Dixons Retail and Carphone Warehouse Group. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Nordea
companies.description: Nordea Bank Abp is a Nordic financial services group headquartered in Helsinki, Finland. It operates in northern Europe and is listed on Nasdaq Nordic exchanges in Helsinki, Copenhagen, and Stockholm, with American Depository Receipts traded in the US. The company exited several markets including Poland, the Baltics, and Russia.

companies.name: MOL Group
companies.description: MOL Plc., also known as MOL Group, is a Hungarian multinational oil and gas company headquartered in Budapest. It includes Croatian and Slovak formerly state-owned companies INA and Slovnaft. MOL is Hungary's second most profitable enterprise and was ranked 402 on the Fortune Global 500 list in 2013.

companies.name: Nucor
companies.description: Nucor Corporation is an American steel producer based in Charlotte, North Carolina. It is the largest steel producer in the United States and the largest recycler of scrap in North America. Nucor is also one of the two primary suppliers of rebar used in U.S. infrastructure.

companies.name: Pirelli
companies.description: Pirelli & C. S.p.A. is an Italian multinational tyre manufacturer headquartered in Milan. It is the fifth-largest tyre manufacturer globally, producing tyres for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. The company operates in over 160 countries with 18 manufacturing sites across 12 countries.

companies.name: MAPFRE
companies.description: Mapfre, S.A. is a Spanish multinational insurance company based in Majadahonda, Madrid. It is the leading insurance company in Spain and the largest non-life insurance company in Latin America. The company originated from a mutual insurance background.

companies.name: Evonik Industries
companies.description: Evonik Industries AG is a publicly listed German chemicals company headquartered in Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia. It is the second-largest chemicals company in Germany and one of the largest specialty chemicals companies worldwide. The company was founded in 2007 after restructuring RAG AG.

companies.name: Baidu
companies.description: Baidu, Inc. is a Chinese multinational technology company specializing in internet services and artificial intelligence. It holds a leading share of China's search engine market and offers services including Baidu App, Baidu Baike, iQIYI, and Baidu Tieba.

companies.name: Sumitomo Chemical
companies.description: Sumitomo Chemical Co., Ltd. is a major Japanese chemical company founded in 1913 as a fertilizer manufacturer. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and is part of the Sumitomo group. The company operates in the industrial and chemical sectors.

companies.name: Bristol-Myers Squibb
companies.description: Bristol-Myers Squibb Company is an American multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey. Its products include medications for cancer, autoimmune diseases, and blood disorders. In 2025, 69% of its revenues came from the United States.

companies.name: Maxxis
companies.description: Cheng Shin Rubber Industry Co. is a Taiwanese tire company established in 1967 in Yuanlin City, Changhua County. It is the 16th largest tire manufacturer globally. Maxxis Tyres and CST tires are wholly owned subsidiaries of Cheng Shin.

companies.name: Omron
companies.description: Omron Corporation is a Japanese electronics company based in Kyoto, Japan. It was established by Kazuma Tateishi in 1933 and incorporated in 1948. The company operates in the electronics industry.

companies.name: Cleveland-Cliffs
companies.description: Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. is an American steel manufacturer based in Cleveland, Ohio. It specializes in mining, beneficiation, and pelletizing of iron ore, as well as steelmaking including stamping and tooling. It is the largest flat-rolled steel producer in North America and the second-largest steel producer in the United States.

companies.name: Orkla Group
companies.description: Orkla ASA is a Norwegian conglomerate operating in Europe, Asia, and the US. It works in branded consumer goods, aluminium products, and financial investment sectors. The company is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange and headquartered in Oslo, Norway.

companies.name: Arçelik
companies.description: Arçelik A.Ş. is a Turkish multinational manufacturer of household appliances. It operates in the consumer electronics industry and is based in Turkey.

companies.name: Magazine Luiza
companies.description: Magazine Luiza S.A. is a Brazilian retail company known as Magalu. It operates in the retail sector in Brazil and is led by chairperson Luiza Trajano and CEO Frederico Trajano.

companies.name: Truist Financial
companies.description: Truist Financial Corporation is an American bank holding company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. Formed in 2019 from the merger of BB&T and SunTrust, it offers consumer, commercial, and investment banking services across 15 states and Washington, D.C.

companies.name: Colruyt Group
companies.industry: retail sale in non-specialised stores with food, beverages or tobacco predominating
companies.description: Colruyt Group is a Belgian family-owned retail corporation managing Colruyt supermarkets and subsidiaries like OKay, Bio-Planet, DATS 24, and Spar. It operates in the retail sector focusing on food, beverages, and tobacco.

companies.name: Bancolombia
companies.description: Bancolombia S.A. is a full-service financial institution operating in Colombia, Panama, and Puerto Rico. It provides banking, leasing, trust, investment, brokerage, offshore, and insurance services and is part of the COLCAP index.

companies.name: LKQ Corporation
companies.description: LKQ Corporation is an American provider of alternative and specialty parts for repairing and accessorizing automobiles and other vehicles. It operates in North America, Europe, and Taiwan, selling replacement systems, components, and parts.

companies.name: Nippon Sheet Glass
companies.description: Nippon Sheet Glass Co., Ltd. is a Japanese glass manufacturing company. It acquired Pilkington in 2006, making it one of the four largest glass companies globally alongside Asahi Glass, Saint-Gobain, and Guardian Industries.

companies.name: Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation
companies.description: Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation Limited (OCBC) is a Singaporean multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered at the OCBC Centre. It operates over 400 branches in 19 countries including Malaysia, Indonesia, China, Hong Kong, and Macau.

companies.name: Vestas
companies.description: Vestas Wind Systems A/S is a Danish company that manufactures, sells, installs, and services wind turbines. Founded in 1945, it operates manufacturing plants in multiple countries including Denmark, Germany, and the United States. The company employs 37,000 people globally.

companies.name: Krungthai Bank
companies.description: Krungthai Bank Public Company Limited is a Thai commercial bank with the Financial Institutions Development Fund as its majority shareholder. It is known by its initials KTB and operates under the Bank of Thailand. The bank's SWIFT code is KRTHTHBK.

companies.name: Jollibee Group
companies.description: Jollibee Foods Corporation, known as Jollibee Group, is a Philippine multinational company headquartered in Pasig, Metro Manila. It owns the fast food brand Jollibee. The company operates in the fast food industry.

companies.name: Shiseido
companies.description: Shiseido Company, Limited is a Japanese multinational cosmetic company founded in Tokyo in 1872. It offers products in skin care, makeup, body care, hair care, and fragrances. Shiseido is the largest cosmetic firm in Japan and is headquartered in Tokyo.

companies.name: Lehman Brothers
companies.description: Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc. was an American global financial services firm founded in 1850. It was the fourth-largest investment bank in the U.S. before filing for bankruptcy in 2008. Lehman operated in investment banking, trading, research, investment management, private equity, and private banking.

companies.name: Astra Agro Lestari
companies.description: Astra Agro Lestari Tbk. is the second largest palm oil company in Indonesia and a subsidiary of PT Astra International Tbk. It controlled extensive land banks as of 2004, including two concessions on peatlands in Riau totaling about 20,000 hectares.

companies.name: Jastrzębska Spółka Węglowa
companies.description: Jastrzębska Spółka Węglowa S.A. is a large coal mining company based in Jastrzębie-Zdrój, Poland. It produces around 12 million tonnes of coal annually and has proven recoverable reserves of 503.4 million tonnes.

companies.name: AMD
companies.description: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) is an American multinational semiconductor company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It develops CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs, SoCs, and high-performance computer components for various markets including PCs, gaming, data centers, and embedded systems.

companies.name: Telus Communications
companies.description: Telus Communications Inc. is a Canadian telecommunications company based in Vancouver, British Columbia. It provides a wide range of products and services including Internet, voice, entertainment, healthcare, and mobile networks. Telus is the incumbent local exchange carrier in British Columbia and Alberta.

companies.name: Wilh. Wilhelmsen
companies.description: Wilh. Wilhelmsen Holding ASA is a Norwegian multinational maritime group headquartered in Lysaker, Norway. It employs over 21,000 people and operates in 75 countries. The group runs the largest maritime network in the world with more than 2200 locations globally.

companies.name: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles
companies.description: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited, known as Tata Cars, is an Indian multinational automobile manufacturer based in Mumbai. It was formed in 2024 after separating Tata Group's commercial and passenger vehicle segments. The company owns British car manufacturer Jaguar Land Rover and is the third largest car manufacturer in India by sales as of 2025.

companies.name: Aviva
companies.description: Aviva plc is a British multinational insurance company headquartered in London, England. It serves about 25.3 million customers across the UK, Ireland, and Canada. Aviva is the UK's only diversified insurer and the second-largest general insurer in Canada.

companies.name: NTT DoCoMo
companies.description: NTT Docomo, Inc. is a Japanese mobile telecommunications carrier and subsidiary of NTT. The company is headquartered in the Sanno Park Tower in Nagatachō, Chiyoda, Tokyo. It operates as a joint-stock corporation under Japan's Companies Act.

companies.name: Progressive Corporation
companies.description: The Progressive Corporation is an American insurance company headquartered in Mayfield, Ohio. Founded in 1937, it insures passenger vehicles, motorcycles, RVs, trailers, boats, and commercial vehicles. Progressive also offers home, life, pet, and other insurance types through select companies.

companies.name: Rexel
companies.description: Rexel S.A. is a French company specializing in the distribution of electrical, heating, lighting, and plumbing equipment. It also focuses on renewable energies and energy efficiency products and services. The company operates primarily in France.

companies.name: KBR, Inc.
companies.description: KBR, Inc. is a U.S.-based company operating in science, technology, and engineering sectors. It serves markets including aerospace, defense, industrial, intelligence, and energy. KBR supports NASA programs, international space agencies, and commercial partners.

companies.name: Tenaris
companies.description: Tenaris S.A., organized in Luxembourg, manufactures and supplies steel pipes and related services for the petroleum industry. It ships over 4 million tons of pipes annually with significant sales in North America, South America, Asia-Pacific, and Europe.

companies.name: TIM Group
companies.description: TIM S.p.A. is an Italian multinational telecommunications company headquartered in Rome, Milan, Bari, and Naples. It provides fixed, public, and mobile telephony as well as DSL data services across Italy.

companies.name: Yandex
companies.description: Yandex LLC is a Russian technology company offering internet-related products and services such as a web browser, search engine, cloud computing, and ridesharing. Yandex Search holds the largest market share in Russia, and Yandex Taxi is the largest ridesharing company there.

companies.name: onsemi
companies.description: ON Semiconductor Corporation is an American semiconductor supplier based in Scottsdale, Arizona. It produces power and signal management, logic, discrete, and custom devices for various applications including automotive and communications. The company operates manufacturing facilities and design centers globally.

companies.name: Mondi Group
companies.description: Mondi plc is a multinational packaging and paper group based in Weybridge, England. It is listed on both the Johannesburg Stock Exchange and the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index. The company specializes in papermaking and packaging products.

companies.name: Telkom
companies.description: Telkom is a South African telecommunications provider offering wireline and wireless services across more than 38 African countries. Headquartered in Centurion, Gauteng, it is one of the largest telecommunications companies in South Africa by annual revenue.

companies.name: Sabadell Bank
companies.description: Banco de Sabadell, S.A. is a Spanish multinational financial services company headquartered in Sabadell, Catalonia. It is the fourth-largest banking group in Spain and serves small and medium enterprises as well as affluent clients, with a focus on international trade.

companies.name: Aéropostale
companies.description: Aéropostale Inc. is an American retailer specializing in casual apparel and accessories for young adults and teenagers. Founded by Macy's, it is currently owned by Catalyst Brands and sells products through its own stores, website, and third-party retailers like Target in the U.S.

companies.name: United Parks & Resorts
companies.description: United Parks & Resorts Inc. is an American entertainment company headquartered in Orlando, Florida. It owns and operates 12 recreational destinations including eight theme parks and four water parks, with notable brands such as SeaWorld and Busch Gardens.

companies.name: Nexans
companies.description: Nexans S.A. is a global company in the cable and optical fibre industry headquartered in Paris, France. It specializes in manufacturing cables and related products for various applications worldwide.

companies.name: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena
companies.wiki: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena
companies.logo_file: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena.png
companies.description: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena S.p.A. is an Italian bank with origins dating back to 1472. It is the world's oldest bank and, following its acquisition of Mediobanca in 2025, became the third largest bank in Italy.

companies.name: Monsanto
companies.description: The Monsanto Company was an American agrochemical and agricultural biotechnology corporation headquartered in Creve Coeur, Missouri. Founded in 1901, it was known for products like the Roundup herbicide and genetically engineered crops before ceasing to exist as an independent company.

companies.name: Bank Negara Indonesia
companies.description: PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk is an Indonesian state-owned bank with a large domestic branch network and several international branches. It is listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange and serves millions of customers primarily in Indonesia.

companies.name: WW International
companies.description: WW International, Inc., formerly Weight Watchers International, Inc., is a global company headquartered in the U.S. offering weight loss, fitness, and mindset services. Founded in 1963, it provides programs online, via coaching, and through in-person meetings.

companies.name: Babcock International
companies.description: Babcock International Group plc is a British aerospace, defence and nuclear engineering services company based in London, England. It specializes in managing complex assets and infrastructure, mainly serving public bodies such as the UK's Ministry of Defence and Network Rail. The company operates in four sectors with overseas operations across multiple continents.

companies.name: 21st Century Fox
companies.description: Twenty-First Century Fox, Inc., known as 21st Century Fox, was an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate based in New York City. Formed in 2013 as the legal successor to News Corporation, it focused on film and television industries until its acquisition by the Walt Disney Company in 2019. It was the fourth-largest US media conglomerate by revenue before the acquisition.

companies.name: JSL S.A.
companies.description: JSL is a Brazilian conglomerate intermodal logistics company founded in 1956 and headquartered in Mogi das Cruzes, Greater São Paulo. Owned by the Simões family, it operates in supply chain services, cargo and passenger transportation, outsourced fleet management, vehicle commercialization, and car rental.

companies.name: Bashneft
companies.description: Bashneft is a Russian oil company formed from Soviet oil ministry assets in Bashkortostan and privatized in the early 2000s. It operates 140 oil and natural gas fields in Russia and owns three refineries in Ufa with a combined capacity of 820,000 barrels per day, along with 100 petrol stations. The company has experienced significant ownership changes and government involvement.

companies.name: Hermès
companies.description: Hermès International S.C.A. is a French luxury goods company founded in 1837 in Paris by Thierry Hermès. Originally specializing in saddlery and harness making, it expanded into leather goods, silk, ready-to-wear, watchmaking, jewelry, fashion accessories, and perfumery. By 2020, its beauty division included sixteen business lines.

companies.name: İşbank
companies.description: İşbank, officially Türkiye İş Bankası, is a commercial bank in Turkey founded in 1924 by the orders of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk. It was the first bank to operate in the Republic of Türkiye.

companies.name: Polskie Górnictwo Naftowe i Gazownictwo
companies.description: Polskie Górnictwo Naftowe i Gazownictwo S.A. (PGNiG) is a Polish state-controlled oil and gas company headquartered in Warsaw. It has branches and representative offices in Russia, Pakistan, Belarus, and Ukraine, and holds equity interests in about 30 subsidiaries providing specialist geophysical, drilling, and well services.

companies.name: Grupo Televisa
companies.description: Grupo Televisa, S.A.B., known as Televisa, is a Mexican telecommunications and broadcasting company and the largest in Hispanic America. It is a major mass media corporation producing Spanish-language content.

companies.name: Asseco Poland
companies.description: Asseco Poland S.A. is a Polish multinational software company founded in 1991 and headquartered in Rzeszów, Poland. It develops enterprise software primarily for banking and finance industries and operates in over 60 countries. It is one of the largest technology companies listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange and the largest software house in Central and Eastern Europe.

companies.name: DBS Bank
companies.description: DBS Bank Limited is a Singaporean multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered at the Marina Bay Financial Centre in Singapore. It was formerly known as The Development Bank of Singapore Limited before adopting the abbreviated name DBS in 2003. DBS is one of the "Big Three" local banks in Singapore.

companies.name: LPP
companies.description: LPP S.A. is a Polish multinational fashion group headquartered in Gdańsk, Poland. It distributes clothing, footwear, accessories, and home and pet products under five brands through stores and e-commerce. LPP operates in 41 global markets and employs nearly 30,000 people across Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.

companies.name: Tietoevry
companies.description: Tieto Corporation is a Finnish IT software and service company domiciled in Espoo, Finland. It provides IT and product engineering services and has approximately 15,000 employees across 20 countries. Tieto serves customers in sectors including energy, forestry, banking, healthcare, and public sectors.

companies.name: Grifols
companies.description: Grifols, S.A. is a global healthcare company founded in Barcelona, Spain, in 1909. It is a leading producer of plasma-derived medicines and employs over 23,800 people. Grifols serves more than 110 countries and maintains a direct presence in over 30 countries.

companies.name: Solvay S.A.
companies.description: Solvay is a Belgian-French multinational chemical company established in 1863 with headquarters in Neder-Over-Heembeek, Brussels, Belgium. Since 2023, after a demerger, it has specialized in essential chemistry and employs over 9,000 people in 40 countries.

companies.name: Fielmann
companies.description: Fielmann Group AG is a German eyewear company.

companies.name: Ralph Lauren Corporation
companies.description: Ralph Lauren Corporation is an American fashion and lifestyle brand founded in 1967 in New York City. It markets apparel, home products, accessories, and fragrances under various brands including its flagship Polo Ralph Lauren. The company offers products ranging from mid-range to luxury labels.

companies.name: Smiths Group
companies.description: Smiths Group plc is a British multinational diversified engineering business headquartered in London, England. It operates in over 50 countries and employs approximately 16,000 staff. Smiths Group is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Trelleborg AB
companies.description: Trelleborg AB is a multinational engineering company headquartered in Trelleborg, Sweden. It designs and manufactures polymer technology products including seals, hoses, and antivibration solutions. The company became public in 1964 and trades on Nasdaq Stockholm.

companies.name: Dutch Bros. Coffee
companies.description: Dutch Bros Inc. is a publicly held drive-through coffee chain in the United States, founded in 1992. It is headquartered in Tempe, Arizona, having previously been based in Grants Pass, Oregon. The company operates company-owned and franchise locations primarily in the Western United States and has expanded as far east as Orlando, Florida.

companies.name: PACCAR
companies.description: Paccar Inc. is an American company headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, that manufactures heavy-duty trucks. It operates subsidiaries including Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF Trucks. The company also provides financial services and industrial parts.

companies.name: Ackermans & van Haaren
companies.description: Ackermans & van Haaren is a diversified Belgian group active in marine engineering and contracting, private banking, real estate, energy and resources, and growth capital. It operates across multiple sectors as a holding company.

companies.name: Bunge Limited
companies.description: Bunge Global SA is a global agribusiness and food company incorporated in Geneva, Switzerland, with headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri, United States. It operates in the food industry worldwide.

companies.name: Oki Electric Industry
companies.description: Oki Electric Industry Co., Ltd., commonly known as OKI, is a Japanese information and communications technology company headquartered in Tokyo. It operates in over 120 countries globally.

companies.name: Obrascón Huarte Lain
companies.description: Obrascón Huarte Lain, branded as OHLA Progress Enablers, is a Spanish multinational construction and civil engineering company. It is involved in infrastructure, commercial property construction, homebuilding, and transport concessions, with significant activity in Mexico and a majority-owned American subsidiary.

companies.name: Prudential plc
companies.description: Prudential plc is a British multinational insurance and asset management company headquartered in London and Hong Kong. Founded in 1848, it originally provided loans to professional and working people.

companies.name: Grendene
companies.description: Grendene is a Brazilian company known as the world's largest manufacturer of sandals. It was founded by Alexandre Grendene Bartelle and his twin brother Pedro Grendene Bartelle.

companies.name: Telecom Argentina
companies.description: Telecom Argentina S.A., operating under the brand Personal, is the major telephone company for northern Argentina including Buenos Aires. It was briefly known as Sociedad Licenciataria Norte S.A. and is commonly called Telecom within Argentina.

companies.name: Solventum
companies.description: Solventum Corporation is an American health care company that was spun off from 3M on April 1, 2024. It operates in the health care sector.

companies.name: SpaceX
companies.description: Space Exploration Technologies Corp., known as SpaceX, is an American aerospace manufacturer and provider of space transportation, telecommunications, infrastructure, and AI services. Headquartered in Starbase, Texas, it operates segments including space launch vehicles, satellite internet via Starlink, and AI development through its subsidiary.

companies.name: Saab Group
companies.description: Saab AB, known as the Saab Group, is a Swedish aerospace and defence company headquartered in Stockholm. It primarily operates in Sweden with development and manufacturing based in Linköping. The company is notable for its focus on aerospace and defence sectors.

companies.name: Stantec
companies.description: Stantec Inc. is a multinational professional services company founded in 1954 and based in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. It provides consulting services in planning, engineering, architecture, and environmental sciences worldwide. The company operates from over 450 locations across six continents.

companies.name: Stryker Corporation
companies.description: Stryker Corporation is an American multinational medical technologies company headquartered in Portage, Michigan. It produces surgical equipment, neurotechnology products, and orthopedic implants used in various surgeries. Its products are sold in over 75 countries and used by 150 million patients annually.

companies.name: AGCO
companies.description: AGCO Corporation is an American agricultural machinery manufacturer headquartered in Duluth, Georgia. Founded in 1990, it designs, produces, and sells tractors, combines, sprayers, and smart farming technologies. The company focuses on equipment for agriculture and farming.

companies.name: Eurocash
companies.description: Eurocash S.A. is a Polish corporate group owning various retail chains and service companies. The largest shareholder is Portuguese Luis Amaral, who acquired a stake in 2003. Eurocash has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since February 2005.

companies.name: Beiersdorf
companies.description: Beiersdorf AG is a German multinational company headquartered in Hamburg that manufactures personal-care products and pressure-sensitive adhesives. Its brands include Nivea, Elastoplast, and Tesa. The company operates in the chemical industry focusing on consumer products.

companies.name: Kazatomprom
companies.description: Kazatomprom is a Kazakhstani company and the world’s largest producer and seller of natural uranium. It supplied over 40% of global primary uranium in 2019. The uranium produced is used worldwide for nuclear power generation.

companies.name: NCR Corporation
companies.description: NCR Voyix Corporation, formerly NCR Corporation, is a global software, consulting, and technology company based in the United States. It produces self-service kiosks, point-of-sale software and terminals, check processing systems, thermal printers, and barcode scanners.

companies.name: Freescale Semiconductor
companies.description: Freescale Semiconductor, Inc. was an American semiconductor manufacturer created in 2004 from Motorola's Semiconductor Products Sector. It focused on integrated circuits for automotive, embedded, and communications markets. The company merged with NXP Semiconductors in 2015.

companies.name: Bashkirenergo
companies.description: OJSC Bashkirenergo was a power and heat company operating in Bashkortostan, Russia. Its major shareholder was the holding company Sistema, with 21.27% of shares owned by the Russian grid company FGC UES. The company operated in the utilities sector.

companies.name: Dresdner Bank
companies.description: Dresdner Bank AG was a German bank founded in 1872 in Dresden. It was headquartered in Berlin from 1884 to 1945 and in Frankfurt from 1963 onwards after a postwar hiatus. It was Germany's second-largest bank and was acquired by Commerzbank in May 2009.

companies.name: Osaka Gas
companies.description: Osaka Gas Co., Ltd. is a Japanese gas company based in Osaka, Japan. It supplies gas to the Kansai region, especially the Keihanshin area. The company is commonly written as 大阪ガス.

companies.name: Renesas Electronics
companies.description: Renesas Electronics Corporation is a Japanese semiconductor manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo. It supplies embedded processors, analog, power and connectivity devices, and related software for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT applications. It ranked third worldwide in the microcontroller market in 2025.

companies.name: Swisscom
companies.description: Swisscom AG is a major telecommunications provider in Switzerland with headquarters in Worblaufen, near Bern. The Swiss government owns 51% of Swisscom. It holds significant market shares in mobile, broadband, and TV telecommunications in Switzerland and operates the Italian subsidiary Fastweb.

companies.name: Telekom (Greece)
companies.description: Hellenic Telecommunications Organization S.A., also known as Hellenic Telekom, is the largest telecommunications and IT company in Greece. It is a subsidiary of Germany-based Deutsche Telekom and one of the three largest companies listed on the Athens Stock Exchange by market capitalization.

companies.name: Fiserv
companies.description: Fiserv, Inc. is an American multinational financial technology company headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. It processes debit and credit card transactions, loyalty programs, loans, electronic bill pay, wires and ACH transfers, check deposits, and ATM transactions for banking institutions. It also produces debit and credit cards and point of sale terminals.

companies.name: Tenneco
companies.description: Tenneco, Inc. is an American automotive components original equipment manufacturer and aftermarket ride control and emissions products manufacturer. It was publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange until it was taken private in November 2022. The company is headquartered in Northville Charter Township, Michigan.

companies.name: Carvana
companies.description: Carvana Co. is an American online car retailer based in Tempe, Arizona. It was named to the 2021 Fortune 500 list, making it one of the youngest companies to be added to the list.

companies.name: Hankook Tire & Technology
companies.description: Hankook Tire & Technology Co., Ltd., known as Hankook, is a South Korean tire company based in Seoul. It is the seventh-largest tire company in the world and is part of Hankook & Company.

companies.name: Corteva
companies.industry: Pesticide and Other Agricultural Chemical Manufacturing
companies.description: Corteva, Inc. is an American company focused on products for seeds and crop protection, including herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, and biologicals sold in 110 countries. It is headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, and its primary brand is Pioneer Hi-Bred International.

companies.name: Korea Electric Power Corporation
companies.description: Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO) is the largest electric utility in South Korea, responsible for electricity generation, transmission, and distribution. It develops electric power projects including nuclear, wind, and coal power. The South Korean government owns a majority share of KEPCO, which has an installed capacity of 83,235 MW.

companies.name: SK Telecom
companies.description: SK Telecom Co., Ltd. is a South Korean wireless telecommunications operator and part of the SK Group. It is the largest wireless carrier in South Korea, leading the local market with a significant share. SK Telecom was formerly also a film distributor.

companies.name: Northern Trust
companies.description: Northern Trust Corporation is an American financial services company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It serves corporations, institutional investors, and ultra-high-net-worth individuals. Northern Trust is one of the largest and oldest banks in the United States.

companies.name: Uralkali
companies.description: Uralkali is a Russian producer and exporter of potash fertilizer. The company operates five mines and seven ore-treatment mills located in Berezniki and Solikamsk. Uralkali employs about 12,000 people and is traded on the Moscow Exchange.

companies.name: Papa John's
companies.description: Papa John's International, Inc. is an American pizza restaurant chain founded in Jeffersonville, Indiana, in 1984. It went public in 1993 and expanded rapidly. As of 2023, it is the fourth largest pizza delivery chain in the United States with headquarters in Louisville, Kentucky, and Atlanta, Georgia.

companies.name: Kansai Electric Power Company
companies.description: The Kansai Electric Power Company, also known as Kanden, is an electric utility operating in the Kansai region of Japan. It provides electricity supply services within its operational area.

companies.name: Demant A/S
companies.description: Demant A/S is a Danish international company specializing in hearing care, hearing aids, and audiometric equipment. It is headquartered in Smørum, Denmark.

companies.name: DIC Corporation
companies.description: DIC Corporation is a Japanese chemical company that develops, manufactures, and sells inks, pigments, polymers, specialty plastics, compounds, and biochemicals.

companies.name: Yamaha
companies.description: Yamaha Corporation is a Japanese multinational company that manufactures musical instruments and audio equipment.

companies.name: Zaporizhstal
companies.description: Zaporizhstal Iron and Steel Works is a steel mill based in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine. Founded in 1933, it became the country's fourth-largest steel maker until operations stopped in 2026 due to the ongoing Russian war.

companies.name: Foton Motor
companies.description: Foton Motor is a Chinese company that designs and manufactures trucks, buses, and sport utility vehicles. It is headquartered in Changping, Beijing, and operates as a subsidiary of the BAIC Group.

companies.name: CACI
companies.description: CACI International Inc. is an American multinational aerospace and defense company headquartered in Northern Virginia. It provides services to various branches of the US federal government including defense, homeland security, and intelligence.

companies.name: Chiquita Brands International
companies.description: Chiquita Brands International S.à.r.l. is a Swiss company that produces and distributes bananas and other produce. It operates under subsidiary brand names such as Chiquita and Fresh Express salads and is among the leading banana distributors worldwide.

companies.name: Elbit Systems Ltd.
companies.description: Elbit Systems Ltd. is an Israel-based international military technology company and defense contractor. Founded in 1966, it is the primary provider of the Israeli military's land-based equipment and unmanned aerial vehicles.

companies.name: Neusoft
companies.description: Neusoft Corporation is a Chinese multinational provider of software engineering, IT services, product engineering, IT education, and medical equipment. It is headquartered in Shenyang, China.

companies.name: JetBlue Airways
companies.description: JetBlue Airways Corporation is an American low-cost airline headquartered in Long Island City, Queens, New York City. It operates a point-to-point network with six focus cities including its main hub at JFK Airport, serving destinations across the Americas and Europe.

companies.name: Jeld-Wen
companies.description: JELD-WEN is an American company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It operates over 120 manufacturing facilities in 19 countries and designs, produces, and distributes doors, windows, wall systems, and other components for residential and non-residential buildings.

companies.name: Equinor ASA
companies.description: Equinor ASA is a Norwegian multinational energy company headquartered in Stavanger, Norway. Primarily a petroleum company, it operates in 36 countries and has investments in renewable energy and lithium mining.

companies.name: Siam Commercial Bank
companies.description: Siam Commercial Bank is the first and oldest Thai bank, officially named Siam Commercial Bank Public Company Limited. It was founded on January 30, 1907, by appointment of Chulalongkorn.

companies.name: Power Machines
companies.description: OJSC Power Machines is a Russian energy systems machine-building company founded in 2000. It is headquartered in Saint Petersburg.

companies.name: Workday, Inc.
companies.description: Workday, Inc. is an American cloud-based software provider specializing in financial management, human capital management, and student information systems. Founded by former PeopleSoft executives David Duffield and Aneel Bhusri after Oracle acquired PeopleSoft in 2005, the company operates in the software industry.

companies.name: Saudi Telecom Company
companies.description: Saudi Telecom Company, trading as stc Group, is a telecommunications provider based in Saudi Arabia. It offers ICT services across the Middle East and Europe, including landline, mobile, broadband, cloud computing, online payments, IoT, 5G, cybersecurity, and digital entertainment.

companies.name: BlackRock
companies.description: BlackRock, Inc. is an American multinational investment company founded in 1988. Headquartered in New York City, it is the largest asset manager worldwide with offices in 30 countries and clients in 100 countries.

companies.name: RWE
companies.description: RWE AG is a German multinational energy company headquartered in Essen. It generates and trades electricity across the Asia-Pacific region, Europe, and the United States.

companies.name: Arkema
companies.description: Arkema S.A. is a French multinational manufacturer of specialty materials headquartered in La Défense near Paris. The company operates in three specialty materials segments: adhesives, advanced materials, and coatings, along with a segment covering primary materials.

companies.name: Vallourec
companies.description: Vallourec S.A. is a multinational manufacturing company based in Meudon, France. It specializes in hot rolled seamless steel tubes, expandable tubular technology, automotive parts, and stainless steel for energy, construction, automotive, and mechanical industries.

companies.name: Amadeus IT Group
companies.description: Amadeus IT Group, S.A. is a Spanish multinational technology company providing software for the global travel and tourism industry. The parent company holds over 99.7% of Amadeus IT Group, which has been listed on Spanish stock exchanges since April 2010.

companies.name: Pacific Gas and Electric Company
companies.logo_file: Pacific Gas and Electric Company logo.svg
companies.description: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E) is an American investor-owned utility headquartered in Oakland, California. It supplies natural gas and electricity to 5.2 million households across northern California.

companies.name: Embraer
companies.description: Embraer S.A. is a Brazilian multinational aerospace corporation headquartered in São José dos Campos, São Paulo. It develops and manufactures aircraft and aviation systems and is the third largest producer of civil aircraft globally, with a significant presence in military aviation.

companies.name: Wienerberger
companies.description: Wienerberger AG is an Austrian company specializing in building solutions and infrastructure systems. It is Europe's leading manufacturer of roof tiles and the world's largest producer of bricks.

companies.name: United Microelectronics Corporation
companies.description: United Microelectronics Corporation is a Taiwanese semiconductor company based in Hsinchu. Founded in 1980, it was Taiwan's first semiconductor company and originated as a spin-off from the government-sponsored Industrial Technology Research Institute.

companies.name: United Rentals
companies.description: United Rentals, Inc. is an American equipment rental company operating in North America, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. It owns the largest rental fleet globally and operates 1,625 locations, including 1,504 in North America.

companies.name: Pernod Ricard
companies.description: Pernod Ricard is a French company known for its anise-flavoured pastis apéritifs Pernod Anise and Ricard Pastis. It is the world's second-largest wine and spirits seller and produces several other types of pastis.

companies.name: Americanas
companies.description: Americanas, formerly Lojas Americanas, is a Brazilian retail chain founded in 1929 in Niterói, Rio de Janeiro. It operates 1,945 stores across all 26 Brazilian states and the Federal District, making it the sixth largest retailer in Brazil.

companies.name: Hugo Boss
companies.description: Hugo Boss AG is a German designer fashion company headquartered in Metzingen, Baden-Württemberg. It sells clothing, accessories, footwear, and leather goods under the brands Boss and Hugo, and is one of the largest German clothing brands.

companies.name: Magnitogorsk Iron and Steel Works
companies.logo_file: Magnitogorsk Iron and Steel Works logo.svg
companies.description: Magnitogorsk Iron and Steel Works (MMK) is an iron and steel company located in Magnitogorsk, Russia. As of 2017, it was the 30th largest steel company worldwide.

companies.name: Paramount Global
companies.description: Paramount Global, commonly known as Paramount, was an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate headquartered in Midtown Manhattan. It was formed in 2019 as ViacomCBS through a merger and renamed Paramount in 2022.

companies.name: Alfa Laval
companies.description: Alfa Laval AB is a Swedish company founded in 1883 that initially provided centrifuges for dairies. It now produces specialized products for heavy industry used to heat, cool, separate, and transport various substances including oil, water, chemicals, and foodstuffs.

companies.name: Südzucker
companies.description: Südzucker AG is a German company and the largest sugar producer in the world, with an annual production of around 4.8 million tonnes.

companies.name: KDDI
companies.description: KDDI Corporation is a Japanese telecommunications operator established in 2000 through the merger of DDI Corporation, KDD Corporation, and IDO Corporation. It provides long-distance, international, and mobile telecommunications services.

companies.name: Worldline
companies.industry: data processing, hosting and related activities
companies.description: Worldline SA is a French payment processing company founded in 1972. It operates in data processing, hosting, and related activities. In 2024, the company reported revenue of €4.63 billion.

companies.name: Citizen Watch
companies.description: Citizen Watch Co., Ltd. is a Japanese precision-equipment manufacturer and holding company of the Citizen Group. Headquartered in Nishitōkyō, Tokyo, it operates in watches, machine tools, and devices and components segments. It is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Meritor
companies.description: Meritor, Inc. is an American corporation headquartered in Troy, Michigan. It manufactures automobile components for military suppliers, trucks, and trailers. Meritor is recognized as a Fortune 500 company.

companies.name: Micro-Star International
companies.description: Micro-Star International Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese multinational corporation based in New Taipei City. The company designs, develops, and provides computer hardware and related products including laptops, motherboards, graphics cards, and automotive infotainment systems.

companies.name: Motorola Solutions
companies.description: Motorola Solutions, Inc. is an American technology company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It provides safety and security products and services including critical communications and video security technologies. The company was formed in 2011 as the legal successor to Motorola, Inc.

companies.name: M.video
companies.description: PJSC M.video is a leading Russian e-commerce and consumer electronics retailer. It unites the M.Video and Eldorado brands in its retail operations.

companies.name: Amgen
companies.description: Amgen Inc. is an American multinational biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Thousand Oaks, California. It ranks 18th among the largest biomedical companies by revenue. The name AMGen is derived from Applied Molecular Genetics.

companies.name: Xylem Inc.
companies.description: Xylem Inc. is a large American water technology provider headquartered in Washington, DC. It serves public utility, industrial, commercial, agricultural, and residential markets in over 150 countries. The company was launched in 2011 as a spinoff from ITT Corporation.

companies.name: Agilent Technologies
companies.description: Agilent Technologies, Inc. is an American global company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It provides instruments, software, services, and consumables for laboratories. Agilent was established in 1999 as a spin-off from Hewlett-Packard.

companies.name: PhosAgro
companies.description: PhosAgro is a Russian chemical holding company based in Moscow. It produces fertilizer, phosphates, and feed phosphates, and owns subsidiaries including Apatit, which extracts apatite rock. PhosAgro is Europe's largest producer of phosphate-based fertilizers.

companies.name: Covestro
companies.description: Covestro AG is a German company that produces polyurethane and polycarbonate raw materials. It offers products such as isocyanates, polyols for cellular foams, thermoplastic polyurethane, and additives for coatings and adhesives. Covestro was formed as a spin-off from Bayer in 2015 and was formerly known as Bayer MaterialScience.

companies.name: Brenntag
companies.description: Brenntag SE is a German holding company specializing in the distribution of chemicals and ingredients. Founded in 1874 in Berlin, it is headquartered in Essen, Germany, and operates in more than 600 locations across 72 countries.

companies.name: Citizens Financial Group
companies.description: Citizens Financial Group, Inc. is an American bank holding company headquartered in Providence, Rhode Island. It owns Citizens Bank, N.A., which operates in multiple U.S. states including Connecticut, Florida, and New York, among others.

companies.name: HTC
companies.description: HTC Corporation is a Taiwanese consumer electronics company headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan. Founded in 1997, HTC started as an original design and equipment manufacturer focusing on laptop computers.

companies.name: Newell Brands
companies.description: Newell Brands Inc. is an American conglomerate producing consumer and commercial products. Its brands include Rubbermaid storage containers, Contigo water bottles, Coleman outdoor products, and various writing instruments and cookware.

companies.name: BlueScope Steel
companies.description: BlueScope Steel Limited is an Australian flat product steel producer. The company was spun off from BHP Billiton in 2002 and operates in the iron and steel industry.

companies.name: Suzano Papel e Celulose
companies.description: Suzano Papel e Celulose is a Brazilian paper and pulp producer with operations in over 80 countries. It is the largest paper and pulp company in Latin America and has offices in cities including Salvador, São Paulo, Buenos Aires, and London.

companies.name: QBE Insurance
companies.description: QBE Insurance Group Limited is an Australian multinational general insurance and reinsurance company headquartered in Sydney. It offers commercial, personal, specialty, and risk management insurance products and employs around 13,500 people in 27 countries.

companies.name: Gilead Sciences
companies.description: Gilead Sciences, Inc. is an American biopharmaceutical company based in Foster City, California. It focuses on developing antiviral drugs for diseases such as HIV/AIDS, hepatitis, influenza, and COVID-19, as well as medicines for oncology, inflammation, and cell therapy.

companies.name: Belaruskali
companies.description: Belaruskali is a large state-owned company in Belarus and one of the world's largest producers of potash fertilizers. As of 2019, it accounted for 20% of the global potash supply.

companies.name: ASUS
companies.description: Asus, officially Asustek Computer Inc., is a Taiwanese multinational company headquartered in Taipei. It manufactures a wide range of computer, phone hardware, and electronics products including desktops, laptops, mobile phones, and networking equipment. Asus also operates as an original equipment manufacturer (OEM).

companies.name: Kasikornbank
companies.description: Kasikornbank, also known as KBank, is a banking group based in Thailand. Established in 1945 and formerly called Thai Farmers Bank, it has been listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand since 1976. The bank changed its English name to Kasikornbank PCL in 2003.

companies.name: Powszechny Zakład Ubezpieczeń
companies.description: Powszechny Zakład Ubezpieczeń (PZU SA) is Poland's largest and oldest publicly traded insurance company headquartered in Warsaw. It is the largest financial institution in Poland and the biggest insurance company in Central and Eastern Europe. PZU is part of the WIG30 stock market index.

companies.name: Public Power Corporation SA
companies.description: Public Power Corporation S.A. is the largest electric power company in Greece. In 2023, it acquired Enel Romania from the Italian Enel group. The company operates in the electricity generation sector.

companies.name: Edison International
companies.description: Edison International is a public utility holding company based in Rosemead, California. Its subsidiaries include Southern California Edison and Edison Energy. The company traces its roots back to 1886 as a street light provider in Visalia, California.

companies.name: Ternium
companies.description: Ternium S.A. is a steel manufacturer with production centers in several countries including Argentina, Brazil, and the United States. It owns a majority interest in Brazil's Usiminas and produces flat and long steel products. The company has a significant sales presence across the Americas.
