companies.name: Dino Polska
companies.description: Dino Polska S.A. is a Polish retail company operating grocery stores throughout Poland. It is publicly traded on the Warsaw Stock Exchange and has a large network of stores equipped with photovoltaic installations. The company employs tens of thousands of people.

companies.name: Israel Aerospace Industries Ltd
companies.description: Israel Aerospace Industries is Israel's major aerospace and aviation manufacturer producing aerial and astronautic systems for military and civilian use. It is state-owned by the government of Israel and employs thousands of people.

companies.name: Doğan Holding Company
companies.description: Doğan Holding is a Turkish holding company based in Istanbul, founded in 1959. It operates across multiple industries including electricity generation, energy, iron and steel, mining, automotive, finance, real estate, and entertainment.

companies.name: Makita
companies.description: Makita Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of power tools founded in 1915 and based in Anjō, Japan. It operates factories in several countries including Brazil, China, Japan, and the United States.

companies.name: INA
companies.description: INA-Industrija nafte, d.d. is a Croatian multinational oil company headquartered in Zagreb. It plays a leading role in Croatia's oil business, including exploration, production, processing, and distribution of oil and gas. The company is partly owned by the Hungarian MOL Group and the Croatian Government.

companies.name: JVC Kenwood
companies.description: JVCKenwood Corporation is a Japanese multinational electronics company headquartered in Yokohama, Japan. It was formed in 2008 from the merger of JVC and Kenwood Corporation. The company focuses on car and home electronics, wireless systems, professional broadcast, CCTV, and two-way radio equipment.

companies.name: Komerční banka
companies.description: Komerční banka is a major Czech universal bank and the parent company of KB Group, part of Société Générale. It provides retail, corporate, and investment banking services in the Czech Republic and Slovakia. The bank serves over 1.6 million customers through 399 branches.

companies.name: Enea SA
companies.description: Enea is a Polish power industry company based in Poznań. It is the fourth largest energy group in Poland with a significant share in the domestic electricity sales market. The company operates primarily in the energy sector within Poland.

companies.name: Halyk Bank of Kazakhstan
companies.description: Halyk Bank is a commercial savings bank headquartered in Almaty, Kazakhstan. It operates branches in several countries including Kyrgyzstan, Georgia, Russia, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan. The bank is the legal successor of the Soviet-era Sberbank in Kazakhstan.

companies.name: Flowserve
companies.description: Flowserve Corporation is an American multinational headquartered in Irving, Texas. It supplies industrial and environmental machinery such as pumps, valves, and seals to power, oil, gas, and chemical industries. The company was formed in 1997 from a merger of BW/IP and Durco International.

companies.name: Wincanton plc
companies.description: Wincanton plc is a British logistics provider originally focused on milk haulage. It offers transport, logistics services, automated warehouses, and supply chain management. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by GXO Logistics in April 2024.

companies.name: Iran Post
companies.wiki: National Post Company of the Islamic Republic of Iran
companies.description: Iran Post is a government-owned corporation responsible for postal services in Iran. It operates as the national postal service provider within the country. The company is state-operated and manages mail delivery across Iran.

companies.name: Expedia Group
companies.description: Expedia Group, Inc. is an American travel technology company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. It owns and operates multiple travel fare aggregators and metasearch engines including Expedia and Hotels.com. The company offers booking for millions of lodging facilities and flights worldwide.

companies.name: Aker Solutions
companies.description: Aker Solutions ASA is a Norwegian engineering firm headquartered near Oslo. It focuses on energy infrastructure, including systems and services for de-carbonizing oil and gas production, wind-to-grid infrastructure, and CO2 capture and sequestration. The company operates in the energy engineering sector.

companies.name: Millicom
companies.description: Millicom International Cellular S.A., known as Millicom, is a Luxembourg-domiciled telecommunications provider operating exclusively in Latin America under the Tigo brand. Its registered office is in Luxembourg City, with principal executive offices in Doral, Florida. The company is listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market in the United States.

companies.name: Grupa Azoty S.A.
companies.description: Grupa Azoty S.A. is a major Polish chemical industry company headquartered in the Mościce district of Tarnów, in southeastern Poland. It operates in the chemical sector and is one of the leading companies in its industry in Poland.

companies.name: Acron Group
companies.description: Acron Group is a global Russian producer of mineral fertilizers. The company operates internationally in the chemical industry, focusing on fertilizer production.

companies.name: Sacyr
companies.description: SACYR S.A. is a Spanish infrastructure operator and developer company based in Madrid. It operates in the construction and infrastructure sector in Spain.

companies.name: Ball Corporation
companies.description: Ball Corporation is an American aluminum manufacturing company headquartered in Westminster, Colorado. Founded in 1880, it is known for producing glass jars and has expanded into aerospace technology and aluminum packaging manufacturing.

companies.name: Sanoma Corporation
companies.description: Sanoma Corporation is Finland's largest media group and a European education publisher headquartered in Helsinki. It operates media businesses in Finland and education businesses in twelve European countries.

companies.name: Embracer Group
companies.description: Embracer Group AB is a Swedish video game and media holding company based in Karlstad. The company operates through two segments: Embracer and Fellowship Entertainment.

companies.name: Fortinet
companies.description: Fortinet, Inc. is an American cybersecurity company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It develops and sells security products such as firewalls, endpoint security, and intrusion detection systems, with offices in the US, Canada, and UK.

companies.name: Cushman & Wakefield
companies.description: Cushman & Wakefield is a global commercial real estate services firm headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It provides services to occupiers and investors with operations in leasing, capital markets, valuation, and advisory services across nearly 60 countries.

companies.name: Fibria
companies.description: Fibria Celulose was a Brazilian pulp and paper company formed by merging Aracruz Celulose and Votorantim Celulose e Papel. It had production capacity exceeding six million tons across seven factories in five Brazilian states and maintained distributor centers worldwide.

companies.name: Synchrony Financial
companies.description: Synchrony Financial is an American consumer financial services company headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut. It offers consumer financing products such as credit, promotional financing, loyalty programs, and installment lending through its wholly owned online bank subsidiary, Synchrony Bank.

companies.name: Nizhnekamskneftekhim
companies.description: Nizhnekamskneftekhim is a large petrochemical company headquartered in Nizhnekamsk, Russia. It is the largest specialized petrochemical company in Europe.

companies.name: Sun Life Financial
companies.description: Sun Life Financial Inc. is a financial services company headquartered in Toronto, Canada. Founded in 1865, it operates internationally in life insurance, wealth management, and asset management.

companies.name: Gold Peak
companies.description: Gold Peak Technology Group Limited is a Hong Kong–based multinational corporation established in 1964. It produces batteries under brands like GP and GP Recyko, and owns speaker brands KEF and Celestion.

companies.name: Bic
companies.industry: wholesale trade (business-to-business) of other household goods
companies.description: Société Bic S.A. is a French manufacturing corporation based in Clichy, Hauts-de-Seine. Founded in 1945, it produces disposable items including pens, stationery, lighters, and shaving razors.

companies.name: International
companies.description: International Motors, LLC is an American manufacturer of commercial vehicles and engines established in 1986. It produces trucks under its own brand and buses under the IC Bus name and is an independent subsidiary of Traton since 2021.

companies.name: The Warehouse Group
companies.description: The Warehouse Group is the largest retail group in New Zealand, headquartered in Auckland. Founded in 1982, it includes brands such as the Warehouse, Warehouse Stationery, and Noel Leeming.

companies.name: Kesko
companies.description: Kesko Corporation is a Finnish retail conglomerate headquartered in Helsinki. It operates in grocery, building and technical trade, and car trade sectors across several Northern and Eastern European countries.

companies.name: Tsinghua Tongfang Company
companies.description: Tsinghua Tongfang Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded state-owned enterprise headquartered in Beijing, China. Established in 1997, it operates in consumer electronics, information technology, and energy and environmental industries.

companies.name: GlobalFoundries
companies.description: GlobalFoundries Inc. is a multinational semiconductor technology development, design, and contract manufacturing company headquartered in Malta, New York. It was created from AMD's manufacturing arm divestiture in 2009 and is majority owned by Mubadala Investment Company.

companies.name: K+S
companies.description: K+S AG is a German chemical company headquartered in Kassel. It is Europe's largest supplier of potash used in fertilizer and also produces other mineral fertilizers like magnesium and sulfur. The company operates mainly in Europe, North and South America.

companies.name: Rocket Companies
companies.description: Rocket Companies, Inc. is an American fintech and homeownership services company based in Downtown Detroit, Michigan. It is one of the largest mortgage lenders in the United States through its subsidiary Rocket Mortgage. Its subsidiaries include Redfin, Forsalebyowner.com, and Rocket Money.

companies.name: Zalando
companies.description: Zalando SE is a German multinational e-commerce company headquartered in Berlin, specializing in fashion, beauty, and footwear. It is Europe's largest online fashion retailer and operates in 30 European markets with a large active customer base.

companies.name: Proximus Group
companies.description: The Proximus Group provides digital services and communication solutions in Belgium and internationally. It operates under brands like Proximus, Scarlet, and Mobile Vikings in Belgium and has operations in Luxembourg and the Netherlands. The group also includes an ecosystem of IT partners.

companies.name: Uniper
companies.description: Uniper SE is a German multinational energy company based in Düsseldorf, formed in 2016 by separating E.ON's fossil fuel assets. It is one of Europe's largest energy companies by revenue and has been state-owned since late 2022. The company employed about 6,800 people in over 40 countries as of 2019.

companies.name: DFDS
companies.description: DFDS is a Danish international shipping and logistics company founded in 1866 by merging the three biggest Danish steamship companies of that time. The company's name is an abbreviation of Det Forenede Dampskibs-Selskab.

companies.name: Rede Energia
companies.description: Rede Energia Participacoes, formerly Rede Energia, is a Brazil-based utility holding company focused on electricity energy. It is one of the largest electricity companies in Brazil.

companies.name: M. Dias Branco
companies.description: M. Dias Branco S.A. is a Brazilian multinational company headquartered in Eusébio, Ceará. It manufactures, markets, and distributes biscuits, pasta, cakes, snacks, wheat flour, margarine, and vegetable shortening throughout Brazil.

companies.name: Edwards Lifesciences
companies.description: Edwards Lifesciences Corporation is an American medical technology company headquartered in Irvine, California. It specializes in tissue heart valves and transcatheter technologies for structural heart disease treatment. The company has manufacturing facilities in multiple countries and is building a new plant in Spain.

companies.name: Indorama Ventures
companies.description: Indorama Ventures (IVL) is a producer in the intermediate petrochemicals industry and is the world's largest producer of PET resins. The company is based in Thailand.

companies.name: Orica
companies.description: Orica Limited is an Australian multinational corporation that provides commercial explosives and blasting systems to mining, quarrying, oil and gas, and construction markets. It also supplies sodium cyanide for gold extraction and offers ground support services in mining and tunnelling.

companies.name: Stadler Rail
companies.description: Stadler Rail AG is a Swiss manufacturer of railway rolling stock based in Bussnang, Switzerland. The company produces regional multiple unit trains, trams, rapid transit, high-speed rail, intercity, sleeper train vehicles, and rack railway rolling stock.

companies.name: Turkcell
companies.description: Turkcell İletişim Hizmetleri A.Ş. is the leading mobile phone operator in Turkey, headquartered in Istanbul. It operates in multiple countries and has developed the Yaani browser for mobile and desktop platforms.

companies.name: Palo Alto Networks
companies.description: Palo Alto Networks, Inc. is an American multinational cybersecurity company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It offers a platform with advanced firewalls and cloud-based security services, serving over 70,000 organizations worldwide.

companies.name: Optimum Communications
companies.description: Optimum Communications, Inc. is an American telecommunications provider controlled by Patrick Drahi. It offers digital cable television and broadband services primarily in the New York metropolitan area and other U.S. states.

companies.name: Lifan Group
companies.description: Lifan Industry (Group) Co., Ltd. is a civilian-owned Chinese manufacturer of motorcycles and automobiles headquartered in Chongqing. Founded in 1992, it began automobile production in 2005 with license-built microvans and a small sedan.

companies.name: Uztelecom
companies.description: Uztelecom is a telecommunications operator in Uzbekistan providing mobile communications, broadband Internet, fixed-line and IP telephony, digital television, and other services. It also develops cloud technologies, video surveillance, OTT services, data centers, and cybersecurity solutions.

companies.name: Dahua Technology
companies.description: Zhejiang Dahua Technology Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded company based in Hangzhou, China, that manufactures video surveillance equipment. A minority of the company is state-owned.

companies.name: SYENSQO
companies.description: Syensqo is a Belgian multinational chemicals and advanced materials company headquartered in Brussels. It was established in December 2023 through a spin-off from Solvay and is led by CEO Mike Radossich since January 2026.

companies.name: Kennametal
companies.description: Kennametal, Inc. is an American manufacturer of high-performance cutting tools and engineered components used in aerospace, defense, transportation, and oil and gas drilling industries. It serves a global customer base.

companies.name: Lululemon Athletica
companies.description: Lululemon Athletica is a Canadian-American multinational athletic apparel retailer headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. Founded in 1998, it started as a retailer of yoga pants and yoga wear and has expanded to include sportswear, lifestyle apparel, shoes, accessories, and personal care products. The company operates 811 stores and sells products online.

companies.name: Atlassian
companies.description: Atlassian is a multinational proprietary software company headquartered in Sydney, Australia. It specializes in collaboration tools primarily designed for software development and project management. The company serves a global market with its software products.

companies.name: Weyerhaeuser
companies.description: The Weyerhaeuser Company is an American timberland company that owns approximately 10.4 million acres of timberlands in the U.S. and manages an additional 14 million acres in Canada under long-term licenses. It has manufactured wood products for over a century and operates as a real estate investment trust (REIT).

companies.name: Lanxess
companies.description: Lanxess AG is a German specialty chemicals company based in Cologne, Germany. It was founded in 2004 following the spin-off of Bayer AG's chemicals division and parts of its polymers business. The company operates in the chemical industry.

companies.name: Puig
companies.description: Puig Brands, S.A. is a Spanish premium beauty company founded in 1914 by Antonio Puig Castelló in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. The company remains under the management of the Puig family and operates in the fashion and beauty sector.

companies.name: Suzlon Energy
companies.description: Suzlon Energy is an Indian multinational wind turbine manufacturer headquartered in Pune, Western India. The company operates in the renewable energy industry, focusing on wind energy solutions.

companies.name: easyJet
companies.description: EasyJet plc is a British low-cost airline and package holiday multinational group headquartered at Luton Airport. It operates domestic and international scheduled services on 927 routes in over 34 countries through affiliate airlines and offers package holidays to more than 100 destinations across Europe and North Africa.

companies.name: RTL Group
companies.description: RTL Group S.A. is a Luxembourgish-German international media conglomerate with a corporate office in Cologne, Germany. It operates 86 television channels and 42 radio stations across Europe, offers national streaming platforms, content production, and digital services. Key segments include RTL Deutschland, Groupe M6, and Fremantle.

companies.name: Bausch & Lomb
companies.description: Bausch & Lomb is an eye health products company based in Vaughan, Ontario. It produces contact lenses, intraocular lenses, medications, and products related to eye surgery. The company operates in the pharmaceutical and eye health sector.

companies.name: Nexstar Media Group
companies.description: Nexstar Media Group, Inc. is an American multimedia conglomerate headquartered in Irving, Texas, with additional offices in Manhattan and Chicago. Founded in 1996, it is the largest television broadcasting company in the U.S., owning 265 television stations affiliated with major networks and operating others through local marketing agreements.

companies.name: Gedeon Richter Ltd.
companies.description: Gedeon Richter Plc. is a Hungarian multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company headquartered in Budapest. Founded in 1901 by pharmacist Gedeon Richter, it is listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the BUX Index.

companies.name: Rosbank
companies.description: Rosbank is a Russian bank currently operating as a branch of T-Bank with its own brand focused on corporate clients. In 2024, it ranked 11th among Russian banks by assets and was named the third most reliable Russian bank by Forbes Russia.

companies.name: OMV Petrom
companies.description: OMV Petrom S.A. is a Romanian integrated oil company controlled by Austria's OMV. It is the largest oil and gas producer in Southeast Europe and one of Romania's largest corporations. Since 2004, it has been a subsidiary of OMV.

companies.name: Charles Schwab Corporation
companies.description: The Charles Schwab Corporation is an American multinational financial services company headquartered in Westlake, Texas. It offers banking, investing, and wealth management services to retail and institutional clients, operating over 380 branches mainly in the US and UK.

companies.name: Bandai Namco Holdings
companies.description: Bandai Namco Holdings Inc. is a Japanese mass media and entertainment conglomerate founded in 2005 by merging Namco and Bandai. The company specializes in toys, video games, arcades, anime, restaurants, and amusement parks.

companies.name: Jiangling Motors
companies.description: Jiangling Motors Corporation Limited (JMC) is a Chinese automobile manufacturer. Its largest shareholder is Jiangling Investment, which is controlled equally by the state-owned enterprises Changan and Jiangling Motors Corporation Group.

companies.name: Goodbaby International
companies.description: Goodbaby International is a Chinese company incorporated in the Cayman Islands and headquartered in Shanghai. It designs, develops, markets, and sells a variety of children's products worldwide, including strollers and child seats.

companies.name: Rockwool
companies.description: Rockwool A/S, also known as the ROCKWOOL Group, is a Danish multinational manufacturer of mineral wool products headquartered in Hedehusene, Denmark. Its research and development unit is co-located with its Copenhagen headquarters.

companies.name: Vonovia
companies.description: Vonovia is a European multinational real estate company based in Bochum, Germany. It owns around 530,979 apartments in Germany, Sweden, and Austria and is a member of the DAX 40 and STOXX Europe 600 blue-chip indexes.

companies.name: Axia Energia
companies.description: Axia Energia S.A. is a major electric utilities company based in Brazil. Its headquarters are located in Rio de Janeiro. The company operates in the renewables and utilities sector.

companies.name: Konecranes
companies.description: Konecranes Oyj is a Finnish company specializing in the manufacture and service of cranes and lifting equipment. It is headquartered in Hyvinkää, Finland. The company also services machine tools.

companies.name: Oshkosh Corporation
companies.description: Oshkosh Corporation is an American industrial company that designs and builds specialty trucks, military vehicles, and airport fire apparatus. It owns Pierce Manufacturing and JLG Industries. The company operates in the automotive industry sector.

companies.name: Tampella
companies.description: Oy Tampella Ab was a Finnish heavy industry manufacturer based mainly in Tampere. It produced paper machines, locomotives, military weaponry, and wood-based products. The company operated in the arms industry.

companies.name: Ozon
companies.description: Ozon Holdings PLC is a Russian e-commerce company established in 1998 as an online bookstore. It became one of the three biggest online retail platforms in Russia by 2019. It is sometimes called the Amazon of Russia.

companies.name: Solidcore Resources
companies.description: Solidcore Resources plc, formerly Polymetal International plc until June 2024, is a mining company registered in Kazakhstan. It operates two mines and one major development project in Kazakhstan. The company focuses on exploration and processing refractory ores.

companies.name: Tabcorp
companies.description: Tabcorp is Australia's largest gambling company and the largest provider of wagering and gaming products and services in the country. It employs over 5,000 people and is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.

companies.name: Weir Group
companies.description: Weir plc is a Scottish multinational engineering company headquartered in Glasgow. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index. The company operates in the mining sector.

companies.name: Konzum
companies.description: Konzum is Croatia's largest supermarket chain with over 700 stores and more than 10,000 employees. It serves over 650,000 customers daily and is headquartered in Zagreb. Konzum is part of the Fortenova Group since 2019.

companies.name: NetApp
companies.description: NetApp, Inc. is an American data infrastructure company based in San Jose, California. Founded in 1992, it provides unified data storage, integrated data services, and cloud operations solutions. It was ranked in the Fortune 500 from 2012 to 2021.

companies.name: Dassault Aviation
companies.description: Dassault Aviation SA is a French manufacturer of military aircraft and business jets. Founded in 1929 by Marcel Bloch, the company was renamed Avions Marcel Dassault in 1947 after its founder changed his name to Marcel Dassault. It is based in France and has a long history in the arms industry.

companies.name: Ashok Leyland
companies.description: Ashok Leyland Limited is an Indian multinational automotive manufacturer headquartered in Chennai. Founded in 1948 as Ashok Motors, it was renamed Ashok Leyland in 1955 after collaborating with British Leyland. It is one of the largest commercial vehicle manufacturers in India.

companies.name: Bally's Corporation
companies.description: Bally's Corporation is an American gambling, betting, and interactive entertainment company headquartered in Providence, Rhode Island. It operates casinos, a horse track, a golf course, and online sports betting across multiple states in the US and properties in Australia through a subsidiary.

companies.name: China Airlines
companies.description: China Airlines is the state-owned flag carrier of Taiwan, headquartered at Taoyuan International Airport. It operates over 1,400 weekly flights to 102 cities worldwide and is one of Taiwan's three major airlines. The airline carries millions of passengers and significant cargo annually.

companies.name: Robert Half
companies.description: Robert Half Inc. is an international human resource consulting firm founded in 1948 and based in California. It is one of the world's largest accounting and finance staffing firms with over 345 locations worldwide.

companies.name: Harman International Industries
companies.description: Harman International Industries, Inc. is an American audio electronics company. Since 2017, it has operated as an independent subsidiary of Samsung Electronics. The company is known for its audio products and electronics.

companies.name: Kongsberg Automotive
companies.description: Kongsberg Automotive Holding ASA is a manufacturer of automotive parts based in Norway. It operates in the automotive industry providing components for vehicles.

companies.name: USA Today Co.
companies.description: USA Today Co., Inc., formerly known as Gannett, is an American mass media holding company headquartered in New York City. It is the largest U.S. newspaper publisher by total daily circulation.

companies.name: Viacom
companies.description: Viacom Inc. was an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate focused on film and television. It was split from the original Viacom in 2005, with National Amusements as the controlling shareholder. The split created a new Viacom and CBS Corporation.

companies.name: Paul Hartmann AG
companies.description: The Hartmann Group is a German manufacturer of medical and care products headquartered in Heidenheim, Baden-Württemberg. It operates in wound care, incontinence management, and infection management segments, providing products and associated services.

companies.name: Wanhua Chemical Group Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Wanhua Chemical Group Co., Ltd., also known as Wanhua Chemical, is a Chinese listed company in the chemical industry. It was formerly known as Yantai Wanhua Polyurethane. The company is based in China and operates in the chemical sector.

companies.name: Kinder Morgan
companies.description: Kinder Morgan, Inc. is an American energy infrastructure company specializing in owning and controlling oil and gas pipelines and terminals. It is based in the United States and operates within the petroleum industry.

companies.name: NIS
companies.description: Naftna Industrija Srbije (NIS) is a Serbian multinational oil and gas company headquartered in Novi Sad, Serbia. It is one of the most profitable companies in Serbia and a major domestic exporter. Gazprom Neft is the largest shareholder, owning 44.85% of NIS shares.

companies.name: Arrium
companies.description: Arrium was an Australian mining and materials company that employed nearly 10,000 workers before entering voluntary administration in 2016. It was acquired in 2017 by the British-owned Liberty House Group. The company was based in Australia and operated in the mining sector.

companies.name: Electronic Arts
companies.description: Electronic Arts Inc. (EA) is an American video game company headquartered in Redwood City, California. Founded in 1982 by Trip Hawkins, it was a pioneer in the early home computer game industry and shifted toward internal game studios through acquisitions starting in 1987.

companies.name: United Wagon Company
companies.description: United Wagon Company is a major Russian manufacturer of railway freight cars headquartered in Moscow. The company operates in the mechanical engineering industry and is based in Russia.

companies.name: Trimble
companies.description: Trimble Inc. is an American technology company founded in 1978 and headquartered in Westminster, Colorado. It develops hardware and software for sectors including architecture, engineering, construction, surveying, mapping, and transportation logistics.

companies.name: Smith & Nephew
companies.description: Smith & Nephew plc is a British multinational medical equipment manufacturer headquartered in Watford, England. It produces advanced wound management, arthroscopy, trauma, clinical therapy, and orthopaedic reconstruction products sold in over 100 countries.

companies.name: Discovery, Inc.
companies.description: Discovery, Inc. was an American multinational mass media and factual television conglomerate based in New York City, operating from 1982 to 2022. It owned channels like Discovery Channel and Animal Planet and acquired Scripps Networks Interactive in 2018.

companies.name: Huntington Bancshares
companies.description: Huntington Bancshares Incorporated is an American bank holding company headquartered in Columbus, Ohio. Its subsidiary, The Huntington National Bank, operates over 1,300 banking offices primarily in the Midwest and South regions of the United States.

companies.name: Western Union
companies.description: The Western Union Company is an American multinational financial services corporation headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It specializes in financial services and operates globally.

companies.name: Pall Corporation
companies.description: Pall Corporation is a global supplier of filtration, separations, and purification products headquartered in Port Washington, New York. It operates in Life Sciences and Industrial sectors and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Danaher Corporation since 2015.

companies.name: Toyo Tire Corporation
companies.description: Toyo Tire Corporation, commonly known as Toyo Tires, is a multinational tire and rubber products company based in Itami, Japan. It owns eight factories across Asia, North America, and Europe and distributes products worldwide.

companies.name: Euronet Worldwide
companies.description: Euronet is an American provider of global electronic payment services headquartered in Leawood, Kansas. It offers ATM, POS, credit/debit card services, currency exchange, and other electronic financial services.

companies.name: Brembo
companies.description: Brembo N.V. is an Italian manufacturer of automotive parts, notably producing braking systems for high-performance cars. Its operational head office is in Curno, Bergamo, Italy, with its legal seat in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

companies.name: PTT Public Company Limited
companies.description: PTT Public Company Limited is a Thai state-owned petroleum and natural gas company involved in exploration, production, electricity generation, and gasoline retailing. It also owns Café Amazon, a coffee chain in Southeast Asia.

companies.name: Tiffany & Co.
companies.description: Tiffany & Co. is an American luxury jewelry and specialty design house headquartered on Fifth Avenue in Manhattan. Owned by LVMH, it is known for sterling silver and diamond jewelry sold in stores, online, and through corporate merchandising.

companies.name: ITT Corporation
companies.description: ITT Inc. is an American manufacturing company based in Stamford, Connecticut. It produces specialty components for aerospace, transportation, energy, and industrial markets through its three business units.

companies.name: Dorel Industries
companies.description: Dorel Industries Inc. is a Canadian company based in Montreal, Quebec, designing and manufacturing juvenile products and home furnishings. It was formed in 1987 from a merger and sells products in over 100 countries.

companies.name: Kintetsu World Express
companies.description: Kintetsu World Express, Inc. is a major Japanese freight forwarding company and subsidiary of Kintetsu Group Holdings. It provides air and sea freight forwarding, customs brokerage, and warehouse inventory management services.

companies.name: Konami
companies.description: Konami Group Corporation is a Japanese multinational entertainment company headquartered in Chūō, Tokyo. It develops and publishes video games and also produces trading cards, anime, pachinko and slot machines, and operates casinos and health clubs in Japan.

companies.name: Yaskawa Electric Corporation
companies.description: Yaskawa Electric Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer specializing in servos, motion controllers, AC motor drives, switches, and industrial robots. Their Motoman robots are used in various industrial automation tasks such as welding and packaging.

companies.name: Asiana Airlines
companies.description: Asiana Airlines Inc. is a South Korean airline headquartered in Seoul. It operates numerous international, domestic, and cargo routes across Asia, Europe, and North America, with hubs at Incheon and Gimpo International Airports. The airline is set to merge with Korean Air in December 2026.

companies.name: ServiceNow
companies.description: ServiceNow, Inc. is an American software company founded in 2003 in Santa Clara, California. It provides cloud computing platforms for creating and managing automated business workflows and is listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

companies.name: MTU Aero Engines
companies.description: MTU Aero Engines AG is a German aircraft engine manufacturer. It develops, manufactures, and services engines for military and civil aircraft and was formerly known as MTU München.

companies.name: JCDecaux
companies.description: JCDecaux SE is a French multinational corporation specializing in outdoor advertising. Headquartered in Neuilly-sur-Seine, France, it is the largest company in its sector worldwide with advertisements on bus stops and airports.

companies.name: Dixon Technologies
companies.description: Dixon Technologies is an Indian multinational electronics manufacturing services company based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. It manufactures consumer electronics like televisions and smartphones for major brands and operates 17 manufacturing units in India.

companies.name: NetEase
companies.description: NetEase, Inc. is a Chinese Internet technology company founded in 1997 by Ding Lei. Its businesses include video games, news aggregation, music streaming, advertising, email, and e-commerce.

companies.name: Scandic Hotels Group
companies.description: Scandic Hotels is a Swedish hotel chain headquartered in Stockholm with operations mainly in the Nordic countries and presence in Germany and Poland. It operates hundreds of hotels and tens of thousands of guest rooms.

companies.name: Curtiss-Wright
companies.description: The Curtiss-Wright Corporation is an American manufacturer and services provider headquartered in Davidson, North Carolina. Founded in 1929, it was the largest U.S. aviation firm and produced over 142,000 aircraft engines for the military during World War II.

companies.name: Rakuten Group, Inc.
companies.description: Rakuten Group, Inc. is a Japanese technology conglomerate headquartered in Tokyo. Founded in 1997 by Hiroshi Mikitani, it operates a global system of internet services centered around its online retail marketplace Rakuten Ichiba.

companies.name: China Steel Corporation
companies.description: China Steel Corporation is the largest integrated steel maker in Taiwan, with its main steel mill located in Siaogang District, Kaohsiung. It is part of the CSC Group and was the 23rd largest steel producer worldwide in 2016.

companies.name: Altria
companies.description: Altria Group, Inc. is an American corporation and one of the world's largest producers and marketers of tobacco and cigarettes. It operates worldwide and is headquartered in Richmond, Virginia.

companies.name: Burberry
companies.description: Burberry Group plc is a British luxury fashion house established in 1856 and headquartered in London, England. It designs and distributes ready-to-wear clothing, including trench coats, leather accessories, and footwear.

companies.name: NRG Energy
companies.description: NRG Energy, Inc. is an American energy company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It is involved in energy generation and retail electricity, with a portfolio including natural gas, coal, oil, nuclear, wind, and solar generation.

companies.name: Skechers
companies.description: Skechers U.S.A., Inc. is an American multinational footwear and apparel manufacturing company founded in 1992. It is headquartered in Manhattan Beach, California, and is the third largest footwear brand in the world.

companies.name: Casio
companies.description: Casio Computer Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational electronics manufacturer headquartered in Shibuya, Tokyo. Its principal products include watches, clocks, calculators, electronic dictionaries, label printers, and electronic musical instruments.

companies.name: Danieli
companies.description: Danieli Group is an Italian supplier of equipment and physical plants to the metal industry. Based in Buttrio, Italy, it is a world leader in the production of steel plants, especially in the long products segment.

companies.name: Allegheny Technologies
companies.description: ATI Inc. is an American producer of specialty materials headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It produces metals including titanium, nickel-based alloys, stainless steels, zirconium, hafnium, niobium, tungsten materials, forgings, and castings.

companies.name: Aperam
companies.description: Aperam S.A. is a global leader in stainless, electrical, alloy, and specialty steels with recycling activities. It operates facilities in Brazil, Belgium, and France, focusing on stainless and specialty steel production. The company is listed on multiple European stock exchanges including Amsterdam and Luxembourg.

companies.name: Morningstar, Inc.
companies.description: Morningstar, Inc. is an American financial services firm headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. Founded in 1984 by Joe Mansueto, it provides investment research and investment management services.

companies.name: Banca Transilvania
companies.description: Banca Transilvania is a Romanian universal bank and financial services group headquartered in Cluj-Napoca. Founded in 1993 by local entrepreneurs, it has become the largest bank in Romania and Southeastern Europe with a significant share of national banking assets.

companies.name: Boryszew
companies.description: Boryszew SA is a Polish public company based in Sochaczew, listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange and part of the WIG30 index. It produces automotive components, chemical materials, metal oxides, and other metal elements, operating 30 production plants in 14 countries.

companies.name: Keysight Technologies
companies.description: Keysight Technologies, Inc. is a global company headquartered in Santa Rosa, California. It manufactures electronic testing equipment and software used in designing and evaluating technologies across sectors like mobile communications, aerospace, automotive, and energy.

companies.name: Equifax
companies.description: Equifax Inc. is an American multinational consumer credit reporting agency headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It collects and aggregates credit and demographic data on millions of consumers and businesses worldwide and offers credit monitoring and fraud prevention services.

companies.name: Rostselmash
companies.description: Rostselmash is a Russian agricultural equipment company based in Rostov-on-Don. Founded in 1929, it primarily produces combine harvesters. The company name is an abbreviation of its original Russian name referring to the Rostov factory for agricultural machines.

companies.name: Energa
companies.description: Energa SA is a Polish corporate group involved in electricity generation, distribution, and supply. It serves approximately 2.7 million people in Northern Poland and is the country's third largest electricity distribution network operator.

companies.name: Juniper Networks
companies.description: Juniper Networks, Inc. was an American multinational corporation headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It developed and marketed networking products including routers, switches, network management software, and network security products.

companies.name: TIM Brasil
companies.description: TIM Brasil Serviços e Participações S.A., known as TIM Brasil, is a Brazilian telecommunications company and subsidiary of TIM S.p.A. It provides mobile and fixed telephony services in Brazil.

companies.name: Legal & General
companies.description: Legal & General Group plc is a British multinational financial services and asset management company headquartered in London, England. It offers investment management, lifetime mortgages, pensions, annuities, and life insurance. The company sold its general insurance business to Allianz in 2020.

companies.name: Maxim Integrated
companies.description: Maxim Integrated Products, Inc. was an American semiconductor company based in San Jose, California. It designed, manufactured, and sold analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits for various markets including automotive and communications. The company was acquired by Analog Devices in 2021.

companies.name: Kinross Gold
companies.description: Kinross Gold Corporation is a Canadian gold and silver mining company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. Founded in 1993, it operates six active gold mines in Brazil, Mauritania, and the United States. It was ranked fifth among the top gold-mining companies in 2019.

companies.name: China High Speed Transmission
companies.description: China High Speed Transmission Equipment Group Company, Ltd. is a Chinese manufacturer of high-speed gear transmission equipment. It is the largest wind power transmission gear manufacturer in China.

companies.name: Illumina
companies.description: Illumina, Inc. is an American biotechnology company headquartered in San Diego, California. Founded in 1998, it develops and markets integrated systems for genetic variation and biological function analysis. Its products serve sequencing, genotyping, gene expression, and proteomics markets worldwide.

companies.name: TIM
companies.description: TIM S.p.A. is an Italian multinational telecommunications company with headquarters in Rome, Milan, Bari, and Naples. It provides fixed, public and mobile telephony, as well as DSL data services.

companies.name: China Merchants Port
companies.description: China Merchants Port Holdings Company Limited is a Hong Kong-based conglomerate involved in port operations, cargo transportation, container shipping, air cargo, logistics parks, and paint products. It has port facilities in mainland China and Hong Kong and traces its origins to 1872.

companies.name: ASICS
companies.description: ASICS Corporation is a Japanese multinational sportswear company headquartered in Kobe, Hyōgo Prefecture. It manufactures athletic and lifestyle footwear, apparel, and sports equipment, with a focus on running shoes and the Onitsuka Tiger brand.

companies.name: QinetiQ
companies.description: QinetiQ is a British defence technology company headquartered in Farnborough, Hampshire. It operates in defence, security, and critical national infrastructure markets, providing testing and evaluation for air, land, sea, and target systems.

companies.name: Tele2
companies.description: Tele2 AB is a Swedish provider of mobile and fixed connectivity, telephony, data network services, TV, streaming, and global Internet of Things services. It is headquartered in Kista Science City, Stockholm, and operates major mobile networks in Sweden, Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania.

companies.name: Commercial Metals Company
companies.description: Commercial Metals Company (CMC) is a producer of rebar and related construction materials headquartered in Irving, Texas. It is one of the two primary suppliers of steel used to reinforce concrete in U.S. infrastructure. The company also owns Tensar, which produces foundation systems for construction projects.

companies.name: Fox Corporation
companies.description: Fox Corporation is an American multinational mass media company headquartered in Midtown Manhattan, New York City, with offices in Burbank, California. It was formed in 2019 as a spin-off of 21st Century Fox's broadcasting, news, and sports assets. The company is controlled by Lachlan Murdoch through a family trust.

companies.name: Citrix Systems
companies.description: Citrix Systems, Inc. is an American multinational company specializing in cloud computing and virtualization technology. It provides server, application, and desktop virtualization, networking, SaaS, and cloud computing technologies. Its products are used by over 400,000 clients worldwide, including most Fortune 100 and Fortune 500 companies.

companies.name: Reliance Infrastructure
companies.description: Reliance Infrastructure Limited is an Indian private sector enterprise involved in power generation, infrastructure, construction, and defence. Headquartered in Navi Mumbai, it is part of the Reliance Group and led by chairman Anil Ambani. The company has interests in power plants, metro rail, airports, bridges, toll roads, and defence.

companies.name: Endesa
companies.description: Endesa, S.A. is the largest Spanish multinational electric utility company and a majority-owned subsidiary of the Italian company Enel. It serves 10 million customers in Spain and internationally, generating electricity from nuclear, fossil-fueled, hydroelectric, and renewable sources. The company also has interests in natural gas and telecommunications in Spain.

companies.name: Ülker
companies.description: Ülker is a Turkish multinational food and beverage manufacturer based in Istanbul. Its products, including biscuits, cookies, crackers, and chocolates, are exported to 110 countries. The company has expanded its product categories beyond its core offerings.

companies.name: Winbond
companies.description: Winbond Electronics Corporation is a Taiwan-based semiconductor company founded in 1987. It produces various integrated circuits including dynamic and static random-access memory, serial flash, microcontrollers, and Super I/O chips.

companies.name: KAMET-STEEL
companies.description: Dnieper Metallurgical Combine is one of the largest metallurgical companies in Ukraine, located in Kamianske, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast. It operates alongside other major Ukrainian steel producers such as Kryvorizhstal and Illich Steel and Iron Works.

companies.name: VK
companies.description: VK, formerly Mail.ru Group until October 2021, is a Russian technology company founded in 1998. It began as the parent company of the Mail.ru email service and has become a major player in the Russian-speaking internet segment.

companies.name: Nasdaq, Inc.
companies.description: Nasdaq, Inc. is an American multinational financial services corporation headquartered in New York City. Founded in 1971 as the world's first electronic stock market, it provides data, analytics, software, exchange capabilities, and advisory services globally. Its CEO and chair is Adena Friedman.

companies.name: Bank Hapoalim B.M.
companies.description: Bank Hapoalim is one of the largest banks in Israel, established in 1921. It offers a broad range of financial services to retail, corporate, and institutional customers, focusing on retail banking. The bank operates more than 250 branches and offices in Israel and abroad.

companies.name: Zhenhua Port Machinery Company
companies.description: Shanghai Zhenhua Heavy Industries Company Limited (ZPMC) is a Chinese state-owned engineering company and the world's largest manufacturer of cranes and large steel structures. In 2015, it accounted for about 75% of the world market share for container cranes.

companies.name: FANUC
companies.description: FANUC is a Japanese group of companies providing automation products and services such as robotics and computer numerical control systems. It is the world's largest maker of industrial robots.

companies.name: Rostvertol
companies.description: JSC Rostvertol is a Russian helicopter manufacturer located in Rostov-on-Don, founded in 1939. It has produced helicopters designed by the Mil design bureau since 1956 and is a world leader in manufacturing heavy-lift helicopters.

companies.name: Groupe Bull
companies.description: Bull SAS is a French computer company headquartered in Les Clayes-sous-Bois near Paris. Founded in 1931, it has operated under various names and has a worldwide presence in over 100 countries, active in sectors including defense, finance, healthcare, manufacturing, public, and telecommunications.

companies.name: SVB Financial Group
companies.description: SVB Financial Group is a financial services holding company headquartered in New York City. Its main business unit was Silicon Valley Bank until the bank failed in March 2023. As of December 31, 2022, it had 164 subsidiaries.

companies.name: Evry
companies.description: EVRY A/S was a Norwegian information technology company headquartered in Oslo. Established in 2010 through a merger, it supplied computing services including operation, outsourcing, and online banking, with 10,000 employees at 135 offices in 16 countries.

companies.name: Stifel
companies.description: Stifel Financial Corp. is an American multinational independent investment bank and financial services company headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. It was created under the Stifel name in 1983, with a predecessor founded in 1890.

companies.name: Celanese Corporation
companies.description: Celanese Corporation is an American technology and specialty materials company headquartered in Irving, Texas. It is the world's leading producer of acetic acid and the largest producer of vinyl acetate monomer.

companies.name: The Mosaic Company
companies.description: The Mosaic Company is an American chemical company based in Tampa, Florida. It mines phosphate and potash and collects urea used for fertilizer, operating through international distribution networks and Mosaic Fertilizantes. It is the largest U.S. producer of potash and phosphate fertilizers.

companies.name: Extra Space Storage
companies.description: Extra Space Storage Inc. is an American real estate investment trust headquartered in Cottonwood Heights, Utah. It invests in self storage facilities and operates thousands of locations across the United States under several brand names. It is the largest owner and manager of self storage units in the country.

companies.name: Vivo
companies.description: Vivo Brazil is a telecommunications brand owned by Telefônica Brasil, a subsidiary of the Spanish company Telefónica. It is the largest telecommunications company in Brazil and is headquartered in the Brooklin Novo neighborhood of São Paulo.

companies.name: Akamai Technologies
companies.description: Akamai Technologies, Inc. is an American company specializing in content delivery networks, cybersecurity, DDoS mitigation, and cloud services. The company is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

companies.name: SunPower
companies.description: SunPower Corporation is an American provider of photovoltaic solar energy systems and battery storage products, mainly for residential customers. Founded in 1985 and headquartered in San Jose, California, it has had significant ownership changes including investments by Cypress Semiconductor and TotalEnergies.

companies.name: Bio-Rad Laboratories
companies.description: Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc. is an American developer and manufacturer of specialized products for life science research and clinical diagnostics. Founded in 1952 in Berkeley, California, it is now based in Hercules, California, with operations worldwide.

companies.name: Teradata
companies.description: Teradata Corporation is an American software company providing cloud database and analytics software and services. It was formed in 1979 in Brentwood, California, through a collaboration between Caltech researchers and Citibank's technology group.

companies.name: Kongsberg Maritime
companies.description: Kongsberg Maritime is a Norwegian technology company formerly part of Kongsberg Gruppen. It delivers systems for positioning, navigation, surveying, and automation to merchant vessels and offshore installations, with products in dynamic positioning and marine automation.

companies.name: HubSpot
companies.description: HubSpot, Inc. is an American customer relationship management firm that also operates as an unregistered data broker. The company is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

companies.name: Acerinox
companies.description: Acerinox, S.A. is a steel manufacturer headquartered in Madrid, Spain. It is the fourth largest stainless steel producer worldwide and operates factories across Europe, Asia, the U.S., and South Africa, focusing on increasing production in the U.S.

companies.name: Constellium
companies.description: Constellium SE is a French manufacturer and recycler of aluminium rolled and extruded products as well as structural components. It primarily serves the aerospace, automotive, and packaging industries.

companies.name: ING Bank Śląski
companies.description: ING Bank Śląski is a universal bank headquartered in Katowice, Poland. Established in 1989, it provides retail, corporate, and institutional banking services. Since 1996, it has been majority-owned by the Dutch banking corporation ING Group.

companies.name: Tribune Media
companies.description: Tribune Media Company, formerly known as the Tribune Company, was an American multimedia conglomerate headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It operated in the media industry.

companies.name: Veidekke
companies.description: Veidekke is the largest Norwegian construction and civil engineering company and the fourth largest in Scandinavia. It operates across Scandinavia in construction, engineering, rehabilitation, and development of dwellings and public buildings. The company also manages asphalt operations, aggregates production, and public road maintenance.

companies.name: Mosenergo
companies.description: Mosenergo is a Russian power-generating company founded in 1887 and based in Moscow. It operates fossil fuel and thermal power generation and supplies both electric power and heat to consumers in Moscow and the Moscow Oblast.

companies.name: Kajima Corporation
companies.description: Kajima Corporation is one of the oldest and largest construction companies in Japan, founded in 1840. It is headquartered in Motoakasaka, Minato, Tokyo, and is known for its DIB-200 proposal. The company is publicly traded on four major Japanese stock exchanges.

companies.name: Isuzu
companies.description: Isuzu Motors Ltd. is a Japanese multinational automobile manufacturer headquartered in Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture. It specializes in the production, marketing, and sale of commercial vehicles and diesel engines.

companies.name: Braskem
companies.description: Braskem S.A is a Brazilian petrochemical company headquartered in São Paulo. It is the largest petrochemical company in Latin America and a significant player in the international petrochemical market.

companies.name: Ørsted
companies.description: Ørsted A/S is a majority state-owned Danish multinational energy company headquartered in Fredericia, Denmark. It is the largest energy company in Denmark and adopted its current name in November 2017, previously known as DONG Energy.

companies.name: Detskiy Mir
companies.description: Detsky Mir, or Children's World, is a Russian children's goods retailer founded in 1957. It operates 1125 stores across Russia, Belarus, and Kazakhstan, making it the largest children's retailer in Russia and the CIS. The company went public in 2017 and is considered systemically important in Russia.

companies.name: Parametric Technology Corporation
companies.description: PTC Inc. is an American computer software and services company founded in 1985 and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It pioneered parametric CAD modeling software and offers products including an Internet of Things and augmented reality platform.

companies.name: Cyrela Brazil Realty
companies.description: Cyrela Brazil Realty is the largest homebuilder and real estate company by revenue and market value in Brazil. Founded in 1962 and headquartered in São Paulo, it operates in 16 states and 66 cities in Brazil, as well as in Argentina and Uruguay.

companies.name: DNIPROSPETSSTAL
companies.description: Dneprospetsstal (DSS) is a Ukrainian manufacturer of special stainless steel based in Zaporizhia. Founded in 1932 as a state-run enterprise, it is now a publicly traded company known as JPrSC Electrometallurgical Works Dneprospetsstal named after A. N. Kuzmin.

companies.name: CrowdStrike
companies.description: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. is an American cybersecurity technology company headquartered in Austin, Texas. Founded in 2011, it provides endpoint security, threat intelligence, and cyberattack response services. The company went public on Nasdaq in 2019 and joined the S&P 500 in 2024.

companies.name: Universal Music Group
companies.description: Universal Music Group N.V. is a Dutch-American multinational music corporation with corporate headquarters in Hilversum, Netherlands, and operational headquarters in Santa Monica, California. It is one of the "Big Three" record labels globally and went public on the Euronext Amsterdam stock exchange in 2021.

companies.name: ProSiebenSat.1 Media SE
companies.description: ProSiebenSat.1 Media SE is a German mass media and digital company based in Unterföhring near Munich. It operates in three segments: Entertainment, Dating, and Commerce & Ventures. The company is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and majority-owned by MediaForEurope.

companies.name: Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat
companies.description: Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat is a Russian petrochemicals company headquartered in Salavat, Bashkortostan. It specializes in processing hydrocarbons into about 150 petrochemicals, fertilizers, and petroleum products including gasoline and fuel oil.

companies.name: GN Store Nord
companies.description: GN Store Nord A/S is a Danish manufacturer of hearing aids, speakerphones, videobars, and headsets. The company is publicly listed on NASDAQ OMX Copenhagen.

companies.name: Raspadskaya coal mine
companies.description: The Raspadskaya Coal Mine is the largest coal and underground mine in Russia, located in Mezhdurechensk, Kemerovo Oblast. Opened in 1973 and completed in 1977, the mining complex includes several underground and open-pit mines as well as a preparation plant.

companies.name: Herbalife
companies.description: Herbalife Nutrition Ltd. is an American multinational multi-level marketing corporation that develops and sells dietary supplements. It is also known as Herbalife International, Inc.

companies.name: S.P. Korolev Rocket and Space Corporation Energia
companies.description: S.P. Korolev Rocket and Space Corporation Energia, known as RSC Energia, is a Russian aerospace manufacturer and spacecraft design bureau headquartered in Korolyov, Moscow Oblast. It is the principal contractor for Russia's human spaceflight program, producing crewed and cargo spacecraft, space station modules, and satellite platforms.

companies.name: Steel Dynamics
companies.description: Steel Dynamics, Inc. is an American steel producer based in Fort Wayne, Indiana. It is the third largest producer of carbon steel products in the United States and is among the most profitable American steel companies by profit margins and operating margin per ton.

companies.name: Canal+ S.A.
companies.industry: production de films et de programmes pour la télévision
companies.description: Canal+ S.A. is a French media and telecommunications conglomerate based in Paris. It operates subscription TV channels and an over-the-top video on-demand service, and is a major financier of domestic film production in France. It was a subsidiary of Vivendi until December 2024 and remains partly controlled by the Bolloré family.

companies.name: FLSmidth
companies.description: FLSmidth & Co. A/S is a Danish multinational technology company headquartered in Copenhagen. It provides equipment and services to the global mining and cement industries, including technology for mining metals like copper and gold and for cement production. The company has offices in over 60 countries worldwide.

companies.name: L'Occitane en Provence
companies.industry: retail sale of perfumery and beauty products in specialized stores
companies.description: L'Occitane en Provence is a French retailer of body, face, hair, home products, and fragrances based in Manosque, France. Founded in 1976, it was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2010 and was taken private by its controlling shareholder in 2024.

companies.name: Informa
companies.description: Informa plc is a British publishing, business intelligence, and exhibitions group headquartered in London. It operates in 42 countries with approximately 14,000 employees and owns brands such as Fan Expo and Taylor & Francis. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Quiksilver
companies.description: Quiksilver is a surf-inspired apparel and accessories brand founded in 1969 in Torquay, Victoria, now based in Huntington Beach, California. The parent company, Boardriders, Inc., owns multiple brands including Quiksilver, Roxy, and DC Shoes, and was acquired by Authentic Brands Group in 2023.

companies.name: Dowa Holdings
companies.description: Dowa Holdings is a Japanese nonferrous metals manufacturer. The company is a component of the Nikkei 225 stock index.

companies.name: Hongkong and Shanghai Hotels
companies.description: The Hongkong and Shanghai Hotels, Limited is a Hong Kong-based holding company managing The Peninsula Hotels and commercial and residential properties across Asia, the United States, and Europe. It also provides tourism, leisure, and club management services. Michael Kadoorie owns 47% of the company.

companies.name: Plantronics
companies.description: Plantronics, Inc., formerly known as Poly, is an American multinational electronics company headquartered in Santa Cruz, California. It produces audio communications equipment for business and consumer use, supporting unified communications, mobile use, gaming, and music, with most products manufactured in China and Mexico.

companies.name: Logista
companies.description: Logista is a Spanish company that operates as a distributor of products and services to proximity retailers in Southern Europe. Its distribution includes tobacco, convenience, pharmaceutical products, books, periodicals, and e-transactions. The company also provides various transport services including long distance, temperature-controlled, and express courier services.

companies.name: GMA Network, Inc.
companies.description: GMA Network Inc. is a Filipino media company based in Quezon City, Metro Manila, Philippines. It is primarily involved in radio and television broadcasting and has subsidiaries in various media-related businesses. The majority of its profits come from publicity and marketing incomes related to television distribution.

companies.name: Playtech
companies.description: Playtech plc is a gambling software development company founded in 1999 and based in the Isle of Man. It provides software for online casinos, poker rooms, bingo games, sports betting, mobile gaming, and live dealer games. Playtech is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Logitech
companies.description: Logitech International S.A. is a Swiss multinational manufacturer of computer peripherals and software headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland. The company operates globally with offices in Europe, Asia, Oceania, and the Americas. It is listed on the Nasdaq and is a component of the Swiss Market Index.

companies.name: Wizz Air
companies.description: Wizz Air Holdings plc is a Hungarian ultra-low-cost airline group headquartered in Budapest, Hungary. Founded in 2003, it operates an exclusive Airbus fleet and is the world's largest operator of the Airbus A321neo aircraft. The airline serves numerous cities across Europe, North Africa, and the Middle East.

companies.name: SunEdison
companies.description: SunEdison, Inc. was a U.S.-based renewable energy company involved in developing, building, owning, and operating solar and wind energy plants. It also manufactured high-purity polysilicon, silicon wafers, solar modules, and related systems. The company originated as Monsanto Electronic Materials Company in 1959 and was sold by Monsanto in 1989.

companies.name: Macro Bank
companies.description: Banco Macro is the second largest domestically-owned private bank in Argentina and ranks sixth by deposits and lending. It began operations in 1988 and has an extensive network of branches and ATMs throughout the country. This network enables it to provide banking services to a broad customer base.

companies.name: Waters Corporation
companies.industry: manufacturing of scientific and technical instrumentation
companies.description: Waters Corporation is an American company headquartered in Milford, Massachusetts. It provides analytical instruments and software used for chromatography, mass spectrometry, laboratory informatics, and rheometry. Its products serve the life sciences, materials, and food industries.

companies.name: Freenet AG
companies.description: Freenet AG is a German telecommunications and web content provider. It was formerly a subsidiary of Mobilcom and merged with Mobilcom in 2007, after which it changed its name to Freenet AG. In 2008, Freenet AG acquired another German telecommunications company, debitel AG.

companies.name: Cellcom Israel Ltd.
companies.description: Cellcom is an Israeli telecommunications company founded in 1994. Its business primarily focuses on wireless services. As of June 2016, the company had 2.812 million subscribers and its current CEO is Eli Adadi.

companies.name: Bank Permata
companies.description: Permata Bank is an Indonesian bank headquartered in Jakarta. It serves nearly four million customers across 62 cities with 304 branch offices and two mobile branches. The bank became a BUKU IV bank after confirmation from the Financial Services Authority in January 2021.

companies.name: Deutsche Börse
companies.description: Deutsche Börse AG is a German multinational corporation headquartered in Frankfurt that operates a marketplace for trading shares and securities. Founded in 1992, it provides transaction services and access to global capital markets. It is the third-largest stock market in Europe by market capitalization.

companies.name: Camping World
companies.description: Camping World Holdings, Inc. is an American company based in Lincolnshire, Illinois, specializing in selling recreational vehicles, parts, and camping supplies. It operates 202 locations and sells goods through dealerships, phone orders, and online. It claims to be the world's largest supplier of RV parts and supplies.

companies.name: First Republic Bank
companies.description: First Republic Bank was a commercial bank and wealth management provider headquartered in San Francisco, California. It served high-net-worth individuals with 93 offices in 11 states. The bank was closed and sold to JPMorgan Chase in May 2023 during the US banking crisis.

companies.name: ZAZ
companies.description: ZAZ, or Zaporizhzhia Automobile Building Plant, is Ukraine's main automobile manufacturer based in Zaporizhzhia. It produces cars, buses, and trucks. The company is also known by the name of its former parent company, AvtoZAZ.

companies.name: Kyowa Kirin
companies.description: Kyowa Kirin Co., Ltd. is a Japanese pharmaceutical and biotechnology company headquartered in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. It operates under Kirin Holdings and was among the 40 largest pharmaceutical companies worldwide by revenue in 2012. The company is a member of the Nikkei 225 stock index.

companies.name: MayBank of Indonesia
companies.description: PT Bank Maybank Indonesia Tbk is a private bank in Indonesia and part of Maybank, one of the largest financial services groups in ASEAN. It operates within the Indonesian financial services sector.

companies.name: Valid
companies.description: Valid S.A. is a Brazilian engraving company headquartered in São Paulo. It provides security printing services to financial institutions, telecommunication companies, state governments, and public agencies in Brazil, Argentina, and Spain.

companies.name: Tryg
companies.description: Tryg A/S is a Scandinavian insurance company operating in Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland. It is the largest provider of general insurance services in the Nordic countries and is listed on Nasdaq OMX Copenhagen.

companies.name: Balkrishna Industries
companies.description: Balkrishna Industries Limited (BKT) is an Indian multinational tyre manufacturer based in Mumbai. It produces off-highway tyres for mining, earthmoving, agriculture, and gardening from five factories. In 2013, it was ranked 41st among the world's tyre makers and sponsors various sports competitions.

companies.name: Magyar Telekom
companies.description: Magyar Telekom Nyrt. is a leading telecommunications service provider based in Hungary. It operates as a subsidiary of Deutsche Telekom. The company is a key player in the Hungarian telecommunications industry.

companies.name: West Fraser Timber
companies.description: West Fraser Timber Co. Ltd. is a Canadian forestry company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. It produces various wood products including lumber, plywood, and pulp. The company is a member of the Forest Products Association of Canada.

companies.name: Abercrombie & Fitch
companies.description: Abercrombie & Fitch Co. is an American lifestyle retailer headquartered in New Albany, Ohio. Founded in 1892, it targets customers in their early 20s to mid 40s and operates several offshoot brands including Hollister Co. and Abercrombie Kids.

companies.name: Chugai Pharmaceutical Co.
companies.description: Chugai Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is a Japanese drug manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo. It is a subsidiary controlled by Hoffmann-La Roche, which owns 62% of the company. The company is led by Osamu Nagayama and Tatsuro Kosaka.

companies.name: Podravka
companies.description: Podravka d.d. is a Croatian food company based in Koprivnica. Founded in 1934, it is one of the largest food companies in Southeast Europe. The company operates in the food industry.

companies.name: Sampo Group
companies.description: Sampo Group is a property and casualty insurance group operating in the Nordics, Baltics, and the UK. It operates in four segments including Private and Commercial and Industrial sectors. The company is based in Finland.

companies.name: Fox-Wizel Ltd.
companies.description: Fuchs-Wiesel Inc., known as Fox, is an Israeli clothing retail company. It is publicly traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. The company operates in the fashion industry.

companies.name: People Incorporated
companies.description: People Incorporated is an American conglomerate owning People Inc. and The Daily Beast. It holds significant shares in MGM Resorts International and Turo. The company operates in the media industry.

companies.name: Far Eastern Shipping Company
companies.description: FESCO Transportation Group is a Russian intermodal transport operator headquartered in Moscow. It provides marine shipping, rail transportation, and port handling services. The parent company is Far-Eastern Shipping Company JSC.

companies.name: Novonesis
companies.description: Novonesis is a biotechnology company formed in January 2024 by the merger of Novozymes A/S and Chr. Hansen. It is based in Bagsværd, Greater Copenhagen, Denmark. The company focuses on industrial enzymes, microorganisms, and biopharmaceutical ingredients.

companies.name: Bank of Georgia
companies.description: Bank of Georgia JSC is a universal bank and financial services company founded in 1994. It is headquartered in Tbilisi, Georgia, and received its banking license from the National Bank of Georgia in December 1994.

companies.name: U.S. Cellular
companies.description: U.S. Cellular, formerly known as Array Digital Infrastructure, is an American wireless communications infrastructure manager and former mobile network operator. Founded in 1983, it is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, and was the fifth largest wireless carrier in the United States.

companies.name: Naturgy
companies.description: Naturgy Energy Group S.A. is a Spanish multinational company operating in natural gas and electrical energy utilities. It primarily operates in Spain and has its administrative headquarters in Madrid.

companies.name: Dongfeng Automobile Company Limited
companies.description: Dongfeng Automobile Co., Ltd. is a Chinese automobile company based in Xiangyang, Hubei. It is a subsidiary of Dongfeng Motor Co., Ltd., a joint venture between Dongfeng Motor Group and Nissan, with Dongfeng Motor Corporation as the majority owner.

companies.name: Brady Corporation
companies.description: Brady Corporation is an American developer and manufacturer of specialty products and technical equipment for workplace component identification. Headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, it was founded in 1914 and serves customers globally.

companies.name: Fiskars
companies.description: Fiskars Corporation is a Finnish consumer goods company founded in 1649 in Fiskars, Finland. It is one of the oldest continuously operating companies in the world, with global headquarters in Espoo near Helsinki.

companies.name: Shizuoka Bank
companies.description: The Shizuoka Bank Ltd. is a Japanese regional bank headquartered in Shizuoka, Shizuoka Prefecture. It is one of the largest regional banks in Japan with over 190 domestic branches and overseas offices in several major cities.

companies.name: Entel Chile
companies.description: Entel Chile, also known as the National Communications Company, is the largest telecommunications company in Chile. It is known for the Torre Entel, a 127-meter high landmark in central Santiago.

companies.name: Lucid Motors
companies.description: Lucid Group, Inc. is an American automotive and technology company that manufactures electric vehicles and advanced powertrain systems. Headquartered in Newark, California, it began producing the Lucid Air sedan in 2021 and the Lucid Gravity SUV in 2024.

companies.name: Take-Two Interactive
companies.description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is an American video game holding company based in New York City. It was co-founded by Ryan Brant and Mark E. Seremet in September 1993. The company operates in the video game industry.

companies.name: Nippon Chemi-Con
companies.description: Nippon Chemi-Con Corporation is a Japanese company that produces capacitors and other discrete electronic components. It operates in the electronics industry and is based in Japan.

companies.name: Pharmstandard
companies.description: JSC Pharmstandard is a Russian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Dolgoprudny, Moscow Oblast. It operates in the healthcare and pharmaceutical industry.

companies.name: Villeroy & Boch
companies.description: Villeroy & Boch is a German manufacturer of ceramic goods headquartered in Mettlach, Saarland. Founded in 1748, the company has 15 production sites in Europe and Asia and sells products in around 140 countries.

companies.name: Groupe ADP
companies.description: Groupe ADP is an international airport operator based in Paris, France. It owns and manages Parisian international airports including Charles de Gaulle, Orly, and Le Bourget, all under the Paris Aéroport brand since 2016.

companies.name: Comarch
companies.description: Comarch is a Polish multinational software house and systems integrator based in Kraków. It provides services in telecommunications, finance, and other sectors, including ERP systems, IT security, CRM, and cloud solutions.

companies.name: Kalinin Machine-Building Plant
companies.description: JSC Kalinin Machine-Building Plant, also known as ZiK or MZiK, is a Russian industrial company producing artillery and vehicles. It is part of the Almaz-Antey holding company.

companies.name: National Instruments
companies.description: National Instruments, now known as NI, is an American multinational company headquartered in Austin, Texas. It produces automated test equipment, semiconductor production equipment, and virtual instrumentation software. Since October 2023, it operates as Emerson Electric's test and measurement business unit.

companies.name: Tegna Inc.
companies.description: Tegna Inc. is an American broadcast, digital media, and marketing services company headquartered in Tysons, Virginia. It operates 64 local television stations in 51 U.S. markets and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Nexstar Media Group.

companies.name: Vozrozhdenie Bank
companies.description: Vozrozhdenie Bank was a Russian bank founded in 1991 and headquartered in Moscow. It provided personal banking and business services to clients in Russia.

companies.name: Maaden
companies.description: Maaden, also known as the Saudi Arabian Mining Co., is a Saudi state-owned mining company headquartered in Riyadh. It was established in 1997 to develop Saudi Arabia's mineral resources. The Saudi government owns 50% of its shares, with the rest publicly traded on Tadawul.

companies.name: Nachi-Fujikoshi
companies.description: Nachi-Fujikoshi Corp. is a Japanese company known for producing industrial robots, machining tools, systems, and machine components. It operates in the industrial and chemical sectors.

companies.name: OGC-3
companies.description: OGK-3 was a Russian power company whose stock was traded on the MICEX-RTS stock exchange. It operated in the energy sector before ceasing operations.

companies.name: Lerøy
companies.description: Lerøy Seafood Group ASA is a seafood production and distribution company based in Bergen, Norway. It operates in the seafood industry.

companies.name: YIT
