companies.description: YIT Oyj is the largest Finnish construction company headquartered in Helsinki. It develops and builds apartments, business premises, infrastructure, and operates in eight countries across Europe.

companies.name: Showa Shell Sekiyu
companies.description: Showa Shell Sekiyu K.K. was a Japanese petroleum company formed by the merger of Showa Oil Company and Shell Sekiyu. It was a subsidiary of Royal Dutch Shell until acquired by Idemitsu Kosan in 2018.

companies.name: Potbelly Sandwich Shop
companies.description: Potbelly Sandwich Shop is an American fast-casual restaurant chain specializing in submarine sandwiches and milkshakes. It has over 400 locations and is owned by RaceTrac.

companies.name: GoDaddy
companies.description: GoDaddy Inc. is an American internet domain registry, registrar, and web hosting company headquartered in Tempe, Arizona. It serves primarily small and micro companies and manages over 62 million registered domains.

companies.name: Kalashnikov Concern
companies.description: JSC Kalashnikov Concern is a Russian defense manufacturer headquartered in Izhevsk and Moscow. It produces a wide range of civilian and military weapons including rifles, machine guns, guided projectiles, and military robots.

companies.name: Wix.com
companies.description: Wix.com Ltd. is an Israeli software company that provides cloud-based web development services. It offers tools for creating HTML5 websites using online drag-and-drop editing. The company has headquarters in Israel and offices worldwide, including the United States and several other countries.

companies.name: Finnair
companies.description: Finnair Plc is the flag carrier and largest full-service legacy airline of Finland, headquartered in Vantaa at Helsinki Airport. Founded in 1923, it dominates domestic and international air travel in Finland and is a member of the Oneworld alliance. The Finnish State is the majority shareholder.

companies.name: Devon Energy
companies.description: Devon Energy Corporation is an American hydrocarbon exploration company headquartered in Houston, Texas, and organized in Delaware. Its operations focus on regions including the Delaware Basin, Eagle Ford Group, and the Rocky Mountains.

companies.name: Kirov Plant
companies.description: The Kirov Plant is a major Russian mechanical engineering and agricultural machinery manufacturer based in St. Petersburg. Established in 1789, it originally produced cannonballs and now mainly manufactures Kirovets heavy tractors.

companies.name: AF Gruppen
companies.description: AF Group ASA is the third largest civil engineering and construction company in Norway, headquartered in Oslo. The company is publicly listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Moderna
companies.description: Moderna, Inc. is an American pharmaceutical and biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts. It focuses on RNA therapeutics, primarily mRNA vaccines that use messenger RNA to instruct protein production for immune responses.

companies.name: Hasbro
companies.description: Hasbro, Inc. is an American multinational toy manufacturing and media company headquartered in Pawtucket, Rhode Island. Founded in 1923, it develops and sells toys, games, and entertainment properties, owning brands such as Transformers, Monopoly, and Nerf.

companies.name: Sandoz
companies.description: Sandoz Group AG is a Swiss company specializing in generic pharmaceuticals and biosimilars. Formerly part of Novartis, it became independent in October 2023 with headquarters in Basel, Switzerland, and global functions in Germany, Czechia, and Spain.

companies.name: Piaggio
companies.description: Piaggio Group is an Italian motor vehicle manufacturer headquartered in Pontedera, Italy. Founded in 1884, it produces two-wheeled motor vehicles and compact commercial vehicles under brands including Piaggio, Vespa, and Aprilia.

companies.name: Partner Communications Company Ltd.
companies.description: Partner Communications Company Ltd., formerly Orange Israel, is an Israeli telecommunications provider offering mobile network, internet Wi-Fi, fixed telephony, OTT/IPTV, international calling, and business solutions. It operates a mobile network with a standalone 5G core and a nationwide fiber-optic broadband network.

companies.name: Lundbeck
companies.description: Lundbeck is a Danish international pharmaceutical company that researches, develops, manufactures, markets, and sells pharmaceuticals worldwide. Its products focus on brain diseases such as depression, schizophrenia, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and migraine. The company is based in Denmark.

companies.name: Kao Corporation
companies.description: Kao Corporation is a Japanese global chemical and cosmetics company headquartered in Nihonbashi-Kayabacho, Chūō, Tokyo, Japan. It operates in the chemical and cosmetics industry.

companies.name: MongoDB Inc.
companies.description: MongoDB, Inc. is an American software company that develops and supports the MongoDB database engine for unstructured data. It has expanded its product to include features like ACID and transactions to appeal to enterprise customers.

companies.name: Antofagasta plc
companies.description: Antofagasta plc is a London-based Chilean multinational conglomerate with equity in mining and railroad operations. It participates in Antofagasta Minerals, a railroad to Bolivia, and other ventures worldwide. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Airbnb
companies.description: Airbnb, Inc. is an American company operating an online marketplace for short- and long-term homestays, experiences, and services globally. It acts as a broker charging commissions on bookings. The company was founded in 2008 by Brian Chesky, Nathan Blecharczyk, and Joe Gebbia.

companies.name: Orlen Unipetrol
companies.description: Orlen Unipetrol is a Czech oil refining and petrochemical company based in Prague and owned by the Polish energy group Orlen. It operates refineries producing petrol, diesel, polyethylene, and polypropylene, and runs a network of filling stations in the Czech Republic, Slovakia, and Hungary.

companies.name: Bank Sinarmas
companies.description: PT Bank Sinarmas Tbk is an Indonesian bank and subsidiary of Sinar Mas Multiartha. By the end of 2020, it operated numerous branch offices, sub-branch offices, cash offices, and sharia branches to support its banking activities.

companies.name: Sirius XM Rad
companies.description: Sirius XM Holdings Inc. is an American broadcasting corporation headquartered in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. It provides satellite and online radio services in the US and holds a 70% equity interest in SiriusXM Canada. The company was formed by merging Sirius Satellite Radio and XM Satellite Radio in 2008.

companies.name: Birkenstock
companies.description: Birkenstock Holding plc is a German shoe manufacturer known for sandals with contoured cork footbeds made of suede and jute. Founded in 1774 and headquartered in Neustadt (Wied), Germany, the company aimed to create supportive shoes and expanded sales across Europe by 1925.

companies.name: Kapsch
companies.description: The Kapsch Group is an international corporation headquartered in Vienna, Austria, specializing in telematics, information technology, and telecommunication. It operates in the information technology sector.

companies.name: Inner Mongolia Yitai Coal Company
companies.description: Inner Mongolia Yitai Coal Company is a coal mining and production company based in Ordos City, China. Founded in 1997, it operates in mining, production, transport, and sale of coal and coal-based products. It holds the seventh largest coal reserve in the world by potential carbon emissions.

companies.name: Metlen Energy & Metals
companies.description: Metlen Energy & Metals is a global industrial and energy conglomerate based in Greece. It operates in two sectors: Energy and Metallurgy. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: AMP Limited
companies.description: AMP Limited is an Australian financial services company headquartered in Sydney. It operates in Australia and New Zealand, offering superannuation, investment products, and banking services including home loans and savings accounts through AMP Banking.

companies.name: Molson Coors Brewing Company
companies.description: Molson Coors Beverage Company is a Canadian-American multinational brewing company. It is the fifth-largest brewer worldwide by beer output. The company has operational headquarters in Chicago and offices in Prague, Golden, Colorado, and Montréal, Québec.

companies.name: Bezeq The Israeli Telecommunication Corp. Ltd.
companies.description: Bezeq is an Israeli telecommunications company offering fixed-line, mobile telephony, high-speed Internet, fiber Internet transmission, and pay TV services. It operates through its subsidiaries providing a range of telecom services in Israel.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.description: Anthropic, PBC is an American artificial intelligence public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. Founded in January 2021 by former OpenAI members, it develops proprietary large language models, including its flagship product Claude. Anthropic had the largest initial public offering in November 2026.

companies.name: Plains All American Pipeline
companies.description: Plains All American Pipeline is a master limited partnership headquartered in Houston, Texas. It operates pipeline transport, marketing, and storage of liquefied petroleum gas and petroleum in the US and Canada. The company owns extensive pipeline and storage assets across key producing basins and market hubs.

companies.name: Shire plc
companies.description: Shire plc was a specialty biopharmaceutical company originally founded in the United Kingdom and registered in Jersey. It had an operational base in the United States and produced brands including Vyvanse, Lialda, and Adderall XR. Shire was acquired by Takeda Pharmaceutical Company in January 2019.

companies.name: Atlantic Grupa
companies.description: Atlantic Grupa d.d. is a Croatian multinational company engaged in the production, development, sales, and distribution of consumer goods. It has a market presence in over 40 countries worldwide.

companies.name: Qianjiang Motorcycle
companies.description: Qianjiang Motorcycle Group, known as QJMOTOR, is a Chinese motorcycle manufacturer founded in 1985 and headquartered in Winling, Zhejiang Province. It is one of the largest two-wheeled vehicle manufacturers in China.

companies.name: Meda AB
companies.description: Meda AB is a specialty pharmaceutical company headquartered in Solna, Sweden. It imports and markets pharmaceuticals, nutritional, and health-care products, and provides services such as clinical research, registration, and logistics. Meda's pharmaceuticals are sold in more than 150 countries.

companies.name: OCI Company Ltd.
companies.description: OCI Company Ltd. is a chemical company founded in 1959 with its head office in Seoul, South Korea. The company's name is an initialism of its former corporate name, Oriental Chemical Industries.

companies.name: Wirecard
companies.description: Wirecard AG was a German payment processor and financial services provider. It offered electronic payment transaction services, risk management, and issued physical and virtual cards. The company was listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and was part of the DAX index from 2018 to 2020 before becoming insolvent.

companies.name: TVS Motor Company
companies.description: TVS Motor Co., Ltd. is an Indian multinational motorcycle manufacturer headquartered in Chennai. It is the third-largest motorcycle company in India by revenue and the second largest two-wheeler exporter with exports to over 60 countries.

companies.name: Atmel
companies.description: Atmel Corporation was a semiconductor creator and manufacturer founded in 1984 and later acquired by Microchip Technology in 2016. It focused on embedded systems with products including microcontrollers, RF devices, EEPROM, flash memory, security chips, and touch sensors.

companies.name: Square Enix
companies.description: Square Enix Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational holding company involved in video game development, publishing, and entertainment. It is known for role-playing game franchises like Final Fantasy, Kingdom Hearts, and Dragon Quest, and also operates in merchandise, arcade facilities, and manga publication.

companies.name: Vend Marketplaces
companies.description: Vend Marketplaces ASA operates marketplaces in Northern Europe and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway. The company is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange and led by CEO Christian Printzell Halvorsen.

companies.name: IDEXX Laboratories, Inc.
companies.description: IDEXX Laboratories, Inc. is an American multinational corporation that develops, manufactures, and distributes products and services for veterinary, livestock, poultry, water testing, and dairy markets. Founded in 1983, it is headquartered in Westbrook, Maine, and Hoofddorp, Netherlands, serving customers in over 175 countries.

companies.name: Moscow City Telephone Network
companies.description: The Moscow City Telephone Network is a public joint-stock company providing local telephone and internet services to over 4 million subscribers in Moscow, Russia. It is known by the Latin acronym MGTS.

companies.name: Nabil Bank Limited
companies.description: Nabil Bank Limited, formerly Nepal Arab Bank Limited, is the first foreign joint venture commercial bank in Nepal, established in 1984. It offers a wide range of commercial banking services and operates an extensive network of branches, ATMs, and correspondent banking relationships.

companies.name: Vivint Solar
companies.description: Vivint Solar was an American company providing photovoltaic solar energy systems mainly for residential customers. Founded in 2011 as an offshoot of Vivint, it was headquartered in Lehi, Utah. The company used a power purchase agreement model and was acquired by Sunrun in 2020.

companies.name: CPI Property Group
companies.description: CPI Property Group is a real estate landlord focusing on commercial properties in the Czech Republic, Berlin, Warsaw, and Central & Eastern Europe. Founded in 1991 in the Czech Republic, it operates primarily in the real estate sector.

companies.name: Kemira
companies.description: Kemira Oyj is a chemical industry group headquartered in Helsinki, Finland. Established in 1920, it operates in Water Solutions, Packaging & Hygiene Solutions, and Fiber Essentials business areas.

companies.name: Ultimate Software
companies.description: Ultimate Software was an American multinational technology company headquartered in Weston, Florida. Founded in 1990, it developed UltiPro, a cloud-based human capital management software, and was acquired by Hellman & Friedman Capital Partners in 2019.

companies.name: OmniVision Group
companies.description: OmniVision Integrated Circuits Group, Inc. is a Chinese publicly listed fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Shanghai. It operates in the semiconductor industry.

companies.name: Nokian Tyres
companies.description: Nokian Tyres plc is a Finnish tyre manufacturer based in Nokia, Finland. It produces tyres for various vehicles and is known for having the only permanent winter tyre testing facility in the world.

companies.name: Kaman Corporation
companies.description: Kaman Corporation is an American aerospace company headquartered in Bloomfield, Connecticut. Founded in 1945, it initially focused on designing and manufacturing helicopters that set world records and achieved aviation firsts.

companies.name: Blackstone Inc.
companies.description: Blackstone Inc. is an American alternative investment management company based in New York City. Founded in 1985, it is known for private equity, real estate acquisitions, and various investment activities globally.

companies.name: Bank of Yokohama
companies.hq_city: Bank of Yokohama Head Office Building
companies.description: The Bank of Yokohama is the largest regional bank in Japan, headquartered in Yokohama. It operates mainly in Kanagawa Prefecture and southwestern Tokyo and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Yokohama Financial Group since 2016.

companies.name: Ignitis
companies.description: Ignitis Group is a state-owned energy holding company based in Vilnius, Lithuania. It operates Lithuania’s electricity distribution network and manages a green generation portfolio, providing electricity, natural gas, solar, and other energy services.

companies.name: Tata Chemicals
companies.description: Tata Chemicals Limited is an Indian multinational corporation headquartered in Mumbai. It operates in chemicals, crop protection, and specialty chemistry products across India, Europe, North America, and Africa. The company is part of the Tata Group and has a publicly listed subsidiary called Rallis India.

companies.name: NetSuite
companies.description: NetSuite Inc. is an American cloud-based enterprise software company headquartered in Austin, Texas. It provides software products and services for small and medium-sized businesses, including accounting, CRM, and e-commerce. Founded in 1998, it was acquired by Oracle in 2016.

companies.name: Viridien
companies.description: Viridien, formerly CGG, is a multinational technology, digital, and Earth data company. It specializes in addressing complex challenges related to natural resources, energy transition, and infrastructure. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

companies.name: Elia Group
companies.description: Elia is a Belgian transmission system operator for high-voltage electricity based in Brussels. It operates in Belgium and Germany, transmitting electricity from generators to distribution operators and major industrial users connected to its grid.

companies.name: Warner Music Group
companies.description: Warner Music Group Corp. is an American multinational entertainment and record label conglomerate headquartered in New York City. It is one of the Big Four recording companies and ranks third in the global music industry.

companies.name: Ambu
companies.description: Ambu A/S is a Danish company that develops, produces, and markets single-use endoscopy solutions, diagnostic, and life-supporting equipment. Its products serve hospitals, private practices, and rescue services.

companies.name: Despegar
companies.description: Despegar.com Corp. is an online travel company based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Founded in 1999, it operates a booking platform for airline tickets, hotels, package tours, and other travel products in Latin America.

companies.name: TPG Telecom
companies.description: TPG Telecom Limited is an Australian telecommunications company formed after a merger with Vodafone Hutchison Australia. It is the second-largest telecommunications company listed on the Australian Securities Exchange and the third-largest wireless carrier in Australia.

companies.name: Hero Supermarket
companies.description: PT Hero Retail Nusantara, known as Hero, is one of Indonesia's largest supermarket operators. It is owned by Hero Intiputra and affiliated with DFI Nusantara, formerly known as Hero Group.

companies.name: Motor Oil Hellas
companies.description: Motor Oil (Hellas) Corinth Refineries S.A. is a petroleum industry company based in Greece. It focuses on oil refining and trading and is a leading force in its sector in Southern Europe and the Mediterranean.

companies.name: Opus Global
companies.description: Opus Global is a Hungarian industrial conglomerate and asset management company headquartered in Budapest. Its subsidiaries play a significant role in Hungary's strategically important industries. The company operates primarily in the industrial sector within Hungary.

companies.name: Palantir Technologies
companies.description: Palantir Technologies Inc. is an American company that develops data integration and analytics software. It is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and was founded in Palo Alto, California in 2003 by Peter Thiel and others. The company operates in the technology sector.

companies.name: FTI Consulting
companies.logo_file: FTI Consulting Inc. Logo Dark Blue.svg
companies.description: FTI Consulting is a business consultancy firm founded in 1982 and headquartered in Washington, D.C. It specializes in corporate finance, restructuring, economic consulting, forensic and litigation consulting, strategic communications, and technology and strategy consulting. It is one of the largest financial consulting firms worldwide.

companies.name: Arjo
companies.description: Arjo is a global medical technology company serving acute and long-term care needs. It produces medical equipment for patient handling, hygiene, medical beds, pressure ulcer prevention, wound healing, and diagnostics. The company operates in the healthcare sector.

companies.name: Skyworks Solutions
companies.description: Skyworks Solutions, Inc. is an American semiconductor company headquartered in Irvine, California. It is listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market and is a constituent of the S&P 500. The company operates in the semiconductor industry.

companies.name: Yelp
companies.description: Yelp Inc. is an American company that develops the Yelp.com website and mobile app, which publish crowd-sourced reviews about businesses. It also operates a table reservation service called Yelp Guest Manager. The company is headquartered in San Francisco.

companies.name: Virbac
companies.description: Virbac is a French company dedicated to animal health, located in Carros near Nice. It was founded in 1968 by veterinarian Pierre-Richard Dick. The company operates in the healthcare sector focusing on animal health.

companies.name: Azelis Group
companies.description: Azelis Group is a Belgium-based distributor specializing in food ingredients and specialty chemicals. Headquartered in Antwerp, it has a presence in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Asia-Pacific, and the Americas. The company has been listed on Euronext since 2021.

companies.name: Altafiber
companies.description: Cincinnati Bell, Inc., doing business as Altafiber, is a regional telecommunications service provider based in Cincinnati, Ohio. It provides landline telephone, fiber-optic Internet, and IPTV services through subsidiaries including Hawaiian Telcom. The company operates in the telecommunications sector.

companies.name: Mitsui Chemicals
companies.description: Mitsui Chemicals is a Japanese chemicals company listed on the Nikkei with business interests in Japan, Europe, China, Southeast Asia, and the USA. It deals mainly in performance materials, petrochemicals, basic chemicals, and functional polymeric materials. The company is part of the Mitsui conglomerate.

companies.name: Hrvatski Telekom
companies.description: Hrvatski Telekom is a Croatian telecommunications company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Zagreb. It is majority-owned by Deutsche Telekom with a 53.5% stake and is publicly traded on the Zagreb Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Mueller Water Products
companies.description: Mueller Water Products, Inc. is a publicly traded company based in Atlanta, Georgia. It manufactures and distributes fire hydrants, gate valves, and other water infrastructure products in North America through its two business units, Mueller Co. and Mueller Technologies.

companies.name: Manitou Group
companies.industry: manufacture of lifting and handling equipment
companies.description: Manitou is a French heavy equipment manufacturer founded in 1957 and headquartered in Ancenis. It produces forklifts, cherry pickers, telehandlers, and other heavy equipment, originating with the design of the first rough terrain forklift truck.

companies.name: CeWe
companies.description: Cewe is a German printing company based in Oldenburg, Lower Saxony, founded in 1961. It is the largest photo printing company in Europe, focusing mainly on digital printing of photos, photo books, and calendars.

companies.name: Lotus Bakeries
companies.industry: manufacture of rusks and biscuits; manufacture of preserved pastry goods and cakes
companies.description: Lotus Bakeries NV is a Belgian multinational snack food company founded in 1932 and based in Lembeke, East Flanders. It is best known for its speculoos biscuits branded as Biscoff and owns several other snack brands.

companies.name: Bank of Cyprus
companies.description: The Bank of Cyprus is a financial services company established in 1899 with headquarters in Strovolos, Cyprus.

companies.name: Saizeriya
companies.description: Saizeriya is a Japanese chain of family-style Italian yōshoku restaurants managed by Saizeriya Co. Its headquarters are in Yoshikawa, Saitama, and it operates locations in Japan and several Asian countries, with a factory in Australia.

companies.name: Anritsu
companies.description: Anritsu Corporation is a Japanese multinational corporation in the telecommunications electronics equipment market. It is known as a global pioneer for producing the world's first wireless telephone network.

companies.name: Bankinter
companies.description: Bankinter, S.A. is a Spanish financial services company headquartered in Madrid. Founded in 1965 as an industrial bank through a joint venture between Banco Santander and Bank of America, it has been listed on the Bolsa de Madrid since 1972.

companies.name: Kureha
companies.description: Kureha Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer specializing in specialty chemicals, polymers, and agrichemicals.

companies.name: BDO
companies.description: BDO Unibank, Inc., commonly known as Banco de Oro (BDO), is a Philippine banking company based in Makati City. It is a member of the SM Group and has a presence in SM Malls throughout the Philippines.

companies.name: Krispy Kreme
companies.description: Krispy Kreme, Inc. is an American multinational doughnut company and coffeehouse chain founded in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. The company was founded by Vernon Rudolph in 1937 and has undergone periods of public and private ownership.

companies.name: Jyske Bank
companies.description: Jyske Bank A/S is the third largest Danish bank by market share. It operates in Denmark and provides financial services.

companies.name: Jumià
companies.description: Jumia is an African marketplace, logistics, and payment service operating across the continent. It partners with over 100,000 sellers and is Africa's largest online marketplace with millions of monthly visitors.

companies.name: XL Group
companies.description: Axa XL is an American subsidiary of the global insurance and reinsurance company Axa. It is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, domiciled in Bermuda, and operates more than 100 offices worldwide.

companies.name: King Long
companies.description: King Long United Automotive Industry Co., Ltd, known as King Long, is a Chinese bus manufacturer headquartered in Xiamen, Fujian. Founded in 1988, it focuses on large and medium-sized coaches and light vans and was ranked among China's most influential brands in 2024.

companies.name: Bank Saint Petersburg
companies.description: Bank Saint Petersburg is a Russian bank established in 1990 and based in Saint Petersburg. It primarily operates in Northwest Russia and is listed on the Moscow Exchange.

companies.name: UiPath
companies.description: UiPath Inc. is a Romanian-American multinational software company that develops AI and automation software. Its products enable building and orchestrating AI agents to automate complex workflows.

companies.name: Matas
companies.description: Matas is a Danish company founded in 1949 that operates a chain of drug stores across Denmark. It sells cosmetics, personal hygiene products, household chemicals, and vitamin supplements.

companies.name: TORM
companies.description: TORM is a Copenhagen-based Danish shipping company that owns and operates product tankers. Its vessels transport refined oil products such as gasoline, jet fuel, naphtha, and diesel oil.

companies.name: NACCO Industries
companies.description: NACCO Industries, Inc. is an American holding company headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio. It operates through mining and natural resources businesses in three segments: Coal Mining, North American Mining, and Minerals Management. The company also provides stream and wetland mitigation solutions.

companies.name: VARTA AG
companies.description: VARTA AG is a German company that manufactures batteries for automotive, industrial, and consumer markets worldwide. It is based in Germany and serves global markets with its battery products.

companies.name: De La Rue
companies.description: De La Rue plc is a British company headquartered in Basingstoke, England. It produces secure digital and physical protections for goods, trade, and identities, selling to governments, central banks, and businesses in 140 countries.

companies.name: Treasury Wine Estates
companies.description: Treasury Wine Estates is an Australian global winemaking and distribution company headquartered in Melbourne. It was formerly the wine division of the international brewing company Foster's Group.

companies.name: Capcom
companies.description: Capcom Co., Ltd. is a Japanese video game company based in Osaka. Established in 1983, it has created multiple successful game franchises and operates internationally with subsidiaries in East Asia, Europe, and North America.

companies.name: Bulgari
companies.description: Bulgari S.p.A. is an Italian luxury fashion house founded in 1884 and headquartered in Rome. It is known for jewellery, watches, fragrances, accessories, and leather goods and became a subsidiary of LVMH in 2011.

companies.name: Syriatel
companies.description: Syriatel is a mobile network provider in Syria headquartered on Sehnaya Road in Damascus. It offers LTE services under the brand name Super Surf and is one of two mobile network providers in the country.

companies.name: Gjensidige
companies.description: Gjensidige Forsikring ASA is a Norwegian insurance company headquartered in Oslo. Founded in 1816, it has subsidiaries in Denmark and Sweden and holds a significant market share in the Norwegian insurance market.

companies.name: Haitai Confectionery & Foods
companies.description: Haitai is a South Korean company based in Seoul specializing in retail and instant foods, particularly confectionery, beverages, and ice cream. It operates primarily in the food sector.

companies.name: Orion Corporation
companies.description: Orion Corporation is a Finnish pharmaceutical company founded in 1917 and headquartered in Espoo, Finland. It develops, manufactures, and markets human and veterinary pharmaceuticals and active pharmaceutical ingredients globally.

companies.name: Qemetica
companies.description: Qemetica S.A. is a Polish chemical company headquartered in Warsaw. It is a leading producer in the European chemical industry, known for producing sodium carbonate, sodium bicarbonate, sodium silicate, and crop protection products in Poland and the EU.

companies.name: Alexion Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Alexion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a pharmaceutical company based in New Haven, Connecticut, United States. It specializes in orphan drugs for rare diseases and is a subsidiary of AstraZeneca.

companies.name: Zendesk
companies.description: Zendesk, Inc. is a software-as-a-service company headquartered in San Francisco, California. Founded in 2007, it provides products related to customer support, sales, and communications, and was previously publicly traded before being taken private.

companies.name: HELLENiQ ENERGY
companies.description: HELLENiQ ENERGY Holdings S.A., formerly Hellenic Petroleum S.A., is a major oil company in Southeast Europe. It is based in Greece and traces its origins to the first oil refinery established in Aspropyrgos in 1958.

companies.name: CTS EVENTIM AG & Co. KGaA
companies.description: CTS Eventim is a German company headquartered in Bremen that operates in the leisure-events market. It specializes in ticketing and live entertainment and is part of the MDAX index.

companies.name: Asian Development Bank
companies.description: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) is a regional development bank headquartered in Mandaluyong, Metro Manila, Philippines. It promotes social and economic development in Asia and maintains 31 field offices worldwide.

companies.name: Groupon
companies.description: Groupon, Inc. is an American e-commerce marketplace that connects subscribers with local merchants. It offers activities, travel, goods, and services across 13 countries.

companies.name: BlackBerry
companies.description: BlackBerry Limited is a Canadian software company specializing in secure communications and the Internet of Things. Founded in 1984, it was known for its mobile devices until 2016 and now focuses on software, services, and patents.

companies.name: Kaspi.kz Joint Stock Company
companies.description: Kaspi.kz is a Kazakhstani unicorn company comprising several subsidiaries including Kaspi Shop LLP and Kaspi Bank JSC. It became one of the fastest-growing financial IT organizations in Europe and Eurasia in 2020.

companies.name: Dan Hotels  Ltd.
companies.description: Dan Hotels is an Israeli hotel chain established in 1947. It owns 18 hotels in Israel, a convention center, a hotel training center, and a 226-room hotel in Bangalore, India.

companies.name: Barco
companies.description: Barco NV is a global technology company headquartered in Kortrijk, Belgium. It specializes in visualization, collaboration, and networking technology for entertainment, enterprise, and healthcare markets. The company holds over 900 patents and operates facilities across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

companies.name: TC Energy
companies.description: TC Energy Corporation is a Canadian energy company based in Calgary, Alberta. It builds and operates fossil fuel pipelines and energy infrastructure across Canada, the United States, and Mexico. Its core business segments include Natural Gas Pipelines, Power Generation, and Energy Storage.

companies.name: Schroders
companies.description: Schroders Limited is a British multinational asset management company headquartered in London, England. Founded in 1804, it employs over 6,000 people worldwide and was traded on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Nuveen in 2026. It ranks as the 21st largest asset management firm globally.

companies.name: Ryman Healthcare
companies.description: Ryman Healthcare Limited is a New Zealand company operating retirement villages and rest homes. It is publicly listed on the New Zealand Stock Exchange and was among the largest companies on the NZX 50 Index.

companies.name: KrAZ
companies.description: KrAZ is a Ukrainian factory located in Kremenchuk that produces trucks and special-purpose heavy-duty off-road vehicles. It operates as a holding company combining several factories and was nationalized by the Ukrainian government under martial law in 2022.

companies.name: Dermapharm
companies.description: Dermapharm Holding SE is a publicly listed German pharmaceutical company based in Grünwald. It specializes in manufacturing and distributing dermatological and allergological preparations.

companies.name: MakeMyTrip
companies.description: MakeMyTrip Limited is an Indian online travel company headquartered in Gurgaon. Founded in 2000, it operates a platform for booking airline tickets, hotel reservations, holiday packages, and rail and bus tickets.

companies.name: Bumi Serpong Damai
companies.description: PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk manages BSD City, a planned community in Greater Jakarta, Indonesia. The city includes residential, commercial, and institutional facilities and is owned by Sinar Mas Land, a subsidiary of the Sinar Mas Group.

companies.name: Royal Unibrew
companies.description: Royal Unibrew is a brewing and beverage company headquartered in Faxe, Denmark. It owns several brands including Ceres and Faxe, and has a presence in the Baltic region and Finland. The company also brews and markets Heineken and Pepsi in Denmark.

companies.name: Cheboksary Khimprom
companies.description: Khimprom Novocheboksarsk is a chemicals-producing company based in Novocheboksarsk, Russia. It is part of the Orgsintez Group, which is associated with Renova. The company operates in the chemical industry.

companies.name: Orbital Sciences Corporation
companies.description: Orbital Sciences Corporation was an American aerospace company specializing in the design, manufacture, and launch of small- and medium-class space and launch vehicle systems. It served commercial, military, and government customers. In 2014, it merged with Alliant Techsystems to form Orbital ATK, later acquired by Northrop Grumman.

companies.name: Haemonetics
companies.description: Haemonetics Corporation is a global provider of blood and plasma supplies and services. Founded in the 1970s by Dr. Allen Latham, it is headquartered in Natick, Massachusetts, United States. The company operates in the biomedical engineering industry.

companies.name: Hannover Rück SE
companies.description: Hannover Re is a reinsurance company based in Hannover, Germany. Founded in 1966, it is the third-largest reinsurance group worldwide and transacts all lines of property & casualty and life & health reinsurance. The company has a global network with over 170 subsidiaries and offices.

companies.name: Lazard
companies.description: Lazard Inc. is a multinational financial advisory and asset management firm headquartered in the United States. It provides investment banking, asset management, and other financial services primarily to institutional clients. The firm has principal offices in New York City, Paris, and London.

companies.name: Mil Moscow Helicopter Plant
companies.logo_file: Логотип Московского вертолётного завода имени М. Л. Миля.svg
companies.description: Mil Moscow Helicopter Plant is a Russian helicopter designer and manufacturer headquartered in Tomilino, Moscow. It operates as a subsidiary of Russian Helicopters. The company is involved in mechanical engineering within the aerospace sector.

companies.name: Cloudflare
companies.description: Cloudflare, Inc. is an American technology company based in San Francisco, California. It provides internet services including content delivery network, cloud cybersecurity, DDoS mitigation, and domain registration. Its services act as a reverse proxy to improve website performance and security.

companies.name: Teradyne
companies.description: Teradyne, Inc. is an American company that designs and manufactures automatic test equipment. It is headquartered in North Reading, Massachusetts, and serves high-profile customers such as Samsung, Qualcomm, Intel, and IBM. The company operates in the technology sector.

companies.name: Mobileye
companies.description: Mobileye Global Inc. is an autonomous driving company headquartered in Israel and domiciled in the United States. It develops AI technologies including self-driving and advanced driver-assistance systems as well as humanoid robotics. Mobileye was acquired by Intel in 2017 and went public again in 2022.

companies.name: Wolfspeed
companies.description: Wolfspeed, Inc. is an American developer and manufacturer of wide-bandgap semiconductors, focusing on silicon carbide materials and devices for power applications. The company was formerly known as Cree, Inc. It serves sectors such as transportation, power supplies, and wireless systems.

companies.name: Polycom
companies.description: Polycom, Inc. was an American multinational corporation that developed video, voice, and content collaboration and communication technology. It was co-founded in 1990 by Brian L Hinman and Jeffrey Rodman. The company specialized in video conference technology.

companies.name: Groupe TF1
companies.description: Télévision Française 1 S.A., known as the TF1 Group, is a French media holding company. Its best-known property is the broadcast network TF1, launched in 1975 and privatized in 1987. The group is controlled with a 43% stake by industrial group Bouygues and is quoted on Euronext Paris.

companies.name: Materion
companies.description: Materion Corp. is a multinational company specializing in high-performance advanced materials. Its products include advanced beryllium metals, thin film deposition materials, high-performance alloys, composites, and specialty coatings. The company operates in the industrials and chemicals sector.

companies.name: Unibail Rodamco Westfield
companies.description: Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield SE is a multinational commercial real estate company headquartered in Paris, France. It owns, develops, and operates large shopping centres in Europe and the United States, mostly under the Westfield brand, along with office buildings and convention centers in the Paris region.

companies.name: OVHcloud
companies.industry: data processing, hosting and related activities
companies.description: OVHcloud, legally OVH Groupe SA, is a French cloud computing company headquartered in Roubaix, France. Founded in 1999 by the Klaba family, it offers VPS, dedicated servers, and other web services. In 2019, it adopted OVHcloud as its public brand name.

companies.name: Legg Mason
companies.description: Legg Mason, Inc. was an American investment management and asset management firm headquartered in Baltimore. Founded in 1899, it was acquired by Franklin Templeton Investments in July 2020. The company managed a diverse portfolio including equity, fixed income, alternative, and liquidity assets.

companies.name: Tikkurila
companies.description: Tikkurila Oyj is a Finnish manufacturer of paints and lacquers. Its main office and most production facilities are located in Kuninkaala, Vantaa near Helsinki. The company operates in the industrial manufacturing sector.

companies.name: Amica S.A.
companies.description: Amica is a global manufacturer of household appliances headquartered in Wronki, Poland. It produces refrigerators, washing machines, dishwashers, vacuum cleaners, microwave ovens, electric stoves, and kettles under brands such as Hansa, CDA, and Gram.

companies.name: Mega Brands
companies.description: Mega Brands Inc. is a Canadian children's toy company and a wholly owned subsidiary of Mattel. It distributes a wide range of construction toys, puzzles, and craft-based products, with Mega Bloks being its most popular product line.

companies.name: Chr. Hansen Holding
companies.description: Chr. Hansen A/S was a biotechnology company based in Hørsholm, Denmark, supplying bacteria cultures, probiotics, enzymes, and human milk oligosaccharides. Its products are used in food production, dietary supplements, pharmaceuticals, and agriculture. In 2024, it merged with Novozymes to form Novonesis.

companies.name: Quilter Plc
companies.description: Quilter plc is a British wealth management company formerly known as Old Mutual Wealth Management Limited. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index. The company also has a secondary listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

companies.name: CSR Limited

companies.name: AsiaCell

companies.name: Tennant Company

companies.name: NextGen Healthcare Information Systems

companies.name: Cellnex Telecom

companies.name: Sumitomo Heavy Industries
companies.description: Sumitomo Heavy Industries, Ltd. is a Japanese integrated manufacturer producing industrial machinery, defense products, ships, bridges, steel structures, environmental protection equipment, power transmission equipment, plastic molding machines, laser processing systems, particle accelerators, material handling systems, and cancer diagnostic and treatment equipment.

companies.name: ALK-Abelló

companies.name: Zakłady Chemiczne Police

companies.name: Lectra
companies.description: Lectra is a technology company headquartered in Paris, France, operating in 59 countries with 59 subsidiaries. It specializes in CAD software and CAM cutting-room systems for industries using soft materials like leather and textiles, serving sectors such as fashion, automotive, and furniture.

companies.name: Wielton
companies.description: Wielton SA is a Polish manufacturer specializing in tippers and tautliners for traction units. It is the third largest producer of semi-trailers in Europe and leads the market in several Central- and Eastern European countries as well as Central Asia.

companies.name: SThree
companies.description: SThree plc is an international specialist staffing organization founded and headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It operates in the employment services industry and is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Extreme Networks
companies.description: Extreme Networks, Inc. is an American company based in Morrisville, North Carolina, that designs, develops, and manufactures wired and wireless network infrastructure equipment. It also develops software for network management, policy, analytics, security, and access controls.

companies.name: Houlihan Lokey
companies.description: Houlihan Lokey, Inc. is an American multinational independent investment bank and financial services company headquartered in Century City, Los Angeles, California. It is the top-ranked global M&A advisor by transaction count and was founded in 1972.

companies.name: Bentley Systems
companies.description: Bentley Systems, Incorporated is a US-based software development company providing software and services for the design, construction, and operation of infrastructure worldwide. Their products serve markets including architecture, engineering, construction, and operations for large assets like roads, bridges, and power plants.

companies.name: Tripadvisor
companies.description: Tripadvisor is an American company operating online travel agencies, comparison shopping websites, and mobile apps featuring user-generated content. It serves the tourism industry by providing travel-related information and services.

companies.name: SouthState Bank
companies.description: SouthState Bank is an American bank based in Winter Haven, Florida, and a subsidiary of SouthState Corporation. It operates 371 branches across several states including South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Virginia, Colorado, and Texas.

companies.name: Taurus
companies.description: Taurus Armas S.A. is a Brazilian manufacturing conglomerate headquartered in São Leopoldo, Rio Grande do Sul. Founded in 1939, it includes a firearm division and other divisions focused on metals manufacturing, plastics, body armor, helmets, and civil construction.

companies.name: Cloetta
companies.description: Cloetta AB is a Swedish confectionery company that manufactures and sells local confectionery brands. Its main markets include Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the Netherlands, Germany, and the UK.

companies.name: Storebrand
companies.description: Storebrand is a Norwegian financial services company primarily involved in life insurance and pension savings. It also operates divisions in investments, banking, and property and casualty insurance, and expanded into the Swedish life insurance market through acquiring SPP in 2007.

companies.name: Strategy
companies.description: Strategy Inc., formerly known as MicroStrategy, is an American company that provides business intelligence and mobile software. Founded in 1989, it is headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia. The company develops software to analyze data for business decisions and mobile app development.

companies.name: Nissan Chemical
companies.description: Nissan Chemical Corporation is a Japanese chemical company and a constituent of the Nikkei 225 stock index. It operates in the chemical industry and is based in Japan.

companies.name: Multilaser
companies.description: Multilaser, also known as Multi, is an electronics company based in Brazil. It operates in the electronics industry and serves the Brazilian market.

companies.name: Simpson Manufacturing Company
companies.description: Simpson Manufacturing Company is a U.S.-based manufacturer of building materials. It produces structural connectors, fasteners, anchors, and products for new construction and retrofitting.

companies.name: CI&T

companies.name: Rubrik

companies.name: Navneet Publications
companies.description: Navneet Education Limited is an Indian company engaged in educational and children book publishing, scholastic stationery, and non-paper stationery products. It operates in the stationery industry and is based in India.

companies.name: Dynegy
companies.description: Dynegy Inc. is an electric company based in Houston, Texas, owning and operating fossil fuel-powered power stations in the U.S. Founded in 1984 as Natural Gas Clearinghouse, it was acquired by Vistra Corp in 2018.

companies.name: Københavns Lufthavne
companies.description: Københavns Lufthavne is a public limited company operating Copenhagen Airport and Roskilde Airport in Denmark. It previously held stakes in Newcastle International Airport and Aeropuertos del Sureste in Mexico.

companies.name: Integrated Device Technology
companies.description: Integrated Device Technology, Inc. was an American semiconductor company headquartered in San Jose, California. It designed and marketed mixed-signal semiconductor products for communications, computing, and consumer industries before being acquired by Renesas Electronics.

companies.name: SACO Hardware
companies.description: SACO is a Saudi Arabian company providing home improvement products. Founded in 1984 with one store in Riyadh, it has expanded to operate 34 stores across 18 cities. The stores vary in size, with some occupying up to 24,500 square meters.

companies.name: Cielo S.A.

companies.name: Austal
companies.description: Austal Limited is an Australian global shipbuilding company and defence prime contractor. It specializes in designing, constructing, and supporting defence and commercial vessels, including naval vessels, high-speed ferries, and offshore windfarm supply vessels.

companies.name: Santos
companies.description: Santos Limited is an Australian oil and gas exploration and production company headquartered in Adelaide. It owns LNG, pipeline gas, and oil assets and is the largest natural gas supplier in Australia, operating in the Cooper Basin and offshore regions.

companies.name: Carlyle Group
companies.description: The Carlyle Group Inc. is an American multinational company engaged in private equity, alternative asset management, and financial services. As of 2023, it managed assets totaling $426 billion.

companies.name: Future plc
companies.description: Future plc is a British publishing company founded in 1985 by Chris Anderson. It is publicly traded on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Klaviyo

companies.name: Moldova Agroindbank

companies.name: Jensen-Group

companies.name: Alm. Brand

companies.name: Robertet
companies.description: Robertet SA is a French manufacturer specializing in natural raw materials for fragrances and flavors. Founded in 1850, it is a member of the European Flavour Association. In 2021, it ranked 12th on FoodTalks' Global Top 50 Food Flavours and Fragrances Companies list.

companies.name: Westlake Corporation
companies.description: Westlake Corporation is an international manufacturer and supplier of petrochemicals, polymers, and fabricated building products based in the United States. Founded in 1986, it is the largest producer of low-density polyethylene in the US. The company operates in Olefins and Vinyls segments with integrated vinyl production.

companies.name: Farstad Shipping
companies.description: Farstad Shipping is a publicly listed supply shipping company headquartered in Ålesund, Norway. It employs approximately 2,200 people, with the majority working offshore. The company operates in the shipping industry.

companies.name: AMC Global Media

companies.name: Transelectrica

companies.name: Colt CZ Group
companies.description: Colt CZ Group SE is a Czech holding company based in Prague owning firearms manufacturers Česká zbrojovka and Colt, and ammunition maker Sellier & Bellot. It sells firearms and ammunition to armed forces, police, hunters, and sport shooters. Its business Synthesia Nitrocellulose produces nitrocellulose for ammunition and industrial uses.

companies.name: CETIN

The company is wholly owned by CETIN Group N.V., itself owned by PPF Group.

companies.name: Samsung Card
companies.description: Samsung Card Co, Ltd. is a South Korean credit card company established in 1988 and headquartered in Seoul. It merged with Samsung Capital in 2004 and is owned by Samsung Life Insurance. The company serves millions of individual credit card users in South Korea.

companies.name: Hess Corporation
companies.description: Hess Corporation is an American global independent energy company involved in crude oil and natural gas exploration and production. It was formed in 1968 by merging Hess Oil and Chemical with Amerada Petroleum. The company was acquired by Chevron in 2025.

companies.name: Silvano Fashion Group
companies.description: Silvano Fashion Group is an Estonian company specializing in designing, manufacturing, and selling ladies' lingerie. It operates within the clothing industry and is based in Estonia.

companies.name: Red Eléctrica de España
companies.description: Red Eléctrica de España is a partly state-owned Spanish corporation that operates the national electricity grid and power transmission system in Spain. It also holds assets in Peru, Chile, and Brazil.

companies.name: Bang & Olufsen

companies.name: Adtran

companies.name: Telenet group
companies.description: Telenet Group N.V. is the largest cable broadband provider in Belgium, offering analog and digital cable TV, fixed and mobile telephone services primarily in Flanders and Brussels. It also serves business customers across Belgium and Luxembourg.

companies.name: Oberbank

companies.name: Colian Holding
companies.description: Colian Holding S.A. is a corporate group specialized in the food industry controlled by Jan Kolański. Its headquarters are located in Opatówek near Kalisz, Poland. The company operates in the food industry sector.

companies.name: Insta360

companies.name: Coeur Mining

companies.name: Century Casinos

companies.name: Brunello Cucinelli

companies.description: PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk is an Indonesian mobile telecommunications operator headquartered in Jakarta. The company offers broadband services through 2G, 4G, 5G, and optical fiber networks under brands XL, Axis, and Smartfren.

companies.description: AD Plastik is a Croatian manufacturer of automotive components based in Solin. The group includes operations in Romania, Hungary, Serbia, and Russia, exporting mainly to Western Europe.

companies.name: Stock Spirits Group

companies.name: B.Grimm
companies.description: B.Grimm Group is a multinational conglomerate founded in 1878 and based in Bangkok, Thailand. companies.name: Shepherd Neame Limited

companies.name: Getty Images

companies.description: Dolby Laboratories, Inc. is an American technology corporation specializing in audio noise reduction, audio encoding/compression, spatial audio, and HDR imaging. companies.description: Bavarian Nordic A/S is a Danish biotechnology company focused on developing, manufacturing, and commercializing vaccines. companies.name: Cargojet

companies.name: Spar Nord Bank
companies.description: Spar Nord Bank A/S is a bank based in North Jutland, Denmark.

companies.name: Iluka Resources

companies.name: Polaris Media

companies.name: TeamViewer SE

companies.name: Huntsworth

companies.name: SpareBank 1 SMN
companies.description: SpareBank 1 SMN is a Norwegian savings bank based in Trøndelag. It operates in the financial services industry.

companies.name: Jamnica

The company operates mining sites in Zambia and Mozambique, contributing significantly to global emerald and ruby supplies.

companies.name: Sparebanken Norge
companies.description: Sparebanken Norge is a Norwegian banking and financial services group formed in 2025 by merging Sparebanken Vest and Sparebanken Sør. It is headquartered jointly in Bergen and Kristiansand and is the largest savings bank in Norway by assets and branch count as of 2025.

companies.name: Rába Járműipari Holding Nyrt.
companies.description: Rába Automotive Group is a Hungarian public company headquartered in Győr. It engineers and manufactures automotive components, specialty vehicles, and axles for commercial vehicles and machinery. The company has been building axles and vehicles since 1902 and employs over 2000 people.

companies.name: Century Aluminum
companies.description: Century Aluminum Company is a US-based producer of primary aluminum with plants in Kentucky, South Carolina, and Iceland. It is the largest primary aluminum producer in the United States and is headquartered in Chicago.

companies.name: BioNTech
companies.description: BioNTech SE is a German multinational biotechnology company headquartered in Mainz. It develops immunotherapies and vaccines, focusing on cancer and infectious diseases.

companies.name: AES Andes
companies.description: AES Andes S.A. is an electricity producer and distributor based in Santiago, Chile. It is a subsidiary of the American AES Corporation and operates in the Andes region of South America.

companies.name: Pony.ai
companies.description: Pony AI Inc. is a Chinese autonomous vehicle technology company with locations in Silicon Valley, Beijing, and Guangzhou. It focuses on developing autonomous car technologies.

companies.name: Newag
companies.description: Newag S.A. is a Polish company based in Nowy Sącz specializing in the production, maintenance, and modernization of railway rolling stock. Its products include electric multiple units and prototype trams, and it collaborates with Siemens Mobility on metro train assembly.

companies.name: CD Projekt
companies.description: CD Projekt Red S.A. is a Polish video game company based in Warsaw, founded in 1994. It started as a distributor of foreign video games and later formed a development department known for The Witcher series and Cyberpunk 2077. In 2008, it launched the digital distribution service Good Old Games, now GOG.com.

companies.name: Rostelecom
companies.description: Rostelecom is Russia's largest provider of digital services for consumers, businesses, and government entities. It interconnects local public operators' networks into a single national network for long-distance service. The company is publicly traded on the Moscow Exchange.

companies.name: MTN Syria
companies.description: MTN Syria is one of two mobile operators in Syria, formerly known as Areeba. It offers GSM, 3.5G, and 4G (LTE) broadband and mobile services in the country.

companies.name: Coinbase
companies.description: Coinbase Global, Inc. is an American cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2012. It is the largest U.S.-based cryptocurrency exchange and the world's biggest bitcoin custodian, operating in more than 100 countries with over 100 million users.

companies.name: Dolphin Drilling
companies.description: Dolphin Drilling Holdings Limited is an offshore drilling rig company headquartered in Aberdeen, Scotland, with its main subsidiary in Sandnes, Norway. The company previously had its headquarters in Oslo until 2019.

companies.name: Doosan Škoda Power
companies.description: Doosan Škoda Power is a Czech engineering company based in Plzeň that develops and manufactures steam turbines and related equipment. Its turbines are used for electricity generation and steam supply for factories and district heating, and it offers repair and maintenance services.

companies.name: Liveperson Inc.
companies.description: LivePerson is a global technology company that develops conversational commerce and artificial intelligence software.

companies.name: Janus Capital Group
companies.description: Janus Capital Group, Inc. was an American publicly owned investment firm headquartered in Denver, Colorado, founded in 1969. It had offices worldwide and was part of the S&P MidCap 400 Index.

companies.name: DigitalGlobe
companies.description: DigitalGlobe was an American commercial vendor of space imagery and geospatial content, operating civilian remote sensing spacecraft. It went public in 2009 and was acquired by Maxar Technologies in 2017.

companies.name: Zynga
companies.description: Zynga Inc. is an American video game developer and publisher founded in 2007, known for social video game services. It is owned by Take-Two Interactive since 2022 and is headquartered in San Mateo, California, focusing on mobile and social networking platforms.

companies.name: Lassonde Industries
companies.description: Lassonde Industries Inc. is a Canadian agri-food company based in Rougemont, Montérégie. It operates throughout North America, focusing on agriculture and food products.

companies.name: Azenta Life Sciences
companies.description: Azenta Life Sciences is a life sciences services provider based in Burlington, Massachusetts, United States. Founded in 1978, it offers genomics, cryogenic storage, automation, and informatics services.

companies.name: Dunkin' Brands
companies.description: Dunkin' Brands Group, Inc. was an American restaurant holding company headquartered in Canton, Massachusetts. It operated Dunkin' Donuts, Mister Donut, and Baskin-Robbins before being acquired by Inspire Brands in 2020.

companies.name: Netia
companies.description: Netia is a Polish telecommunications company owning the second-largest fixed-line cable television and broadband network in Poland. Founded in 1990, it was listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange in 2000.

companies.name: Aloqabank
companies.description: Joint-Stock Commercial Aloqabank is a banking and financial services company headquartered in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. It operates in the banking sector within Uzbekistan.

companies.name: Tessellis
companies.description: Tessellis S.p.A. is an Italian telecommunications company founded in 1998 and based in Cagliari, Sardinia. It provides Internet and telecommunications services in Italy and previously operated in other European countries.

companies.name: TRI Pointe Group
companies.description: Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. is a home construction company headquartered in Incline Village, Nevada. It operates in multiple U.S. states and offers financing and insurance services to homebuyers.

companies.name: American Tower Corporation
companies.description: American Tower Corporation is an American real estate investment trust headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It owns, develops, and operates wireless and broadcast communications infrastructure in several countries.

companies.name: Ugreen
companies.description: Ugreen is a Chinese consumer electronics brand owned by Ugreen Group Ltd and based in Shenzhen, Guangdong. Established in 2012, it specializes in USB hardware and other consumer electronics, launching network-attached storage devices in 2024.

companies.name: Ateam Holdings
companies.description: Ateam Inc. is a provider of mobile content and websites based in Nagoya, Japan. It operates in the mobile content industry.

companies.name: Cirrus Logic
companies.description: Cirrus Logic Inc. is an American fabless semiconductor supplier specializing in analog, mixed-signal, and audio DSP integrated circuits. Since 1998, its headquarters have been located in Austin, Texas.

companies.name: Intersil
companies.description: Intersil is an American semiconductor company headquartered in Milpitas, California. Founded in 1967 by Jean Hoerni, it initially focused on analog electronics and later developed CMOS designs including early electronic watches and the Intersil 6100 single-chip PDP-8 computer implementation.

companies.name: Sturm, Ruger & Co.
companies.description: Sturm, Ruger & Company, Inc., known as Ruger, is an American firearm manufacturer based in Mayodan, North Carolina, with production facilities in several states. Founded in 1949, it has been publicly traded since 1969.

companies.name: VusionGroup
companies.description: Vusion provides digitalization services for positive commerce, serving over 350 large retailer groups worldwide across Europe, Asia, and North America.

companies.name: Luminex
companies.description: Luminex Corporation is a biotechnology company that develops, manufactures, and markets proprietary biological testing technologies with applications in life sciences.

companies.name: Bakkafrost
companies.description: P/F Bakkafrost is a Faroese salmon farming company based in Glyvrar on Eysturoy island in the Faroe Islands. It is the largest fish farming company and biggest private employer in the Faroe Islands, and the third-largest fish farming company globally.

companies.name: Cray
companies.description: Cray Inc. is an American supercomputer manufacturer headquartered in Seattle, Washington, and a subsidiary of Hewlett Packard Enterprise. It also produces data storage and analytics systems and holds three of the top four spots in the TOP500 supercomputer rankings as of June 2026.

companies.name: SMART Technologies
companies.description: Smart Technologies is a Canadian company headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, and wholly owned by Foxconn. Founded in 1987, it is known for developing interactive whiteboards branded as Smart Board, widely used in education and business.

companies.name: Elektroprivreda Crne Gore
companies.description: Elektroprivreda Crne Gore AD is an integrated electricity company located in Niksić, Montenegro. It is majority government-owned and listed on the Montenegro Stock Exchange, where the remaining shares are publicly traded.

companies.name: Nordic Semiconductor
companies.description: Nordic Semiconductor ASA is a Norwegian fabless technology company headquartered in Trondheim, Norway. Founded in 1983, it specializes in ultra-low-power wireless communication semiconductors and software for Internet of Things product development.

companies.name: Aixtron SE
companies.description: Aixtron SE is a German technology company headquartered in Herzogenrath. It develops chemical vapor deposition equipment for electronic and optoelectronic applications, including metalorganic and plasma-enhanced systems. Aixtron is a leading manufacturer in its field and is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Verisign
companies.description: Verisign, Inc. is an American company based in Reston, Virginia, operating network infrastructure including two of the Internet's thirteen root nameservers. It manages authoritative registries for several generic and country-code top-level domains. Verisign supports key internet domain systems.

companies.name: Similarweb
companies.description: Similarweb Ltd. is a global software and data aggregation company specializing in mobile app and web analytics, digital performance, and SEO tools. Founded in Israel, it has 12 offices worldwide and went public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2021.

companies.name: Urban One
companies.description: Urban One, Inc. is an American media conglomerate based in Silver Spring, Maryland. Founded in 1980 by Cathy Hughes, it primarily operates media properties targeting African American audiences.

companies.name: Patrizia Immobilien
companies.description: Patrizia is a German investment management company focused on the European real estate market. Based in Augsburg, it is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and is a member of the SDAX and MSCI World Small Cap Index.

companies.name: WildBrain
companies.description: WildBrain Ltd. is a Canadian media, animation studio, production, and brand licensing company. It owns the largest independent library of children's television programming, including assets from acquisitions like Cookie Jar Group and distribution rights to Jay Ward Productions.

companies.name: Atlantic Tele-Network
companies.description: ATN International, Inc., formerly Atlantic Tele-Network, is an American telecommunications company headquartered in Beverly, Massachusetts. It operates digital wireless, wireline, and fiber optic networks serving geographically and technically challenging markets in the United States.

companies.name: GUM
companies.description: GUM is a shopping center located in Moscow, Russia. It was the main department store in many cities of the former Soviet Union and had similarly named stores in some Soviet republics and post-Soviet states.

companies.name: ZipRecruiter
companies.description: ZipRecruiter, Inc. is an American employment marketplace connecting job seekers and employers. It operates in the software industry.

companies.name: Piquadro
companies.description: Piquadro S.p.A. is an Italian leather goods company headquartered in Silla di Gaggio Montano, Bologna. Founded in 1987 by Marco Palmieri, it designs, manufactures, and distributes premium leather accessories under three brands: Piquadro, The Bridge, and Lancel.

companies.name: Đuro Đaković
companies.description: Đuro Đaković Grupa d.d. is a Croatian mechanical engineering company based in Slavonski Brod. Named after a prominent Yugoslav metal worker, it is one of Croatia's largest defence contractors and manufacturers.

companies.name: GoPro
companies.description: GoPro, Inc. is an American technology company founded in 2002 and based in San Mateo, California. It manufactures action cameras and develops mobile apps and video-editing software, widely used for adventure sports and outdoor activities.

companies.name: A.G. Barr
companies.description: A.G. Barr p.l.c., known as Barr's, is a soft drink and energy drink manufacturer based in Cumbernauld, Scotland. It is widely known for producing the drink Irn-Bru and is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: DNO International
companies.description: DNO ASA is a Norwegian oil and gas operator focused on the Middle East and North Sea. Founded in 1971, it holds stakes in exploration, development, and production licenses in Iraq, Norway, the UK, and Yemen.

companies.name: Nature's Sunshine Products
companies.description: Nature's Sunshine Products, Inc. is a manufacturer of dietary supplements including herbs, vitamins, minerals, and personal care products. It is based in Lehi, Utah, with a manufacturing facility in Spanish Fork, Utah.

companies.name: Imagination Technologies
companies.description: Imagination Technologies Group Limited is a British semiconductor and software design company headquartered in Kings Langley, England. It designs PowerVR graphics processors for AI processing and is owned by Canyon Bridge Capital Partners.

companies.name: SpareBank 1 Nord-Norge
companies.description: SpareBank 1 Nord-Norge is a Norwegian savings bank with 90 branches across northern Norway and a head office in Tromsø. It serves private and institutional customers and is a founding member of the SpareBank 1 alliance.

companies.name: Qt Group Plc
companies.description: Qt Group Plc is a software company headquartered in Espoo, Finland. It was formed after Digia acquired Qt and later spun off into a separate publicly traded company.

companies.name: Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd.
companies.description: Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd. is an Israeli public company specializing in satellite-based broadband communications technology. It develops, manufactures, and markets ground-based satellite systems for global communication.

companies.name: Calpis
companies.description: Calpis Co., Ltd., based in Shibuya, Tokyo, Japan, manufactures Calpis, a probiotic milk beverage known as Calpico in North America. The drink has a light, milky, and slightly acidic flavor and is produced through lactic acid fermentation using ingredients like water, dry milk, and lactic acid.

companies.name: Comptel Corporation
companies.description: Comptel Corporation was a Finnish international software company specializing in telecommunications. In 2017, Nokia acquired Comptel to integrate it into its Nokia Software business unit.

companies.name: Alinco
companies.description: Alinco is a Japanese manufacturer producing radio and amplification equipment. In Japan, it also offers metal products, construction equipment, and exercise equipment.

companies.name: Nepal SBI Bank Limited
companies.description: Nepal SBI Bank Limited is the first Indo-Nepal joint venture in the financial sector. It was established through a memorandum of understanding signed on 17 July 1992 by the State Bank of India, Employees Provident Fund, and Agricultural Development Bank of Nepal.

companies.name: Quantum Corporation
companies.description: Quantum Corporation, headquartered in San Jose, California, provides technology for data storage, management, archiving, and protection. Its products serve enterprises, media and entertainment companies, government agencies, data companies, and life science organizations worldwide.

companies.name: EVS Broadcast Equipment
companies.description: EVS SA is a Belgian company that develops hardware and software products and services for live video production applications. The company employs over 600 people globally.

companies.name: Netgear
companies.description: Netgear, Inc. is an American computer networking company based in San Jose, California, with offices in about 22 countries. It produces networking hardware for consumers, businesses, and service providers, operating in retail, commercial, and service provider segments.

companies.name: Mitsubishi Estate
companies.description: Mitsubishi Estate Company, Limited is one of Japan's largest real estate developers. The company is involved in property management as well as architecture research and design.

companies.name: Josef Manner & Comp AG
companies.description: Josef Manner & Comp AG is an Austrian conglomerate founded in 1890 that produces a wide range of confectionery products. Its Manner line includes wafers, long-life confectionery, chocolate-based products, sweets, cocoa, and seasonal items.

companies.name: Audiocodes Ltd.
companies.description: AudioCodes Ltd. is an Israeli technology company providing communication software, hardware, and productivity solutions for enterprises and service providers.

companies.name: Ringkjøbing Landbobank
companies.description: Ringkjøbing Landbobank is a bank headquartered in Ringkøbing, Denmark. Founded in 1886, it operates in the banking sector providing financial services. The bank has a long history dating back to the 19th century.

companies.name: Sparebanken Vest
companies.description: Sparebanken Vest was a savings bank based in Bergen, Norway, serving Western Norway. It was the third-largest savings bank in Norway with branches throughout Møre og Romsdal, Vestland, and Rogaland regions.

companies.name: SM Entertainment
companies.description: SM Entertainment Co., Ltd. is a South Korean multinational entertainment agency established in 1995 by Lee Soo-man. It operates as a record label, talent agency, music production company, event management, concert production, and music publishing house. The company is known for leading the worldwide K-pop phenomenon.

companies.name: Altri
companies.description: Altri SGPS SA is a Portuguese industrial conglomerate headquartered in Porto. Its main operations include wood pulp production, forest cultivation for timber and paper, and co-generation of energy including renewable resources. The group previously operated in the steelworks industry before 2008.

companies.name: Trivago
companies.description: Trivago N.V. is an international technology company owned by the US-based Expedia Group specializing in travel and lodging. Its main product is the Trivago online search engine and accommodation booking website that lists prices from hotels and other booking sites.

companies.name: Nextdoor
companies.description: Nextdoor Holdings, Inc. is an American company operating a hyperlocal social networking service for neighborhoods. Founded in 2008 and based in San Francisco, California, it launched in the US in 2011 and is available in eleven countries as of 2023.

companies.name: Vizrt
companies.description: Vizrt is a Norwegian vendor of broadcast technology known for its real-time broadcast graphics software powered by the Viz Engine. Formed from a merger between Peak Broadcast Systems and RT-SET, its products include 3D graphics systems, sports analysis, media asset management, and workflow systems for digital broadcasting.

companies.name: Central Telegraph
companies.description: PJSC Central Telegraph is a Russian telecommunications company providing fixed line telephony, internet access, IPTV, communication channel rental, electrical documentation, and integrated business solutions. It operates mainly in Moscow and is wholly owned by Rostelecom.

companies.name: Rossi Residencial
companies.description: Rossi Residencial is a Brazilian construction and real estate company. As of 2013, it was the sixth largest residential construction company in Brazil, competing with firms like PDG, Cyrela Brazil Realty, MRV, and Brookfield Incorporações.

companies.name: YG Entertainment
companies.description: YG Entertainment Inc. is a South Korean multinational entertainment agency established in 1996 by Yang Hyun-suk. It operates as a record label, talent agency, music production company, event management and concert production company, and music publishing house. The company also had various subsidiary ventures under YG Plus, though many were discontinued due to lack of profitability.

companies.name: Tomy
companies.description: Tomy Company, Ltd. is a Japanese toy and entertainment company founded in 1924 by Eiichirō Tomiyama. Known for popular toys like the B-29 friction toy and Pop-up Pirate game, it merged with Takara in 2006 and is headquartered in Katsushika, Tokyo.

companies.name: Nova Ltd.
companies.description: Nova Ltd., formerly Nova Measuring Instruments, is an Israeli publicly traded company founded in 1993 that provides advanced metrology solutions for semiconductor manufacturing. It specializes in dimensional, materials, and chemical metrology technologies and is listed on NASDAQ and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Redes Energéticas Nacionais
companies.description: REN - Redes Energéticas Nacionais, SGPS, S.A. is a Portuguese energy company managing the country's National Electricity Transmission Grid and National Natural Gas Transportation Grid. It handles planning, construction, operation, and maintenance of these infrastructures to ensure stable energy supply and equal grid access.

companies.name: American Shipping Company
companies.description: American Shipping Company ASA is a Norwegian-American shipping and shipyard company and part of the Aker Group. Formerly known as Aker American Shipping ASA, Aker ASA reduced its ownership from 53.2% to 19.9% in 2008.

companies.name: Mahaka Media
companies.description: PT Mahaka Media Tbk, traded as Mahaka X since 2022, is an Indonesian media and entertainment company founded by Erick Thohir. It owns printed newspapers Harian Republika and Harian Indonesia, a magazine, a regional TV station JakTV, and a radio station.

companies.name: Upwork
companies.description: Upwork Inc. is an American freelancing platform headquartered in Palo Alto and San Francisco, California. Formed in 2013 by merging Elance Inc. and oDesk Corp, it was rebranded as Upwork in 2015 and went public in 2018. The company faced protests over fee changes and underwent workforce reductions in 2024 and 2026.

companies.name: Bursa Malaysia
