companies.description: Bursa Malaysia is the stock exchange of Malaysia, based in Kuala Lumpur and formerly known as the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange. It is one of the largest bourses in ASEAN and offers integrated transaction services including trading, settlement, clearing, and currency exchange.

companies.name: CureVac
companies.description: CureVac is a biopharmaceutical company based in Tübingen, Germany, founded in 2000 by Ingmar Hoerr and others. It develops therapies based on messenger RNA (mRNA) and had approximately 375 employees in 2018.

companies.name: Planet Labs
companies.description: Planet Labs PBC, known as Planet., is an American Earth imaging company based in San Francisco, California. It aims to image the entire Earth daily to monitor changes and identify trends. The company is publicly traded.

companies.name: Tobii AB
companies.description: Tobii AB is a Swedish technology company that develops and sells eye tracking and attention computing products. It is based in Sweden and specializes in peripheral technology.

companies.name: Ballard Power Systems
companies.description: Ballard Power Systems Inc. is a Canadian developer and manufacturer of proton exchange membrane fuel cell products. It serves markets including heavy-duty motive, portable power, and material handling. The company has designed and shipped over 400 MW of fuel cell products.

companies.name: Telegate
companies.description: Telegate is a communications company based in Martinsried, Germany, providing directory assistance services in Germany, Spain, and Italy. Founded in 1996, it is publicly held and was listed on the Neuer Markt of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in 1999.

companies.name: Odyssey Re
companies.description: Odyssey Re Holdings Corp. is an underwriter of property and casualty treaty and facultative reinsurance, as well as specialty insurance. Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, it operates globally through four divisions and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Fairfax Financial.

companies.name: Inmarsat
companies.description: Inmarsat is a British satellite telecommunications company providing mobile telephone and data services worldwide. It operates through fifteen geostationary telecommunications satellites and offers services via portable or mobile terminals.

companies.name: Telenav
companies.description: Telenav, Inc. is a wireless location-based services company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It provides GPS navigation, local search, automotive navigation, mobile advertising, and enterprise mobility services with offices worldwide.

companies.name: Frontier Developments
companies.description: Frontier Developments plc is a British video game developer based in Cambridge, England. Founded in 1994, it develops games including Planet Coaster, Planet Zoo, and titles in the Elite series. The company is listed on the AIM segment of the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Krasnoyarsk Dam
companies.description: The Krasnoyarsk Dam is a concrete gravity dam on the Yenisey River near Krasnoyarsk, Russia. Constructed between 1956 and 1972, it supplies about 6,000 MW of electricity, primarily to the KrAZ, with power and aluminum plants controlled by RUSAL.

companies.name: Talvivaara Mining Company
companies.description: Ahtium was a Finnish mining company that operated the Talvivaara nickel mine from 2004 until the mining business was sold to the state-owned Terrafame in 2015. It was involved in the mining industry in Finland.

companies.name: Kimco Realty
companies.description: Kimco Realty Corporation is a real estate investment trust based in Jericho, New York. It invests in shopping centers across the Contiguous United States and the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico. The company focuses on retail real estate assets.

companies.name: Art Technology Group
companies.description: Art Technology Group (ATG) was an American internet technology company specializing in eCommerce software and on-demand optimization applications. It was independent until its acquisition by Oracle on January 5, 2011. The company operated in the technology sector.

companies.name: Interxion
companies.description: Interxion is a provider of carrier and cloud-neutral colocation data centre services in Europe. Founded in 1998 in the Netherlands, it is headquartered in Schiphol-Rijk and operates 53 data centres across 11 European countries. It was publicly listed on the NYSE until its acquisition by Digital Realty in 2020.

companies.name: CyberLink
companies.description: CyberLink Corp. is a Taiwanese multimedia software company headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan. It produces PC and mobile applications for media playback, video and photo editing, and disc burning and backup solutions. The company operates in the software industry.

companies.name: Stratasys
companies.description: Stratasys, Ltd. is an American-Israeli manufacturer of 3D printers, software, and materials for polymer additive manufacturing. The company is incorporated in Israel and produces systems used to model complex geometries in various polymer materials. It serves the 3D printing industry.

companies.name: SinnerSchrader
companies.description: SinnerSchrader was a digital agency headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, founded in 1996. It was publicly listed from 1999 and became part of Accenture in 2017, fully integrating into Accenture Song by 2022. The company operated in the internet economy sector.

companies.name: General Shopping e Outlets
companies.description: General Shopping is a Brazilian shopping mall management company headquartered in São Paulo. Founded in 1989 and controlled by the Veronezi Family, it manages 9 shopping malls and 6 outlets with a significant gross leasable area. The company operates in retail real estate.

companies.name: DFI Inc.
companies.description: DFI is a Taiwanese industrial computer company headquartered in Taipei. It designs, develops, manufactures, and sells industrial motherboards, PCs, System-on-Module, industrial displays, and provides ODM/OEM services. The company operates in the computer hardware industry.

companies.name: Harboes Bryggeri
companies.description: Harboe's Brewery is a Danish brewery located in Skælskør, Denmark, established in 1883. It is an international beverage manufacturer with production facilities in three countries and business activities in over 90 markets. The company has been family-owned for five generations.

companies.name: Codan
companies.description: Codan Limited is a manufacturer and supplier of communications, metal detection, and mining technology headquartered in Adelaide, South Australia. The company operates in the communication technology sector. It is known for its diverse technology products.

companies.name: Sectra AB
companies.description: Sectra AB is a Swedish company founded in 1978 that operates in medical technology and encrypted communication systems. It produces the RAKEL communication system used by Swedish emergency services and public utility providers. The company is based in Sweden.

companies.name: Sparebanken Sør
companies.description: Sparebanken Sør was a Norwegian banking and financial services group based in Kristiansand, Norway. Its main market was in the counties of Agder, Telemark, and Rogaland. The company operated in the financial services sector.

companies.name: Paradox Interactive
companies.description: Paradox Interactive AB is a video game publisher headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. It originated as part of Target Games and Paradox Entertainment before becoming independent in 2004. The company includes nine first-party development studios and publishes games from other developers.

companies.name: Merkur Bank
companies.description: Merkur Privatbank is a German private bank headquartered in Munich. It is owner-managed and operates in the financial services sector. The bank is based in Germany.

companies.name: Cyber Folks
companies.description: cyber_Folks S.A. is a Polish capital group headquartered in Poznań, operating in the technology sector. It provides digitalisation solutions such as web hosting, domain registration, SaaS, and communication platforms. The company has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 2017.

companies.name: Sparebanken Møre
companies.description: Sparebanken Møre is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Ålesund, Norway. It serves the Møre og Romsdal region and was formed by merging several savings banks in that area. The bank operates in the financial services sector.

companies.name: Halogen Software
companies.description: Halogen Software was a Canadian company headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario, providing cloud-based talent management solutions. It served customers with between 100 and 10,000 employees. The company operated in the software industry.

companies.name: Tomra
companies.description: TOMRA is a Norwegian multinational corporation that manufactures collection and sorting products, including reverse vending machines for recycling bottles and cans. It also produces machines for the food, recycling, and mining industries. TOMRA is a market leader with a global presence.

companies.name: AerCap
companies.description: AerCap Holdings N.V. is an Irish aviation leasing company based in Dublin, with its registered office in Amsterdam. It became the largest aviation leasing company globally after acquiring ILFC in 2014 and GECAS in 2021. The company operates in the financial services sector.

companies.name: Jeudan
companies.description: Jeudan is the largest listed real estate company in Denmark and the largest private real estate investment company in the country. Its activities include property and facility management. The company is headquartered in Prince William Mansion in Copenhagen.

companies.name: IC Group
companies.description: IC Group is a clothing company based in Copenhagen, Denmark. It operates in the clothing industry.

companies.name: AutoStore
companies.description: AutoStore AS is a Norwegian manufacturer of automated storage and retrieval systems that combine automation, software, and AI for intelligent fulfillment. The company is headquartered in Nedre Vats, Norway, and operates globally with offices in Europe, the United States, Asia, and Australia.

companies.name: Tungsten Network
companies.description: Tungsten Network is a global electronic invoicing firm providing supply chain financing services from offices in the United Kingdom, United States, Bulgaria, Germany, and Malaysia. It is traded on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: CTW Inc.
companies.description: CTW Inc. is a Japanese video game company based in Tokyo. It is mainly known for its browser-based gaming platform, G123.

companies.name: Emmis Communications
companies.description: Emmis Corporation is an American media conglomerate based in Indianapolis, Indiana. Founded in 1979, it has owned many radio stations and invested in TV, publishing, and mobile operations throughout the U.S.

companies.name: Songa Offshore SE
companies.description: Songa Offshore SE is a European offshore drilling contractor founded in 2005. It has offices in Cyprus, Stavanger, Oslo, Houston, Kuala Lumpur, Aberdeen, and Singapore.

companies.name: Bradespar
companies.description: Bradespar is a Brazilian holding company headquartered in São Paulo. It was formed in 2000 by Banco Bradesco and holds large investments in mining company Vale, being one of its largest shareholders.

companies.name: SpareBank 1 Buskerud-Vestfold
companies.description: SpareBank 1 BV was a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Sandefjord, Norway. Its main market was Buskerud and Vestfold, with history tracing back to 1883.

companies.name: Infomaniak SA
companies.description: Infomaniak is a Swiss technology company offering sustainable and privacy-focused online services. It is Switzerland's largest cloud computing company, providing cloud storage and webmail services through kSuite.

companies.name: KN Energies, AB
companies.description: KN Energies is a liquid energy product and LNG terminals operator based in Klaipėda, Lithuania. Founded in 1994, it operates several terminals in Lithuania and LNG terminals in Brazil and Germany, and develops LNG projects worldwide.

companies.name: GungHo Online Entertainment
companies.description: GungHo Online Entertainment, Inc. is a Japanese video game developer and publisher known for the mobile game Puzzle & Dragons. The company also hosts the Japanese server of Ragnarok Online through its Korean subsidiary Gravity. It is based in Japan and has generated most of its revenue from Puzzle & Dragons in the 2010s and 2020s.

companies.name: Leadtek Research
companies.description: Leadtek Research, Inc. is a Taiwanese company specializing in research and development focused on designing and manufacturing graphics cards. Founded in 1986, it operates in the computer hardware industry. The company is based in Taiwan.

companies.name: Sentul City
companies.description: Sentul City is a modern housing area located in Sentul, Babakan Madang, Bogor Regency, West Java, Indonesia. It is situated near Bogor and about 48 km south of Jakarta, Indonesia's capital. The township covers approximately 3100 hectares at the western foot of the Jonggol Mountains.

companies.name: Israel Shipyards Industries Ltd
companies.description: Israel Shipyards is a large shipbuilding and repair facility located at Kishon Port in the eastern Mediterranean. The company also operates a privately owned port adjacent to its shipyard near Haifa International Airport. It is based in Israel.

companies.name: Don’t Nod
companies.description: Don't Nod Entertainment SA is a French video game developer and publisher headquartered in Paris. Founded in 2008, it developed games such as Remember Me and Life Is Strange, the latter boosting its industry status. The company began third-party publishing in 2022.

companies.name: Toei Company
companies.description: Toei Company, Ltd. is a Japanese entertainment company headquartered in Tokyo. It is involved in film and television production, distribution, video game development, and owns 34 movie theaters. Toei is known for producing anime, live-action dramas, and is the majority shareholder of Toei Animation.

companies.name: ABG Sundal Collier
companies.description: ABG Sundal Collier Holding ASA is a Nordic investment bank headquartered in Oslo, Norway. Founded in 1984, it offers investment banking, stock broking, and corporate advisory services to institutional investors and high net-worth individuals. The company has offices across Europe and the US.

companies.name: Merlin Properties
companies.description: MERLIN Properties SOCIMI, S.A. is a Spanish real estate investment trust focused on acquiring and managing commercial assets and infrastructure in the Iberian Peninsula. Its operations include office, shopping center, logistics, and data center segments. The company is based in Spain.

companies.name: CSG Limited
companies.description: CSG Limited was an Australian business technology company founded in 1988 and publicly listed in 2007. In 2020, it was acquired by Fuji Xerox and integrated into Fujifilm, after which the CSG brand was retired. The company was based in Australia.

companies.name: ispace Inc
companies.description: ispace Inc. is a publicly traded Japanese company developing robotic spacecraft and technology for transportation and exploration missions. Its mission is to enable clients to discover, map, and utilize natural lunar resources. The company operates in the space industry and is based in Japan.

companies.name: Electromagnetic Geoservices
companies.description: Electromagnetic Geoservices ASA is a Norwegian geophysical services company based in Trondheim. It uses proprietary marine electromagnetic technology to assist oil and gas companies in locating offshore hydrocarbons. The company specializes in supporting petroleum exploration.

companies.name: Tauron Polska Energia
companies.description: Tauron Polska Energia S.A. is an energy holding company headquartered in Katowice, Poland. It owns assets in power and heat generation, distribution, and coal mining, mainly in southwestern Poland. It is the second largest energy producer in Poland.

companies.name: Exar Corporation
companies.description: Exar Corporation was an American semiconductor manufacturer active from 1971 to 2017. It operated as a subsidiary of the Japanese firm Rohm before being acquired by MaxLinear in 2017. The company was maintained as a wholly owned subsidiary for a short period after acquisition.

companies.name: Text
companies.description: Text, formerly LiveChat Software, is a Polish software company based in Wrocław. It develops AI-based customer service and communication software for both B2B and B2C markets. The company is publicly listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Delticom
companies.description: Delticom AG is a listed company headquartered in Hanover, Germany. It operates 140 online shops across 42 countries selling car and motorcycle tyres and accessories to private and corporate customers. Delticom is Europe's largest online tyre retailer.

companies.name: SpareBank 1 Ringerike Hadeland
companies.description: SpareBank 1 Ringerike Hadeland is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Hønefoss. Its main market includes Ringerike in Buskerud and the Hadeland district of Oppland. The bank traces its history back to 1833 with the establishment of Ringerikes Sparebank.

companies.name: 11 Bit Studios
companies.description: 11 bit studios S.A. is a Polish video game developer and publisher based in Warsaw. Founded in 2010 by former members of CD Projekt and Metropolis Software, it is known for games such as Anomaly: Warzone Earth, This War of Mine, and Frostpunk.

companies.name: SAF Tehnika
companies.industry: business and other management consultancy activities
companies.description: SAF Tehnika is a Latvian company that designs, manufactures, and distributes digital microwave data transmission equipment. Its products include digital microwave radio equipment, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and wireless sensor network solutions for environmental monitoring.

companies.name: Infrastrutture Wireless Italiane
companies.description: Infrastrutture Wireless Italiane S.p.A. (INWIT) is an Italian public company headquartered in Milan. It operates in the wireless network infrastructure sector, providing services related to wireless communication networks.

companies.name: SpareBank 1 Østfold Akershus
companies.description: SpareBank 1 Østfold Akershus is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Moss. Its main market covers the Østfold and Akershus regions. The bank's history dates back to 1835.

companies.name: Zealand Pharma
companies.description: Zealand Pharma A/S is a Danish biotechnology research company that designs and develops peptide-based medicines, focusing on metabolic diseases like diabetes and obesity. Its head office is located in Søborg near Copenhagen. In 2018, Zealand Pharma opened a subsidiary in the United States and is part of the Danish-Swedish life science cluster Medicon Valley.

companies.name: JYP Entertainment
companies.description: JYP Entertainment Corporation is a South Korean multinational entertainment and record label conglomerate founded in 1997. It operates as a record label, talent agency, music production company, event management company, concert production company, and music publishing house. The company also runs subsidiary ventures and divisions internationally.

companies.name: Inmobiliaria Colonial
companies.description: Inmobiliaria Colonial is a Spanish multinational corporation involved in real estate. It operates a Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) and its activities include property rental, land, and development. The company is based in Spain.

companies.name: EHang
companies.description: Guangzhou EHang Intelligent Technology Co. Ltd. is a company based in Guangzhou, China, that develops and manufactures autonomous aerial vehicles (AAVs) and passenger AAVs. These vehicles have entered service in China for aerial cinematography, photography, emergency response, and survey missions.

companies.name: Synspective
companies.description: Synspective is a publicly traded space company formed in 2018 and based in Tokyo, Japan. The company specializes in synthetic aperture radar satellites and operates a constellation of these satellites for advanced earth imaging.

companies.name: Rainmaker Entertainment
companies.description: Mainframe Studios is a Canadian animation studio based in Vancouver, British Columbia, and owned by Wow Unlimited Media. Founded in 1993 as Mainframe Entertainment Inc., it contributed to the introduction of computer-generated imagery (CGI) in animation, film, and television.

companies.name: Rocky Mountain Chocolate
companies.description: Rocky Mountain Chocolate is an international franchiser, confectionery manufacturer, and retail operator based in Durango, Colorado, United States. The company has outlets in Panama and the Philippines and was formerly known as Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory, Inc.

companies.name: Digimarc
companies.description: Digimarc Corporation is a provider of enterprise software and services based in the United States. Its software includes digital identifiers designed to address counterfeiting, product authenticity, recycling accuracy, and supply chain traceability across multiple industries such as apparel, consumer packaged goods, health and beauty, and automotive.

companies.name: Bitdeer
companies.description: Bitdeer Technologies Group is a cryptocurrency mining and artificial intelligence cloud infrastructure company headquartered in Singapore. Spun off from Bitmain in 2021, it operates data centers in the United States, Norway, and Bhutan. Since 2023, Bitdeer has expanded into AI cloud services through partnerships and facility conversions.

companies.name: Garanti BBVA
companies.description: Garanti BBVA is a Turkish financial services company based in Turkey. The majority stake of 86% is owned by the Spanish bank Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria (BBVA).

companies.name: Norwegian Air Shuttle
companies.description: Norwegian Air Shuttle ASA, trading as Norwegian, is a Norwegian low-cost airline and Scandinavia's second-largest airline. It operates a high-frequency domestic flight schedule within Scandinavia and Finland, as well as to business and holiday destinations in Europe. The airline is known for its distinctive livery featuring portraits on the tail fins of its aircraft.

companies.name: Oricon
companies.description: Oricon Inc. is a Japanese holding company established in 1999 that supplies statistics and information on music in Japan and Western music. It originated from Original Confidence Inc., founded in 1967, and took over the Oricon record charts in 2002. The company is known for its music charts.

companies.name: Protector Forsikring
companies.description: Protector Forsikring ASA is a Norwegian multinational insurance company headquartered in Oslo. It offers property and casualty insurance services. The company operates within the financial services industry.

companies.name: Tanger Inc.
companies.description: Tanger Inc. is a real estate investment trust based in Greensboro, North Carolina. It invests in open air outlet and lifestyle shopping centers across the United States and Canada. The company operates in the real estate sector.

companies.name: ASRock
companies.description: ASRock Inc. is a Taiwanese manufacturer specializing in motherboards, industrial PCs, and home theater PCs. The company operates in the computer industry and is based in Taiwan.

companies.name: Eni Plenitude France
companies.description: Eni Gas & Power France is the first French natural gas company headquartered in Paris. It was founded in 2003 by Taoufik Tahar, Robert Delbos, and Jean-Paul George. The company operates in the renewables and utilities sector.

companies.name: Itamar Medical Ltd
companies.description: Itamar Medical is a multinational medical device company headquartered in Caesarea, Israel. It focuses on devices related to respiratory sleep disorders and is owned by ZOLL Medical Corporation. The company provides diagnostic devices for sleep disorders and early diagnosis of atherosclerosis.

companies.name: Sparebanken Øst
companies.description: Sparebanken Øst is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Drammen, Norway. Its main market is the eastern part of Norway, and it was established in 1843. The bank operates within the financial services industry.

companies.name: Entra Eiendom
companies.description: Entra ASA is a Norwegian real estate company headquartered in Oslo. It operates in the real property sector. The company is known for its real estate activities in Norway.

companies.name: Devolver Digital
companies.description: Devolver Digital, Inc. is an American video game publisher based in Austin, Texas, specializing in indie games. Founded in 2009 by five executives from previous game companies, it focuses on digital distribution platforms to publish games. The company operates in the film industry sector.

companies.name: Odfjell Drilling
companies.description: Odfjell Drilling is an international drilling company based in Norway. Founded in 1973 with maritime roots dating back to 1914, it has experience in the petroleum industry since the mid-1960s. The company was listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange on 27 September 2013.

companies.name: SpareBank 1 Nordmøre
companies.description: SpareBank 1 Nordmøre is a Norwegian savings bank with branches in Nordmøre, Molde, and Ålesund. It has 11 branch offices and a head office in Kristiansund. The bank is part of the SpareBank 1 and Samarbeidende Sparebanker alliances.

companies.name: Kadokawa Shoten
companies.description: Kadokawa Shoten is a Japanese publisher and division of Kadokawa Corporation based in Tokyo. It publishes manga, light novels, and entertainment magazines, and has expanded into multimedia including video games and films. It became an internal division of Kadokawa Corporation in 2013.

companies.name: Björn Borg AB
companies.description: Björn Borg AB is a Swedish apparel fashion brand named after the former professional tennis player Björn Borg. The company operates in the retail industry.

companies.name: CI Games S.A.
companies.description: CI Games S.A. is a Polish video game developer and publisher based in Warsaw. Founded in 2002, it is known for the Sniper: Ghost Warrior and Lords of the Fallen series. Originally, it focused on budget-range games.

companies.name: Skue Sparebank
companies.description: Skue Sparebank is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Nesbyen, Norway. Its main market is Buskerud, and its history dates back to 1842 with the establishment of Nes Prestegjelds Sparebank.

companies.name: Bank of Greenland
companies.description: The BANK of Greenland is one of two commercial banks in Greenland, headquartered in Nuuk. It is listed on the Copenhagen Stock Exchange and had 2,700 shareholders and 118 employees as of 2017.

companies.name: Scatec Solar
companies.description: Scatec ASA, formerly Scatec Solar ASA, is a Norwegian renewable energy company founded in 2007. It was renamed in 2020 to reflect a broadened strategy beyond solar energy. Major shareholders include Scatec Innovation AS and Equinor.

companies.name: Eltek
companies.description: Eltek is a brand of electric power conversion products for telecommunications and industrial applications. It is developed and sold by Delta Electronics (Norway) AS, based in Drammen, Norway. Eltek has offices in 40 countries and had approximately 2000 employees as of 2018.

companies.name: Jæren Sparebank
companies.description: Jæren Sparebank is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Bryne, Norway. Its main market is the Rogaland region. The bank operates primarily in financial services within Norway.

companies.name: Royal Caribbean Group
companies.description: Royal Caribbean Group is a cruise holding company headquartered in Miami, Florida, United States, and incorporated in Liberia. It fully owns three cruise lines and holds a 50% stake in TUI Cruises. The group operates a global fleet of 71 ships.

companies.name: Funcom
companies.description: Funcom Oslo AS is a Norwegian video game developer and publisher specializing in online games. It is known for MMORPG titles like Conan Exiles and Age of Conan. The company has offices in multiple countries and is owned by Tencent.

companies.name: Phunware
companies.description: Phunware Inc. is a publicly traded enterprise software company headquartered in Austin, Texas. Founded in 2009, it builds cloud-based platforms for user engagement in marketing and public relations. Its services include mobile app development, location-based services, digital advertising, and generative AI tools.

companies.name: Kalray
companies.description: Kalray is a French fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Montbonnot, France. It operates in the manufacture of electronic components sector.

companies.name: Daugavpils Locomotive Repair Plant
companies.description: Daugavpils Locomotive Repair Plant is a Latvian railway rolling stock repair and metalworking company based in Daugavpils. Its origins trace back to steam-locomotive repair workshops established in 1866. The current joint-stock company was registered in Latvia in 1991.

companies.name: Aurskog Sparebank
companies.description: Aurskog Sparebank is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Aurskog, Norway. Its main market is the Romerike district of Akershus. The bank's equity certificates were listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange in 1998.

companies.name: Sofina
companies.description: Sofina is a Belgian holding company headquartered in Brussels with offices in Singapore and Luxembourg. It is part of the Bel20 index and invests in multiple industrial sectors including telecommunications, banks, insurance, private equity, consumer goods, and energy. Its investments span several countries including Belgium, France, and China.

companies.name: MelhusBanken
companies.description: Melhus Sparebank is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Melhus Municipality, Norway. Its main market is the southern part of Trøndelag county. Established in 1840, it is one of Norway’s oldest savings banks.

companies.name: Cube Entertainment
companies.description: Cube Entertainment, Inc. is a South Korean entertainment company that operates as a record label, talent agency, music production company, event management and concert production company, and music publishing house. It is known for having self-composing and self-producing idols. The founder, Hong Seung-sung, resigned in April 2020 due to an ownership dispute.

companies.name: Team17
companies.description: Team17 Digital Limited is a British video game developer and publisher based in Wakefield, England. It was formed in 1990 through the merger of 17-Bit Software and Team 7. The company is known for the Worms franchise, which remains its primary development output with over 20 entries.

companies.name: GP Investments
companies.description: GP Investments, Ltd is an investment firm in Latin America with a strong presence in asset management, mainly private equity funds. The firm's shares are listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange and traded on BM&FBovespa via Brazilian Depositary Receipts.

companies.name: Selvaag Bolig
companies.description: Selvaag Bolig ASA is a residential property developer headquartered in Oslo, Norway. It was established in 2008 when Selvaag Group's property development activities were separated into a new company.

companies.name: Norwegian Property
companies.industry: renting and operating of own or leased real estate
companies.description: Norwegian Property is a real estate company with a portfolio in Oslo and Stavanger, Norway. Founded in 2006 and listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange, it invests in major commercial real estate and offers a publicly traded real estate portfolio.

companies.name: Montea (company)
companies.description: Montea NV is a publicly traded real estate company based in Aalst, Belgium, specializing in logistics and industrial real estate development and management. It operates in Belgium, the Netherlands, France, and Germany with a portfolio of over 120 locations totaling more than 2.3 million m².

companies.name: Sogn Sparebank
companies.description: Indre Sogn Sparebank is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Årdalstangen, Norway. Its main market is the area surrounding Sognefjorden.

companies.name: TGS-NOPEC Geophysical Company
companies.description: TGS, formerly TGS NOPEC Geophysical Company ASA, is an energy data and analytics company that gathers, interprets, and markets seismic and geophysical data worldwide to evaluate oil and gas formations. It was founded by a 1998 merger and has financial headquarters in Oslo, Norway, and operational headquarters in Houston, Texas.

companies.name: Aker
companies.description: Aker ASA is a Norwegian industrial investment company with ownership interests in oil and gas, renewable energy, green technologies, industrial software, seafood, and marine biotechnology. It is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange and headquartered in Fornebu, Norway. The company was established in 1841.

companies.name: Nokian Panimo
companies.description: Nokian Panimo Oy is a brewery based in Nokia, Finland, founded in 1991. It produces beer, cider, mineral water, and soft drinks. The company operates in the food industry.

companies.name: Croatia Records
companies.description: Croatia Records is a record label located in Zagreb, Croatia. It is owned by AUTOR d.o.o. The company operates in the music industry.

companies.name: Høland og Setskog Sparebank
companies.description: Høland og Setskog Sparebank is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Bjørkelangen, Norway. Its main market is Akershus, and its history dates back to 1849. The bank operates in the financial services industry.

companies.name: Hikvision
companies.description: Hangzhou Hikvision Digital Technology Co., Ltd., known as Hikvision, is a Chinese partly state-owned manufacturer and supplier of video surveillance equipment. It is headquartered in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, and serves both civilian and military purposes.

companies.name: TCL Electronics
companies.description: TCL Electronics Holdings Limited is a Chinese multinational corporation headquartered in Hong Kong and incorporated in the Cayman Islands. It specializes in R&D, manufacturing, and distribution of televisions, mobile phones, air conditioners, washing machines, refrigerators, and smart home internet services. It is a subsidiary of TCL Industries Holdings.

companies.name: Kinnevik AB
companies.description: Kinnevik AB is a Swedish investment company founded in 1936 by the Stenbeck, Klingspor, and von Horn families. It operates in the investment industry.

companies.name: Fortress Biotech
companies.description: Fortress Biotech Inc., also known as Fortress Bio, is a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Bay Harbor Islands, Florida. It acquires, develops, and commercializes pharmaceutical and biotechnology products. The company is led by CEO Lindsay A. Rosenwald, M.D.

companies.name: Canadian Tire
companies.description: Canadian Tire Corporation, Limited is a Canadian retail corporation headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. It operates department stores, gas stations, and financial services, and owns several retail brands including Mark's and Sport Chek. It also owns the intellectual property of the former Hudson's Bay Company as of 2025.

companies.name: Arendals Fossekompani
companies.description: Arendals Fossekompani ASA is a Norwegian company based in Arendal. Its main business is producing and selling electric energy from two hydroelectric power plants. The company is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Voss Veksel- og Landmandsbank
companies.description: Voss Veksel- og Landmandsbank, also known as Vekselbanken, is a Norwegian commercial bank located in Vossavangen, Voss Municipality. It is the only remaining independent commercial bank not merged into larger banks like DnB NOR or Nordea.

companies.name: Nel
companies.industry: manufacture of other special-purpose machinery n.e.c.
companies.description: Nel ASA is a Norwegian company founded in 1927 and based in Oslo. It provides solutions for the production, storage, and distribution of hydrogen from renewable energy sources. Nel is listed in the OBX Index of the Oslo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Weifa
companies.description: Weifa is a Norwegian pharmaceutical company headquartered in Oslo with production facilities in Kragerø Municipality. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry in Norway.

companies.name: Axactor
companies.description: Axactor ASA is a multinational debt buyer headquartered in Oslo, Norway. Founded in 2015, it has expanded through acquisitions in several European countries and is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: 4Licensing Corporation
companies.description: 4Kids Entertainment, Inc. was an American licensing company specializing in children's entertainment, including English-dubbed Japanese anime. It produced and licensed popular franchises such as Pokémon and Yu-Gi-Oh! and operated TV program blocks aimed at children.

companies.name: Latécoère
companies.description: Groupe Latécoère is an aircraft company based in Toulouse, France. Founded in 1917 by Pierre-Georges Latécoère, it became known for its range of seaplanes, including the six-engined Latécoère 631.

companies.name: Barry Callebaut
companies.description: Barry Callebaut AG is a Swiss-Belgian cocoa processor and chocolate manufacturer based in Zürich, Switzerland. It was formed in 1996 by merging Cacao Barry and Callebaut and operates production sites worldwide.

companies.name: Kimia Farma
companies.description: PT Kimia Farma Tbk is an Indonesian pharmaceutical producer and distributor based in Jakarta. It operates within Indonesia's pharmaceutical industry.

companies.name: Bank CIMB Niaga
companies.description: PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk is an Indonesian private bank established in 1955 and majority-owned by Malaysian CIMB Group Holdings Berhad. It is the largest payment bank by transaction value and the third largest mortgage provider in Indonesia.

companies.name: BlueNord
companies.description: BlueNord ASA, formerly Norwegian Energy Company ASA, is an independent international petroleum company based in Norway. Established in 2005, it explores, develops, and produces oil and gas in the North Sea and operates in Norway, Denmark, and the UK.

companies.name: SG Micro
companies.description: SG Micro is a publicly listed semiconductor company based in Beijing, China. It specializes in analog chips as its main business focus.

companies.name: Buenaventura
companies.description: Compañia de Minas Buenaventura is a Peruvian company engaged in mining and exploration of precious metals including gold and silver. It operates in the mining industry in Peru.

companies.name: Melco Holdings
companies.description: Melco Holdings Inc. is a family business founded in 1975 and located in Japan. The company is known for its brand Buffalo Inc. and operates in the computer hardware industry.

companies.name: Build-A-Bear Workshop
companies.description: Build-A-Bear Workshop, Inc. is an American retailer headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. It sells teddy bears and stuffed animals that customers can customize with sounds, scents, clothing, and accessories.

companies.name: Taiyuan Coal Gasification Group
companies.description: Taiyuan Coal Gasification (Group) Co., Ltd. is a Chinese state-owned coal mining conglomerate based in Taiyuan, Shanxi. It is managed by Jincheng Anthracite Mining Group since 2011 under Shanxi SASAC.

companies.name: China Pacific Insurance
companies.description: China Pacific Insurance (Group) Co., Ltd., known as Pacific Insurance, is a Chinese insurance company headquartered in Shanghai. It was established based on the former China Pacific Insurance Corporation founded in 1991.

companies.name: Bulgarian Stock Exchange
companies.description: The Bulgarian Stock Exchange is the only licensed and operating stock exchange in Bulgaria. It was founded on October 10, 1991.

companies.name: Bumi Resources
companies.description: PT Bumi Resources Tbk is a major Indonesian mining holding company and the largest producer of thermal coal in Indonesia. It is majority owned by the Bakrie Group and Salim Group.

companies.name: Pool Corporation
companies.description: Pool Corporation, known as POOLCORP, is the largest global distributor of swimming pool supplies, equipment, and machinery. Headquartered in Covington, Louisiana, it operates 439 sales centers across North America, Europe, and Australia.

companies.name: Vontier
companies.description: Vontier Corporation is an industrial manufacturing company headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. It owns brands including Gilbarco Veeder-Root, Matco Tools, and Teletrac Navman, along with subsidiaries like Hennessy Industries.

companies.name: Medigen Vaccine Biologics
companies.description: Medigen Vaccine Biologics Corporation is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in Neihu, Taipei, Taiwan. It operates in the biotechnology industry focusing on vaccine development and biologics.

companies.name: Yunnan Copper
companies.description: Yunnan Copper Company Limited is the third largest copper producer in China. Established in 1958, it is based in Kunming, Yunnan, and operates in the mining industry.

companies.name: Aurora Innovation
companies.description: Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a self-driving vehicle technology company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, USA. It developed the Aurora Driver, a system for autonomous driving, and was co-founded by former leaders from Google, Tesla, and Uber's autonomy teams.

companies.name: Pepper Lunch
companies.description: Pepper Lunch is a Japanese fast-steak restaurant franchise popular in the Tokyo area. As of 2026, it operates approximately 575 locations.

companies.name: Buzzi
companies.description: Buzzi S.p.A. is an Italian company producing cement, ready-mix concrete, and construction aggregates. Headquartered in Casale Monferrato, it has subsidiaries and operations across Europe, North America, and Algeria.

companies.name: Viatris
companies.description: Viatris Inc. is a global pharmaceutical and healthcare corporation headquartered in Canonsburg, Pennsylvania, USA. It was formed through the merger of Mylan and Upjohn, a division of Pfizer, in November 2020.

companies.name: Sitronics
companies.description: Sitronics is a Russian microelectronics company owned by Sistema Holdings and based in Moscow. It operates electronics fabrication facilities and has R&D centers in Zelenograd and other parts of Eastern Europe.

companies.name: CBRE Group
companies.description: CBRE Group, Inc. is an American commercial real estate services and investment firm headquartered in Dallas, Texas, with global financial headquarters in Midtown Manhattan. It is the world's largest commercial real estate services and investment firm by 2025 revenue.

companies.name: CDW
companies.description: CDW Corporation is an American provider of information technology services serving business, government, education, and healthcare sectors in the US, UK, and Canada. It is headquartered in Vernon Hills, Illinois.

companies.name: China Agri-Industries Holdings Limited
companies.description: China Agri-Industries Holdings Limited is a leading producer and supplier of processed agricultural products in Mainland China. Its services include biofuel, oilseed processing, rice and wheat processing, and brewing materials.

companies.name: CROBEX
companies.description: CROBEX is the official share index of the Zagreb Stock Exchange in Croatia. It includes stocks of 15 companies and is calculated continuously using the latest stock prices. The index is measured using free float market capitalization with a weight limit of 10 percent per stock.

companies.name: CTT Correios de Portugal
companies.description: CTT – Correios de Portugal, S.A. is the national postal service of Portugal and a commercial group with subsidiaries in banking, e-commerce, and postal services. Founded in 1520 by King Manuel I, it is the oldest company still operating in Portugal. The company is based in Portugal.

companies.name: Callaway Golf Company
companies.description: Callaway Golf Company is an American global sports equipment manufacturer specializing in golf clubs, balls, and accessories like bags, gloves, and caps. The company designs, manufactures, markets, and sells its products worldwide. It is based in the United States.

companies.name: Cameco
companies.description: Cameco Corporation is the world's largest publicly traded uranium company based in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Canada. In 2015, it was the world's second largest uranium producer, accounting for 18% of global production. The company operates in the mining sector.

companies.name: Ernest Borel
companies.description: Ernest Borel is a Swiss watch manufacturer founded in 1856 in Neuchatel, Switzerland. The company has focused on export markets outside Europe and won awards in the 19th century, including first place in the 1866 Neuchatel observatory timing accuracy competition. This award was important for its brand value.

companies.name: Anhui Heli
companies.description: Heli is a Chinese construction equipment maker primarily known for producing forklift trucks. It is the largest forklift maker in China and the seventh largest worldwide based on 2018 sales revenue. The company operates in the construction and cement industry.

companies.name: Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A.
companies.description: Iguatemi is the third largest Brazilian company involved in the creation, planning, development, and administration of shopping centers. It holds shareholdings in 16 shopping malls, one premium outlet, and three office towers totaling 657,000 m² of gross leasable area. The company serves approximately 10 million customers monthly.

companies.name: International Meal Company
companies.description: International Meal Company (IMC) is a Brazilian holding company in the food service sector operating fast food restaurants. Founded in 2006, it operates 386 restaurants across Brazil and several other Latin American countries. Its brands include Viena, Frango Assado, Wraps, and others.

companies.name: JHSF Participações
companies.description: JHSF Participações is a Brazilian real estate holding company focusing on high-income segment recurrent income assets like shopping malls, airports, and hotels. It operates in Brazil and internationally, including the United States and Uruguay. The company is known for prioritizing recurrent income assets.

companies.name: Campbell's
companies.description: The Campbell's Company is an American company best known for its canned soup products. Its classic red-and-white can design has become an American icon and has been featured in American pop art. The company operates in the food industry.

companies.name: NTT Data Group
companies.description: NTT DATA Group Corporation is a Japanese multinational IT service and consulting company headquartered in Tokyo. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone (NTT). The company operates in the information technology consulting industry.

companies.name: Canadian Oil Sands Limited
companies.description: Canadian Oil Sands Limited was a Canadian company involved in oil sands investment through the Syncrude Joint Venture. It operated an oil sands facility producing crude oil by mining oil sands in the Athabasca region of northern Alberta, Canada.

companies.name: Canadian Western Bank
companies.logo_file: Canadian Western Bank Financial Group horizontal logo.svg
companies.description: Canadian Western Bank, also known as CWB Financial Group, was a Canadian bank based in Edmonton, Alberta. It primarily operated in western Canada with several branches in eastern Canada.

companies.name: Capital Power Corporation
companies.description: Capital Power is a Canadian independent power generation company headquartered in Edmonton, Alberta. It develops, acquires, owns, and operates power generation facilities using various energy sources.

companies.name: Capital One
companies.description: Capital One Financial Corporation is an American bank holding company headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, with operations in the US, Canada, and the UK. It is a major issuer of credit cards and owns Discover Card, Diners Club, and Pulse payment networks.

companies.name: RaiaDrogasil
companies.description: RD Saúde is the largest drugstore company in Latin America by revenue and market capitalization. Headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil, it operates more than 3,000 pharmacies across all 27 Brazilian states.

companies.name: Stoxx Europe 600 Index
companies.description: The STOXX Europe 600 is a stock index designed by STOXX Ltd representing 600 European companies across 17 countries. It covers approximately 90% of the free-float market capitalization of the European stock market.

companies.name: Smiles S.A.
companies.description: Smiles S.A. is a Brazilian company managing the Smiles loyalty program, formerly the frequent-flyer program of Varig. The program is now associated with GOL Linhas Aéreas Inteligentes S.A.

companies.name: ThoughtWorks
companies.description: Thoughtworks Holding, Inc. is a privately held global technology company with 49 offices in 18 countries. It provides software design, delivery, tools, and consulting services, and is linked to the Agile software development movement.

companies.name: Ministop
companies.description: Ministop Co., Ltd., a member of AEON, operates the Ministop convenience store franchise in Japan. Its stores feature kitchens preparing fresh food and seating areas for customers to eat on-site.

companies.name: Aaron's, Inc.
companies.description: Aaron's, Inc. is an American lease-to-own retailer specializing in furniture, electronics, appliances, and computers. It operates through company-owned and franchised stores as well as an e-commerce platform. The company is known for its lease and retail sales model.

companies.name: Bathurst Resources
companies.description: Bathurst Resources is a coal mining company based in New Zealand, established in 2010. It operates along with several subsidiaries in the mining sector. The company focuses on coal extraction and related activities.

companies.name: C3.ai
companies.description: C3.ai is an American information technology company specializing in enterprise artificial intelligence. Founded in 2009 by Thomas Siebel, it is based in Redwood City, California. The company became publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange in 2020.

companies.name: Vistra
companies.description: Vistra Corp. is an integrated retail electricity and power generation company headquartered in Irving, Texas. It is the largest competitive power generator in the U.S., with a diverse portfolio including natural gas, coal, nuclear, solar, and battery energy storage facilities.

companies.name: Carnival Corporation
companies.description: Carnival Corporation Ltd. is a Bermuda-domiciled American cruise line operator owning over 90 vessels across eight brands. It is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and was a dual-listed company with a British counterpart until 2026. The company is a component of the S&P 500 index.

companies.name: Vallibel One
companies.description: Vallibel One PLC is one of Sri Lanka's largest conglomerates, listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange since 2011. It controls subsidiaries including LB Finance, Royal Ceramics Lanka, and Delmege Group. The company was included in the S&P Sri Lanka 20 Index in 2018.

companies.name: CRISPR Therapeutics
companies.description: CRISPR Therapeutics AG is a Swiss-American biotechnology company headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with offices in the US and UK. It was among the first to use CRISPR gene editing for medicine development. Its manufacturing facility won the FOYA award in 2022, and its lead program received FDA approval in 2023.

companies.name: United Technologies Corporation
companies.description: United Technologies Corporation was an American multinational conglomerate based in Farmington, Connecticut. It developed products in aircraft engines, aerospace systems, HVAC, elevators, fire and security, and industrial products. In 2020, it merged with Raytheon Company to form Raytheon Technologies.

companies.name: Savills
companies.description: Savills plc is a British multinational real estate services company headquartered in London. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index. The company provides a range of real estate services internationally.

companies.name: KEGOC
companies.description: The Kazakhstan Electricity Grid Operating Company (KEGOC) is a state joint-stock company based in Astana, Kazakhstan. Established in 1997, it operates in the power engineering sector. KEGOC manages electricity grid operations within Kazakhstan.

companies.name: Delek US
companies.description: Delek US Holdings, Inc. is an oil refining, logistics, and biofuels company founded in 2001. It is headquartered in Brentwood, Tennessee. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

companies.name: Rumble
companies.description: Rumble, Inc. is an American AI, infrastructure, and video company headquartered in Longboat Key, Florida. It was founded in 2013 by Canadian tech entrepreneur Chris Pavlovski. The company operates in the AI and software industry.

companies.name: Penumbra
companies.description: Penumbra, Inc. is an American medical device company headquartered in Alameda, California. Founded in 2004 by Arani Bose and Adam Elsesser, it manufactures devices for interventional therapies to treat vascular conditions such as stroke and aneurysm.

companies.name: SentinelOne
companies.description: SentinelOne, Inc. is an American cybersecurity company based in Mountain View, California. Founded in 2013, it uses machine learning and patented behavioral AI to monitor personal computers, IoT devices, and cloud workloads. The company is AV-TEST certified.

companies.name: California Water Service Group
companies.description: California Water Service Group (CWSG) is an American public utility company providing drinking water and wastewater services. It serves roughly two million people through subsidiaries in California, Hawaii, New Mexico, and Washington. CWSG was formed in 1997 to expand into other states and businesses.

companies.name: Sefalana
companies.description: Sefalana is Botswana's second largest food retailer operating more than 1200 stores across Africa. The company is headquartered in Gaborone, Botswana, and is publicly listed on the Botswana Stock Exchange.

companies.name: GRAIL
companies.description: GRAIL, Inc. is an American biotechnology company based in Menlo Park, California, founded in 2015. It develops early cancer screening tests for asymptomatic people and was a subsidiary of Illumina before being fully acquired in 2021.

companies.name: Hangzhou GreatStar Industrial
companies.description: Hangzhou GreatStar Industrial Co., Ltd. is an industrial conglomerate based in Hangzhou, China. It primarily produces hand tools and power tools.

companies.name: Seres Group
companies.description: Seres Group is a Chinese automotive manufacturer headquartered in Chongqing, China, founded in 1986. It produces electric and internal combustion engine cars, motorcycles, commercial vehicles, and shock absorbers through its subsidiaries.

companies.name: G5 Entertainment
companies.description: G5 Entertainment is a Swedish video game developer specializing in free-to-play mobile games.

companies.name: MR.DIY
companies.description: MR.DIY is a Malaysian multinational discount variety store chain founded in Kuala Lumpur in 2005. It offers a wide range of home improvement products and general merchandise, with over 6,000 stores across 15 countries as of August 2026. The stores typically carry more than 17,000 product varieties.

companies.name: Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos
companies.description: Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos S.A. (BYMA) is an Argentine stock exchange and financial market infrastructure operator based in Buenos Aires. It provides securities trading, clearing, settlement services, and central securities depository services through its subsidiary Caja de Valores.

companies.name: ASmallWorld
companies.description: ASMALLWORLD operates a digital travel and luxury lifestyle ecosystem based in Zürich, Switzerland. It enables members to find inspiration, book unique journeys, and connect with like-minded individuals including notable personalities.

companies.name: Subaru Corporation
companies.description: Subaru Corporation, formerly Fuji Heavy Industries, is a Japanese multinational conglomerate involved in terrestrial and aerospace transportation manufacturing. It is best known for Subaru automobiles and manufactures helicopters and airplanes under license for Boeing and Lockheed Martin.

companies.name: Cenovus Energy
companies.description: Cenovus Energy Inc. is a Canadian integrated oil and natural gas company headquartered in Calgary, Alberta. The company moved its offices to Brookfield Place in 2019 from the neighbouring Bow building.

companies.name: Immersion Corporation
companies.description: Immersion Corporation is a developer and licensor of touch feedback (haptic) technology based in Aventura, Florida. Founded in 1993 by Louis Rosenberg, it is currently led by CEO and general counsel Francis Jose.

companies.name: CenterPoint Energy
companies.description: CenterPoint Energy, Inc. is an American utility company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It provides electric and natural gas utility services in Indiana, Ohio, Minnesota, and Texas, and is located in the CenterPoint Energy Tower in Downtown Houston.

companies.name: Alma Media
companies.description: Alma Media Oyj is a Finnish media and digital service company known for products such as Iltalehti, Kauppalehti, Talouselämä, Ampparit, Monster.fi, and Etuovi.com. It operates primarily in publishing and digital services.

companies.name: GenCell
companies.description: GenCell Ltd. is an Israeli company developing hydrogen alkaline based fuel cell systems and ammonia-based off-grid power solutions. Its products replace diesel generators with clean backup power for utilities, homeland security, healthcare, and automated industries.

companies.name: NTT, Inc.
companies.description: NTT, Inc. is a Japanese telecommunications holding company headquartered in Tokyo. It is one of the largest telecommunications companies globally by revenue and market capitalization, with a history of being the world's largest company by market cap in the late 1980s.

companies.name: Cerner
companies.description: Oracle Health, formerly Cerner Corporation, is an American multinational provider of health information technology platforms and services. It is headquartered in North Kansas City, Missouri. The company is a leading electronic health record provider with over 9.5 million customers.

companies.name: LOLC Holdings
companies.description: LOLC Holdings PLC is a Sri Lankan conglomerate listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange. It started as a non-banking financial company and has grown into one of the largest conglomerates in Sri Lanka, involved in many sectors and subsidiaries in several countries, mainly in the financial sector.

companies.name: MP Materials
companies.description: MP Materials Corp. is an American rare-earth materials company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada. It owns and operates the Mountain Pass mine, the only operating rare earth mine and processing facility in the United States. The company focuses on producing neodymium-praseodymium used in high-strength permanent magnets for advanced technologies.

companies.name: Libsyn
companies.description: Liberated Syndication, Inc. (Libsyn) is an American podcasting company founded in 2004 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. As of 2026, it is headquartered in Dallas, Texas.

companies.name: DL E&C
companies.description: DL E&C Co., Ltd. is a construction company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. It was formerly the construction division of Daelim Industrial.

companies.name: The Hershey Company
companies.industry: manufacture of cocoa, chocolate and sugar confectionery
companies.description: The Hershey Company is an American multinational confectionery company headquartered in Hershey, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1894 by Milton S. Hershey, it is one of the largest chocolate manufacturers in the world and also produces baked goods and beverages.

companies.name: DirecTV
companies.description: DirecTV, LLC is an American video programming distributor based in El Segundo, California. Launched in 1994 by Hughes, it provides virtual multichannel video programming and satellite services in the United States and Puerto Rico.

companies.name: IndiGo
companies.description: IndiGo is an Indian low-cost airline headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana. It is the largest airline in India by passengers carried and operates over 2,700 daily flights to 137 destinations. Its primary hub is Indira Gandhi International Airport in Delhi.

companies.name: Thredup
companies.description: ThredUp Inc. is an American company operating an online resale platform specializing in second-hand clothing, footwear, and accessories. Founded in 2009, it is headquartered in Oakland, California, and is a leading resale fashion marketplace.

companies.name: Medivir
companies.description: Medivir is a Swedish biotech company focusing on oncology and innovative pharmaceuticals addressing unmet medical needs. It conducts pharmaceutical development in-house and through partnerships and has expertise in protease inhibitors and nucleotide science. Medivir is listed on the Nasdaq Stockholm Mid Cap List.

companies.name: Shake Shack
companies.description: Shake Shack is an American multinational fast casual restaurant chain based in New York City. It began as a hot dog cart in Madison Square Park in 2001 and expanded to a permanent kiosk in 2004, broadening its menu to include hamburgers, hot dogs, fries, and milkshakes.

companies.name: Beike
companies.description: KE Holdings Inc. is a publicly listed Chinese real estate holding company that provides an integrated online and offline platform for housing transactions and services. It is the largest online real estate transaction platform in China.

companies.name: EVE Energy Co., Ltd
companies.description: EVE Energy Co., Ltd. is a Chinese battery manufacturer founded in 2001, specializing in lithium-ion batteries for energy storage systems and electric vehicles. Headquartered in Huizhou, Guangdong, it is the third largest energy storage battery cell maker globally and ranked ninth in electric vehicle battery production as of 2024.

companies.name: Ariston
companies.description: Ariston Holding N.V., known as Ariston, is an Italian multinational company operating in the thermal comfort sector. It produces solutions for space and water heating, including burners and components.

companies.name: Wingtech Technology
companies.description: Wingtech Technology is a Chinese partially state-owned semiconductor and communications product integration company based in Jiaxing, Zhejiang. It has been publicly traded on the Shanghai Stock Exchange since 2015 and is partly owned by Luxshare.

companies.name: WestJet
companies.description: WestJet is a Canadian airline headquartered in Calgary, Alberta. Founded in 1994, it is the second-largest airline in Canada and the eighth largest in North America by frequency, initially launched as a low-cost alternative with three aircraft and five destinations.

companies.name: Innovent Biologics
companies.description: Innovent Biologics, Inc. is a publicly listed Chinese biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Suzhou, Jiangsu.

companies.name: Sangfor Technologies Inc.
companies.description: Sangfor Technologies is a Chinese technology company specializing in cybersecurity, cloud computing, and enterprise IT infrastructure. It serves enterprise customers and is publicly listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange. The company was founded by He Zhaoxi and Xiong Wu.

companies.name: Orexo
companies.description: Orexo is a Swedish pharmaceutical company that develops improved pharmaceuticals using innovative formulation technologies. It commercializes drugs and digital therapies in the US to treat opioid use disorder and other diseases, and develops products for other therapeutic areas worldwide with partners.

companies.name: Live Nation Entertainment
companies.description: Live Nation Entertainment, Inc. is an American multinational entertainment company founded in 2010 after the merger of Live Nation and Ticketmaster. It operates both brands, promotes and manages ticket sales for live entertainment globally, owns venues and festivals, and manages music artists' careers.

companies.name: Teejay Lanka
companies.description: Teejay Lanka PLC, formerly Textured Jersey Lanka, is a knitted fabric manufacturer based in Sri Lanka. It is part of the S&P Sri Lanka 20 Index and supplies fabrics to major brands including Nike and Marks & Spencer.

companies.name: Changzhou Xingyu Automotive Lighting Systems Co.,Ltd.
companies.description: Changzhou Xingyu Automotive Lighting Systems is a Chinese automotive lighting manufacturer headquartered in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province. Established in 1993, it operates 12 factories in China and Serbia and 16 research centers globally, producing lighting systems for major carmakers like Volkswagen and BMW.

companies.name: Luminar Technologies
companies.description: Luminar Technologies Inc. was a U.S.-based technology company specializing in vision-based lidar and machine perception technologies for self-driving cars. Its headquarters and main R&D facilities were in Orlando, Florida, with a major office in Palo Alto, California.

companies.name: Walmart de México y Centroamérica
companies.logo_file: Logo de Walmart Mexico y Centroamerica.jpg
companies.description: Walmart de México y Centroamérica, known as Walmex, is the Mexican and Central American division of Walmart. It is the largest Walmart division outside the U.S. and the largest retailer in Latin America, operating thousands of stores across Mexico and Central America.

companies.name: Asahi Broadcasting Group Holdings
companies.description: Asahi Broadcasting Group Holdings Corporation is a certified broadcasting holding company headquartered in Osaka, Japan. In 2018, it spun off its radio and television broadcasting divisions into separate subsidiaries for radio and television.

companies.name: Nok Air
companies.description: Nok Airlines plc, trading as Nok Air, is a low-cost airline based in Thailand. It primarily operates domestic flights from Bangkok's Don Mueang International Airport.

companies.name: VBI Vaccines
companies.description: VBI Vaccines was a U.S.-based pharmaceutical company that faced bankruptcy proceedings in 2024. The company experienced operational, financial, and organizational challenges, with criticisms regarding leadership, strategic direction, and employee management.

companies.name: Genex Power
companies.description: Genex Power is an electricity generation company based in Australia.

companies.name: Kyndryl
companies.description: Kyndryl Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational corporation headquartered in New York City. It designs, builds, and manages infrastructure services and also provides business advisory services.

companies.name: UTair Aviation
companies.description: Utair is a Russian airline headquartered at Khanty-Mansiysk Airport with hubs at Surgut and Vnukovo airports. It operates domestic and some international passenger services, helicopter services, and charter flights supporting the oil and gas industry in western Siberia. It is banned from flying in the EU.

companies.name: Charoen Pokphand Foods
companies.description: Charoen Pokphand Foods Public Company Limited is an agro-industrial and food conglomerate headquartered in Thailand. It is one of the world's largest producers of feed and shrimp, and among the top three producers of poultry and pork globally. The company is part of the Charoen Pokphand Group.

companies.name: Storytel
companies.description: Storytel AB is a Swedish e-book and audiobook subscription service based in Stockholm. It operates in more than 25 countries and its English audiobook service, Audiobooks.com, is available in over 150 countries.

companies.name: CVC Brasil
companies.description: CVC CORP is a Brazilian holding company specializing in tourism. It was founded and is headquartered in Santo André, São Paulo, Brazil.

companies.name: GoTo Group
companies.description: GoTo Group is an Indonesian technology company headquartered in Jakarta. It operates Indonesia's largest digital ecosystem, offering services including ride hailing, food deliveries, logistics, and financial services.

companies.name: Chevron Lubricants Lanka
companies.description: Chevron Lubricants Lanka PLC is a Sri Lankan manufacturer, distributor, and marketer of petroleum-based lubricants. Chevron Corporation holds a controlling 51% stake in the company, which offers products under the Havoline and Delo brands.

companies.name: Warner Bros. Discovery
companies.description: Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. was an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate headquartered in New York City. It was formed in 2022 by merging Discovery, Inc. with WarnerMedia, a subsidiary of AT&T.

companies.name: Reliance Worldwide Corporation
companies.description: Reliance Worldwide Corporation is an Australian-owned publicly listed company that designs, manufactures, and supplies water flow and control products. It is the world's largest manufacturer of PTC behind-the-wall plumbing fittings and operates in multiple countries including Australia, the US, and the UK.

companies.name: iShares
companies.description: iShares is a collection of exchange-traded funds and index mutual funds managed by BlackRock. The brand was acquired from Barclays in 2009, and its first ETFs were originally called World Equity Benchmark Shares (WEBS).

companies.name: China Communications Construction Company
companies.description: China Communications Construction Company, Ltd. is a Chinese majority state-owned multinational engineering and construction company. It focuses on infrastructure projects such as highways, bridges, railways, airports, and marine ports, and has been involved in Belt and Road Initiative projects.

companies.name: China Coal Energy
companies.description: China Coal Energy Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded Chinese company involved in mining coal and processing coal products. It is listed on both the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

companies.name: China International Marine Containers
companies.description: China International Marine Containers (Group) Co., Ltd is a Chinese company that manufactures and sells transportation equipment, including containers, road transport vehicles, and airport ground-handling equipment.

companies.name: China Overseas Land and Investment Limited
companies.description: China Overseas Land and Investment Limited (COLI) is a Hong Kong-based real estate conglomerate. It is an indirect subsidiary of China State Construction Engineering Corporation Limited.

companies.name: China Resources Beer (Holdings) Company Limited
companies.description: China Resources Beer is a subsidiary of China Resources Holdings. It owns a 51% share in CR Snow, the largest brewing company in China, which is a joint venture with SAB Miller.

companies.name: Matterport
companies.description: Matterport LLC is an American 3D spatial mapping company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. Founded in 2011, it became publicly traded in 2021 and was acquired by CoStar Group in 2025.

companies.name: LiveWire
companies.description: LiveWire is an American electric motorcycle manufacturer. It was launched as an EV division of Harley Davidson in 2021 and became the first publicly traded electric motorcycle company in the US after a 2022 SPAC merger.

companies.name: Definium Therapeutics
companies.description: Definium Therapeutics, Inc., formerly MindMed, is a New York-based biotechnology company developing clinical and therapeutic applications for psychedelic and psychoplastogenic drugs.

companies.name: Morinaga & Company
companies.description: Morinaga & Company, Ltd. is a Japanese confectionery company headquartered in Tokyo, founded in 1899. Its products include candy such as Hi-Chew and other confectioneries.

companies.name: Serko
companies.description: Serko Limited is a travel management and expense technology company headquartered in New Zealand. It operates in the hotels and tourism sector.

companies.name: Singer
companies.description: Singer PLC is a Sri Lankan holding company engaged in retailing and wholesale marketing of home appliances and furniture. It also participates in financial services and manufacturing, and is listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Shenzhen Kangtai Biological Products
companies.description: Shenzhen Kangtai Biological Products, also known as BioKangtai, is a Chinese biopharmaceutical company that develops, manufactures, and markets vaccines and other vaccine products. It operates in the healthcare and pharmaceutical sector.

companies.name: Anora Group
companies.description: Anora Group Plc is a Nordic distilled beverage and wine company headquartered in Helsinki, Finland. It was formed in 2021 through the merger of Norway's Arcus Group and Finland's Altia Group, with offices in Nordic capital cities.

companies.name: Tokyo Cement
companies.description: Tokyo Cement Company (Lanka) PLC is a Sri Lankan cement manufacturer headquartered in Colombo. Founded in 1982 by entrepreneur A. Y. S. Gnanam, it produces Portland cement, Pozzolana cement, tile adhesives, and other cement products.

companies.name: Eastroc Beverage
companies.description: Eastroc Beverage (Group) Co. Ltd. is a Chinese company specializing in energy drinks, beverage products, and sports beverages. It operates within the beverage industry.

companies.name: Ola Electric
companies.description: Ola Electric Mobility Limited is an Indian electric vehicle manufacturer based in Bengaluru. Founded in 2017 by Bhavish Aggarwal, it designs and manufactures electric two-wheelers and has a manufacturing facility in Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu.

companies.name: Nippon Paper Industries
companies.description: Nippon Paper Industries Co., Ltd. is a Japanese paper manufacturing company. Its stock is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Echelon Corporation
companies.description: Echelon Corporation was an American company that designed control networks to connect machines and electronic devices for sensing, monitoring, and control. It was acquired by Adesto Technologies in 2018, which later became part of Renesas Electronics.

companies.name: Mishorim Development
companies.description: Mishorim Development Ltd. is an Israeli public company founded in 1990 and traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. It owns historic sites and buildings in various countries, including Canada and the United States.

companies.name: Darou Pakhsh
companies.description: Karkhanjat Darupakhsh Company is the largest pharmaceutical company in Iran, with 74% of its shares owned by the Social Security Investment Company (Shasta).

companies.name: 36Kr
companies.description: 36Kr is a publicly listed Chinese media company focusing on technology and financial news. It also provides data services for entrepreneurs and investors.

companies.name: CJ ENM Entertainment Division
companies.description: CJ ENM Entertainment Division is a South Korean entertainment and mass media division of CJ ENM. It was formerly known as CJ E&M and merged with CJ O Shopping in July 2018, with CJ O Shopping as the surviving entity. The company operates in the media and entertainment industry.

companies.name: Galaxia SM
companies.description: Galaxia SM is a South Korean sports marketing and management company under Trinity Asset Management and SM Entertainment. It offers services including advertising, broadcast programming, content creation, digital marketing, event management, and production. The company operates in the media and entertainment sector.

companies.name: LG CNS
companies.description: LG CNS Co., Ltd. is a South Korean technology company providing services in artificial intelligence, robotics, cloud computing, smart factories, smart logistics, system integration, and IT outsourcing. It operates in the information technology industry.

companies.name: Greenland
companies.description: Greenland is an amusement park located in Arao City, Kumamoto, Japan, and is one of the largest on the island of Kyūshū. The Greenland Resort covers 300 hectares including the amusement park, golf course, hotel, onsen, and shopping mall. It is operated by Greenland Resort Co. Ltd., part of Saibu Gas Holdings Group.

companies.name: Newegg
companies.description: Newegg Commerce, Inc. is an American online retailer headquartered in Diamond Bar, California. Founded in 2001 by Fred Chang, it specializes in computer hardware, consumer electronics, and related technology products. It is known for its focus on technology enthusiasts and PC builders.

companies.name: Sina Bank
companies.description: Sina Bank is a private Iranian bank offering retail, commercial, and investment banking services. It was established in 1985 as part of the government's privatization of the banking system. The bank operates within Iran's financial services sector.

companies.name: Industrial Alliance
companies.logo_file: Logo iA Groupe financier - Industrielle Alliance.png
companies.description: iA Financial Group is a Canadian insurance and wealth management company operating in Canada and the United States. It is one of the largest public companies in Canada. The group provides various financial services.

companies.name: Xiabu Xiabu
companies.description: Xiabu Xiabu Catering Management Co., Ltd. is a fast food hot pot restaurant chain headquartered in Daxing District, Beijing, China. It operates in the restaurant industry within China.

companies.name: China Everbright Bank
companies.description: China Everbright Bank Co., Ltd. is a Chinese joint-stock commercial bank established in August 1992 and headquartered in Beijing. It is approved by the State Council and People's Bank of China and was ranked 139th in the 2016 Forbes Global 2000. It operates in the financial services sector.

companies.name: China Reinsurance
companies.description: China Reinsurance (Group) Corporation is one of the largest reinsurance groups in China. It operates within the reinsurance industry, providing reinsurance services across the country.

companies.name: Concord New Energy
companies.description: Concord New Energy Group Limited is a renewable energy company headquartered in Singapore. It develops, owns, and operates wind power, solar energy, and energy storage projects across the Asia-Pacific and North American regions. The company is listed on the Hong Kong and Singapore stock exchanges.

companies.name: KGI Financial Holding
companies.description: KGI Financial Holding Co., Ltd. is a financial holding corporation based in Taiwan.
