Founded by Jeffrey Koo Sr. and the Koo Family, it operates key subsidiaries including CDIB Capital Group, KGI Securities, KGI Bank, and KGI Life. The company is currently chaired by Angelo Koo.

companies.name: ZTO Express
companies.description: ZTO Express is a logistics company headquartered in Shanghai, China. It is one of the largest courier services in China and is dual listed on the New York Stock Exchange and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Sumitomo Pharma
companies.description: Sumitomo Pharma Company Limited is a Japanese multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Osaka. It focuses on areas including oncology, psychiatry, neurology, women's health, and urological diseases.

companies.name: King's Town Bank
companies.description: King's Town Bank is a Taiwanese commercial bank established in 1948. It was previously known as the Tainan Small and Medium Business Bank.

companies.name: Pagaya technologies
companies.description: Pagaya Technologies is an Israeli-American financial technology company based in New York City. It uses artificial intelligence to evaluate loan applications and has been listed on the New York Stock Exchange since 2022.

companies.name: Tri Counties Bank
companies.logo_file: Tri Counties Bank logo (California's local bank).svg
companies.description: Tri Counties Bank is a financial institution headquartered in Chico, California. It is a subsidiary of TriCo Bancshares and was founded in 1975 to serve three counties in California.

companies.name: China Everbright Environment
companies.description: China Everbright International Limited is a Hong Kong incorporated company specializing in environmental resource management in mainland China.

companies.name: Chubb Corp.
companies.description: Chubb Limited is an American–Swiss insurance company incorporated in Zürich. It is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and is a component of the S&P 500.

companies.name: Lukfook Jewellery
companies.description: Luk Fook Holdings (International) Limited is a company engaged in sourcing, designing, wholesaling, trademark licensing, and retailing gold, platinum, and gem-set jewellery. It is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and has expanded into the mid to high-end watch market.

companies.name: 4iG
companies.description: 4iG is a Budapest-based IT company listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange. The name 4iG stands for International, Innovative, IT, and Investment Group. Its predecessor was FreeSoft, an IT-focused company founded in 1990.

companies.name: Trump Media & Technology Group
companies.description: Trump Media & Technology Group Corp. is an American media and technology company headquartered in Sarasota, Florida. It operates the Truth Social social-media platform and is majority-owned by the Donald J. Trump Revocable Trust.

companies.name: Goldwind
companies.description: Goldwind Science & Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese multinational wind turbine manufacturer headquartered in Beijing. It was formerly a state-owned enterprise with major shareholders including state-controlled corporations. Its founder, Wu Gang, held a seat in the 12th National People's Congress.

companies.name: Bajaj Auto
companies.description: Bajaj Auto Limited is an Indian multinational automotive manufacturer based in Pune. It produces motorcycles, scooters, and auto rickshaws and is part of the Bajaj Group. The company was founded by Jamnalal Bajaj in Rajasthan in the 1940s.

companies.name: Chubu Electric Power
companies.description: Chubu Electric Power Co., Inc., known as Chuden, is a Japanese electric utilities provider serving the middle Chūbu region of Honshu island. It ranks third among Japan's largest electric utilities by power generation capacity and has expanded into optical fibers and telecommunications.

companies.name: Ciena
companies.description: Ciena Corporation is an American optical networking systems and software company based in Hanover, Maryland. It reported revenues of $4.8 billion and employed over 9,000 people as of November 2025. Gary Smith has been CEO since 2003.

companies.name: Central Finance Company
companies.description: Central Finance Company PLC is one of Sri Lanka's oldest non-bank financial institutions, founded in 1957. It is listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange since 1969 and was ranked the 28th most valuable brand in Sri Lanka in 2021.

companies.name: Cathay Financial Holding
companies.description: Cathay United Bank is one of the largest commercial banks in Taiwan with over 165 branches. It is part of Cathay Financial Holdings and has a capital value of TW$67 billion.

companies.name: Dipped Products
companies.description: Dipped Products PLC is a Sri Lankan rubber glove manufacturer that also manages rubber and tea plantations. Incorporated in 1976 and listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange since 1983, it is controlled by the Hayleys conglomerate and is part of the S&P Sri Lanka 20 Index.

companies.name: Softstar Entertainment
companies.description: Softstar Entertainment Inc. is a Taiwanese video game developer and publisher based in Zhonghe District, New Taipei. It has subsidiary branches in Beijing, Shanghai, and Xiamen. The company is known for its involvement in the video game industry.

companies.name: Archer Aviation
companies.description: Archer Aviation Inc. is an aerospace and defense technology company headquartered in San Jose, California. It develops eVTOL aircraft intended for urban air taxi and defense operations. The company operates in the aviation sector.

companies.name: Bank of Tianjin
companies.description: Bank of Tianjin is a city commercial bank headquartered in Tianjin, China. It is regulated by the People's Bank of China. The bank operates in the financial services industry.

companies.name: Ten Fu Group
companies.description: Tenfu Tea, or Ten Fu, is a China-based company specializing in tea and tea food products. It operates within the consumer goods sector focused on tea products.

companies.name: Hesai Technology
companies.description: Hesai Technology is a publicly listed Chinese company that develops and sells lidar products such as sensors. Its products are mainly used in ADAS, vehicular automation, robotics, and industrial sectors.

companies.name: Banco Santander-Chile
companies.description: Banco Santander-Chile is the largest bank in Chile by loans and deposits with a network of 504 branches. It is a subsidiary of the Santander Group and competes with Banco de Chile, Itaú Corpbanca, and BCI.

companies.name: Jiangsu Expressway Company
companies.description: Jiangsu Expressway Company Limited is a Chinese enterprise engaged in investment, construction, operation, and management of toll expressways in Jiangsu Province. Its projects include major expressways and the Jiangyin Yangtze River Bridge.

companies.name: UserJoy Technology
companies.description: UserJoy Technology Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese video game development and publishing company founded in 1995 in Taipei. It publishes video games worldwide.

companies.name: Fairchild Semiconductor
companies.description: Fairchild Semiconductor International, Inc. was an American semiconductor company based in San Jose, California. Founded in 1957 by the "traitorous eight," it pioneered transistor and integrated circuit manufacturing before being acquired by ON Semiconductor in 2016.

companies.name: Foxtron
companies.description: Foxtron Inc., or Foxtron Vehicle Technologies, is a Taiwanese manufacturer of electric cars and buses based in Taipei. Operating since 2020, it is a joint venture between Foxconn and Yulon.

companies.name: Resolute Mining
companies.description: Resolute Mining Limited is an Australian mining corporation focused on gold mining operations in Africa. It operates two gold mines: the Syama Gold Mine in Mali and the Mako Gold Mine in Senegal.

companies.name: Vulcan Energy Resources
companies.description: Vulcan Energy Resources is an Australian company specializing in lithium and renewable energy production. It focuses on producing lithium with a net-zero carbon footprint.

companies.name: Westgold Resources Limited
companies.description: Westgold Resources is a gold producer and explorer based in Perth, Western Australia. The company was founded in 1987 and operates in the gold mining sector.

companies.name: Franchise Group
companies.description: Franchise Group, Inc. is an American privately held holding company that acquires and manages franchise companies. Before its 2024 bankruptcy, it owned several retail brands including American Freight and The Vitamin Shoppe.

companies.name: Himalayan Bank Limited
companies.description: Himalayan Bank Limited is one of the largest private banks in Nepal, incorporated in 1992. It is the first commercial bank in Nepal with most shares held by the private sector and has its head office in Kathmandu.

companies.name: Electrolux Professional
companies.description: Electrolux Professional AB is a Swedish multinational professional appliance manufacturer headquartered in Stockholm. It was spun off from Electrolux in March 2020 and focuses on products for professional use.

companies.name: Adani Wilmar
companies.description: AWL Agri Business, formerly Adani Wilmar, is an Indian multinational food and beverage conglomerate based in Ahmedabad. Founded in 1999 as a joint venture, it is India's largest processor of edible oils with operations across India and exports globally.

companies.name: Doosan Robotics
companies.description: Doosan Robotics is a South Korean robotics company founded in 2015. It mainly manufactures collaborative robots (cobots) and ranked fifth globally in market share as of 2022.

companies.name: Elitegroup Computer Systems
companies.description: Elitegroup Computer Systems Co., Ltd. is a Taiwan-based electronics firm and the fifth largest PC motherboard manufacturer worldwide. It produced 24 million units in 2002.

companies.name: Zojirushi Corporation
companies.description: Zojirushi Corporation is a Japanese multinational manufacturer of vacuum flasks, beverage dispensers, and consumer electronics like rice cookers and electric kettles. It has branches and subsidiaries across Asia and the US and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Kader
companies.description: Kader Industrial Company Limited was founded in Hong Kong in 1948 and is currently known as Kader Holdings Company Limited. It was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 1985. The company operates in the industrial and chemical sector.

companies.name: Cordiant Digital Infrastructure
companies.description: Cordiant Digital Infrastructure Limited is a British investment trust focused on infrastructure investments related to the digital economy. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index. The company is based in Guernsey.

companies.name: Coty
companies.description: Coty Inc. is a multinational beauty company founded in Paris in 1904 and incorporated in Delaware, United States. Its global headquarters are in Amsterdam, Netherlands. Coty develops, manufactures, markets, and distributes a wide range of beauty products and owns around 40 brands as of 2024.

companies.name: Coca-Cola HBC
companies.description: Coca-Cola HBC AG is the world's third-largest Coca-Cola anchor bottler by volume. The company is primarily listed on the London Stock Exchange and also on the Athens Stock Exchange. It is a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index and is based in Switzerland.

companies.name: GF Securities Company Limited
companies.description: GF Securities is a Chinese securities firm founded in 1991 and headquartered in Guangzhou. It provides large-scale comprehensive securities broking and trading services. By mid-2020, it was among China's four largest securities firms.

companies.name: CIC Holdings
companies.description: CIC Holdings PLC is a Sri Lankan conglomerate engaged in merchandising and manufacturing chemical products. Incorporated and listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange in 1964, it was formerly part of Imperial Chemical Industries and known as Chemical Industries (Colombo) PLC before 2011.

companies.name: Oklo
companies.description: Oklo Inc. is a publicly traded American nuclear power company based in Santa Clara, California. It develops a small modular nuclear reactor called the Aurora Powerhouse and plans to sell electricity and radioisotopes produced by these reactors. The company's name is derived from a region in Gabon, Africa.

companies.name: Coherent, Inc.
companies.description: Coherent, Inc. is an American company headquartered in Santa Clara, California that develops and manufactures laser equipment and specialty components. Founded in 1966, it went public in 1970 and expanded through acquisitions. In 2022, it was acquired by II-VI Incorporated and renamed Coherent Corp.

companies.name: Fosun Pharmaceutical
companies.description: Shanghai Fosun Pharmaceutical (Group) Co., Ltd. is a Chinese pharmaceutical company mostly owned by Fosun International. It operates in the healthcare and pharmaceutical sector.

companies.name: Glorious Property Holdings
companies.description: Glorious Property Holdings Limited is a Shanghai-based property developer established in 1996. It holds a land bank of 13.6 square kilometers in major Chinese cities including Shanghai, Beijing, and Tianjin.

companies.name: Value Partners
companies.description: Value Partners Group Limited is an asset management company based in Hong Kong. It operates in the financial sector, focusing on managing investment assets for clients.

companies.name: ONEOK
companies.description: Oneok, Inc. is an American oil and gas midstream operator headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma. It provides gathering, processing, fractionation, transportation, and storage services to the oil and gas industry. The company was founded in 1906 as Oklahoma Natural Gas Company and renamed Oneok in 1980.

companies.name: Silicon Motion
companies.description: Silicon Motion Technology Corporation is an American-Taiwanese company that develops NAND flash controller integrated circuits for solid-state storage devices. Its controllers are used in commercial, enterprise, and industrial applications including SSDs, eMMCs, memory cards, and USB flash drives. The company claims to have supplied more NAND flash controllers than any other company from 2006 to 2016.

companies.name: Block, Inc.
companies.description: Block, Inc. is an American technology company and financial services provider for consumers and merchants. Founded in 2009 by Jack Dorsey, it is the U.S. market leader in point-of-sale systems.

companies.name: Damai Entertainment
companies.description: Damai Entertainment Holdings Limited is a Chinese film company under Alibaba Group. Formerly known as ChinaVision Media and later Alibaba Pictures Group, it was renamed Damai Entertainment Holdings in June 2025. By 2015, it was the largest Chinese film company by market value.

companies.name: New World Department Store China Limited
companies.description: New World Department Store China Limited is a Hong Kong–based holding company for department store chains in Mainland China. It operates stores under the brands "New World" and Ba-li Chun-tian and is a subsidiary of New World Development. The chairman is Henry Cheng, son of billionaire Cheng Yu-tung.

companies.name: New China Life Insurance Co., Ltd.
companies.description: New China Life Insurance Co., Ltd. is a Chinese life insurance company based in Beijing. The Chinese government owns more than half of its shares through sovereign fund Central Huijin and state-owned enterprises Baosteel Group and China Securities Finance.

companies.name: Nippon Television Holdings
companies.description: Nippon Television Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese media and broadcasting holding company headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It includes Nippon Television, Japan's first commercial broadcaster, and owns shares in animation and film studios. The company is partially controlled by The Yomiuri Shimbun Holdings, Japan's largest media conglomerate.

companies.name: China Lumena New Materials Corp.
companies.description: China Lumena New Materials is a Chinese mining and manufacturing company specializing in the production of polyphenylene sulfide (PPS), an industrial plastic. It is among the largest producers of PPS according to a 2016 market research report.

companies.name: United Wholesale Mortgage
companies.description: United Wholesale Mortgage (UWM) is an American wholesale mortgage lender headquartered in Pontiac, Michigan. Formerly United Shore Financial Services, it underwrites loans for independent brokers and is the largest mortgage lender in the United States as of 2024.

companies.name: Dhani
companies.description: Dhani is an Indian software company that provides digital financial and healthcare services through its app. It operates in the technology sector, combining software solutions with healthcare and finance.

companies.name: Myer
companies.description: Myer is an Australian department store chain operating across all Australian states and one self-governing territory. It offers a wide range of products including clothing, footwear, cosmetics, homewares, and food.

companies.name: Dongfeng Motor Group Company Limited
companies.description: Dongfeng Motor Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese holding company based in Wuhan, Hubei. It is involved in the automotive industry and has H shares listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange.

companies.name: DigitalBridge
companies.description: DigitalBridge Group, Inc. is a global digital infrastructure investment firm headquartered in Boca Raton, USA. It owns and operates assets like cell towers, data centers, and fiber networks, with offices worldwide.

companies.name: Cettire
companies.description: Cettire is an Australian-owned online luxury fashion retail platform. It sells clothing, shoes, and accessories from over 1300 international high-end fashion brands.

companies.name: Youngor Group
companies.description: Youngor Group Company Limited is a public textiles and clothing company based in Ningbo, Zhejiang, China. It designs, manufactures, and sells men's clothing under the Youngor brand and was established in 1993.

companies.name: SBI Holdings
companies.description: SBI Holdings, Inc. is a financial services holdings corporation based in Tokyo, Japan. It is the primary holding company of the SBI Group, one of Japan's largest financial services conglomerates with over 635 subsidiaries.

companies.name: Comcast
companies.description: Comcast Corporation is an American multinational conglomerate in mass media, telecommunications, and entertainment. Its headquarters are in Philadelphia and New York City, and it is a leading telecommunications and pay-TV company in the US.

companies.name: Cerence Inc.
companies.description: Cerence Inc. is an American multinational software company specializing in artificial intelligence assistant technology for automobiles. It operates primarily in the automotive industry sector.

companies.name: Asana Inc.
companies.description: Asana, Inc. is an American software company based in San Francisco, California. It offers a web and mobile work management platform designed to help teams organize and manage their work, founded in 2008.

companies.name: Comerica
companies.description: Comerica Incorporated was an American financial services company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It was the parent company of Comerica Bank, a regional commercial bank with branches in Texas, Michigan, California, Florida, and Arizona. Comerica was one of the largest U.S. financial holding companies before being acquired by Fifth Third Bank in 2026.

companies.name: Comgás
companies.description: Companhia de Gás de São Paulo - Comgás is a Brazilian gas distributor focused on São Paulo state. It is Brazil's largest gas distributor, operating about 14,000 kilometers of pipelines supplying over 1.7 million consumers in 88 cities. Comgás sells gas under a 30-year franchise with potential extension.

companies.name: Industrie De Nora
companies.description: Industrie De Nora S.p.A. is an Italian multinational company based in Milan operating in the electrochemical industry. It is the world's leading supplier of electrodes for major industrial electrochemical processes.

companies.name: Dusit International
companies.description: Dusit Thani Public Company Limited, branded as Dusit International, is a Thai multinational hospitality company headquartered in Bangkok. It operates 57 hotels and resorts and approximately 240 villas across 18 countries. The company was founded in 1948 by Thanpuying Chanut Piyaoui.

companies.name: Hung Fook Tong
companies.description: Hung Fook Tong is a Hong Kong-based chain of herbal tea shops specializing in Chinese herb teas, soups, healthy food, and guilinggao. Founded in 1986, it held a 37.5% market share in Hong Kong's wellness drink market in 2015. The company has been publicly traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 2014.

companies.name: Yantian International Container Terminals
companies.description: Yantian International Container Terminal is a deep water port located in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China. It specializes in handling containers from feeder vessels to very large container ships.

companies.name: Persimmon plc
companies.description: Persimmon plc is a British housebuilding company headquartered in York, England. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: ABC-Mart
companies.description: ABC-Mart, Inc. is a Japanese footwear company with stores in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, and the Philippines.

companies.name: BEC World
companies.description: BEC World Public Company Limited is a Thai media conglomerate best known for operating television Channel 3. Founded in 1990 and listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand in 1995, it expanded its content businesses including Global Content Licensing, BEC Studio, and BEC Music.

companies.name: GMO Internet Group
companies.description: GMO Internet Group, Inc. is a Japanese Internet company headquartered in Cerulean Tower, Shibuya, Tokyo. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and serves as the holding company of GMO Internet Group. Its founder, Masatoshi Kumagai, is among Japan's wealthiest individuals.

companies.name: Companhia Energética de São Paulo
companies.description: Companhia Energética de São Paulo (CESP) is the largest electricity producer in São Paulo state and the third largest in Brazil. It owns and operates six hydroelectric plants connected to the National Interconnected System. The company is based in Brazil.

companies.name: Companhia Energética de Minas Gerais
companies.logo_file: Companhia Energética de Minas Gerais logo.svg
companies.description: Companhia Energética de Minas Gerais S.A. is a Brazilian power company headquartered in Belo Horizonte. It operates in generation, transmission, distribution, and commercialization of electric energy, as well as natural gas distribution. It is one of the main electricity concessionaires in Brazil.

companies.name: CPFL Energia
companies.description: CPFL Energia is the second largest non-state-owned electric energy generation and distribution group in Brazil. Headquartered in Campinas, São Paulo, it comprises several holding companies and was acquired by the State Grid Corporation of China in 2017.

companies.name: Coway Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Coway Co., Ltd. is a South Korean manufacturer of household appliances including water purifiers, air purifiers, bidets, water softeners, and mattresses. Founded and headquartered in Seoul, it is the largest company in its product categories in South Korea and has subsidiaries worldwide.

companies.name: Martifer
companies.description: Martifer SGPS, S.A. is a family group based in Oliveira de Frades, Portugal. It focuses on metal construction and renewable energy sectors and employs over 3,000 people.

companies.name: Computer Sciences Corporation
companies.description: Computer Sciences Corporation (CSC) was an American multinational IT and professional services company founded in Los Angeles in 1959. It became the largest software company in the US within four years and was the largest non-manufacturing IT services provider worldwide by 2009.

companies.name: J. Front Retailing
companies.description: J. Front Retailing Co., Ltd. is a major holding company in Japan. It is headquartered in Yaesu, Chūō, Tokyo.

companies.name: Juki
companies.description: Juki Corporation is a Japanese multinational manufacturer of industrial and domestic sewing machines and SMT assembly equipment. Headquartered in Tama-shi, Tokyo, it was once the largest industrial sewing machine manufacturer globally.

companies.name: Compuware
companies.description: Compuware was an American software company based in Detroit. It developed enterprise software mainly for mainframe computing and provided related services such as software testing, development, and performance management.

companies.name: Lixil
companies.description: Lixil Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of building materials and housing equipment. The company is headquartered in Shinagawa, Tokyo.

companies.name: MonotaRO
companies.description: MonotaRO Co., Ltd. is a Japanese e-commerce company specializing in industrial supply products. It is based in Osaka, Japan. The company was recognized on Forbes Asia's "Best Under A Billion" list in 2013.

companies.name: Conagra Brands, Inc.
companies.description: Conagra Brands, Inc. is an American consumer packaged goods holding company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It produces and sells products under various brand names available in supermarkets, restaurants, and food service establishments. The company was founded in Nebraska in 1919 and was originally called Nebraska Consolidated Mills.

companies.name: Concha y Toro
companies.description: Concha y Toro is the largest producer and exporter of wines from Latin America and one of the ten largest wine companies globally. The winery is located in Santiago de Chile and has vineyards in Chile, Argentina, and the United States. It is known for internationally recognized wines such as Casillero del Diablo and Don Melchor.

companies.name: SCSK Corporation
companies.description: SCSK Corporation is a Japanese information technology company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It offers IT services and computer software.

companies.name: Sunshine Holdings PLC
companies.description: Sunshine Holdings PLC is a Sri Lankan conglomerate holding company engaged in healthcare, consumer goods, and agribusiness sectors. It was incorporated in 1973 and listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange in 1983. The company ranked 45th in the LMD 100 list of Sri Lankan quoted companies by revenue in 2020/21.

companies.name: AST SpaceMobile
companies.description: AST SpaceMobile, Inc. is a publicly traded satellite designer and manufacturer based in Midland, Texas, United States. The company is developing the SpaceMobile satellite constellation, a space-based cellular broadband network designed to connect directly to standard smartphones. The network aims to provide 4G and 5G coverage globally, especially in remote and underserved areas.

companies.name: Etron Technology, Inc.
companies.description: Etron Technology, Inc. is a Taiwanese electronics company that produces dynamic RAM and systems-on-a-chip.

companies.name: Constellation Brands
companies.description: Constellation Brands, Inc. is an American producer and marketer of beer, wine, and spirits headquartered in Rochester, New York. It is the largest beer import company in the US by sales and holds the third-largest market share among major beer suppliers. The company also has investments in medical and recreational cannabis through Canopy Growth.

companies.name: Haleon
companies.description: Haleon plc is a British multinational consumer healthcare company headquartered in Weybridge, England. It is one of the largest consumer healthcare businesses worldwide, with brands including Sensodyne, Panadol, Advil, and Centrum. The company was projected to hold a 7.3% market share in over-the-counter medicines in 2022.

companies.name: Hyundai Elevator
companies.description: Hyundai Elevator Co., Ltd. is a South Korean company manufacturing elevators, escalators, moving walkways, and parking systems. It is a subsidiary of Hyundai Group based in Chungju, South Korea. The company has six overseas subsidiaries and agents in 49 countries.

companies.name: Impress
companies.description: Impress Holding, Inc. is a Japanese publishing and digital media company known for operating the IT news website Impress Watch. It publishes books, articles, and magazines related to the tech industry and the internet. The company is recognized as a pioneer in publishing internet-related books.

companies.name: S&B Foods
companies.description: S&B Foods Inc. is a Japanese company that manufactures, processes, and distributes foodstuffs, spices, condiments, and instant curries. It also makes and sells cooked food. The company's logo represents the words "Spice" and "Herb."

companies.name: EDION
companies.description: EDION Corporation is a consumer electronics retailer chain based in Japan. It was formerly a holding company operating multiple chain brands. As of 2023, it ranks as the fifth largest electronics and home appliance retailer in Japan.

companies.name: Tupperware
companies.description: Tupperware is an American company that manufactures and distributes kitchen and home preparation, storage, and serving containers internationally. It was founded in 1942 by Earl Tupper, who introduced the first bell-shaped container to the public in 1946.

companies.name: A&D Company
companies.description: A&D Company, Limited is a Japanese company. Further details about its operations or industry are not provided in the summary.

companies.name: Kakaku.com, Inc.
companies.description: Kakaku.com, Inc. is a Japanese company that operates Kakaku.com, also known as Price.com, a comparison shopping website, along with other services.

companies.name: Convergys
companies.description: Convergys Corporation was a Cincinnati, Ohio-based company that sold customer management and information management products to large corporations. Its products served various markets including communications, financial services, technology, retail, healthcare, and government. It employed approximately 130,000 people across 33 countries.

companies.name: Kaneka Corporation
companies.description: Kaneka Corporation is a Japanese international chemical manufacturing company headquartered in Osaka. Founded in 1949, it produces chemical products such as functional resin, foam resin, and synthetic fibers.

companies.name: Kayaba
companies.description: KYB Corporation is a Tokyo-based Japanese automotive company. Further details about its products or services are not provided in the summary.

companies.name: Kewpie Corporation
companies.description: Kewpie Corporation is a Japanese company known for producing Kewpie mayonnaise, a brand with a unique flavor attributed to its use of egg yolks instead of whole eggs. The mayonnaise is associated with the tamago sando, an egg salad sandwich sold in 7-Eleven Japan convenience stores.

companies.name: The Cooper Companies
companies.description: The Cooper Companies, Inc., branded as CooperCompanies, is a global medical device company headquartered in San Ramon, California. It has two business units: CooperVision, which manufactures contact lenses, and CooperSurgical, which produces medical devices and fertility and genomic products for women's healthcare.

companies.name: Cooper Tire & Rubber Company
companies.description: Cooper Tire & Rubber Company is an American company headquartered in Findlay, Ohio, specializing in the design, manufacture, marketing, and sales of replacement automobile and truck tires. It has subsidiaries focusing on medium truck, motorcycle, and racing tires and operates 60 facilities worldwide.

companies.name: Krakatau Steel
companies.description: PT Krakatau Steel (Persero) Tbk is the largest steel maker in Indonesia, headquartered in Cilegon, Banten. Its factory is located on a 280-hectare plot near the Sunda Strait, close to the Krakatoa volcano and island, from which the company takes its name.

companies.name: Gunze
companies.description: Gunze Limited is a Japanese clothing brand with its registered head office in Ayabe, Kyoto Prefecture, and additional offices in Osaka and Tokyo. Established in 1896 by Tsurukichi Hatano, it was originally known as Gunze Silk Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

companies.name: Sparklight
companies.description: Cable One, Inc., operating under the Sparklight brand, is an American broadband communications provider headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona. It offers cable television, internet, and phone services across 24 U.S. states to 1.1 million customers and owns the Fidelity Communications brand serving five states.

companies.name: CyberAgent
companies.description: CyberAgent Inc. is a Japanese entertainment conglomerate founded in 1998 by Susumu Fujita and headquartered in Shibuya, Tokyo. Fujita owns 20.50% of the company and serves as its representative director, with Yusuke Hidaka as executive vice president.

companies.name: Service Corporation International
companies.description: Service Corporation International is an American provider of funeral goods and services, cemetery property, and cremation services. Headquartered in Neartown, Houston, Texas, it operates over 1500 funeral homes and 400 cemeteries, with secondary offices in Jefferson, Louisiana.

companies.name: THine Electronics
companies.description: THine Electronics Incorporated is a Japanese fabless LSI manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo, with subsidiaries in Seoul and Taipei. It provides mixed signal LSIs and analog technologies, including high-speed interfaces and power management products used in smartphones, tablets, TVs, monitors, and automotive markets.

companies.name: Companhia Paranaense de Energia
companies.description: Companhia Paranaense de Energia (COPEL) is a Brazilian electric utility company and the largest in the State of Paraná. Founded in 1954, its ownership control is held by the State of Paraná.

companies.name: OGK-2
companies.description: OGK-2 is a Russian power generation company with a majority of its stock owned by Gazprom.

companies.name: Lion Corporation
companies.description: Lion Corporation is a Japanese multinational company that manufactures detergent, soap, medications, oral hygiene products, and other toiletries. It also has a chemical engineering research division focused on developing new products. The company is based in Japan.

companies.name: Copperbelt Energy Corporation
companies.description: Copperbelt Energy Corporation Plc is a Zambian company involved in electricity generation, transmission, distribution, and supply. It operates in Zambia and Nigeria and is listed on the Lusaka Stock Exchange. The company is based in Zambia.

companies.name: Tech Mahindra India
companies.description: Tech Mahindra is an Indian multinational information technology services and consulting company. Founded in 1986 as a joint venture between Mahindra & Mahindra and BT Group, it is part of the Mahindra Group and headquartered in Pune, India.

companies.name: Sailor Pen
companies.description: The Sailor Pen Company is a Japanese pen manufacturer based in Kure, Hiroshima. It is known for producing the first fountain pen in Japan with a gold nib and the first Japanese ballpoint pens.

companies.name: Zeria Pharmaceutical
companies.description: Zeria Shinyaku Kōgyō KK is a Japanese drug manufacturer that acquired Tillotts Pharma AG. The company operates in the pharmaceutical sector and is based in Japan.

companies.name: Daicel
companies.description: Daicel Corporation is a Japanese chemical company operating in celluloid technologies, organic chemicals, high-performance chemicals, polymers, and pyrotechnic devices. Its products include cellulose acetate, cigarette filter tow, engineering plastics, and automotive airbag inflators.

companies.name: Dynic Corporation
companies.description: Dynic Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of print media supplies, publishing products, stationery, non-woven fabrics, embossed products, foils, films, and paper products. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and based in Japan.

companies.name: Tein
companies.description: TEIN, INC. is a Japanese company specializing in suspension manufacturing and sales for passenger cars and motorsports cars. It is headquartered in Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan.

companies.name: TV Tokyo Holdings
companies.description: The TV Tokyo Holdings Corporation is a Japanese media holding company headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It includes TV Tokyo Corporation, TV Tokyo Communications, and BS TV Tokyo, operating broadcasting and internet streaming services. The company was formed in 2010 and is partially controlled by Nikkei, Inc.

companies.name: Persol Holdings Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Persol Holdings is a Japanese human resource management company providing labor hire services to clients. The company operates in Japan and focuses on employment services.

companies.name: DeNA
companies.description: DeNA Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company headquartered in Shibuya, Tokyo, that provides mobile portal and e-commerce websites. It owns the Mobage cell phone platform and operates other services including the e-commerce website DeNA Shopping.

companies.name: PVH Corp.
companies.description: PVH Corp., formerly Phillips-Van Heusen Corporation, is an American clothing company that owns brands such as Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein. It also licenses brands including Kenneth Cole New York and Michael Kors.

companies.name: Nabtesco
companies.description: Nabtesco is a Japanese engineering company specializing in gearboxes, rotors, motors, and robotics. It operates in the industrial engineering sector.

companies.name: Narumiya International
companies.description: Narumiya International is a Japanese company headquartered in Minato Ward, Tokyo, that manufactures and distributes textiles. It specializes in children's clothing.

companies.name: Nipro
companies.description: Nipro Corporation is a Japanese medical equipment manufacturing company founded in 1954 and headquartered in Osaka. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and the Osaka Securities Exchange.

companies.name: NetDragon Websoft
companies.description: NetDragon Websoft is a Chinese company that develops and operates massively multiplayer online games and creates mobile applications. The company launched its first product in 2002.

companies.name: HI-LEX
companies.description: HI-LEX Corporation is a Japanese company specializing in manufacturing and selling remote-controlling mechanical cables and accessories for vehicles, machinery, appliances, medical equipment, and marine vessels.

companies.name: Papyless
companies.description: Papyless Co. Ltd., formerly Fuji Online Systems, is a Japanese e-book distribution company established in 1995. It is the parent company of Renta!, a digital manga online rental service.

companies.name: Fancl Corporation
companies.description: FANCL Corporation is a Japanese cosmetics and dietary supplements company incorporated in 1981. It operates in the beauty and health sector.

companies.name: Fairfield Enterprises
companies.description: Fairfield Enterprises was a British machine distributor and supplier of tooling and support services to the printing and packaging industries. It was taken over in 2000 by Swiss company Bobst AG.

companies.name: Furyu Corporation
companies.description: FuRyu Corporation is a Japanese entertainment company based in Shibuya, Tokyo. It operates in publishing and development of video games, mobile games, photo-booths, figures, and multimedia content. The company is involved in various entertainment sectors within Japan.

companies.name: Otis Worldwide Corporation
companies.description: Otis Worldwide Corporation is an American company that develops, manufactures, and markets elevators, escalators, moving walkways, and related equipment. It is known by its former legal name Otis Elevator Company and styled as OTIS. The company operates in the United States.

companies.name: Mandom
companies.logo_file: 株式会社マンダム ロゴ.svg
companies.description: Mandom Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer and distributor of hair care, skin care, perfumes, and deodorants. Founded in 1927 as Kintsuru Perfume Corporation, it changed its name to Tancho Corporation in 1959 and to Mandom Corporation in 1971. The company operates in the consumer goods sector in Japan.

companies.name: Miroku Corp.
companies.description: Miroku Corporation is a Japanese firearms manufacturer located in Nankoku, Kōchi Prefecture. It produces shotguns for Browning Arms Company and rifles licensed by Winchester Firearms, sold under both Miroku and Browning brand names in European markets. The company operates in the arms industry.

companies.name: Yutaka Giken
companies.description: Yutaka Giken Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational automotive components manufacturer headquartered in Hamamatsu, Shizuoka. It specializes in torque converters, catalytic converters, exhaust systems, and brake systems, with multiple facilities in Japan and overseas. The company operates in the automotive industry.

companies.name: CoreCivic
companies.description: CoreCivic, Inc. is an American private prison operator and one of the largest for-profit prison, jail, and detention contractors in the United States. It operates 82 state and federal correctional and detention facilities and has been subject to investigations and lawsuits related to civil rights violations.

companies.name: Corus Entertainment
companies.description: Corus Entertainment Holdings Inc. is a Canadian mass media, television production, and distribution company headquartered at Corus Quay in Toronto, Ontario. Founded in 1987 as Shaw Radio Ltd., it was spun off from Shaw Communications in 1999 and holds assets in radio, publishing, and television industries.

companies.name: Sansei Technologies
companies.description: Sansei Technologies, Inc. is a Japanese manufacturing firm based in Osaka. The company specializes in manufacturing amusement rides, stage equipment, and elevators. It operates within the industrial manufacturing sector in Japan.

companies.name: Intertek
companies.description: Intertek Group plc is a British multinational company headquartered in London, England. It provides assurance, inspection, product testing, and certification services. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: United Aircraft Corporation
companies.description: PJSC United Aircraft Corporation is a Russian aerospace and defense corporation headquartered in Moscow. It consolidates Russian private and state-owned aircraft manufacturing companies engaged in the manufacture, design, and sale of military, civilian, transport, and unmanned aircraft. The Russian government holds a majority stake.

companies.name: Sanrio
companies.description: Sanrio Company, Ltd. is a Japanese entertainment company that designs, licenses, and manufactures products focused on the kawaii segment of Japanese popular culture. It sells stationery, school supplies, gifts, and accessories worldwide, including specialty brand retail stores in Japan. Sanrio's best-known character is Hello Kitty, a globally successful marketing brand.

companies.name: Nuance Communications
companies.description: Nuance Communications, Inc. was an American multinational computer software technology corporation headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts. It marketed speech recognition and artificial intelligence software.

companies.name: Gala
companies.description: Gala Inc. is a holding company based in Tokyo, Japan, administering the GALA Group, which includes subsidiaries focused on MMORPG games, web design, and data mining. The group develops multiplayer online role-playing games and has companies in the United States, Japan, and South Korea.

companies.name: JEOL
companies.description: JEOL, Ltd. is a major developer and manufacturer based in Japan, producing electron microscopes, scientific instruments, industrial equipment, and medical equipment.

companies.name: Frontier Airlines
companies.description: Frontier Airlines, Inc. is an American ultra-low-cost airline headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It operates flights to over 120 destinations across the United States, the Caribbean, Mexico, and Central America, with operating bases in 13 cities including Puerto Rico.

companies.name: Riverbed Technology
companies.description: Riverbed Technology LLC is an American information technology company offering software and hardware products focused on Unified Observability, Network Visibility, End User Experience Management, network and application performance monitoring, and wide area networks including SD-WAN and WAN optimization.

companies.name: Hokuetsu Kishu Paper
companies.description: Hokuetsu Corporation is a Japanese paper milling company established in 1907.

companies.name: Crnogorski Telekom
companies.description: Crnogorski Telekom is a Montenegrin telecommunications operator based in Podgorica. It is the largest telecommunications company in Montenegro, providing fixed-line, mobile, IPTV, internet, ICT, and cloud services.

companies.name: Robinsons Retail
companies.description: Robinsons Retail Holdings, Inc. is one of the largest multi-format retailers in the Philippines.

companies.name: Swire Group
companies.description: Swire Group is a global conglomerate with its parent company John Swire & Sons Limited holding controlling stakes in businesses across the UK, USA, Australia, Papua New Guinea, East and West Africa, and Southeast Asia. Its businesses include property, aviation, beverages and food chain, marine services, and trading and industrial sectors.

companies.name: Taiyo Yuden
companies.description: Taiyo Yuden Co., Ltd. is a Japanese materials and electronics company headquartered in Kyobashi, Tokyo. Founded in 1950, it helped pioneer recordable CD technology (CD-R) along with Sony and Philips in 1988. The company operates factories across several Asian countries including Japan, Singapore, and China.

companies.name: Haier
companies.description: Haier Group Corporation is a Chinese multinational company headquartered in Qingdao, Shandong, specializing in home appliances and consumer electronics. It owns 35% of Haier Smart Home Company, which designs and sells various home appliances under multiple brand names. Haier Electronics Group manufactures consumer electronics including mobile phones and televisions.

companies.name: SCREEN Holdings
companies.description: SCREEN Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japanese semiconductor and electronics company headquartered in Kyoto. It manufactures and sells equipment used in the production of semiconductors, flat panel displays, storage media, and precision technology manufacturing equipment.

companies.name: Daito Trust Construction
companies.description: The Daito Trust Construction Company, Ltd. is a Japanese construction and real estate company based in Minato-ku, Tokyo. It is listed on the Tokyo and Nagoya Stock Exchanges and is part of the TOPIX Large70 stock index.

companies.name: Nippon Ichi Software
companies.description: Nippon Ichi Software, Inc. is a Japanese video game developer and publisher founded in 1991. It is known for developing role-playing video games such as the Disgaea and Marl Kingdom series. The company’s mascot is the penguin-like character Prinny from Disgaea.

companies.name: Taiyo Nippon Sanso
companies.description: Nippon Sanso Holdings Corporation is a holding company overseeing group companies including Taiyo Nippon Sanso, a major industrial gas manufacturer, and Thermos, a stainless steel thermos manufacturer. It is a consolidated subsidiary of the Mitsubishi Chemical Group.

companies.name: Randgold Resources
companies.description: Randgold Resources was a gold mining business headquartered in Jersey, Channel Islands, operating mainly in Mali. It was listed on the London and NASDAQ stock exchanges until it merged with Barrick Gold in December 2018.

companies.name: Metro
companies.description: Metro Inc. is a Canadian supermarket chain operating in Quebec and Ontario. Based in Montreal, Quebec, it is the third-largest grocer in Canada after Loblaw Companies Limited and Sobeys.

companies.name: Inspur
companies.description: Inspur Group is a Chinese information technology conglomerate focusing on cloud computing, big data, servers, storage, artificial intelligence, and ERP. It changed its English name from Langchao to Inspur in 2006 and is listed on the SSE, SZSE, and SEHK stock exchanges.

companies.name: Ono Pharmaceutical
companies.description: Ono Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in Japan, headquartered in Chuo-ku, Osaka. It has major plants in Osaka and Shizuoka, and its central research institute is located in Osaka Prefecture.

companies.name: Yahoo Japan
companies.description: Yahoo! Japan is a Japanese web portal and was the most-visited website in Japan in October 2018. It is also ranked among the top 50 websites worldwide. The company operates primarily in Japan.

companies.name: Blue Owl Capital
companies.description: Blue Owl Capital Inc. is an American alternative investment asset management company headquartered in New York City. It is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and has offices in London, Dubai, and Hong Kong.

companies.name: VakıfBank
companies.description: VakıfBank is the second-largest bank in Turkey by asset size. It was established in 1954 and is currently led by CEO Abdi Serdar Üstünsalih. The bank operates within the Turkish financial sector.

companies.name: NS Solutions
companies.description: NS Solutions Corp. is a Japanese company based in Tokyo that provides IT services, system integration, cloud computing, and information security. It operates within the information technology sector in Japan.

companies.name: Nippon Filcon
companies.description: Nippon Filcon is a Japanese manufacturing company established in 1936. It operates in the pulp and paper industry in Japan.

companies.name: Japan Exchange Group
companies.description: Japan Exchange Group, Inc. is a Japanese financial services company headquartered in Tokyo and Osaka. It operates as a financial instruments exchange holding company regulated by the Financial Services Agency of Japan.

companies.name: NKK switches
companies.description: NKK SWITCHES Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company that designs and manufactures a variety of industrial operational switches. Their products include illuminated, process sealed, miniature, and programmable switches among others.

companies.name: Meiji Holdings
companies.description: Meiji Holdings Company, Ltd. is a Japanese holding company established in 2009 after the stock transfer from Meiji Seika and Meiji Dairies. It is the fourth largest confectionery company in the world.

companies.name: Shobunsha
companies.description: Shobunsha is a Japanese map publisher headquartered in Kōjimachi, Chiyoda, Tokyo. The company is known for its road maps and travel guidebook series.

companies.name: GE HealthCare
companies.description: GE HealthCare is an American health technology company based in Chicago, Illinois. It operates four divisions including medical imaging, ultrasound, patient care solutions, and pharmaceutical diagnostics.

companies.name: AIA Group
companies.description: AIA Group Limited is a Hong Kong multinational insurance and finance company. It is one of the largest publicly traded life insurance groups in the Asia-Pacific and originated from an American insurance firm established in Shanghai in 1919.

companies.name: Tokyo Tatemono
companies.description: Tokyo Tatemono Co., Ltd. is a Japanese real estate company headquartered in Tokyo. Founded in 1896, it develops, sells, and manages commercial buildings, housing, hotels, and leisure facilities, with investments expanding into China and Southeast Asia.

companies.name: Tōkai Kisen
companies.description: Tōkai Kisen is a shipping company based in Minato, Tokyo, Japan. It provides freight and passenger transportation between Honshu and the Izu Islands and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Toho Gas
companies.logo_file: Toho Gas company logo - English version.svg
companies.description: Toho Gas Co., Ltd. is a Japanese gas company based in Nagoya. It supplies gas to the Tōkai region and is considered one of Nagoya's four influential companies.

companies.name: Dalia Energy Companies
companies.description: Dalia Energy Companies Ltd. is an Israeli company involved in the development, construction, and operation of electricity supply stations. It operates advanced natural gas power plants and is one of Israel's largest private electricity producers.

companies.name: Nofar Energy
companies.description: Nofar Energy is an Israeli renewable energy company headquartered in Kfar Saba. It develops, finances, constructs, owns, and operates renewable energy and energy storage projects, focusing on solar photovoltaic generation and battery storage.

companies.name: Shandong Airlines
companies.description: Shandong Airlines Co., Ltd. is a Chinese airline based in Jinan, Shandong. It operates domestic and regional international flights and is majorly owned by Shandong Aviation Group and Air China.

companies.name: DRB-HICOM
companies.description: DRB-HICOM Berhad is a Malaysian automotive company involved in manufacturing, assembly, and distribution. It is the majority shareholder of Proton and owns Modenas, assembling cars for multiple international brands.

companies.name: Silvergate Capital
companies.description: Silvergate Bank was a California-based bank founded in 1988. It began providing services for cryptocurrency users in 2016 and conducted an IPO in 2019.

companies.name: Koikeya
companies.description: Koikeya is a Japanese snack food manufacturer known as the second-largest producer of potato chips in Japan as of 2019.

companies.name: Daiwa Securities Group
companies.description: Daiwa Securities Group Inc. is a Japanese investment bank and the second largest securities brokerage in Japan after Nomura Securities.

companies.name: Daktronics
companies.description: Daktronics, Inc. is an American company based in Brookings, South Dakota, that designs and manufactures video displays, scoreboards, and related products. It was founded in 1968 by two South Dakota State University professors.

companies.name: Danaher Corporation
companies.description: Danaher Corporation is an American healthcare company headquartered in Washington, D.C. It develops products for biotechnology, life sciences, and diagnostics and operates three divisions focused on therapeutics, disease identification, and diagnostics.

companies.name: Fukusima Bank
companies.description: The Fukushima Bank Ltd. is a Japanese regional bank headquartered in Fukushima City, Fukushima Prefecture. Founded in 1922, it provides banking, leasing, credit card, and credit guarantee services.

companies.name: Precision BioSciences
companies.description: Precision BioSciences, Inc. is a publicly traded American clinical stage gene editing company headquartered in Durham, North Carolina. Founded in 2006, it develops gene editing therapies using its proprietary ARCUS genome editing platform.

companies.name: mBank
companies.description: mBank SA is a bank based in Warsaw, Poland. It offers retail, corporate, and investment banking along with other financial services and is the successor of BRE Bank after rebranding in 2013.

companies.name: Saipa
companies.description: SAIPA is an Iranian automaker headquartered in Tehran. Established in 1965 to assemble Citroëns under license, it changed its name in 1975 and now produces mostly under-licensed Korean cars and its own engines.

companies.name: Fujita Kanko
companies.description: Fujita Kankō is a leading hospitality company in Japan operating prominent hotels such as Hotel Chinzanso in Tokyo and Kowaku-en in Hakone. It also owns WHG Hotels located in major Japanese cities. The company is based in Japan and is notable for its significant presence in the hotel industry.

companies.name: Seibu Holdings
companies.logo_file: Seibu group HLDG Logo with phrase.svg
companies.description: Seibu Holdings Inc. is a Japanese multinational holding company owning Seibu Railway, Prince Hotels, Seibu Bus, and their subsidiaries, collectively known as the Seibu Group. It was formed in 2006 to restructure the group after a share ownership falsification scandal. The group includes fifty-three affiliated companies worldwide.

companies.name: Saibu Gas
companies.description: Saibu Gas Co., Ltd. is a Japanese gas company based in Fukuoka that supplies gas to the Northern Kyushu region, including Fukuoka, Saga, Nagasaki, and Kumamoto. It operates in the utilities sector and serves multiple areas in Japan.

companies.name: FMC Technologies
companies.description: FMC Technologies, Inc. was a North American company producing equipment for hydrocarbon exploration and production. Incorporated in 2000 after FMC Corporation divested its machinery businesses, it merged with Technip in 2017 to form TechnipFMC.

companies.name: Kingdee
companies.description: Kingdee International Software Group is a Chinese cloud computing and software company headquartered in Shenzhen. It is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and is a leader in the Chinese software industry.

companies.name: MDA Space
companies.description: MDA Space Ltd. is a Canadian space technology company headquartered in Brampton, Ontario. It provides geointelligence, robotics, space operations, and satellite systems.

companies.name: SM Pictures
companies.description: SM Pictures was a South Korean DVD distribution and film import company under SM Entertainment. Founded in 1999 as Bitwin, it was later acquired and renamed by SM Entertainment but closed after losses, with remaining stakes transferred in 2008.

companies.name: Kansai Paint
companies.description: Kansai Paint Co., Ltd. is a Japanese chemical company based in Osaka. Its main products include automotive, industrial, and decorative coatings.

companies.name: Megmilk Snow Brand
companies.description: Megmilk Snow Brand Co., Ltd., formerly Snow Brand Milk Products Co., Ltd., is one of the largest dairy companies in Japan.

companies.name: Bank of Kaohsiung
companies.description: The Bank of Kaohsiung is a public bank headquartered in Zuoying District, Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

companies.name: Torikizoku
companies.description: Torikizoku is a Japanese izakaya chain established in 1985 by Tadashi Okura. It operates 700 branches worldwide as of 2026 and is part of the Eternal Hospitality Group. The company is based in Japan and specializes in food service.

companies.name: LOLC Finance
companies.description: LOLC Finance PLC is a non-banking financial company based in Sri Lanka and a subsidiary of LOLC Holdings PLC. Established in 2001, it offers a wide range of financial services including savings, deposits, loans, and alternate financial solutions. It is one of the largest NBFIs in Sri Lanka.

companies.name: Grupa TVN
companies.description: TVN S.A. is a Polish media and entertainment group established in 1995. Its flagship TV channel is TVN, and the CEO is Katarzyna Kieli, who is also president and managing director of TVN Warner Bros. Discovery. The company operates in Poland.

companies.name: FERRUM SA
companies.description: FERRUM SA is an ironworks company established in 1874 and located in Katowice, Poland. It is a key producer of large diameter steel pipes used in various industries including petrochemical, heating, water, sewage, hydrotechnics, energy, and construction. The company is listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Dassault Systèmes
companies.description: Dassault Systèmes SE is a French multinational software corporation that develops software for 3D product design, simulation, manufacturing, and other 3D related products. The company is based in France and operates in the digital distribution sector.

companies.name: MCI Capital
companies.description: MCI Capital SA is a private equity fund established in 1999 and listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange. Founded by Tomasz Czechowicz, it is recognized as one of Poland’s leading private equity companies. The company manages assets under management of 2.74 billion PLN as of September 2024.

companies.name: MOJ
companies.description: MOJ was a brand of motorcycles manufactured in Katowice, Poland from 1937 to 1939. The brand name derives from the nickname of its founder, Gustaw Różycki, from his time as a student at the University of Leoben. The brand is now defunct.

companies.name: Debenhams PLC
companies.description: Debenhams plc was a British department store chain operating in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Denmark, and franchised locations across Europe and the Asia Pacific. The company was based in the United Kingdom and operated in the retail sector.

companies.name: Deckers Outdoor Corporation
companies.description: Deckers Outdoor Corporation, also known as Deckers Brands, is an American footwear designer and distributor founded in 1973 and based in Goleta, California. Its portfolio includes brands such as UGG, Teva, and Hoka. The company was founded by Doug Otto and Karl F. Lopker.

companies.name: Polski Holding Nieruchomości
companies.description: Polski Holding Nieruchomości is a Polish real estate company headquartered in Warsaw. It has a holding structure controlling dozens of subsidiaries and has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since February 2013.

companies.name: Bridge Investment Group
companies.description: Bridge Investment Group Holdings Inc. is an alternative investment company based in Salt Lake City, Utah. It focuses on real estate and credit investments and has expanded into private-equity secondary markets, property technology, and renewable energy.

companies.name: Del Taco
companies.description: Del Taco Restaurants, Inc. is an American fast food chain headquartered in Lake Forest, California. It offers tacos, burritos, fries, and burgers and operates approximately 595 locations across 18 US states.

companies.name: Delek Group Ltd.
companies.description: Delek Group is an Israeli holding conglomerate mainly operating in the petroleum industry. It owns Delek – The Israel Fuel Corporation, a large filling station chain, and has exploration and production operations in the Levant, North Sea, and Gulf of Mexico. It also owns a coffeehouse chain and a majority stake in the Israeli Burger King franchise.

companies.name: Atria Group
companies.description: Atria Plc is a Finnish food industry company with roots dating back to 1903. It originated from a livestock sales co-operative and is listed on the Helsinki stock exchange.

companies.name: Don Quijote
companies.description: Don Quijote Co., Ltd., known as Donki, is a Japanese discount store chain. It offers a wide range of products from groceries to electronics and clothing, often staying open late or 24/7 with densely packed merchandise.

companies.name: Capman
companies.description: CapMan Oyj is a Finnish private equity fund manager founded in 1989 and headquartered in Helsinki. It manages funds mainly from European institutional investors and focuses on Private Equity, Real Estate, and Infrastructure investments, employing professionals across several European cities.

companies.name: Componenta
companies.description: Componenta is a Finnish contract manufacturer of cast and machined metal components. Its customers are global manufacturers of vehicles, machines, and equipment. The company is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki.

companies.name: Banco Comercial Português
companies.description: Banco Comercial Português is the largest private bank in Portugal, founded in 1985. It is based in Porto with operations headquartered in Oeiras, Greater Lisbon, and operates brands including Millennium BCP, Banque BCP, and ActivoBank.

companies.name: Rockchip
companies.description: Rockchip is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company based in Fuzhou, Fujian province, with offices in several major cities. It designs system on a chip products using ARM architecture licensed from ARM Holdings.

companies.name: GE Vernova
companies.description: GE Vernova, Inc. is an energy equipment manufacturing and services company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. It operates through segments including Power, Wind, and Electrification, providing technologies and solutions for electricity generation, transmission, and management.

companies.name: Denny's
companies.description: Denny's is an American diner-style restaurant chain operating over 1,400 locations across the United States, Canada, Mexico, Puerto Rico, and other countries. It is known for its table service dining experience.

companies.name: Dentsu
companies.description: Dentsu Group Inc. is a Japanese international advertising and public relations company headquartered in Tokyo. It is the largest advertising agency in Japan and ranks fifth worldwide by revenue.

companies.name: Spirit Airlines
companies.description: Spirit Airlines was an American ultra-low-cost airline based in Dania Beach, Florida. It operated flights across the United States, the Caribbean, and Latin America before ceasing all scheduled operations in 2026.

companies.name: Reckitt
companies.description: Reckitt is a British multinational consumer goods company headquartered in Slough, UK. It manufactures health and hygiene products.

companies.name: Spansion
companies.description: Spansion Inc. was an American company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, that designed and manufactured flash memory, microcontrollers, and system-on-chip solutions. It originated as a joint venture between AMD and Fujitsu before becoming independent.

companies.name: Rohm
companies.description: Rohm Co., Ltd is a Japanese electronic parts manufacturer based in Kyoto. It was founded in 1958 as Toyo Electronics Industry Corporation by Kenichiro Sato.

companies.name: Trident Microsystems
companies.description: Trident Microsystems Inc. was an American fabless semiconductor company known in the 1990s for supplying integrated circuits for video display controllers. It later focused on display processors for digital and LCD televisions.

companies.name: TVB
companies.description: TVB Limited is a Hong Kong television network that started broadcasting in 1967. It operates multiple free-to-air channels including TVB Jade and TVB Pearl, and is known for its television dramas and beauty pageants.

companies.name: Austevoll Seafood
companies.description: Austevoll Seafood ASA is a major seafood company based in Norway.

companies.name: Rambus
companies.description: Rambus Inc. is an American technology company that designs and licenses chip interface technologies used in digital electronics. Founded in 1990, it is known for inventing RDRAM and its intellectual property litigation related to DDR-SDRAM.

companies.name: Newsmax Media
companies.description: Newsmax, Inc. is an American cable news, political opinion commentary, and digital media company founded in 1998 by Christopher Ruddy. It operates divisions including Newsmax TV, Newsmax.com, and Newsmax magazine. The company went public in March 2025.

companies.name: Dish
companies.description: DISH Network LLC, known as Dish, is an American provider of satellite television and IPTV services. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of EchoStar Corporation and competes primarily with DirecTV.

companies.name: APA Corporation
companies.description: APA Corporation is an American holding company for Apache Corporation engaged in hydrocarbon exploration. It is organized in Delaware and headquartered in Houston, Texas.

companies.name: Telio
companies.description: Telio is a Norwegian telecommunications company providing VoIP telephony services in Norway, Denmark, and the Netherlands. It is the second largest VoIP provider in Norway and also supplies GSM mobile subscriptions virtually.

companies.name: Energizer Holdings, Inc.
companies.description: Energizer Holdings, Inc. is an American electric battery manufacturer headquartered in Clayton, Missouri. It produces batteries under brands such as Energizer, Ray-O-Vac, Varta, and Eveready. The company separated its personal care businesses into Edgewell Personal Care in 2015.

companies.name: Weibo Corporation
companies.description: Weibo Corporation is a Chinese social network company based in Beijing, known for the microblogging website Sina Weibo.

companies.name: Samsonite
companies.description: Samsonite International S.A. is a Luxembourg-based multinational luggage manufacturer and retailer. Founded in 1910 in Denver, Colorado, it offers products ranging from large suitcases to small bags and briefcases.

companies.name: Revvity Inc.
companies.description: Revvity, Inc. is a multinational life sciences and diagnostics company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. It focuses on pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries, especially in cell and gene therapy developments, and originates from PerkinElmer.

companies.name: Golden Flake
companies.description: Golden Flake Snack Foods produces various snack foods including potato chips and cheese curls in the Southern United States. It is now part of Utz Quality Foods.

companies.name: Whistler Blackcomb
companies.description: Whistler Blackcomb is a ski resort located in Whistler, British Columbia, Canada. It is the largest ski resort in North America by several measures and features the Peak 2 Peak Gondola connecting two mountains.

companies.name: DRDGOLD Limited
companies.description: DRDGOLD Limited is a South African gold producer specializing in recovering gold from the retreatment of surface tailings. The company is publicly traded on both the New York and Johannesburg stock exchanges.

companies.name: Icom Incorporated
companies.description: Icom Inc. is a Japanese manufacturer of radio transmitting and receiving equipment founded in 1954. Its products serve radio amateurs, pilots, maritime, land mobile professional applications, and radio scanner enthusiasts.

companies.name: Noah Holdings
companies.description: Noah Holdings is a Chinese financial services company headquartered in Shanghai. It is recognized as the largest independent wealth management company in China.

companies.name: Perion Network Ltd.
companies.description: Perion Network Ltd. is an Israeli technology company providing digital advertising products and services. It is headquartered in Tel Aviv and has offices in multiple cities including New York, Los Angeles, and London.

companies.name: GMM Music
companies.description: GMM Music Public Company Limited is a Thai music company operating as a subsidiary of GMM Grammy. It manages record labels, artist management services, and music distribution channels.

companies.name: Hikma Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Hikma Pharmaceuticals plc is a British multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in London. Founded in 1978 in Amman, Jordan, it manufactures non-branded generic and in-licensed pharmaceutical products.

companies.name: Nikon
companies.description: Nikon Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of optical and precision equipment headquartered in Tokyo. Its products include cameras, lenses, semiconductor lithography systems, microscopes, and industrial measurement equipment.

companies.name: Saudi Investment Bank
companies.description: The Saudi Investment Bank is a Saudi joint stock bank established by Royal Decree in 1977. It operates within Saudi Arabia's banking sector.

companies.name: Saudi Electricity Company
companies.description: Saudi Energy, formerly Saudi Electricity Company, is the primary electric utility in Saudi Arabia. It operates across power generation, transmission, and distribution within the Kingdom.

companies.name: National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia
companies.description: Bahri, formerly known as the National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia, is a transportation and logistics company serving as the national shipping carrier of Saudi Arabia. It is based in Saudi Arabia and plays a key role in the country's shipping industry.

companies.name: Nadec
companies.description: The National Agricultural Development Company (Nadec) is a major agricultural and food-processing joint stock company in the Middle East and North Africa. Established in 1981 by royal decree, it is one of the largest vertically integrated dairy businesses globally and is partly owned by the Saudi government.

companies.name: Bank Aljazira
companies.description: Aljazira Bank is a Saudi Arabian financial group founded in 1975 and headquartered in Jeddah. It operates as a joint-stock company providing financial services within Saudi Arabia.

companies.name: Diebold Nixdorf
companies.description: Diebold Nixdorf, Incorporated is an American multinational company based in North Canton, Ohio. It specializes in financial and retail technology, including self-service transaction systems, point-of-sale terminals, and security products, serving global financial, retail, and commercial markets.

companies.name: Abdullah AlOthaim Markets
companies.description: Abdullah Al-Othaim Markets Company is a Saudi Arabian retail company that originated as an extension of Saleh Al Othaim Trading Establishment founded in 1956. Established in 1980, it expanded wholesale and retail foodstuff sales across Saudi Arabia.

companies.name: Zain Saudi Arabia
companies.description: Mobile Telecommunication Company Saudi Arabia, known as Zain Saudi Arabia, is a telecommunications and digital services company. It offers telecom services including 5G, digital payments, cloud computing, and IoT solutions, and is part of the Kuwaiti Zain Group.

companies.name: Zamil Industrial
companies.description: Zamil Industrial Investment Co., known as Zamil Industrial, is a publicly listed company based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. It develops materials and equipment for the construction industry and is partly owned by Zamil Group Holding Company.

companies.name: Jio Financial
companies.description: Jio Financial Services Limited is an Indian financial services company based in Mumbai. It was originally a subsidiary of Reliance Industries and became an independent entity listed on Indian stock exchanges in August 2023.

companies.name: Shochiku
companies.description: Shochiku Co., Ltd. is a Japanese entertainment company founded in 1895. It manages kabuki theaters and is one of Japan's Big Four film studios, known for its long history in film production and theater management.

companies.name: Miss Grand International (company)
companies.description: Miss Grand International is a Thai conglomerate founded in 2013 and headquartered in Bangkok. It operates businesses across various industries including advertisement, cosmetics, entertainment, events, health products, and talent management.

companies.name: CAB Payments
companies.description: CAB Payments Holdings plc is a British company specializing in payment processing and foreign exchange services. It is based in the United Kingdom and is publicly traded on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Yili Group
companies.description: Yili Group is a Chinese dairy products producer headquartered in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia. It manufactures various milk products including ice cream and powdered milk under multiple brands and is partly state-owned by the government of Hohhot.

companies.name: Resona Holdings
companies.description: Resona Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese holding company for Resona Group, the fifth-largest banking group in Japan as of 2012. It is headquartered in Tokyo and includes Resona Bank and Saitama Resona Bank as its main operating entities.

companies.name: TTM Technologies
companies.description: TTM Technologies, Inc. is an American manufacturer of printed circuit boards headquartered in Santa Ana, California. Founded in 1998, it is one of the top five PCB manufacturers globally and the largest supplier to the U.S. military.

companies.name: Robam Appliances
companies.description: Hangzhou Robam Appliances Co., Ltd., known as Robam Appliances, is a Chinese manufacturer of kitchen appliances. The company is headquartered in Hangzhou, Zhejiang province.

companies.name: Dollar Thrifty Automotive Group
companies.description: Dollar Thrifty Automotive Group was the holding company for Thrifty Car Rental and Dollar Rent A Car. It operated as a subsidiary of Chrysler Corporation starting in 1997 and was acquired by The Hertz Corporation in 2012.

companies.name: Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group
companies.description: Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group International Limited is a multinational hospitality and management company based in Bermuda. It focuses on luxury hotels, resorts, and residences, owning or partially owning 20 of its 46 properties worldwide.

companies.name: Iliad
companies.description: Iliad SA is a French telecommunications company headquartered in Paris. It operates fixed and mobile telephony, broadband, and IPTV services in France, Italy, and Poland under various brands including Free and Play.

companies.name: Torrent Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Ltd is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Ahmedabad. It is part of the Torrent Group and was originally founded as Trinity Laboratories Ltd before being renamed.

companies.name: Lithium Americas
companies.description: Lithium Americas Corp. is a Canadian mining company currently developing the Thacker Pass Lithium Mine located in northern Nevada. It is engaged in the mining industry.

companies.name: Alumindo Light Metal Industry
companies.description: PT Alumindo Light Metal Industry Tbk is the largest flat rolled aluminium manufacturer in South East Asia. It is headquartered in Surabaya, East Java, Indonesia. The company produces aluminum sheets used in household appliances, transportation equipment, and building materials, as well as tin sheets for packaging.

companies.name: Bakrie Sumatera Plantations
companies.description: Bakrie Sumatera Plantations is an agricultural subsidiary of Bakrie Group based in Jakarta, Indonesia. It manages rubber and palm oil plantations, a railroad for transporting rubber, and several land banks. The company operates in the agriculture sector.

companies.name: Maspion Bank of Indonesia
companies.description: PT Bank Maspion Indonesia Tbk is an Indonesian banking and financial services company established in 1989 and based in Surabaya. It is part of the Kasikornbank group of companies. The company operates in the banking sector.

companies.name: Elang Mahkota Teknologi
companies.description: PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk, trading as Emtek, is an Indonesian technology, telecommunication, and media conglomerate headquartered in Jakarta. It is Indonesia's second largest media company as of 2013 and owns subsidiaries including pay television service Nex Parabola and five television networks.

companies.name: Coal India
companies.description: Coal India Limited is an Indian state-owned coal mining company headquartered in Kolkata. It is the largest coal producer in the world by output and operates under the administrative control of the Ministry of Coal. The company is involved in coal mining.

companies.name: Mayora Indah
