companies.description: PT Mayora Indah Tbk is a large Indonesian multinational food and beverage company headquartered in Jakarta. Founded in 1977, it is recognized as the world's largest coffee candy manufacturer through its Kopiko brand. The company operates in the food industry.

companies.name: Sido Muncul
companies.description: PT Industri Jamu dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk, known as Sido Muncul, is an Indonesian herbal medicine and food products company based in Semarang. Established in 1940, it produces and markets herbal medication products such as the jamu Tolak Angin.

companies.name: PT Suparma Tbk
companies.description: Suparma is an Indonesian pulp and paper company based in Surabaya, East Java. Founded in 1976 by Welly, the company operates in the agriculture sector focusing on pulp and paper production.

companies.name: Surya Semesta Internusa
companies.description: PT Surya Semesta Internusa Tbk is an Indonesian publicly traded construction company. It operates in property development and management, construction, and hospitality sectors. The company is involved in real estate and construction industries.

companies.name: The Howard Hughes Corporation
companies.description: Howard Hughes Holdings Inc., formerly the Howard Hughes Corporation, is a real estate development and management company based in The Woodlands, Texas. Formed in 2010 as a spin-off from General Growth Properties, it focuses on master-planned communities and has historical ties to the original Howard Hughes Corporation.

companies.name: LiveRamp
companies.description: LiveRamp Holdings, Inc. is an American SaaS company that provides a data connectivity platform. Its services include data onboarding, which involves transferring offline data online for marketing purposes. The company operates in the United States.

companies.name: Dr Pepper Snapple Group
companies.description: Dr Pepper Snapple Group was an American multinational soft drink company based in Plano, Texas. It originated as Cadbury Schweppes Americas Beverages, a division of Cadbury Schweppes. The company operated in the beverage industry.

companies.name: Ngk
companies.description: NGK Corporation is a Japanese ceramics company headquartered in Tokyo. It primarily produces insulators and other ceramic products. Established in 1919 as a spin-off from Nippon Toki, it is listed on multiple Japanese stock exchanges.

companies.name: Fuyao
companies.description: Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese glass manufacturing company headquartered in Fuqing, Fujian. Founded in 1987, it is one of the largest automotive glass producers globally, serving major automobile manufacturers. It also produces float and construction glass.

companies.name: Drax Group
companies.description: Drax Group plc is a renewable energy company based in the United Kingdom. It operates biomass-fueled power stations and pellet production plants across North America. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: SM Culture & Contents
companies.description: SM Culture & Contents is a South Korean company involved in advertising, production, travel, and talent management. It operates as a talent agency, television and theatrical production company, and travel company. The company is based in South Korea.

companies.name: CJ ENM Commerce Division
companies.description: CJ ENM Commerce Division is a commerce division of CJ Group based in South Korea. It operates within the media and entertainment industry. The division is part of the larger CJ Group conglomerate.

companies.name: FNC Entertainment
companies.description: FNC Entertainment is a South Korean entertainment company founded in 2006 by singer and producer Han Seong-ho. It functions as a record label, talent agency, music production, event management, and music publishing company. Since 2012, it has been based in Cheongdam-dong.

companies.name: LS Electiric
companies.description: LS Electric Co., Ltd., formerly LS Industrial Systems, is an electric power equipment and industrial automation company headquartered in Anyang, South Korea. It is a key affiliate of the LS Group, alongside LS Cable & System and LS MnM.

companies.name: Namyang Dairy Products
companies.description: Namyang Dairy Products is a South Korean food and dairy corporation headquartered in Seoul. It is one of the largest dairy manufacturers in South Korea, alongside Seoul Milk and Maeil Holdings. The company operates in the agriculture and food sector.

companies.name: Lotte Shopping
companies.description: Lotte Shopping Co., Ltd. is a multinational retailer headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Founded in 1979, it operates various retail stores including department stores, outlet stores, hypermarkets, drug store chains, and e-commerce. The company also holds a majority stake in Lotte Cultureworks, engaging in the film industry.

companies.name: Lotte Chemical
companies.description: Lotte Chemical Corporation is a chemical company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. It is one of the largest chemical companies in the world by revenue. The company manufactures synthetic resins and other chemical products used for various industrial materials.

companies.name: Binggrae
companies.description: Binggrae Co., Ltd. is a South Korean multinational food and beverage corporation that manufactures ice cream, milk products, and snacks. Founded in 1967 as Daeil Corporation, it is known for releasing the first banana milk in 1974, Banana Flavored Milk, which became culturally important in South Korea.

companies.name: Estée Lauder Companies
companies.description: The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. is an American multinational cosmetics company based in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. It manufactures and markets makeup, skincare, perfume, and hair care products. The company owns a diverse portfolio of brands distributed internationally through digital commerce and retail channels.

companies.name: Chong Kun Dang
companies.description: Chong Kun Dang is a South Korean multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Seoul. Founded in 1941 as Goongbon Pharmacy and renamed in 1946, it has become one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in South Korea.

companies.name: Lionsgate Studios
companies.description: Lionsgate Studios Corp. is a Canadian-American film and television production and distribution conglomerate domiciled in Vancouver, British Columbia, and primarily based in Santa Monica, California. It was formed on May 14, 2024, after Starz Entertainment spun off its film and television businesses and merged with Screaming Eagle Corporation.

companies.name: Coupang
companies.description: Coupang, Inc. is an American online retail and technology company headquartered in Seattle, Washington, operating primarily in South Korea and Taiwan. Founded in South Korea in 2010, it operates an internet retail business, food delivery service, and OTT streaming service with offices in multiple countries.

companies.name: Kiwoom Securities
companies.description: Kiwoom Securities is a South Korean financial services company based in Seoul. Founded in 2000, it acts as a broker for foreign and domestic stock and futures exchanges and provides financial services including investment, risk management, asset management, and investment strategy research.

companies.name: POSCO Future M
companies.description: POSCO Future M Co., Ltd. is a South Korean battery material and chemical company. It produces cathode and anode materials for lithium-ion batteries, refractories, and basic industrial materials.

companies.name: Korea District Heating Corporation
companies.description: The Korea District Heating Corporation is a South Korean district heating company headquartered in Seongnam. Established in 1985 as a statutory corporation, it promotes energy conservation and efficient district heating, supplying services to 1.3 million households as of 2015.

companies.name: Xos, Inc.
companies.description: Xos, Inc. is an American manufacturer specializing in commercial electric vehicles and mobile EV chargers. The company operates in the automotive industry and focuses on electric vehicle technology.

companies.name: Avolta
companies.description: Avolta AG is a Swiss travel retailer headquartered in Basel. It operates duty-free and duty-paid shops and convenience stores in airports, cruise lines, seaports, railway stations, and tourist areas across over 75 countries.

companies.name: Saponia
companies.description: Saponia is a Croatian company producing consumer goods and chemicals, including cleaning and hygiene products and supplements for household and industrial use. It is headquartered in Osijek.

companies.name: Bionor Pharma
companies.description: Bionor Holding AS is a Norwegian biotechnology company developing vaccines for rapidly mutating viruses such as HIV, Hepatitis C, and Influenza. It also leads in soy technology with patented health products and was founded by Lars Høie.

companies.name: LHV Pank
companies.description: LHV Pank is an Estonian banking and financial services company headquartered in Tallinn. It serves private individuals, companies, and institutional investors and is the third largest bank in Estonia with multiple branch offices.

companies.name: Wuhan Iron and Steel Corporation
companies.description: Wuhan Iron and Steel Corporation (WISCO) is a Chinese state-owned enterprise operating since 1958. It is based in Qingshan, Wuhan, Hubei, China, and operates in the iron and steel industry.

companies.name: Vital Farms
companies.description: Vital Farms, Inc. is an American egg and butter brand founded in 2007 and headquartered in Austin, Texas. Its products are sold in over 23,500 stores across the United States.

companies.name: Albemarle Corporation
companies.description: Albemarle Corporation is an American specialty chemicals and mining company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It produces lithium compounds for electric-vehicle batteries and bromine-based specialty chemicals including flame retardants.

companies.name: EDP Renewables
companies.description: EDP Renováveis is a renewable energy company registered in Oviedo and headquartered in Madrid, Spain. It designs, develops, manages, and operates power plants using renewable energy sources.

companies.name: Vicat
companies.industry: manufacture of cement, lime and plaster
companies.description: Vicat SA is a French company manufacturing cement, aggregates, and ready-mix concrete. It operates across four continents in the construction materials industry.

companies.name: First Financial Bancorp
companies.description: First Financial Bancorp is a regional bank headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, with operations centers in Springdale, Ohio, and Greensburg, Indiana. Founded in 1863, it holds the sixth oldest national bank charter and operates 131 locations across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky, and Illinois. It acquired Irwin Financial Corp in 2009 through a government-assisted transaction.

companies.name: Levi Strauss & Co.
companies.description: Levi Strauss & Co. is an American clothing company known worldwide for its Levi's denim jeans. Founded in 1853 by Levi Strauss in San Francisco, California, it is registered in Delaware and headquartered in Levi's Plaza in San Francisco.

companies.name: TV Azteca
companies.description: TV Azteca is a Mexican multimedia conglomerate owned by Grupo Salinas and is the second-largest mass media company in Mexico. It owns two national television networks, Azteca Uno and Azteca 7, and operates additional nationally distributed services including adn40 and A Más+. The company also runs a collection of pay TV networks.

companies.name: Ecolab
companies.description: Ecolab Inc., headquartered in Saint Paul, Minnesota, provides water treatment, sanitation, and hygiene products primarily to commercial and industrial customers. It is ranked 274th on the Fortune 500 and 569th on the Forbes Global 2000.

companies.name: OMZ
companies.description: OMZ, also known as United Heavy Machinery or Uralmash-Izhora Group, is a Russia-based international heavy industry and manufacturing conglomerate. It manufactures steel, custom, and industrial components for nuclear power plants, petrochemical and mining operations, and utilities, including reactor pressure vessels for VVER nuclear reactors and EKG mining power shovels.

companies.name: Mondelez International
companies.description: Mondelez International, Inc. is an American multinational company based in Chicago that produces confectionery, food, beverages, and snack foods. It operates in approximately 160 countries and was ranked No. 108 in the 2021 Fortune 500 list of largest U.S. corporations by revenue.

companies.name: TJX Companies
companies.description: The TJX Companies, Inc. is an American multinational off-price department store corporation headquartered in Framingham, Massachusetts. It was formed as a subsidiary of Zayre Corp. in 1987 and became the legal successor to Zayre Corp. after a reorganization in 1989.

companies.name: Caesarstone Sdot-Yam
companies.description: Caesarstone Ltd. is a publicly traded company headquartered in Kibbutz Sdot Yam, Israel, producing engineered stone surfaces for kitchen countertops, flooring, and interior design. Founded in 1987, it has production facilities in Israel and India and sources products from China, selling in about 50 countries through subsidiaries and distributors.

companies.name: Meyer Burger
companies.description: Meyer Burger Technology AG is an industrial manufacturer of solar cells and solar modules headquartered in Gwatt, Thun, Switzerland. Its registered shares are listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange.

companies.name: Nomura Holdings
companies.description: Nomura Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese financial holding company and principal member of the Nomura Group, Japan's largest investment bank and brokerage group. It provides investment, financing, and related services globally through its broker-dealer, banking, and other financial subsidiaries.

companies.name: TransMontaigne
companies.description: TransMontaigne GP LLC is an oil pipeline and terminal company based in Denver, Colorado. It became a wholly owned subsidiary of Morgan Stanley in 2006 and was later sold to NGL Energy in 2014. In 2016, it was sold to ArcLight Capital Partners.

companies.name: Sabeco
companies.description: Sabeco, officially Saigon Beer – Alcohol – Beverage Corporation, is Vietnam's leading beer producer. It was formerly under Vietnam's Ministry of Trade and Industry and is now a subsidiary of ThaiBev. Its main brands include Bia Saigon and 333 Beer.

companies.name: Jain Irrigation Systems Limited
companies.description: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd. is an Indian multinational conglomerate based in Jalgaon, Maharashtra. The company operates in the agriculture industry.

companies.name: Lupin Ltd.
companies.description: Lupin Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai. It manufactures generic drugs covering various therapeutic areas and operates in international markets including the US, Japan, Europe, and Australia.

companies.name: Bangkok Dusit Medical Services
companies.description: Bangkok Dusit Medical Services is Thailand's largest private healthcare group. It was founded by Thai billionaire Prasert Prasarttong-Osoth.

companies.name: Karmarts
companies.description: Karmarts, formerly DiStar Electric Corporation, is a Thai company that imports and distributes cosmetic goods and beauty products. It previously manufactured and distributed electronic goods under the DiStar brand.

companies.name: Chicken Soup for the Soul Entertainment
companies.wiki: Chicken Soup for the Soul Entertainment
companies.logo_file: Chicken Soup for the Soul Entertainment.png
companies.description: Chicken Soup for the Soul Entertainment, Inc. was an American media company based in Cos Cob, Connecticut. Established in 2016, it was a subsidiary of the publisher Chicken Soup for the Soul.

companies.name: IRPC Public Company Limited
companies.description: IRPC Public Company Limited is a Thai petroleum and petrochemical company listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand. It is a subsidiary of PTT Group and was formerly known as Thai Petrochemical Industry Public Company Limited.

companies.name: Natura & Co
companies.description: Natura Cosméticos S.A. is a Brazilian global personal care cosmetics group headquartered in São Paulo. It includes the Natura brand and Avon Products, operates in 73 countries, and became the 4th largest pure-play beauty company after acquiring Avon.

companies.name: Valeo
companies.description: Valeo is a French global automotive supplier headquartered in France and listed on the Paris Stock Exchange. It supplies products to automakers and the aftermarket, with 186 production plants and 66 R&D centers worldwide.

companies.name: Koç Holding
companies.description: Koç Holding A.Ş. is a Turkish multinational industrial conglomerate headquartered in Istanbul. It is the largest company in Turkey and is listed on the Fortune Global 500 as of 2024. The company is controlled by the Koç family and contributes up to 7% of Turkey's overall exports.

companies.name: Biemlfdlkk
companies.description: Biemlofen, formerly Biemlfdlkk, is a Chinese golf apparel manufacturer founded in 2003. It focuses on high-end fashion sportswear and owns global trademark rights for Cerruti 1881 and Kent & Curwen. The company is owned by Xie Bingzheng.

companies.name: Longyuan Power
companies.description: China Longyuan Power Group Limited, or Longyuan Power, is the largest wind power producer in China and Asia. It designs, develops, manages, and operates wind power plants and sells the electricity generated. As of June 2013, it had installed wind power plants with a total capacity of 10,661 MW.

companies.name: Perusahaan Gas Negara
companies.description: PT Pertamina Gas Negara Tbk is an Indonesian natural gas transportation and distribution company. It operates 3,187 km of distribution pipelines serving around 84 million customers. The company adopted its current name and Pertamina branding in 2021.

companies.name: HD Hyundai Construction Equipment
companies.description: HD Construction Equipment Co., Ltd., formerly Hyundai Construction Equipment, is a South Korean construction equipment manufacturer. It is a subsidiary of the HD Hyundai conglomerate.

companies.name: Dear U
companies.description: Dear U is a South Korean software development company established in July 2017, formerly known as Everysing. It merged with Brinicle and specializes in multimedia content hosting and artist-to-fan communications, offering products like Everysing, Lysn, and Bubble.

companies.name: Foster's Group Limited
companies.description: Foster's Group Pty. Ltd. was an Australian beer group known for Foster's Lager, now called Carlton & United Breweries since 2011. Founded in 1888 in Melbourne by two American brothers, the brewery was sold a year later.

companies.name: Symetra
companies.description: Symetra is an American family of companies providing retirement plans, employee benefits, annuities, and life insurance through independent distributors nationwide. The company is headquartered in Bellevue, Washington.

companies.name: Goodwin Steel Castings
companies.description: Goodwin plc is a heavy engineering firm based in Stoke-on-Trent, Staffordshire, England. It specializes in the supply and fabrication of castings and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: NMB Bank Nepal
companies.description: NMB Bank Nepal is a commercial bank headquartered in Kathmandu, Nepal. Licensed by the Nepal Rastra Bank, it operates 202 branches nationwide providing retail and commercial banking services.

companies.name: Global IME Bank
companies.description: Global IME Bank Limited is a commercial bank based in Kathmandu, Nepal. It was formed in 2012 through the merger of IME Financial Institution Limited and Lord Buddha Finance Limited. The bank has expanded by acquiring 21 banking and financial institutions and operates branches nationwide.

companies.name: Nepal Investment Bank Limited
companies.description: Nepal Investment Mega Bank Limited is a leading commercial bank in Nepal, established in 1986 as a joint venture with Credit Agricole Indosuez. It became fully Nepalese-owned in 2001 and merged with Mega Bank Nepal in 2023, operating under its current name since January 2023.

companies.name: Sanima Bank
companies.description: Sanima Bank is a commercial bank in Nepal that started as a National Level Development Bank in 2004. It was licensed as an 'A' Class Commercial Bank in 2012 and operates 106 branches and 28 extension counters within and outside Kathmandu Valley.

companies.name: Intuit
companies.description: Intuit Inc. is an American financial technology company headquartered in Mountain View, California. Founded in 1983, it develops financial software and services including TurboTax and QuickBooks, and has expanded through acquisitions such as Credit Karma and Mailchimp.

companies.name: Osisko Metals
companies.description: Osisko Metals Incorporated is a Canadian mining corporation holding two historical past-producing mines: the Pine Point Mine in the Northwest Territories and the Gaspé Copper mine in Quebec. The company aims to reactivate these mines.

companies.name: Nathan's Famous
companies.description: Nathan's Famous, Inc. is an American fast-food company specializing in hot dogs. Its original restaurant is located in Coney Island, Brooklyn, New York City, and its headquarters are in Jericho, New York. The chain primarily operates in the Northeastern United States.

companies.name: Allegiant Air
companies.description: Allegiant Air is an American ultra-low-cost airline headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada. It focuses on leisure travel from small and medium-sized cities, offering low base fares with additional fees for extra services.

companies.name: Kikkoman
companies.description: Kikkoman Corporation is a Japanese food manufacturer known for soy sauce, seasonings, beverages, and restaurant management. As of 2002, it was the world's largest soy sauce producer and promotes international exchange of food culture.

companies.name: NatWest Group
companies.description: NatWest Group plc is a British banking and insurance holding company based in Edinburgh, Scotland. It operates multiple banking brands including National Westminster Bank and Royal Bank of Scotland, and issues banknotes in Scotland and Northern Ireland.

companies.name: RealNetworks
companies.description: RealNetworks LLC is an American technology company based in Seattle, Washington. It provides Internet streaming media delivery software and services, along with subscription-based online entertainment and mobile messaging services.

companies.name: Gentoo Media
companies.description: Gentoo Media Inc. is a publicly traded company based in Malta operating in the iGaming affiliate marketing industry. It manages a network of over 150 websites that direct traffic to licensed online casinos and sports betting operators, focusing on lead generation, content marketing, and compliance monitoring.

companies.name: Getinge AB
companies.description: Getinge AB is a Swedish publicly traded medical technology company producing and distributing medical products and equipment for healthcare and life sciences. It operates in three business areas and has a significant market presence in the United States, China, and Western Europe.

companies.name: Office Depot
companies.description: The ODP Corporation, known as Office Depot, is an American office supply retailer headquartered in Boca Raton, Florida. It employs about 19,000 people in the United States.

companies.name: Spring Airlines
companies.description: Spring Airlines is a low-cost airline headquartered in Changning, Shanghai, China. It operates in the airline industry.

companies.name: Sunac China
companies.description: Sunac China Holdings Limited is a major property developer headquartered in Tianjin, China. The company focuses on large-scale, medium to high-end property developments across multiple Chinese cities including Beijing and Chongqing.

companies.name: Energias de Portugal
companies.description: EDP is a Portuguese electric utilities company headquartered in Lisbon. It was founded in 1976 through the merger of 14 nationalised electricity companies.

companies.name: EnerSys
companies.description: EnerSys is a provider of stored energy systems and technology for industrial applications. The company manufactures batteries, battery chargers, power equipment, and outdoor equipment enclosures.

companies.name: Enerplus
companies.description: Enerplus Corporation is a Canadian independent oil and gas producer with property interests in the United States and western Canada, including Alberta, British Columbia, and Saskatchewan.

companies.name: Tokmanni
companies.description: Tokmanni Group Oyj is a Finnish retail chain and the largest discount store chain in Finland by net sales. It operates nearly 200 stores nationwide.

companies.name: Tod's S.p.A.
companies.description: Tod's S.p.A. is an Italian luxury fashion company specializing in footwear, leather goods, and accessories. It originated as a family shoemaking business in the late 1920s and expanded into industrial production in the 1970s. The company was publicly listed on the Borsa Italiana in 2000 until its privatization in 2024.

companies.name: Fantagio
companies.description: Fantagio is a South Korean entertainment company operating as a record label, talent training and management agency, and movie and K-drama production company. Founded in 2008 as N.O.A. Entertainment, it changed its name to Fantagio in 2011. The company reported operating and net incomes in 2012.

companies.name: Gruppo Intesa Sanpaolo
companies.description: Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. is an Italian international banking group formed in 2007 through the merger of Banca Intesa and Sanpaolo IMI. It is Italy's largest bank by total assets and has two headquarters in Milan and Turin, each housing different banking divisions.

companies.name: Villar Land
companies.description: Villar Land Holdings Corporation is a Philippine holding company with stakes in real estate and death care industries. It is associated with Manny Villar.

companies.name: StarFlyer
companies.description: Star Flyer Inc. is a Japanese airline headquartered at Kitakyushu Airport in Fukuoka Prefecture. It operates as a hybrid airline offering higher service levels than low-cost carriers but with lower operating costs than full-service carriers. It uses the IATA code 7G and domestically also MQ.

companies.name: Entergy
companies.description: Entergy Corporation is an American energy company headquartered in New Orleans, Louisiana. It produces and distributes electric power to three million customers in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Texas. The company has approximately 24,000 megawatts of electric generating capacity.

companies.name: Rémy Cointreau
companies.description: Rémy Cointreau is a French family-owned business group specializing in the production and distribution of alcoholic beverages including cognac, triple sec, and whisky. The group was formed in 1990 after the merger of Rémy Martin and Cointreau and also owns the fragrance company Maison Psyché.

companies.name: Tianjin Port Holdings
companies.description: Tianjin Port Holdings Company Limited operates Tianjin Port and provides warehousing, storage, freight forwarding, and shipping brokerage services. It is parented by Tianjin Port (Group) and was listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 1996. The company changed its name to Tianjin Port Holdings in 1998.

companies.name: Okuma Corporation
companies.description: Okuma Corporation is a Japanese machine tool builder based in Ōguchi, Aichi Prefecture. It has a global market share in CNC machine tools including lathes and machining centers and also offers factory automation products and servomotors.

companies.name: Postmedia Network
companies.description: Postmedia Network Canada Corp. is a Canadian media conglomerate majority-owned by American investors. It operates English-language newspaper publishing, news gathering, and internet operations. The company owns over 130 print and digital news titles including the National Post and Financial Post.

companies.name: Helicos Biosciences
companies.description: Helicos BioSciences Corporation was a life science company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, specializing in genetic analysis technologies for research, drug discovery, and diagnostics. It developed the Helicos Genetic Analysis Platform, the first DNA-sequencing instrument to image individual DNA molecules. The company faced financial difficulties and was delisted from NASDAQ in 2010.

companies.name: Saputo
companies.description: Saputo Inc. is a Canadian dairy company headquartered in Montreal, Quebec. Founded in 1954 by the Saputo family, it produces, markets, and distributes a wide range of dairy products including cheese, fluid milk, and cultured products. It is one of the top ten dairy processors globally.

companies.name: Corby Distilleries
companies.description: Corby Spirit and Wine Limited is a Canadian alcohol manufacturing and distribution company founded in 1859 in Corbyville, Ontario. It is partly owned by Pernod Ricard and distills Canadian specialties while marketing Pernod Ricard's products in Canada. The company is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Harvest Operations
companies.description: Harvest Operations Corp. was a Canadian oil and natural gas company based in Calgary, Alberta, operating both upstream and downstream components. It functioned as an open-ended investment trust known as a "Canroy." In 2009, it was acquired by Korea National Oil Corporation and subsequently delisted from stock exchanges.

companies.name: Oncolytics Biotech
companies.description: Oncolytics Biotech Inc. is a biotech company headquartered in San Diego, California, developing an intravenously delivered immuno-oncolytic virus called pelareorep for treating solid tumors and hematological malignancies. Pelareorep is a proprietary isolate of the reovirus that induces selective tumor lysis and promotes immune responses.

companies.name: RioCan Real Estate Investment Trust
companies.description: RioCan Real Estate Investment Trust is the second-largest REIT in Canada, owning 164 properties across the country. It manages a net leasable area of 31.4 million square feet and is led by CEO Jonathan Gitlin. The company operates in the real estate sector.

companies.name: Sierra Wireless
companies.description: Sierra Wireless is a Canadian multinational company headquartered in Richmond, British Columbia, that designs, manufactures, and provides wireless communications equipment and services. It maintains offices and operations in multiple countries including the United States, Korea, and Japan.

companies.name: Western Forest Products
companies.description: Western Forest Products Inc. is a Canadian lumber company based in Vancouver, British Columbia. It operates in the industrial sector focusing on lumber production.

companies.name: Neuland Laboratories
companies.description: Neuland Laboratories Limited is an Indian contract development and manufacturing organization headquartered in Hyderabad. Founded in 1984, it produces active pharmaceutical ingredients, advanced intermediates, and peptide APIs. The company is publicly traded on Indian stock exchanges.

companies.name: Pilot Corporation
companies.description: Pilot Corporation is a Japanese pen manufacturer based in Tokyo. It produces writing instruments, stationery, and jewellery, and is best known for its pens.

companies.name: Jaber Ebne Hayyan Pharmaceutical Company
companies.description: Jaber Ebne Hayyan Pharmaceutical Company is an Iranian manufacturer and seller of injection and oral antibiotics, ointments, inhalers, nasal sprays, and pearls. Founded in 1960 and based in Tehran, it was formerly known as Squibb Iran before changing its name in 1979. The company is publicly traded on the Tehran Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Nippn
companies.description: Nippn Corporation is a Japanese company primarily engaged in milling flour and producing flour-related products such as noodles. Established in 1896, it is part of the Mitsui keiretsu. The company operates within Japan's food industry.

companies.name: Shikun & Binui Ltd.
companies.description: Shikun & Binui Ltd. is a global business group based in Israel operating through subsidiaries in infrastructure, real estate, energy, and concessions. Its subsidiaries operate in more than twenty countries worldwide. The company is involved in the construction industry.

companies.name: Versant
companies.description: Versant Media Group, Inc., known as Versant, is an American multinational mass media and technology company headquartered in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. Its technical operations and master control are located at CNBC's headquarters in Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey.

companies.name: Aircastle
companies.description: Aircastle Limited is an aircraft leasing company headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, with offices in Dublin and Singapore. It acquires, leases, and sells commercial jet aircraft to airlines globally. The company was incorporated in 2004.

companies.name: OMX Helsinki 25
companies.description: OMX Helsinki 25 is a stock market index representing the 25 most traded stocks on the Nasdaq Helsinki stock exchange. It is a price return and capitalization-weighted index with a maximum weight limit of 10 percent for any single stock.

companies.name: Laurentian Bank of Canada
companies.description: The Laurentian Bank of Canada is a Schedule 1 bank that became a subsidiary of Fairstone Bank of Canada on November 1, 2026. It primarily serves large business clients after selling other lines of business to National Bank of Canada.

companies.name: Hilton Grand Vacations
companies.description: Hilton Grand Vacations Inc. is a multinational company based in Orlando, Florida, managing and operating Hilton Worldwide's timeshare and vacation ownership brands under an exclusive licensing agreement. It was spun off from Hilton Worldwide in 2017 but continues to manage several Hilton timeshare brands.

companies.name: Ovintiv
companies.description: Ovintiv Inc., based in Denver, is an American hydrocarbon exploration company. Formerly known as Encana, it restructured in 2020 from a Canadian to a U.S. domiciled company. Its operations focus on the Permian Basin in the U.S. and the Montney Formation in Canada, where it partners with Mitsubishi.

companies.name: Lingbao Gold
companies.description: Lingbao Gold Group Company Ltd. is a state-owned gold mining enterprise headquartered in Lingbao, Henan Province, China. It operates in the gold mining industry and is owned by the state.

companies.name: Maoye International
companies.description: Maoye International Holdings Limited is a leading department store company based in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China. It operates retail businesses in Guangdong, Sichuan, Chongqing, and Jiangsu provinces.

companies.name: Padini
companies.description: Padini Holdings Berhad is a Malaysian fashion company that primarily exports its manufactured goods to the Middle East and Southeast Asia. It operates in the clothing industry.

companies.name: Vantiva
companies.description: Vantiva SA is a French multinational corporation providing technology products and services for the communication, media, and entertainment industries. Headquartered in Paris, it has offices in multiple countries including China, India, Belgium, the US, and Brazil.

companies.name: TierOne Bank
companies.description: TierOne Bank was a bank based in Lincoln, Nebraska, founded in 1907. It traded on the Nasdaq until its failure in June 2010, after which multiple executives faced charges related to the failure.

companies.name: USA Rare Earth
companies.description: USA Rare Earth, Inc. is an American mining and manufacturing company headquartered in Stillwater, Oklahoma. It specializes in extraction, processing, and production of rare-earth elements and permanent magnets, aiming to develop a domestic supply chain.

companies.name: Mothercare
companies.description: Mothercare plc is a global brand offering products for parents and young children. The company is listed on the AIM stock exchange in London, United Kingdom.

companies.name: Heartland Express
companies.description: Heartland Express is an American trucking company headquartered in North Liberty, Iowa. It provides truckload shipping services across the United States.

companies.name: Archion
companies.description: Archion is a Japanese holding company headquartered in Shinagawa, Tokyo. It was founded to assume full ownership of truck manufacturing companies Mitsubishi Fuso, Hino, and Rizon Trucks in 2026 following their merger agreement.

companies.name: High Voltage Engineering Corporation
companies.description: High Voltage Engineering Corporation was an American manufacturer of particle accelerators and one of the first venture capital-backed startups.

companies.name: W. R. Berkley
companies.description: W. R. Berkley Corporation is an American commercial lines property and casualty insurance holding company. It is organized in Delaware and based in Greenwich, Connecticut. The company operates in the insurance industry.

companies.name: Steel Authority of India Limited
companies.description: Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) is an Indian public sector steel manufacturing corporation based in New Delhi. It is designated as a Maharatna CPSE and is the largest government-owned steel producer in India. The company was incorporated on 24 January 1973 and operates under the Ministry of Steel.

companies.name: Atotech
companies.description: Atotech is a German speciality chemicals and equipment company operating in 40 countries. It provides chemistry and equipment for manufacturing printed circuit boards, IC-substrates, semiconductors, and surface finishing in various industries including automotive and construction.

companies.name: MBIA
companies.description: MBIA Inc. is an American financial services company founded in 1973 as the Municipal Bond Insurance Association. It is headquartered in Purchase, New York. As of 2015, the company had approximately 180 employees.

companies.name: Lowe's
companies.description: Lowe's Companies, Inc. is an American retail company specializing in home improvement. Headquartered in Mooresville, North Carolina, it operates a chain of retail stores across the United States. As of 2022, Lowe's operated 2,181 home improvement and hardware stores in North America.

companies.name: Evotec
companies.description: Evotec SE is a publicly listed drug discovery and development company headquartered in Hamburg, Germany. It operates globally through alliances with pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, academic institutions, and others. The company has a pipeline of more than 130 partnered programs in various stages of development.

companies.name: Evraz
companies.description: EVRAZ plc is a UK-incorporated multinational steel manufacturing and mining company. It is part-owned by Russian oligarchs and has operations mainly in Russia, the US, Canada, and Kazakhstan. The company operates in the iron and steel industry.

companies.name: BILLIONS
companies.description: Billions is a South Korean entertainment agency and film and drama production company. In June 2024, the company changed its name from Blade Entertainment to Billions. It operates in the entertainment industry.

companies.name: Expeditors International
companies.description: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. is an American Fortune 500 logistics company headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. It provides optimized and customized supply chain solutions through a global network of over 340 locations in more than 100 countries across six continents.

companies.name: IREN
companies.description: IREN Ltd is an Australian company headquartered in Sydney that provides cloud computing infrastructure and services for artificial intelligence. It develops and operates data centres globally, focusing on renewable energy usage. The company also operates Bitcoin mining facilities transitioning to support its AI cloud business.

companies.name: Taiheiyo Cement
companies.description: Taiheiyo Cement Corporation is a Japanese cement company formed in 1998 by merging Chichibu Onoda and Nihon Cement. It operates in the cement industry in Japan.

companies.name: OceanaGold Philippines
companies.description: OceanaGold Corporation is a gold mining and exploration company based in Vancouver, Canada, and Brisbane, Australia. It was previously known as Macraes Mining Company and GRD Macraes.

companies.name: Qnity
companies.description: Qnity Electronics, Inc. is headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, and supplies materials for semiconductor manufacturing and electronics industries. It produces products for chemical-mechanical polishing, photolithography, and OLED displays, and owns the Kapton brand.

companies.name: SoftBlue
companies.description: SoftBlue S.A. (InTechHouse) is a Polish technology company headquartered in Bydgoszcz and Dallas. Founded in 2003, it operates in IT, electronics, and telecommunications, serving enterprises and public institutions, and holds a research and development centre status from the Polish Ministry of Development and Technology.

companies.name: FTSE MIB
companies.description: The FTSE MIB is the benchmark stock market index for the Borsa Italiana, Italy's national stock exchange. It includes 40 highly liquid and capitalised shares and is operated by Borsa Italiana, part of the Euronext group since 2021.

companies.name: FICO
companies.description: FICO, originally Fair, Isaac and Company, is an American data analytics company based in Bozeman, Montana. Founded in 1956, it is known for its FICO score, a widely used measure of consumer credit risk in the United States.

companies.name: Fairfax Financial
companies.description: Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited is a Canadian diversified financial holding company headquartered in Toronto. Founded in 1985, it focuses on property and casualty insurance and reinsurance, with operations spanning consumer services, retail, logistics, agriculture, hospitality, and banking globally.

companies.name: Bao Viet Holdings
companies.description: Bao Viet is the largest Vietnamese insurance company and the seventh largest listed company in Vietnam by market capitalization. It is state-owned, has a strategic partnership with HSBC, and has diversified into stock trading, fund management, real estate, banking, hotels, and construction.

companies.name: Haima Automobile
companies.description: Haima Automobile Co., Ltd., trading as Haima, is a Chinese automotive manufacturer based in Haikou, Hainan. Its main activity is producing passenger cars for other companies.

companies.name: Austral Gold
companies.description: Austral Gold is a mining company headquartered in Sydney, Australia. It focuses on the exploration, development, and production of gold and silver with assets located in South America and the United States. The company is dual-listed on the Australian Securities Exchange and the TSX Venture Exchange.

companies.name: Federal Signal Corporation
companies.description: Federal Signal Corporation is an American manufacturer based in Downers Grove, Illinois. It produces street sweeper vehicles, public address systems, emergency vehicle equipment, and emergency vehicle lighting. The company serves various public safety and municipal markets.

companies.name: Zagrebačka banka
companies.description: Zagrebačka Banka, also known as ZABA, is the largest bank in Croatia. It is owned by the Milan-based UniCredit. The bank plays a significant role in the Croatian banking sector.

companies.name: Western Mining Company
companies.description: Western Mining Co., Ltd. is a major Chinese metal mining and smelting company headquartered in Xining, Qinghai Province. It explores, mines, processes, and sells non-ferrous and precious metals including copper, lead, zinc, iron, gold, and silver. It is one of China's largest producers of lead and zinc concentrates.

companies.name: Rediff
companies.description: Rediff.com is an Indian website offering news, information, entertainment, email services, and shopping. Founded in 1996 by Ajit Balakrishnan, it was the first Indian website to become a mainstream news media organization. The company is headquartered in Mumbai with offices in Bengaluru, New Delhi, and New York City.

companies.name: TelecityGroup
companies.description: Telecity Group plc was a European carrier-neutral data centre and colocation provider based in the United Kingdom. It specialized in designing, building, and managing datacentre space. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Equinix in January 2016.

companies.name: Man Group
companies.description: Man Group plc is an active investment management firm headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It provides investment funds for institutional and private investors and is the world's largest publicly traded hedge fund company. The company was a sponsor of the Man Booker Prize from 2002 to 2019.

companies.name: Industrial Bank Co.
companies.description: The Industrial Bank Co., Ltd., officially Fujian Industrial Bank Joint-Stock Corporation, Limited, is a commercial bank based in Fuzhou, Fujian province, China. In 2023, it was ranked 60th in the Forbes Global 2000 list. The bank operates within the Chinese financial sector.

companies.name: Fidessa
companies.description: Fidessa group Holdings Ltd is a British-headquartered company providing financial markets software and services. Its offerings include trading and investment management systems, analytics, and market data for buy side and sell side clients in the financial services sector.

companies.name: NRJ Group
companies.description: The NRJ Group is a French multimedia group based in Paris. Founded in 1981 by Jean-Paul Baudecroux and Max Guazzini, it started as a French pop music radio station and has since evolved into a broader multimedia company.

companies.name: Skydance
companies.description: Skydance Corporation is an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate headquartered in Midtown Manhattan, New York. It was formed through the merger of Skydance Media and Paramount Global in 2025 and later acquired Warner Bros. Discovery in 2026, adopting its current name.

companies.name: GDEV Inc.
companies.description: GDEV Inc. is a gaming and entertainment holding company headquartered in Limassol, Cyprus. It evolved from the video game company Nexters in 2023 and owns subsidiaries including Nexters Studio and Cubic Games. The company is known for mobile games such as Throne Rush and Hero Wars.

companies.name: Hirose Electric Group
companies.description: Hirose Electric Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company specializing in manufacturing electric connectors. Founded in 1937, it changed its name to Hirose Electric in 1963 and began international sales in 1968.

companies.name: Finning
companies.description: Finning is a Canadian industrial equipment dealer specializing in Caterpillar products. It sells, rents, and provides parts and service for equipment used in mining, construction, petroleum, forestry, and power systems. It is the largest Caterpillar dealer worldwide.

companies.name: Spizzico
companies.description: Spizzico is a chain of franchised quick-service pizzerias owned by the Italian multinational catering company Autogrill.

companies.name: FirstEnergy
companies.description: FirstEnergy Corp. is an American electric utility headquartered in Akron, Ohio. It was established in 1997 through the merger of Ohio Edison and Centerior Energy.

companies.name: First Horizon National Corporation
companies.description: First Horizon Corporation, formerly First Tennessee Bank, is a financial services company based in Memphis, Tennessee. Founded in 1864, it operates through its banking subsidiary in 12 states across the Southeast and is the fourth largest regional bank in that area.

companies.name: First Quantum Minerals
companies.description: First Quantum Minerals is a Canadian mining and metals company focused on mineral exploration, development, and mining. Its main product is copper, which accounted for 82% of its revenues as of 2025.

companies.name: Handelsbanken
companies.description: Svenska Handelsbanken AB is a Nordic bank headquartered in Sweden with international operations. It offers a wide range of financial services including corporate and investment banking, trading, and consumer banking, and operates in countries such as Norway, the Netherlands, and the UK.

companies.name: Faurecia
companies.description: Forvia SE, formerly Faurecia SE, is a French global automotive supplier headquartered near Paris. It is a leading manufacturer of automotive parts, specializing in seats, exhaust systems, interior systems, and decorative vehicle components.

companies.name: Mitsubishi Materials
companies.description: Mitsubishi Materials Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of cement products, copper and aluminum products, cemented carbide tools, and electronic materials. It is one of the core companies of the Mitsubishi Group. The company is based in Japan.

companies.name: Sunoco
companies.description: Sunoco LP is an American vehicle gasoline master limited partnership headquartered in Dallas, Texas. Founded in 1886, it has transitioned from a vertically integrated energy company to a distributor of fuels and operator of energy infrastructure. It previously engaged in oil and gas exploration, refining, chemical manufacturing, and retail fuel sales.

companies.name: Inchcape plc
companies.description: Inchcape plc is a British multinational automotive distribution company headquartered in London, England. It originated from the Calcutta-based Mackinnon Mackenzie Company and operates in 38 countries worldwide. Inchcape is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Kawai Musical Instruments
companies.description: Kawai Musical Instruments Manufacturing Co., Ltd. is a musical instrument manufacturer headquartered in Hamamatsu, Shizuoka, Japan. Founded in August 1927, it is known for producing grand pianos, upright pianos, digital pianos, electronic keyboards, and synthesizers.

companies.name: Flatexdegiro
companies.description: Flatexdegiro SE is a German listed online brokerage and financial technology company based in Frankfurt am Main. It operates the Flatex, Degiro, and ViTrade brokerage platforms through Flatexdegiro Bank. It is one of Europe's largest retail online brokers.

companies.name: News Corp
companies.description: News Corporation, known as News Corp, is an American mass media and publishing company headquartered in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. Formed in 2013 as a spin-off of the first News Corporation, it operates across digital real estate, news media, book publishing, and cable television. Notable assets include Dow Jones & Company and HarperCollins.

companies.name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation
companies.description: The Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) is an Indian government-owned oil and gas explorer and producer headquartered in Delhi. It accounts for about 70% of India's crude oil production and 84% of natural gas production. ONGC was founded in 1956 and has Maharatna status conferred by the Government of India.

companies.name: Prosafe SE
companies.description: Prosafe SE is a company specializing in owning and operating semi-submersible accommodation vessels. It is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange. The company is based in Norway.

companies.name: Hyperion Solutions Corporation
companies.description: Hyperion Solutions Corporation was a software company based in Santa Clara, California, acquired by Oracle Corporation in 2007. Its products targeted business intelligence and performance management markets. Hyperion was formed in 1998 from the merger of Hyperion Software and Arbor Software.

companies.name: Huhtamäki
companies.description: Huhtamäki Oyj is a global food packaging company headquartered in Espoo, Finland. It produces paper and plastic disposable tableware, flexible packaging, labels, egg cartons, trays, and cup carriers for various industries including food service and pharmaceuticals.

companies.name: Harris Corporation
companies.description: Harris Corporation was an American technology company and defense contractor that produced wireless equipment, tactical radios, electronic systems, and antennas for government, defense, emergency service, and commercial sectors. It specialized in surveillance solutions and electronic warfare. In 2019, it merged with L3 Technologies to form L3Harris Technologies.

companies.name: Unum
companies.description: Unum Group is an American insurance company headquartered in Chattanooga, Tennessee. Founded in 1848, it was created by the 1999 merger of Unum Corporation and The Provident Companies. The company operates four businesses across the US, UK, Poland, and Colonial Life.

companies.name: Luxoft
companies.description: Luxoft is a software development company headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, and a subsidiary of DXC Technology. It operates in 21 countries with over 17,000 employees and has large offices in the US, Poland, Germany, Bulgaria, India, Ukraine, Singapore, and Serbia.

companies.name: Stockland
companies.description: Stockland Corporation Limited is one of Australia's largest residential property development companies. It specializes in master-planned communities and owns and develops retail town centers, logistics, business parks, office assets, residential communities, and retirement living villages.

companies.name: Fortescue Ltd
companies.description: Fortescue is an Australian global metal mining and energy company. It focused on iron ore mining under the name Fortescue Metals Group until merging with Fortescue Energy in 2023. It is the fourth-largest iron ore producer globally and holds the largest tenement area in Western Australia's Pilbara region.

companies.name: Fortis Inc.
companies.description: Fortis Inc. is a Canadian electric utility holding company based in St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador. It operates in Canada, the United States, Central America, and the Caribbean. The company is involved in electricity generation and distribution.

companies.name: Fostex
companies.description: Foster Denki KK is a Japanese electronics company that manufactures loudspeakers and audio equipment. It sells products under the trade name Fostex and is traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Kingsoft
companies.description: Kingsoft Corporation is a Chinese software company based in Beijing. It operates subsidiaries in video game development, mobile internet apps, cloud storage, and office software. Its popular game JX Online 3 was launched in 2009.

companies.name: Lucky Cement
companies.description: Lucky Cement Limited is a Pakistani conglomerate headquartered in Karachi. Named after Lakki Marwat where its first plant was commissioned in 1993, it is one of Pakistan's largest cement producers. The company is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.

companies.name: SDL
companies.description: SDL plc was a British multinational professional services company based in Maidenhead, UK. It specialized in language translation software and services and was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by RWS Group in 2020.

companies.name: Alvarion
companies.description: Alvarion Technologies Ltd. is an Israeli company providing autonomous Wi-Fi networks with self-organizing capabilities. Their solutions serve carrier-grade Wi-Fi, enterprise connectivity, smart city planning, hospitality, campuses, and events. The company focuses on advanced wireless network technologies.

companies.name: Française des jeux
companies.description: La Française des Jeux operates the national lottery games in France and the Republic of Ireland. It was formerly government-owned and became partially public in 2018 when the French government sold half its stake. The company also sponsors the FDJ cycling team.

companies.name: Dollar General
companies.description: Dollar General Corporation is an American discount store chain headquartered in Goodlettsville, Tennessee. It operates thousands of stores across the contiguous United States and Mexico. The company focuses on retailing a variety of consumer goods.

companies.name: Hormel
companies.description: Hormel Foods Corporation is a U.S.-based multinational food processing company founded in 1891 in Austin, Minnesota. It produces packaged and refrigerated foods including ham, sausage, and Spam. Hormel's products are sold in over 80 countries worldwide.

companies.name: Tan Chong Motor Holdings Berhad
companies.description: Tan Chong Motor Holdings Berhad is a Malaysian multinational corporation involved in automobile assembly, manufacturing, distribution, and sales. Founded in 1957, it is best known as the Nissan franchise holder in Malaysia. The company was listed on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange in 1974.

companies.name: Sega Sammy Holdings
companies.description: Sega Sammy Holdings Inc. is a Japanese global holding company formed in 2004 by merging Sega and Sammy Corporation. Both companies operate in the amusement industry. The conglomerate is headquartered in Japan.

companies.name: Revlon
companies.description: Revlon, Inc. is an American multinational company headquartered in New York City, founded in 1932. It produces cosmetics, skin care, perfume, and personal care products sold in 150 countries. The company has global locations including Mexico City, London, Paris, and Tokyo.

companies.name: Nordgold
companies.description: Nord Gold S.E. (Nordgold) is a gold mining company with assets in Russia, Kazakhstan, Burkina Faso, Guinea, and Canada. The company operates internationally in the gold mining sector.

companies.name: National Grid plc
companies.description: National Grid plc is a British multinational electricity transmission company headquartered in London. It operates electricity transmission networks in Great Britain and the Northeastern United States, also producing and supplying electricity and gas in New York and Massachusetts.

companies.name: Sage Group
companies.description: The Sage Group plc is a British multinational enterprise software company headquartered in Newcastle upon Tyne. It develops accounting, financial management, payroll, and human-resources software mainly for small and medium-sized businesses. Its products include Sage 50, Sage Intacct, and Sage X3.

companies.name: Hospira
companies.description: Hospira was an American global pharmaceutical and medical device company headquartered in Lake Forest, Illinois. It was the world's largest producer of generic injectable pharmaceuticals before being acquired by Pfizer in 2015. Hospira's products were used by hospitals and other healthcare providers worldwide.

companies.name: Yokohama Rubber Company
companies.description: The Yokohama Rubber Company is a Japanese manufacturing company based in Hiratsuka, Japan. Founded in 1917 as a joint venture, it produces tires, rims, and golf equipment. The company expanded to the United States in 1969 as Yokohama Tire Corporation.

companies.name: HRG Group
companies.description: HRG Group, Inc. was a holding company based in Rochester, New York, originally started as an oil company involving former U.S. president George H. W. Bush. It was renamed Harbinger Group Inc. in 2009 and merged with Spectrum Brands in 2018, after which the HRG Group name was discontinued.

companies.name: ManpowerGroup
companies.description: ManpowerGroup is an American multinational corporation headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Founded in 1948, it is the third-largest staffing firm globally and provides administrative, professional, and business services through its four primary brands.

companies.name: Klabin
companies.description: Klabin is a Brazilian paper producing, exporting, and recycling company headquartered in São Paulo. It is the largest paper producer and exporter in Brazil, focusing on pulp, packaging paper, corrugated cardboard, and industrial sacks. The company is controlled by Klabin Irmãos & Cia and NIBLAK Participações S/A.

companies.name: Petroleum Geo-Services
companies.description: Petroleum Geo-Services (PGS) was a Norwegian oilfield service company providing geophysical services worldwide. Its seismic services helped oil companies identify offshore oil and gas reserves, offering products from survey planning to advanced imaging and reservoir analysis.

companies.name: NET
companies.description: NET was a Brazilian telecommunications company offering cable television, broadband internet, and telephony services. Owned by América Móvil, the NET brand was absorbed into the Claro brand in 2019 and discontinued in 2022.

companies.name: TUI Travel
companies.description: TUI Travel PLC was a British leisure travel group headquartered in Crawley, West Sussex. Formed in 2007 by merging First Choice Holidays and TUI AG's tourism division, it operated in 180 countries and served 30 million customers.

companies.name: Seadrill
companies.description: Seadrill is a Bermuda-based offshore drilling contractor providing worldwide drilling services to the oil and gas industry. It owns and operates drillships, semi-submersible rigs, and jack-up rigs for operations in various water depths and environments.

companies.name: Smithfield Foods
companies.description: Smithfield Foods, Inc. is an American pork producer and food-processing company based in Smithfield, Virginia. Founded in 1936, it is the largest pig and pork producer globally and is majority owned by Hong Kong-based WH Group. The company operates farms and processing facilities in multiple countries.

companies.name: Shanghai Pudong Development Bank
companies.description: Shanghai Pudong Development Bank, also known as SPD Bank, is a city-owned joint-stock commercial bank established in 1993. It is owned by the Shanghai Municipal Government and operates primarily in China.

companies.name: PCCW Limited
companies.description: PCCW Limited is an information and communication technology and telecommunications company based in Hong Kong. It provides ICT and telecom services in the region.

companies.name: Esure
companies.description: Esure Group plc is an insurance company based in Reigate, England, with additional offices in Manchester and Glasgow. It operates primarily through internet and telephone channels.

companies.name: GD Power Development Company
companies.description: GD Power Development Company is a subsidiary of China Guodian Corporation engaged in electric power and heat generation and supply. Founded in 1992, it is headquartered in Beijing, China, and was listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 1997.

companies.name: GOME Electrical Appliances
companies.description: GOME Retail Holdings Ltd., formerly GOME Electrical Appliances Holding Ltd., is one of the largest privately owned electrical appliance retailers in mainland China and Hong Kong. Founded in Beijing in 1987, it expanded beyond Beijing since 1999 and is incorporated in Bermuda.

companies.name: Delhaize Le Lion
companies.description: Delhaize Group SA was a Belgian multinational retail company headquartered in Brussels, operating food supermarkets in seven countries across three continents. In 2015, it merged with Ahold to form Ahold Delhaize.

companies.name: Lagardère Group
companies.description: Lagardère S.A. is an international group based in Paris, France, with operations in over 50 countries. Founded in 1992 by Jean-Luc Lagardère, it was originally named Matra, Hachette & Lagardère.

companies.name: Galp Energia
companies.description: Galp Energia is a Portuguese multinational energy corporation headquartered in Lisbon. Founded in 1999 through a merger, it operates in oil and natural gas supply, exploration, refining, trading, logistics, retailing, and renewable energy.

companies.name: Gecina
companies.description: Gecina is a French real estate group owning and managing property holdings mainly in the Paris Region. It is a real estate investment trust listed on Euronext Paris, with a portfolio including offices, residential assets, and student residences.

companies.name: Science Applications International Corporation
companies.description: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC) is an American technology company headquartered in Reston, Virginia. It provides government services and information technology support. SAIC focuses on delivering technology solutions primarily to government clients.

companies.name: Genworth Financial
companies.description: Genworth Financial is an American financial services company headquartered in Richmond, Virginia. It offers life insurance, long-term care insurance, mortgage insurance, and annuities. The company operates primarily in the insurance sector.

companies.name: GEO Group
companies.description: The GEO Group, Inc. is an American private prison and mental health facility operator. It owns or manages 80,000 beds at 95 facilities across the United States, Australia, South Africa, and the United Kingdom. GEO is the largest prison operator in the United States and operates government-owned facilities under management contracts.

companies.name: CooperVision
companies.description: CooperVision is an American company that manufactures soft contact lenses and is a business unit of The Cooper Companies. Founded in 1980 and headquartered in Pleasanton, California, its products are sold in over 100 countries. It has manufacturing locations worldwide and major distribution centers in the UK, US, and Belgium.

companies.name: Las Vegas Sands
companies.description: Las Vegas Sands Corp. is an American casino and resort company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada. It was founded by Sheldon G. Adelson and partners, originating from the Sands Hotel and Casino on the Las Vegas Strip. The company redeveloped the Sands into The Venetian and opened The Palazzo resort.

companies.name: The Wharf (Holdings) Limited
companies.description: The Wharf (Holdings) Limited is a Hong Kong-based company founded in 1886. Originally focused on wharfage and dockside warehousing, it was initially known as The Hong Kong and Kowloon Wharf and Godown Company, Limited. The company adopted its current name in 1986 and is majorly held by Wheelock & Co.

companies.name: Outotec
companies.description: Outotec Oyj was a Finnish company headquartered in Espoo that provided technologies and services for the metal and mineral processing industries. In 2020, it merged with Metso Minerals to form Metso Outotec. The company specialized in industrial technology solutions.

companies.name: Harmony Gold
companies.description: Harmony Gold is the largest gold mining company in South Africa, founded in 1950 and headquartered in Johannesburg. It operates mining activities in South Africa and Papua New Guinea. The company focuses on gold extraction and production.

companies.name: Tel Aviv Stock Exchange
companies.description: The Tel Aviv Stock Exchange is the only public stock exchange in Israel and is itself a public company listed on its own exchange since August 2019. It is regulated by the Securities Law of 1968 and supervised by the Israel Securities Authority. The exchange is colloquially known as The Bursa.

companies.name: Vitasoy International Holdings
companies.description: Vitasoy International Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based beverage company founded in 1940. It produces a brand of beverages and desserts named Vita. The company is headquartered in Tuen Mun, New Territories, Hong Kong.

companies.name: Safeway
companies.description: Safeway, Inc. is an American supermarket chain operating primarily in the Western United States and some Mid-Atlantic locations. It offers grocery items, general merchandise, and specialty departments including bakery, delicatessen, floral, pharmacy, Starbucks coffee shops, and vehicle fuel centers.

companies.name: Sarepta Therapeutics
companies.description: Sarepta Therapeutics, Inc. is a medical research and drug development company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Founded in 1980 as AntiVirals, it changed its name to Sarepta Therapeutics in 2012. As of 2023, the company has four approved drugs.

companies.name: Craft Brew Alliance
companies.description: Craft Brew Alliance, Inc. was a beer brewing company composed of five beer and cider brands including Redhook Ale Brewery and Kona Brewing Company. It operated in the United States.

companies.name: Dexcom
companies.description: Dexcom, Inc. is an American multinational healthcare company that develops and manufactures continuous glucose monitoring systems for diabetes management. It is headquartered in San Diego, California, with manufacturing facilities in the US, Malaysia, and Ireland.

companies.name: Harmonic Inc.
companies.description: Harmonic Inc. is an American technology company that develops and markets video routing, server, and storage products. Its customers include companies producing, processing, and distributing video content for television and the Internet.

companies.name: Coherent Corp.
companies.description: Coherent Corp. is an American manufacturer of optical materials and semiconductors. In 2022, II-VI acquired laser manufacturer Coherent, Inc. and adopted its name. The company is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker COHR.

companies.name: Innospec
companies.description: Innospec Inc. is an American specialty chemical company formerly known as Octel Corporation. It operates three business units: Performance Chemicals, Fuel Specialties, and Oilfield Services, serving markets including personal care, fuel additives, and drilling chemicals.

companies.name: Investors Bank
companies.description: Investors Bank was a publicly traded full-service bank based in Short Hills, New Jersey. It operated over 150 branches across New Jersey and New York.

companies.name: Luna Innovations
companies.description: Luna Innovations Incorporated is an American company based in Roanoke, Virginia. It develops and manufactures fiber-optics- and terahertz-based technology products for industries including aerospace, automotive, communications, and defense. Its products are used to test, measure, analyze, monitor, protect, and improve products and processes.

companies.name: Maxygen
companies.description: Maxygen Inc. was a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Redwood City, California. It focused on developing improved versions of protein drugs using DNA shuffling and other protein modification technologies. The company was dissolved in 2013.

companies.name: Medivation
companies.description: Medivation, Inc. was an American biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It focused on developing novel therapies to treat serious diseases with limited treatment options. The company began operations in 2004 and its final CEO was David Hung.

companies.name: Natural Alternatives International
companies.description: Natural Alternatives International, Inc. is an American company based in Carlsbad, California that manufactures nutritional supplements such as Juice Plus. Founded in 1980, it operates manufacturing facilities in Vista, California, Switzerland, and Japan.

companies.name: Netlist Inc.
companies.description: Netlist, Inc. is a Delaware-registered corporation headquartered in Irvine, California. It designs and sells high-performance SSDs and modular memory subsystems to enterprise customers and holds patents in server memory and storage technologies. The company trades on the OTCQB market.

companies.name: NewBridge Bank
companies.description: NewBridge Bank was a banking company based in Greensboro, North Carolina, with branches in North Carolina and Virginia. It was formed from the merger of Lexington State Bank and FNB Southeast in 2007 and was the banking subsidiary of NewBridge Bancorp. The bank no longer operates under that name.

companies.name: Tractor Supply Company
companies.description: Tractor Supply Company is an American chain store founded in 1938 and based in Brentwood, Tennessee. It sells home improvement, agriculture, lawn and garden, livestock, equine, and pet care equipment and supplies. The company caters to farmers, ranchers, pet owners, and landowners.

companies.name: WiLAN
companies.description: WiLAN is a technology development and intellectual property licensing company headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. It licenses its own portfolio of patents and collaborates with other patent owners. WiLAN Labs conducts research and development in modern wireless communication methods.

companies.name: Youku
companies.description: Youku Tudou Inc., doing business as Youku, is a subscription video on-demand streaming service and former video sharing website based in Beijing, China. It operates as a subsidiary of Alibaba Group Holding Limited.

companies.name: WME Group
companies.description: WME Group, LLC is an American holding company for talent and media agencies headquartered in Beverly Hills, California. Founded in 2009 after the merger of William Morris Agency and Endeavor Talent Agency, it represents artists across multiple entertainment sectors and owns major sports entertainment companies.

companies.name: Singapore Stock Exchange
companies.description: Singapore Exchange Limited is a Singapore-based exchange conglomerate that operates equity, fixed income, currency, and commodity markets. It offers listing, trading, clearing, settlement, depository, and data services. SGX Group is a member of the World Federation of Exchanges and the Asian and Oceanian Stock Exchanges Federation.

companies.name: Liberty Media
companies.description: Liberty Media Corporation is an American mass media company founded in 1991 by John C. Malone. It is known for diversified media and entertainment investments and the use of tracking stocks. As of 2026, its primary assets include three global motorsport businesses: Formula One, MotoGP, and World Superbikes.

companies.name: Alleghany Corporation
companies.description: Alleghany Corporation is an American investment holding company originally created by railroad entrepreneurs Oris and Mantis Van Sweringen. Incorporated in 1929 and reincorporated in Delaware in 1984, it was acquired by Berkshire Hathaway in October 2022 following an offer in March 2022.

companies.name: Plus500
companies.description: Plus500 is a global multi-asset financial technology company headquartered in Haifa, Israel. It provides online trading services including contracts for difference, share dealing, futures trading, prediction markets, and options on futures. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Jiangxi Copper Company Limited
companies.description: Jiangxi Copper Company Limited is the largest integrated copper producer in China, headquartered in Nanchang, Jiangxi Province. It is a key subsidiary of the state-owned Jiangxi Copper Corporation. The company engages in mining, smelting, refining of copper and other non-ferrous metals, along with related trading and financial services.

companies.name: The Saudi National Bank
companies.description: Saudi National Bank, also known as SNB AlAhli and formerly National Commercial Bank, is the largest commercial bank in Saudi Arabia.

companies.name: Kweichow Moutai Company
companies.description: Kweichow Moutai Co. Ltd. is a Chinese company specializing in the production, sale, and distribution of Maotai liquor, a style of jiangxiang baijiu.

companies.name: Omnicom Group
companies.description: Omnicom Group Inc. is an American multinational media, marketing, and corporate communications holding company headquartered in New York City. It provides services in advertising, customer relationship management, public relations, and specialty services including media planning, digital marketing, and brand consultancy.

companies.name: Sainsbury's
companies.description: J Sainsbury plc, trading as Sainsbury's, is a British supermarket chain and the second-largest in the United Kingdom.

companies.name: CallidusCloud
companies.description: Callidus Software Inc., formerly CallidusCloud, is an enterprise software and SaaS company headquartered in Dublin, California. It markets software and services for sales effectiveness, management, and execution, and is part of the SAP Sales Cloud.

companies.name: GK SOFTWARE AG
companies.description: GK Software is a German technology company headquartered in Schöneck/Vogtland. It specializes in software and services for operating large retail company branches. The company focuses on enterprise software solutions.

companies.name: Gujarat State Fertilizers and Chemicals
companies.description: Gujarat State Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited (GSFC) is an Indian chemicals and fertilizers manufacturer headquartered in Vadodara. Founded in 1962, it is partly owned by the Government of Gujarat. The company produces fertilizers like diammonium phosphate and industrial products such as caprolactam and nylon 6.

companies.name: Gigaset
companies.description: Gigaset AG is a multinational corporation based in Munich, Germany. The summary does not specify its products or services but identifies it as a telecommunications industry company.

companies.name: Gildan Activewear
companies.description: Gildan Activewear Inc. is a Canadian manufacturer of branded clothing including blank activewear like t-shirts and hoodies. It supplies branded and private label socks to US retail companies and operates manufacturing facilities in Honduras and the Caribbean.

companies.name: Hyundai Rotem
companies.description: Hyundai Rotem Company is a South Korean manufacturer of railway rolling stock, signaling, defense products, and plant equipment. It is part of Hyundai Motor Group and operates in over 50 countries worldwide.

companies.name: Kimball International
companies.description: Kimball International, Inc. is an American company consisting of furniture brands such as Kimball and National. It is the successor to W.W. Kimball and Company, once the world's largest piano and organ manufacturer.

companies.name: RetailMeNot
companies.description: RetailMeNot, Inc. is an American multinational company headquartered in Austin, Texas. It operates a collection of coupon websites including RetailMeNot.com and VoucherCodes.co.uk and acquires coupon sites and third-party software.

companies.name: Rockwell Automation
companies.description: Rockwell Automation, Inc. is an American provider of industrial automation and digital transformation technologies headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Its brands include Allen-Bradley and FactoryTalk software, serving customers in over 100 countries.

companies.name: Exelis Inc.
companies.description: Exelis Inc. was an American aerospace, defense, information, and services company headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia. Created in 2011 from ITT Corporation's defense business, it was acquired by Harris Corporation in 2015.

companies.name: Fastjet
