companies.description: Fastjet Limited is an African airline brand that began operations in 2012 in Tanzania. Headquartered in Johannesburg and incorporated in England and Wales, it operates Fastjet Zimbabwe and Federal Airlines, with plans to restart Fastjet Mozambique in 2026.

companies.name: IGB Electronica
companies.description: IGB Eletrônica S.A., known as Gradiente, is a Brazilian consumer electronics company based in Manaus with offices in São Paulo. It designs and markets various product lines including video, audio, home theater, and mobile stereo products for the Brazilian market.

companies.name: Globe Trade Centre
companies.description: Globe Trade Centre S.A. (GTC) is a real estate development group established in 1994, operating in Poland and several Central and Eastern European countries. It focuses on commercial and residential projects, emphasizing sustainable development with certifications like LEED and BREEAM.

companies.name: Uponor
companies.description: Uponor Oyj is a Finnish company headquartered in Helsinki that sells products for drinking water delivery, radiant heating, and cooling. It employs approximately 3,700 people.

companies.name: Noble Group
companies.description: Noble Resources Trading Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based commodity trader dealing in energy products and industrial raw materials. Its predecessor, Noble Group Ltd, faced an accounting fraud controversy starting in 2015, leading to a debt restructuring.

companies.name: Lundin Mining
companies.description: Lundin Mining Corporation is a Canadian mining company headquartered in Vancouver. It owns and operates mines producing base metals like gold, silver, copper, and nickel, with major properties in Chile, Brazil, and the United States.

companies.name: Jack in the Box
companies.description: Jack in the Box, Inc. is an American fast-food restaurant chain founded in 1951 and headquartered in San Diego, California. It primarily serves the West Coast of the U.S. and formerly operated the Qdoba Mexican Grill chain.

companies.name: Kelly Services
companies.description: Kelly Services, Inc. is an American multinational office staffing company headquartered in Troy, Michigan. It provides employee placement across various sectors and offers professional services including HR consulting and recruitment.

companies.name: Oi
companies.description: Oi, formerly Telemar, is a Brazilian telecommunications company headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. It was the largest fixed telephone operator and the fourth largest mobile operator in Brazil, ranking third in Latin America.

companies.name: Sekisui House
companies.description: Sekisui House, Ltd. is a Japanese homebuilder and real estate developer headquartered in Osaka. Founded in 1960, it constructs custom-built houses, rental housing, condominiums, and also engages in remodeling and urban development.

companies.name: Vanguard International Semiconductor Corporation
companies.description: Vanguard International Semiconductor Corporation (VIS) is a Taiwanese IC foundry service provider founded in 1994 in Hsinchu Science Park. It became publicly listed in 1998 with major shareholders including TSMC and the National Development Fund.

companies.name: The Timberland Company
companies.description: Timberland LLC is an American manufacturer and retailer of outdoor footwear and apparel, headquartered in Stratham, New Hampshire. The company also sells accessories such as watches, eyewear, and leather goods. It is owned by VF Corporation.

companies.name: VSMPO-AVISMA
companies.description: VSMPO-AVISMA Corporation is a Russian mining company and the world's third-largest producer of titanium sponge. It operates facilities in multiple countries including Russia, Ukraine, England, Switzerland, Germany, and the United States. The company produces titanium, aluminum, magnesium, and steel alloys and serves aerospace companies globally.

companies.name: Usiminas
companies.description: Usiminas is one of the largest steel producers in the Americas, with major steel mills located in Brazil. The company accounts for 28% of Brazil's total steel output. It has a total steel production capacity of 9.5 million metric tons per year.

companies.name: GPA
companies.description: Companhia Brasileira de Distribuição, or GPA, is the largest Brazilian retailer of food, general merchandise, electronics, and home appliances. Its stores include supermarkets, hypermarkets, and home appliance outlets. The company is headquartered in São Paulo and is owned by Free Float.

companies.name: Iridium Communications
companies.description: Iridium Communications Inc. is an American satellite communications company headquartered in McLean, Virginia. It operates the Iridium satellite constellation of 80 satellites for worldwide voice and data communication. The company also hosts space-based ADS-B receivers through its subsidiary Aireon.

companies.name: Gree Electric
companies.description: GREE Electric Appliances Inc. of Zhuhai is a Chinese home appliances manufacturer headquartered in Zhuhai, Guangdong province. It is the world's largest air-conditioner manufacturer and produces household and commercial air conditioners along with other appliances. The company has joint ventures with Daikin.

companies.name: Teleste
companies.description: Teleste Oyj is an international technology group specializing in broadband, security, and information technologies and related services. Its customers include data communications operators, train manufacturers, public transport operators, and public sector organizations.

companies.name: Magic Software Enterprises Ltd.
companies.description: Magic Software Enterprises Ltd is a global enterprise software company headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel. It was listed on Nasdaq and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange until its sale to Matrix IT Ltd. in February 2026.

companies.name: WHSmith
companies.description: WH Smith plc is a British travel retailer operating in Europe, North America, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East. It mainly operates in airports, railway stations, hospitals, and motorway service stations, selling refreshments, books, and entertainment under brands like WHSmith and InMotion.

companies.name: TEAC Corporation
companies.description: TEAC Corporation is a Japanese electronics manufacturer formed by the merger of the Tokyo Television Acoustic Company and the Tokyo Electro-Acoustic Company. It was created from companies founded in 1953 and 1956 respectively. The company is based in Japan.

companies.name: Ormat Technologies
companies.description: Ormat Technologies, Inc. is an international company based in Reno, Nevada, United States. It supplies alternative and renewable geothermal energy technology and has built over 190 power plants. The company also produces turbines, generators, and heat exchangers.

companies.name: Triumph Group
companies.description: Triumph Group, Inc. is an American aerospace supplier based in Radnor, Pennsylvania. It engineers, designs, and manufactures aircraft components, systems, and accessories. The company operates through three organizations: Integrated Systems, Aerospace Structures, and Product Support.

companies.name: GAC Group
companies.description: Guangzhou Automobile Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese state-owned automobile manufacturer headquartered in Guangzhou, Guangdong. It was the fifth largest automobile manufacturer in China as of 2021. The company operates in the automotive industry.

companies.name: Shanghai Construction Group
companies.description: Shanghai Construction (Group) Corporation is a Chinese construction and engineering company. It is ranked as the 16th largest construction company in the world based on 2011 revenues. The company operates in the civil engineering sector.

companies.name: Gudang Garam
companies.description: PT Gudang Garam Tbk is an Indonesian tobacco company known for its kretek products. It is Indonesia's largest tobacco manufacturer with a market share of nearly 33%. The company was founded in 1958 by Tjoa Ing Hwie, later known as Surya Wonowidjojo.

companies.name: Lawson
companies.description: Lawson, Inc. is a convenience store franchise chain in the Asia-Pacific region. Originally founded in the United States, it is now a Japanese company headquartered in Shinagawa, Tokyo. The company operates in the food retail sector.

companies.name: VEON
companies.description: VEON Ltd. is a multinational telecommunications and digital services company headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It is publicly traded on the Nasdaq stock exchange. The company operates in the telecommunications industry.

companies.name: Air Berlin
companies.description: Air Berlin was a major German airline headquartered in Berlin. It was Germany's second-largest airline and Europe's tenth-largest by passengers carried. The airline had hubs at Berlin Tegel and Düsseldorf Airports and was a member of the Oneworld alliance.

companies.name: Kohlberg Kravis Roberts
companies.description: KKR & Co. Inc., also known as Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co., is an American investment firm serving institutional investors, wealth investors, family offices, and companies across various industries. It operates in asset management, insurance, and Strategic Holdings. KKR is one of the world's largest alternative asset management firms.

companies.name: Synaptics
companies.description: Synaptics, Inc. is an American technology company based in San Jose, California, specializing in computer-to-human interface devices. It develops touchpads, fingerprint biometrics, and other technologies for laptops, smartphones, smart home devices, wearables, and automobiles. Synaptics sells its products to original equipment manufacturers and display manufacturers.

companies.name: Arcos Dorados Holdings
companies.description: Arcos Dorados Holdings is the master franchise of McDonald's in 20 countries and territories across Latin America and the Caribbean. It operates nearly 2,400 restaurants, making it the largest independent McDonald's franchisee globally and the largest quick-service restaurant chain in the region.

companies.name: Yingli
companies.description: Yingli Green Energy Holding Company Limited, also known as Yingli Solar, is a solar panel manufacturer. It covers the photovoltaic value chain from ingot casting and wafering through solar cell production and solar panel assembly. The company is based in China.

companies.name: Corcept Therapeutics
companies.description: Corcept Therapeutics Inc. is a pharmaceutical company focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing drugs for severe metabolic, psychiatric, and oncologic disorders. It studies compounds that may mitigate the adverse effects of excess cortisol. The company is led by CEO Joseph K. Belanoff, MD.

companies.name: Hang Lung Properties
companies.description: Hang Lung Properties is a Hong Kong-based property developer and a subsidiary of Hang Lung Group. Formerly known as Amoy Properties, it is headquartered in the Standard Chartered Bank Building in Central, Hong Kong. It is a member of the Hang Seng Index Constituent Stocks.

companies.name: Hang Seng Bank
companies.description: Hang Seng Bank Limited is a Hong Kong-based banking and financial services company headquartered in Central, Hong Kong. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of the HSBC Group.

companies.name: Koei Tecmo Holdings
companies.description: Koei Tecmo Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japanese holding company in the video game, amusement, and anime industries. It was created in 2009 by merging Koei and Tecmo. The company and its subsidiaries were known as Tecmo Koei until 2014 when the name was reversed to Koei Tecmo.

companies.name: Marathon Oil
companies.description: Marathon Oil Corporation was an American company engaged in hydrocarbon exploration. In November 2024, it was acquired by ConocoPhillips.

companies.name: Ultrapar
companies.description: The Ultra Group is a Brazilian conglomerate operating in energy and logistics infrastructure through subsidiaries Ipiranga, Ultragaz, and Ultracargo. These subsidiaries are fully controlled by the holding company Ultrapar. Its shares are traded on the São Paulo and New York stock exchanges.

companies.name: Hutchison Whampoa
companies.description: Hutchison Whampoa Limited was a Hong Kong-based investment holding company with diverse holdings including the world's biggest port and telecommunications operations in 14 countries under the 3 brand. It was a Fortune Global 500 company and one of the largest listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. Its businesses also included retail, property development, and infrastructure.

companies.name: Invitrogen
companies.description: Invitrogen is a brand under Thermo Fisher Scientific in the United States, offering biotechnology products such as machines and consumables for PCR, cloning, cell therapy, immunotherapy, DNA/RNA purification, diagnostic tests, antibodies, and immunoassays. It is part of a larger corporation specializing in scientific products.

companies.name: Iseki
companies.description: Iseki & Co., Ltd. is a Japanese agricultural machinery manufacturer based in Matsuyama and Tokyo. It is the third largest in Japan and produces tractors, combine harvesters, rice transplanters, mowers, tillers, components, and diesel engines.

companies.name: Orbite Aluminae
companies.description: Orbite Technologies Inc. was a Canadian cleantech company based in Montreal specializing in alumina extraction processes for the mining industry. Its Orbite process aimed to replace the Bayer process and treat red mud. The company declared bankruptcy in 2017 but rebranded as Advanced Energy Minerals by 2022, manufacturing high purity alumina at its Cap-Chat plant.

companies.name: KPIT Technologies
companies.logo_file: KPIT Technologies New Brand Visual Identity 2019.png
companies.description: KPIT Technologies Ltd is an Indian multinational providing engineering research and development services to automotive companies. Headquartered in Pune, it operates development centers in Europe, USA, Brazil, Japan, China, and India.

companies.name: Tianwei Baobian Electric
companies.description: Baoding Tianwei Baobian Electric Co., Ltd. (BTW) is a Chinese manufacturer of power transformers and electrical equipment. It is one of the major transformer manufacturers in China alongside Tebian Electric Apparatus and the XD Group.

companies.name: Monotype
companies.description: Monotype Imaging Holdings Inc., founded in 1887 in Philadelphia, is an American company specializing in digital typesetting and typeface design for consumer electronics. Based in Woburn, Massachusetts, it developed many widely used typefaces including Times New Roman, Gill Sans, and Arial.

companies.name: Dali Foods Group
companies.description: Dali Foods Group is a baked goods company headquartered in Hui'an County, Quanzhou, Fujian, China. It operates in the food industry within China.

companies.name: Vesuvius plc
companies.description: Vesuvius plc is a British engineered ceramics company headquartered in London. Its products serve steelmakers, foundries, glass, and solar energy industries. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Keppel Ltd.
companies.description: Keppel Ltd. is a Singaporean company headquartered in Keppel Bay Tower, HarbourFront, with operations in over 20 countries. Since 2024, it has been organized into four main business platforms: Infrastructure, Real Estate, Connectivity, and Fund Management & Investment.

companies.name: LSI Corporation
companies.description: LSI Logic Corporation was an American company based in Santa Clara, California. It designed and sold semiconductors and software that accelerated storage and networking in data centers, mobile networks, and client computing. The company specialized in ASIC and EDA technologies.

companies.name: Blom
companies.description: Blom is a European service provider headquartered in Oslo, Norway, specializing in acquisition, processing, and modeling of geographical information. It maintains European databases of maps, images, and models, focusing on online services for government, enterprise, and consumer markets. Blom is a subsidiary of NRC Group, listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Jinduicheng Molybdenum
companies.description: Jinduicheng Molybdenum Group Mining Corporation is a Chinese company engaged in molybdenum production, sales, and manufacturing. It provides various molybdenum materials including charging materials, metal products, and chemical products. The company operates in the industrial and chemical sectors.

companies.name: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Company
companies.description: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Company, Inc. is a Japanese company operating in the chemical industry. The summary provides limited information beyond its nationality and industry classification.

companies.name: Zhihu
companies.description: Zhihu is a Chinese social question and answer site and news aggregator originally based in Chengdu. Launched in 2011, it has developed features similar to Reddit and is often compared to Quora. It serves a large user base in China.

companies.name: Medialink Group
companies.description: Medialink Group Limited is a content distributor and licensor based in Kowloon, Hong Kong. It specializes in distributing Japanese anime and brand licensing, with offices located on Mody Road, Tsim Sha Tsui.

companies.name: Lao Feng Xiang Company Limited
companies.description: Lao Feng Xiang is a Chinese jewelry brand with a history spanning 174 years of continuous operation. It is recognized as one of the oldest jewelry brands in China.

companies.name: iQIYI
companies.description: iQIYI is a Chinese subscription video on-demand streaming service owned by Baidu. It distributes original and acquired films and television shows across various genres. The service was formerly known as Qiyi.

companies.name: Sands China
companies.description: Sands China Limited is an integrated resort developer and operator based in Macau. It is a majority-owned subsidiary of Las Vegas Sands Corporation and operates in the tourism industry.

companies.name: Xunlei Limited
companies.description: Xunlei Limited is a Chinese multinational technology company and online service provider founded in 2003. Its headquarters are in Nanshan District, Shenzhen. The company has a subsidiary named Shenzhen Xunlei Networking Technologies, Co., Ltd.

companies.name: Shenghe Resources
companies.description: Shenghe Resources is a Chinese partly state-owned company specializing in rare earths mining and processing. Founded in 1998, it is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange. The Ministry of Natural Resources is its largest shareholder, and it is affiliated with Aluminum Corporation of China, which influences its strategic decisions.

companies.name: Quidel
companies.description: QuidelOrtho Corporation is an American manufacturer of diagnostic healthcare products sold worldwide. It operates in the health care industry and is based in the United States.

companies.name: Haynes International
companies.description: Haynes International, Inc. is a subsidiary of Acerinox headquartered in Kokomo, Indiana. It produces corrosion-resistant and high-temperature alloys marketed under the Hastelloy and Haynes brands, serving industries such as aerospace and chemical processing.

companies.name: Hitron
companies.description: Hitron Technologies is a Taiwanese telecommunication equipment supplier founded in 1986 and headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

companies.name: Kinki Sharyo
companies.description: Kinki Sharyo Co., Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of railroad vehicles based in Osaka. Founded in 1920 and renamed in 1945, it produces rolling stock including Shinkansen high-speed trains and is an affiliate of Kintetsu Corporation.

companies.name: Tivity Health
companies.description: Tivity Health is an administrator of fitness and wellness services headquartered in Franklin, Tennessee. Founded in 1981 as American Healthways, it rebranded in 2017 and acquired Nutrisystem Inc. in 2019 before selling the nutrition business in 2020.

companies.name: China Zheshang Bank
companies.description: China Zheshang Bank is a national joint-stock commercial bank based in China. It is regulated by the People's Bank of China.

companies.name: Union Bank of Taiwan
companies.description: Union Bank of Taiwan is a bank headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan. It employs over 3,600 people.

companies.name: Huaneng Renewables
companies.description: Huaneng Renewables Corporation Limited is a Chinese electricity generation company and a subsidiary of China Huaneng Group. It primarily generates electricity from wind farms.

companies.name: China Cinda Asset Management Co., Ltd.
companies.description: China Cinda Asset Management Co., Ltd., known as Cinda, is a Chinese distressed asset management company headquartered in Beijing.

companies.name: Senao International
companies.description: Senao International, Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese distributor of cellular phones, smartphones, tablets, notebooks, game consoles, and related accessories. Founded in 1979, it is a public company listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange and a subsidiary of Chunghwa Telecom. Senao International holds over 50% market share as the largest cellular phone distributor in Taiwan.

companies.name: Martinrea
companies.description: Martinrea International Inc. is an auto parts manufacturer based in Vaughan, Ontario, Canada. It operates in North America, Europe, and Asia, serving as a supplier for major automakers including General Motors, Toyota, and Ford.

companies.name: China Galaxy Securities
companies.description: China Galaxy Securities Co., Ltd. is a Chinese state-owned brokerage and investment bank. It operates within the financial services sector in China.

companies.name: Hua Xia Bank
companies.description: Huaxia Bank Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded commercial bank based in Beijing, China, founded in 1992. Germany's Deutsche Bank held a 19.99% stake as of 2010, which was later announced to be acquired by People's Insurance Company of China in 2015.

companies.name: Cepheid
companies.description: Cepheid is an American molecular diagnostics company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It is a subsidiary of Danaher Corporation and produces automated nucleic acid test systems used to identify pathogens and genetic disorders, selling clinical tests for various health conditions.

companies.name: ImmunoGen Inc.
companies.description: ImmunoGen, Inc. was a biotechnology company focused on developing antibody-drug conjugate therapeutics for cancer treatment. Founded in 1981, it was headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts.

companies.name: Technip
companies.description: Technip S.A. was a French company specializing in project management, engineering, and construction for the energy industry. Headquartered in Paris, it merged with FMC Technologies in 2017 to form TechnipFMC and operated in 48 countries with about 38,000 employees.

companies.name: Airborne Maintenance & Engineering Services
companies.description: Airborne Maintenance & Engineering Services is a US-based MRO company located in Wilmington, Ohio, providing aircraft maintenance, repair, and overhaul services. It holds FAA certification and operates multiple facilities including line maintenance stations and offers Boeing 737 cargo conversion services through its subsidiary.

companies.name: QX Metals
companies.description: QX Metals Corp. is a Canadian multinational corporation based in Vancouver, British Columbia, focused on exploring a porphyry copper-gold deposit in Bulgaria. It was formerly known as Black Sea Copper & Gold Corp. and has a history involving geothermal power projects in the US.

companies.name: Enpro Industries
companies.description: Enpro is a US-based industrial technology company designing and manufacturing products and materials for technology-intensive sectors. It serves industries including semiconductors, aerospace, power generation, and life sciences from 61 manufacturing facilities in 12 countries, organized into three segments.

companies.name: Positivo Tecnologia
companies.description: Positivo Tecnologia is a Brazilian company headquartered in Curitiba, Paraná. It provides end-to-end IT infrastructure solutions and develops, manufactures, and sells computers, mobile phones, tablets, smart home and office devices, servers, payment solutions, educational technologies, and electronic security solutions.

companies.name: HellermannTyton
companies.description: HellermannTyton is a British registered company with affiliated companies in 40 countries. It manufactures and supplies products for fastening, fixing, identifying, and protecting cables and their connecting components. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Delphi Automotive in December 2015.

companies.name: Publicis Sapient
companies.description: Publicis Sapient is a technology company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It operates as an independent subsidiary of Publicis Groupe and was originally established as Sapient in Cambridge, Massachusetts in 1990. In 2015, it became an independent subsidiary of the French multinational advertising firm Publicis.

companies.name: Adventa
companies.description: Adventa Berhad is a Malaysian holding company headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Selangor. Founded in 2004, it initially invested in the glove-making business but later divested it and acquired companies leading to healthcare businesses. Its operations include distribution and third-party logistics for other healthcare companies.

companies.name: TARO Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Taro Pharmaceutical Industries is an Israeli research-based pharmaceutical manufacturer. It was publicly listed on the New York Stock Exchange before being acquired by Sun Pharma. The company sells more than 180 drugs worldwide, mainly in the United States, Canada, and Israel.

companies.name: Cofix Group Ltd
companies.description: Cofix is an Israeli coffee shop, bar, and supermarket chain established in 2013 by Avi Katz. It uses a fixed price menu system and has branches mostly in city centers and near educational institutions such as Haifa University.

companies.name: Hero MotoCorp
companies.description: Hero MotoCorp Limited is an Indian multinational motorcycle and scooter manufacturer headquartered in Delhi. It holds about 30% market share in the Indian two-wheeler industry as of March 2024. The Munjal family is the biggest shareholder with a 34.75% stake.

companies.name: Alderon Iron Ore Corp.
companies.description: Alderon Iron Ore Corp. was a Canadian development-stage company focused on exploration, development, and mining of an iron ore property in the Labrador Trough near the Quebec border. It owned 75% of the Kami Project, a high-grade iron ore project, and had a strategic partnership with HBIS Group of China.

companies.name: Isle of Capri Casinos
companies.description: Isle of Capri Casinos, Inc. was a gaming company headquartered in Creve Coeur, Missouri. It operated casinos and associated entertainment and lodging facilities in the United States.

companies.name: A10 Networks
companies.description: A10 Networks, Inc. is an American public company that manufactures application delivery controllers. Founded in 2004 by Lee Chen, it initially focused on identity management products and later expanded to bandwidth management appliances. The company went public in 2014.

companies.name: Hybe
companies.description: Hybe Co., Ltd. is a South Korean multinational music and entertainment conglomerate headquartered in Seoul. Founded in 2005 as Big Hit Entertainment, it started as a music production and artist management agency. The company rebranded to Hybe in 2021 after expanding beyond record label operations.

companies.name: Auburn National Bancorporation
companies.description: Auburn Bank is an American community bank operating in eastern Alabama. It offers financial products such as checking, savings, and lending services. The bank is a member of the Federal Home Loan Bank of Atlanta and is regulated by the Alabama Superintendent of Banks.

companies.name: Samsung Securities
companies.description: Samsung Securities Co., Ltd. is a South Korean financial services company headquartered in Seoul. It is a subsidiary of Samsung Group and ranks among the largest securities companies in Korea.

companies.name: Yakult Honsha
companies.description: Yakult Honsha Company, Limited is a Japanese multinational corporation that produces Yakult, a probiotic beverage using lactic acid bacteria discovered in the 1920s. The company also owns the Tokyo Yakult Swallows baseball team and operates in India through a joint venture with Danone.

companies.name: SK Innovation
companies.description: SK Innovation Co., Ltd. is a South Korean intermediate holding company of SK Group engaged in petroleum, alternative energy, and oil exploration. It operates through six major subsidiaries including SK Energy and SK On.

companies.name: Taihan Cable & Solution
companies.description: Taihan Cable & Solution Co., Ltd. is a South Korean company that manufactures electric wires and stainless steel products for electricity and communication. Established in 1941 as South Korea's first wire and cable company, it is listed on the Korean Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Korea Zinc Co.
companies.description: Korea Zinc Company, Ltd. is a South Korean non-ferrous metal smelter headquartered in Seoul. It is a leading refined zinc producer and manufactures 18 types of metals and chemical products from various raw materials including zinc and lead concentrates.

companies.name: HD Hyundai Infracore
companies.description: HD Hyundai Infracore Co., Ltd., formerly Doosan Infracore, was a South Korean manufacturer of construction equipment and commercial and military engines. It was among the largest construction equipment manufacturers by sales revenue.

companies.name: Hindalco Industries
companies.description: Hindalco Industries Limited is an Indian aluminium and copper manufacturing company headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra. It operates as a subsidiary of the Aditya Birla Group. The company is notable for being part of one of India's major industrial groups.

companies.name: GS Engineering & Construction
companies.description: GS Engineering & Construction is part of GS Group, one of the largest South Korean conglomerates. GS Group includes various subsidiaries such as GS Holdings, GS Caltex, and GS E&C. It is recognized as the 8th largest chaebol in Korea by asset size as of 2019.

companies.name: LG Innotek
companies.description: LG Innotek Co., Ltd. is a South Korean electronic component manufacturer headquartered in Seoul. It is an affiliate of LG Group and produces core components for mobile devices, automotive displays, semiconductors, and smart products. A significant portion of its revenue comes from selling camera modules for the iPhone.

companies.name: Komatsu Limited
companies.description: Komatsu Ltd. is a Japanese multinational corporation headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It manufactures construction, mining, forestry, and military heavy equipment, as well as diesel engines and industrial equipment. The company was founded in 1921 in Komatsu, Ishikawa Prefecture.

companies.name: Knoll
companies.description: Knoll is an American company that manufactures office and storage systems, furniture, textiles, and accessories. Its KnollStudio division produces licensed furniture designed by renowned architects and designers. Over 40 of its designs are part of the permanent collection at the Museum of Modern Art in New York City.

companies.name: Batm Advanced Communications Ltd
companies.description: BATM Advanced Communications Ltd. is an Israeli technology company engaged in the development, production, and marketing of data and telecommunication products for local and wide area networks. It also develops and distributes laboratory diagnostic equipment in the medical sector. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE techMARK 100 Index.

companies.name: Cineverse
companies.description: Cineverse Corp. is an American entertainment company headquartered in Los Angeles, California. Its business activities include digital cinema, streaming channels, content marketing, and distribution. The company operates within the entertainment industry.

companies.name: Datadog
companies.description: Datadog, Inc. is an American company headquartered in New York City that provides an observability service for cloud-scale applications. It offers monitoring of servers, databases, tools, and services through a SaaS-based data analytics platform. The company is publicly traded on the Nasdaq stock exchange.

companies.name: Eagle Materials
companies.description: Eagle Materials Inc. is an American producer of building materials based in Dallas, Texas. The company manufactures cement, concrete, construction aggregate, gypsum, wallboard, paperboard, and sand used for hydraulic fracturing. It operates in the construction and cement industry.

companies.name: Enzon Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Enzon Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in Piscataway, New Jersey. It is publicly traded on NASDAQ and conducts marketing activities in Asia, including China. In 2012, the company presented on its drug delivery systems at a symposium in Nanjing, China.

companies.name: Fidelity Southern Corporation
companies.description: Fidelity Southern Corporation was an American financial holding company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It wholly owned Fidelity Bank and the LionMark Insurance Company. The company was acquired by Ameris Bancorp in July 2019.

companies.name: Unite Students
companies.description: The Unite Group Plc is a British developer, owner, and operator of purpose-built student accommodation. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. The company operates in the United Kingdom.

companies.name: Gaming and Leisure Properties
companies.description: Gaming and Leisure Properties, Inc. is a real estate investment trust specializing in casino properties based in Wyomissing, Pennsylvania. Formed in 2013 as a spin-off from Penn National Gaming, it owns 64 casino properties leased to other companies.

companies.name: Berau Coal Energy
companies.description: PT Berau Coal Energy Tbk is a major coal producer based in Jakarta, Indonesia. It was Indonesia's fifth largest coal producer as of 2013. The company operates in the mining and metals industry.

companies.name: Jazz Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Jazz Pharmaceuticals plc is an American global biopharmaceutical company focused on oncology and neuroscience. Founded in 2003 in California, it is now headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.

companies.name: City Developments Limited
companies.description: City Developments Limited (CDL) is a Singaporean multinational real estate company founded in 1963. It initially developed projects in Johor Bahru and Singapore but later consolidated into Singapore. CDL is controlled by Hong Leong Bank since 1969 and develops various property types.

companies.name: Hyundai EP
companies.description: Hyundai EP was founded in 1988 as the Petrochemical Division of HDC Group in South Korea. It focuses on developing advanced technologies and produces automobile bumpers and interior materials. The company became independent in 2000 and has experienced significant growth since.

companies.name: W. W. Grainger
companies.description: W. W. Grainger, Inc. is an American industrial supply company founded in 1927 in Chicago. It serves over 4.5 million customers worldwide with products like motors, lighting, and safety supplies, mainly through business-to-business sales via branches and online channels.

companies.name: Host Hotels & Resorts
companies.description: Host Hotels & Resorts, Inc. is an American real estate investment trust based in Bethesda, Maryland. It invests in hotels and owns 81 upscale hotels with approximately 43,400 rooms across the United States, Brazil, and Canada.

companies.name: PTT Global Chemical Public Company Limited
companies.description: PTT Global Chemical (PTTGC) is a petrochemical company specializing in synthesizing olefins and aromatics. Founded in 2011, it is a subsidiary of PTT Public Company Limited and operates in Thailand.

companies.name: Snap-on
companies.description: Snap-on Incorporated is a United States company that designs, manufactures, and markets high-end tools and equipment for professional use in the transportation industry. It is headquartered in Kenosha, Wisconsin, and has been since 1930. Snap-on also distributes lower-end tools under the Blue-Point brand.

companies.name: Internet Gold Golden Lines Ltd
companies.description: Internet Gold Golden Lines Ltd. is a principal communication service group based in Israel. Founded in 1992, it is a subsidiary of Eurocom Communications Ltd. and owns subsidiaries such as B Communications and GoldMind Ltd. The company changed its name from Euronet Golden Lines Ltd. to Internet Gold - Golden Lines Ltd. in 1999.

companies.name: Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd.
companies.description: Enlight Renewable Energy is an Israeli publicly traded company that builds and operates solar and wind power facilities. It also develops utility-scale energy storage and agrivoltaic projects. The company is listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and Nasdaq following its U.S. initial public offering in February 2023.

companies.name: Tullett Prebon Europe - OTF
companies.description: TP ICAP Group plc is a financial services firm headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Telekom Malaysia
companies.description: Telekom Malaysia Berhad is a Malaysian telecommunications company founded in 1984. It started as the national telecommunications provider for fixed line, radio, and television broadcasting services and has grown to be the largest provider of broadband, data, fixed line, pay television, and network services in Malaysia.

companies.name: Allied Irish Banks
companies.description: Allied Irish Banks, p.l.c. is one of the Big Four commercial banks in the Republic of Ireland. It offers a full range of personal, business, and corporate banking services, as well as general insurance products and life assurance and pensions through AIB Life.

companies.name: Össur
companies.description: Össur hf. is an Icelandic company that develops, manufactures, and sells non-invasive orthopaedic equipment including bracing, support products, compression therapy, and prosthetics. It is headquartered in Reykjavík and has offices in the Americas, Europe, and Asia with distributors in other markets.

companies.name: Holcim Group
companies.description: The Holcim Group, legally Holcim Limited, is a Swiss multinational company that manufactures building materials. It operates in around 45 countries and has two business segments: building materials and building solutions.

companies.name: Sumitomo Rubber Industries
companies.description: Sumitomo Rubber Industries, Ltd. is a global tire and rubber company based in Japan and part of the Sumitomo Group. It produces a wide range of rubber products including automobile tires and sports equipment under brands such as Dunlop, Falken, Srixon, and Cleveland Golf.

companies.name: Banco BMG
companies.description: Banco BMG is a major retail bank in Brazil, originally founded in 1930 as Banco de Minas Gerais S.A. It operates in the finance sector serving retail banking customers.

companies.name: Daycoval
companies.description: Banco Daycoval S.A. is a Brazilian financial institution founded in 1968 and headquartered in São Paulo. It specializes in corporate lending and retail services including payroll loans, vehicle financing, foreign exchange, and investment management. Daycoval has a national presence with 53 branches and an international branch in the Cayman Islands.

companies.name: State Bank of Para
companies.description: Banpará is a Brazilian regional bank founded in 1959 by the Pará state government. It primarily supports the banking needs of the state government and its employees. The bank operates regionally within Brazil.

companies.name: Manulife Financial
companies.description: Manulife Financial Corporation is a Canadian multinational insurance company and financial services provider headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. It operates in Canada and Asia as Manulife and in the US through John Hancock Financial. Manulife has served over 26 million customers worldwide.

companies.name: NEX Group
companies.description: NEX Group plc, formerly ICAP plc, is a UK-based business focused on electronic financial markets and post-trade services for financial institutions. It operates BrokerTec and EBS, major treasury and foreign exchange markets. NEX was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by CME Group in 2018.

companies.name: Valvoline
companies.description: Valvoline Inc. is an American retail automotive services company based in Lexington, Kentucky. It licenses its name for automotive oils and lubricants and owns several car repair chains including Valvoline Instant Oil Change. It is the second-largest oil change service provider in the US with over 1,650 locations.

companies.name: IHI Corporation
companies.description: IHI Corporation is a Japanese engineering company headquartered in Tokyo. It produces ships, space launch vehicles, aircraft engines, marine diesel engines, gas turbines, railway systems, turbochargers, industrial machinery, power station boilers, and suspension bridges among other products.

companies.name: IMAX Corporation
companies.description: IMAX Corporation is a Canadian production theatre company founded in Montreal in 1967 and headquartered in Mississauga. It designs and manufactures IMAX cameras and projection systems and handles film development, production, post-production, and distribution to IMAX-affiliated theatres worldwide.

companies.name: Inpex
companies.description: INPEX Corporation is a Japanese oil company established in 1966. It is Japan's largest oil and gas exploration and production company with projects in 20 countries. INPEX was ranked as the 597th-largest public company globally in the 2020 Forbes Global 2000.

companies.name: IOI Group
companies.description: IOI Corporation Berhad is a major Malaysian conglomerate incorporated in 1969. It expanded into oil palm plantations in 1983, property development in 1984, and refineries in 1997. IOI is listed on Bursa Malaysia, formerly the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.

companies.name: ITC Limited
companies.description: ITC Limited is an Indian conglomerate headquartered in Kolkata with business segments including FMCG, agribusiness, IT, paper products, and packaging. A significant portion of its revenue comes from tobacco products.

companies.name: Iamgold
companies.description: Iamgold Corporation is a Canadian company headquartered in Toronto that owns and operates gold mines in Burkina Faso and Canada. Incorporated in 1990, it has also owned stakes in mines in Mali, Botswana, and Quebec. The company is publicly traded on the Toronto and New York Stock Exchanges.

companies.name: Phillips 66
companies.description: Phillips 66 Company is an American multinational energy company based in Houston, Texas. It was formed after the merger of Phillips Petroleum and Conoco, and later spun off its downstream operations into the Phillips 66 entity. The company began trading on the New York Stock Exchange in 2012.

companies.name: Vodafone Idea
companies.description: Vodafone Idea is an Indian telecommunications company headquartered in Gandhinagar. It operates as an all-India integrated GSM mobile telephony service provider.

companies.name: Rogers Communications
companies.description: Rogers Communications Inc. is a Canadian communications and media company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. It operates in wireless communications, cable television, telephony, and Internet services, with additional assets in telecommunications, mass media, and professional sports.

companies.name: MakoLab
companies.description: MakoLab is an international IT company headquartered in Łódź, Poland, specializing in business web software. It has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 2007 and collaborates on R&D projects with John Paul II University in Lublin. The company has offices in Poland, Paris, London, Munich, and Tampa.

companies.name: Playmates Toys
companies.description: Playmates Toys Limited is a Hong Kong-based manufacturing company founded in 1966. It initially manufactured dolls for other companies before marketing its own preschool toy line starting in 1975. The company established subsidiaries in the United States and went public in 1984.

companies.name: Incitec Pivot
companies.description: Incitec Pivot Limited is an Australian multinational corporation that manufactures fertiliser, explosives chemicals, and mining services. It is the largest fertiliser supplier in Australia and a leading explosives supplier globally. The company was formed from a merger in 2003 and expanded through acquisitions in 2006 and 2008.

companies.name: Indykpol
companies.description: Indykpol is one of Poland's largest poultry processors and the largest turkey processor, headquartered in Olsztyn. Founded in 1991 as a successor to a state-owned corporation, it became a joint-stock company in 1993 and has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 1994.

companies.name: Insurance Australia Group
companies.description: Insurance Australia Group Limited (IAG) is a multinational insurance company headquartered in Sydney, Australia. It is the largest general insurance company in Australia and New Zealand, with origins in the National Roads and Motorists' Association (NRMA).

companies.name: Veeco
companies.description: Veeco Instruments Inc. is an American capital equipment supplier based in Plainview, New York. It designs and builds processing systems used in semiconductor and compound semiconductor manufacturing, data storage, and scientific markets for applications including advanced packaging and photonics.

companies.name: Interface, Inc.
companies.description: Interface, Inc. is a global manufacturer of commercial flooring headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company produces modular carpet tiles, luxury vinyl tile, and rubber flooring under the Nora brand. It operates in the textile industry.

companies.name: Mizuho Financial Group
companies.description: Mizuho Financial Group, Inc. is a Japanese banking holding company headquartered in the Ōtemachi district of Chiyoda, Tokyo. It was formed between 2000 and 2002 by merging Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank, Fuji Bank, and Industrial Bank of Japan. The name Mizuho means "abundant rice" or "harvest" in Japanese.

companies.name: International Flavors & Fragrances
companies.description: International Flavors & Fragrances Inc. (IFF) is an American corporation headquartered in New York City. It creates products across taste, texture, scent, nutrition, enzymes, cultures, soy proteins, and probiotics categories and operates facilities in 44 countries. The company is a member of the S&P 500 index.

companies.name: International Game Technology
companies.description: International Game Technology (IGT) was an American gaming company based in Las Vegas that manufactured and distributed slot machines and gambling technology. It was acquired in 2015 by GTECH, which then adopted the IGT name.

companies.name: Internet Initiative Japan
companies.description: Internet Initiative Japan is a Japanese telecommunications company founded in 1992 by Koichi Suzuki. It is recognized as Japan’s first Internet service provider (ISP).

companies.name: US Foods
companies.description: US Foods Holding Corp. is an American food service distributor supplying 250,000 locations including independent and chain restaurants, healthcare, hospitality, and educational institutions. It is the second-largest food service distributor in the United States after Sysco.

companies.name: Heibao
companies.description: Heibao Auto is a Chinese automotive manufacturing company headquartered in Weihai, China. It operates in the automotive industry.

companies.name: Noritake
companies.description: Noritake Co., Limited is a Japanese manufacturer of porcelain, fine ceramics, and sharpening stones headquartered in Nagoya, Japan. It operates in the industrials and chemicals sector.

companies.name: Investec
companies.description: Investec is an Anglo-South African international banking and wealth management group founded in Johannesburg, South Africa. It provides a range of financial products and services to clients in Europe, Southern Africa, and Asia-Pacific.

companies.name: Ipsos
companies.description: Ipsos Group S.A. is a multinational market research and consulting firm headquartered in Paris, France. Founded in 1975 by Didier Truchot, it has been publicly traded on Euronext Paris since July 1, 1999.

companies.name: Koss Corporation
companies.description: Koss Corporation is a Milwaukee, Wisconsin-based company that manufactures headphones. It is notable for creating the first high-fidelity stereo headphones in 1958.

companies.name: Irkutskenergo
companies.description: Irkutskenergo is a Russian power company that primarily focuses on generating hydroelectricity.

companies.name: Iron Mountain Incorporated
companies.description: Iron Mountain Inc. is a global enterprise information management services company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. Founded in 1951, it provides records management, information destruction, and data backup and recovery services to customers worldwide.

companies.name: Allegion
companies.description: Allegion plc is an American company domiciled in Ireland that provides security products for homes and businesses.

companies.name: The Israel Corporation Ltd.
companies.description: Israel Corporation is Israel's largest holding company, founded in 1968 by the Government of the State of Israel.

companies.name: Metsä Board
companies.description: Metsä Board Oyj is a Finnish producer of fresh fibre paperboards, including folding boxboards and food service boards. It is part of Metsä Group, one of the largest forest industry groups globally.

companies.name: JBS S.A.
companies.description: JBS N.V. is a Brazilian multinational and the largest meat processing company worldwide. It produces various meats and by-products and is headquartered in São Paulo and Amsterdam.

companies.name: J. Walter Thompson
companies.description: J. Walter Thompson was an American advertising holding company founded in 1896. It was acquired by WPP plc in 1987 and later merged with other agencies to form new entities.

companies.name: Samsung Asset Management
companies.description: Samsung Asset Management Co., Ltd. is a South Korean asset management company headquartered in Seoul. It is a subsidiary of Samsung Life Insurance and the largest asset management company in South Korea.

companies.name: Siam Cement
companies.description: The Siam Cement Public Company Limited is the largest and oldest cement and building material company in Thailand and Southeast Asia. Its major shareholder is King Vajiralongkorn, owning 30 percent of shares.

companies.name: Toray Industries
companies.description: Toray Industries, Inc. is a multinational corporation headquartered in Japan specializing in industrial products based on organic synthetic chemistry, polymer chemistry, and biochemistry technologies.

companies.name: Acceleron Pharma
companies.description: Acceleron Pharma, Inc. is an American clinical stage biopharmaceutical company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts. It focuses on developing medicines that regulate the transforming growth factor beta superfamily of proteins involved in cell and tissue growth and repair.

companies.name: Advanced Accelerator Applications
companies.description: Advanced Accelerator Applications is a pharmaceutical group based in France specializing in nuclear medicine. It operates in all three segments of nuclear medicine to diagnose and treat serious conditions in oncology, neurology, cardiology, infectious and inflammatory diseases.

companies.name: Agios Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Agios Pharmaceuticals Inc. is a publicly traded American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Founded in 2008, it pioneers therapies for genetically defined diseases with a focus on hemolytic anemias.

companies.name: Andatee China Marine Fuel
companies.description: Andatee China Marine Fuel Service Corporation is a marine fuel wholesale and retail company based in Dalian, China. It sells oil fuel products mainly to one municipality and four provinces in Northeast and East China and has subsidiaries including a joint venture with CPC Corp.

companies.name: China Aerospace International Holdings Limited
companies.description: China Aerospace International Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong incorporated holding company and a subsidiary of China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation. It is listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong as a red chip company.

companies.name: BBCN
companies.description: Bank of Hope is an American bank based in Los Angeles focusing on the Korean American community. It was originally established in 1980 under the name Wilshire Bank.

companies.name: Alliance Bank
companies.description: Alliance Bank Malaysia Berhad, known as Alliance Bank, is a publicly traded banking and financial institution in Malaysia.

companies.name: Annaly Capital Management
companies.description: Annaly Capital Management, Inc. is one of the largest mortgage real estate investment trusts. It is organized in Maryland with its principal office in New York City.

companies.name: Cobalt International Energy
companies.description: Cobalt International Energy, Inc. is a development stage petroleum exploration and production company headquartered in Houston, Texas. The company filed for bankruptcy on December 14, 2017.

companies.name: Corpay
companies.description: Corpay, Inc. is a financial services company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It provides payments and spend management systems focusing on vehicle-related expenses, lodging expenses, and corporate payments. The company controls expense-related purchasing and payment processes.

companies.name: Griffon Corporation
companies.description: Griffon Corporation is a multinational conglomerate based in New York City. It operates as a diversified management and holding company with subsidiaries including Ames True Temper, ClosetMaid, Clopay Building Products, and CornellCookson. Griffon has been publicly traded since 1961.

companies.name: Hitit Computer Services
companies.description: Hitit Computer Services is a travel technology company headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey, at the Istanbul Technical University science park. It provides commercial and operational IT systems for the airline and travel industry. Hitit has been publicly listed on the Borsa Istanbul stock exchange since March 2022.

companies.name: Superdry
companies.description: Superdry Limited is a British clothing company owning the Superdry & Co label. Its products combine vintage American styling with Japanese-inspired graphics. Despite the Japanese lettering, Superdry has never expanded into Japan.

companies.name: Borgestad
companies.description: Borgestad ASA is a Norwegian company involved in shipping, industry, and real estate. It operates primarily through two divisions: Borgestad Properties and Borgestad Industries. The company is based in Norway.

companies.name: Horizon Therapeutics
companies.description: Horizon Therapeutics plc was an Ireland-based biopharmaceutical company focused on medicines for rare and rheumatic diseases. It primarily marketed products in the United States. The company was acquired by Amgen in October 2023.

companies.name: Infinis
companies.description: Infinis Energy is a British renewable energy group headquartered in Northampton. It produces electricity from captured landfill and mineral methane. The company operates in the renewable energy sector.

companies.name: Vulcan Materials Company
companies.description: Vulcan Materials Company is an American construction materials producer based in Birmingham, Alabama. It is the largest producer of aggregate materials like gravel, crushed stone, and sand, serving multiple US states and nearby countries. The company developed a large quarry and seaport project on Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula.

companies.name: Ceres, Inc.

companies.name: Ramsay Health Care
companies.description: Ramsay Health Care Limited is an Australian multinational healthcare provider and hospital network founded in Sydney in 1964. It operates in Australia, Europe, the UK, and Asia, specializing in surgery, rehabilitation, and psychiatric care.

companies.name: Tsinghua Holdings
companies.description: Tsinghua Holdings Corp., Ltd. is a wholly owned subsidiary of Tsinghua University in China. It was established as an in-house asset management company for Tsinghua's subsidiaries created in the 1990s through technology transfer from research to business.

companies.name: Metro Realty
companies.description: PT Metro Realty Tbk. is a real estate and property management company based in Jakarta, Indonesia. It operates primarily in the real estate industry within the country.

companies.name: Invepar
companies.description: Invepar S.A. is a private urban mobility and transit infrastructure management company headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. It holds 11 concessions in toll roads, airports, and urban mobility through subsidiaries and joint ventures.

companies.name: United Tractors
companies.description: PT United Tractors Tbk is an Indonesian company and subsidiary of PT Astra International Tbk. It operates in six business lines including construction machinery, mining, and energy, with numerous branch offices and service points.

companies.name: Xaar plc
companies.description: Xaar plc is a company based in Cambridge, United Kingdom, that supplies industrial inkjet printheads. It is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Teamway International Group Holdings Limited
companies.description: Teamway International Group Holdings Limited is a Cayman-incorporated holding company based in Hong Kong and mainland China. It is engaged in packaging product manufacturing, corporate services, and property investment.

companies.name: Hyundai Motor America
companies.description: Hyundai Motor America is the operating subsidiary overseeing Hyundai Motor Company's operations in the US, Canada, and Mexico. Headquartered in Fountain Valley, California, it manages manufacturing, sales, and corporate functions.

companies.name: Bank of Qingdao
companies.description: Bank of Qingdao Company Limited provides retail and corporate banking services in Shandong province, China. Its headquarters are in Qingdao and it is regulated by the People's Bank of China.

companies.name: Knightscope
companies.description: Knightscope, Inc. is a security camera and robotics company headquartered in Mountain View, California. It designs and deploys autonomous robots for monitoring public areas using self-driving technology and sensors.

companies.name: Southern California Edison
companies.industry: electric power generation, transmission and distribution
companies.description: Southern California Edison is the primary electric utility company serving much of Southern California, United States. It provides electricity to 15 million people across a large service territory.

companies.name: Mackinac Financial Corporation
companies.description: Mackinac Financial Corporation was a bank holding company based in Manistique, Michigan. It provided commercial and retail banking products through its bank, mBank. The company was incorporated in 1974 and was acquired by Nicolet National Bank in 2021.

companies.name: C. Mer Industries Ltd.
companies.description: Mer Group Ltd. is an Israeli holding company consisting of three autonomous business divisions. Each division is led by a company with subsidiaries, manufacturing facilities, and logistics chains. It operates primarily in Israel.

companies.name: MedAssets
companies.description: MedAssets, Inc. was an American healthcare performance improvement company. It provided products and services to thousands of hospitals and non-acute healthcare providers. The company operated in the United States.

companies.name: East Boston Savings Bank
companies.description: East Boston Savings Bank was a Massachusetts-chartered stock savings bank founded in 1848. It offered a wide range of deposit and loan products through its banking operations. The bank was based in Massachusetts, USA.

companies.name: eGain
companies.description: eGain Corporation is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It provides AI knowledge software to help businesses automate customer and employee experiences. The company operates in the United States.

companies.name: YogaWorks
companies.description: YogaWorks is a subsidiary of GoDigital Media Group based in the United States. It offers yoga therapy classes via streaming media and provides yoga teacher training. The company operates in the consumer goods and retail sector.

companies.name: Beowulf Mining
companies.description: Beowulf Mining plc is a UK-registered exploration and development company focused on the Nordic region. It operates subsidiaries involved in open-pit mining in Sweden and Finland. The company was formed in 1988 and is listed on the AIM in London and Spotlight in Sweden.

companies.name: National Research Corporation
companies.description: National Research Corporation, known as NRC Health, is an American healthcare company based in Lincoln, Nebraska. It provides healthcare products and subscription-based solutions in the US and Canada. The company was founded in 1981 and changed its name to NRC Health in 2026.

companies.name: North Valley Bancorp
companies.description: North Valley Bancorp was a bank holding company headquartered in Redding, California. It operated 22 branches before being acquired by TriCo Bancshares in 2014. The company was part of the banking industry in the United States.

companies.name: Norway Royal Salmon
companies.description: Norway Royal Salmon ASA was a Norwegian fish farming company headquartered in Trondheim with a sales office in Kristiansand. After nearly 30 years, it merged with SalMar in 2022, with SalMar acquiring its assets and operations. Its trading activities became part of Visscher Seafood Group.

companies.name: Novavax
companies.description: Novavax, Inc. is a pharmaceutical company based in Gaithersburg, Maryland. It develops vaccines to counter infectious diseases, including the Novavax COVID-19 vaccine now commercialized by Sanofi. The company also works on vaccines for influenza, RSV, avian flu, shingles, Clostridioides difficile, and malaria.

companies.name: ON24
companies.description: ON24 is a cloud-based platform company in the United States that develops and sells web-based webinar, virtual conferencing, content hub, and landing page applications as a service. It serves marketing and sales teams in B2B organizations and expanded its offerings in 2023 to include generative AI services.

companies.name: Organovo
companies.description: Organovo Holdings, Inc. is a biotechnology company headquartered in San Diego, California. Founded in 2007, it designs and develops functional, three-dimensional human tissue for medical research and therapeutic applications using its internally developed NovoGen MMX Bioprinter for 3D bioprinting.

companies.name: Richard Pieris & Company PLC
companies.description: Richard Pieris and Company (ARPICO) is a Sri Lankan conglomerate established in 1940 with interests in manufacturing, engineering, retail, and plantations. It is a pioneer in Sri Lanka's tyre, plantation, and rubber industries and employs over 25,000 people with major brands including Arpitec, Arpidag, and Arpico.

companies.name: Patriot National Bancorp
companies.description: Patriot Bank, N.A. is a bank holding company based in Stamford, Connecticut. It operates Patriot Bank NA and is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol PNBK.

companies.name: Powerwave Technologies
companies.description: Powerwave Technologies Inc. was a global telecommunications corporation founded in 1985 and disbanded in 2013. It produced wireless infrastructure products such as antennas, base stations, and coverage systems supporting major frequency bands and air interfaces, focusing on expanding coverage, capacity, and data speed including 4G WiMAX and LTE systems.

companies.name: Repligen
companies.description: Repligen Corporation is a life sciences company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. It develops and manufactures products used in biological drug manufacturing and is listed on Nasdaq under the symbol RGEN.

companies.name: Network 18
companies.description: Network18 Media & Investments Limited is an Indian media conglomerate owned by Reliance Industries, with a 56.89% share. The company is led by managing director and CEO Rahul Joshi and chairman Adil Zainulbhai.

companies.name: SciQuest
companies.description: JAGGAER, formerly SciQuest, is a cloud-based, AI-enabled procurement software and spend management company headquartered in Durham, North Carolina. Founded in 1995, it offers sourcing, contract management, spend analysis, e-procurement, invoicing, payments, and supplier management solutions and formed its current structure after merging with Pool4Tool and BravoSolution in 2017.

companies.name: Mattersight Corporation
companies.description: Mattersight Corporation, formerly eLoyalty, is a publicly traded company based in Chicago, Illinois. Founded in 1994, it provides SaaS-based enterprise behavioral analytics software focusing on customer-employee interaction and behavior.

companies.name: Silgan Holdings
companies.description: Silgan Holdings Inc. is an American manufacturing company based in Connecticut that produces consumer goods packaging. Founded in 1987 by two former executives of Continental Can, the company name is derived from their names. It operates in the product packaging industry.

companies.name: Silicon Graphics International
companies.description: Silicon Graphics International Corp. was an American manufacturer of computer hardware and software, including high-performance computing systems and x86-based servers. Founded as Rackable Systems in 1999, it adopted the SGI name in 2009 after acquiring Silicon Graphics Inc. out of bankruptcy.

companies.name: SpareBank 1 Nøtterøy–Tønsberg
companies.description: SpareBank 1 Nøtterøy–Tønsberg was a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Nøtterøy, Norway, with its main market in Vestfold. The bank's history dates back to June 20, 1857, with the establishment of the first savings bank in Nøtterøy.

companies.name: SPS Commerce
companies.description: SPS Commerce, Inc. is a technology and application software company based in the United States that provides cloud-based supply chain management software. Headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, it also has offices in the US and internationally in multiple cities worldwide.

companies.name: OmniVision Technologies
companies.description: OmniVision Technologies Inc. is an American subsidiary of the Chinese semiconductor design house OmniVision Group. It designs and develops digital imaging products for various applications including mobile phones and automotive systems. The company is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with offices in the US, Western Europe, and Asia.

companies.name: Paycom
companies.description: Paycom Software, Inc., known as Paycom, is an online payroll and human resource software provider based in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. Founded in 1998, it has offices throughout the United States and is recognized as one of the first fully online payroll providers.

companies.name: Totens Sparebank
companies.description: Totens Sparebank is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Lena, Norway, with its main market in Innlandet. The bank was established in 1854 and operates in the financial services sector.

companies.name: United Spirits Limited
companies.description: United Spirits Limited (USL) is an Indian alcoholic beverages company headquartered at UB Tower in Bengaluru, Karnataka. It is the world's second-largest spirits company by volume and a subsidiary of Diageo, exporting products to over 37 countries.

companies.name: Huron Consulting Group
companies.industry: business and other management consultancy activities
companies.description: Huron Consulting Group is an American management consulting company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It provides consulting and digital services to clients in healthcare, life sciences, commercial, and higher education industries.

companies.name: VirnetX
companies.description: VirnetX is a publicly traded Internet security software and technology company based in Zephyr Cove, Nevada. Founded in 2005, it holds a patent portfolio including U.S. and international patents in areas such as DNS and network communication.

companies.name: Willdan Group
companies.description: Willdan Group, Inc. is an American company providing professional technical and consulting services to utilities, government agencies, and commercial firms. It operates offices in more than a dozen states, with key operations in California and New York.

companies.name: Spanish Broadcasting System
companies.description: Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc. is a U.S.-based media company specializing in Spanish-speaking audiences. It is one of the largest owners and operators of radio stations in the United States and also has investments in television and internet properties.

companies.name: Voltari
companies.description: Voltari Corp is a U.S. company engaged in acquiring, financing, and leasing commercial real estate properties. It is headquartered in New York City at 767 Fifth Avenue.

companies.name: Weingarten Realty
companies.description: Weingarten Realty Investors was a real estate investment trust focused on shopping centers primarily in the Southern United States, often anchored by grocery stores. The company was acquired by Kimco Realty in August 2021.

companies.name: PRA Health Sciences
companies.description: PRA Health Sciences was a contract research organization headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. Established in 1976, it was acquired by ICON in 2021.

companies.name: Quick Heal
companies.description: Quick Heal is an Indian multinational cybersecurity software company headquartered in Pune. It develops security software for consumers, servers, cloud environments, and small to medium enterprises, with enterprise products under the brand Seqrite.

companies.name: Markit
companies.description: Markit was a British financial information and services company founded in 2003 that focused on credit derivative pricing.

companies.name: IMRIS
companies.description: IMRIS, founded in 2005, is a global provider of intraoperative imaging solutions. The company specializes in medical equipment and operates internationally. It is known for its focus on advanced imaging technology used during surgeries.

companies.name: Medpace
companies.description: Medpace Holdings, Inc. is a global clinical research organization based in Cincinnati, Ohio. It offers a full-service model including central laboratory, imaging, ECG core laboratory, and bioanalytical laboratory services. The company also operates a Phase I unit at its headquarters.

companies.name: Taylor Corporation
companies.description: Taylor Corporation is a privately owned print and communications company headquartered in North Mankato, Minnesota. Founded in 1975 by Glen Taylor, it operates in the communications sector. The company focuses on print and related services.

companies.name: Mississippi Power
companies.description: Mississippi Power is an electric utility company headquartered in Gulfport, Mississippi. It is a subsidiary of Southern Company, based in Atlanta. The company provides electric utility services in its region.

companies.name: M/A-COM Technology Solutions
companies.description: MACOM Technology Solutions, Inc. is an American developer and producer of radio, microwave, and millimeter wave semiconductor devices. Headquartered in Lowell, Massachusetts, it was the city's largest private employer in 2005. The company holds ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certifications.

companies.name: Veris Residential
companies.description: Veris Residential, Inc. is a real estate investment trust headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey. It primarily invests in apartments in New Jersey and Boston, owning multiple apartment complexes and retail properties. The company is owned by Affinius Capital and Vista Hill Partners.

companies.name: Sandy Spring Bank
companies.description: Sandy Spring Bancorp, Inc. was a bank holding company headquartered in Olney, Maryland, serving the Washington metropolitan area. It offered banking, insurance, and wealth management services. In April 2025, it was acquired by Atlantic Union Bank.

companies.name: JBG Smith
companies.description: JBG SMITH Properties is a publicly traded real estate investment trust based in Bethesda, Maryland. The company operates in the real estate sector. It focuses on property investment and management.

companies.name: Heidrick & Struggles
companies.description: Heidrick & Struggles International Incorporated is an American executive search and management consulting company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It has offices in 56 cities worldwide and provides executive search, leadership consulting, and interim executive services.

companies.name: Silicon Valley Bank
companies.description: Silicon Valley Bank was an independent commercial bank now operating as a division of First Citizens BancShares. It was the primary subsidiary of SVB Financial Group with offices in 15 U.S. states and multiple international locations. The SVB name will be phased out by Q4 2026.

companies.name: LayerOne
companies.description: LayerOne, Inc. was a U.S. private corporation providing carrier-neutral datacenters and interconnection services. It was acquired by Switch & Data in 2005. The company operated in the internet industry within the United States.

companies.name: Newpark Resources
companies.description: Newpark Resources, Inc. is a worldwide provider of drilling fluids systems and composite matting systems used in oilfield and commercial markets. Founded in 1932, it is based in The Woodlands, Texas. The company partners with industry organizations like the American Petroleum Institute.

companies.name: Nektar Therapeutics
companies.description: Nektar Therapeutics is an American biopharmaceutical company based in San Francisco, California. Founded in 1990, it develops drug candidates using proprietary PEGylation and polymer conjugate technologies. It developed Exubera, the world's first inhalable non-injectable insulin.

companies.name: Dutch Lady Milk Industries Berhad
companies.description: Dutch Lady Milk Industries Berhad manufactures cow milk and dairy products in Malaysia and several Asian countries. It was formerly part of Royal FrieslandFoods and is now a subsidiary of FrieslandCampina. The company has been operating since the 1960s.

companies.name: Taiyuan Heavy
companies.description: Taiyuan Heavy Industry Co., Ltd. is a Chinese manufacturer of industrial machinery including construction equipment and train wheels. It is one of the largest heavy machinery makers in China and competes with CITIC Heavy Industries and China First Heavy Industries.

companies.name: Rockwell Medical Inc.
companies.description: Rockwell Medical Inc. is a pharmaceutical company based in Wixom, Michigan. Founded in 1996, it focuses on developing and commercializing treatments for diseases such as end-stage renal disease and chronic kidney disease.

companies.name: MedMen
companies.description: MedMen Enterprises was a United States-based cannabis company headquartered in Culver City, California. It operated retail stores and cultivation facilities across multiple states and was publicly traded on the Canadian Securities Exchange and over-the-counter in the U.S. before its stock was delisted in 2024.

companies.name: Opko Health Inc.
companies.description: OPKO Health, Inc. is a medical test and medication company focused on diagnostics and pharmaceuticals. It is publicly traded on NASDAQ and TASE under the symbol "OPK". The company operates in the healthcare sector.

companies.name: CareCloud
companies.description: CareCloud, Inc. is an American healthcare information technology company providing services to healthcare providers and hospitals. It is publicly traded and headquartered in Somerset, New Jersey, employing approximately 4,000 workers worldwide.

companies.name: SJW Group
companies.description: SJW Group, also known as H2O America, is a water utility company based in San Jose, California. It processes, distributes, and supplies water to over 1 million residents in California and about 60,000 people in Texas. The company serves a total of approximately 245,000 connections across these regions.

companies.name: Pixelworks
companies.description: Pixelworks, Inc. is a semiconductor company founded in 1997 and based in San Jose, California. It provides video and pixel processing semiconductors and software, as well as digital display, projection devices, and digital signage products.

companies.name: Pernix Therapeutics Holdings
companies.description: Pernix Therapeutics was a specialty pharmaceutical company focused on acquiring, developing, and commercializing prescription drugs primarily for the U.S. market. It operated within the pharmaceutical industry in the United States.

companies.name: PacWest Bancorp
companies.description: PacWest Bancorp was an American bank holding company based in Beverly Hills, California. It owned Pacific Western Bank as its wholly owned banking subsidiary and was a subsidiary of Banc of California.

companies.name: Tesco Corporation
companies.description: Tesco Corporation was an oilfield services company headquartered in Spring Branch, Houston. It provided top drive rental services for land and offshore oil platforms and casing running services. The company was acquired by Nabors Industries in December 2017.

companies.name: National Rural Utilities Cooperative Finance Corporation
companies.wiki: National Rural Utilities Cooperative Finance Corporation
companies.description: The National Rural Utilities Cooperative Finance Corporation (CFC) is a member-owned nonprofit cooperative in the United States. Established in 1969, it provides financial products to rural electric cooperatives and supplements USDA loan programs for these cooperatives.

companies.name: UFP Technologies
companies.description: UFP Technologies, Inc. is an American multinational company that develops and manufactures custom solutions for medical devices, sterile packaging, and other highly engineered products. It operates in the healthcare and pharmaceutical sector.

companies.name: Natural Grocers
companies.description: Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage, Inc. is a health food retail chain based in Colorado, United States. It operates in the retail sector focusing on health food products.

companies.name: Zynex
