companies.description: Zynex, Inc. is a medical device manufacturer founded in 1996 by Thomas Sandgaard. The company produces and markets electrotherapy devices used in pain management, physical rehabilitation, neurological diagnosis, and cardiac monitoring.

companies.name: NCC Group
companies.description: NCC Group is an information assurance firm based in Manchester, United Kingdom. It provides cyber security consulting and managed services to over 15,000 clients worldwide. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: U.S. Concrete
companies.description: U.S. Concrete, Inc. is an American company headquartered in Euless, Texas, specializing in concrete and heavy construction aggregates. Its main products include ready-mix concrete and aggregates, serving customers across multiple U.S. states and territories.

companies.name: Proto Labs
companies.description: Protolabs is a manufacturing company headquartered in Maple Plain, Minnesota, USA. It provides rapid manufacturing of custom parts using 3D printing, CNC machining, sheet metal, and injection molding for various markets including medical devices and aerospace. The company operates manufacturing facilities in the U.S., England, and Germany.

companies.name: Civeo Corporation
companies.description: The Civeo Corporation is an American multinational company providing accommodation services. It is a spin-off of Oil States International and is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Seagen
companies.description: Seagen Inc. is a biotechnology company based in Bothell, Washington, focused on developing monoclonal antibody-based therapies for cancer treatment. It is known for its antibody-drug conjugates technology, which targets cancer cells while reducing toxic effects on non-targeted cells.

companies.name: Tech Data
companies.description: Tech Data Corporation was a multinational distribution company headquartered in Clearwater, Florida, specializing in IT products and services. It merged with Synnex to form TD Synnex, providing technology manufacturers and resellers with product lines, logistics, and value-added services.

companies.name: Macrogen
companies.description: Macrogen, Inc. is a South Korean biotechnology company headquartered in Seoul. Founded in 1997, it was the first Korean biotech firm to raise funds through an IPO on the KOSDAQ market. The company has been involved in genomic mapping and personalized genomic medicine.

companies.name: Oil States International
companies.description: Oil States International, Inc. is an American multinational corporation providing services to oil and gas companies. It is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Glacier Bancorp, Inc
companies.description: Glacier Bancorp, Inc. is a regional multi-bank holding company headquartered in Kalispell, Montana. It offers personal and commercial banking services through 221 locations across several western U.S. states.

companies.name: JX Nippon Mining & Metals
companies.description: JX Advanced Metals Corporation is a Japanese non-ferrous metal company partially owned by ENEOS Holdings. It engages in resource development, smelting, refining, and recycling, holding about 60% of the global market share in sputtering targets used in semiconductor manufacturing.

companies.name: Tama Home
companies.description: TamaHome Co. Ltd., also known as TamaHome, is a Japanese housing company established in 1998. It operates in the construction industry and is part of the JPX-Nikkei Mid and Small Cap Index as of 2021. The company is based in Japan.

companies.name: Kadokawa Corporation
companies.description: Kadokawa Corporation, formerly Kadokawa Dwango Corporation, is a Japanese conglomerate based in Fujimi, Chiyoda, Tokyo. It operates in the media and entertainment industry. The company is headquartered in Japan.

companies.name: Kansas City Life Insurance Company
companies.description: Kansas City Life Insurance Company is a public insurance company established in 1895 and located in Kansas City, Missouri. It markets individual life, annuity, and group products through agencies in 48 US states and the District of Columbia. It also offers investment options through its subsidiary, Sunset Financial Services.

companies.name: Samhwa Networks
companies.description: Samhwa Networks is a Korean drama production company founded in 1980 by Shin Hyun-taek. It started as a home video distributor and later became known for its drama productions. The company is based in South Korea.

companies.name: Mutares
companies.description: Mutares SE & Co. KGaA is an international private equity investor focused on special situations. It specializes in acquiring parts of large corporations and companies undergoing transitional phases. The company is based in Germany.

companies.name: Kobe Steel
companies.description: Kobe Steel, Ltd. is a major Japanese steel manufacturer headquartered in Chūō-ku, Kobe. The Kobe Steel Group operates under the unified brand name Kobelco. The company is part of Japan's iron and steel industry.

companies.name: Bukalapak
companies.description: PT Bukalapak.com Tbk, trading as Bukalapak, is an Indonesian e-commerce company founded in 2010. It facilitates online commerce for small and medium enterprises and digitizes small family-owned businesses known as warungs through its Mitra programme. The company is based in Indonesia.

companies.name: Cummins
companies.description: Cummins Inc. is an American multinational corporation that designs, manufactures, and distributes diesel engines, electric vehicle components, and power generation products. It also services engines and related equipment. The company is based in the United States.

companies.name: KeyBank
companies.description: KeyBank is an American regional bank headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio. Formed by a 1994 merger, it operates nearly 1,000 branches and over 1,200 ATMs across multiple US regions including the Midwest and Pacific Northwest. It is one of the largest banks in the United States.

companies.name: Key Tronic
companies.description: Key Tronic Corporation is a US-based technology company founded in 1969. It specializes in printed circuit board and full product assembly, offering design and assembly services for various electronic and household products. It is among the ten largest contract manufacturers providing electronic manufacturing services in the US.

companies.name: Kimberly-Clark
companies.description: Kimberly-Clark Corporation is an American multinational consumer goods company producing mostly paper-based products. It manufactures sanitary paper products and surgical and medical instruments. Its brands include Kleenex, Kotex, Cottonelle, Scott, Andrex, Wypall, KimWipes, and Huggies.

companies.name: Gartner
companies.description: Gartner, Inc. is a US-based research and advisory firm focusing on business and technology topics. It provides products and services through research reports, conferences, and consulting. Its clients include large corporations, government agencies, technology companies, and investment firms.

companies.name: Kinepolis
companies.description: The Kinepolis Group is a Belgian cinema chain operating 110 theaters in Europe and North America. It is the third-largest cinema chain in Europe.

companies.name: Kingdom Holding Company
companies.description: The Kingdom Holding Company is a Saudi Arabian holding company based in Riyadh. It is listed on the Saudi stock exchange.

companies.name: Wheaton Precious Metals
companies.description: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. is a Canadian multinational precious metals streaming company. It produces and sells large quantities of silver mined by other companies as a by-product of their main operations.

companies.name: WH Group
companies.description: WH Group is a Hong Kong-based multinational meat and food processing company. It operates businesses including hog raising, consumer meat products, flavoring products, and logistics. It is the largest meat producer in China.

companies.name: Aimia
companies.description: Aimia Inc. is a global investment holding company based in Montreal, Canada. It is publicly listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange. Originally a loyalty solutions provider from Air Canada's Aeroplan program, it restructured in 2020 to become an investment holding company.

companies.name: Clearwater Analytics
companies.description: Clearwater Analytics Holdings, Inc. is a US-based fintech company providing automated investment accounting, performance, compliance, and risk reporting via software-as-a-service. It is headquartered in Boise, Idaho, with offices in London, Edinburgh, New York City, and Noida.

companies.name: Plum Creek Timber
companies.description: Plum Creek Timber Company, Inc. was a US timberland owner and manager involved in forest products, mineral extraction, and property development. It was headquartered in Seattle before merging with Weyerhaeuser Company.

companies.name: Tim Hortons
companies.description: Tim Hortons Inc. is a Canadian multinational coffeehouse and restaurant chain headquartered in Toronto. It serves coffee, donuts, sandwiches, breakfast egg muffins, and other fast-food items. It is Canada's largest quick-service restaurant chain with over 6,000 restaurants across 14 countries.

companies.name: CoolBrands International
companies.description: CoolBrands International was a Canadian frozen food and dessert company based in Markham, Ontario. The company specialized in frozen food products and desserts.

companies.name: Brixmor Property Group
companies.description: Brixmor Property Group is a publicly traded real estate investment trust in the United States. It invests in shopping centers as part of its real estate portfolio.

companies.name: Atlas Mara Limited
companies.description: Atlas Mara Limited is a financial services holding company formed to acquire target banks in Africa. It was formerly known as Atlas Mara Co-Nvest Limited and is based in the United Arab Emirates.

companies.name: Toto Ltd.
companies.description: Toto Ltd. is a Japanese multinational manufacturer of plumbing fixtures and semiconductors, known for the Washlet product. Founded in 1917, the company is based in Kitakyushu, Japan, and has production facilities in nine countries.

companies.name: PSE Composite Index
companies.description: The PSE Composite Index, or PSEi, is the main stock market index of the Philippines. It consists of 30 of the largest companies traded on the Philippine Stock Exchange, contrasting with the broader PSE All Shares Index.

companies.name: NewMarket Corporation
companies.description: NewMarket Corporation is a publicly traded American company serving the petroleum additives industry. Based in Richmond, Virginia, it operates across North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific. Its predecessor was founded in 1887.

companies.name: Tempur-Pedic
companies.description: Tempur-Pedic International, Inc. manufactures and distributes mattresses and pillows made from viscoelastic foam. The company is headquartered in Lexington, Kentucky, with manufacturing plants in Virginia and New Mexico.

companies.name: Sartorius AG
companies.description: Sartorius AG is an international supplier of pharmaceutical and laboratory equipment headquartered in Göttingen, Germany. Founded in 1870, it operates through two divisions: Bioprocess Solutions and Lab Products & Services.

companies.name: SMCP Group
companies.description: SMCP Group is a French holding company specializing in accessible luxury ready-to-wear fashion. Headquartered in Paris, it was formed in 2010 through the merger of Sandro, Maje, and Claudie Pierlot. The company operates over 1,600 points of sale in 43 countries and includes the subsidiary De Fursac.

companies.name: Österreichische Post
companies.description: Austrian Post provides postal services in Austria. Established in 1999 after splitting from the state-owned Post und Telekom Austria AG, it is listed on the Vienna Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Nu Skin Enterprises
companies.description: Nu Skin Enterprises, Inc. is an American multilevel marketing company that develops and sells personal care products and dietary supplements. Founded in 1984, it operates under the Nu Skin and Pharmanex brands and sells products in 54 markets through about 1.2 million independent distributors.

companies.name: Horiba
companies.description: Horiba, Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of precision instruments for measurement and analysis. Its products include instruments that measure automobile exhaust gas and applications in environmental, medical, and scientific fields.

companies.name: Check Point
companies.description: Check Point Software Technologies Ltd. is an Israeli cybersecurity company based in Tel Aviv. Founded in 1993, it sells network firewalls and security products for various platforms and has acquired startups focused on AI security tools since 2025.

companies.name: Computershare
companies.description: Computershare Limited is an Australian stock transfer company providing corporate trust, stock transfer, and employee share plan services internationally.

companies.name: Novolipetsk Steel
companies.description: Novolipetsk Steel (NLMK) is one of Russia's four largest steel companies, producing flat steel, semi-finished steel, electrical steels, and specialty coated steels. It is the 21st-largest steel maker globally and owns several steel and mining companies primarily in Russia.

companies.name: Arbutus Biopharma
companies.description: Arbutus Biopharma Corporation is a Canadian biopharmaceutical company specializing in liposomal drug delivery and RNA interference. It is developing drugs for hepatitis B infection and is publicly traded.

companies.name: Yokogawa Electric
companies.description: Yokogawa Electric Corporation is a Japanese multinational electrical engineering and software company. Its business focuses on measurement, control, and information technologies.

companies.name: Rexam
companies.description: Rexam plc was a British multinational consumer packaging company headquartered in London. Originally a paper producer known as Bowater, it became a leading beverage can manufacturer with 55 plants worldwide before being acquired by Ball Corporation in 2016.

companies.name: Tradedoubler
companies.description: Tradedoubler is a global affiliate marketing network and provider of performance marketing and technology. Founded in Stockholm, Sweden, in 1999 by Felix Hagnö and Martin Lorentzon, it is led by president and CEO Matthias Stadelmeyer since 2014.

companies.name: Koppers
companies.description: Koppers is a global chemical and materials company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States. Its headquarters is located in the art-deco 1920s skyscraper known as the Koppers Tower.

companies.name: Newmont Mining Corporation
companies.description: Newmont Corporation is an American gold mining company based in Denver, Colorado. Incorporated in 1921, it owns gold mines across multiple countries and also mines copper, silver, zinc, and lead. It is the world's largest gold mining corporation.

companies.name: Peabody Energy
companies.description: Peabody Energy is an American coal mining company headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. It mines, sells, and distributes coal used in electricity generation and steelmaking, and also markets and trades coal through offices in China, Australia, and the United States.

companies.name: Marsh & McLennan Companies
companies.description: Marsh & McLennan Companies is an American professional services firm headquartered in New York City. It operates in insurance brokerage, risk management, reinsurance, talent management, investment advisory, and consulting, and is the largest insurance broker worldwide.

companies.name: Wilmar International
companies.description: Wilmar International Limited is a Singaporean food processing and investment holding company founded in 1991. It is one of Asia's leading agribusiness groups and was ranked 211th in the Fortune Global 500 list in 2020.

companies.name: Ricoh
companies.description: Ricoh Company, Ltd. is a Japanese multinational imaging and electronics company founded in 1936. Its headquarters is located in Ōta, Tokyo, and it originated from the commercial division of the Institute of Physical and Chemical Research (Riken).

companies.name: Sun Hung Kai Properties
companies.description: Sun Hung Kai Properties Limited is a listed corporation and one of the largest property developers in Hong Kong. Its businesses include property sales, rental, telecommunications, hotel operation, transport, and logistics, and it is controlled by the Kwok family trust.

companies.name: Kunlun Energy
companies.description: Kunlun Energy Company Limited is a Hong Kong-listed company engaged in exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas. Its parent company is China National Petroleum Corporation, and it operates in multiple countries including China and Kazakhstan.

companies.name: Reinsurance Group of America
companies.description: Reinsurance Group of America, Incorporated is a holding company for a global life and health reinsurance entity based in Chesterfield, Missouri, United States. It focuses primarily on life and health-related reinsurance and has grown to be an international company in this sector.

companies.name: SFC Energy
companies.description: SFC Energy is a German manufacturer of direct methanol and hydrogen fuel cells based in Brunnthal near Munich. The company develops solutions for off-grid and stationary power generation, including voltage converters and switching power supplies. It has production sites in Germany, the Netherlands, Romania, and Canada.

companies.name: AlamTri Resources
companies.description: PT AlamTri Resources Tbk is an Indonesian coal mining company and the country's second-largest by production volume. It operates the largest single-site coal mine in the southern hemisphere located in Tabalong district, South Kalimantan. The company operates under a first-generation CCA with the Indonesian Government valid until 2022.

companies.name: Ladbrokes
companies.description: Ladbrokes is a British gambling company established in 1886. Its product offerings include sports betting, online casino, online poker, and online bingo. The company operates primarily in the United Kingdom.

companies.name: Owens-Illinois
companies.description: O-I Glass, Inc. is an American company specializing in container glass products. It is the largest manufacturer of glass containers across North America, South America, Asia-Pacific, and Europe. The company operates in the product packaging industry.

companies.name: LEG Immobilien
companies.description: LEG Immobilien SE is a German property company. As of 2025, it is a constituent of the MDAX trading index of German mid-cap companies. The company operates in the real estate industry.

companies.name: Uzbekneftegaz
companies.description: Uzbekneftegaz is a state-owned holding company of Uzbekistan's oil and gas industry. It serves as the national holding company for the country's petroleum sector. The company is based in Uzbekistan.

companies.name: Parques Reunidos
companies.description: Parques Reunidos is an international entertainment operator based in Madrid, Spain. It operates over 60 parks in nine countries, including theme parks, zoos, water parks, family entertainment centers, and cable cars. The group has facilities across Europe and attracts millions of annual visitors.

companies.name: The People's Insurance Company (Group) of China Limited
companies.logo_file: People's Insurance Company of China logo 2.png
companies.description: The People's Insurance Company (Group) of China Limited, known as PICC, is a Chinese listed insurer. The Chinese Central Government is the controlling shareholder. The company operates in the insurance industry.

companies.name: CAE Inc.
companies.description: CAE Inc. is a Canadian manufacturer of simulation and modelling technologies and training services for airlines, aircraft manufacturers, and defense customers. Founded in 1947, it has manufacturing operations and training facilities in 35 countries worldwide.

companies.name: National Post
companies.description: The National Post is a Canadian English-language broadsheet newspaper and the flagship publication of the American-owned Postmedia Network. It is published Monday through Saturday and distributed in several Canadian provinces. It is one of Canada's two national newspapers.

companies.name: Woodside Energy
companies.description: Woodside Energy Group Ltd is an Australian petroleum exploration and production company headquartered in Perth, Western Australia. It operates oil and gas production in Australia and is the country's largest independent dedicated oil and gas company. Woodside is publicly listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.

companies.name: Leggett & Platt
companies.description: Leggett & Platt is an American diversified manufacturer based in Carthage, Missouri. The company designs and produces engineered components and products found in homes and automobiles. Founded in 1883, it operates 15 business units and 135 manufacturing facilities in 18 countries.

companies.name: Mitsui Fudosan
companies.description: Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd. is a major Japanese real estate developer with properties worldwide. It is one of the core companies of the Mitsui Group. The company is based in Japan.

companies.name: Tokyo Gas
companies.description: Tokyo Gas Co., Ltd., founded in 1885, is the primary natural gas provider to major cities in Japan including Tokyo and Kanagawa. As of 2012, it is the largest natural gas utility in Japan.

companies.name: KOLON Industries
companies.description: Kolon Industries is a South Korean chemical and textile manufacturer founded in 1957 as Korea Nylon Inc. It produces chemicals, materials, and fashion products. In 2015, it opened South Korea's first shopping mall built with shipping containers and has a US subsidiary selling polyester and nylon films.

companies.name: Esterline
companies.description: Esterline Technologies Corporation was a publicly traded company designing and manufacturing specialty products primarily for aerospace and defense customers. It supplied products and equipment to aerospace companies like Boeing and Airbus and to American and allied military forces.

companies.name: Farmer Brothers
companies.description: Farmer Bros. Co. is an American coffee foodservice company based in Fort Worth, Texas. It specializes in manufacturing and distributing coffee, tea, and about 300 other foodservice items used by restaurants and other establishments.

companies.name: Catalyst Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Catalyst Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company based in Coral Gables, Florida. It develops medicines for rare diseases, including Firdapse, a drug approved by the FDA for treating Lambert–Eaton myasthenic syndrome in adults and children.

companies.name: Envivio
companies.description: Envivio, Inc. was a software-based video processing and delivery company founded in 2000 in San Francisco. It was acquired by Ericsson in 2015, and in 2019 Ericsson sold its television business unit to One Equity Partners, forming MediaKind.

companies.name: CIMIC Group
companies.description: CIMIC Group Limited is an engineering-led company specializing in construction, mining, services, and public private partnerships. It works across the lifecycle of assets, infrastructure, and resources projects.

companies.name: ForgeRock
companies.description: ForgeRock, Inc. was an identity and access management software company headquartered in San Francisco. In August 2023, it was acquired by Thoma Bravo and merged into Ping Identity, with its technology incorporated into the Ping Identity platform.

companies.name: Methode Electronics
companies.description: Methode Electronics is an American multinational company headquartered in Southfield, Michigan. It operates engineering, manufacturing, and sales operations in more than 35 locations across 14 countries and employs around 6,500 people worldwide.

companies.name: Syneos Health
companies.description: Syneos Health is an American company based in Morrisville, North Carolina, providing contract research and commercial services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. It specializes in late-stage clinical trials and commercial services to market health treatments.

companies.name: Taboola
companies.description: Taboola is a public advertising technology company headquartered in New York City. Founded in 2007, it operates a digital advertising platform that connects advertisers with audiences across publisher websites using machine learning techniques.

companies.name: Robinhood
companies.description: Robinhood Markets, Inc. is an American financial services company based in Menlo Park, California. It provides an electronic trading platform for various financial instruments and offers additional services including cryptocurrency wallets, wealth management, and banking products.

companies.name: Habit Burger & Grill
companies.description: The Habit Restaurants, LLC, doing business as Habit Burger & Grill, is a fast casual restaurant chain based in Irvine, California. It specializes in chargrilled hamburgers and typical fast-casual fare.

companies.name: Tsinghua Unigroup
companies.description: Tsinghua Unigroup Co., Ltd. is a state-owned Chinese technology and semiconductor manufacturer based in Beijing. It is among China's largest technology conglomerates, with subsidiaries including UNISOC, the country's largest mobile phone chip designer.

companies.name: Qorvo
companies.description: Qorvo, Inc. was an American semiconductor company headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina. It developed and manufactured radio-frequency, analog, mixed-signal, and power-management semiconductor products for various applications including wireless communications and defense.

companies.name: Supermicro
companies.description: Super Micro Computer, Inc., known as Supermicro, is an American IT company based in San Jose, California. It produces high-performance servers, server management software, and storage systems for markets such as enterprise data centers, cloud computing, AI, 5G, and edge computing.

companies.name: National Oilwell Varco
companies.description: NOV, formerly National Oilwell Varco, is an American multinational corporation based in Houston, Texas. It provides equipment and components for oil and gas drilling and production, oilfield services, and supply chain integration to the upstream oil and gas industry worldwide.

companies.name: Optimus Telecomunicações
companies.description: Optimus Comunicações, S.A. was a Portuguese mobile operator providing GSM, UMTS, and LTE services. It was a wholly owned subsidiary of Sonaecom. In 2014, Optimus merged with ZON Multimédia to form a new company called NOS.

companies.name: Renewable Energy Corporation
companies.description: Renewable Energy Corporation (REC) is a solar power company headquartered in Singapore. It produces silicon materials for photovoltaic applications, multicrystalline wafers, solar cells, and modules. REC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Reliance New Solar Energy Limited.

companies.name: Beyond Meat
companies.description: Beyond Meat, Inc. is a U.S.-based producer of plant-based meat alternatives founded in 2009. The company launched its products in the United States in 2012. It is known for its focus on plant-based food products.

companies.name: Bill.com, LLC
companies.description: BILL Holdings, Inc. is an American company based in San Jose, California, providing automated cloud-based software for financial operations targeting small businesses. It offers Bill.com Connect, a payments automation platform for financial institutions integrated into their online banking ecosystems.

companies.name: Tandy Leather Factory
companies.description: Tandy Leather Factory, Inc. is an American specialty retailer and wholesale distributor of leather and leatherwork products. It operates over 100 stores worldwide and was originally part of the Tandy Corporation. Its flagship store in Fort Worth, Texas houses the Al and Ann Stohlman Leathercraft Museum.

companies.name: Liaoning Chengda
companies.description: Liaoning Chengda Company Limited is a state-owned conglomerate based in Dalian, Liaoning, China. Its business activities include exports and imports, trading, chemical fertilizers, pharmaceuticals, property leasing, biological vaccines, and warehousing.

companies.name: Linamar
companies.description: Linamar Corporation is a Canadian manufacturing company serving the mobility, access, agriculture, and MedTech industries. It operates through three segments: Industrial, Mobility, and eLIN.

companies.name: Lincoln National Corporation
companies.description: Lincoln National Corporation is a Fortune 200 American holding company operating multiple insurance and investment management businesses through subsidiaries. Lincoln Financial Group is the marketing name for the company and its subsidiaries.

companies.name: Sabesp
companies.description: Sabesp is a Brazilian water and waste management company headquartered in São Paulo. It provides water and sewage services to residential, commercial, and industrial users in São Paulo and 363 municipalities under long-term concession contracts. It is the largest water and waste management company in Latin America.

companies.name: Voltage
companies.description: Voltage Inc. is a Japanese developer and publisher of interactive story apps, including visual novels and otome games for iOS and Android. It previously developed games through its San Francisco-based subsidiary Voltage Entertainment USA.

companies.name: IHH Healthcare
companies.description: IHH Healthcare Berhad is a multinational private healthcare group headquartered in Singapore and Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It operates 190 healthcare facilities, including 89 hospitals, across 10 countries. The group employs 76,000 people in regions including Singapore, Malaysia, Turkey, India, and Greater China.

companies.name: Kite Pharma
companies.description: Kite Pharma, Inc. is an American biotechnology company based in Santa Monica, California. It develops cancer immunotherapy products focusing on genetically engineered autologous CAR T cell therapy. Founded in 2009, it was acquired by Gilead Sciences in 2017.

companies.name: Globus Medical
companies.description: Globus Medical, Inc. is a publicly traded orthopedic medical device company headquartered in Audubon, Pennsylvania. It designs, develops, and commercializes products to help surgeons promote healing in patients with musculoskeletal disorders.

companies.name: Hertz Car Sales
companies.description: Hertz Car Sales is a division of Hertz Global Holdings that sells vehicles previously used in the Hertz rental fleet. It is based in Estero, Florida, with over 68 dealer locations in the U.S. and additional units in several European countries.

companies.name: Splunk Inc.
companies.description: Splunk Inc. is a subsidiary of Cisco Systems producing software for indexing, searching, and analyzing machine-generated data. Its products support cyber security and observability through dashboards, alerts, and reports. Splunk offers on-premises software and SaaS solutions.

companies.name: Scentre Group
companies.description: Scentre Group Limited is a shopping centre company operating retail destinations under the Westfield brand in Australia and New Zealand. It manages ownership, development, design, and leasing of its centres. The group was formed in 2014 after separating from the Westfield Group's American and European businesses.

companies.name: Stitch Fix
companies.description: Stitch Fix, Inc. is an online personal styling service based in San Francisco, California. It combines human stylists with AI tools to recommend clothing and accessories based on fit, budget, and style. The company was founded in 2011 and went public in 2017.

companies.name: Yuehua Entertainment
companies.description: Yuehua Entertainment is a privately held Chinese multinational entertainment group and talent agency based in Beijing. Founded in 2009, it is involved in television and movie production, artist management, music production, and entertainment marketing. It has partnered with South Korean entertainment companies.

companies.name: Quality Technology Services
companies.description: Quality Technology Services is an American provider of carrier-neutral data centers offering colocation services in North America and the Netherlands. Headquartered in Overland Park, Kansas, its largest operating areas include Northern Virginia, Dallas/Fort Worth, Chicago, and locations in Europe.

companies.name: Wealthfront
companies.description: Wealthfront Corporation is an American financial services company based in Palo Alto, California, founded in 2008. It manages assets for more than 1.5 million clients.

companies.name: Canopy Growth Corporation
companies.description: Canopy Growth Corporation is a Canadian cannabis company based in Smiths Falls, Ontario. It was formerly known as Tweed Marijuana Inc.

companies.name: Minerva Foods
companies.description: Minerva Foods is a Brazilian food company founded in 1924 in Barretos, São Paulo. It operates in the agriculture and food industry.

companies.name: Marcopolo
companies.description: Marcopolo S.A. is a Brazilian manufacturer of buses, coaches, and rail vehicles founded in 1949 in Caxias do Sul, Rio Grande do Sul. It produces various types of coach bodies including microbus, intercity, and touring models.

companies.name: Polaris
companies.description: Polaris Inc. is an American automotive manufacturer headquartered in Medina, Minnesota. Founded in Roseau, Minnesota, it has produced motorcycles and personal watercraft and underwent a name change in 2019.

companies.name: SANY Heavy Industry Co., Ltd
companies.description: Sany Heavy Industry Co., Ltd. is a Chinese multinational heavy equipment manufacturer headquartered in Changsha, Hunan. It is the third-largest heavy equipment maker globally and the first in China to enter the FT Global 500 and Forbes Global 2000.

companies.name: The Honest Company
companies.description: The Honest Company, Inc. is an American digital-first consumer goods company based in Los Angeles, founded by Jessica Alba and others. It serves markets including the US, China, Canada, and Europe and went public in May 2021.

companies.name: S-Oil
companies.description: S-Oil Corporation is a petroleum and refinery company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Established in 1976, it produces petroleum, petrochemical, and lubricant products and was listed in the Fortune Global 500 in 2009.

companies.name: Tempo Beverages Ltd
companies.description: Tempo Beer Industries is Israel's largest brewer and the country's second-largest beverage company.

companies.name: Lendlease
companies.description: Lendlease Corporation Limited is an Australian multinational construction and real estate company headquartered in Barangaroo, Sydney, New South Wales. It operates in the real estate development industry.

companies.name: VTech
companies.description: VTech Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based electronics company founded in 1976. It manufactures cordless phones, baby monitors, electronic learning toys, and provides contract manufacturing services.

companies.name: Greenhill & Co.
companies.description: Greenhill & Co., Inc. is an American investment banking advisory firm founded in 1996 in New York. It advises on mergers, acquisitions, restructurings, financings, and capital raisings across various industries.

companies.name: Rayonier Advanced Materials
companies.description: Rayonier Advanced Materials (RYAM) is an American company specializing in cellulose-based technologies and high-purity cellulose specialties. Headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, it serves industries including filters, food, pharmaceuticals, paper, and packaging.

companies.name: Restaurant Brands International
companies.description: Restaurant Brands International Inc. is a Canadian multinational fast food holding company based in Toronto. Formed in 2014 by the merger of Burger King and Tim Hortons, it also owns Popeyes and Firehouse Subs.

companies.name: KAZ Minerals
companies.description: KAZ Minerals is a copper producer operating in Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan. The company focuses on copper mining and developing new copper mining projects in these countries.

companies.name: Lightspeed
companies.description: Lightspeed Commerce is a Canadian point-of-sale and e-commerce software provider based in Montreal, Quebec. Founded in 2005, it serves retail, restaurant, and hospitality businesses with offices worldwide.

companies.name: OncoMed
companies.description: OncoMed Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was an American pharmaceutical development company headquartered in Redwood City, California. Founded in 2004, it focused on developing targeted antibodies against cancer stem cells and was acquired by Mereo BioPharma in 2019.

companies.name: Umios
companies.description: Umios Corporation is a Japanese seafood company founded in 1880 in Osaka. It is the largest seafood company in Japan with main competitors including Nippon Suisan Kaisha and Kyokuyo Co., Ltd.

companies.name: Amicus Therapeutics
companies.description: Amicus Therapeutics, Inc. is an American biopharmaceutical company based in Princeton, New Jersey. Founded before 2007, it went public in 2007 and is now a subsidiary of BioMarin Pharmaceutical.

companies.name: Sprinklr
companies.description: Sprinklr is an American software company that develops a SaaS customer experience management platform. Its software integrates applications for social media marketing, advertising, content management, collaboration, and customer care. The company is based in the United States.

companies.name: Sweetgreen
companies.description: Sweetgreen is an American fast casual restaurant chain specializing in salads and grain bowls. Founded in 2006, it opened its first store in Washington, D.C. shortly after its founders graduated from Georgetown University. The company operates in the United States.

companies.name: Caesars Entertainment
companies.description: Caesars Entertainment, formerly Eldorado Resorts, is an American hotel and casino entertainment company based in Reno, Nevada. It operates more than 50 properties and adopted its current name after acquiring Caesars Entertainment Corporation in 2020.

companies.name: Global Industrial
companies.description: Global Industrial Company is based in Port Washington, New York, and provides industrial and MRO products through e-commerce websites and relationship marketers across North America. Its primary brand is Global Industrial.

companies.name: Modern Water
companies.description: Modern Water plc is a British company listed on the AIM submarket of the London Stock Exchange since 2007. It owns, installs, and operates advanced membrane technologies and develops systems for water monitoring.

companies.name: Fifth Street Asset Management
companies.description: Fifth Street Asset Management Inc. was an American SEC-registered credit-focused asset manager. The firm lent to small and medium-sized businesses with revenues generally between $25 million and $500 million.

companies.name: 37Games
companies.description: 37Games is a Shanghai-registered international developer and publisher of browser and mobile games. It operates across North America, Europe, China, and several Asian countries, with branch offices in multiple Chinese cities. The company went public on China's A-Share stock market in 2014.

companies.name: Shanghai Shentong Metro Group Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Shanghai Shentong Metro Group Co., Ltd. operates the Shanghai Metro and Shanghai Maglev systems. It manages investment, financing, and operations, owning most of the network's assets. The company is named after Shanghai and its transportation function.

companies.name: Meitu
companies.description: Meitu Inc. is a Chinese technology company headquartered in Xiamen, Fujian, established in 2008. It produces smartphones and selfie applications.

companies.name: Booking Holdings
companies.logo_file: Logo of Booking Holdings Inc,(lock up, stacked with Brands, full color).PNG
companies.description: Booking Holdings Inc. is an American travel technology company based in Norwalk, Connecticut. It owns and operates multiple travel fare aggregators and metasearch engines, including Booking.com and Priceline.com, serving customers in about 40 languages and 200 countries.

companies.name: Neles
companies.description: Neles Oyj was a Finnish publicly traded company offering flow control products and services for process industries. It originated from the Neles trademark filed in 1956 by Finnish engineers. The company started operations on July 1, 2020, after the transformation of the remaining Metso following a merger.

companies.name: Puuilo
companies.description: Puuilo is a Finnish retail chain founded in 1982 specializing in DIY products including tools, construction, electrical, and plumbing supplies. It also sells garden, car, household, pet, and leisure products. Puuilo operates about 60 stores across Finland and plans to expand into Sweden by 2026.

companies.name: Walgreens Boots Alliance
companies.description: Walgreens Boots Alliance, Inc. was an American multinational holding company headquartered in Deerfield, Illinois. It was formed in 2014 after Walgreens acquired the remaining stake in Alliance Boots. In 2025, it was taken private by Sycamore Partners and split into five new companies.

companies.name: SolarEdge
companies.description: SolarEdge Technologies, Inc. is an Israeli company producing DC optimized inverter systems. Founded in 2006, it began mass production in 2009 and went public on Nasdaq in 2015. In 2023, it was removed from the S&P 500 after being the worst performing stock in the index that year.

companies.name: Louisiana-Pacific
companies.description: Louisiana-Pacific Corporation is an American building materials manufacturer founded in 1973. It was the first in the U.S. to commercially produce oriented strand board panels. Based in Nashville, Tennessee, it produces OSB and engineered wood products sold through distributors and retail home centers.

companies.name: SeaLink Travel Group
companies.description: Kelsian Group Limited, formerly SeaLink Travel Group, is an Australian public company operating transport services in Australia, the UK, Jersey, the USA, and Singapore. It provides various transport services across these regions.

companies.name: Tradeweb Llc
companies.description: Tradeweb Markets Inc., headquartered in New York City, operates electronic trading platforms mainly for institutional investors trading fixed income products, ETFs, and derivatives. It serves over 3,000 customers including banks and asset managers, with revenue primarily from transaction fees and commissions.

companies.name: Unipar Carbocloro
companies.description: Unipar Carbocloro is a publicly traded Brazilian chemical company based in São Paulo. The company is chaired by Frank Geyer Abubakir and operates in the chemical industry.

companies.name: Vivmark Residential
companies.description: Vivmark Residential is a real estate investment trust based in Arlington, Virginia, and Chicago, Illinois. It invests in apartments and, as of August 2026, owned or had investments in 184,000 rental apartments with over 11,100 under construction.

companies.name: Unipro
companies.description: Unipro is a Russian power generation company formed by merging five generation companies. The majority ownership (83.73%) is held by German energy company Uniper, with the remainder owned by minority shareholders. The company has had several general directors since 2023.

companies.name: MTS Systems Corporation
companies.description: MTS Systems Corporation is a United States-based supplier of test and simulation systems. It provides test and measurement products to assess the performance and reliability of vehicles, aircraft, civil structures, biomedical materials, and raw materials. Notable products include aerodynamics simulators, seismic simulators, and hydraulic actuators.

companies.name: Magellan Aerospace
companies.description: Magellan Aerospace Corporation is a Canadian manufacturer of aerospace systems and components. It also offers repair, overhaul, testing, and aftermarket support for engines and structural components. The company operates in Canada, the United States, and the United Kingdom with corporate offices in Mississauga, Ontario.

companies.name: Granite Real Estate
companies.description: Granite Real Estate Investment Trust is a Canadian REIT focused on acquiring, developing, owning, and managing industrial, warehouse, and logistics properties in North America and Europe. It was originally composed mainly of former holdings of Magna International.

companies.name: Time Warner Cable
companies.description: Time Warner Cable Enterprises LLC was an American cable television company headquartered in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. It was the second largest cable company in the United States by revenue before being acquired by Charter Communications in 2016. It operated in 29 states with additional offices in Connecticut, North Carolina, and Virginia.

companies.name: Tata Motors Limited
companies.description: Tata Motors Limited is an Indian multinational commercial vehicle manufacturer headquartered in Mumbai. It produces trucks, vans, and buses and is part of the Tata Group.

companies.name: FactSet
companies.description: FactSet Research Systems Inc. is an American financial data and software company headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut. It provides integrated data and software solutions for financial professionals.

companies.name: KOSÉ Corporation
companies.description: Kosé Holdings Corporation is a Japanese multinational company that manufactures cosmetics, personal care, and beauty products. It is headquartered in Chūō, Tokyo.

companies.name: MISC Group
companies.description: MISC Berhad, formerly Malaysia International Shipping Corporation Berhad, is Malaysia's leading international shipping line. It operates a fleet of over 120 vessels and is involved in ship owning, operating, offshore facilities, marine repair, and engineering. Its main shareholder is Petronas, Malaysia's national oil conglomerate.

companies.name: Thai Airways
companies.description: Thai Airways International plc is the flag carrier airline of Thailand headquartered in Bangkok. Founded in 1961, it operates primarily from Suvarnabhumi Airport and is a founding member of the Star Alliance. It also holds a stake in Nok Air and launched the regional carrier Thai Smile, which is planned to merge back into Thai Airways.

companies.name: RenoNorden
companies.description: RenoNorden is a Norwegian multinational waste collection company headquartered in Frogner, Norway.

companies.name: UPM
companies.description: UPM-Kymmene Oyj is a Finnish forest industry company formed in 1996 by merging Kymmene Corporation with Repola Oy and United Paper Mills Ltd. It operates six business areas including UPM Fibres and UPM Energy, with production plants in 11 countries. UPM is listed on the NASDAQ OMX Helsinki stock exchange and is the only paper company in the global Dow Jones Sustainability Index.

companies.name: Suning.com
companies.description: Suning.com Co., Ltd. is a major Chinese retailer headquartered in Nanjing, Jiangsu. It operates over 10,000 stores nationwide and its e-commerce platform ranks among the top three Chinese B2C companies. Suning.com was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2004 and ranked 328th on the Fortune Global 500 list in 2021.

companies.name: Marshall & Ilsley
companies.description: Marshall & Ilsley Corporation was a U.S. bank and diversified financial services company based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. It was acquired by Bank of Montreal in 2010.

companies.name: Maxell
companies.description: Maxell, Ltd. is a Japanese company that manufactures consumer electronics. It is commonly known simply as Maxell.

companies.name: McCormick & Company
companies.description: McCormick & Company, Incorporated is an American food company that produces, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments, and other flavoring products. Its customers include retail outlets, food manufacturers, and food service businesses.

companies.name: Meredith Corporation
companies.description: Meredith Corporation was an American media conglomerate based in Des Moines, Iowa, owning newspapers, magazines, television stations, and websites. Its publications had a large readership and its broadcast stations reached 11% of U.S. households. Since 2021, Meredith has been part of Dotdash Meredith under IAC Inc.

companies.name: Mesa Air Group
companies.description: Mesa Air Group, Inc. was a Nevada-based commercial aviation holding company headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona. It operated Mesa Airlines, which flew as United Express and American Eagle under agreements with United Airlines and American Airlines.

companies.name: Yuke's
companies.description: Yuke's Co. Ltd. is a Japanese video game developer based in Osaka, established in 1993 by Yukinori Taniguchi. The company is known for developing the WWE video game series until 2018.

companies.name: IDT Corporation
companies.description: IDT Corporation is a multinational company headquartered in Newark, New Jersey, providing cloud communications, point of sale systems, unified communications, and financial foreign exchange services. It serves both business and consumer markets, including the Boss Revolution prepaid phone cards.

companies.name: Harley-Davidson
companies.description: Harley-Davidson, Inc. is an American motorcycle manufacturer and lifestyle brand headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Founded in 1903, it is one of two major American motorcycle manufacturers to survive the Great Depression. The company is known for its loyal following and has owner clubs and events worldwide.

companies.name: Prada
companies.description: Prada S.p.A. is an Italian luxury fashion house founded in 1913 in Milan by Mario Prada. The company licenses its name and branding to Luxottica for eyewear and L'Oréal for fragrances and cosmetics. Prada is a notable name in the fashion industry.

companies.name: Micro Focus International
companies.description: Micro Focus International plc was a British multinational software and information technology business based in Newbury, Berkshire, England. The firm provided software and consultancy services. It was listed on the London and New York Stock Exchanges until its acquisition by OpenText in January 2023.

companies.name: Mikuni
companies.description: Mikuni Corporation is a Japanese automotive products manufacturer focused on carburetors, fuel injectors, and other automobile and motorcycle related equipment. The company operates in the automotive industry in Japan.

companies.name: Terex
companies.description: Terex Corporation is an American company that manufactures materials processing machinery, waste and recycling equipment, mobile elevating work platforms, and equipment for the electric utility industry. It operates globally in the Americas, Europe, Australia, and Asia Pacific.

companies.name: Stanley Gibbons
companies.description: The Stanley Gibbons Group plc is a London-incorporated company specializing in retailing collectible postage stamps and related products. It is a major stamp dealer and philatelic publisher with a subsidiary that held a royal warrant from Queen Elizabeth II.

companies.name: Mitchells & Butlers
companies.description: Mitchells & Butlers plc operates pubs, bars, and restaurants in the United Kingdom. The company is headquartered in Birmingham, England, and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Qumak
companies.description: Qumak S.A. is a Polish company that develops information and communications technology. It collaborates with fifty technology companies to develop products and has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since August 2006.

companies.name: Molex
companies.description: Molex, LLC is a manufacturer of electronic, electrical, and fiber optic connectivity systems based in the United States. It produces over 100,000 products for various industries and is known for pioneering the Molex connector widely adopted in personal computing.

companies.name: MoneyGram
companies.description: MoneyGram International, Inc. is an American peer-to-peer payments and money transfer company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It operates an operations center in St. Louis Park, Minnesota, and has regional and local offices worldwide.

companies.name: Monster Beverage
companies.description: Monster Beverage Corporation is an American company that manufactures energy drinks such as Monster Energy, Relentless, Reign, and Burn. Founded in 1935 in Southern California as Hansen's, it originally sold juice products. The company renamed itself Monster Beverage in 2012.

companies.name: Morgan Crucible
companies.description: Morgan Advanced Materials plc is a UK-based company headquartered in Windsor that manufactures specialist products using carbon, advanced ceramics, and composites. It operates 57 sites worldwide and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as a public limited company.

companies.name: CK Hutchison Holdings
companies.description: CK Hutchison Holdings Limited is a multinational conglomerate based in Hong Kong and registered in the Cayman Islands. Formed in 2015 by merging Cheung Kong Holdings and Hutchison Whampoa, it operates four core businesses: ports, retail, infrastructure, and telecommunications across over 50 countries.

companies.name: Mitel
companies.description: Mitel Networks Corporation is a Canadian telecommunications company headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario. It shifted focus after 2001 from TDM PBX systems to Voice-over-IP, unified communications, collaboration, and contact center products, with offices and partners worldwide.

companies.name: Helmerich & Payne
companies.description: Helmerich & Payne, Inc. is an American petroleum contract drilling company headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma. It provides oil and gas well drilling services worldwide and is known for its FlexRigs used extensively in unconventional shale formations. It is the largest onshore driller in the U.S.

companies.name: Murphy USA
companies.description: Murphy USA is an American corporation based in El Dorado, Arkansas, operating a chain of retail gas stations primarily near Walmart stores. It was founded in 2013 as a spin-off from Murphy Oil.

companies.name: Sucampo Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Sucampo Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was a pharmaceutical company headquartered in Rockville, Maryland, focusing on gastroenterology, ophthalmology, and oncology-related disorders. The company was acquired by Mallinckrodt in 2018.

companies.name: TT Electronics Plc
companies.description: TT Electronics Plc is a global manufacturer of electronic components and provider of manufacturing services headquartered in London, England. It is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: United Plantations
companies.description: United Plantations Berhad is a Malaysia-based company specializing in oil palm plantations.

companies.name: Vericel
companies.description: Vericel Corporation is an American biopharmaceutical company formerly known as Aastrom Bio until October 2014. It was originally formed in 1989 in Ann Arbor, Michigan. The company is publicly traded and operates in the biotechnology sector.

companies.name: Kenon Holdings Ltd
companies.description: Kenon Holdings is a public corporation spun off from Israel Corporation and traded on the New York and Tel Aviv Stock Exchanges. It is owned by Israeli businessman Idan Ofer and controls Israel Corp's investments in companies such as Qoros. The company is based in Israel.

companies.name: Bursa Çimento
companies.description: Bursa Çimento is the sole cement factory in Bursa, Turkey, established in 1966 as a joint stock company. It has a production facility in Kütahya and maintains a 100% publicly traded capital. The factory's foundation was laid with participation from Prime Minister Süleyman Demirel.

companies.name: NSK Ltd.
companies.description: NSK Ltd., also known as NSK Automation in some markets, is a major Japanese manufacturer of bearings. It produces industrial machinery bearings, precision machinery parts, and automotive bearings and components. NSK is the largest bearing manufacturer in Japan.

companies.name: NV Energy
companies.description: NV Energy is an investor-owned public utility based in Las Vegas, Nevada. It generates, transmits, and distributes electric service in northern and southern Nevada and provides natural gas service in the Reno-Sparks area. The company serves about 1.3 million customers and many tourists annually.

companies.name: HUI Gold Index
companies.description: The NYSE Arca Gold BUGS Index, also known by its ticker symbol HUI, is a modified equal dollar weighted index of companies involved in gold mining. BUGS stands for Basket of Unhedged Gold Stocks. It is a stock market index based in the United States.

companies.name: Nabors Industries
companies.description: Nabors Industries Limited is an American global oil and gas drilling contractor headquartered in Houston, Texas. It owns the world's second largest land drilling rig fleet with over 250 rigs operating in 20 countries. The company operates in the oil and gas industry.

companies.name: Standard BioTools Inc.
companies.description: Standard BioTools Inc., formerly Fluidigm Corp., is an American life science tools company. It offers analytical mass cytometry systems for flow cytometry and tissue imaging, automated genomic analysis instruments, microfluidic arrays, and associated reagents and services.

companies.name: ScS
companies.description: poltronesofà UK, formerly known as ScS, is a home furnishings retailer in the United Kingdom specializing in sofas. It has been owned by the Italian furniture group Poltronesofà since 2024, and its UK stores were rebranded from ScS to poltronesofà in March 2026.

companies.name: Johnson Outdoors
companies.description: Johnson Outdoors Inc. produces outdoor recreational products including watercraft, diving equipment, camping gear, and outdoor clothing. It operates in 24 locations worldwide and has been run by Helen Johnson-Leipold since 1999. The company is based in the United States.

companies.name: Natco Pharma
companies.description: Natco Pharma is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company based in Hyderabad. It manufactures finished dosage formulations, active pharmaceutical ingredients, and agrochemical products. The company is a major producer of branded oncology, cardiology, diabetology, and other specialty drugs at affordable prices.

companies.name: Everest Bank Limited
companies.description: Everest Bank Limited is a commercial bank in Nepal and a joint venture with Punjab National Bank of India, which holds 20% equity. It is the first Nepalese bank with a Representative Office in India and operates a wide network of branches, ATMs, and revenue collection counters.

companies.name: TGC-1
companies.description: TGC-1 is a regional power company headquartered in Saint Petersburg, Russia. It operates in North-West Russia with branches in Karelia and Kola. The company is involved in power engineering.

companies.name: Machhapuchhre Bank
companies.description: Machhapuchchhre Bank Limited is the first regional commercial bank from western Nepal, registered in 1998. It started operations in 2000 from its head office in Pokhara, located in the foothills of Machhapuchchhre.

companies.name: Mega Bank Nepal Limited
companies.description: Mega Bank Nepal Limited was an 'A' class commercial bank licensed by Nepal Rastra Bank. It had branches nationwide with its head office in Kathmandu and provided comprehensive commercial banking services.

companies.name: Danya Group
companies.description: Danya Cebus is an Israeli construction company founded in 1997 and a subsidiary of Africa Israel Investments. It operates in Israel, Russia, and Romania.

companies.name: PRIO
companies.description: PRIO S.A. is a Brazilian publicly traded company focused on oil and gas production. It specializes in efficient reservoir management and development of mature fields without investing in asset recovery.

companies.name: Saudi Arabian Fertilizer Company
companies.description: Saudi Arabian Fertilizer Company (SAFCO) is the first petrochemical company in Saudi Arabia, established in 1965. It is one of the largest chemical producers globally, with SABIC owning 42.99% and the rest held by private and public sectors.

companies.name: Kedawung Setia Industrial
companies.description: Kedawung Setia Industrial is an Indonesian home appliance manufacturer based in Surabaya, East Java. Founded in 1973, it mainly produces enamelware products.

companies.name: Mustika Ratu
companies.description: PT Mustika Ratu Tbk is an Indonesian manufacturer of cosmetics and herbal medicine headquartered in South Jakarta. The company operates a factory in Ciracas to support its business activities.

companies.name: Pakuwon Jati
companies.description: PT Pakuwon Jati Tbk is an Indonesian real estate developer based in Surabaya. It is the holding company of Pakuwon Group, founded in 1982, and focuses on constructing shopping centres and office buildings in Surabaya and Jakarta. Pakuwon Jati is known for embodying the superblock concept in Indonesia, integrating malls, offices, condominiums, and hotels.

companies.name: Ramayana Lestari Sentosa
companies.description: PT Ramayana Lestari Sentosa Tbk is an Indonesian retail company operating department stores and supermarkets across Indonesia. As of 2021, it runs 86 Ramayana department stores, 82 Robinson supermarkets, and 2 Cahaya department stores. The company primarily targets middle to lower income customers.

companies.name: Rimo International Lestari
companies.description: Rimo International Lestari is a company headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia. It was founded in 1987. The summary does not provide further details about its operations.

companies.name: Kintetsu Group Holdings
companies.description: Kintetsu Group Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japanese railway holding company. It primarily owns Kintetsu Railway, Kintetsu World Express, Kintetsu Department Store, and 141 other corporations collectively known as Kintetsu Group.

companies.name: Paysafe Group
companies.description: Paysafe Limited is a multinational online payments company offering payment processing, digital wallet, and online cash systems to businesses and consumers. It serves the global entertainment sectors and operates under the Paysafe brand and several subsidiaries acquired through mergers and acquisitions.

companies.name: Zhong Tong Bus
companies.description: Zhongtong Bus Holding Co., Ltd. is a Chinese bus manufacturing company based in Liaocheng, Shandong Province. It is listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and is one of China's major bus makers.

companies.name: Voxeljet
companies.description: voxeljet AG is a German manufacturer of industrial 3D printing systems based in Friedberg near Augsburg. It develops and distributes printing systems and operates service centers for on-demand manufacturing of molds and models for metal casting in Germany, the USA, and China.

companies.name: Joyoung
companies.description: Joyoung Co., Ltd. is a Chinese manufacturer of home-use soybean milk machines headquartered in Jinan, Shandong. Incorporated in 1994, it was China's largest soybean milk machine company as of 2009 and was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2008.

companies.name: Concordia Healthcare Corp
companies.description: Advanz Pharma Corp., formerly Concordia Healthcare Corp., is a British multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in London. It focuses on various therapy areas and acquiring off-patent pharmaceutical compounds, with operational centers in London, Mumbai, and regional hubs in Europe, Australia, and Canada.

companies.name: Guangzhou Zhujiang Brewery Group
companies.description: Zhujiang Brewery is a large state-owned Chinese enterprise established in 1985, dealing mainly in beer and related products. It operates one of the largest single-site production facilities in the world and produces Zhujiang Beer. Its headquarters is located in Haizhu District.

companies.name: Lufax
companies.description: Lufax, officially Shanghai Lujiazui International Financial Asset Exchange Co., Ltd., is an online Internet finance marketplace headquartered in Lujiazui, Shanghai, China. Founded in 2011, it is an associate of China Ping An Group.

companies.name: NiSource
companies.description: NiSource Inc. is a fully regulated utility company based in Merrillville, Indiana, United States. It serves natural gas and electric customers across six states through its Columbia Gas and NIPSCO brands and is the sole Indiana-based utility company as of 2018.

companies.name: Vipshop
companies.description: Vipshop is a Chinese e-commerce company operating the website VIP.com, specializing in online discount sales. It is based in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China, and was listed on the New York Stock Exchange in 2012.

companies.name: Lens Technology
companies.description: Lens Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese precision manufacturing company producing glass, ceramic, metal, and sapphire components for consumer electronics and automotive interaction systems. Its customers include multinational electronics and automotive manufacturers.

companies.name: Meredian Holdings Group Inc.
companies.description: Danimer Scientific, formerly Meredian Holdings Group Inc., is a biopolymer manufacturer headquartered in Bainbridge, Georgia, United States.

companies.name: Vapotherm
companies.description: Vapotherm Inc. is a medical device manufacturer based in Exeter, New Hampshire, United States. Founded in 1999, it created the first heated and humidified high flow therapy nasal cannula system.

companies.name: Ventas, Inc.
companies.description: Ventas, Inc. is a real estate investment trust specializing in owning and managing research, medicine, and healthcare facilities in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom.

companies.name: Catalent Pharma Solutions
companies.description: Catalent, Inc. is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Tampa, Florida. It provides drug delivery technologies, development, manufacturing, biologics, gene therapy, and consumer health products, operating over 50 facilities on four continents.

companies.name: ClearSign Combustion
companies.description: ClearSign Technologies Corporation is a United States-based company that develops emission-control technology.

companies.name: WPX Energy
companies.description: WPX Energy, Inc. was a hydrocarbon exploration company organized in Delaware and headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma. In 2021, it merged with Devon Energy.

companies.name: SeaChange International
companies.description: SeaChange International, Inc. is a global supplier of video delivery software based in the United States. It provides video streaming, linear TV, and video advertising technology for operators, content owners, and broadcasters worldwide.

companies.name: PRA Group
companies.description: PRA Group, Inc. is a publicly traded debt buyer and collection company headquartered in Norfolk, Virginia, United States. It purchases delinquent consumer debt from financial institutions at a discount and collects the full amount owed.

companies.name: STX Entertainment
companies.description: STX Financing, LLC is an American independent entertainment and media company founded in 2014. The studio produces film, television, and digital media projects.

companies.name: The Star Entertainment Group
companies.description: The Star Entertainment Group Limited is an Australian gambling and entertainment company formerly known as Echo Entertainment. It is Australia's largest listed casino group.

companies.name: Spire Global
companies.description: Spire Global, Inc. is a space-to-cloud data and analytics company based in the United States. It specializes in tracking global data sets using a constellation of nanosatellites, including maritime, aviation, and weather patterns.

companies.name: Gogoro
companies.description: Gogoro Inc. is a Taiwanese company that developed a battery-swapping platform for electric two-wheel scooters and motorcycles. It also produces electric scooters and operates a rideshare service called GoShare in Taiwan and Japan.

companies.name: Synageva
companies.description: Synageva BioPharma Corp. was a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Lexington, Massachusetts, focused on medicines for rare diseases. It had manufacturing and laboratory locations in Massachusetts and Georgia, as well as offices worldwide.

companies.name: Bandhan Bank
companies.description: Bandhan Bank Ltd. is a private sector bank headquartered in Kolkata, India. It began as an NGO in 2001 and started universal banking operations in 2015, focusing on inclusive banking for unbanked and under-banked populations.

companies.name: Milacron
companies.description: Milacron, LLC is an American company that manufactures and distributes plastic processing equipment such as injection and extrusion molding machines. It is part of Hillenbrand, Inc., which acquired it in 2019.

companies.name: Pricol
companies.description: Pricol Limited is an automotive components manufacturer based in Coimbatore, India. Founded in 1975, it produces parts for motorcycles, cars, trucks, and off-road vehicles, as well as sintered components and fleet management products.

companies.name: DWF LLP
companies.description: DWF LLP is an international law firm headquartered in Manchester, England. It operates 35 offices worldwide, providing legal services across multiple regions.

companies.name: Indivior
companies.description: Indivior is an American pharmaceuticals company focused on substitution products for opioid addiction. It was established as a division of Reckitt Benckiser in 1994 and became independent in 2014. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and NASDAQ.

companies.name: Momentum Metropolitan Holdings Limited
companies.description: Momentum Metropolitan Holdings Limited is a South African financial services group. It is publicly traded on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Navient
companies.description: Navient Corporation is an American financial services company based in Herndon, Virginia. Formed in 2014 from the split of Sallie Mae, it serviced a quarter of all US student loans in 2018 but was barred from servicing federal student loans in 2024.

companies.name: Byco Petroleum
companies.description: Byco Petroleum, now known as Cnergyico Pk Limited, is a petroleum refinery based in Karachi, Pakistan. It is a subsidiary of the Mauritian company Cnergyico Industries Incorporated.

companies.name: Varonis Systems
companies.description: Varonis Systems, Inc. is a software company headquartered in Miami, Florida. It provides a Data Security Platform that analyzes data and activity to remediate exposure in cloud and multi-cloud environments and various SaaS and IaaS applications.

companies.name: Nilesat
companies.description: Nilesat, or Egyptian Satellites Co SAE, is an Egyptian company established in 1996 to operate communications satellites and related ground stations. It is listed on the Egyptian Exchange and majority-controlled by the Egyptian government.

companies.name: CK Asset Holdings
companies.description: CK Asset Holdings Limited is a property developer registered in the Cayman Islands with headquarters in Hong Kong. It was formerly known as Cheung Kong Property Holdings Limited.

companies.name: Nordson Corporation
companies.description: Nordson Corporation is an American multinational headquartered in Westlake, Ohio. It designs and manufactures dispensing equipment for adhesives and coatings, as well as equipment for testing electronic components and medical devices.

companies.name: Interactive Brokers
companies.description: Interactive Brokers Group, Inc. is an American multinational brokerage and financial services company based in Greenwich, Connecticut. It offers automated trade execution and custody services for various financial products worldwide.

companies.name: Golden Power Group
companies.description: Golden Power Group, established in 1972 in Hong Kong, is an industrial and chemical company. It was formerly known as Golden Power Industrial Limited. As of January 2016, the company had total assets of HKD 150 million.

companies.name: Bank of Baroda
companies.description: Bank of Baroda is an Indian public sector bank headquartered in Vadodara, Gujarat. It is the second largest public sector bank in India after State Bank of India. The bank was ranked 455 on the Forbes Global 2000 list based on 2025 data.

companies.name: Magellan Health
companies.description: Magellan Health Inc. is an American for-profit managed health care company and subsidiary of Centene. It focuses on special populations and specialty healthcare areas, serving health plans, employers, unions, military, government agencies, and third-party administrators. It ranked 390 on the Fortune 500 in 2021.

companies.name: Metallurgical Corporation of China Limited
companies.description: Metallurgical Corporation of China Limited (MCC) is a publicly listed Chinese engineering and construction company. It operates in metallurgical engineering, project contracting, resource development, and real estate. The company is listed on the Shanghai and Hong Kong Stock Exchanges and was formed through corporatization of its parent group's assets.

companies.name: Polyus
companies.description: PJSC Polyus is a Russian gold mining company headquartered in Moscow. It is the largest gold producer in Russia and among the top 10 globally by output. Its main assets are located in Eastern Siberia and the Russian Far East.

companies.name: Pharmacyclics
companies.description: Pharmacyclics LLC is an American biopharmaceutical company based in Sunnyvale, California. It focuses on developing cancer therapies. In 2017, Xynomic Pharmaceuticals acquired all global rights to its primary commercial product, Abexinostat.

companies.name: Oklahoma Gas & Electric
companies.description: Oklahoma Gas & Electric Company is a regulated electric utility serving customers in Oklahoma and Arkansas. It is the leading subsidiary of OGE Energy Corp., headquartered in Oklahoma City. OGE Energy previously owned Enogex Inc., which merged to form Enable Midstream, later sold in 2021.

companies.name: OGK-1
companies.description: OGK-1, the First Generation Company of the Wholesale Electricity Market, was a large Russian electricity generation company formed by merging six electricity generation companies.

companies.name: Ocean Rig
companies.description: Ocean Rig UDW Inc. was a Cyprus-based operator of semi-submersible oil platforms and underwater drillships headquartered in Athens. The company was acquired by Transocean in 2018.

companies.name: Oil Search
companies.description: Oil Search was the largest oil and gas exploration and development company incorporated in Papua New Guinea. It operated all of the country's oilfields. In December 2021, it merged with Santos.

companies.name: Jinko Solar
companies.description: JinkoSolar Holding Co., Ltd. is a solar module manufacturer headquartered in Shanghai, China. It has been listed on the New York Stock Exchange since 2010. Its subsidiary was listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange's Science and Technology Innovation Board in 2022.

companies.name: TsUM
companies.description: TsUM — Central Universal Department Store is a high-end department store located in Moscow, Russia. It operates in the retail industry.

companies.name: Nordic Investment Bank
companies.description: The Nordic Investment Bank is an international financial institution founded in 1975 by the five Nordic countries. Its headquarters are in Helsinki, Finland. The bank acquires funds for lending by borrowing on international capital markets.

companies.name: Open Text Corporation
companies.description: Open Text Corporation is a global software company based in Canada. It develops and sells information management software.

companies.name: Zijin Mining Group
companies.description: Zijin Mining Group Co., Limited is a publicly traded partly state-owned mining company headquartered in Longyan, Fujian, China. It is one of the largest producers of gold, copper, and zinc in China, with operations across Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Americas.

companies.name: Orbis
companies.description: Orbis is the oldest travel agency in Poland, founded in 1920 in Lwów. It is currently the largest hotel group in Poland and Central Europe, and the parent company of Orbis S.A. Capital Group with nine subsidiaries.

companies.name: Ally Financial
companies.description: Ally Financial Inc. is an American bank holding company headquartered in Detroit, Michigan. It provides financial services including car finance, online banking, corporate lending, vehicle insurance, mortgage loans, and related financing services.

companies.name: Zimmer Biomet Holdings
companies.description: Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. is a publicly traded American medical device company founded in 1927. It was originally established to produce aluminum splints and is headquartered in Warsaw, Indiana, part of a medical devices business cluster.

companies.name: Westfield Group
companies.description: Westfield Group was an Australian shopping centre company from 1960 to 2014. It split into Scentre Group, operating Australian and New Zealand centres, and Westfield Corporation, which operated American and European centres until merging to form Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield.

companies.name: Allison Transmission
companies.description: Allison Transmission Holdings, Inc. is an American manufacturer specializing in commercial duty automatic transmissions and hybrid propulsion systems. Its products are used by over 250 vehicle manufacturers across various sectors including bus, refuse, fire, construction, distribution, military, and specialty applications.

companies.name: City Union Bank
companies.description: City Union Bank Limited is an Indian private sector bank headquartered in Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu. Originally named Kumbakonam Bank Limited, it was incorporated on 31 October 1904 and initially operated as a regional bank in Kumbakonam.

companies.name: Yes Bank
companies.description: Yes Bank is an Indian private sector bank headquartered in Mumbai. Founded in 2004 by Rana Kapoor and Ashok Kapur, it serves both retail and corporate customers with a network spanning 300 districts in India, including 1,300 branches and over 1,350 ATMs.

companies.name: Dhanlaxmi Bank
companies.description: Dhanlaxmi Bank is an Indian private sector bank headquartered in Thrissur, Kerala. Incorporated on 14 November 1927, it became a Scheduled Commercial Bank in 1977.

companies.name: PPL
companies.description: PPL Corporation is an energy company headquartered in Allentown, Pennsylvania. It operates in the electricity supply sector and serves millions of customers in the eastern Pennsylvania region.

companies.name: South Indian Bank
