companies.description: The South Indian Bank Limited is an Indian private-sector bank headquartered in Thrissur, Kerala. Established during the Swadeshi movement, it transitioned from a private limited to a public limited company in 1939 and offers retail, corporate banking, para banking, treasury, and foreign exchange services.

companies.name: Paladin Energy
companies.description: Paladin Energy Ltd is a uranium mining company based in Western Australia. It operates in the mining and metals industry.

companies.name: Greif, Inc.
companies.description: Greif, Inc. is a global industrial packaging products and services company based in Delaware, Ohio. Originally a barrel manufacturer, it now produces steel, fiber and plastic drums, IBCs, jerrycans, plastic bottles, closures, containerboard, corrugated products, and adhesives.

companies.name: H.B. Fuller
companies.description: H.B. Fuller Company is an American multinational adhesives manufacturer headquartered in St. Paul, Minnesota. It produces over 20,000 products for applications in construction, engineering, electronics, hygiene, and food packaging, with manufacturing facilities in 26 countries.

companies.name: Northern Tier Energy
companies.description: Northern Tier Energy LP was an American downstream energy limited partnership that owned the SuperAmerica gas station chain, an oil refinery in St. Paul Park, Minnesota, and an interest in a pipeline. It was ranked 525 on the Fortune 1000 in 2014.

companies.name: Alon Blue Square Israel Ltd
companies.description: Alon Blue Square is a private Israeli holding company based in Yakum. Originally founded as a retail chain, it later expanded into real estate and other fields. The company is owned by Moti Ben-Moshe.

companies.name: Zions Bancorporation
companies.description: Zions Bancorporation is an American national bank headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah. It operates under seven brands including Zions Bank and Amegy Bank of Texas, functioning as a national bank rather than a bank holding company.

companies.name: Akorn
companies.description: Akorn Operating Company LLC was an American generic pharmaceuticals manufacturer based in Lake Forest, Illinois. It developed, manufactured, and marketed generic and prescription drugs as well as animal and consumer health products. It was part of the NASDAQ Biotechnology Index.

companies.name: PRFoods
companies.description: PRFoods is an Estonian company involved in fish farming, production, and sales. It operates within the food industry focusing on seafood products.

companies.name: IGATE Patni
companies.description: IGATE Corporation was an IT services company headquartered in Bridgewater, New Jersey, operating globally across North America, Asia, Europe, Japan, and Australia. It provided technology consultancy and services and was acquired by Capgemini in 2015.

companies.name: Takashimaya
companies.description: Takashimaya Company, Limited is a Japanese multinational corporation operating a department store chain. It sells a wide range of products including apparel and electronics, with branches in Japan and Asia.

companies.name: Amarin Corporations
companies.description: Amarin Corporations Public Company Limited is a Thai media company known as Amarin Group. It publishes magazines, operates the Naiin bookstore chain, and runs Amarin TV. The company has been listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand since 1993.

companies.name: Areeya Property (PCL.)
companies.description: Areeya Property (PCL.) is a company founded in 2000 that develops real estate projects under the name 'Areeya'. It operates in the real estate sector.

companies.name: Arrow Electronics
companies.description: Arrow Electronics, Inc. is an American company headquartered in Centennial, Colorado. It provides electronic components and enterprise computing products, specializing in distribution and value-added services for various commercial customers.

companies.name: Beijing Yanjing Brewery
companies.description: Beijing Yanjing Brewery is a brewing company founded in 1980 and based in Beijing, China. It is known for Yanjing Beer, which was designated as the official beer served at state banquets in the Great Hall of the People in 1995.

companies.name: Arch Resources
companies.description: Arch Resources, formerly Arch Coal, was an American coal mining and processing company. It mined and marketed bituminous and sub-bituminous coal with low sulfur content, supplying about 15% of the US domestic market mainly to electricity generators.

companies.name: Otokar
companies.description: Otokar Otomotiv ve Savunma Sanayi A.Ş., known as Otokar, is a Turkish manufacturer of buses and military vehicles headquartered in Sakarya, Turkey. It operates as a subsidiary of Koç Holding.

companies.name: Chemours
companies.description: The Chemours Company is an American chemical company headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware. Spun off from DuPont in 2015, it produces refrigerants, titanium dioxide pigment, and industrial fluoropolymer resins, operating 28 major production facilities in 8 countries.

companies.name: United Overseas Bank
companies.description: United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a Singaporean regional bank headquartered at Raffles Place, Singapore. It has branches mainly in Southeast Asia and is one of the three major local banks in Singapore.

companies.name: Fleetmatics
companies.description: Fleetmatics was a provider of software-as-a-service for fleet management based in Dublin, Ireland. It offered web and mobile applications that provided fleet operators with vehicle location, speed, mileage, and fuel usage information, along with field management and job scheduling services.

companies.name: South32
companies.description: South32 Limited is a mining and metals company headquartered in Perth, Western Australia. It was spun out of BHP Billiton in 2015 and is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange with secondary listings in Johannesburg and London.

companies.name: Nomad Foods
companies.description: Nomad Foods is the largest frozen food company in Europe, headquartered in the United Kingdom. It manufactures, sells, and distributes frozen food products across 22 European markets, with popular brands including Birds Eye, Iglo, and Findus.

companies.name: NextEra Energy Partners
companies.description: XPLR Infrastructure is a publicly traded subsidiary of NextEra Energy, a renewable energy company based in Juno Beach, Florida, United States.

companies.name: PerkinElmer
companies.description: PerkinElmer, Inc. is an American global corporation founded in 1937, originally focused on precision optics. It now specializes in diagnostics, life science research, food, environmental and industrial testing, producing analytical instruments and diagnostic tools worldwide.

companies.name: Talen Energy
companies.description: Talen Energy Corporation is an independent power producer and energy infrastructure company based in the United States. It operates in the energy industry, focusing on power production and related infrastructure.

companies.name: Pacific Biosciences
companies.description: Pacific Biosciences of California, Inc. is an American biotechnology company founded in 2004. It develops and manufactures gene sequencing systems, including two principal sequencing platforms: single-molecule real-time sequencing and sequencing by binding chemistry.

companies.name: Complete Genomics
companies.description: Complete Genomics is a life sciences company based in the United States that has developed and commercialized a DNA sequencing platform for human genome sequencing and analysis.

companies.name: Alupar
companies.description: Alupar is a Brazilian holding company dedicated to power generation and transmission. It is one of the largest companies in its segment by Annual Permitted Revenue and is the largest privately held company in this sector in Brazil.

companies.name: Performance Food Group
companies.description: Performance Food Group Company is an American food service distributor. It is the third-largest food service distributor in the U.S., supplying 250,000 products to 300,000 locations including restaurants, healthcare, hospitality, and educational institutions.

companies.name: Live Oak Bank
companies.description: Live Oak Bank is an American bank headquartered in Wilmington, North Carolina. It serves small business owners and was the largest SBA 7(a) lender by dollar volume in fiscal year 2025.

companies.name: Forum Energy Technologies
companies.description: Forum Energy Technologies is an American oilfield products company providing products and services to the oil and gas and renewable industries worldwide.

companies.name: Bank OZK
companies.description: Bank OZK is a regional bank headquartered in Little Rock, Arkansas. It operates 265 offices across six states including Arkansas, Georgia, Florida, North Carolina, Texas, and Tennessee.

companies.name: Alico
companies.description: Alico, Inc. is a holding company in the United States owning Alico Citrus and Alico Water Resources. It owns major land holdings in Florida and announced plans to discontinue citrus crop operations due to disease and weather damage while maintaining agricultural land through leasing.

companies.name: GB Group
companies.description: GB Group plc, trading as GBG, is a UK-based company specializing in identity verification, location intelligence, and fraud prevention. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Caffyns
companies.description: Caffyns plc is a United Kingdom-based motor retailer with dealerships in Ashford, Brighton, Eastbourne, Lewes, Tunbridge Wells, and Worthing. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker CFYN in the general retailers sector.

companies.name: DoorDash
companies.description: DoorDash, Inc. is an American company operating online food ordering and delivery services. It holds a 56% market share in the US food delivery market and a 60% share in convenience delivery. The platform serves merchants, consumers, and delivery couriers across the United States.

companies.name: Primoris Services Corporation
companies.description: Primoris Services Corporation is a publicly traded specialty construction and infrastructure company in the United States. It focuses on pipelines for natural gas, wastewater, and water. In 2026, it was ranked 497th in the Fortune 500.

companies.name: Teladoc
companies.description: Teladoc Health, Inc. is an American telemedicine and virtual healthcare company founded in 2002 and headquartered in New York City. Its services include telehealth, employer-sponsored health plans, mental health, chronic disease management, primary care, and AI analytics.

companies.name: China Energy Engineering
companies.description: China Energy Engineering Corporation, also known as Energy China, is a Chinese state-owned energy conglomerate headquartered in Chaoyang District, Beijing.

companies.name: Miniso
companies.description: MINISO Group Holding Limited is a Chinese retailer and variety store chain specializing in household and consumer goods such as cosmetics, stationery, toys, and kitchenware. Founded in 2013, its headquarters are in Haizhu District, Guangzhou.

companies.name: BNP Paribas Bank Polska
companies.description: BNP Paribas Bank Polska is a Polish bank majority-owned by BNP Paribas of Paris. It originated from a joint venture established in 1994 and expanded significantly after BNP Paribas acquired BGZ Bank in 2015.

companies.name: TOTVS
companies.description: TOTVS S.A. is a Brazilian software company based in São Paulo, formed from the merger of Microsiga and Logocenter. It leads the Brazilian ERP market and has offices in the United States, Portugal, and Latin America.

companies.name: CPL Resources
companies.description: CPL Resources is a human resources company based in Dublin, operating in Ireland and Europe. Founded in 1992, it has 12 companies across 21 offices in the Republic of Ireland, Northern Ireland, and other parts of Europe.

companies.name: Norfolk Southern Corporation
companies.description: Norfolk Southern Railway is a Class I freight railroad operating in the Eastern United States, headquartered in Atlanta. Formed in 1982 by merging Norfolk and Western Railway and Southern Railway, it operates over 19,000 route miles in 22 states and the District of Columbia.

companies.name: PROS
companies.description: PROS Holdings, Inc. is a technology company headquartered in Houston, Texas, that provides revenue management, dynamic pricing, and digital retailing solutions. After acquisition by Thoma Bravo, it refocused exclusively on the airline industry. PROS operates globally with offices in Europe and North America.

companies.name: Tucows
companies.description: Tucows Inc. is an American–Canadian Internet services and telecommunications company headquartered in Toronto, Canada, and incorporated in Pennsylvania, USA. It operates three independent businesses: Tucows Domains, Ting Internet, and Wavelo.

companies.name: Sepahan Oil Company (SOC)
companies.description: Sepahan Oil Company (SOC) is an independent oil refining company based in Tehran, Iran, with refining facilities in Isfahan. Established in 2002, it is the largest producer of base oil in the Middle East and produces diesel and engine oils under the Speedy brand.

companies.name: Sinotrans Limited
companies.description: Sinotrans Limited is one of the largest logistics companies in China. Its business includes storage and terminal services, trucking, and marine transportation.

companies.name: Globe International
companies.description: Globe International Limited is an Australian company founded in 1985 that produces footwear, clothing, and skateboard hardware. It operates internationally with offices in Australia, the USA, France, and China, and is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.

companies.name: UzAuto Motors
companies.description: UzAuto Motors is an automotive manufacturer owned by the Government of Uzbekistan and based in Asaka. It manufactures vehicles under the Chevrolet brand and formerly under the Ravon marque.

companies.name: American Homes 4 Rent
companies.description: American Homes 4 Rent, based in Las Vegas, Nevada, is a real estate investment trust that invests in single-family rental homes. It owns over 52,000 homes across 22 states, with major concentrations in Atlanta, Dallas-Fort Worth, and Charlotte.

companies.name: Everi Holdings
companies.description: Everi Holdings Inc., formerly Global Cash Access Holdings, was based in Spring Valley, Nevada. It produced slot machines and provided financial equipment and services to casinos.

companies.name: Pruksa Holding
companies.description: Pruksa Real Estate Public Company Limited is one of Thailand's largest real estate developers. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Bangkok, it is listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand.

companies.name: Samart Group
companies.description: Samart Group is a Thai conglomerate focusing on telecommunications and consumer electronics. It is the parent company of Samart Corporation, Samart I-Mobile, and Samart Telecom, and is listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand.

companies.name: Thai Life Insurance
companies.description: Thai Life Insurance Public Co. Ltd is the first Thai insurance company, founded in 1942. It is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, and was one of the largest insurance companies in the country.

companies.name: Bumi Armada
companies.description: Bumi Armada Berhad is an oilfield services company based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It provides marine transportation, engineering, and maintenance services to the offshore oil and gas industry and is the world's fifth largest floating production storage and offloading provider.

companies.name: Vantris Energy
companies.description: Vantris Energy Berhad is a Malaysian integrated oil and gas services company headquartered in Kuala Lumpur. It was formed via a merger in 2012 and renamed Vantris Energy Berhad in 2025, operating in exploration, development, production, and other oil and gas services.

companies.name: partypoker
companies.description: PartyPoker is an online poker card room launched in 2001 by PartyGaming. It was once the largest online card room and is now run by Entain, available in 14 languages with dedicated networks for several regions.

companies.name: Galaxy Resources
companies.description: Galaxy Resources Limited was an Australian public mining company listed on the Australian Securities Exchange. It merged with Orocobre in 2021 to form Allkem.

companies.name: Hubbell Incorporated
companies.description: Hubbell Incorporated is an American company headquartered in Shelton, Connecticut. It designs, manufactures, and sells electrical and electronic products for construction, industrial, and utility applications and was founded in 1888.

companies.name: Altice Portugal
companies.description: MEO Portugal S.A. is the largest telecommunications service provider in Portugal. Since 2015, it has been a wholly owned subsidiary of Altice, a multinational telecommunications company with presence in multiple countries.

companies.name: YG Plus
companies.description: YG Plus Inc. is a South Korean publicly traded media and advertising company acquired by YG Entertainment in 2014. It entered the music distribution industry in 2019 and also produces and licenses merchandise related to music artists.

companies.name: HANSSEM
companies.description: Hanssem Co., Ltd. is a South Korean corporation that designs and sells home appliances and furniture. Founded in 1970, it is the largest home product brand in South Korea and introduced the Western kitchen concept to the country.

companies.name: Del Frisco's Restaurant Group
companies.description: Del Frisco's Restaurant Group, Inc. was an American steakhouse restaurant chain founded in 1981. It operated Del Frisco's Grille and Del Frisco's Double Eagle Steak House in the United States. The company became public in 2012 and focused on steakhouse dining.

companies.name: Focus Media Holding
companies.description: Focus Media Information Technology is a China-based international out-of-home advertising and digital media company founded in 2003. It pioneered the global elevator-based advertising model and operates in over 15 countries across 5 continents. The company has been traded on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange since 2015.

companies.name: Springer Nature
companies.description: Springer Nature is a German-British academic publishing company created in May 2015. It was formed by merging Springer Science+Business Media with Holtzbrinck Publishing Group's Nature Publishing Group, Palgrave Macmillan, and Macmillan Education.

companies.name: Samsung SDI
companies.description: Samsung SDI Co., Ltd. is a South Korean battery and electronic materials manufacturer headquartered in Yongin, Gyeonggi-do. It operates Energy Solutions and Electronic Materials segments producing rechargeable batteries and semiconductor materials. In 2022, it ranked sixth worldwide in battery market share.

companies.name: Progress Energy
companies.description: Progress Energy was a power generation and distribution company headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. It served about 3.1 million customers in the Carolinas and Florida before being acquired by Duke Energy in 2012. The company had over 21,000 megawatts of generation capacity.

companies.name: Computacenter
companies.description: Computacenter plc is a British multinational information technology services provider based in Hatfield, Hertfordshire. It serves both public- and private-sector customers. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Ethyl Corporation
companies.description: Ethyl Corporation is a United States-based fuel additive distributor headquartered in Richmond, Virginia. It distributes products including tetraethyl lead, which is used to make leaded gasoline. The company operates in the chemical industry focusing on fuel additives.

companies.name: Providence and Worcester Railroad
companies.description: The Providence and Worcester Railroad is a Class II railroad operating 612 miles of track in Rhode Island, Massachusetts, Connecticut, and New York. Founded in 1844, it began operations in 1847 and expanded its network over time. The railroad's mainline was double-tracked after an 1853 collision.

companies.name: Italia Independent Group
companies.description: Italia Independent Group S.p.A. is an Italian holding corporation that produces and distributes eyewear and sunglasses. It operates within Italy and focuses on eyewear products.

companies.name: National Storage
companies.description: National Storage is an Australian and New Zealand self-storage provider operating over 200 centres. It offers residential and commercial storage solutions. The company listed on the Australian Securities Exchange in 2013 as National Storage REIT, the first publicly listed independent self-storage owner and operator in Australia.

companies.name: Punch Pubs
companies.description: Punch Pubs & Co is a pub and bar operator based in Burton upon Trent, England, United Kingdom. It operates around 1,300 leased pubs. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its sale in 2016 to a private equity fund and Heineken International.

companies.name: WD-40 Company
companies.description: The WD-40 Company is an American manufacturer of household and multi-use products based in San Diego, California. Its signature brand is WD-40, and it also produces other products such as 3-In-One Oil and Lava. The company was originally known as the Rocket Chemical Company.

companies.name: ASOS
companies.description: ASOS plc is a British online fast-fashion and cosmetic retailer founded in 2000 in London. It targets young adults and sells over 850 brands along with its own clothing and accessories. The company ships to 196 countries from fulfillment centers in the UK, US, and Europe.

companies.name: Black Stone Minerals
companies.description: Black Stone Minerals, L.P. is an oil and natural gas corporation based in Houston, Texas, United States. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

companies.name: Denbury Resources
companies.description: Denbury Inc. was a company engaged in hydrocarbon exploration and extraction using enhanced oil recovery with carbon dioxide. It focused on extracting petroleum from previously exploited fields. In November 2023, it was acquired by ExxonMobil.

companies.name: Strauss Group Ltd.
companies.description: Strauss Group Ltd. is an Israeli manufacturer and marketer of consumer foods sold through retail stores. It is one of the largest food manufacturers in Israel and focuses on dairy, coffee, water, snacks, salads, and dips. The company is publicly traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Qinghai Salt Lake Potash
companies.description: Qinghai Salt Lake Potash Company Limited is the largest potash production base in China, owning a 120-square-kilometer salt lake in Golmud, Qinghai. Established in 1997 and listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, it manufactures and sells potassium chloride under the brand "Yanqiao."

companies.name: Toscana Aeroporti
companies.description: Toscana Aeroporti S.p.A. is an Italian company managing Florence and Pisa International Airports. It is publicly listed on Borsa Italiana.

companies.name: Hensoldt AG
companies.description: Hensoldt AG is a German multinational headquartered in Munich that specializes in sensor technologies for defense, security, and aerospace sectors. Its main products include radar, optoelectronics, and avionics. The company's main office is in Taufkirchen near Munich.

companies.name: FrieslandCampina Engro Pakistan
companies.description: FrieslandCampina Engro Pakistan Limited is a Pakistani dairy products company based in Karachi. It operates as a subsidiary of the Dutch multinational cooperative FrieslandCampina. The company is part of the dairy industry in Pakistan.

companies.name: RR Donnelley
companies.description: R.R. Donnelley & Sons Co. is an American integrated communications company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It provides marketing and business communications, commercial printing, and related services. In 2007, it was the world's largest commercial printer.

companies.name: Innogy
companies.description: innogy SE was an energy company based in Essen, Germany. It has since merged and integrated into the German energy company E.ON. The company operated in the energy supply sector.

companies.name: Japan Airlines
companies.description: Japan Airlines (JAL) is a major Japanese airline headquartered in Shinagawa, Tokyo. Its main hubs include Tokyo's Narita and Haneda airports, with secondary hubs in Osaka. The JAL group includes several domestic feeder services and low-cost carriers.

companies.name: LT Group
companies.description: LT Group, Inc. is a publicly listed holding company headquartered in Bonifacio Global City, Taguig, Philippines. It operates in the industrials and chemicals sector. The company is known as LTG in the Philippines.

companies.name: Recruit Holdings
companies.description: Recruit Holdings Co., Ltd. is an HR Tech holding company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It operates in the tertiary sector of the economy. The company focuses on human resource technology services.

companies.name: Cornerstone OnDemand Inc.
companies.description: Cornerstone OnDemand, Inc. is a cloud-based human capital management software company headquartered in Santa Monica, California. Founded in 1999 as CyberU, it provides learning management and talent management platforms. The company was taken private in 2021 by Clearlake Capital.

companies.name: Reliance Power
companies.description: Reliance Power Limited is an Indian company established to develop, construct, operate, and maintain power projects domestically and internationally. It is part of the Reliance Group and promoted by Reliance Infrastructure and Reliance ADA Group. The CEO since May 2018 is K. Raja Gopal.

companies.name: Plasson Industries Ltd.
companies.description: Plasson Industries Ltd. is an Israeli global manufacturer of plastic fittings for pipes used in water, gas, industrial fluid, wastewater systems, and mines. Its division Plasson Poultry manufactures systems for poultry farming. The company is listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and included in the TA-100 Index.

companies.name: HashiCorp
companies.description: HashiCorp, Inc. is an American software company based in San Francisco, California, and a subsidiary of IBM. It provides tools for provisioning, securing, running, and connecting cloud-computing infrastructure. IBM completed its acquisition of HashiCorp in February 2025.

companies.name: Opera
companies.description: Opera Norway AS is a multinational technology corporation headquartered in Oslo, Norway, with offices in Europe, China, and Africa. It offers PC and mobile web browsers, gaming portals, news content products, advertising platforms, and Web3 and e-commerce services. Opera is recognized for browser innovation and early adoption of AI, cryptocurrency, and Web3 technologies.

companies.name: DASAN Networks
companies.description: DASAN Networks is a South Korean company that develops and manufactures network equipment for fixed and mobile broadband services. Established in 1993 as DASAN Engineering Co., Ltd, it was listed on KOSDAQ in 2000 and renamed DASAN Networks Inc. in 2002.

companies.name: CITIC Financial AMC
companies.description: China CITIC Financial Asset Management is a majority state-owned financial asset management company in China focused on distressed debt management. It was one of four asset management companies established by the Chinese government in 1999 following the 1997 Asian financial crisis.

companies.name: Bisichi Mining
companies.description: Bisichi PLC is a mining and property corporation based in the United Kingdom and listed on the London Stock Exchange. Founded in 1910, it operates the Black Wattle coal mine in South Africa and manages retail property investments through London & Associated Properties.

companies.name: BOK Financial Corporation
companies.description: BOK Financial Corporation is a financial services holding company headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma, USA. It offers retail and commercial banking products across the American Midwest and Southwest. It is among the 50 largest financial services firms in the US and the largest in Oklahoma.

companies.name: Sibanye-Stillwater
companies.description: Sibanye-Stillwater is a global mining and metals processing group with operations, projects, and investments across five continents. The group is also involved in recycling various metals and holds interests in secondary mining operations.

companies.name: Jabil
companies.description: Jabil Inc. is an American multinational manufacturing company headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida. It designs, engineers, and manufactures electronic circuit board assemblies and systems, providing supply chain services primarily to original equipment manufacturers.

companies.name: Dawonsys
companies.industry: installation of mechanical machines and equipment
companies.description: Dawonsys is a South Korean company manufacturing rolling stock, display, semiconductor, plant equipment, and environmental systems. It adopted its current name in May 2001 to reflect its parent company.

companies.name: Freedom Holding
companies.description: Freedom Holding Corp. is an American investment conglomerate headquartered in Almaty, Kazakhstan. Founded in 2008 by Timur Turlov in the United States, it offers services including brokerage, asset management, investment banking, and consumer financial services. Its main focus is on the American stock market and markets in Europe and Central Asia.

companies.name: NEC
companies.description: NEC Corporation is a Japanese multinational conglomerate headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It provides IT and network services such as cloud computing, AI, IoT platforms, and telecommunications equipment to businesses, communication providers, and governments. NEC is one of Japan's five largest defense contractors.

companies.name: Energix-renewable Energies Ltd
companies.description: Energix Renewable Energies Ltd. is an Israeli power producer specializing in renewable energy, mainly photovoltaics and wind power. It is a public company traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange since May 2011.

companies.name: Deliveroo
companies.description: Roofoods Ltd, trading as Deliveroo, is a British multinational online food delivery company based in London. It was acquired by DoorDash in October 2025 and worked with around 182,000 restaurants, grocers, and retailers as of August the previous year.

companies.name: YETI
companies.description: YETI Holdings, Inc. is an American company headquartered in Austin, Texas, specializing in outdoor recreation products. Its product range includes ice chests, vacuum-insulated stainless-steel drinkware, soft coolers, dry bags, and related accessories.

companies.name: Pacific Edge Limited
companies.description: Pacific Edge Limited is a New Zealand-based company focusing on cancer diagnostics, particularly bladder cancer diagnostic tools using genetic biomarkers. It operates offices in Dunedin, New Zealand, and Hershey, USA, and is listed on the Australian ASX and New Zealand NZX stock exchanges.

companies.name: ProntoForms
companies.description: TrueContext, formerly ProntoForms Corporation, is a Canadian app development company providing a low-code platform for building software and mobile apps. Its application digitizes paperwork for mobile data collection and transmission. The company went public in 2005 and trades on the TSX Venture Exchange.

companies.name: Zoran Corporation
companies.description: Zoran Corporation was a multinational digital technology company founded in 1981 and headquartered in Silicon Valley. It focused on designing and selling SoC integrated circuits for consumer electronics and had offices worldwide, including a strong R&D presence in Israel.

companies.name: Segro
companies.description: SEGRO plc is a British property investment and development company based in London. It develops and invests in properties in the UK and Continental Europe, focusing on areas around cities and transport hubs. The company became a Real Estate Investment Trust in 2007 and is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Monolithic Power Systems
companies.description: Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. is an American semiconductor company headquartered in West Palm Beach, Florida. It operates in more than 15 locations worldwide. The company is publicly traded.

companies.name: Aegion
companies.description: Azuria Water Solutions, formerly Aegion Corporation, is an American multinational company involved in construction, maintenance, protection, rehabilitation, engineering, and design of infrastructure projects. It serves industries including oil and gas, power plants, food manufacturing, water, and wastewater.

companies.name: Elastic
companies.description: Elastic is a Dutch-American software company providing a platform for enterprise search, observability, and cybersecurity. Founded in 2012 in Amsterdam, it maintains operational headquarters in the Netherlands and San Francisco. The company is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

companies.name: SPX Technologies
companies.description: SPX Technologies, Inc. is an American manufacturing company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It operates in HVAC, detection and measurement, power transmission and generation, and engineered solutions markets. The company has a global presence with operations in 17 countries and sales in 100 countries.

companies.name: Sinch
companies.description: Sinch AB, formerly CLX Communications, is a communications platform as a service company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. It powers messaging, voice, and email communications between businesses and customers. The company employs over 4000 people in more than 60 countries.

companies.name: Clover Health
companies.description: Clover Health Investments, Corp. is an American health care company founded in 2014. It provides Medicare Advantage insurance plans and operates as a direct contracting entity with the U.S. government. The company manages care for Medicare beneficiaries in 11 states.

companies.name: Harrow Health
companies.description: Harrow Health, Inc., formerly Imprimis Pharmaceuticals, is a publicly traded pharmaceutical company based in Nashville, Tennessee, United States.

companies.name: Mellat Investment Bank
companies.description: Bank Mellat is an Iranian bank established in 1980 through the merger of ten pre-1979 private banks. Its name means "Bank of the Nation" and it is one of the most active banks in Iran.

companies.name: Pushpay
companies.logo_file: Pushpay logo Red RGB Wordmark Stacked.png
companies.description: Pushpay Holdings Limited is a mobile giving, donor management, and church management software company serving faith-based and nonprofit organizations in the United States. It was publicly listed on the New Zealand and Australian stock exchanges before being taken private in 2023.

companies.name: SUMCO
companies.description: SUMCO Corporation is a Japanese semiconductor company that manufactures silicon wafers for semiconductor manufacturers worldwide.

companies.name: State Printing Company
companies.description: ANY Security Printing Company, formerly known as State Printing Company, is a major security printing firm based in Hungary and the CEE region. It focuses on security documents, plastic card production, electronic document management, and bulk transactional printing. The company has been listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange since 2005.

companies.name: 2345.com
companies.description: 2345.com is a Chinese web directory founded in 2005 and hosted by Abitcool China Inc. in Beijing. It is the second most used web directory in China and ranks 47th nationally and 419th worldwide on Alexa. The downloadable version of the site contains adware.

companies.name: Paz Retail And Energy
companies.description: Paz Oil Company Ltd. is Israel's largest oil and gas company. It distributes gasoline and petroleum products through gas stations and supplies LPG and natural gas for home use via its subsidiary PazGaz. The company also operates convenience stores and owns supermarket chains Freshmarket and Super Yuda.

companies.name: Applied Genetic Technologies Corporation
companies.description: Applied Genetic Technologies Corporation was a publicly traded biotechnology company headquartered in Alachua, Florida. Founded in 1999, it was part of the NASDAQ Biotechnology Index. In 2019, it appointed Theresa G.H. Heah as Chief Medical Officer.

companies.name: Arrowhead Research
companies.description: Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company based in Pasadena, California. It develops products using RNA interference mechanisms targeting hepatitis B, alpha 1-antitrypsin deficiency-related liver disease, and cardiovascular disease.

companies.name: Cimpress
companies.description: Cimpress plc is an Irish multinational technology company that operates various businesses using mass customization to produce small quantities of customized goods. Its products are sold to small businesses, graphic designers, and consumers through multiple customer-facing brands.

companies.name: Exact Sciences
companies.description: Exact Sciences Corporation is an American molecular diagnostics company based in Madison, Wisconsin. It specializes in early-stage cancer detection, offering products like Cologuard, the first stool DNA test for colorectal cancer, along with other screening and precision oncology tests.

companies.name: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc.
companies.description: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc. is a medical-device company headquartered in San Diego, California. It develops and markets insulin pumps, automated insulin delivery systems, and diabetes-management software, including the t:slim X2 and Tandem Mobi pumps using Control-IQ+ software with compatible continuous glucose monitors.

companies.name: Saipem
companies.description: Saipem S.p.A. is an Italian multinational oilfield services company and one of the largest globally. It was a subsidiary of Italian oil and gas supermajor Eni until 2016, which still holds about 30% of Saipem's shares.

companies.name: Idemitsu Kosan
companies.description: Idemitsu Kosan Co., Ltd. is a Japanese petroleum company that owns and operates oil platforms and refineries. It produces and sells petroleum, oils, and petrochemical products, and operates gas stations under the apollostation brand and formerly under Idemitsu and Shell brands, with Shell used under license.

companies.name: Sanden Corporation
companies.description: Sanden Corporation is a Japanese company based in Isesaki, Gunma. It manufactures automotive and electrical equipment and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Dongxing Securities
companies.description: Dongxing Securities Co., Ltd. is a Chinese investment bank and brokerage firm. It was a constituent of the SSE 50 Index and CSI 100 Index.

companies.name: BOE Technology
companies.description: BOE Technology Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese electronic components producer founded in 1993. It specializes in interface devices, smart IoT systems, and smart medicine, and is one of the world's largest manufacturers of LCD, OLED, and flexible displays.

companies.name: Angang Steel Company
companies.description: Angang Steel Company Limited is a joint-stock company parented by Anshan Iron and Steel Group and supervised by the State Council of China. It is the second largest steel maker in Mainland China.

companies.name: Alpha Group Company
companies.description: Alpha Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese multinational conglomerate in animation, toys, mass media, and entertainment. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in China, it operates a Chinese webcomics site and an American film company, with an animation division in the US.

companies.name: Lennox International
companies.description: Lennox International Inc. is an American company based in Richardson, Texas, providing climate control products for HVAC and refrigeration markets. Its largest production facilities are in Mexico, Iowa, and South Carolina.

companies.name: Sears Canada
companies.description: Sears Canada Inc. was a publicly traded Canadian retail company headquartered in Toronto. It operated from 1952 to 2018 and was affiliated with the American Sears chain, owning 125 full-line department stores at its peak.

companies.name: DEME
companies.description: DEME is an international group based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, specializing in dredging, land reclamation, port infrastructure, offshore oil & gas services, offshore windfarm installation, and environmental remediation with operations on five continents.

companies.name: Fixstars Solutions
companies.description: Fixstars Solutions, Inc. is a US software and services company specializing in multi-core processors including Nvidia GPU and CUDA, IBM Power7, and Cell. It also manufactures the world's largest SATA solid-state drives.

companies.name: AVG Technologies
companies.description: AVG Technologies B.V. is a cybersecurity brand developed by Avast, part of Gen Digital. It offers antivirus, secure browser, firewall, VPN, and performance software for multiple platforms, with many products offered as freeware.

companies.name: B2Gold
companies.description: B2Gold Corporation is a Canadian mining company headquartered in Vancouver. Founded in 2007, it owns and operates gold mines in Canada, Mali, Namibia, and the Philippines. The company grew through mergers with several other mining companies and is listed on multiple stock exchanges.

companies.name: Tose Co.
companies.description: Tose Co., Ltd. is a Japanese video game developer based in Kyoto. Founded in 1979, it is known for developing Nintendo's Game & Watch Gallery series and various Dragon Ball games. Tose is recognized as the largest non-publishing game developer worldwide.

companies.name: FAW Tianjin
companies.description: Tianjin FAW Xiali Automobile Co., Ltd. was an automobile company based in Tianjin, China, and a subsidiary of FAW Group. It designed, developed, manufactured, and distributed automobiles under the Xiali, Vita, and Junpai brands. The company was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Silicon Laboratories
companies.description: Silicon Laboratories, Inc., known as Silicon Labs, is a fabless global technology company based in the United States. It designs and manufactures semiconductors, silicon devices, and software for electronics design engineers and manufacturers in the Internet of Things infrastructure worldwide.

companies.name: Sinclair Broadcast Group
companies.description: Sinclair Broadcast Group, headquartered in Cockeysville, Maryland, is an American telecommunications conglomerate. It is the second-largest television station operator in the United States, owning or operating 193 stations across over 100 markets and covering 40% of American households.

companies.name: baihe.com
companies.description: Baihe.com is a Chinese online dating service founded in 2005 and operated by Baihe Network Company. It incorporates Sesame Credit data into its service and merged with its largest competitor, jiayuan.com, in December 2015.

companies.name: Bega Group
companies.description: The Bega Group is an Australian diversified food and drinks company with manufacturing sites across several states. Founded as an agricultural cooperative in Bega, New South Wales, it became a public company in 2011 and remains partly owned by its farmer-suppliers. It is a major player in Australia's dairy sector.

companies.name: Dexus
companies.description: Dexus is an Australasian real assets manager and owner founded in 1984. The company is publicly listed on the Australian Securities Exchange and operates in the real estate sector.

companies.name: Riskified
companies.description: Riskified is a publicly traded Israeli company providing software for ecommerce risk management. Its services include fraud prevention and chargeback management for online retailers.

companies.name: Stratec Biomedical Systems
companies.description: STRATEC SE is a German company that designs and manufactures fully automated analyzer systems for clinical diagnostics and biotechnology partners. It specializes particularly in the field of in-vitro diagnostics and operates worldwide.

companies.name: Instacart
companies.description: Instacart, officially Maplebear Inc., is a US-based retail media and delivery company headquartered in San Francisco. It operates a grocery delivery and pick-up service in the US and Canada, allowing customers to order groceries online with personal shoppers handling the shopping and delivery.

companies.name: The a2 Milk Company
companies.description: The a2 Milk Company Limited is a New Zealand company that commercializes intellectual property related to A1 protein-free milk. It sells milk and related products such as infant formula under the a2 and a2 Milk brands and is cross-listed on the NZX and ASX.

companies.name: Valhi, Inc.
companies.description: Valhi, Inc. is an American holding company founded in 1987 from the merger of LLC Corporation and Amalgamated Sugar Company. It operates through wholly and majority-owned subsidiaries in various industries and was a Fortune 1000 company as of 2014.

companies.name: Lotte Tour Development
companies.description: Lotte Tour Development is a South Korean tourism corporation headquartered in Seoul. Founded in 1971, it operates as a travel agency, travel information provider, and casino proprietor, owning the Jeju Dream Tower casino, the tallest building on Jeju Island.

companies.name: Noventiq
companies.description: Noventiq Holdings plc is an information technology company focusing on digital transformation and cybersecurity. Headquartered in London and incorporated in the Cayman Islands, it operates in about 60 countries across Europe, Asia, Latin America, India, and the Middle East.

companies.name: Sunsoft
companies.description: Sun Corporation is a Japanese electronics manufacturer and video game developer and publisher. It is known for its video games produced under the Sunsoft division.

companies.name: TNK-BP
companies.description: TNK-BP was a major vertically integrated Russian oil company headquartered in Moscow. It was Russia's third-largest oil producer and among the ten largest private oil companies globally before being acquired by Rosneft in 2013.

companies.name: Starbreeze Studios
companies.description: Starbreeze AB is a Swedish video game developer and publisher based in Stockholm. Founded by members of the demogroup Triton, it is known for games like The Chronicles of Riddick: Escape from Butcher Bay and Payday 2, and has experienced financial challenges and restructuring.

companies.name: Nidec ASI
companies.description: Nidec Industrial Solutions is an Italian multinational company based in Milan that designs and manufactures rotating electrical machines, power electronics, and industrial automation. Founded in 2012 after Nidec Corporation acquired Ansaldo Sistemi Industriali, it serves markets including petrochemical, energy, steel, marine, and industrial automation.

companies.name: Albany International
companies.description: Albany International Corp. is an industrial-goods company based in Rochester, New Hampshire, United States. It produces machine clothing such as felts for paper manufacturing and textile processing, as well as composites for the aerospace industry. The company is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Virgin Money UK plc
companies.description: Virgin Money is a British banking and financial services brand based in the United Kingdom. Since October 1, 2024, it has been owned by Nationwide Building Society. The company operates in the financial services sector.

companies.name: Flutter Entertainment
companies.description: Flutter Entertainment plc is an Irish-American multinational company specializing in sports betting and gambling. It owns several well-known brands including Betfair, FanDuel, and PokerStars. The company is listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Synopsys
companies.description: Synopsys, Inc. is an American multinational electronic design automation company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It provides tools and services for the design and verification of silicon chips and electronic systems. In 2024, it was ranked as the 12th largest software company globally.

companies.name: Outfront Media
companies.description: Outfront Media, Inc. is an American advertising company operating billboards, logo signs, and transit displays focused on outdoor advertising. It operates within the United States and includes both billboard and transit display advertising.

companies.name: Ascential
companies.description: Ascential was a British-headquartered global company specializing in events, intelligence, and advisory services for marketing and financial technology industries. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Informa in October 2024.

companies.name: Editas Medicine
companies.description: Editas Medicine, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing therapies for rare diseases using CRISPR gene editing technology. It is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, with additional facilities in Boulder, Colorado.

companies.name: Match Group
companies.description: Match Group, Inc. is an American internet and technology company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It owns and operates a large portfolio of online dating services including Tinder and Match.com. The company was spun off from IAC in July 2020.

companies.name: RealPage
companies.description: RealPage, Inc. is an American company headquartered in Texas that produces property management software for algorithmic rent setting. It is owned by private equity firm Thoma Bravo and its services are used on over 24 million housing units worldwide.

companies.name: St. Jude Medical
companies.description: St. Jude Medical, Inc. was an American global medical device company headquartered in Little Canada, Minnesota. It operated more than 20 manufacturing facilities worldwide and sold products in over 100 countries. The company was named after Jude the Apostle.

companies.name: My Food Bag
companies.description: My Food Bag is a New Zealand meal-kit home-delivery service that provides customers with ingredients and recipes to cook meals. The company is publicly traded and was listed on the NZX and ASX on 5 March 2021.

companies.name: El Pollo Loco
companies.description: El Pollo Loco is a group of three independent restaurant chains specializing in Mexican-style grilled chicken. Founded by Mexican American Juan Francisco Ochoa, the company began franchising in 1991. It operates in both Mexico and the United States.

companies.name: Suncorp Group
companies.description: Suncorp Group Limited is an Australian general insurance corporation based in Brisbane, Queensland. Formed in 1996 by merging Suncorp, Metway Bank, and QIDC, it was one of Australia's mid-sized banks until 2022 and is the largest general insurance group in the country.

companies.name: Altia
companies.description: Altia Oyj was a Finnish state-owned corporation based in Helsinki that produced, imported, exported, and marketed alcoholic beverages. It operated in several Nordic and Baltic countries and had production plants in Finland and Estonia. Its largest imported brands included Drostdy-Hof, Two Oceans, and Jack Daniel's.

companies.name: Alkem Laboratories
companies.description: Alkem Laboratories Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai. It specializes in generics and specialty pharmaceuticals, manufacturing and marketing pharmaceutical generics, formulations, and nutraceuticals across India and global markets.

companies.name: Wintrust Financial
companies.description: Wintrust is a financial holding company in the United States operating 15 chartered community banks in northern Illinois and southern Wisconsin. It is classified as a medium-sized banking institution and is the second largest banking company in Chicago.

companies.name: DuPont Fabros Technology Inc.
companies.description: DuPont Fabros Technology, Inc. was a real estate investment trust in the United States that invested in carrier-neutral data centers and provided colocation and peering services. The company was acquired by Digital Realty in 2017.

companies.name: Russneft
companies.description: Russneft is a Russian oil company headquartered in Moscow, established in 2002 by Mikhail Gutseriev. It is a member of the SAFMAR industrial and financial group.

companies.name: Alfamart
companies.description: PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk, known as Alfamart, is an Indonesian primarily-franchised convenience store chain. Founded in 1989 in Jakarta, it has expanded to over 18,000 stores across Indonesia and the Philippines, serving millions of daily customers.

companies.name: OBI Pharma, Inc.
companies.description: OBI Pharma, Inc. is a bio-pharmaceutical company based in Nangang District, Taipei, Taiwan. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry focusing on biopharmaceutical products.

companies.name: Dentsply Sirona
companies.description: Dentsply Sirona Inc. is an American manufacturer of dental equipment and consumables, marketing products in over 120 countries. The company was formed largely from a 1993 merger involving Gendex Corporation and Dentsply International Inc.

companies.name: Clovis Oncology
companies.description: Clovis Oncology is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, specializing in oncology treatments. Founded in 2009, it filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in December 2022.

companies.name: Tadano Limited
companies.description: Tadano Ltd. is a Japan-based manufacturer of cranes and aerial work platforms, recognized as one of the largest crane manufacturers worldwide.

companies.name: Yutong
companies.description: Yutong is a Chinese manufacturer of commercial vehicles, especially electric buses, headquartered in Zhengzhou, Henan. It is the world's largest bus and coach manufacturer by volume and leads in new energy bus production.

companies.name: TOPIX
companies.description: The Tokyo Stock Price Index (TOPIX) is a major stock market index for the Tokyo Stock Exchange in Japan. It tracks most stocks in the Prime market and some in the Standard market, covering domestic companies.

companies.name: Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison
companies.description: PT Indosat Tbk, trading as Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison, is an Indonesian telecommunications provider owned by Ooredoo Hutchison Asia. It offers wireless mobile phone services under the IM3 and Three brands, as well as broadband internet and other telecom services.

companies.name: Tate & Lyle
companies.description: Tate & Lyle Plc is a British multinational supplier of food and beverage products to food and industrial markets. Originally a sugar refining business, it diversified from the 1970s and divested its sugar business in 2010.

companies.name: Visual China Group
companies.description: Visual China Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese photo and media agency established in 2000. It is the largest stock image and media footage provider in China and the third largest globally.

companies.name: Techtronic Industries
companies.description: Techtronic Industries Company Limited is a Hong Kong–based multinational that designs, produces, and markets cordless power tools, outdoor power equipment, hand tools, and floor care appliances.

companies.name: Actel
companies.description: Actel Corporation was an American manufacturer of nonvolatile, low-power field-programmable gate arrays and programmable logic solutions. It was headquartered in Mountain View, California, with offices worldwide. In 2010, Actel was acquired by Microsemi, which was later acquired by Microchip Technology.

companies.name: Orange Belgium
companies.description: Orange Belgium is a Belgian telecommunications company operating internet and mobile services in Belgium and Luxembourg. It acquired VOXMobile in 2007, which was rebranded under the Orange brand. The company competes with Proximus and Base in the telecommunications market.

companies.name: Parsian Bank
companies.description: Parsian Bank is a major private bank headquartered in Tehran, Iran. It offers traditional banking services along with diversified services such as insurance and car rentals. The bank is reportedly controlled by the Supreme Leader’s business empire.

companies.name: Brookfield Property Partners
companies.description: Brookfield Property Partners L.P. is a limited partnership headquartered in Hamilton, Bermuda. It owns office buildings, shopping centers, and holds minority interests in investment funds that invest in commercial property. The company operates in the real estate sector.

companies.name: The Scotts Miracle-Gro Company
companies.description: The Scotts Miracle-Gro Company is an American multinational headquartered in Marysville, Ohio. It manufactures and sells consumer lawn, garden, and pest control products, including the Scotts, Miracle-Gro, and Ortho brands. It also markets the herbicide Roundup in the U.S. and internationally.

companies.name: MRV Engenharia
companies.description: MRV is the largest Brazilian homebuilder and real estate company, founded in 1979 and headquartered in Belo Horizonte. The company was founded by Mário Lúcio Pinheiro Menin, Rubens Menin Teixeira de Souza, and Vega Engenharia Ltda. Its major shareholder is Rubens Menin Teixeira de Souza.

companies.name: Kraton Polymers
companies.description: Kraton Polymers manufactures high-performance elastomers used as synthetic replacements for rubber. These polymers provide properties similar to natural rubber but with increased resistance to heat, weathering, and chemicals. Kraton is a trade name for these elastomers.

companies.name: Veeva Systems
companies.description: Veeva Systems Inc., headquartered in Pleasanton, California, provides cloud computing software, data, and consulting services for the life sciences industry. Its products are used to track drug development and pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.

companies.name: Signature Bank
companies.description: Signature Bank was an American full-service commercial bank headquartered in New York City with offices in several states. It offered banking products and specialized services for industries such as commercial real estate, private equity, and venture banking. The bank also had subsidiaries providing equipment financing and investment services.

companies.name: OnDeck Capital
companies.description: OnDeck Capital is an American small business lending company with offices in multiple U.S. cities. It provides loans exclusively online using proprietary software and algorithms to determine loan eligibility based on business data.

companies.name: Banco Itaú Corpbanca
companies.description: Banco Itaú Corpbanca, known as Itaú Chile, is a Chilean commercial bank and subsidiary of Brazilian Itaú Unibanco. It is headquartered in Santiago and operates branches in Chile and Colombia, with offices in Lima, Madrid, Miami, and New York City.

companies.name: Brocade Communications Systems
companies.description: Brocade Communications Systems, Inc. was an American technology company specializing in storage networking products, including Fibre Channel technology. It expanded into IP/Ethernet hardware and software markets before becoming a subsidiary of Broadcom Inc.

companies.name: Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad
companies.description: Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (KLK) is a Malaysian multinational company primarily engaged in plantation activities, with plantations in Malaysia and Indonesia. It has diversified into manufacturing, property development, and retailing, and is Malaysia's third-largest palm oil producer.

companies.name: Top Glove
companies.description: Top Glove Corporation Berhad is a Malaysian manufacturer specializing in rubber gloves, face masks, dental dams, and other products. It operates 50 manufacturing facilities across Malaysia, Thailand, China, and Vietnam, with marketing offices in multiple countries including the US and Germany.

companies.name: Zebra Technologies
companies.description: Zebra Technologies Corporation is an American multinational technology conglomerate specializing in smart data capture systems. The company is commonly known as Zebra.

companies.name: Ukrnafta
companies.description: PJSC Ukrnafta is the largest Ukrainian company involved in oil and natural gas extraction. It also operates a nationwide network of gas filling stations in Ukraine.

companies.name: TransAlta Corporation
companies.description: TransAlta Corporation is a Canadian electricity power generator and wholesale marketing company headquartered in Calgary, Alberta. It operates 76 power plants across Canada, the US, and Australia, including wind, hydro, natural gas, and coal facilities.

companies.name: Glu Mobile
companies.description: Glu Mobile LLC is an American developer and publisher of mobile games. Founded as Sorrent in 2001, it rebranded as Glu Mobile in 2005 and was acquired by Electronic Arts in 2021, becoming part of EA Mobile.

companies.name: Travis Perkins
companies.description: Travis Perkins plc is a British builders' merchant and home improvement retailer headquartered in Northampton. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and operates in mainland Europe through its Toolstation subsidiary.

companies.name: Zyxel
companies.description: Zyxel Communications Corporation is a Taiwanese multinational broadband provider headquartered in Hsinchu Science Park, Taiwan. Founded in 1989, it has multiple research centers, regional headquarters, and branch offices worldwide.

companies.name: Trina Solar
companies.description: Trina Solar Co., Ltd., stylized as Trinasolar, is a Chinese photovoltaics company founded in 1997. It specializes in solar energy products and solutions. The company is based in China.

companies.name: 5N Plus Inc.
companies.description: 5N Plus is a Canadian producer of high-purity metals and compounds for electronic applications, including cadmium telluride supplied to First Solar. Founded in 2000, it is headquartered in Saint-Laurent, Quebec, Canada. The company serves customers worldwide with operations in North America, Europe, and Asia.

companies.name: Manawa Energy
companies.description: Manawa Energy Limited is a New Zealand electricity generation company operating 26 power schemes across the country. It offers bespoke electricity products to commercial and industrial customers. The company serves regions from the Bay of Plenty to Otago.

companies.name: U-blox
companies.description: u-blox is a Swiss company that designs wireless semiconductors and modules for consumer, automotive, and industrial markets. Founded in 1997 as a spin-off from ETH Zurich, it operates as a fabless IC and design house.

companies.name: Next plc
companies.description: Next plc is a British multinational retailer of clothing, footwear, and home products headquartered in Enderby, England. It operates around 700 stores across the UK, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East and provides e-commerce services. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Guess
companies.description: Guess?, Inc. is an American clothing company known for its black-and-white advertisements. It licenses its brand on fashion accessories including watches, jewelry, perfumes, bags, and shoes. The company is based in the United States.

companies.name: Orient Securities Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Orient Securities, also known as DFZQ, is a Chinese investment bank and brokerage firm founded in 1998 and headquartered in Shanghai. It is a constituent of the SSE 50 Index, the blue chip index of the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Indigo
companies.description: Indigo Books & Music Inc. is a Canadian bookstore chain operating stores in all ten provinces and one territory. It offers books, toys, home décor, stationery, and gifts, and has expanded to music and audio equipment sales. It is Canada's largest book, gift, and specialty toy retailer.

companies.name: DallasNews Corporation
companies.description: DallasNews Corporation, formerly A. H. Belo Corporation, was a Dallas, Texas-based media holding company of The Dallas Morning News and Belo + Company. In 2025, it was purchased by Hearst Communications and remains a formal subsidiary.

companies.name: East Money Information
companies.description: East Money Information is a Chinese financial data and software company headquartered in Shanghai. It operates Guba, an investment chat forum. The company focuses on banking and fintech services.

companies.name: Hithink RoyalFlush Information Network
companies.description: Hithink RoyalFlush Information Network is a Chinese financial data and software company headquartered in Hangzhou. It operates in the AI and software industry, providing financial data services.

companies.name: Huawen Media Group Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Huawen Group is a private-sector publicly listed Chinese media holding company. It is included in the SZSE Component Index and its sub-indices SZSE 300 and SZSE 100.

companies.name: Nikola Corporation
companies.description: Nikola Corporation was an American manufacturer of heavy-duty commercial battery-electric and fuel-cell electric vehicles headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona. Founded in 2014, it was named after Nikola Tesla.

companies.name: Washington Prime Group
companies.description: Washington Prime Group Inc. is an American real estate investment trust organized in Indiana with headquarters in Columbus, Ohio. It invests in shopping centers and filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in June 2021.

companies.name: Envestnet
companies.description: Envestnet, Inc. is an American financial technology corporation that develops and distributes wealth management software and products to financial advisors and institutions. Its main product is an advisory platform integrating various services.

companies.name: Octaware Technologies
companies.description: Octaware Technologies is a software development company based in Mumbai, India, incorporated in 2005. It is India's first sharia-compliant company listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange and operates internationally with subsidiaries and marketing offices.

companies.name: ESAB
companies.description: ESAB, Elektriska Svetsnings-Aktiebolaget, is an American-Swedish industrial company. It operates in the industrials and chemicals sector.

companies.name: CAVE
companies.description: CAVE Interactive Co., Ltd. is a Japanese video game company founded in 1994 by former Toaplan employees. It is known for its "bullet hell" shoot 'em ups and has produced various games for arcades, consoles, PCs, and smartphones.

companies.name: Goa Carbon Limited
companies.description: Goa Carbon Limited is an Indian petrochemical company engaged in manufacturing and selling Calcined Petroleum Coke. Established in 1967, it is the second largest producer in India with manufacturing facilities in Goa, Paradip, and Bilaspur.

companies.name: United Online
companies.description: United Online, Inc. is a company formed by the 2001 merger of NetZero and Juno Online Services. It is headquartered in Woodland Hills, California, and has evolved from providing dial-up Internet access to offering a range of products aided by acquisitions such as Classmates Online and MyPoints.

companies.name: Nicolet Bankshares
companies.description: Nicolet Bankshares, Inc. is a regional bank holding company based in Green Bay, Wisconsin. It is the parent company of Nicolet National Bank, which is the second largest Wisconsin-based bank.

companies.name: Cosmo Oil Company
companies.description: Cosmo Oil Company, Limited is a Japanese petrochemical company and the third-biggest refiner in Japan by sales. It operates in the petroleum industry and is based in Japan.

companies.name: Diplomat Pharmacy
companies.description: Diplomat Pharmacy, Inc. was the largest independent provider of specialty pharmacy services in the United States. Headquartered in Flint, Michigan, it offers specialized medication and management programs for patients with complex conditions and operates facilities across the US.

companies.name: ISEQ 20
companies.description: The ISEQ 20 is a benchmark stock market index composed of the 20 companies with the highest trading volume and market capitalization on Euronext Dublin. It was started on December 31, 2004, and is used to compare the performance of Irish stocks.

companies.name: USANA Health Sciences
companies.description: Usana Health Sciences, Inc. is an American multi-level marketing company based in Salt Lake City, Utah. It manufactures nutritional products, dietary supplements, and skincare products sold in 24 countries through independent distributors.

companies.name: Toast, Inc.
companies.description: Toast, Inc. is an American cloud-based restaurant management software company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It provides an all-in-one point of sale system built on the Android operating system.

companies.name: Israel Discount Bank Ltd.
companies.description: Israel Discount Bank, Ltd. is an Israeli bank headquartered in Tel Aviv. It offers retail, commercial, and private banking services through 112 branches and is listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Sinovel
companies.description: Sinovel Wind Group Company is a Chinese state-owned manufacturer of wind turbines headquartered in Beijing. It operates in the wind power industry.

companies.name: Dynatrace
companies.description: Dynatrace, Inc. is an American multinational technology company providing an AI-powered observability platform. Its software monitors and optimizes application performance, software development, cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, and user experience.

companies.name: Swala Gas and Oil
companies.description: Swala Gas and Oil is a Tanzanian oil and gas exploration company headquartered in Dar es Salaam. Incorporated in 2011, it holds exploration licenses for the Kilosa-Kilombero and Pangani fields in the East African Rift. It is a subsidiary of Swala Energy and trades on the Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Pavlovo Bus Factory
companies.description: Pavlovo Bus Factory is a Russian manufacturer of buses located in Pavlovo, Nizhny Novgorod Oblast. Since 2005, bus production has been carried out by PAZ, a 100% subsidiary of PAO Pavlovsky Avtobus. PAZ is a subsidiary of Russian Buses, which is a division of GAZ.

companies.name: Transphorm
companies.description: Transphorm, Inc. is an American semiconductor company specializing in transistors made from gallium nitride for switched-mode power supplies. The company was acquired by Renesas Electronics in 2024. It focuses on power electronics technology.

companies.name: UMH Properties
companies.description: UMH Properties, Inc. is a public equity real estate investment trust owning and operating 135 manufactured home communities with about 25,700 developed homesites. These communities are spread across 12 U.S. states. UMH also operates two communities in Florida through a joint venture with Nuveen Real Estate.

companies.name: Matrix Concepts Holdings Berhad
companies.description: Matrix Concepts Holdings Berhad is a Malaysia-based investment holding company. It is listed on the Malaysian stock exchange under the ticker MYX: 5236. The company operates within the real estate industry.

companies.name: Howmet Aerospace
companies.description: Howmet Aerospace Inc. is an American aerospace company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It manufactures components for jet engines, fasteners, titanium aerospace structures, and forged aluminum wheels for heavy trucks.

companies.name: Sunrise Bank Limited
companies.description: Laxmi Sunrise Bank Limited is a commercial bank in Nepal with its head office in Kathmandu. It is an 'A' class bank licensed by Nepal Rastra Bank and has branches nationwide. The bank's shares are publicly traded on the Nepal Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Prabhu Bank Limited
companies.description: Prabhu Bank Limited is a commercial bank in Nepal headquartered in Kathmandu. It is an 'A' class bank licensed by Nepal Rastra Bank and provides full commercial banking services with branches across the nation.

companies.name: Molecular Partners
companies.description: Molecular Partners AG is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Zürich, Switzerland. It develops a new class of small-protein therapies called DARPins for diseases including oncology and infectious diseases. The company has molecules in clinical and preclinical development.

companies.name: Novatek
companies.description: Novatek is Russia's second-largest natural gas producer and the seventh-largest publicly traded company globally by natural gas production volume. It is based in the Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Region in West Siberia and has a head office in Moscow. The company was originally known as OAO FIK Novafininvest.

companies.name: Virtusa
companies.description: Virtusa Corporation is an American information technology services company based in Southborough, Massachusetts. It provides IT consulting, business consulting, and outsourcing services. The company was founded in 1996 in Sri Lanka.

companies.name: Flat Glass Group
companies.description: Flat Glass Group is a publicly listed Chinese glass production company headquartered in Jiaxing, Zhejiang. It operates in the industrial and chemical sectors.

companies.name: Tabio
companies.description: Tabio is a Japanese manufacturer and retailer specializing in socks, stockings, and tights. It operates in the consumer goods and retail industry.

companies.name: 21Vianet
companies.description: VNET Group, Inc., also known as 21Vianet, is the largest private, carrier-neutral Internet and data center service provider in China. It operates through four domestic companies and is the exclusive operator of Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 services in China. The company also houses data centers for Alibaba and other Chinese firms.

companies.name: Aerie Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Aerie Pharmaceuticals was an American clinical-stage pharmaceutical company focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing therapies for glaucoma and other eye diseases. Its lead products were once-daily therapies aimed at lowering intraocular pressure in patients with glaucoma or ocular hypertension.

companies.name: Viohalco
companies.description: Viohalco S.A. is a Greek heavy industry corporation established in 1937 and listed on the Athens Stock Exchange since 1947. It comprises multiple companies active in metal production and steel and aluminum trade. The company accounts for 7 percent of Greek exports and is included in the FTSE/Athex Large Cap index.

companies.name: Hisense
companies.description: Hisense Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese multinational manufacturer of major appliances and electronics headquartered in Qingdao, Shandong. Television sets are a principal product, and the company also operates as an original equipment manufacturer producing goods sold under other brands.

companies.name: Vishay Intertechnology
companies.description: Vishay Intertechnology, Inc. is an American manufacturer of discrete semiconductors and passive electronic components. Founded by Felix Zandman, it has manufacturing plants across Israel, Asia, Europe, and the Americas producing various electronic components including rectifiers, diodes, and resistors.

companies.name: The New York Times Company
companies.logo_file: The New York Times Company logo.svg
companies.description: The New York Times Company is an American mass media corporation that publishes The New York Times and its associated publications, including the International Edition. Its headquarters are located in the New York Times Building in Manhattan, New York City.

companies.name: Lundin Energy
companies.description: Lundin Energy is an independent oil and gas exploration and production company based in Sweden. It was formed from Lundin Oil in 2001 and focuses on operations in Norway.

companies.name: SJVN
companies.description: SJVN is an Indian public sector undertaking involved in hydroelectric power generation and transmission. Incorporated in 1988 as Nathpa Jhakri Power Corporation, it operates three hydropower plants and also has wind and solar power capacities.

companies.name: Nubank
companies.description: Nubank is a Brazilian neobank headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil. It operates as a financial and payment institution regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil and is the largest fintech bank in Latin America.

companies.name: Marvelous
companies.description: Marvelous Inc. is a Japanese video game developer, publisher, and anime producer. The company was founded in 1997 and formed in its current state in 2011 after acquiring AQ Interactive and Liveware.

companies.name: Wendel
companies.description: Wendel is a French investment company managed by Laurent Mignon and David Darmon. Since July 2018, Nicolas ver Hulst has been chairman of the supervisory board.

companies.name: Wendy's Company
companies.description: The Wendy's Company is an American fast food corporation and holding company for Wendy's and First Kitchen. It is headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, and its principal subsidiary is Wendy's International, the franchisor of Wendy's restaurants.

companies.name: Affiliated Managers Group
companies.description: Affiliated Managers Group, Inc. is an American financial services firm founded in 1993 and headquartered in West Palm Beach, Florida. It is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange and listed on the S&P 400.

companies.name: Colfax Corporation
companies.description: Enovis Corporation, originally founded as Colfax Corporation in 1995 by Mitchell and Steven Rales, is a medical technology company focused on orthopedics. It is headquartered in Dallas, Texas, and operates at 30 sites worldwide.

companies.name: AGL Resources
companies.description: Southern Company Gas, formerly AGL Resources, is an American energy services holding company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It operates natural gas distribution, wholesale, retail, and midstream services and serves approximately 4.5 million utility customers.

companies.name: Williams-Sonoma, Inc.
companies.description: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an American publicly traded consumer retail company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It sells kitchenware and home furnishings through stores, websites, and a gift registry, with brands including Williams Sonoma and Pottery Barn.

companies.name: AppFolio
companies.description: AppFolio, Inc. is an American company founded in 2006 that provides software-as-a-service applications and services to the real estate industry. It is based in the United States and focuses on SaaS solutions for real estate professionals.

companies.name: Constellation Energy
companies.description: Constellation Energy Corporation is an American energy company headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland. It supplies electric power, natural gas, and energy management services to about two million customers across the continental United States.

companies.name: Worthington Industries
