companies.description: Worthington Enterprises, Inc. is an American industrial manufacturing company based in Columbus, Ohio. It operates two business segments: consumer products and building products, manufacturing pressure vessels and various retail products under several brand names.

companies.name: Wüstenrot & Württembergische
companies.description: Wüstenrot & Württembergische (W&W) is a German financial services company founded in 1999 and based in Stuttgart. It offers insurance, banking, and investment products, and became one of Germany's top 15 insurance groups after acquiring Karlsruher Versicherungsgruppe in 2005.

companies.name: UBE Corporation
companies.description: UBE Corporation is a Japanese chemical company that manufactures chemicals, plastics, battery materials, pharmaceuticals, cement, construction materials, and machinery. It is based in Japan and operates in multiple chemical-related industries.

companies.name: Ypsomed Holding
companies.description: Ypsomed Holding Inc. is a Swiss multinational medical technology company headquartered in Burgdorf, Switzerland. Founded in 2003 after the break up of Disetronic Group, it specializes in injection and infusion systems for self-medication, focusing on diabetes care and biotechnology.

companies.name: Martela
companies.description: Martela Oyj is a Finnish company that supplies furniture. It is based in Finland and operates in the interior design sector.

companies.name: E-Trade
companies.description: E-Trade is an investment brokerage and electronic trading platform operating as a subsidiary of Morgan Stanley. It is based in the United States and provides financial services.

companies.name: GAZ Group
companies.description: GAZ Group is a Russian automotive conglomerate headquartered in Nizhny Novgorod. It includes 18 manufacturing facilities across eight Russian regions, along with sales and service organizations.

companies.name: Pinnacle West Capital Corporation
companies.description: Pinnacle West Capital Corporation is an American utility holding company that owns Arizona Public Service (APS). APS is the largest utility company in Arizona and is regulated by the Arizona Corporation Commission.

companies.name: Yellow Pages Limited
companies.description: Yellow Pages Limited is a Canadian company that publishes directories and operates internet services including YellowPages.ca and Canada411.ca. It reaches approximately 9 million unique visitors monthly and has mobile applications downloaded more than 3 million times. The company focuses on local search and directory services in Canada.

companies.name: Axalta Coating Systems
companies.description: Axalta Coating Systems Ltd. is an American company specializing in coatings for industrial applications, including automotive paints. It is based in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and incorporated in Bermuda. Axalta operates in 130 countries and serves over 100,000 customers worldwide.

companies.name: Maxis Communications
companies.description: Maxis Berhad is a Malaysian communications service provider headquartered in Kuala Lumpur. It is one of the oldest and largest telecommunications companies in Malaysia, offering various communication products and services to consumers and businesses. The company covers a wide geographic area within Malaysia.

companies.name: Sony Financial Holdings
companies.description: Sony Financial Group Inc., formerly Sony Financial Holdings Inc., is a Japanese holding company based in Tokyo. It operates businesses including life and non-life insurance, online banking, credit card settlement, nursing care, and venture capital. The company is part of the financial services sector in Japan.

companies.name: Singapore Press Holdings
companies.description: Singapore Press Holdings Limited (SPH) was a state media company in Singapore that published The Straits Times and other newspapers. It also operated radio, television, and digital media platforms. SPH was one of the two main state media companies in Singapore.

companies.name: Moscow Exchange
companies.description: The Moscow Exchange is Russia's largest exchange, operating markets in equities, bonds, derivatives, foreign exchange, money markets, and precious metals. It also manages the National Settlement Depository and the National Clearing Centre. The exchange was formed in 2011 by merging two previous exchanges.

companies.name: Türk Telekom
companies.description: Türk Telekomünikasyon A.Ş., known as Türk Telekom, is a state-controlled Turkish telecommunications company headquartered in Ankara. It was separated from the Turkish Post in 1995 and offers fixed-line telephony, broadband internet, mobile services, digital television, and IT solutions across Turkey.

companies.name: Allen-Bradley
companies.description: Allen-Bradley is a brand of factory automation equipment owned by Rockwell Automation, headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The company manufactures programmable logic controllers, human-machine interfaces, sensors, safety components, software, drives, and motor control systems. Rockwell Automation also provides asset-management services.

companies.name: Qcells
companies.description: Qcells is a manufacturer of photovoltaic cells headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, with engineering offices in Bitterfeld-Wolfen, Germany. Founded in 1999 in Germany, it was acquired out of bankruptcy in 2012 by the Hanwha Group. Qcells operates as a subsidiary of Hanwha Solutions.

companies.name: Noble Energy
companies.description: Noble Energy, Inc. was a hydrocarbon exploration company headquartered in Houston, Texas. In October 2020, it was acquired by Chevron Corporation. The company operated in the petroleum industry prior to its acquisition.

companies.name: Outokumpu
companies.description: Outokumpu Oyj is a group of international companies headquartered in Helsinki, Finland. It is the largest producer of stainless steel in Europe and the second largest in the Americas. The company also mines chromium ore for use in stainless steel production.

companies.name: McAfee, LLC
companies.description: McAfee Corp. is an American proprietary software company focused on online protection for consumers worldwide. It is headquartered in San Jose, California. The company has undergone several name changes since its founding in 1987.

companies.name: Admiral Group
companies.description: Admiral Group plc is a British financial services company headquartered in Cardiff, Wales. It markets several insurance brands and founded the price comparison service Confused.com, which it sold in 2021. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Bridgepoint Group plc
companies.description: Bridgepoint Group plc is a British private investment company listed on the London Stock Exchange as a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. It operates in the investment sector and is based in the United Kingdom.

companies.name: Japan Display
companies.description: Japan Display Inc., commonly called JDI, is a Japanese display technology joint venture. It was formed by merging the small and medium-sized liquid crystal display businesses of Sony, Toshiba, and Hitachi. The company is based in Japan.

companies.name: Adient
companies.description: Adient plc is an American, Irish-domiciled company that operates as the largest manufacturer of automotive seating worldwide. It is based in Plymouth, Michigan, United States. The company serves the automotive industry globally.

companies.name: Blue Apron
companies.description: Blue Apron Holdings, Inc. is an American ingredient-and-recipe meal kit company headquartered in New York City. It operates exclusively in the United States, offering weekly boxes with ingredients and suggested recipes for customers to cook by hand.

companies.name: KAONMEDIA
companies.description: Kaon Media is a South Korean technology company specializing in the development and manufacturing of digital connectivity devices and residential gateways. It serves pay-TV operators, broadband operators, and telcos. The company is based in South Korea.

companies.name: 7digital
companies.description: 7digital Group PLC is a British company based in London that provides end-to-end music services including access, tracking, and reporting for clients in fitness, social media, DSPs, and gaming industries. It was acquired by Songtradr in 2023 and has produced content for BBC radio stations.

companies.name: Snap Inc.
companies.description: Snap Inc. is an American technology company headquartered in Santa Monica, California. Founded in 2011, it develops and maintains products such as Snapchat, Spectacles, and Bitmoji. The company was rebranded from Snapchat Inc. to Snap Inc. in 2016.

companies.name: Gogo Inflight Internet
companies.description: Gogo Inc. is an American provider of in-flight broadband Internet and connectivity services for business aircraft, headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado. It developed the 2Ku satellite-based Wi-Fi technology and sold its Commercial Air business to Intelsat in 2020.

companies.name: Maple Leaf Foods
companies.description: Maple Leaf Foods Inc. is a Canadian multinational company specializing in consumer-packaged meats and food production. Its head office is located in Mississauga, Ontario.

companies.name: Ameris Bancorp
companies.description: Ameris Bancorp is an American bank holding company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It operates full-service branches and mortgage-only locations across several southeastern states and offers online and mobile banking for consumers and businesses.

companies.name: AppLovin
companies.description: AppLovin Corporation is an American mobile technology company based in Palo Alto, California. Founded in 2012, it provides platforms for app marketing, monetization, analytics, and publishing, and invests in mobile game publishers.

companies.name: Spelling Television
companies.description: Spelling Television Inc. was an American television production company founded by Aaron Spelling in 1965. It produced popular TV shows and is now an in-name-only unit of CBS Studios, with its library owned by CBS' parent company Skydance.

companies.name: Advantest
companies.description: Advantest Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of automatic test equipment for the semiconductor industry, based in Tokyo. It produces test systems for memory, SoC, and RF, and measuring instruments for electronic systems including fiber optic and wireless communications.

companies.name: Dabur
companies.description: Dabur India Limited is an Indian multinational consumer goods company headquartered in Ghaziabad, Delhi NCR. Founded in 1884, it manufactures Ayurvedic products and fast-moving consumer goods, with revenue from consumer care, food, and international business units.

companies.name: Betsson
companies.description: Betsson AB is a Swedish online gambling company operating more than 20 online gaming brands. It offers casino, poker, bingo, sports betting, and scratch cards through brands including Betsson, Betsafe, and NordicBet.

companies.name: BPM Bank
companies.description: Banco BPM S.p.A. is an Italian bank formed in 2017 by merging Banco Popolare and Banca Popolare di Milano. It is the third largest retail and corporate banking group in Italy, with dual headquarters in Verona and Milan.

companies.name: Weber-Stephen Products
companies.description: Weber Inc. is an American company that manufactures charcoal, gas, and electric outdoor grills along with related accessories. It also owns restaurants and publishes cookbooks.

companies.name: Petrofac
companies.description: Petrofac Limited is a British international energy services company that designs, builds, manages, and maintains oil, gas, refining, petrochemicals, and renewable energy infrastructure. It is registered in Jersey with its main office in London and filed for bankruptcy protection in October 2025.

companies.name: G City Ltd
companies.description: G City Ltd, formerly Gazit Globe, is a global real estate company focused on owning, developing, and managing income-producing mixed-use properties including retail, office, and residential in densely populated urban areas.

companies.name: Navya SAS
companies.description: Navya Mobility, founded in Lyon, France in 2017, specializes in designing and building autonomous and electric vehicles. It was acquired from receivership in 2023 by Gaussin and Macnica and renamed Gaussin-Macnica-Mobility (Gama).

companies.name: Intuitive Surgical
companies.description: Intuitive Surgical, Inc. is an American biotechnology company that develops robotic products to improve clinical outcomes through minimally invasive surgery, notably the da Vinci Surgical System. It is listed on Nasdaq-100, S&P 100, and S&P 500.

companies.name: Vertex Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated is an American biopharmaceutical company based in Boston, Massachusetts. It was among the first biotech firms to use rational drug design and maintains research facilities in San Diego and Oxfordshire, England.

companies.name: Sarcos
companies.description: Palladyne AI Corp., formerly Sarcos Research Corporation founded in 1983, is an American company that developed robots. In 2023, it shifted focus to AI software for robotic applications and changed its name to Palladyne AI in 2024.

companies.name: Sanonda
companies.description: Hubei Sanonda Co., Ltd. is a Chinese pesticide producer based in Jingzhou, Hubei Province. ChemChina and Adama Agricultural Solutions together owned 30.75% as of 2016, with additional ownership by the Government of Qichun County.

companies.name: Builders FirstSource
companies.description: Builders FirstSource, Inc. is a publicly traded company headquartered in Irving, Texas, supplying building materials for residential construction and remodeling. Founded in 1998, it is the largest supplier of building products and services in the US.

companies.name: Azure Power
companies.description: Azure Power Global Limited is an Indian solar power company headquartered in New Delhi. Founded in 2008 by Inderpreet Wadhwa, it sells energy to government utilities and independent industrial and commercial customers in India.

companies.name: SG Automotive
companies.description: SG Automotive Group Co Ltd is a Chinese vehicle and component manufacturer based in Dandong, Liaoning province. It produces buses, light trucks, semi-trailer trucks, SUVs, and automotive components used by other Chinese car makers.

companies.name: Mizrahi Tefahot Bank Ltd.
companies.description: Bank Mizrahi-Tefahot is the third-largest bank in Israel with around 140 branches. It is the largest mortgage lender in the country.

companies.name: First International Bank Of Israel Ltd.
companies.description: The First International Bank of Israel is an Israel-based bank serving primarily large corporate clients and end-market consumers.

companies.name: DHC Software Co., Ltd.
companies.description: DHC Software Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded company based in Beijing, China. It has been a constituent of the SZSE 100 Index, SZSE 300 Index, and SZSE Component Index.

companies.name: Le.com
companies.description: Le.com, legally Leshi Internet Information and Technology Corp., Beijing, is a Chinese technology company headquartered in Chaoyang District, Beijing. It is one of the largest online video companies in China.

companies.name: CSC Financial Co., Ltd.
companies.description: CSC Financial Co., Ltd., trading as China Securities, is a Chinese investment bank and brokerage firm established in 2005 by CITIC Securities and China Jianyin Investment. It is majority owned by Central Huijin Investment and a Beijing municipal asset managing subsidiary.

companies.name: Pennon Group
companies.description: Pennon Group plc is a British water utility company based in Exeter, England. Its main subsidiary is South West Water, which contributes much of the company's profits.

companies.name: Fortive
companies.description: Fortive Corporation is an American industrial technology conglomerate headquartered in Everett, Washington. It provides technologies for connected workflow solutions and operates in three segments: Intelligent Operating Solutions, Precision Technologies, and Advanced Healthcare Solutions.

companies.name: Cheniere Energy
companies.description: Cheniere Energy, Inc. is an American liquefied natural gas (LNG) company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It operates in the oil and gas industry, focusing on LNG production and related activities.

companies.name: Essex Property Trust, Inc.
companies.description: Essex Property Trust is a publicly traded real estate investment trust that invests in apartments located in California and the Seattle metropolitan area. It focuses on residential real estate investments in these regions.

companies.name: Wuhan Iron and Steel (joint-stock)
companies.wiki: Wuhan Iron and Steel Company Limited
companies.description: Wuhan Iron and Steel Company Limited, known as WISCO, is a subsidiary of Baoshan Iron and Steel. It was formerly a subsidiary of the state-owned Wuhan Iron and Steel Corporation until 2016 and operates a steel plant in Qingshan District, Wuhan.

companies.name: Post Holdings
companies.description: Post Holdings, Inc. is an American consumer packaged goods holding company headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. It operates businesses in center-of-the-store, refrigerated, foodservice, and food ingredient categories.

companies.name: Federal Realty Investment Trust
companies.description: Federal Realty Investment Trust is a real estate investment trust that invests in shopping centers across the Northeastern United States, Mid-Atlantic states, California, and South Florida. It focuses on retail real estate investments.

companies.name: UDR
companies.description: UDR Inc. is a publicly traded real estate investment trust organized in Maryland with headquarters in Highlands Ranch, Colorado. It invests in apartments and owns interests in numerous apartment communities across 21 U.S. markets.

companies.name: Veritiv
companies.description: Veritiv is a business-to-business provider of packaging, publishing, and hygiene products. Headquartered in Sandy Springs, Georgia, it operates 125 distribution centers throughout the United States and Mexico and is a subsidiary of Clayton, Dubilier & Rice.

companies.name: MAA
companies.description: Mid-America Apartment Communities, Inc. (MAA) is a publicly traded real estate investment trust based in Memphis, Tennessee. It invests in apartments located in the Southeastern and Southwestern United States.

companies.name: A2A
companies.description: A2A S.p.A. is an Italian company organized as a società per azioni that generates, distributes, and markets renewable energy, electricity, gas, integrated water supply, and waste management services. It has a significant presence in Northern Italy and energy facilities in Italy and Greece.

companies.name: Winmark
companies.description: Winmark Corporation is an American franchisor of five retail businesses specializing in buying and selling used goods. Based in Minneapolis, Minnesota, it transitioned from owning stores to having franchisees own all stores after restructuring in the early 2000s.

companies.name: Starlux Airlines
companies.description: Starlux Airlines is a Taiwanese full service carrier headquartered in Taipei. Established in 2018 by Chang Kuo-wei, it operates from its hub at Taoyuan International Airport. Starlux is one of three major international airlines in Taiwan alongside China Airlines and EVA Air.

companies.name: Chewy
companies.description: Chewy, Inc. is an American online retailer specializing in pet food and pet-related products. The company is based in Plantation, Florida, and went public in 2019. It operates primarily through e-commerce channels.

companies.name: Adore Beauty
companies.description: Adore Beauty is an Australian beauty and wellness retailer operating both online and through physical stores across Australia and New Zealand. Founded in 1999, it is headquartered in Melbourne, Victoria, and is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.

companies.name: Ibotta
companies.description: Ibotta, Inc. is a mobile technology company based in Denver, Colorado. Founded in 2011, it offers cash back rewards through its app and the Ibotta Performance Network, partnering with consumer packaged goods brands and publishers. The company operates solely in the United States.

companies.name: Criteo
companies.description: Criteo S.A. is an advertising technology company headquartered in Paris, France. Initially focused on online display retargeting, it has expanded into retail media advertising since the mid-2010s.

companies.name: Descartes Systems Group
companies.description: The Descartes Systems Group Inc. is a Canadian multinational technology company specializing in logistics and supply chain management software. It provides cloud-based services tailored for logistics businesses.

companies.name: Arch Capital Group
companies.description: Arch Capital Group Ltd. is a Bermuda-based public company that writes insurance, reinsurance, and mortgage insurance worldwide. It focuses on specialty lines and operates from 60 offices across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia.

companies.name: Genomic Health
companies.description: Genomic Health, Inc. was a company based in Redwood City, California, focusing on genetic research in cancer detection. It was acquired and merged with Exact Sciences Corporation in 2019.

companies.name: Costa Group
companies.description: Costa Group is Australia's largest horticultural company and a major supplier of produce to food retailers. The company went public in 2015 and is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.

companies.name: EVT Limited
companies.description: EVT Limited is an Australian company operating cinemas, hotels, restaurants, and resorts across Australia, New Zealand, and Germany. It is involved in multiple hospitality and entertainment sectors.

companies.name: Leyou
companies.description: Leyou Technologies Holdings Limited is a Chinese video game holding company based in Hong Kong. Founded in 2010, it transitioned from poultry to video games, acquiring several developers including Digital Extremes and Splash Damage. In December 2020, Leyou was acquired by Tencent.

companies.name: A&W
companies.description: A&W is a fast-food restaurant chain in Canada, franchised by A&W Food Services of Canada Inc. It operates within the Canadian fast-food industry.

companies.name: Ayvens
companies.description: Ayvens, formerly ALD Automotive, is a French fleet management and operational car leasing company. It is a majority-owned subsidiary of Société Générale and operates internationally with a presence in 42 countries.

companies.name: ATM Grupa
companies.description: ATM Grupa S.A. is the largest independent TV producer in Poland, founded in 1992. It holds about 14 percent of the Polish market and uniquely owns its own technical and logistic base for TV program production.

companies.name: LONGi Green Energy Technology
companies.description: LONGi Green Energy Technology Co. Ltd., formerly Xi'an Longi Silicon Materials Corporation, is a Chinese photovoltaics company. It is a major manufacturer of solar modules and a developer of solar power projects.

companies.name: Ikegami Tsushinki
companies.description: Ikegami Tsushinki Co., Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of professional and broadcast television equipment, especially video cameras for news gathering and studio use. The company was founded in 1946.

companies.name: Lanka Graphite Limited
companies.description: Lanka Graphite Limited is an Australian company engaged in the mining of graphite in Sri Lanka.

companies.name: Aussie Broadband
companies.description: Aussie Broadband is an Australian telecommunications and internet retail service provider formed in 2008 after the amalgamation of Wideband Networks and Westvic Broadband.

companies.name: VIAVI Solutions
companies.description: Viavi Solutions Inc. is an American network test, measurement, and assurance technology company based in Chandler, Arizona. It manufactures testing and monitoring equipment for networks and develops optical technology for various applications.

companies.name: BlackLine
companies.description: BlackLine Systems, Inc. is an American enterprise software company based in Los Angeles. It develops cloud-based services to automate and manage financial close processes and related accounting functions.

companies.name: cdv Software Entertainment
companies.description: CDV Software Entertainment AG was a German video game publisher founded in 1989 in Karlsruhe. It was once the largest German publisher in the video game market and became a Frankfurt stock market traded company in 2000. The company filed for bankruptcy in April 2010 after financial difficulties.

companies.name: AECOM
companies.description: AECOM is an American multinational infrastructure consulting firm headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It provides consulting services related to construction and infrastructure projects.

companies.name: Affymetrix
companies.description: Affymetrix was an American biotechnology company based in Santa Clara, California, known for developing DNA microarray products. It is now a brand under Thermo Fisher Scientific, originating from its research and manufacturing operations.

companies.name: Aggreko
companies.description: Aggreko is a global supplier of mobile and modular power, temperature control equipment, and energy services headquartered in Glasgow, United Kingdom. Founded in 1962, it was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition in 2021.

companies.name: Flybe
companies.description: Flybe was a British airline based in Exeter, England, originally launched in 1979 as Jersey European Airways. It was rebranded as Flybe in 2002 and was at times the largest independent regional airline in Europe.

companies.name: Simmons Bank
companies.description: Simmons Bank operates in several US states including Arkansas and Texas. It is the main subsidiary of Simmons First National Corporation, a bank holding company.

companies.name: Watches of Switzerland
companies.description: Watches of Switzerland is a British watch retailer headquartered in Braunstone, England. It is publicly traded on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Arrival
companies.description: Arrival was a British electric vehicle manufacturer headquartered in Howald, Luxembourg, focusing on lightweight commercial vehicles. Its research and development took place in Banbury, Oxfordshire.

companies.name: Acadia Healthcare
companies.description: Acadia Healthcare Company, Inc. is an American for-profit behavioral healthcare services provider. It operates a network of over 225 facilities across the United States and Puerto Rico. The company focuses on behavioral healthcare.

companies.name: Fubo
companies.description: FuboTV, Inc. is an American over-the-top sports streaming television service operating in the United States, Canada, and Spain. It primarily focuses on live sports channels and also operates the live TV streaming service Molotov in France.

companies.name: American Eagle Outfitters
companies.description: American Eagle Outfitters, Inc. is an American clothing and accessories retailer headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1977, it is the parent company of brands including Aerie, Unsubscribed, and Todd Snyder.

companies.name: American Superconductor
companies.description: American Superconductor Corporation is an American energy technologies company based in Ayer, Massachusetts. It specializes in superconductors for power systems, including high-temperature superconductor wire, motors, generators, and power electronics for wind farms and transmission.

companies.name: Ameriprise Financial
companies.description: Ameriprise Financial, Inc. is an American diversified financial services company and bank holding company headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota. It provides financial planning, wealth management, asset management, insurance, annuities, and estate planning services.

companies.name: Edenor S.A.
companies.description: Edenor is an Argentine electricity distribution company founded in 1992 and headquartered in Buenos Aires. It holds an exclusive concession to distribute electricity in parts of Greater Buenos Aires and sells power to residential, commercial, industrial, and government customers.

companies.name: OneMain Financial
companies.description: OneMain Holdings, Inc. is an American financial services holding company headquartered in Evansville, Indiana. It operates OneMain Finance Corporation and subsidiaries, focusing on personal loans and optional insurance products for customers with limited access to traditional lenders.

companies.name: Dubber
companies.description: Dubber is an Australian cloud-based call recording software company founded in Melbourne in 2011. It operates as a software-as-a-service and voice data provider, primarily selling to telecommunications service providers and enterprise customers.

companies.name: Renasant Bank
companies.description: Renasant Bank is an American regional commercial financial institution based in Tupelo, Mississippi. It operates more than 280 branches across several southern states and is affiliated with Renasant Corporation and the Renasant Nation platform.

companies.name: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Ltd
companies.description: Alembic Pharmaceuticals is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Vadodara, Gujarat. It manufactures and markets pharmaceutical products including active pharmaceutical ingredients and formulations, with a presence in the macrolide anti-infective drug segment.

companies.name: Anker
companies.description: Anker Innovations Co., Ltd is a Chinese electronics manufacturer based in Changsha, Hunan. The company produces a wide range of consumer electronics including phone chargers, power banks, earbuds, 3D printers, and smart home devices. It is known for its diverse product portfolio in the consumer electronics industry.

companies.name: Beijing Enlight Media
companies.description: Beijing Enlight Media Co., Ltd is a Chinese publicly traded company specializing in TV program and film production through its subsidiary Beijing Enlight Pictures. The company was incorporated on April 24, 2000. It operates in the media and entertainment industry.

companies.name: Fingerprint Cards
companies.description: Fingerprint Cards (FPC) is a Swedish biometrics company founded in 1997 by Lennart Carlson. It develops and produces biometric systems. The company operates in the semiconductor industry.

companies.name: UGI Corporation
companies.description: UGI Corporation is a natural gas and electric power distribution company headquartered in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania. It has extensive operations in the United States and Europe. The company operates in the energy industry.

companies.name: Group Lala
companies.description: Grupo Lala is a Mexican food processing company founded in 1949 and headquartered in Gómez Palacio, Durango. It is one of the largest dairy companies in the world following its acquisition of National Dairy. The company operates in the food industry.

companies.name: Arista Networks
companies.description: Arista Networks, Inc. is an American company providing client to cloud networking services for large data centers, AI, campus, and routing environments. It operates in the computer networking industry. The company is based in the United States.

companies.name: Aristocrat Leisure
companies.description: Aristocrat Leisure Limited is an Australian gambling machine manufacturer headquartered in North Ryde, Sydney. It develops and supplies electronic gambling machines, casino management systems, online gambling technology, and social casino games. The company has offices in the UK, Europe, and the US.

companies.name: AAON
companies.description: AAON, Inc. manufactures heating, ventilation, and air conditioning equipment for commercial and industrial indoor environments. The company is headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma, with manufacturing facilities in Texas, Missouri, and Oregon. It operates in the central heating industry.

companies.name: Aruba Networks
companies.description: HPE Aruba Networking, formerly Aruba Networks, is a security and networking subsidiary of Hewlett Packard Enterprise based in Santa Clara, California. The company operates in the computer networking sector. It provides networking solutions as part of HPE.

companies.name: Universal Entertainment
companies.description: Universal Entertainment Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of pachinko, slot machines, arcade games, and other gaming products, as well as a video game publisher. Headquartered in Tokyo, it holds licenses to manufacture and distribute casino machines in Nevada, Mississippi, and New Jersey. The company was formerly known as Aruze Corporation.

companies.name: Atacadão
companies.description: Atacadão is a Brazilian chain of warehouse stores operating in Brazil and also running hypermarkets in Morocco and France. It was established by Alcides Parizotto and later acquired by Carrefour in 2007. The company competes with Assaí Atacadista in the retail sector.

companies.name: Avis Budget Group
companies.description: Avis Budget Group, Inc. is an American car rental agency holding company headquartered in Parsippany, New Jersey. It is one of the three major rental car holding companies in the United States and owns brands including Avis Car Rental, Budget Rent a Car, and Zipcar.

companies.name: Oramed Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Oramed Pharmaceuticals Inc. is a publicly traded company developing oral drug delivery systems, notably an oral insulin capsule for type 2 diabetes. Founded in 2006, it is headquartered in Jerusalem and listed on the NASDAQ Capital Market and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

companies.name: BBVA Argentina
companies.description: BBVA Argentina, formerly BBVA Banco Francés, is a financial institution operating in Argentina. It provides various financial services within the country.

companies.name: Datang International Power Generation Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Datang International Power Generation Company Limited is one of the five largest state-owned power producers in China, particularly in Northern China. It develops and operates power plants, sells electricity and thermal power, and provides repair and maintenance services for power equipment.

companies.name: BTG Pactual
companies.description: BTG Pactual is a global financial services group headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil, founded in 1983. It operates in 13 major financial centers worldwide and offers investment banking, wealth management, asset management, corporate lending, sales and trading, and consumer banking services.

companies.name: ACCO Brands
companies.description: ACCO Brands Corporation is an American producer of branded consumer, academic, business, and technology products. Headquartered in Lake Zurich, Illinois, it sells its products in more than 100 countries worldwide.

companies.name: Banca Intesa Beograd
companies.description: Banca Intesa a.d. Beograd is a commercial bank in Serbia and a subsidiary of Intesa Sanpaolo. It operates within the Serbian financial sector.

companies.name: Patagonia Bank
companies.description: Banco Patagonia is an Argentine commercial bank headquartered in Buenos Aires with 200 service points across Argentina. It serves individual clients and small to medium-sized businesses, with over 775,000 clients.

companies.name: Bank of Credit and Investments
companies.description: Banco de Crédito e Inversiones (BCI) is a Chilean bank specializing in savings, deposits, securities brokerage, asset management, and insurance. It was the Latin American partner for Bear Stearns and is owned by the Yarur family. The bank is based in Chile.

companies.name: Banco Santander (Brasil)
companies.description: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. is the Brazilian subsidiary of the Spanish Santander Group, headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil. It is the fifth largest banking institution in Brazil and Latin America and the largest division of Santander outside Europe. The bank is publicly listed in São Paulo and New York.

companies.name: Bank Saderat Iran
companies.description: Bank Saderat Iran is an Iranian multinational banking and financial services company headquartered in Tehran. Founded in 1952 by the Mofarrah and Bolurfrushan families, it is Iran's largest bank. The bank started operations with a board of three directors and 20 employees.

companies.name: Bank Sepah
companies.description: Bank Sepah is a major Iranian bank headquartered in Tehran with historical links to the country's military community. Established in 1925 as the first modern domestic Iranian bank, it is owned by the Iranian government and serves as a financial platform for the Ministry of Defence and Armed Forces Logistics.

companies.name: Kioxia
companies.description: Kioxia is a Japanese semiconductor memory and data-storage group headquartered in Tokyo. It is led by the publicly traded holding company Kioxia Holdings Corporation. Its principal subsidiary develops, manufactures, and sells NAND flash memory, solid-state drives, and related storage products.

companies.name: Puma Biotechnology
companies.description: Puma Biotechnology is a publicly traded biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Los Angeles, California, United States. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry focusing on biotechnology.

companies.name: Suntory Global Spirits
companies.description: Suntory Global Spirits Inc. is an American beverage company and a subsidiary of Suntory Holdings, a Japanese multinational beverage conglomerate. The company produces alcoholic beverages and was formerly known as Beam Suntory, Inc. and Beam, Inc.

companies.name: Beijing Capital International Airport Company Limited
companies.wiki: Beijing Capital International Airport Company Limited
companies.description: Beijing Capital International Airport Company Limited (BCIA) is majority owned by Capital Airport Holding and operates the Beijing Capital International Airport in Beijing, China. The company also provides related airport services.

companies.name: Essential Utilities
companies.description: Essential Utilities is an American utility company with operations in multiple states including Illinois, Indiana, and Pennsylvania. It provides drinking water, wastewater treatment infrastructure, and natural gas services. The company oversees Aqua America and Peoples Natural Gas, which operate under their original names.

companies.name: Old Mutual
companies.description: Old Mutual is a South African investment, savings, insurance, and banking group operating across Africa. Headquartered in Cape Town, it is listed on multiple stock exchanges including Johannesburg, Zimbabwe, Namibia, and Botswana.

companies.name: Federal-Mogul
companies.description: Federal-Mogul Corporation is an American developer, manufacturer, and supplier of products for automotive, commercial, aerospace, marine, rail, and off-road vehicles, as well as industrial, agricultural, and power-generation applications. It was acquired in February 2022 by Apollo Global Management.

companies.name: Bank Of Jerusalem L.t.d.
companies.description: Bank of Jerusalem, Ltd is Israel's seventh-largest bank, headquartered in Jerusalem with 25 branches around the country. It operates in the financial services sector providing banking services across Israel.

companies.name: Havanna Argentina
companies.description: Havanna Holding S.A. is an Argentine manufacturer of food products, mostly known for its alfajores. Founded in 1948 in Mar del Plata, Argentina, the company specializes in producing traditional Argentine sweets.

companies.name: Ginkgo Bioworks
companies.description: Ginkgo Bioworks Holdings, Inc. is an American biotechnology company founded in 2008 by five MIT scientists. It uses genetic engineering to produce bacteria with industrial applications and went public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2021.

companies.name: Syncona
companies.description: Syncona is a British closed-ended investment trust dedicated to life science investments. Co-founded in 2012 and publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange, it is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Union Bank Of Israel Ltd.
companies.description: The Union Bank of Israel, Ltd., also known as Bank Igud, was the seventh largest Israeli bank with thirty branches across the country. It operates in the banking sector in Israel.

companies.name: Tiv Taam Holdings 1 Ltd
companies.description: Tiv Ta'am is an Israeli supermarket chain known for selling pork and other non-kosher products. It operates over 40 branches throughout Israel, some open 24/7, and is involved in food processing and formerly telecommunications.

companies.name: Discount Investment Corp. Ltd.
companies.description: Discount Investment Corporation Ltd. is a holding company based in Israel. It is listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and controlled by IDB Development Company, which is held by IDB Holding Corporation Ltd.

companies.name: ADT Inc.
companies.description: ADT Inc. is an American security company providing residential and small business electronic security, fire protection, and alarm monitoring services in the US and Canada. Its corporate head office is in Boca Raton, Florida.

companies.name: Radware
companies.description: Radware Ltd. is an American provider of cybersecurity and application delivery products for physical, cloud, and software-defined data centers. Its global headquarters is in Israel, and its shares are traded on NASDAQ.

companies.name: Boise Cascade
companies.description: Boise Cascade Company is an American manufacturer of wood products and a wholesale distributor of building materials. It is headquartered in Boise, Idaho. The company operates primarily in the industrials and chemicals sector.

companies.name: ZeroFox
companies.description: ZeroFox Holdings, Inc. is an American external cybersecurity company based in Baltimore, Maryland. It provides cloud-based software as a service to help organizations detect and disrupt various cyber threats. The company operates in the technology sector focused on computer security.

companies.name: Israel Land Development Company
companies.description: Israel Land Development Company is one of Israel's largest conglomerates with activities in real estate, construction, energy, and hotels. It was acquired in 1987 by Yaakov Nimrodi. The company is based in Israel and operates in the real estate sector.

companies.name: Spacecom
companies.description: Spacecom, or Space Communication, is an Israeli communications satellite operator headquartered in Ramat Gan, Israel. It operates multiple satellites across orbital positions in the Middle East, European Union, and North America. The company is part of the telecommunications industry.

companies.name: Boralex
companies.description: Boralex is a Canadian energy production company founded in 1990 in Quebec. It develops, builds, and operates renewable energy facilities in Canada, France, the UK, and the US. Boralex is recognized as a leading independent producer of onshore wind energy in France and operates in the utilities sector.

companies.name: China Southern Airlines
companies.description: China Southern Airlines is a major airline headquartered in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. It is one of the three major airlines in the country alongside Air China and China Eastern Airlines. The company operates in the transportation sector within the airline industry.

companies.name: VeriFone
companies.description: Verifone, Inc. is an American multinational corporation headquartered in New York City. It provides technology for electronic payment transactions and value-added services at the point of sale. Verifone serves various industries including financial, retail, hospitality, and healthcare, operating in the technology sector.

companies.name: Delta Galil Industries Ltd.
companies.description: Delta Galil Industries is a global designer, manufacturer, and marketer of branded and private label apparel products for men, women, and children. The company operates in the textile industry and is based in Israel.

companies.name: Ted Baker Plc
companies.description: Ted Baker is a British clothing brand founded in 1988 in Glasgow, Scotland. The brand offers male and female clothing, accessories, aftershaves, and perfumes, and is styled as 'Ted Baker, London.' It operates in the consumer goods and retail sector.

companies.name: Frasers Group
companies.description: Frasers Group plc is a British conglomerate involved in retail, real estate, intellectual property, and investment. It is named after its ownership of the department store chain House of Fraser. The company is based in the United Kingdom and operates primarily in the retail sector.

companies.name: Brainsway Ltd.
companies.description: BrainsWay Ltd. is an international medical technology company based in Israel that develops a medical device using H-coil for deep transcranial magnetic stimulation. This non-invasive treatment targets conditions such as depression, OCD, and smoking addiction. The company was founded in 2003 and has offices in the US and Jerusalem.

companies.name: AES Corporation
companies.description: The AES Corporation is an American utility and power generation company headquartered in Arlington, Virginia. It operates globally and is recognized as a Fortune 500 power company. AES is involved in electricity generation and supply.

companies.name: Mekorot
companies.description: Mekorot is Israel's national water company and the leading agency for water management in the country. Founded in 1937, it supplies about 80% of Israel's drinking water and operates the National Water Carrier. Mekorot also partners internationally in desalination and water management projects.

companies.name: Israel Electric Corporation
companies.description: Israel Electric Corporation is the largest electrical power supplier in Israel and the Palestinian territories. It builds, maintains, and operates power generation stations, substations, and transmission and distribution networks throughout Israel.

companies.name: Perrigo Company Plc
companies.description: Perrigo Company plc is an American manufacturer of private label over-the-counter pharmaceuticals legally headquartered in Ireland for tax purposes. While 70% of its net sales come from the U.S. healthcare system, its corporate headquarters are in Grand Rapids, Michigan. Perrigo completed a major US corporate tax inversion in 2013.

companies.name: China Eastern Airlines
companies.description: China Eastern Airlines is a major airline headquartered in Minhang, Shanghai, China. It is one of the three largest airlines in the country alongside Air China and China Southern Airlines.

companies.name: Isramco Negev 2 Limited Partnership
companies.description: Isramco Negev 2 Limited Partnership is an American Israeli publicly traded master limited partnership holding interests in oil and gas properties in Israel. Founded in 1989 by Isramco Inc. and others, its shares trade on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and it is part of the TA-35 Index.

companies.name: Boyd Gaming
companies.description: Boyd Gaming Corporation is an American gambling and hospitality company based in Paradise, Nevada. It was founded in 1975 by Sam and Bill Boyd and operates in the gaming and hospitality industry.

companies.name: AGL Energy
companies.description: AGL Energy Ltd is an Australian public company involved in electricity and gas generation and retailing for residential and commercial customers. It is one of the three major retailers in the National Electricity Market and is Australia's largest electricity generator.

companies.name: Terra Santa
companies.description: Terra Santa Agro is a publicly traded Brazilian agribusiness company focused on producing soybean, corn, and cotton. It operates seven production units in Mato Grosso and manages approximately 156.6 thousand hectares of land.

companies.name: Hainan Airlines
companies.description: Hainan Airlines is a Chinese airline headquartered in Haikou, Hainan. It is the largest civilian-run air transport company in China and operates scheduled domestic and international flights on 500 routes. Its main base is Haikou Meilan International Airport, with hubs in several major cities including Beijing and Shenzhen.

companies.name: Broadvision
companies.description: BroadVision, Inc. is a software vendor based in Redwood City, California, United States. It provides self-service web applications for enterprise social software, e-commerce, portals, and customer relationship management. The company was founded in 1993 and went public in 1996.

companies.name: Tegra Incorporadora
companies.description: Tegra Incorporadora is a Brazilian real estate company and the fifth largest homebuilder in Brazil. It was founded in 2008 through the merger of three homebuilder companies and is a subsidiary of Canadian Brookfield Asset Management.

companies.name: CAP S.A.
companies.description: CAP S.A., also known as the Pacific Steel Company, is a Chilean holding company in the mining and steel sectors. Its main facilities are located at Huachipato near the port of Talcahuano in the Bío Bío Region.

companies.name: Cameron International
companies.description: Cameron International Corporation was a global provider of pressure control and flow control systems for the oil and gas and process industries. The company was acquired by SLB in 2016 and now operates as a legacy brand.

companies.name: Recipe Unlimited
companies.description: Recipe Unlimited Corporation is a Canadian company operating several restaurant chains including Swiss Chalet and Harvey's. It also provides food distribution services for large operations.

companies.name: Aimco
companies.description: Apartment Investment and Management Company, known as Aimco, is a publicly traded American real estate investment trust. It owns apartment communities and a hotel as part of its real estate portfolio.

companies.name: Marel
companies.description: Marel is a multinational food processing company headquartered in Garðabær, Iceland. It manufactures equipment and provides services for food processing in the poultry, meat, and fish industries, employing around 8,000 people across 30 countries.

companies.name: Carmike Cinemas
companies.description: Carmike Cinemas, Inc. was an American motion picture exhibitor headquartered in Columbus, Georgia. It operated 276 theaters with 2,954 screens across 41 states and was the fourth largest movie theater chain in the U.S. before ceasing operations.

companies.name: Casey's General Stores
companies.description: Casey's General Stores, Inc. is a chain of convenience stores operating in the Midwestern and Southern United States. It is the third-largest chain in the country by number of locations and the largest American-owned chain, with many stores in small towns.

companies.name: Cellectis
companies.description: Cellectis is a French biopharmaceutical company that develops genome-edited chimeric antigen receptor T-cell technologies for cancer immunotherapy. It has offices in Paris, New York City, and Raleigh, North Carolina.

companies.name: Haitong International Securities Group Limited
companies.description: Haitong International Securities Group Limited is an international financial institution based in Hong Kong with a growing global network. It serves as a bridge linking Chinese and overseas capital markets and is a subsidiary of Guotai Haitong Securities Co., Ltd.

companies.name: Datang Telecom Technology
companies.description: Datang Telecom Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese state-owned telecommunications company based in Beijing. Established in 1998, it was the first Chinese state research institute restructured into a publicly listed company and was once grouped among China's major telecom vendors.

companies.name: Amec Foster Wheeler
companies.description: Amec Foster Wheeler was a British multinational consultancy, engineering, and project management company headquartered in London, England.

companies.name: Bloom Energy
companies.description: Bloom Energy Corporation is an American company headquartered in San Jose, California, that designs and manufactures solid oxide fuel cells producing electricity onsite from natural gas. It also develops electrolyzers for hydrogen production and holds over 1000 patents globally.

companies.name: AOpen
companies.description: AOpen is a Taiwanese electronics manufacturer that produces computers and computer parts. It originated as the Open System Business Unit of Acer Computer Inc.

companies.name: Charter Communications
companies.description: Charter Communications, Inc. is an American telecommunications and mass media company headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, with services branded as Spectrum.

companies.name: Expand Energy
companies.description: Expand Energy Corporation is the largest independent natural gas producer in the U.S., headquartered in Spring, Texas. It operates in the Appalachian Basin and the Haynesville Shale regions.

companies.name: Aware, Inc.
companies.description: Aware, Inc. is a biometrics software and services company based near Boston, Massachusetts.

companies.name: ARC Resources
companies.description: ARC Resources Ltd. is a Canadian energy company operating primarily in the Montney resource play in Alberta and northeast British Columbia. The company has been in operation since 1996.

companies.name: Cineplex Entertainment
companies.description: Cineplex Inc. is a Canadian entertainment and media company headquartered in Toronto. It operates movie theatres and family entertainment centres and is the largest cinema chain in Canada. As of 2019, it operated 165 locations and accounted for 75% of the domestic box office.

companies.name: Frontier Communications
companies.description: Frontier Communications Parent, Inc. is an American telecommunications company owned by Verizon. It operates a fiber-optic network and provides cloud-based services. The company was previously known as Citizens Utilities Co., Citizens Communications Co., and Frontier Communications Corp.

companies.name: HKS
companies.description: HKS Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded Japanese company headquartered in Fujinomiya, Shizuoka Prefecture. It specializes in engineering, manufacturing, and sales of high performance aftermarket and accessory automotive parts. The company has 50 years of experience and is known globally in the aftermarket parts and motorsport sectors.

companies.name: Cloudera
companies.description: Cloudera, Inc. is an American company specializing in data lake software. It operates in the data analytics software industry.

companies.name: Coca-Cola Enterprises
companies.description: Coca-Cola Enterprises was a marketer, producer, and distributor of Coca-Cola products. It served as the anchor bottler for Western Europe and most of North America.

companies.name: Cognex Corporation
companies.description: Cognex Corporation is an American manufacturer headquartered in Natick, Massachusetts. It produces machine vision systems, software, and sensors used in automated manufacturing for inspection, defect detection, product assembly verification, and robot guidance. The company has offices in more than 20 countries.

companies.name: Skullcandy
companies.description: Skullcandy Inc. is an American company based in Park City, Utah. It markets technology products including headphones, earphones, and Bluetooth speakers.

companies.name: Colas Group
companies.description: Colas Group is a major French civil engineering firm specializing in road and rail track construction through its Colas Rail subsidiary. Since the 1990s, it has incorporated the Screg and Sacer road construction firms.

companies.name: Colbun S.A.
companies.description: Colbún is a Chilean utility company engaged in electric power transmission. Founded in 1982 and privatized in 1997, it operates hydroelectric and fossil fuel plants and supplies the Sistema Interconectado Central power grid. It is developing the HidroAysén hydroelectric project in the Aisén Region.

companies.name: Mitsubishi Paper Mills
companies.description: Mitsubishi Paper Mills Limited is a Japanese company based in Sumida, Tokyo. It is part of the Mitsubishi and Oji Paper groups and operates in the pulp and paper industry.

companies.name: Tectoy
companies.description: Tectoy is a Brazilian toy and electronics company headquartered in São Paulo. It is known for producing, publishing, and distributing Sega consoles and video games in Brazil. Founded in 1987, the company was established to develop the electronic toys and video games market in Brazil.

companies.name: NDTV
companies.description: NDTV is an Indian news media company focusing on broadcast and digital news publication. It was founded in 1984 by economist Prannoy Roy and journalist Radhika Roy. The company operates primarily in the mass media industry.

companies.name: The One Enterprise
companies.description: The One Enterprise Public Company Limited is a Thai holding company under GMM Grammy Public Company Limited. It engages in integrated entertainment media business including content creation, distribution, event organization, and artist management. Its subsidiary One31 operates as a licensed digital terrestrial television operator.

companies.name: Compañia General de Electricidad
companies.description: Compañia General de Electricidad (CGE) is a Chilean utility company operating in electricity, natural gas, and other services. It is based in Chile and listed on the Santiago Stock Exchange. The company serves the energy sector.

companies.name: CCU
companies.description: Compañía Cervecerías Unidas S.A. (CCU) is a Chilean producer of diversified beverages founded in 1902. It produces alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages and operates in the food sector across several South American countries. The company has operations in Chile, Argentina, Bolivia, Colombia, Paraguay, Uruguay, and Peru.

companies.name: Iveco
companies.description: Iveco Group N.V. is an Italian multinational transport vehicle manufacturing company headquartered in Turin. It designs and builds light, medium, and heavy commercial vehicles and has production plants in Europe, China, Australia, and Latin America. The company was formed in 1975 after a merger of Italian, French, and German brands.

companies.name: Cosan
companies.description: Cosan S.A. is a Brazilian conglomerate producing bioethanol, sugar, and energy. It operates in Brazil and several South American countries and also in the United Kingdom under the Moove brand, manufacturing and supplying lubricants and related products.

companies.name: Croda International
companies.description: Croda International plc is a British speciality chemicals company based in Snaith, England. It operates in the chemical industry and is listed on the London Stock Exchange. The company focuses on producing speciality chemicals.

companies.name: AAEON
companies.description: AAEON Technology Inc. is a Taiwanese manufacturer specializing in industrial computer and embedding systems. Founded in 1992, it became one of Taiwan's 1,000 largest manufacturers by 1998. The company operates in the computer industry.

companies.name: CyberStep Holdings
companies.description: CyberStep, Inc. is a Japanese global online video game developer and publisher founded on April 1, 2000. The company operates in the video game industry and is based in Japan.

companies.name: MSA Safety
companies.description: Mine Safety Appliances, or MSA Safety Incorporated, is an American manufacturer and supplier of safety equipment for hazardous conditions. It serves industries such as construction, military, fire service, and chemical, oil, and gas production. The company is based in Cranberry, a suburb of Pittsburgh.

companies.name: DLF Limited
companies.description: DLF Limited is an Indian commercial real estate development company founded in 1946 and based in Gurugram, Haryana. It has developed several residential colonies in Delhi and builds residential, office, and retail properties.

companies.name: DavidsTea
companies.description: DavidsTea is a Canadian specialty tea and tea accessory retailer headquartered in Montreal, Quebec. It is the largest Canadian-based specialty tea boutique in the country and operates in the consumer goods and retail industry.

companies.name: bluebird bio
companies.description: Genetix Biotherapeutics Inc., formerly known as bluebird bio, is a privately held biotechnology company based in Somerville, Massachusetts. It develops and commercializes genetic medicine for rare diseases, with three FDA-approved one-time gene addition cell therapies.

companies.name: San’an Optoelectronics
companies.description: Sanan Optoelectronics is a publicly listed Chinese company that manufactures full-color high-brightness LED wafers and chips. It also produces solar cells and PIN photodetectors, operating in the optoelectronics industry.

companies.name: AbCellera
companies.description: AbCellera Biologics Inc. is a biotechnology company based in Vancouver, British Columbia. It discovers and develops antibody therapeutics and is known for its role in DARPA's Pandemic Prevention Platform. Its technology platform was initially developed at the University of British Columbia.

companies.name: Asia Vital Components (Taiwan)
companies.description: Asia Vital Components Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese electronics company producing computer cooling solutions. Founded in 1991, it has been listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange since 2002 and operates in the electronics industry.

companies.name: Align Technology
companies.description: Align Technology, Inc. is an American company headquartered in Tempe, Arizona, that manufactures 3D digital scanners and Invisalign clear aligners used in orthodontics. It produces aligners in Mexico, Poland, and China, and scanners in Israel and China. The company is best known for its Invisalign clear aligner system.

companies.name: Aptar
companies.description: AptarGroup, Inc., known as Aptar, is a United States-based global manufacturer of consumer dispensing packaging and drug delivery devices. The company operates manufacturing facilities in 18 countries worldwide.

companies.name: Elanco
companies.description: Elanco Animal Health Incorporated is an American pharmaceutical company producing medicines and vaccinations for pets and livestock. It was a subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Company until 2019. Elanco is the third-largest animal health company globally.

companies.name: Precigen, Inc
companies.description: Precigen, Inc. is an American biotechnology company. Its president and CEO is Helen Sabzevari.

companies.name: Cytokinetics
companies.description: Cytokinetics, Incorporated is a biopharmaceutical company based in South San Francisco, California. It develops muscle activators and inhibitors as potential treatments for diseases involving impaired or declining muscle function.

companies.name: Inovio Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Inovio Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is an American biotechnology company focused on synthetic DNA products for treating cancers and infectious diseases. In 2020, it was among companies developing a COVID-19 vaccine candidate.

companies.name: Steyr Motors
companies.description: Steyr Motors is an Austrian manufacturer of diesel engines based in Steyr, Upper Austria.

companies.name: Arcadia Biosciences (United States)
companies.description: Arcadia Biosciences is a publicly traded American agricultural biotechnology company headquartered in Davis, California. It focuses on developing traits to enhance crop quality and productivity and is partly owned by Moral Compass Corporation.

companies.name: Verastem Oncology
companies.description: Verastem, Inc., doing business as Verastem Oncology, is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It develops medicines to treat certain cancers and is a member of the NASDAQ Biotechnology Index.

companies.name: L3Harris Technologies
companies.description: L3Harris Technologies, Inc. is an American technology company and defense contractor producing products for command and control systems, wireless equipment, tactical radios, avionics, night vision, and intelligence systems. It serves government, defense, and commercial sectors.

companies.name: Vaxart
companies.description: Vaxart, Inc. is an American biotechnology company that develops oral recombinant vaccines delivered via temperature-stable tablets, eliminating the need for refrigeration and injections. Founded in 2004 and based in Delaware, it focuses on vaccines for norovirus, influenza, RSV, and HPV. The company became a wholly owned subsidiary of Aviragen Therapeutics in 2018 after a reverse merger.

companies.name: F5, Inc.
companies.description: F5, Inc. is an American technology company specializing in multicloud application delivery, API security, online fraud prevention, zero trust access, and enterprise AI workload security. It provides solutions to enhance application and data security across cloud environments.

companies.name: Blue Prism
companies.description: SS&C Blue Prism, formerly Blue Prism Group plc, is a multinational software company that develops robotic process automation and business process management software. Founded in 2001 in the UK, it was acquired by SS&C Technologies in 2022 and now operates as SS&C Blue Prism. In 2026, it launched an automation platform integrating AI agents, robots, and people.

companies.name: Loxley Pacific
companies.description: Loxley PCL is a Thai company involved in technology, IT, energy, and trading sectors. It operates across multiple industries within Thailand, providing diverse business services.

companies.name: Janus Henderson
companies.description: Janus Henderson is a British-American global asset management group headquartered in London. It offers a variety of financial products to individuals, advisors, and institutional investors worldwide under the Janus Henderson Investors brand.

companies.name: West Pharmaceutical Services (United States)
companies.description: West Pharmaceutical Services, Inc. designs and manufactures injectable pharmaceutical packaging and delivery systems. Founded in 1923 and based in Exton, Pennsylvania, it initially produced rubber components for sterile packaging of drugs like penicillin and insulin.

companies.name: Dollarama
companies.description: Dollarama Inc. is a Canadian dollar store retail chain headquartered in Mount Royal, Quebec. Established in 1992, it is Canada's largest retailer of items priced five dollars or less, operating over 1400 stores nationwide and owning other discount chains like The Reject Shop and Dollarcity.

companies.name: D-Link
companies.description: D-Link Systems, Inc. is a Taiwanese multinational manufacturer of networking hardware and telecommunications equipment. Founded in 1986, it is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, and serves global markets with its products.

companies.name: Aastra Technologies
companies.description: Aastra Technologies Limited was a Canadian company based in Concord, Ontario, producing communication network products including telephone terminals, PBX systems, and digital video equipment. Its residential phones were sold in the US under the Bell equipment brand by Sonecor.

companies.name: Kamaz
companies.description: KAMAZ is a Russian manufacturer of trucks, buses, and engines headquartered in Naberezhnye Chelny. It specializes in producing heavy vehicles and related powertrain components.

companies.name: Hopi Hari
companies.description: Hopi Hari is a Brazilian theme park located in Vinhedo, São Paulo. It is the second largest amusement park in Brazil and part of the SerrAzul Full Life tourist complex. The park was sold in 2009 due to debts by its previous owner, GP Investments.

companies.name: Dexco
companies.description: Dexco, formerly Duratex, is a Brazilian company producing fiberboards and wood panels. It operates in Brazil and Colombia and is controlled by the Itaúsa and Ligna Groups. Dexco is the eighth largest wood panel producer globally and the largest in the Southern Hemisphere.

companies.name: MCA Inc.
companies.description: MCA Inc. was an American media conglomerate operating from 1924 to 1996. It started as a talent agency in the music business and expanded into film, television production, and music publishing. MCA also ran MCA Records and produced TV programs for major networks.

companies.name: EDF power solutions
companies.description: EDF Power Solutions is a subsidiary of the French utility EDF Group specializing in renewable energy. The company develops, finances, constructs, and manages renewable energy facilities for itself and third parties. It operates as an integrated renewable energy operator.

companies.name: East West Bank
companies.description: East West Bank is an American bank and the main subsidiary of East West Bancorp. It is the largest publicly traded bank headquartered in Southern California. The bank has been recognized as the top performing U.S. bank in its asset size category since 2023.

companies.name: Public Bank Berhad
companies.description: Public Bank Berhad is a bank based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It provides financial services within Malaysia and across the Asia-Pacific region. The bank operates primarily in the banking and fintech industry.

companies.name: Edenred
companies.description: Edenred is a French international payment service provider formerly known as Accor Services. It specializes in workplace payment services including employee benefits like meal vouchers. Edenred operates in 46 countries and has been listed on Euronext Paris since 2010.

companies.name: Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand
companies.logo_file: Logo of the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand.svg
companies.description: The Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) is a state enterprise under the Ministry of Energy. It manages electric power generation, transmission, and bulk energy sales in Thailand. EGAT operates 45 power plants and is the largest power producer in the country.

companies.name: La Polar
companies.description: La Polar was a retail company based in Chile. The summary provides limited information about its operations or history.

companies.name: First Pacific
companies.description: First Pacific Company Limited is a Hong Kong-based investment management and holding company. It operates in Asia with interests in telecommunications, consumer food products, and infrastructure sectors.

companies.name: Enel Generación Chile
companies.description: Enel Generación Chile S.A. is the largest electric utility company in Chile, originally created as a state-owned subsidiary in 1943 and privatized in 1989. It operates in Chile and other South American countries, with investments in electricity generation, transmission, and distribution. The company owns a majority stake in the HidroAysén hydropower project.

companies.name: IQVIA Holdings, Inc.
companies.description: IQVIA Holdings, Inc. is an American health information technology and clinical research company headquartered in Durham, North Carolina. It provides clinical research services, healthcare analytics, technology solutions, and commercial outsourcing to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and healthcare organizations worldwide.

companies.name: Ericsson Nikola Tesla
companies.description: Ericsson Nikola Tesla d.d. is the Croatian subsidiary of Swedish telecommunications manufacturer Ericsson. Founded in 1949 and privatized in 1994, it is the largest provider of telecommunications products, solutions, and services in central and eastern Europe, serving telecommunications, healthcare, intelligent transportation, and enterprise sectors.

companies.name: Pacific Premier Bancorp
companies.description: Pacific Premier Bancorp, Inc. was an American bank holding company headquartered in Irvine, California. Its main business was Pacific Premier Bank, which offered financial services to individuals, businesses, and professionals, operating branches in California, Arizona, Nevada, and Washington.

companies.name: Boxed.com
companies.description: Boxed, Inc. is an American online and mobile wholesale retailer based in New York City. Founded in 2013, it offers direct delivery of bulk-sized packages without membership via its app and website, with a product offering compared to that of Costco.

companies.name: Halozyme, Inc.
companies.description: Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc. is an American biotechnology company that develops oncology therapies targeting the tumor microenvironment.

companies.name: Sanne Group
companies.description: Sanne Group is a provider of asset management services based in Jersey. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index until its acquisition by Apex Group in August 2022.

companies.name: Exa Corporation
companies.description: Exa Corporation was a developer and distributor of computer-aided engineering software, specializing in PowerFLOW, a computational fluid dynamics tool used extensively in the automotive and transportation industries worldwide.

companies.name: Multistrada Arah Sarana
companies.description: PT Multistrada Arah Sarana is an Indonesian tire manufacturer selling tires under the Achilles and Corsa brands. It operates large factories in East Cikarang and has been a subsidiary of French manufacturer Michelin since 2019.

companies.name: FTSE/JSE Top 40 Index
companies.description: The FTSE/JSE Top 40 Index is a South African stock market index comprising the 40 largest stocks by market capitalization on the JSE Limited, part of the FTSE/JSE All-Share Index.

companies.name: Telecomunicações de São Paulo
companies.description: Telecomunicações de São Paulo S.A. (Telesp) was a telephony operator in the Brazilian state of São Paulo. It operated from 1973 until its privatization in 1998, when it was acquired by the Spanish company Telefónica. This acquisition led to the formation of Telefônica Brasil, which later adopted the Vivo brand for fixed-line operations.

companies.name: ISA CTEEP
companies.description: Companhia de Transmissão de Energia Elétrica Paulista (ISA CTEEP) is a transmission system operator of the electric power grid in Brazil. The company is headquartered in São Paulo and plays a key role in the country's energy infrastructure.

companies.name: GoodRx
companies.description: GoodRx Holdings, Inc. is an American healthcare company operating a telemedicine platform and a free website and mobile app. It tracks prescription drug prices across more than 75,000 U.S. pharmacies and provides drug coupons for discounts. The platform also allows users to consult doctors online and obtain prescriptions for certain medications.

companies.name: Lojas Renner
companies.description: Lojas Renner S.A. is a leading fashion and lifestyle retailer in Brazil, founded in 1922. Originally part of the AJ Renner Group, it separated from the group in 1965 and evolved its store format to its current model. The company is a significant player in Brazil's retail sector.

companies.name: Axway Software
companies.description: Axway Software is a French-American publicly held information technology company. It provides software tools for enterprise software, application integration, business monitoring, analytics, mobile app development, and web API management.

companies.name: French Connection
companies.description: French Connection is a UK-based global retailer and wholesaler of fashion clothing, accessories, and homeware. Founded in the early 1970s by Stephen Marks, it is based in London. The company was acquired by MIP Holdings Ltd in 2021.

companies.name: Janome
companies.description: Janome Corporation is a Japanese company that produces sewing machines. It operates manufacturing plants in Japan, Taiwan, and Thailand, serving the global market for sewing equipment.

companies.name: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile
companies.description: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile (SQM) is a Chilean chemical company supplying plant nutrients, iodine, lithium, and industrial chemicals. It was the world's largest lithium producer by 2017. In 2023, its lithium mining activities were transferred to Nova Andino Litio, a public–private joint venture with Codelco.

companies.name: Fastenal
companies.description: Fastenal Company is an American distributor of industrial and construction supplies, headquartered in Winona, Minnesota. Founded in 1967, it is the largest fastener distributor in North America and offers supply chain solutions including inventory management and logistics services.

companies.name: Pershing Square Holdings
companies.description: Pershing Square Holdings is a Guernsey-based investment trust and financial services company. It is part of the FTSE 100 Index on the London Stock Exchange and is managed by Bill Ackman of Pershing Square Capital Management. The fund tracks the performance of the American fund managed by Pershing Square Capital.

companies.name: Boohoo Group
companies.description: Boohoo Group plc is a United Kingdom-based online retail platform operating five core brands including Debenhams, Karen Millen, boohoo, boohooMAN, and PrettyLittleThing. It focuses on fashion, beauty, and lifestyle retail. The company trades as Debenhams Group.

companies.name: Medical Properties Trust
companies.description: Medical Properties Trust, Inc. is a real estate investment trust headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, United States. It invests in healthcare facilities. The company focuses on real estate related to the healthcare sector.

companies.name: First Hawaiian Bank
companies.description: First Hawaiian, Inc. is an American bank holding company headquartered in Honolulu, Hawaiʻi. Its principal subsidiary, First Hawaiian Bank, is the oldest and largest financial institution in Hawaiʻi. The bank offers a range of banking services including deposit products, lending, and wealth management.

companies.name: Bilibili
companies.description: Bilibili is a Chinese online video sharing platform based in Shanghai. It allows users to upload, view, and comment on videos, featuring a unique system of overlaid on-screen comments called danmu. The platform originally focused on animation, comics, and games but has expanded into other content types.

companies.name: Ito En
companies.description: Ito En, Ltd. is a Japanese multinational drinks company specializing in tea production, distribution, and sales. It is the largest green tea distributor in Japan and operates subsidiaries worldwide. The company also produces private label drinks and acquired Tully's Coffee's business in Japan.

companies.name: Fosun International Limited
companies.description: Fosun International Limited is a Chinese multinational conglomerate holding company headquartered in Shanghai and incorporated in Hong Kong. Founded in 1992, it operates in over 35 countries and is one of China's largest privately owned conglomerates.

companies.name: Mitsumi
companies.description: Mitsumi Electric Co., Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of consumer electronic components founded in 1954. It became a subsidiary of MinebeaMitsumi in 2017 after merging with Minebea to form the parent company.

companies.name: Kabuki-za
