companies.description: Kabuki-za is the principal theater in Tokyo, Japan, for the traditional kabuki drama form. It is located in the Ginza district and serves as a key venue for this classical Japanese performing art.

companies.name: Fresnillo plc
companies.description: Fresnillo plc is a Mexican precious metals mining company incorporated in the United Kingdom and headquartered in Mexico City. It is the world's largest producer of silver from ore and Mexico's second-largest gold miner. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Jamba
companies.description: Jamba, formerly Jamba Juice, is an American quick-service restaurant and juice bar chain selling blended fruit and vegetable juices, smoothies, and other food products. Founded in 1990 in California, it operates 850 locations in the US and several countries in Asia and Australia.

companies.name: Malaysia Airlines
companies.description: Malaysia Airlines Berhad is the flag carrier airline of Malaysia, headquartered at Kuala Lumpur International Airport. It operates flights to destinations across Europe, Oceania, and Asia from its main hub. The airline was formerly known as Malaysian Airline System.

companies.name: Mobarakeh Steel Company
companies.description: Mobarakeh Steel Company is a private Iranian steel producer located near Mobarakeh, Isfahan Province. It is the largest steel maker in the MENA region and one of Iran's largest industrial complexes. The company owns the football club Sepahan F.C. and several other industrial assets.

companies.name: GW Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: GW Pharmaceuticals Limited is a British pharmaceutical company known for its cannabis-based treatments, including nabiximols for multiple sclerosis and Epidiolex for epilepsy. It was the first to gain market approval for a natural cannabis derivative. The company is a subsidiary of Jazz Pharmaceuticals.

companies.name: Wangsu Science & Technology
companies.description: Wangsu Science & Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company providing content delivery network and Internet data center services. Founded in 2000, it was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2009.

companies.name: Genivar
companies.description: Genivar Inc. was a Canadian engineering consulting firm that became WSP Global in 2014. Its head office is located in Montreal, Quebec.

companies.name: OSRAM Licht AG
companies.description: OSRAM Licht AG is a German company headquartered in Munich and Premstätten, Austria, that manufactures electric lights. It focuses on photonics, sensor technology, visualization, and light treatment, serving consumer, automotive, healthcare, and industrial sectors.

companies.name: Mitsubishi Chemical Holdings
companies.description: Mitsubishi Chemical Group Corporation is a Japanese chemical industry company formed in 2005 from the merger of Mitsubishi Chemical Corporation and Mitsubishi Pharma Corporation. It is headquartered in Tokyo and part of the Mitsubishi conglomerate.

companies.name: Goodman Group
companies.description: Goodman Group is a global provider of essential infrastructure, owning, developing, and managing real estate including warehouses, logistics facilities, business parks, and data centers.

companies.name: Keurig Dr Pepper
companies.description: Keurig Dr Pepper, Inc. is an American beverage conglomerate with dual headquarters in Massachusetts and Texas. It was formed in 2018 through the merger of Keurig Green Mountain and Dr Pepper Snapple Group.

companies.name: Universal Display Corporation
companies.description: Universal Display Corporation is a United States-based developer and manufacturer of organic light emitting diode (OLED) technologies and materials. It provides services to the display and lighting industries. The company operates within the computer hardware industry.

companies.name: Jean Coutu
companies.description: The Jean Coutu Group (PJC) Inc. is a Canadian pharmacy chain headquartered in Varennes, Quebec. It operates over 400 franchised locations across Quebec, Ontario, and New Brunswick under various banners. At its peak, it was the third-largest distributor and retailer of pharmaceuticals in North America.

companies.name: TMX Group
companies.description: TMX Group Limited is a Canadian financial services company operating equities, fixed income, derivatives, and energy market exchanges. It offers services including listings, trading, clearing, settling, depository facilities, information, and technology services for the international financial community.

companies.name: TVA Group
companies.description: Groupe TVA Inc. is a Canadian communications company involved in broadcasting, publishing, and production. Founded in 1960 as Télé-Métropole Corporation, it owned Montreal's first privately owned francophone station. Quebecor Media holds voting control through near-complete ownership of Class A shares.

companies.name: iM Financial Group
companies.description: IM Financial Group Co., Ltd. is a financial holding company headquartered in Daegu, South Korea. Its flagship company, IM Bank, is one of the largest regional banks in the country, primarily serving the Daegu-Gyeongbuk region.

companies.name: Studio Dragon
companies.description: Studio Dragon Corporation is a South Korean drama production, marketing, and distribution company under CJ ENM Entertainment Division. Established in 2016 as a spin-off from E&M's drama division, it became a subsidiary of CJ ENM in 2018 after a corporate merger.

companies.name: Galicia Financial Group
companies.description: Grupo Financiero Galicia S.A. is a financial services holding company based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Its banking operations rank as the fifth largest in Argentina and the largest among domestically owned private banks in the country.

companies.name: Dommo Energia
companies.description: Dommo Energia is a Brazilian publicly listed oil and gas company formerly known as OGX Petróleo e Gás Participações S.A. Before filing for bankruptcy in 2013, OGX was Brazil's second-largest oil company by market value after Petrobras.

companies.name: Natura Cosméticos S.A.
companies.description: Natura Cosméticos S.A. is a Brazilian global personal care cosmetics group headquartered in São Paulo. It includes the Natura brand and Avon Products, operating in 73 countries worldwide. Founded in 1969, it became a public company in 2004 and is the largest Brazilian cosmetics company by revenue.

companies.name: Tsingtao Brewery
companies.description: Tsingtao Brewery Co. Ltd. is China's second largest brewery headquartered in Qingdao. It holds about 15% of the domestic market share and accounts for half of China's national beer exports.

companies.name: Yamazaki Baking
companies.description: Yamazaki Baking Company, Ltd. is a Japanese food company established in 1948. It is the world's largest bread-baking corporation, producing bread, bakery products, and confectionery. The company remains controlled by the founding Iijima family, now led by the third generation.

companies.name: ITV plc
companies.description: ITV plc is a British media company based in London, England. It holds 13 of the 15 regional television licences that make up the ITV network. ITV is the oldest and largest commercial terrestrial television network in the United Kingdom.

companies.name: Hydro One
companies.description: Hydro One Limited is an electricity transmission and distribution utility serving Ontario, Canada. It originated from the Hydro-Electric Power Commission of Ontario and was restructured in 1998 under the Energy Competition Act. The restructuring separated generation, transmission, and price management with a goal of privatization.

companies.name: Hypera Pharma
companies.description: Hypera Pharma is a Brazilian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in São Paulo. It is the largest Brazilian pharmaceutical company by market capitalization. Its business includes pharmaceuticals, consumer healthcare, cosmetics, and biotechnology products.

companies.name: IMI plc
companies.description: IMI plc is a British engineering company headquartered in Birmingham, England. Formerly known as Imperial Metal Industries Limited, it is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Icade
companies.industry: rental of land and other real estate
companies.description: Icade SA is a multinational real estate investment trust headquartered in Issy-les-Moulineaux, Paris, France. It is a subsidiary of Caisse des dépôts et consignations and invests in healthcare, offices, business parks, housing, and public facilities. Icade is one of France's largest property businesses and a leading commercial real estate company in Île-de-France.

companies.name: Innergex Renewable Energy
companies.description: Innergex Renewable Energy Inc. develops, owns, and operates run-of-river hydroelectric, wind, and solar energy facilities. It operates in North America, France, and South America, with many assets in Québec and expansions into Ontario, British Columbia, Idaho, Chile, and France.

companies.name: Intact Financial
companies.description: Intact Financial Corporation is a Canadian general insurance holding company and the largest provider of property and casualty insurance in Canada. It operates subsidiaries and brands across Canada, the UK, Ireland, Europe, and the United States. The company was formed in 2009 and is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

companies.name: JBT Marel
companies.description: JBT Marel Corporation, formerly JBT Corporation, is a food processing machinery and automated vehicle company based in Chicago, Illinois. Incorporated in 2008 after FMC Technologies divested its non-energy businesses, it traces its origins to a company founded in 1884 by John Bean in California.

companies.name: JDSU
companies.description: JDS Uniphase Corporation was an American company headquartered in Milpitas, California, that designed and manufactured products for optical communications networks and test equipment. In 2015, it split into two companies: Viavi Solutions and Lumentum Holdings.

companies.name: Taisei Corporation
companies.description: Taisei Corporation is a Japanese company founded in 1873 that specializes in building construction, civil engineering, and real estate development. Its headquarters are located in the Shinjuku Center Building in Tokyo. It is one of the longstanding construction firms in Japan.

companies.name: Abengoa
companies.description: Abengoa, S.A. was a Spanish multinational company focused on green infrastructure, energy, and water sectors. Founded in 1941 and based in Seville, Spain, it faced insolvency in 2021 after financial difficulties and regulatory issues. It was one of the largest corporate collapses in Spanish history.

companies.name: Abertis
companies.description: Abertis Infraestructuras, S.A. is a Spanish multinational corporation that manages toll roads worldwide. Headquartered in Madrid, it operates over 8,600 kilometers of toll roads. In 2018, it was acquired by a consortium including Italian, Spanish, and German companies.

companies.name: Tarkett
companies.description: Tarkett S.A. is a French multinational company specializing in floor and wall coverings. Headquartered near Paris, it was formed in 1997 by merging French Sommer-Allibert and German Tarkett AG. The company’s name originates from a product developed by a Swedish predecessor.

companies.name: Calatrava Capital S.A.
companies.description: Calatrava Capital S.A. is a Polish holding company listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange. It manages subsidiaries and focuses on analysis, restructuring, financing, and selling or floating companies. Its portfolio includes companies from IT, energy, and fuel sectors.

companies.name: Stepan Company
companies.description: Stepan Company is an American manufacturer of specialty chemicals headquartered in Northbrook, Illinois. Founded in 1932, it is known as the largest global merchant manufacturer of anionic surfactants used in detergents, shampoos, toothpastes, and cosmetics.

companies.name: Cathay Pacific
companies.description: Cathay Pacific Airways Limited is the flag carrier airline of Hong Kong. Its head office and main hub are located at Hong Kong International Airport. The airline operates passenger and cargo services to over 190 destinations in more than 60 countries worldwide.

companies.name: Lamar Advertising Company
companies.description: Lamar Advertising Company is an American outdoor advertising firm operating billboards, logo signs, and transit displays across the United States and Canada. Founded in 1902 and headquartered in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, it became a real estate investment trust in 2014.

companies.name: Lamb Weston
companies.description: Lamb Weston Holdings, Inc. is an American food processing company headquartered in Eagle, Idaho. It is one of the world's largest producers and processors of frozen french fries, waffle fries, and other frozen potato products.

companies.name: Landi Renzo
companies.description: Landi Renzo S.p.A is a multinational company based in Cavriago, Italy. It produces pressure management components for natural gas and hydrogen and operates in sustainable mobility and infrastructure sectors. The company serves OEMs and the aftermarket in mobility and provides solutions and project management for global energy companies in infrastructure.

companies.name: Level 3 Communications
companies.description: Level 3 Communications, Inc. was an American multinational telecommunications and internet service provider headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado. It became part of CenturyLink, with its President and CEO Jeff Storey becoming CEO of CenturyLink in a planned succession.

companies.name: Seiko
companies.description: Seiko Group Corporation is a Japanese company known for making watches, clocks, electronic devices, and semiconductors. Founded in 1881 in Tokyo, Seiko introduced the world's first commercial quartz wristwatch in 1969.

companies.name: Light S.A.
companies.description: Light S.A. is a private sector public utility company based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Founded in 1904 in Toronto, Canada, it was authorized to operate in Brazil in 1905. The company operates in the renewables and utilities sector.

companies.name: American Airlines
companies.description: American Airlines, Inc. is a major U.S. airline headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas. It operates an extensive international and domestic network with thousands of daily flights to nearly 350 destinations in 48 countries. The airline is a founding member of the Oneworld alliance.

companies.name: Hays plc
companies.description: Hays plc is a British multinational company providing recruitment and human resources services in 33 countries. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Astro Malaysia Holdings
companies.description: Astro Malaysia Holdings Berhad is a Malaysian media and entertainment holding company. It started as a paid digital satellite radio and television service and serves millions of homes, enterprises, radio listeners, digital visitors, and shoppers across its platforms.

companies.name: Ingram Micro
companies.industry: Wholesale of computers, computer peripheral equipment and software
companies.description: Ingram Micro Holding Corporation is an American distributor of information technology products and services based in Irvine, California. Founded in 1979, it has evolved from a traditional distributor to a platform-based business focused on B2B digital experiences.

companies.name: Transcend Information
companies.description: Transcend Information, Inc. is a Taiwanese manufacturer of memory and storage products headquartered in Taipei. Founded in 1989, it develops, manufactures, and markets memory modules, flash memory, and storage devices for consumer, embedded, and enterprise applications.

companies.name: Jefferies & Company
companies.description: Jefferies Group LLC is an American multinational independent investment bank and financial services company headquartered in New York City. It provides capital markets and financial advisory services, institutional brokerage, securities research, wealth management, and asset management.

companies.name: Loral Space & Communications
companies.description: Loral Space & Communications Inc. is a satellite communications company based in Delaware, United States. It was formed in 1996 from the remnants of Loral Corporation after divesting its defense electronics and system integration businesses. The company is led by Michael B. Targoff.

companies.name: True Corporation
companies.description: True Corporation Public Company Limited is a communications conglomerate in Thailand formed by the merger of True Corporation and Dtac. It operates fixed-line, wireless, satellite, cable TV, IPTV, and broadband services. True controls Thailand's largest cable TV provider and internet service provider.

companies.name: CelcomDigi
companies.description: CelcomDigi Berhad is a communications conglomerate and mobile service provider based in Malaysia. It is jointly owned by Axiata and Telenor, each holding 33.1%. CelcomDigi is the largest wireless carrier in Malaysia.

companies.name: Quanjude
companies.description: Quanjude is a Chinese restaurant chain established in 1864 in Beijing, China. It is known for its Peking duck and longstanding culinary heritage.

companies.name: M&T Bank
companies.description: M&T Bank Corporation is an American bank holding company headquartered in Buffalo, New York. It operates over 940 branches across 12 states and Washington D.C. in the Eastern United States. The holding company was formerly named First Empire State Corporation until 1998.

companies.name: MMX Mineração
companies.description: MMX Mineração is a mining company in Brazil and Chile, part of the EBX Group founded in 2005. It focuses on extraction, beneficiation, and sale of iron ore and minerals. The company filed for bankruptcy in 2016 and its bankruptcy was upheld in 2021.

companies.name: Eneva
companies.description: Eneva is a power generation company based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. It is publicly listed on the São Paulo stock exchange.

companies.name: Maisons du Monde
companies.description: Maisons du Monde is a French furniture and home decor company founded in Brest in 1996. It operates 349 stores in Europe, with 212 in France, and employs over 5,500 people. Nearly half of its sales are made online and 45% of sales come from abroad.

companies.name: Sun Pharmaceutical
companies.description: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai. It manufactures and sells pharmaceutical formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients in over 100 countries. It is the largest pharmaceutical company in India.

companies.name: Masisa
companies.description: MASISA S.A. is a wood products company headquartered in Chile with manufacturing operations across the Americas. Its products include solid wood, particleboard, MDF, OSB, interior doors, mouldings, and millwork. It is the second-largest company in its sector after Duratex.

companies.name: Mead Johnson
companies.description: Mead Johnson & Company, LLC is an American manufacturer of infant formula, known for its product Enfamil. It operates both domestically and globally. The company functions as an independent subsidiary of Reckitt.

companies.name: MedcoEnergi
companies.description: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk, or MedcoEnergi, is an Indonesian oil and gas company. It operates in trading, exploration, production of oil and gas, power, services, chemicals, and property rental.

companies.name: Melrose Industries
companies.description: Melrose Industries plc is a British aerospace manufacturing company based in Birmingham, England. It is the parent company of GKN Aerospace and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Mercialys
companies.industry: rental of land and other real estate
companies.description: Mercialys is a French real estate company that owns and manages properties. It was created by the retailer Casino Group in 2005.

companies.name: JB Hi-Fi
companies.description: JB Hi-Fi Limited is an Australian consumer electronics retail company headquartered in Southbank, Melbourne, Victoria. It is publicly listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.

companies.name: Molinos Río de la Plata
companies.description: Molinos Río de la Plata is Argentina's largest branded food products company. It exports sunflower processed oil and bottled oil and produces a wide range of packaged foods for domestic consumption.

companies.name: MASI index
companies.description: The MASI is a stock index tracking all companies listed on the Casablanca Stock Exchange in Morocco. It is one of the two main indexes at the exchange, alongside the MADEX.

companies.name: SES S.A.
companies.description: SES S.A. is a Luxembourgish communications satellite operator providing video and data connectivity worldwide. Its clients include broadcasters, content and internet service providers, network operators, governments, and institutions.

companies.name: Myriad Genetics
companies.description: Myriad Genetics, Inc. is an American genetic testing company based in Salt Lake City, Utah. Founded in 1991, it uses proprietary technologies to evaluate disease onset, progression, and treatment to guide product development.

companies.name: Nautilus, Inc.
companies.description: Nautilus, Inc., now known as BowFlex, Inc., is an American company based in Vancouver, Washington. It develops, manufactures, and markets fitness equipment brands including Bowflex, Schwinn, and JRNY. The company changed its name from Nautilus, Inc. to BowFlex, Inc. in 2023 and sells products globally through various channels.

companies.name: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings
companies.description: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings is a Japanese electric utility holding company headquartered in Tokyo. It services the Kantō region, Yamanashi Prefecture, and eastern Shizuoka Prefecture, including Tokyo. The company is a founding member of several energy innovation and research consortiums.

companies.name: New World Resources
companies.description: New World Resources Plc was a Central European producer of hard coal and coke. It operated through its subsidiary OKD, the largest hard coal mining company in the Czech Republic. The company supplied coking and thermal coal for steel and energy sectors in Central Europe.

companies.name: Nexity
companies.description: Nexity is a French real estate development company founded in 2000 in Paris by Stéphane Richard and Alain Dinin. It focuses on real estate development and related services. The company is headquartered in France.

companies.name: Nidec
companies.description: Nidec Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer and distributor of electric motors. Its products are used in hard-disk drives, electric appliances, automobiles, and manufacturing equipment. Nidec is the global market leader for spindle motors powering hard-disk drives.

companies.name: Eversource Energy
companies.description: Eversource Energy is a publicly traded energy company headquartered in Springfield, Massachusetts. It operates regulated subsidiaries providing retail electricity, natural gas, and water services to about 4 million customers in Connecticut, Massachusetts, and New Hampshire.

companies.name: Overseas Chinese Town Enterprises
companies.description: Overseas Chinese Town Enterprises Co. is a Chinese state-owned enterprise supervised by the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission. It is the parent company of several publicly traded companies and operates across multiple sectors and industries.

companies.name: OL Groupe
companies.description: OL Groupe is a French holding company established in 1999. It is primarily known for owning and managing the Olympique Lyonnais professional men's and women's football clubs and their stadium, Parc Olympique Lyonnais.

companies.name: Ingrad
companies.description: PJSC INGRAD is a Russian investment and development holding company headquartered in Moscow. It operates in the real estate development sector.

companies.name: PDG S.A.
companies.description: PDG is a Brazilian real estate development company based in Rio de Janeiro. It is the second largest real estate and homebuilder in Brazil, focusing on the residential market.

companies.name: POW! Entertainment
companies.description: POW! Entertainment Inc. is an American media production company founded in 2001 by Gill Champion, Arthur Lieberman, and Stan Lee. It consists of a holding corporation and its wholly owned subsidiary. The company is currently owned by Camsing International Holding.

companies.name: Parque Arauco S.A.
companies.description: Parque Arauco is a Chilean company managing shopping malls in Chile, Peru, and Colombia. It is headquartered in Santiago and is the third largest shopping mall company in Chile. The company operates 24 shopping malls with a total gross leasable area of 672,700 square meters.

companies.name: Blyth, Inc.
companies.description: Blyth, Inc. is a marketing and manufacturing company based in Greenwich, Connecticut. It sells personal and decorative products and was the largest candlemaker in the United States in 2001. Its subsidiaries include multi-level marketing companies PartyLite and Visalus.

companies.name: Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc
companies.description: Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc. provides land drilling, pressure pumping, directional drilling, rental equipment, and technology services. It operates in the United States and western Canada, serving clients in the petroleum industry.

companies.name: Mannatech
companies.description: Mannatech Inc. is a multinational multi-level marketing firm headquartered in Flower Mound, Texas. Founded in 1993, it sells dietary supplements and personal care products through independent sales associates worldwide.

companies.name: Pep Boys
companies.logo_file: PB Auto Service Tires Logo Stacked CMYK EST.png
companies.description: Pep Boys is an American automotive aftermarket service chain founded in Philadelphia in 1921. Headquartered in Bala Cynwyd, Pennsylvania, it provides tires, automotive maintenance, repair, and fleet services across the United States, including mobile maintenance through its service trailers.

companies.name: Phoenix Beverages
companies.description: Phoenix Beverages is the largest brewery in Mauritius, producing Phoenix Beer and other beverages. It operates three plants in Mauritius and one in Reunion Island, has connections with Guinness Brewery, and is listed on the Stock Exchange of Mauritius.

companies.name: Piper Sandler Companies
companies.description: Piper Sandler Companies is an American multinational investment bank and financial services firm. It offers services including mergers and acquisitions, financial restructuring, public offerings, and investment management, targeting corporations, institutional investors, and public entities.

companies.name: Orient Group
companies.description: Orient Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese conglomerate headquartered in Harbin, Heilongjiang. It operates in finance, trading, construction, port, industry, tourism, and property development. It was the first Heilongjiang-based A share listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 1994.

companies.name: Pizza Delight
companies.description: Pizza Delight is a Canadian pizza restaurant franchise founded in 1968 in Shediac, New Brunswick. It primarily serves pizza, pasta, and salad dishes and operates over 70 restaurants mainly in Ontario and the Atlantic provinces. Its head offices are located in Moncton.

companies.name: Metso
companies.description: Metso Corporation was a Finnish industrial machinery company specializing in technology and services for the mining and aggregates industries. It was based in Finland and focused on industrial machinery solutions.

companies.name: Halfords
companies.description: Halfords Group PLC is a UK retailer offering motoring and cycling products and services. It operates Halfords Autocentre, providing vehicle servicing, MOT, maintenance, and repairs across the United Kingdom.

companies.name: Power Assets Holdings Limited
companies.description: Power Assets Holdings Limited is a vertically integrated electric utility company based in Hong Kong. It is the majority shareholder in the Hongkong Electric Company and has reduced its holdings through share sales, most recently in June 2015.

companies.name: Principal Financial Group
companies.description: Principal Financial Group, Inc. is an American global financial investment management and insurance company headquartered in Des Moines, Iowa. It operates in the financial services sector.

companies.name: Greggs
companies.description: Greggs plc is a British bakery and fast food chain headquartered in Newcastle upon Tyne, England. It specializes in 'on-the-go' savory and sweet baked goods and has expanded into convenience and drive-through markets.

companies.name: Fastly
companies.description: Fastly, Inc. is an American cloud computing company based in San Francisco. It provides content delivery network services, image optimization, load balancing, and cloud security services including denial-of-service attack protection and web application firewall.

companies.name: RealD
companies.description: RealD 3D is a digital stereoscopic 3D projection technology made and sold by RealD. It is the most widely used technology for watching 3D films in theaters in the United States.

companies.name: Actavis
companies.description: Actavis Generics is a global pharmaceutical company headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, with administrative offices in Parsippany-Troy Hills, New Jersey. It focuses on acquiring, developing, manufacturing, and marketing branded pharmaceuticals, generics, over-the-counter medicines, and biologics.

companies.name: Ripley S.A.
companies.description: Ripley S.A. is a Chilean company headquartered in Santiago that operates department stores, financial services, and shopping mall management. It has operations in Peru and formerly operated in Colombia.

companies.name: Rite Aid
companies.description: Rite Aid Corporation was an American drugstore chain based in Philadelphia. Founded in 1962 in Scranton, Pennsylvania, it operated more than 5,000 stores at its peak. By May 2025, it operated 1,200 stores across 15 U.S. states and was the seventh-largest pharmacy in the U.S. including big box chains.

companies.name: Riyad Bank
companies.description: Riyad Bank is one of the largest financial institutions in Saudi Arabia. It is ranked fourth in assets among banks in the country.

companies.name: Romande Energie Holding
companies.description: Romande Énergie is a Swiss company involved in energy production, distribution, and marketing, as well as energy services. Its head office is located in Morges, in the canton of Vaud.

companies.name: Ross Dress for Less
companies.description: Ross Stores, Inc., operating as Ross Dress for Less, is an American discount department store chain headquartered in Dublin, California. It is the second largest off-price retailer in the U.S. and operates 1,795 stores in 43 states plus Washington, D.C., Puerto Rico, and Guam.

companies.name: Rubis
companies.description: Rubis SCA is a France-based international company specializing in storage, distribution, and sale of petroleum, LPG, food, and chemical products. It is market leader in several countries including France, Switzerland, and Jamaica. The company operates through subsidiaries such as Coparef and Rubis Terminal.

companies.name: Acushnet Company
companies.description: The Acushnet Company is an American company focused on the golf market. It operates a series of brands that manufacture golf equipment, clothing, and accessories.

companies.name: SBF 120
companies.description: The SBF 120 is a French stock market index based on the 120 most actively traded stocks listed in Paris. It includes all stocks in the CAC 40 and CAC Next 20 indexes plus 60 additional stocks listed on Euronext Paris.

companies.name: Semtech Corporation
companies.description: Semtech Corporation is an American supplier of analog and mixed-signal semiconductors and advanced algorithms for consumer, enterprise computing, communications, and industrial markets. It is based in Camarillo, Southern California, and was founded in 1960 in Newbury Park, California.

companies.name: TS Financial Holdings
companies.description: Taishin Financial is a financial services company headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan. Its holdings include subsidiaries in banking, securities, bills finance, asset management, and venture capital.

companies.name: Smartfren
companies.description: Smartfren is an Indonesian wireless network operator headquartered in Central Jakarta. Operated by XLSMART, a joint venture of Sinar Mas and Axiata, it runs 4G LTE and 5G networks after shifting from CDMA in 2014. As of 2018, it had 10.1 million active subscribers.

companies.name: Servcorp
companies.description: Servcorp Limited is an Australian multinational office services company founded in 1978. It provides serviced offices, virtual offices, and coworking spaces across multiple international markets. The company is based in Australia.

companies.name: Shionogi
companies.description: Shionogi & Company, Limited is a Japanese pharmaceutical company known for developing Crestor. It operates in the medical supply industry and uses katakana (シオノギ) as its brand name. The company is based in Japan.

companies.name: Shutterstock
companies.description: Shutterstock, Inc. is an American provider of stock photography, footage, music, and editing tools headquartered in New York. Founded in 2002, it maintains a large library of royalty-free media and expanded pricing options in 2008. The company was publicly traded and planned a merger with Getty Images that was later cancelled.

companies.name: Sibir Energy
companies.description: Sibir Energy was a British oil company focused on petroleum and natural gas exploration in Siberia, Russia. It became a wholly owned subsidiary of Gazprom Neft in 2011 and was completely liquidated as a separate company in 2016.

companies.name: Sinovac Biotech
companies.description: Sinovac Biotech Ltd. is a Chinese biopharmaceutical company based in Beijing that develops and commercializes vaccines against infectious diseases. It was listed on Nasdaq but had trading halted in 2019 due to a proxy fight. The company has faced bribery probes and disinformation campaigns related to its COVID-19 vaccine.

companies.name: SOCO International
companies.description: Pharos Energy Plc, formerly SOCO International, is a London-headquartered oil and gas exploration and production company. It changed its name in 2019 following controversy over illegal activities in Virunga. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

companies.name: Soitec
companies.description: Soitec is a French multinational corporation that manufactures substrates used in semiconductor manufacturing. The company operates in the electronic components manufacturing industry and is based in France.

companies.name: BAT Brasil
companies.description: Souza Cruz S.A., known as BAT Brasil, is a Brazilian tobacco manufacturer based in Rio de Janeiro. Founded in 1903, it became a subsidiary of British American Tobacco after transferring controlling interest in 1914.

companies.name: Sonos
companies.description: Sonos, Inc. is an American audio equipment manufacturer headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Founded in 2002 by four individuals, the company specializes in smart speakers and related audio products.

companies.name: Spirit AeroSystems
companies.description: Spirit AeroSystems Holdings, Inc. is an American manufacturer of aerostructures for commercial airplanes headquartered in Wichita, Kansas. Wholly owned by Boeing, it produces fuselage and flight deck sections for Boeing and Airbus aircraft. Its competitors include Collins Aerospace and Kawasaki Heavy Industries.

companies.name: Synovus
companies.description: Synovus Financial Corp. is a financial services firm based in Columbus, Georgia. It provides commercial and retail banking, investment, and mortgage services through branches and ATMs in several southeastern U.S. states. The company was formerly known as the Columbus Bank and Trust Company.

companies.name: Alpargatas S.A.
companies.description: Alpargatas S.A. is a Brazilian manufacturing company headquartered in São Paulo. Established in 1907, it is one of the largest companies in Brazil specializing in footwear and canvas products. The company operates in the industrial manufacturing sector.

companies.name: T. Rowe Price
companies.description: T. Rowe Price Group, Inc. is an American global investment management firm headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland. It offers mutual funds, subadvisory services, and retirement plans to individuals and institutions worldwide. The firm operates with multiple international offices and serves clients in 55 countries.

companies.name: TalkTalk Group
companies.description: TalkTalk Telecom Group Limited is a British telecommunications company headquartered in Salford. It provides broadband internet, fixed line, and pay television services to consumers in the United Kingdom. The company was founded in 2003 and became standalone in 2010.

companies.name: Telechips
companies.description: Telechips is a fabless semiconductor company based in Seoul, South Korea. Founded in 1999, it designs integrated circuits and maintains regional offices in Japan, China, the USA, Germany, and Singapore. The company operates in the electronic component industry.

companies.name: Tembec
companies.description: Tembec Industries Inc. was a Canadian paper company founded by Frank Dottori. It operated divisions in forest products, pulp, paper, paperboard, and chemicals with locations in Canada, the United States, and France. The company had approximately 3000 employees as of 2011.

companies.name: Tenet Healthcare
companies.description: Tenet Healthcare Corporation is a for-profit multinational healthcare services company based in Dallas, Texas. It operates around 65 hospitals and over 450 healthcare facilities through various brands and partnerships. The company also provides healthcare support services via Conifer Health Solutions.

companies.name: Terumo
companies.description: Terumo Corporation is a Japanese medical device company founded in 1921 as Red Line Thermometer Corporation. It was established by medical scientists led by Dr. Kitasato Shibasaburō to produce medical thermometers. The company is based in Japan.

companies.name: The Children's Place
companies.description: The Children's Place Inc. is an American retailer of children's clothing headquartered in Secaucus, New Jersey. It operates about 525 stores in the U.S., Canada, and Puerto Rico, and sells products through online outlets and franchise partners in 15 countries. Its brands include The Children's Place and Gymboree.

companies.name: Co-operators
companies.description: The Co-operators Group Limited is a Canadian insurance co-operative founded in 1945 by farmers in Saskatchewan. Owned by 46 members, it offers multi-line insurance products including auto, home, life, farm, travel, and commercial insurance, as well as investment services.

companies.name: Mindtree
companies.description: Mindtree Limited was an Indian multinational information technology services and consulting company headquartered in Bangalore. It was acquired by Larsen & Toubro in 2019 and merged with L&T Infotech in 2022 to form LTIMindtree.

companies.name: Bharat Dynamics Limited
companies.description: Bharat Dynamics Limited is an Indian manufacturer of ammunitions and missile systems founded in 1970 in Hyderabad. It collaborates with the Defence Research and Development Organisation and foreign OEMs to supply missiles and related equipment to the Indian Armed Forces. The company has three manufacturing units in India.

companies.name: Hatton National Bank
companies.description: Hatton National Bank PLC is a private bank in Sri Lanka with 255 branches and 825 ATMs. It originated in 1888 when Hatton Bank began operations in Hatton, Sri Lanka.

companies.name: Torstar
companies.description: Torstar Corporation is a Canadian mass media company primarily publishing news. It is known for publishing the Toronto Star and also publishes daily newspapers in several Canadian regions. The company owns Metroland Media Group and holds a one-third ownership of the Canadian Press.

companies.name: WWE
companies.description: World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) is an American professional wrestling promotion and the largest wrestling promotion worldwide. It has expanded into film, football, and other ventures, including licensing its intellectual property for video games and action figures. WWE is owned by TKO Group Holdings, a subsidiary of WME Group.

companies.name: The Adecco Group
companies.description: The Adecco Group is a Swiss–French human resources and temporary staffing company based in Zürich, Switzerland. It is the world's second largest provider in its sector and is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange.

companies.name: Almarai Company
companies.description: Almarai Company is a Saudi multinational dairy company listed on the Tadawul stock exchange.

companies.name: Towerstream
companies.description: Towerstream Corporation is a fixed wireless fiber alternative company headquartered in Providence, Rhode Island. It delivers high-speed internet access to businesses in 12 urban markets across the United States and launched its On-Net fixed-wireless service in 2014.

companies.name: Towers Watson
companies.description: Towers Watson & Co. was a global professional services firm providing risk management, human resource consulting, actuarial services, and investment management. It operated in 37 countries and served a majority of Fortune Global 500 and Fortune 1000 companies.

companies.name: TC Transcontinental
companies.description: Transcontinental Inc., operating as TC Transcontinental, is a Montreal-based company providing retail marketing services, commercial printing, and specialty media.

companies.name: Transurban
companies.description: Transurban is an Australian multinational company that operates and develops urban toll road networks. It manages toll roads across Australia, Canada, and the United States. The company is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.

companies.name: Wayfair
companies.description: Wayfair Inc. is an American multinational e-commerce company based in Boston, Massachusetts. It sells furniture and home goods online and offers millions of items from thousands of global suppliers. The company operates internationally including in North America, Canada, Ireland, China, and the UK.

companies.name: Globe Telecom
companies.description: Globe Telecom, Inc. is a Philippine telecommunications company headquartered in Bonifacio Global City, Taguig. It operates one of the largest mobile, fixed-line, and broadband networks in the Philippines. Globe is the most-subscribed telecommunications network in the country.

companies.name: Tüpraş
companies.description: Türkiye Petrol Rafinerileri A.Ş. (Tüpraş) is a Turkish company operating four refineries. These refineries have a combined capacity to process 30 million tons of crude oil annually. The company is active in the petroleum industry.

companies.name: Urban Outfitters
companies.description: Urban Outfitters, Inc. is a multinational lifestyle retail corporation headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. It operates in multiple countries including the US, UK, Canada, and others. The brand targets young adults with fashion apparel, accessories, and music products.

companies.name: OneSpan
companies.description: OneSpan Inc. is an information security company based in Boston, Massachusetts. It provides services such as internet fraud prevention, multi-factor authentication, and electronic signature software. The company operates in the software industry.

companies.name: Valens Semiconductor
companies.description: Valens Semiconductor is an Israeli fabless manufacturing company supplying semiconductors for automotive and audio-video industries. It developed the first chipset compliant with the MIPI A-PHY standard and invented the technology behind the HDBaseT standard. The company is a member and co-founder of related industry alliances.

companies.name: Videndum
companies.description: Videndum plc is a British manufacturer of hardware and software for the film and photography industries. Based in Bury St Edmunds, Suffolk, it was founded in 1910 and is listed on the London Stock Exchange. The company was formerly known as Vinten and Vitec.

companies.name: Vizio
companies.description: Vizio, Inc. is an American company designing televisions, soundbars, and related accessories. Founded in 2002, it is based in Irvine, California. Since 2024, Vizio has been owned by Walmart.

companies.name: Fossil
companies.description: Fossil Group, Inc. is an American fashion design and manufacturing company founded in 1984 and based in Richardson, Texas. It owns multiple brands including Fossil and Skagen Denmark, and produces licensed accessories for various well-known brands.

companies.name: Weichai Power
companies.description: Weichai Power Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company based in Weifang, Shandong. It develops and manufactures diesel engines, forklifts, and non-diesel engine automotive parts. The company operates in the automotive industry.

companies.name: Worley
companies.description: Worley Limited is an Australian engineering and professional services company. It provides consulting and project delivery expertise to the energy, chemicals, resources sectors, and complex process industries.

companies.name: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited
companies.description: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) is an Indian public sector aerospace and defence company headquartered in Bengaluru. It designs, manufactures, and overhauls combat aircraft, helicopters, UAVs, engines, avionics, and other hardware. The company is majority-owned by the Indian government.

companies.name: Wockhardt
companies.description: Wockhardt Limited is an Indian pharmaceutical and biotechnology company headquartered in Mumbai. It produces formulations, biopharmaceuticals, nutrition products, vaccines, and active pharmaceutical ingredients. The company has manufacturing plants and subsidiaries in multiple countries including India, the UK, Ireland, France, and the US.

companies.name: S&P/BVL Peru General Index
companies.description: The S&P/BVL Peru General Index is the main index of the Lima Stock Exchange. It serves as a broad benchmark for the Peruvian stock market by tracking the largest and most frequently traded stocks on the exchange.

companies.name: Acea
companies.description: Acea Spa is an Italian multiutility company managing networks and services in water, energy, and environmental sectors. It is the main national operator in the water sector, serving about 10 million people, primarily in regions including Lazio, Liguria, Tuscany, and others, as well as some Latin American countries.

companies.name: Acotel Group
companies.description: The Acotel Group S.p.A. is a global telecommunications company headquartered in Formello, Italy. Founded in 2000, it leads a group operating in ICT, focusing on mobile telecommunications, value-added services, mobile messaging, media solutions, advertising, and security systems for large companies.

companies.name: Coast Entertainment
companies.description: Coast Entertainment Holdings Limited is an Australian leisure company operating Dreamworld, the largest theme park in Australia, WhiteWater World water park, and the SkyPoint Observation Deck on the Gold Coast, Queensland.

companies.name: Bharat Electronics
companies.description: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) is an Indian public sector aerospace and defence electronics company headquartered in Bengaluru. It manufactures advanced electronic products for ground and aerospace applications and is administered by the Ministry of Defence of India with Navratna status.

companies.name: Azimut Holding
companies.description: Azimut Holding is an independent global group operating in asset management, wealth management, investment banking, and fintech. It serves both private and corporate clients.

companies.name: IDBI Bank
companies.description: IDBI Bank Limited is an Indian Scheduled Commercial Bank owned by Life Insurance Corporation of India and the Government of India. Established in 1964 as a development finance institution and subsidiary of the Reserve Bank of India, it provides financial services primarily to the industrial sector.

companies.name: CEAT
companies.description: CEAT Limited is an Indian multinational tyre manufacturing company owned by the RPG Group. Founded in 1924 in Turin, Italy, and acquired by RPG Group in 1982, CEAT produces tyres for various vehicles and operates multiple manufacturing plants across India.

companies.name: Ceva, Inc.
companies.description: Ceva, Inc. is a publicly traded semiconductor and software intellectual property company headquartered in Rockville, Maryland. It develops and licenses signal processing platforms and AI processors for smart edge applications, including wireless connectivity and AI technologies for diverse markets.

companies.name: Razer Inc.
companies.description: Razer Inc. is a Singaporean-American multinational technology company that manufactures and markets gaming-focused computer hardware, consumer electronics, and financial services. It operates in the video game industry.

companies.name: Xinyi Glass
companies.description: Xinyi Glass Holdings Limited is a public company based in Hong Kong, China, producing float glass, automobile glass, and construction glass. Established in 1988, it serves major automobile corporations and has been listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 2005.

companies.name: Mediaset
companies.description: Mediaset S.p.A. is an Italian mass media and television production and distribution company. It is the largest commercial broadcaster in Italy and is controlled by MFE – MediaForEurope, majority-owned by the Berlusconi family's Fininvest Group.

companies.name: Vornado Realty Trust
companies.description: Vornado Realty Trust is an American real estate investment trust formed in Maryland in 1982, with its primary office in New York City. The company invests in office buildings and street retail properties in Manhattan.

companies.name: Credito Emiliano
companies.description: Credito Emiliano S.p.A. (Credem) is an Italian bank based in Reggio Emilia, Emilia-Romagna. Founded in 1910, its shares have been listed on Borsa Italiana since 1997, and it is part of the FTSE Italia Mid Cap index.

companies.name: Lemonade
companies.description: Lemonade, Inc. is an American insurance company based in New York City. It offers various insurance products in the US and Europe, utilizing artificial intelligence and chatbots to sell policies and handle claims.

companies.name: S IMMO
companies.description: S IMMO AG is a real estate investment company investing in properties across Austria, Germany, and Central and Eastern Europe. As of the end of 2023, it held property assets totaling just under EUR 3.5 billion.

companies.name: ETF Securities
companies.description: ETF Securities is an asset management firm that issues exchange-traded funds (ETFs) primarily in Australia. The company is based in the United Kingdom. It specializes in investment management focused on ETFs.

companies.name: ST Engineering
companies.description: ST Engineering, or Singapore Technologies Engineering, is a Singapore-based multinational technology, defence, and engineering group. It has a diverse portfolio across aerospace, smart city, defence, and public security segments. The company is headquartered in Singapore.

companies.name: Dentsu International
companies.description: Dentsu International is a multinational media and digital marketing communications company headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Japanese advertising and public relations firm Dentsu. The company offers services including communications strategy, media planning, sports marketing, and content creation.

companies.name: Credit Suisse
companies.description: Credit Suisse Group AG was a Swiss investment bank and financial services firm headquartered in Zürich, Switzerland. It provided services in investment banking, private banking, asset management, and shared services. The bank was known for strict client confidentiality and was considered globally systemically important.

companies.name: Nissan Shatai
companies.description: Nissan Shatai Co., Ltd. is a Japanese automobile contract manufacturer for Nissan, headquartered in Hiratsuka, Kanagawa. The company began its direct history in 1949. As of 2016, Nissan owned 45.8% of its stock.

companies.name: Virgin Galactic
companies.description: Virgin Galactic Holdings, Inc. is a British-American spaceflight company founded by Richard Branson and the Virgin Group conglomerate. Virgin Group retains an 11.9% stake through Virgin Investments Limited. The company operates in the space tourism industry.

companies.name: Baotou Steel
companies.description: Baotou Iron and Steel Group, also known as Baotou Steel or Baogang Group, is a state-owned iron and steel enterprise based in Baotou, Inner Mongolia, China. Established in 1954 and reorganized in 1998, it is the largest steel enterprise in Inner Mongolia and has the largest rare earth research and production base in China.

companies.name: Black Box Corporation
companies.description: Black Box Corporation is an IT company headquartered in Texas, United States. It provides technology assistance and consulting services across sectors including retail, transportation, government, education, and public safety. The company operates in 75 locations across 35 countries.

companies.name: Funai
companies.description: Funai Electric Co., Ltd. was a Japanese consumer electronics company headquartered in Daitō, Osaka. It produced its own branded electronic products and acted as an OEM for major corporations like Sharp and Toshiba. The company supplied printer hardware technology to Dell and Lexmark and produced printers under the Kodak name.

companies.name: Centerra Gold
companies.description: Centerra Gold Inc. is a Canadian mining company headquartered in Toronto. It owns and operates mines including the Mount Milligan copper-gold mine in British Columbia and the Öksüt gold mine in Turkey. The company also owns inactive molybdenum mines through its subsidiary Thompson Creek Metals.

companies.name: Mphasis
companies.description: Mphasis Limited is an Indian multinational IT service and consulting company based in Bengaluru. It offers infrastructure technology, application outsourcing, development, integration, and management services. Notably, Hewlett Packard Enterprise sold its majority stake in Mphasis to Blackstone Group in 2016.

companies.name: Astarta Holding
companies.description: ASTARTA Holding is a vertically integrated agro-industrial company based in Ukraine. It produces food products with a focus on global markets. The company is publicly traded as a European company.

companies.name: Imagineer
companies.description: Imagineer Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company involved in the content industry. It provides content and services related to characters, games, and education. The company operates in Japan.

companies.name: Hera
companies.description: Hera S.p.A., known as Hera Group, is a multiutility company based in Bologna, Italy. It operates in gas, water, energy distribution, and waste disposal across multiple Italian provinces. Hera serves a wide geographic area including Bologna and Trieste.

companies.name: Modern Times Group
companies.description: Modern Times Group (MTG) is a digital entertainment company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. It originated from Kinnevik's media holdings and manages a portfolio including gaming companies and a digital network. MTG is an investment holding company.

companies.name: Advanced Info Service
companies.description: Advanced Info Service Co., Ltd. (AIS) is Thailand's largest GSM mobile phone operator. Founded in 1986, it started as a computer rental business and launched mobile services in 1990 with a 20-year monopoly concession. AIS was the first to operate on the GSM-900 frequency in Thailand.

companies.name: Electric Power Development Company
companies.description: The Electric Power Development Co., Ltd., known as J-POWER, is a Japanese electric utility company. It produces electricity mainly from coal and hydroelectric sources and operates wind farms. J-POWER is the sole operator of transmission lines connecting Japan's four main islands.

companies.name: Yanbu National Petrochemical Company
companies.description: Yanbu National Petrochemical Company (Yansab) is a Saudi Arabian petrochemical complex affiliated with SABIC. It is the largest SABIC petrochemical complex with an annual capacity exceeding 4 million metric tons of various petrochemical products.

companies.name: Wuling Motors
companies.description: Wuling Motor Holdings, Ltd. is a Chinese automobile manufacturer and subsidiary of Guangxi Automotive Group. It produces engines, mini electric cars, people movers, trucks, buses, and auto parts. The Wuling brand is shared with the SAIC-GM-Wuling joint venture.

companies.name: OMX Copenhagen 25
companies.description: The OMX Copenhagen 25 is the top-tier stock market index for Nasdaq Copenhagen, part of Nasdaq Nordic. It is a market value weighted index consisting of the 25 most-traded stock classes. It replaced the OMX Copenhagen 20 index.

companies.name: Obayashi Corporation
companies.description: Obayashi Corporation is a major Japanese construction company headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and is part of the Nikkei 225 index. In 2018, it was ranked 15th on ENR's list of Top 250 Global Contractors, the highest among Japanese contractors.

companies.name: Oji Holdings
companies.description: Oji Holdings Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of paper products and was the third-largest company in the global forest, paper, and packaging industry in 2012. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the Nikkei 225 stock index.

companies.name: Mediacom
companies.description: Mediacom Communications Corporation is the fifth-largest cable television provider in the United States by video subscribers. Founded in 1995 and headquartered in New York, it focuses on serving smaller cities and towns, with a significant customer base in the Midwest and Southeast.

companies.name: Avid Technology
companies.description: Avid Technology, Inc. is a global technology company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts. Founded in 1987, it develops software, SaaS, and hardware products mainly used in the media and entertainment industry.

companies.name: Mulberry
companies.description: Mulberry Group PLC is a British fashion company founded in 1971. It is best known for its luxury leather goods, particularly women's handbags.

companies.name: Agnico Eagle Mines
companies.description: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited is a Canadian gold producer with operations in Canada, Finland, Australia, and Mexico, and exploration activities in the United States. The company has paid a cash dividend every year since 1983 and maintains a policy of no-forward gold sales.

companies.name: Moltiply Group
companies.description: Moltiply Group S.p.A., formerly Gruppo MutuiOnline S.p.A. until 2024, is an Italian holding company based in Milan. It operates price comparison and online brokerage services for financial, insurance, utility, and e-commerce products in six countries and provides outsourcing and technology services to Italian banks and insurers.

companies.name: Natuzzi
companies.description: Natuzzi S.p.A. is an Italian furniture company founded in 1959 by Pasquale Natuzzi. Headquartered in Santeramo in Colle, Apulia, it designs sofas, armchairs, living room accessories, and bedroom furniture.

companies.name: Netezza
companies.description: IBM Netezza is a subsidiary of IBM that designs and markets high-performance data warehouse appliances and advanced analytics applications. Its products support enterprise uses including data warehousing, business intelligence, predictive analytics, and business continuity planning.

companies.name: Centrus Energy
companies.description: Centrus Energy Corp. is an American company supplying nuclear fuel for nuclear power plants. It also develops centrifuge technology to produce enriched uranium for commercial, government, and national security uses.

companies.name: Bloober Team
companies.description: Bloober Team S.A. is a Polish video game developer based in Kraków, founded in 2008. It is known for creating horror games like Layers of Fear and The Medium. The company owns the third-party publisher Feardemic and has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 2024.

companies.name: China CITIC Bank
companies.description: China CITIC Bank is a major commercial bank in China operating under the CITIC Group. It provides banking services within the Chinese financial sector.

companies.name: Houghton Mifflin Harcourt
companies.description: Houghton Mifflin Harcourt Company is an American publisher based in Boston, specializing in textbooks, instructional technology, and reference works. It was renamed after acquiring Harcourt Publishing in 2007 and was acquired by Veritas Capital in 2022.

companies.name: Petra Diamonds
companies.description: Petra Diamonds Ltd is a diamond mining group headquartered in Jersey. It owns the historically productive Cullinan Diamond Mine, known for producing the world's largest rough and polished diamonds. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Antero Resources
companies.description: Antero Resources Corporation is an American hydrocarbon exploration company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It operates exclusively in the Appalachian Basin using hydraulic fracturing to extract reserves. The company is organized in Delaware.

companies.name: Nayax
companies.description: Nayax Ltd. is an Israeli fintech company providing cashless payment, telemetry, management, monitoring, and business intelligence products for vending and unattended retail industries.

companies.name: Navan, Inc.
companies.description: Navan, Inc. is an American corporate travel and expense management company headquartered in Palo Alto, California. Founded in 2015, it offers an integrated platform combining travel booking, corporate payment cards, expense reporting, and analytics worldwide.

companies.name: Platinum Studios
companies.description: Platinum Studios, Inc. is an American media company that develops, publishes, and licenses comic book properties for adaptation into film, television, and other media.

companies.name: Bank of Beijing
companies.description: Bank of Beijing Co., Ltd. is an urban commercial bank based in Beijing, China. Most revenue comes from Beijing, though over half of its branches are outside the municipality. Major shareholders include the Beijing Municipal Government and ING Bank.

companies.name: Ezaki Glico
companies.description: Ezaki Glico Co., Ltd., known as Glico, is a Japanese multinational food processing company headquartered in Osaka. It operates in 30 countries across North America, Asia-Pacific, and Europe.

companies.name: Eslite Bookstore
companies.description: Eslite Bookstore is one of the largest retail bookstore chains in Taiwan. It offers one of the largest selections of English-language publications and translation materials in Taiwan. The company operates primarily in the retail sector.

companies.name: Brown-Forman
companies.description: Brown-Forman Corporation is an American family-controlled publicly traded company based in Louisville, Kentucky. It is one of the largest companies in the spirits and wine business and manufactures several well-known brands worldwide, including Jack Daniel's and Old Forester.

companies.name: HeySong Corporation
companies.description: HeySong Corporation is a well-known beverage producer in Taiwan. Founded in 1925 as a family business, it has grown into a large corporation operating in the agriculture and food industry.

companies.name: Aerojet Rocketdyne Holdings
companies.description: Aerojet Rocketdyne was a company that manufactured rocket, hypersonic, and electric propulsive systems for space, defense, civil, and commercial applications. It was formed in 2013 by merging Aerojet and Pratt & Whitney Rocketdyne and was acquired by L3Harris in 2023.

companies.name: Indofood
companies.description: Indofood is an Indonesian producer of various foods and drinks headquartered in Jakarta. Established in 1990, it exports food ingredients to Australia, Asia, and Europe. The company operates in the food industry.

companies.name: Agora SA
companies.description: Agora Spółka Akcyjna is a Polish media company known for creating Gazeta Wyborcza, the first independent newspaper in Poland. Founded around 1989, Agora has grown into one of the largest media companies in Poland and is listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Vedanta Limited
companies.description: Vedanta Limited is an Indian multinational mining and metals company headquartered in Mumbai. Its main operations include zinc, silver, cobalt, nickel, and gold mining. The company operates in the mining industry.

companies.name: Agrium
companies.description: Agrium Inc. was a major retail supplier of agricultural products and services across North America, South America, and Australia. It was also a wholesale producer and marketer of major agricultural nutrients and specialty fertilizers in North America.

companies.name: Stericycle
companies.description: Stericycle, Inc. is an American compliance company specializing in collecting and disposing of regulated medical waste, including sharps, pharmaceuticals, and pathological waste. Founded in 1989, it is headquartered in Bannockburn, Illinois, with operations in North America and Europe.

companies.name: Tohokushinsha Film
companies.description: Tohokushinsha Film Corporation is a Japanese film distributor, production company, and dubbing studio based in Akasaka, Minato, Tokyo. Founded in 1961 by Banjirō Uemura as a dubbing house for foreign films, the Uemura family remains its largest shareholders.

companies.name: Tower International
companies.description: Tower International is a U.S.-based manufacturer of automotive structural metal components and assemblies. It primarily serves original equipment manufacturers by supplying body-structure stampings, frame and chassis structures, and complex welded assemblies for various types of vehicles.

companies.name: Tronox
companies.description: Tronox Limited is an American chemical company involved in the titanium products industry. It operates worldwide, mining titanium-bearing mineral sands and producing titanium dioxide pigment, pig iron, and other minerals, including rare earth-bearing monazite.

companies.name: Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional
companies.description: Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional (CSN) is the largest fully integrated steel producer in Brazil and one of the largest in Latin America. Its main plant is located in Volta Redonda, Rio de Janeiro, and it is a major player in crude steel production.

companies.name: Unieuro
companies.description: Unieuro S.p.A. is the largest Italian retailer of consumer electronics and household appliances by number of outlets. It operates a network of 460 stores throughout Italy.

companies.name: Vittoria Assicurazioni
companies.logo_file: Fire mark for La Vittoria Compania Anonima di Assicurazioni Generali in Milan, Italy.jpg
companies.description: Vittoria Assicurazioni is an Italian company active in the insurance sector.

companies.name: Wilhelmina Models
companies.description: Wilhelmina International Inc., formerly Wilhelmina Models, is a modeling and talent agency headquartered in New York City with offices in Los Angeles, Miami, and London. Founded in 1967, it represents models, entertainers, artists, musicians, and athletes and became the first publicly traded modeling agency in 2009.

companies.name: YAGEO
companies.description: YAGEO Corporation is a Taiwanese electronic component manufacturer founded in 1977 by Pierre Chen. The company specializes in passive devices such as resistors, capacitors, and inductors and was the third largest passive component manufacturer globally as of January 2020.

companies.name: Orbcomm
companies.description: ORBCOMM Inc. is an American company offering industrial IoT products to track, monitor, and control fixed and mobile assets across various markets. It provides hardware, modems, web applications, and data services via satellites and cellular networks.

companies.name: Bank Handlowy
companies.description: Bank Handlowy w Warszawie S.A., rebranded as Citibank Handlowy and later Citi Handlowy, is a Polish bank based in Warsaw. It is one of Poland's oldest banks and ranks 10th by assets and 18th by number of outlets.

companies.name: Bossini
companies.description: Bossini International Holdings Limited is an apparel brand owner, retailer, and franchiser headquartered in Hong Kong. It operates mainly in Hong Kong, mainland China, Taiwan, Thailand, and Singapore. The company focuses on the fashion industry in these Asian markets.

companies.name: CRI Middleware
companies.description: CRI Middleware Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company that develops middleware for the video game industry. Originally a video game developer from the early 1990s, it shifted its focus to middleware development in 2001. The company supports game development through its software products.

companies.name: Coterra Energy
companies.description: Coterra Energy Inc. was an American hydrocarbon exploration company with operations in the Permian Basin, Marcellus Shale, and Anadarko Basin. In May 2026, it merged with Devon Energy and the Coterra name was retired. It was ranked 496th in the Fortune 500 before the merger.

companies.name: Changhong
companies.description: Sichuan Changhong Electric Co., Ltd., known as Changhong domestically and CHiQ internationally, is a Chinese consumer electronics company based in Mianyang, Sichuan. Founded in 1958, it was the second-largest television manufacturer in China as of 2010 and exported 90% of TVs from China to the US in 2004.

companies.name: China Everbright Limited
companies.description: China Everbright Limited is a Hong Kong-based financial services company involved in asset management, investment, and merchant banking in Greater China. It is part of the China Everbright Group, a state-owned enterprise supervised by the State Council of China.

companies.name: China Properties Group
companies.description: China Properties Group Limited is a private property developer based in the Cayman Islands. It focuses on large-scale residential and commercial projects in major Chinese cities such as Shanghai, Beijing, and Kunshan. The company's chairman is Wang Shizhong.

companies.name: Chloride Group
companies.description: Chloride Group is a UK-based global company specializing in the design, production, and maintenance of industrial uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems. It ensures reliable power for critical equipment across industries. The company was formerly listed on the London Stock Exchange and became privately owned in 2021.

companies.name: Daifuku
companies.description: Daifuku Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company founded in 1937 that manufactures material-handling equipment. It is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. The company operates in the machinery and equipment manufacturing sector.

companies.name: En+ Group
companies.description: En+ Group plc is a green energy and metals company based in Jersey. It holds a controlling stake in Rusal, one of the world's largest aluminum producers outside China. The company was founded by Oleg Deripaska.

companies.name: Fix Price
companies.description: Fix Price is a Russian discount variety store chain operating in multiple countries including Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, and others. By October 2023, it operated 6,141 stores. The company focuses on retail in the discount variety segment.

companies.name: Harvey Norman
companies.description: Harvey Norman is an Australian multinational retailer specializing in furniture, bedding, computers, home appliances, and consumer electronics. It operates mainly as a franchise, with the brand and company-operated stores owned by ASX-listed Harvey Norman Holdings Limited. The company is based in Australia.

companies.name: Impinj
companies.description: Impinj, Inc. is an American manufacturer of radio-frequency identification (RFID) devices and software headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Founded in 2000, it produces EPC Class 1, Gen 2 passive UHF RFID chips, readers, antennas, and software applications for encoding and business intelligence. The company originated from research at Caltech.

companies.name: Kaga Create
companies.description: Kaga Create Co., Ltd., formerly known as Naxat Soft, was a Japan-based video game developing and publishing division of Kaga Electronics. The company operated in the video game industry and was based in Japan.

companies.name: Kerry Properties
companies.description: Kerry Properties Limited is a listed company engaged in property development in Hong Kong, Mainland China, and the Asia Pacific region. It also undertakes infrastructure projects and hotel ownership and operations in mainland China. The company is headquartered in Quarry Bay, Hong Kong.

companies.name: Kingboard Holdings
companies.description: Kingboard Holdings Limited, formerly Kingboard Chemical Holdings Limited, is a manufacturer of laminates and other chemical products. Headquartered in Shatin, New Territories, Hong Kong, it operates over 60 manufacturing facilities in China and Thailand and invests surplus funds in real estate globally.

companies.name: Manitowoc Cranes
companies.description: Manitowoc Cranes is a division of The Manitowoc Company, Inc. It produces five brands of cranes including Grove and National Crane. The company also operates two distribution businesses based in the U.S.: Aspen Equipment and MGX Equipment Services.

companies.name: National Western Life
companies.description: National Western Life Insurance Company is an American stock life insurance company headquartered in Austin, Texas. It operates in the insurance industry providing life insurance products.

companies.name: PEGATRON
companies.description: Pegatron Corporation is a Taiwanese electronics manufacturer specializing in computing, communications, and consumer electronics for major brands. Its products include laptops, desktops, game consoles, motherboards, and broadband communication devices. The company is based in Taiwan.

companies.name: Pioneer Natural Resources
companies.description: Pioneer Natural Resources Company was engaged in hydrocarbon exploration and headquartered in Irving, Texas. It operated in the Cline Shale of the Permian Basin and was the largest acreage holder there. In May 2024, it was acquired by ExxonMobil.

companies.name: Polestar
companies.description: Polestar Automotive Holding UK PLC is a Swedish automotive manufacturer specializing in electric cars. Headquartered in Torslanda, Sweden, it is principally owned by PSD Investment, Geely Holding, and Volvo Cars. Polestar uses an asset-light approach, producing vehicles in facilities controlled by Volvo or Geely across several countries.

companies.name: Ponsse Corporation
companies.description: Ponsse Plc is a Finnish company that manufactures and markets forestry vehicles and machinery such as forwarders and harvesters. Founded in 1970, all its machines are produced in Vieremä, Finland, and are used in about 40 countries. The company employs over 2,000 people across 12 countries.

companies.name: Proofpoint, Inc.
companies.description: Proofpoint, Inc. is an American enterprise cybersecurity company based in Sunnyvale, California. It provides software as a service and products focused on email security, identity threat defense, data loss prevention, electronic discovery, and email archiving.

companies.name: Qiwi
companies.description: QIWI plc was a Russian company offering payment and financial services in Russia and CIS countries. Its group included the QIWI payment system, QIWI Bank, CONTACT money transfer system, and other services. The company maintained representative offices in three countries.

companies.name: Range Resources
companies.description: Range Resources Corporation is a natural gas exploration and production company headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas. It operates in the Marcellus Formation, where it is the largest landowner.

companies.name: Sonic Focus
companies.description: Sonic Focus Inc was a software development company based in South Lake Tahoe, California, founded in 1995. It developed audio post-processing technologies to enhance sound quality in various electronic products, including mobile phones, car audio, PCs, and home theatre systems.

companies.name: Spirax Group plc
companies.description: Spirax Group plc is a British manufacturer of steam management systems, peristaltic pumps, and related fluid path technologies. Headquartered in Cheltenham, England, it is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Sumitomo Forestry
companies.description: Sumitomo Forestry is a Japanese company engaged in logging, processing, and constructing houses made of wooden materials. It is part of the Sumitomo Group keiretsu.

companies.name: Sumitomo Realty & Development
companies.description: Sumitomo Realty & Development Co., Ltd. is a Japanese real estate development company headquartered in Shinjuku, Tokyo. It is a member of the Sumitomo Group.

companies.name: The Farm 51
companies.description: The Farm 51 is a Polish video game developer founded in 2005. It is known for creating games such as Get Even and Chernobylite.

companies.name: Abrau-Durso
companies.description: Abrau-Durso is a Russian wine company located in the village of Abrau-Dyurso near Lake Abrau, the Dyurso River, and the Black Sea Coast. It is situated about 15 kilometers west of the Black Sea port of Novorossiysk.

companies.name: Imperial Oil
companies.description: Imperial Oil Limited is a Canadian petroleum company and the country's second-largest integrated oil company. It is majority-owned by ExxonMobil and produces crude oil, diluted bitumen, and natural gas. The company also supplies Esso-brand service stations.

companies.name: AirAsia X
companies.description: AirAsia X Berhad is a Malaysian long-haul, low-cost airline and a subsidiary of the AirAsia Group. Established in 2006, it was initially known as FlyAsianXpress and rebranded as AirAsia X in 2007. The airline operates international flights, including its first route from Kuala Lumpur to Gold Coast, Australia.

companies.name: AirAsia
companies.description: AirAsia Group Berhad is a Malaysian multinational low-cost airline headquartered near Kuala Lumpur.
