Founded in 1993 and operational since 1996, it is the largest airline in Malaysia by fleet size and destinations, serving over 166 destinations in 25 countries from its primary hub at Kuala Lumpur International Airport.

companies.name: Air Products & Chemicals
companies.description: Air Products and Chemicals, Inc. is a U.S.-based international corporation that sells gases and chemicals for industrial use. The company is headquartered in Trexlertown, Pennsylvania, in the Lehigh Valley region of eastern Pennsylvania.

companies.name: Sify
companies.description: Sify Technologies Limited is an Indian ICT company providing telecom, data center, cloud, managed, transformation integration, and application integration services. It was an early provider of Internet and e-commerce services in India and has been listed on NASDAQ since October 1999.

companies.name: Caleres
companies.description: Caleres Inc. is an American footwear company owning and operating various footwear brands. Its headquarters is in Clayton, Missouri, near St. Louis. The company was founded in 1878 as Bryan, Brown & Company and has undergone several name changes.

companies.name: Giordano
companies.description: Giordano International Limited is an international retailer of men's, women's, and children's apparel and accessories. The company was founded in Hong Kong in 1981.

companies.name: Bank Islam Malaysia
companies.description: Bank Islam Malaysia Berhad is an Islamic bank based in Malaysia, established in July 1983. It was created primarily to serve the financial needs of the Muslim population and later extended services to the broader population.

companies.name: Saman Bank
companies.description: Saman Bank is a privately owned Iranian bank that is listed on the Tehran Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Zona Franca of Iquique
companies.description: The Zona Franca de Iquique is a free-trade zone located in the coastal port city of Iquique, in the Tarapacá Region of northwestern Chile. It serves as a special economic area facilitating trade and logistics in the region.

companies.name: Ajinomoto
companies.description: Ajinomoto Co., Inc. is a Japanese multinational corporation producing seasonings, cooking oils, frozen foods, beverages, sweeteners, amino acids, insulating films, and pharmaceuticals. Its original product, Aji-No-Moto monosodium glutamate, was first introduced in 1909. The company is headquartered in Chūō, Tokyo.

companies.name: AmBank
companies.description: AmBank Group, comprising AMMB Holdings Berhad, is one of Malaysia's largest banking groups. Its core businesses include retail banking, wholesale banking, Islamic banking, and life and general insurance.

companies.name: IANSA
companies.description: IANSA is a Chilean company engaged in sugar growing, refining, and manufacturing sweeteners and sugar products. It also produces fruit juices, tomato paste, and pet and animal food.

companies.name: HMS Group
companies.description: The HMS Group is a diversified machine-building and engineering holding company based in Russia. It manufactures pumps, compressors, and oil and gas equipment with production and engineering assets located domestically and abroad.

companies.name: Chelyabinsk Pipe Rolling Plant Group
companies.description: Chelyabinsk Tube Rolling Plant manufactures various types of steel pipes used in petroleum, natural gas, water pipelines, and manufacturing processes. The company is based in Russia.

companies.name: Thunder Power
companies.description: Thunder Power is a Taiwanese automobile manufacturer specializing in electric vehicles. It focuses on electromobility solutions.

companies.name: Artisan Partners
companies.description: Artisan Partners is an American asset management company headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. It operates offices internationally in Dublin, Hong Kong, London, Singapore, and Sydney.

companies.name: DEN Networks
companies.description: DEN Networks Limited is an Indian cable television and broadband service provider. It was acquired by Reliance Industries in 2018 and was one of the three major cable distributors in India in 2003.

companies.name: Al Bilad Bank
companies.description: Bank Albilad is an Islamic bank established in Saudi Arabia in 2004. It provides financial services compliant with Islamic banking principles.

companies.name: Saudi Awwal Bank
companies.description: Saudi Awwal Bank (SAB) is a Riyadh-based Saudi joint stock company with HSBC owning a minority stake. It originated from the British Bank of the Middle East acquired by HSBC in 1959. The bank was created in 1978 as Saudi Arab British Bank to manage HSBC branches and assets in Saudi Arabia due to foreign ownership restrictions.

companies.name: Cathay Bank
companies.description: Cathay Bank is a Chinese American bank founded in 1962 in the United States. It serves the financial sector primarily focusing on banking services for the Chinese American community.

companies.name: Takamatsu Construction Group
companies.description: Takamatsu Construction Group Co., Ltd. is a conglomerate of construction and civil engineering companies headquartered in Osaka, Japan. Its subsidiaries specialize in architecture for high-rise buildings, health and welfare facilities, shrines, temples, and public civil engineering projects like airports and railways.

companies.name: Fubon Financial Holding Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Fubon Financial Holding Co., Ltd. is a financial investment holding company based in Taiwan. It includes key subsidiaries such as Fubon Asset Management, Fubon Insurance, Fubon Securities, and several banks including Fubon Bank and Fubon Life. The holding company was established on December 19, 2001.

companies.name: Haw Par Corporation
companies.description: Haw Par Corporation Limited is a Singaporean company involved in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, leisure products, property, and investment. It is known for producing Tiger Balm liniment and owns brands like Kwan Loong. The company also operates leisure destinations such as oceanariums.

companies.name: Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank
companies.description: The Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank is a bank headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan. It operates in the banking sector providing financial services.

companies.name: RHB Bank
companies.description: RHB Bank Berhad is a Malaysian bank based in Kuala Lumpur, founded in 1997. It is the fourth largest fully integrated financial services group in Malaysia. The name RHB represents the initials of its founder, Rashid Hussain Berhad.

companies.name: Kazanorgsintez
companies.description: PJSC Kazanorgsintez is one of Russia's largest chemical companies and the country's largest polyethylene producer. It is based in Kazan, Tatarstan, and operates in the chemical industry.

companies.name: Bank of Shanghai
companies.description: Bank of Shanghai Co., Ltd. (BOSC) is an urban commercial bank based in Shanghai, China. It was ranked 73rd among 1000 banks worldwide by The Banker in terms of Tier 1 capital in 2020.

companies.name: Yakovlev Corporation
companies.description: The JSC Yakovlev Corporation is a Russian aircraft manufacturer headquartered in Moscow. Founded in 1932 as the Irkutsk Aviation Plant, it manufactures the Sukhoi Su-30 family of interceptor and ground-attack aircraft. It was formerly known as Irkut Corporation.

companies.name: Kuzbassenergo
companies.description: Kuzbassenergo OAO is a Russian joint-stock company specializing in energy distribution. It is headquartered in Barnaul, Altai Krai, Russia. The company is controlled by Siberian Energy Investments Ltd., which is linked to Andrey Melnichenko's Donalink Ltd.

companies.name: LSR Group
companies.description: LSR Group is a Russian company engaged in real estate development, construction, and building materials. Its headquarters are in Saint Petersburg. The company has numerous subsidiaries and is a leader in its sector within Russia.

companies.name: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank
companies.description: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Limited is a banking institution based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. It evolved from Ujjivan Financial Services, a microfinance company started in 2005, and became a small finance bank in 2017. In 2024, it merged with its predecessor under a reverse-merger scheme.

companies.name: Changjiang Securities
companies.description: Changjiang Securities Company Limited is a securities firm headquartered in Wuhan, Hubei, China. It offers a wide range of securities services including sales, underwriting, and investment consulting. The company operates numerous branches and departments nationwide.

companies.name: CITIC Guoan
companies.description: CITIC Guoan Information Industry Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company in computer network infrastructure and information services. Founded in 1997 by CITIC Guoan Group, it operates cable and satellite networks and provides software development and telecom services. It is publicly traded on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Luzhou Laojiao
companies.description: Luzhou Laojiao Co. Ltd. is a Chinese company based in Luzhou, Sichuan, specializing in the production and distribution of baijiu. It is known for the Nongxiang style of baijiu, originally named after the distillery. It ranks as the fourth most valuable spirits brand globally.

companies.name: Media Nusantara Citra
companies.description: PT Media Nusantara Citra Tbk, known as MNC Media, is an Indonesian media company. It operates four free-to-air TV networks and 19 pay TV channels, along with radio, print media, talent management, and production services. The company functions as an integrated media group.

companies.name: Sanmina Corporation
companies.description: Sanmina Corporation is an American electronics manufacturing services provider headquartered in San Jose, California. It serves OEMs in communications and computer hardware and operates nearly 80 manufacturing sites. It is among the largest independent manufacturers of printed circuit boards and backplanes.

companies.name: Wharf Real Estate Investment Company Limited
companies.description: Wharf Real Estate Investment Company Limited is a listed real estate portfolio company in China. It is a subsidiary of the private company Wheelock & Co. and a sister company to The Wharf (Holdings), another listed entity.

companies.name: Pitney Bowes
companies.description: Pitney Bowes Inc. is an American technology company known for postage meters and mailing equipment. Founded in 1920 by Arthur Pitney and Walter Bowes, it developed the first commercially available postage meter. The company offers various mailing technologies and services.

companies.name: Zhejiang Wanma
companies.description: Zhejiang Wanma Co., Ltd. is a Chinese manufacturer specializing in electricity transmission lines and distribution networks. Founded in 2009 as a listed company, it also formed a joint venture in 2017 for rental of electricity-powered logistics vehicles. The company is based in China and was part of the SZSE 100 and later SZSE 200 Index.

companies.name: Credit Bank of Moscow
companies.description: Credit Bank of Moscow is a Russian bank established in 1992. It operates primarily in Moscow and the surrounding Moscow Oblast region. The bank provides financial services within Russia.

companies.name: Mostotrest
companies.description: Mostotrest is the largest heavy construction company in Russia. It focuses on building roads, railways, bridges, highways, and other engineering structures. The company operates within the construction industry in Russia.

companies.name: Volaris
companies.description: Volaris is a Mexican ultra low-cost airline headquartered in Mexico City. It operates bases in multiple cities including Cancún and Guadalajara, serving domestic and international destinations across the Americas. Volaris is Mexico's largest airline by passenger numbers.

companies.name: Neftekamsk Automotive Plant
companies.description: Neftekamsk Automotive Plant is a Russian manufacturer of buses and machinery built on KamAZ chassis. The company is located in Neftekamsk, Bashkortostan, and specializes in bus production.

companies.name: Novosibirskenergo
companies.description: OJSC Novosibirskenergo was an electric power company based in Novosibirsk Oblast, Russia. It was involved in power generation, transfer, and distribution services.

companies.name: Twist Bioscience
companies.description: Twist Bioscience is a biotechnology company based in South San Francisco, USA. Founded in 2013, it manufactures synthetic DNA and DNA products for various industries. The company is publicly traded and focuses on synthetic biology.

companies.name: Altairnano
companies.description: Altair Nanotechnologies is an American company specializing in energy storage systems. It develops and manufactures advanced lithium-ion batteries and energy management solutions.

companies.name: Altair Engineering
companies.description: Altair Engineering Inc. is an American multinational information technology company headquartered in Troy, Michigan. It provides software and cloud solutions for simulation, IoT, high performance computing, data analytics, and artificial intelligence. The company operates in the technology sector.

companies.name: Bambuser
companies.description: Bambuser AB is a Swedish company founded in 2007 and headquartered in Stockholm. It offers a video commerce platform aimed at brands seeking to create engaging and personalized shopping experiences. Bambuser is listed on the Nasdaq First North stock exchange.

companies.name: Aktia Bank
companies.description: Aktia Bank is a mid-sized financial services company in Finland, headquartered in Helsinki. It provides digital and personalized services in banking, life insurance, and asset management across several Finnish regions. Its shares are listed on NASDAQ Helsinki.

companies.name: ShopHQ
companies.description: ShopHQ is an American e-commerce retailer and digital shopping platform owned by The Arena Group. It has operated for over 30 years as a multi-channel retailer including a national home shopping television network and an e-commerce website. The company is based in the United States.

companies.name: Peab
companies.description: Peab AB is a construction and civil engineering company headquartered in Förslöv, Scania, Sweden. It is the third largest construction company in Sweden and the Nordic region and is listed on NASDAQ OMX Stockholm. Peab operates in Sweden, Norway, and Finland.

companies.name: Mint of Poland
companies.description: The Mint of Poland is a private joint-stock company located in Warsaw and is the only private entity permitted to mint coins and investment products in Poland. It has been publicly traded on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 1998, making it the only publicly traded mint worldwide.

companies.name: Sabre Corporation
companies.description: Sabre Corporation is a travel technology company headquartered in Southlake, Texas. It operates the Sabre Global Distribution System, the largest global distribution system for air bookings, connecting travel suppliers with travel sellers and providing real-time availability and pricing.

companies.name: Telebras
companies.description: Telebras is a Brazilian telecommunications company that was formerly a state-owned monopoly. It was broken up in 1998 and re-established in 2010 to manage a nationwide broadband plan and provide infrastructure and support networks for telecommunications services across Brazil.

companies.name: China Foods Limited
companies.description: China Foods Limited is a Hong Kong Stock Exchange-listed company engaged in food processing and trading. Its products include oilseed, wineries, beverages, confectionery, wheat, brewing materials, rice, biofuel, biochemicals, and edible oil. The company underwent leadership changes in 2019.

companies.name: Embratel
companies.description: Embratel was a major Brazilian telecommunications company headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. It originated as the long distance arm of Telebras and was owned by MCI Communications and later América Móvil, which renamed it Claro Brasil in 2015.

companies.name: Kiatnakin Phatra Bank
companies.description: Kiatnakin Phatra Bank is a full-service bank based in Bangkok, Thailand. Founded in January 1971, it has expanded to 52 branches and is listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand. The bank is included in the SET50 Index.

companies.name: Hong Leong Bank
companies.description: Hong Leong Bank Berhad is a major public listed banking group based in Malaysia. It operates in the banking sector and is recognized as a significant financial institution in the country.

companies.name: Founder Group
companies.description: Founder Group is a major Chinese technology conglomerate involved in information technology, pharmaceuticals, real estate, finance, and commodities trading. It is divided into five major industry groups and has been undergoing bankruptcy restructuring since 2020.

companies.name: Razgulay
companies.description: OJSC Razgulay Group was one of Russia's largest agribusiness companies based in Moscow. It operated in the agricultural sector before ceasing to be active.

companies.name: Alterra Power
companies.description: Alterra Power Corp., based in Vancouver, Canada, was a diversified renewable power generation company. Formed in 2011 through a merger, it developed and operated hydroelectric, wind, solar, and geothermal projects before being acquired by Innergex Renewable Energy Inc. in 2018.

companies.name: Rusagro
companies.description: Rusagro is one of Russia's largest agricultural companies and a major producer of pork, fats, and sugar. Established in 1995 as a sugar producer, the company is led by CEO Maxim Basov.

companies.name: Borregaard
companies.description: Borregaard is a Norwegian company founded in 1889 in Sarpsborg. Initially producing pulp and paper, it later specialized in chemicals based on timber. It was part of the Orkla Group until its 2012 spin-off and listing on the Oslo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: CTC Media
companies.description: CTC Media LLC is a Russian broadcasting company headquartered in Moscow. It operates in the communication sector providing media services.

companies.name: Magnite Inc
companies.description: Magnite Inc. is an American online advertising technology firm based in Los Angeles, California. It was formed in 2020 following a merger between Rubicon Project and Telaria.

companies.name: Verkkokauppa.com
companies.description: Verkkokauppa.com Oyj is a Finnish online retailer located in Helsinki. Established in 1992, it operates four megastores and over 2500 pickup locations, offering home delivery and installation services.

companies.name: Chunlan Group
companies.description: Chunlan Group Corp is a Chinese corporation headquartered in Taizhou, Jiangsu province. It operates in the electronics industry. The company is notable for being based in one of China's key industrial regions.

companies.name: BBMG
companies.description: BBMG Corporation Ltd. is a cement producer and property developer headquartered in Beijing, China. It is the largest supplier of building materials in Beijing, Tianjin, and Hebei province. The company operates primarily in the real estate and building materials sector.

companies.name: First Media
companies.description: PT First Media Tbk is an Indonesian media and telecommunications company focused on pay cable television and Internet services. It operates primarily in Indonesia's telecommunications sector. The company provides media and internet connectivity solutions.

companies.name: GEA Group
companies.description: GEA Group AG is a German corporation headquartered in Düsseldorf, active mostly in the food and beverages sector. It is one of the world's largest suppliers of process technology and components in the food and beverages industry and other industries. The company is listed on the DAX stock exchange.

companies.name: Alumina Limited
companies.description: Alumina Limited is an Australian holding company spun off from Western Mining Corporation in 2002. Its sole asset is a 40% shareholding in Alcoa World Alumina & Chemicals. In 2024, Alcoa acquired Alumina Limited.

companies.name: Jakks Pacific
companies.description: Jakks Pacific, Inc. is an American toy manufacturer founded in January 1995. The company is known for producing licensed action figures, playsets, dolls, plush toys, dress-up sets, and Plug-n-Play Television Game Consoles popularized in the 2000s. It operates in the consumer products industry.

companies.name: Uralsib
companies.description: Uralsib is a Russian commercial bank headquartered in Moscow. As of 2022, it was one of Russia's largest banks by net asset value. The bank operates in the financial services sector.

companies.name: Aluminum Corporation of China
companies.description: Aluminum Corporation of China is a Chinese state-owned enterprise and the top-level holding company for China's non-ferrous metals industry. It is wholly owned by the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council. The company is responsible for policy execution, strategic asset oversight, and international resource coordination.

companies.name: Cracker Barrel
companies.description: CBOCS Properties, Inc., doing business as Cracker Barrel, is an American chain of restaurants and gift stores with a Southern country theme. Founded in 1969 in Lebanon, Tennessee, the company expanded from locations near Interstate Highway exits to operate 660 stores in 44 states as of 2023.

companies.name: Cherkizovo
companies.description: Cherkizovo is a Moscow-based Russian food company that is a major producer and processor of poultry and pork. It operates in the food industry within Russia. The company is notable for its significant role in meat production and processing.

companies.name: Amada Co
companies.description: Amada Co., Ltd. is a large Japanese manufacturer of metal processing equipment and machinery based in Kanagawa. The company produces metal cutting, forming, shearing, and punching machines, and also develops factory automation systems and electronic equipment. Its products serve industries such as automotive, computer, camera, and electric appliances.

companies.name: Shufersal Ltd.
companies.description: Shufersal is the largest supermarket chain in Israel, established in 1958. It was the first company to implement the American supermarket model in Israel and holds a 20% market share in the country.

companies.name: HSN
companies.description: HSN, Inc., formerly known as Home Shopping Network, is an American free-to-air television network based in West Chester, Pennsylvania. It is owned by the QVC Group, which also owns the catalog company Cornerstone Brands.

companies.name: 01 Communique
companies.description: 01 Communique is a Canadian cyber security and technology company headquartered in Mississauga, Ontario. It operates within the software industry.

companies.name: 1-800-Flowers
companies.description: 1-800-Flowers.com, Inc. is a floral and foods gift retailer and distribution company in the United States. The company focuses on gift baskets outside of Mother's Day and Valentine's Day and also operates under the name 1-800-Baskets.com.

companies.name: Bitstream Inc.
companies.description: Bitstream Inc. was an American type foundry founded in 1981 and located in Marlborough, Massachusetts. It produced digital typefaces and was founded by former employees of Mergenthaler Linotype Company. Its font business was acquired by Monotype Imaging in 2012, and the remaining business was renamed Pageflex, Inc.

companies.name: Ambac
companies.description: The Ambac Financial Group, Inc. is an American holding company headquartered in Lower Manhattan, New York City. Its subsidiaries provide financial guarantee products such as bond insurance globally. Ambac Assurance guarantees public finance and structured finance obligations and is regulated by Wisconsin's insurance commission.

companies.name: Scandinavian Tobacco Group
companies.description: Scandinavian Tobacco Group is a Danish manufacturer of cigars and traditional pipe tobacco headquartered in Copenhagen. It is a publicly listed company on Nasdaq Copenhagen.

companies.name: Skistar
companies.description: SkiStar AB is a Swedish company focused on leisure, tourism, property, and retail, listed on the Stockholm Stock Exchange. Its core business includes alpine skiing in Sweden and Norway, along with accommodation, ski schools, and rental services.

companies.name: Bâloise
companies.description: Bâloise Holding AG is a Swiss insurance holding company founded in 1863 and headquartered in Basel.

companies.name: VF Corporation
companies.description: VF Corporation is an American apparel and footwear company founded in 1899 and headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It organizes its eleven brands into three categories: Outdoor, Active, and Work. The company operates in the clothing industry.

companies.name: Bank of the Ryukyus
companies.description: Bank of The Ryukyus, Limited is a Japanese regional bank serving Okinawa Prefecture in Japan. It operates as a bank focused on regional financial services.

companies.name: 1st Constitution Bancorp
companies.description: 1st Constitution Bancorp was a bank holding company based in Cranbury, New Jersey. It operated 1st Constitution Bank until its acquisition by Lakeland Bancorp, Inc. The company was part of the banking industry.

companies.name: 1st Source
companies.description: 1st Source Corporation is a financial services company headquartered in South Bend, Indiana. It operates 1st Source Bank with branches in Indiana and Michigan and provides financing for aircraft, trucks, and construction equipment, as well as insurance products through 1st Source Insurance.

companies.name: Amcor
companies.description: Amcor plc is a multinational packaging company founded in Australia. It develops and produces flexible packaging, rigid containers, specialty cartons, closures, and services for various industries including food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and medical devices.

companies.name: Amdocs
companies.description: Amdocs Limited is a multinational telecommunications technology and software company headquartered in Chesterfield, Missouri. It specializes in software and services for communications, media, digital enterprises, and financial services providers. Founded in 1982, it is publicly traded on Nasdaq.

companies.name: Rockwell Collins
companies.description: Rockwell Collins, Inc. was a multinational corporation headquartered in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, providing avionics and IT systems and services to government agencies and aircraft manufacturers. It was formed in 1973 when Rockwell International purchased Collins Radio Company and was spun off as Rockwell Collins in 2001.

companies.name: Ameren
companies.description: Ameren Corporation is an American power company based in St. Louis, Missouri. Created in 1997 by the merger of Union Electric Company and Central Illinois Public Service Company, it serves electric and natural gas customers across Missouri and Illinois.

companies.name: Smith & Wesson
companies.logo_file: Smith & Wesson logo from .357 Model 686 Plus.png
companies.description: Smith & Wesson Brands, Inc. is an American firearm manufacturer headquartered in Maryville, Tennessee. The company operates in the arms industry.

companies.name: 2U
companies.description: 2U is an American educational technology company that partners with non-profit colleges, universities, and companies to build, deliver, and support online degree and non-degree programs. It is also the parent company of edX.

companies.name: SMA Solar Technology
companies.description: SMA Solar Technology AG is a German company founded in 1981 and headquartered in Niestetal, Northern Hesse. It produces and manufactures solar inverters for photovoltaic systems used in grid connection, off-grid power supply, and backup operations.

companies.name: 3D Systems
companies.description: 3D Systems Corporation is an American company based in Rock Hill, South Carolina. It engineers, manufactures, and sells 3D printing materials and application engineering services, creating prototypes, tooling patterns, and production parts using proprietary fabrication processes.

companies.name: 7 Days Inn
companies.description: 7 Days Group Holdings Limited, operating as 7 Days Inn, is a Chinese budget hotel chain established in 2005 and based in Guangzhou, Guangdong. It operates in the hospitality sector providing budget accommodations.

companies.name: A. O. Smith
companies.description: A. O. Smith Corporation is an American manufacturer of residential and commercial water heaters and boilers. It is the largest manufacturer and marketer of water heaters in North America and also supplies water treatment products in Asia with multiple manufacturing locations worldwide.

companies.name: Geberit
companies.description: Geberit is a Swiss multinational group specializing in manufacturing and supplying sanitary parts and related systems. It is a leader in its field in Europe and has a global presence through its subsidiaries.

companies.name: AAR Corp
companies.description: AAR CORP. is an American provider of aircraft maintenance services to commercial and government customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Wood Dale, Illinois, and operates in 30 countries with about 7,000 employees.

companies.name: ABM Industries
companies.description: ABM Industries Inc. is an American facility management provider founded in 1909 in San Francisco, California. It offers services including electrical, lighting, energy, HVAC, janitorial, landscaping, parking, and transportation management.

companies.name: ACI Worldwide
companies.description: ACI Worldwide is a digital payments software company headquartered in Elkhorn, Nebraska. It processes billions of transactions daily for customers in 94 countries, providing secure payment solutions for banks, merchants, and other financial institutions.

companies.name: ALCO Stores
companies.description: ALCO Stores, Inc. was a retail chain operating 198 stores in 23 states primarily in the U.S. Midwest. The company was founded in 1901 in Kansas by Alva Lease Duckwall.

companies.name: ATCO
companies.description: ATCO Ltd., operating as the ATCO Group, is a publicly-traded Canadian engineering, logistics, and energy holding company based in Calgary, Alberta. Its subsidiaries include electric utilities, natural gas production and distribution companies, and construction companies. ATCO is involved in electricity generation among other sectors.

companies.name: Allied Telesis Holdings
companies.description: Allied Telesis Holdings K.K., formerly Allied Telesyn, is a network infrastructure and telecommunications company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with branches in San Jose, California. Established in 1987, it provides Ethernet and IP access equipment and IP triple play networks over copper and fiber infrastructure.

companies.name: ATP Oil and Gas
companies.description: ATP Oil & Gas Corporation was a Houston, Texas-based company that developed and produced oil and natural gas in the Gulf of Mexico and the North Sea. The company specialized in developing reserves in these regions.

companies.name: ATS Automation Tooling Systems
companies.description: ATS Corporation is a Canadian company based in Cambridge, Ontario, that designs and builds factory automation systems. It is publicly listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and operates in the industrial automation sector.

companies.name: ATS Medical
companies.description: ATS Medical, Inc. was a developer and manufacturer of products for the cardiac surgery market based in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The company was acquired by Medtronic in 2010.

companies.name: AVX Corporation
companies.description: AVX Corporation is an American manufacturer of electronic components headquartered in Fountain Inn, South Carolina. It is the largest industrial employer in Horry County, South Carolina, and operates in the United States, Europe, and Asia. AVX is a subsidiary of Kyocera Electronics Corporation.

companies.name: Equitable Holdings
companies.description: Equitable Holdings, Inc. is an American financial services and insurance company founded in 1859 by Henry Baldwin Hyde. It operates in the insurance and financial services sector in the United States.

companies.name: Aabsal
companies.description: Aabsal is a major manufacturer of home appliances in Iran, established in 1956 and listed on the Tehran Stock Exchange. The company produces air coolers, gas heaters, gas cookers, washing machines, and other household products.

companies.name: Abcam
companies.description: Abcam Limited is a producer, distributor, and seller of protein research tools operating worldwide from 13 locations with 1,800 employees, including 400 in Research and Development. It was listed on the Nasdaq and London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Danaher Corporation in 2023.

companies.name: AbioMed
companies.description: Abiomed, Inc. is a medical device technology company headquartered in Danvers, Massachusetts, operating as a stand-alone business within Johnson & Johnson's MedTech Segment. It develops and manufactures temporary external and implantable mechanical circulatory support devices and has offices in multiple cities worldwide.

companies.name: Acacia Research
companies.description: Acacia Research Corporation is a publicly traded American company based in New York City. It acquires and operates businesses in technology, energy, and industrial/manufacturing sectors. The company has a strategic relationship with Starboard Value, LP, its controlling shareholder.

companies.name: Acadia Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Acadia Pharmaceuticals Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Del Mar, California. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry.

companies.name: BIOVIA
companies.description: BIOVIA is a software company headquartered in the United States with representation in Europe and Asia. It provides software for chemical, materials, and bioscience research across multiple industries including pharmaceutical and biotechnology.

companies.name: American Water Works
companies.description: American Water Works Company, Inc. is an American public utility company providing water and wastewater services in the United States through its subsidiaries.

companies.name: R1 RCM
companies.description: R1 RCM Inc. is an American revenue cycle management company servicing hospitals, health systems, and physician groups across the United States. It was acquired in a deal completed in November 2024 by TowerBrook Capital Partners and Clayton, Dubilier & Rice.

companies.name: Accuride Corporation
companies.description: Accuride Corporation is a diversified manufacturer and supplier of commercial vehicle components in North America. The company is based in Livonia, Michigan, and designs, manufactures, and markets these components.

companies.name: Acme United Corporation
companies.description: Acme United Corporation is an American supplier of cutting, measuring, and safety products for school, home, office, hardware, and industrial markets. Founded as a partnership in 1867, it is incorporated in Connecticut and publicly traded on the NYSE American.

companies.name: Acom
companies.description: Acom is one of Japan's largest consumer loan companies. Founded by Masao Kinoshita, it also issues credit cards. The company name stands for Affection, Confidence, and Moderation.

companies.name: Acorda Therapeutics
companies.description: Acorda Therapeutics, Inc. is an American biotechnology company based in Pearl River, New York. It develops therapies for neurological disorders and manufactures drugs including Inbrija and Ampyra in the United States.

companies.name: Acquity Group
companies.description: Acquity Group, LLC was an eCommerce and digital marketing company headquartered in Chicago with offices across North America. It was acquired by Accenture in 2013.

companies.name: Actions Technology

companies.description: Actions Technology Co. Ltd. is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company founded in 2000 and headquartered in Zhuhai, Guangdong province, with offices in Shanghai and Shenzhen. It designs system on chips (SoCs) for tablets, digital audio players, photo viewers, and related products.

companies.name: Actuant
companies.description: Enerpac Tool Group Corp., formerly Actuant Corporation, is a company founded in 1910 and headquartered in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin, United States. It operates as a conglomerate with a history dating back over a century.

companies.name: Adacel
companies.description: Adacel Technologies Limited is an Australian air traffic management company that develops and implements air traffic management systems, as well as air traffic control simulation and training solutions.

companies.name: Adcock Ingram
companies.description: Adcock Ingram is a South African pharmaceutical manufacturer listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange. It manufactures and markets healthcare products to both private and public sectors.

companies.name: Adelphia Communications Corporation
companies.description: Adelphia Communications Corporation was an American cable television company headquartered in Coudersport, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1952, it grew to serve over two million subscribers and expanded into high-speed internet, phone services, and voice messaging for businesses.

companies.name: Advance Auto Parts
companies.description: Advance Auto Parts is an American automotive aftermarket parts provider headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. It serves both professional installers and do-it-yourself customers.

companies.name: Leadway Technology Investment Group Limited
companies.description: Leadway Technology Investments Holdings Limited is a Cayman Islands-incorporated offshore holding company. Its subsidiary, Advanced Card Systems Limited, was incorporated in British Hong Kong in 1995, and was acquired by HNA Group in 2017 as part of a reverse IPO.

companies.name: Advanced Energy
companies.description: Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It develops precision power conversion, measurement, and control technologies for manufacturing semiconductors, flat panel displays, data storage products, telecommunications equipment, and more.

companies.name: Advantage Energy
companies.description: Advantage Energy Ltd. is a Canadian oil and gas company based in Calgary, Alberta. It focuses on developing its Montney fossil gas and liquids resource play to provide Canadian energy and is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Advaxis
companies.description: Advaxis Immunotherapies Inc. was an American biotechnology company focused on immunotherapies based on a genetically engineered platform using Listeria monocytogenes. It merged with Ayala Pharmaceuticals, with the new company starting operations in January 2023.

companies.name: SS&C Advent
companies.description: SS&C Advent is a business unit of SS&C Technologies that provides portfolio management and accounting software to investment managers, hedge funds, family offices, and wealth management firms. Founded in San Francisco in 1983, it was acquired and rebranded by SS&C Technologies in 2015.

companies.name: Aeolian Investment Fund S.A.
companies.description: Aeolian Investment Fund S.A. is a Greek company listed on the Athens Stock Exchange that invests in other Greek companies. It operates within Greece's financial market.

companies.name: Aerohive Networks
companies.description: Aerohive Networks, Inc. was an American multinational computer networking equipment company headquartered in Milpitas, California. Founded in 2006, it provided wireless networking solutions to medium-sized and larger businesses worldwide.

companies.name: Agenus
companies.description: Agenus Inc. is a biotechnology company based in Lexington, Massachusetts, focused on immunotherapy including immuno-oncology. It develops checkpoint modulators, patient-specific anti-cancer vaccines, and vaccine adjuvants.

companies.name: Agile Group Holdings Limited
companies.description: Agile Property Holdings Limited is a land developer focused on Guangdong Province, China. Established in 1985 as a furniture maker, it entered the property business in 1992 and was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2005.

companies.name: Timken Company
companies.description: The Timken Company is a global manufacturer of engineered bearings and industrial motion products. Headquartered in North Canton, Ohio, it operates in 45 countries worldwide.

companies.name: Aiful
companies.description: AIFUL Corporation is one of the largest Japanese consumer finance companies based in Kyoto. It had to restructure its debt after failing to make a loan payment.

companies.name: Ametek
companies.description: AMETEK, Inc. is an American multinational conglomerate that designs and manufactures electronic instruments and electromechanical devices. It has headquarters in the United States and operates over 150 sites worldwide.

companies.name: Alabama Power
companies.description: Alabama Power Company is headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, and provides electricity service to 1.4 million customers in southern Alabama. It is one of four U.S. utilities operated by the Southern Company.

companies.name: Alarm.com, Inc.
companies.description: Alarm.com, Inc. is an American technology company based in Tysons, Virginia, providing cloud-based services for remote control, home automation, and alarm monitoring. It was founded in 2000 as a spinoff from MicroStrategy.

companies.name: AlarmForce
companies.description: AlarmForce Industries Inc. is a Toronto-based company that manufactures and provides home security and home automation systems. It operates in both residential and commercial security segments. The company is based in Canada.

companies.name: Alaska Communications
companies.description: Alaska Communications is a telecommunications corporation headquartered in Anchorage, Alaska. It was the first provider in Alaska to maintain a 3G wireless network and owns infrastructure for wireless, internet, and phone services. Its operations include advanced data networks and an underwater fiber optic system.

companies.name: Fnac Darty
companies.description: Fnac Darty SA is a multinational retail company headquartered in Ivry-sur-Seine, France. It adopted its current name after acquiring Darty plc in 2016. The company operates in the retail sector.

companies.name: Aldila
companies.description: Aldila, Inc. is a sports equipment manufacturer based in Carlsbad, California. It specializes in OEM and consumer golf club shafts and also produces other carbon fiber products. The company operates in the consumer goods and retail industry.

companies.name: Alexander's
companies.description: Alexander's, Inc. is a New York City-based real estate investment trust owning seven properties in the New York metropolitan area. Founded in 1928 as a department store chain, it is controlled by Vornado Realty Trust as of 2026.

companies.name: Algonquin Power
companies.description: Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. is a Canadian investor-owned regulated utility company with assets in North America, Bermuda, and Chile. It provides water, wastewater, natural gas, and electricity services through subsidiaries including Liberty Utilities and Bermuda Electric Light Company.

companies.name: Siemens Healthineers
companies.description: Siemens Healthineers is a German multinational company specializing in medical technology and imaging. It was spun off from Siemens in 2017, which retains a 67% stake. The company is headquartered in Erlangen, Germany.

companies.name: Amkor Technology
companies.description: Amkor Technology, Inc. is an American semiconductor product packaging and test services provider. Founded in 1968, it is headquartered in Arizona, having moved there in 2005. The company has locations in Chandler and Tempe.

companies.name: Aliansce Shopping Centers
companies.description: Aliansce Sonae was the second-largest shopping mall developer and manager in Brazil. Founded in 2004 as a joint venture between Nacional Iguatemi and GGP, it merged with Sonae Sierra Brasil in 2019 to form Alliances Sonae, becoming the largest shopping center manager in Brazil.

companies.name: Alimera Sciences
companies.description: Alimera Sciences, Inc. was a biopharmaceutical sales company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. It specialized in the commercialization and sales of prescription ophthalmic pharmaceuticals, focusing on diseases affecting the retina.

companies.name: Alkermes
companies.description: Alkermes plc is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines for psychiatric and neurological disorders. Founded in 1987, it is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, with an R&D center in Massachusetts and a manufacturing facility in Ohio. In 2011, Alkermes merged with Elan Drug Technologies.

companies.name: Allegiance Mining
companies.description: Allegiance Mining NL is an Australian mining company listed on the Australian Securities Exchange since 1993. It operates in the mining industry and is based in Australia.

companies.name: AllianceBernstein
companies.description: AllianceBernstein Holding L.P. is an American asset-management firm providing investment management and research services worldwide. It serves institutional, high-net-worth, and retail investors.

companies.name: Alliant Energy
companies.description: Alliant Energy Corporation is a public utility holding company headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin. It provides power services in the states of Iowa and Wisconsin in the United States.

companies.name: Allied Bank Limited
companies.description: Allied Bank Limited is a Pakistani commercial bank based in Lahore, Punjab. It operates as a subsidiary of the Ibrahim Group.

companies.name: Allot Ltd
companies.description: Allot Ltd., formerly Allot Communications, is an Israeli high-tech company specializing in telecommunications software. The company is headquartered in Hod Hasharon, Israel.

companies.name: Allscripts
companies.description: Veradigm Inc., formerly known as Allscripts, is a publicly traded American company providing practice management and electronic health record technology to healthcare providers. It serves over 180,000 physicians and has products in thousands of hospitals and care organizations.

companies.name: Alpek
companies.description: Alpek S.A.B. de C.V. is a Mexican chemical manufacturing company headquartered in San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León. It is a leading producer of PET, PTA, and the sole polypropylene producer in Mexico, and is the largest chemical company in Mexico.

companies.name: Alsea
companies.description: Alsea, S.A.B. de C.V. is a Mexican multi-brand restaurant operator based in Mexico City. Founded in 1997, it operates fast-food, casual dining, and cafeteria chains across Mexico, South America, and Europe.

companies.name: Altos Computer Systems
companies.description: Altos Computer Systems was founded in 1977 and specialized in small multi-user computers based on CP/M, Unix, and Xenix. The company went public in 1982, raising $59 million, and traded under the symbol ALTO.

companies.name: AmRest
companies.description: AmRest Holdings SE is a European multinational operator of casual dining, fast-food restaurants, and coffee shops headquartered in Madrid, Spain. It operates over 2300 locations, mostly franchises of KFC, Pizza Hut, and Starbucks, across multiple countries including Spain, China, and several European nations.

companies.name: AmTrust Financial Services, Inc.
companies.description: AmTrust Financial Services, Inc. is a New York City-based multinational property and casualty insurance company. It offers various insurance products including workers’ compensation and cyber liability, operating mainly in North America, the UK, and Europe through subsidiaries.

companies.name: Amarin Corporation
companies.description: Amarin Corporation is an Irish-American biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Dublin, Ireland and Bridgewater, New Jersey. Founded in 1993, it develops and markets medicines for cardiovascular disease, including the prescription drug Vascepa.

companies.name: Ambarella Inc.
companies.description: Ambarella, Inc. is an American fabless semiconductor design company specializing in low-power, high-definition video compression, image processing, and computer vision processors. Its products are used in applications such as video security, autonomous driving, and robotics.

companies.name: Amcol International Corporation
companies.description: AMCOL International Corporation is a company based in Hoffman Estates, Illinois that mines, processes, and distributes chemical products. It also provides clays used as moisture barriers in commercial construction.

companies.name: AmeriServ Financial
companies.description: AmeriServ Financial, Inc. is a bank holding company headquartered in Johnstown, Pennsylvania. It operates AmeriServ Financial Bank along with trust, financial services, and life insurance subsidiaries, and maintains 16 automated teller machines.

companies.name: American Axle
companies.description: Dauch Corporation, formerly American Axle & Manufacturing, Inc., is an American manufacturer of automobile driveline and drivetrain components headquartered in Detroit, Michigan.

companies.name: CMC Magnetics
companies.description: CMC Magnetics Corporation is a Taiwanese manufacturer of optical discs with factories in Taiwan and Hong Kong. In 2015, it acquired the optical disc brand and intellectual property from Taiyo Yuden, ending Taiyo Yuden's own production in Japan.

companies.name: American Financial Group
companies.description: American Financial Group, Inc. is a financial services holding company headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio. Its primary businesses include insurance and investments.

companies.name: American National Insurance Company
companies.description: American National Insurance Company is a major American insurance corporation based in Galveston, Texas. It operates in all 50 U.S. states and Puerto Rico and was acquired by Brookfield Reinsurance in May 2022.

companies.name: American Pathology Partners
companies.description: American Pathology Partners, Inc. is a privately held medical laboratory company based in Nashville, Tennessee. It operates a nationwide network of pathology laboratories serving physician offices, hospitals, and surgery centers. The company offers sub-specialized anatomic and molecular pathology services and has laboratory facilities in Colorado, North Carolina, and Florida.

companies.name: American River Bank
companies.description: American River Bank was a community bank founded in 1983 serving the Greater Sacramento area in California. It offered business and personal financial services through ten branches in Northern California. The bank was a wholly owned subsidiary of American River Bankshares.

companies.name: American Science and Engineering
companies.description: American Science and Engineering Inc. (AS&E) is an American manufacturer of advanced X-ray equipment and related technologies founded in 1958. The company initially developed technology for NASA and contributed to the discovery of the first extra-solar source of X-rays. AS&E invented backscatter technology and body scanners used for security screening.

companies.name: American Woodmark
companies.description: American Woodmark Corporation is a kitchen and bath cabinet manufacturer headquartered in Winchester, Virginia. It operates multiple manufacturing facilities across several U.S. states including Arizona, Georgia, and Virginia. The company also maintains service centers throughout the country.

companies.name: TriQuint Semiconductor
companies.description: TriQuint Semiconductor was a semiconductor company founded in 1985 in Beaverton, Oregon, later moving to Hillsboro, Oregon. It designed, manufactured, and supplied high-performance RF modules, components, and foundry services. In 2015, it merged with RF Micro Devices to form Qorvo, Inc.

companies.name: Amidar The Israeli National Public Housing Company
companies.description: Amidar is a state-owned housing company in Israel. It operates in the real estate sector providing public housing services.

companies.name: Amphenol
companies.description: Amphenol Corporation is headquartered in Wallingford, Connecticut, and is a major designer, manufacturer, and marketer of electrical, electronic, and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems. Its products include antennas, sensors, and various types of cables.

companies.name: IONQ
companies.description: IonQ, Inc. is an American quantum computing hardware and software company based in College Park, Maryland. It develops general-purpose trapped ion quantum computers and software to generate, optimize, and execute quantum circuits.

companies.name: Amlin
companies.description: MS Amlin Ltd is an insurer operating in the Lloyd's, UK, Continental Europe, and Bermudian markets. It specializes in insurance cover for commercial enterprises and reinsurance protection for other insurance companies. The company was acquired by Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Group in 2016.

companies.name: Ampol
companies.description: Ampol Limited is an Australian petroleum company headquartered in Alexandria, New South Wales. It is the largest transport energy distributor and retailer in Australia with over 1,800 service stations. Ampol also operates in New Zealand through its subsidiary Z Energy.

companies.name: Amreit
companies.description: AmREIT, Inc. was a real estate investment trust that invested in shopping centers in Texas and Atlanta, Georgia. The company also managed real estate investment funds for high net worth individuals and partnered with JPMorgan Chase and Goldman Sachs. It was based in the United States.

companies.name: Amrep Corporation
companies.description: AMREP Corporation is a real estate and media services company based in Princeton, New Jersey, United States. Founded in 1961 as The American Realty and Petroleum Corporation, it operates in the real estate sector.

companies.name: Kakao Games
companies.description: Kakao Games Corp. is a South Korean video game publisher and subsidiary of Kakao. It specializes in developing and publishing games on PC, mobile, and VR platforms. The company is represented by Namgoong Hoon and Cho Gye-hyun.

companies.name: Epiroc
companies.description: Epiroc AB is a Swedish manufacturer of mining and infrastructure equipment headquartered in Stockholm. It has manufacturing facilities in multiple countries including Sweden, the United States, Canada, Australia, China, India, Japan, and Germany.

companies.name: Anabuki Kosan
companies.description: Anabuki Kosan Inc. is a Japanese real estate company established in 1964 and headquartered in Takamatsu, Kagawa Prefecture. It was formerly part of the Anabuki Construction group and markets condominiums under the Alpha and Alpha Smart brands.

companies.name: Analogic Corporation
companies.description: Analogic Corporation is an American multinational specializing in healthcare technology and aviation security industries. It produces CT scan, digital mammography, and MRI equipment, and develops baggage screening and motion control technologies for airports.

companies.name: Anaplan
companies.description: Anaplan is a business planning software company headquartered in Miami, Florida. It sells subscriptions for cloud-based business-planning software and provides data to support decision-making.

companies.name: Anaren
companies.description: Anaren, Inc. was an American manufacturer of high-frequency radio and microwave electronics based in Syracuse, New York. Founded in 1967, it produced RF microelectronics and components for aerospace, defense, networking, and communications industries before being acquired by TTM Technologies in 2018.

companies.name: Transsion Holdings
companies.description: Transsion is a Chinese mobile phone manufacturer based in Shenzhen. It was the largest smartphone manufacturer by sales in Africa in 2017 and sells phones in multiple regions including the Middle East and Southeast Asia. Its brands include itel, TECNO, and Infinix.

companies.name: Angie's List
companies.description: Angi Inc. is an internet services company formed in 2017 by merging Angie's List and HomeAdvisor. It originated from Angie's List, an American home services website founded in 1995 that allows users to read and publish crowd-sourced reviews of local businesses and contractors.

companies.name: iFlytek
companies.description: iFlytek is a partially state-owned Chinese information technology company established in 1999. It develops voice recognition software and over ten voice-based internet and mobile products across education, communication, music, and intelligent toys industries. China Mobile is its largest shareholder.

companies.name: Ann Taylor
companies.description: Ann Inc. is an American specialty apparel retail group headquartered in New York City. It operates as a subsidiary of Ascena Retail Group and markets its brand under five divisions including Ann Taylor and Loft, offering classic-styled suits, separates, dresses, shoes, and accessories.

companies.name: Annie's Homegrown
companies.description: Annie's Homegrown is an American organic food company owned by General Mills. Founded in Hampton, Connecticut, it is best known for its macaroni and cheese product line, which is the second-best selling in the United States. The company also produces Annie's Naturals condiments and sauces.

companies.name: Creative Technology
companies.description: Creative Technology Ltd., also known as Creative Labs Pte Ltd., is a Singaporean multinational electronics company specializing in audio technologies and products such as speakers, headphones, and sound cards. Founded by Sim Wong Hoo, it was influential in advancing PC audio in the 1990s with its Sound Blaster card.

companies.name: Anthera Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Anthera Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is an American biopharmaceutical company focused on developing products to treat cystic fibrosis, inflammation, and autoimmune diseases. Its leading drug candidate Liprotamase is in Phase 3 trials for exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, and A-623 is in Phase 2 trials for IgA nephropathy.

companies.name: Hang Lung Group
companies.description: Hang Lung Group is an investment holding company engaged in property development, sales, leasing, and management of car parks, properties, and dry cleaning businesses. Its subsidiary Hang Lung Properties is a major property developer in Hong Kong and also invests in mainland China.

companies.name: Anworth Mortgage Asset Corporation
companies.description: Anworth Mortgage Asset Corporation was a mortgage real estate investment trust. It was acquired by Ready Capital Corporation in 2021.

companies.name: ams OSRAM AG
companies.description: ams OSRAM AG is an Austrian semiconductor manufacturer headquartered in Premstätten, Austria, with a co-headquarters in Munich, Germany. The company develops and produces intelligent sensors and emitter components.

companies.name: Apollo Tyres
companies.description: Apollo Tyres Limited is an Indian multinational tyre manufacturer headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana. Incorporated in 1972, it operates five manufacturing units in India and others in the Netherlands and Hungary, generating most of its revenue from India and Europe.

companies.name: Applied Industrial Technologies
companies.description: Applied Industrial Technologies, Inc. is a global company based in the United States that distributes bearings, power transmission products, engineered fluid power components, and other industrial supplies. It also provides engineering, design, and system integration services for industrial and fluid power applications.

companies.name: Applied Micro Circuits Corporation
companies.description: Applied Micro Circuits Corporation was a fabless semiconductor company in the United States that designed network and embedded Power ISA, server processor ARM, optical transport, and storage products.

companies.name: Apricus Biosciences
companies.description: Apricus Biosciences, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company based in San Diego, United States, focused on advancing innovative medicines in urology and rheumatology.

companies.name: Arab National Bank
companies.description: Arab National Bank is a major bank headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and listed on the Saudi Stock Exchange. It is among the top ten largest banks in the Middle East and has 156 branches in Saudi Arabia.

companies.name: Arabian Shield Cooperative Insurance Company
companies.description: Arabian Shield Cooperative Insurance Company is an insurance company operating within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

companies.name: Arcimoto
companies.description: Arcimoto, Inc. is an electric vehicle company headquartered in Eugene, Oregon, United States. It designs, manufactures, and sells the FUV, a tandem two-seat, three-wheeled electric vehicle, along with its four variations.

companies.name: Arena Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Arena Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company based in San Diego, United States, developing small molecule drugs for multiple therapeutic areas. It has investigational clinical programs for pulmonary arterial hypertension, inflammatory indications, and pain associated with Crohn's disease.

companies.name: Ares Management
companies.description: Ares Management Corporation is a global alternative investment manager founded in 1997 and based in the United States. It operates in credit, private equity, and real estate markets with offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

companies.name: Argo Investments
companies.description: Argo Investments Limited is an Australian listed investment company trading on the Australian Stock Exchange. It holds a diversified portfolio of shares selected for profitability and long-term growth and is the second largest listed investment company in Australia as of 2007.

companies.name: Steelcase
companies.description: Steelcase Inc. is a company headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan, United States, that designs, manufactures, and sells office and residential furniture. It also conducts research on workplace design and behavior to inform its product development.

companies.name: Arlington Asset Investment
companies.description: Arlington Asset Investment Corp. is a mortgage real estate investment trust based in McLean, Virginia. The firm primarily invests in mortgage-related assets and residential real estate. It operates as an investment company focused on real estate finance.

companies.name: Arotech Corporation
companies.description: Arotech Corporation is a defense and security products and services company in the United States. It designs and manufactures products for military and non-military air and ground vehicles, interactive simulation, and military batteries and charging systems. The company operates through two main divisions: interactive simulation and batteries and power systems.

companies.name: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co.
companies.description: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. is an American insurance brokerage and risk management services company headquartered in Rolling Meadows, Illinois. Founded in 1927, it provides insurance brokerage and risk management services, including processing workers compensation and automobile insurance claims.

companies.name: AryoGen
companies.description: AryoGen Pharmed is an Iranian biopharmaceutical company specializing in manufacturing therapeutic monoclonal antibodies and other recombinant proteins. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry in Iran.

companies.name: Asbury Automotive Group
companies.description: Asbury Automotive Group is an American company based near Atlanta that operates auto dealerships across the United States. Founded in 1995, it is recognized as a major player in the automotive retail sector.

companies.name: Ashot - Ashkelon Industries Ltd.
companies.description: Ashot Ashkelon Industries Ltd is an Israeli manufacturer headquartered in Ashkelon. It produces build-to-print products such as gears, transmissions, and gearboxes for aerospace, military, and automotive industries. The company employs around 560 people.

companies.name: Sunbelt Rentals
companies.description: Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc. is an industrial equipment rental company with dual headquarters in London, England and South Carolina, United States. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange and was part of the FTSE 100 Index before transferring its listing to the US in 2026.

companies.name: Asphere Innovations
companies.description: Asphere Innovations is a tech holding company and online game operator based in Bangkok, Thailand. It operates the Playpark gaming platform across Southeast Asia, including Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines, Singapore, and Malaysia.

companies.name: Associated Banc-Corp
companies.description: Associated Banc-Corp is a regional bank holding company headquartered in Green Bay, Wisconsin. It provides retail and commercial banking, commercial real estate lending, private banking, and specialized financial services across multiple Midwestern states and other US regions.

companies.name: Assura Group
companies.description: Assura is a British property business headquartered in Altrincham, Greater Manchester. It focuses on investing in buildings used for healthcare and owns and operates over 600 general practitioner and primary healthcare buildings in the UK as of 2025.

companies.name: Assurant
companies.description: Assurant, Inc. is a global provider of risk management products and services headquartered in Atlanta. It offers specialty insurance products in property, casualty, extended device protection, and insurance sectors. The company operates mainly through its Global Housing and Global Lifestyle segments.

companies.name: Astoria Bank
companies.description: Astoria Financial Corporation was a bank holding company based in Lake Success, New York. It was acquired by Sterling Bancorp on October 2, 2017. The company operated in the financial services industry before its acquisition.

companies.name: Asure Software
companies.description: Asure Software, Inc. is a software company that rebranded from Forgent Networks in 2007. It offers human capital management solutions including payroll, time and attendance, talent management, human resource management, benefits administration, and insurance services.

companies.name: Athabasca Oil Corporation
companies.description: Athabasca Oil Corporation is a Canadian petroleum company based in Calgary, Alberta. It focuses on developing thermal and light oil assets in the Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin and holds a significant land base of high-quality resources.

companies.name: athenahealth
companies.description: Athenahealth, Inc. is a privately held American company providing cloud-based healthcare technology and network-enabled services. Its main product, athenaOne, integrates electronic health records, practice management, medical billing, and patient engagement tools for ambulatory practices.

companies.name: IG Group
companies.description: IG Group Holdings plc is a United Kingdom-based online trading and investment provider. It offers access to spread betting, US futures and options, stock and crypto trading, allowing traders to speculate on equities, bonds, and currencies without owning the underlying assets.

companies.name: Sappi
companies.description: Sappi Limited is a South African pulp and paper company originally incorporated in 1936 as South African Pulp and Paper Industries Limited. It operates globally in the pulp and paper industry.

companies.name: Atlantic Power Corporation
companies.description: Atlantic Power Corporation, headquartered in Dedham, Massachusetts, is a power generation and infrastructure company with assets in the United States and Canada. It generates power through hydro, natural gas, biomass, and coal-fired plants and was acquired by I Squared Capital in 2021.

companies.name: Atlantis Casino Resort Spa
companies.description: The Atlantis Casino Resort Spa is a hotel and casino located in Reno, Nevada, owned by Monarch Casino & Resort, Inc. It features three hotel towers with 824 guest rooms and a casino floor of 64,814 square feet. The property has undergone nearly $150 million in upgrades.

companies.name: Atmos Energy
companies.description: Atmos Energy Corporation, headquartered in Dallas, Texas, is one of the largest natural-gas-only distributors in the United States. It serves about three million customers across over 1,400 communities in nine states from the Blue Ridge Mountains to the Rocky Mountains.

companies.name: Atwood Oceanics
companies.description: Atwood Oceanics, Inc. was an offshore drilling contractor headquartered in Houston, Texas. The company operated in the petroleum industry and was acquired by Ensco plc in October 2017.

companies.name: AuRico Gold
companies.description: AuRico Gold was a Canadian intermediate gold mining and exploration company that operated primarily in Mexico until August 2011. It also held assets in silver and copper and reached intermediate gold producer status after Northgate Minerals agreed to be taken over.

companies.name: AudioBoom
companies.description: AudioBoom PLC is a UK-based on-demand audio and podcasting distribution platform. It provides business-to-business services to the radio, media, and podcast industries.

companies.name: Aurobindo Pharma
companies.description: Aurobindo Pharma Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company based in Hyderabad with U.S. headquarters in New Jersey. It manufactures generic pharmaceuticals and active pharmaceutical ingredients across six major therapeutic areas and markets products in over 125 countries.

companies.name: América Latina Logística
companies.description: Rumo, formerly América Latina Logística (ALL), is a Brazilian logistics company focused on railway logistics. It is the largest company in Latin America in this segment and also provides transportation, port operations, and storage services.

companies.name: Australian Agricultural Company
companies.description: The Australian Agricultural Company (AACo) is a public-listed Australian company owning and operating feedlots and farms covering about seven million hectares in Queensland and the Northern Territory. It operates 18 cattle stations and two feedlots with over 456,000 beef cattle.

companies.name: Australian Ethical Investment
companies.description: Australian Ethical is an ethical investment management company based in Sydney, Australia. It is publicly listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX).

companies.name: bwin.party digital entertainment
companies.description: Bwin.Party Digital Entertainment was an online gambling company formed by the 2011 merger of PartyGaming plc and Bwin Interactive Entertainment AG. It was known for its online poker room PartyPoker, World Poker Tour, and sports betting brand Bwin.

companies.name: Australian Pharmaceutical Industries
companies.description: Australian Pharmaceutical Industries (API) is an Australian health and beauty company owned by Wesfarmers. It is involved in pharmaceutical distribution, retailing, and manufacturing, operating retail brands such as Soul Pattinson and Pharmacist Advice.

companies.name: AutoCanada
companies.description: AutoCanada Inc. is a North American automobile dealership group operating 81 franchised dealerships across Canada and Illinois, USA. It sells vehicles from 27 brands and operates used vehicle dealerships, auctions, and collision centres.

companies.name: AutoZone
companies.description: AutoZone, Inc. is an American retailer specializing in aftermarket automotive parts and accessories. Founded in 1979, it is the largest retailer of its kind in the United States. The company is headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee, and operates stores across the US, Mexico, Puerto Rico, Brazil, and the US Virgin Islands.

companies.name: Autotrader Ltd
companies.description: Autotrader Group plc is a British online marketplace and classified advertising business focused on the automotive sector. It is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index. The company operates primarily in the United Kingdom.

companies.name: Jeju Air
companies.description: Jeju Air Co., Ltd. is the first and largest low-cost airline in South Korea. Named after Jeju Island, it is headquartered in Jeju City with its main base at Jeju International Airport. The airline was a founding member of the Value Alliance.

companies.name: AvalonBay
companies.description: AvalonBay Communities, Inc. was a publicly traded real estate investment trust focused on apartment investments. In August 2026, it merged with Equity Residential to form Vivmark Residential. The company operated in the United States.

companies.name: Avalon Rare Metals
companies.description: Avalon Advanced Materials Inc. is a Canadian mineral development company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. It focuses primarily on rare metals and minerals, with principal assets including the Nechalacho Project and others in Nova Scotia and Ontario.

companies.name: Avanza
companies.description: Avanza Bank Holding AB is a Swedish online bank based in Stockholm specializing in savings, investments, and pensions. It is the largest stockbroker in Sweden and on the Stockholm Stock Exchange. The bank serves over two million customers and holds a significant share of the Swedish savings market.

companies.name: Aviat Networks
companies.description: Aviat Networks, Inc. is a global provider of microwave transport and backhaul solutions. It supplies communications infrastructure to both public and private telecommunications operators and enterprise customers. The company operates internationally.

companies.name: Avista
companies.description: Avista Corporation is an American energy company that generates and transmits electricity and distributes natural gas. It serves residential, commercial, and industrial customers across parts of Washington, Idaho, and Oregon. The company employs approximately 1,550 people and covers a service territory of 30,000 square miles.

companies.name: Avita Medical
companies.description: Avita Medical is an Australian clinical and commercial company developing regenerative medicine products. Its first product was ReCell spray-on skin for burn treatment. Other products include PermeaDerm and Cohealyx, which are used for wound coverage and treatment of severe wounds and burns.

companies.name: Avnet
companies.description: Avnet, Inc. is a distributor of electronic components headquartered in Tempe, Arizona. Founded in 1921 by Charles Avnet, the company was incorporated in 1955 and began trading on the New York Stock Exchange in 1961. It later moved its stock listing to Nasdaq in 2018.

companies.name: Avocet Mining
companies.description: Avocet Mining plc is a gold mining and exploration company focused on West Africa, with primary operations in Burkina Faso and Guinea. It is based in the United Kingdom and is listed on the London Stock Exchange and the Oslo Børs.

companies.name: Tiso Blackstar Group
companies.description: Arena Holdings, formerly known as Tiso Blackstar Group, is a South African media company headquartered in Johannesburg. It publishes major South African newspapers including the Sunday Times and Business Day. The company adopted its current name in 2019 after acquisition by Lebashe Investment Group.

companies.name: Hyundai Marine & Fire Insurance
companies.description: Hyundai Marine & Fire Insurance Co., Ltd. is an insurance company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. It is one of the largest non-life insurers in South Korea alongside Samsung Fire & Marine, DB Insurance, and KB Insurance.

companies.name: LG Display
companies.description: LG Display Co., Ltd. is a major manufacturer and supplier of TFT-LCD panels, OLEDs, and flexible displays. Headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, it operates nine fabrication and seven assembly facilities across South Korea, China, Poland, and Mexico.

companies.name: Nong Shim Ltd.
companies.description: Nongshim Co., Ltd. is a South Korean multinational food and beverage company headquartered in Seoul. Founded in 1965 as Lotte Food Industrial Company, it changed its name to Nongshim in 1978.

companies.name: Axcelis Technologies
companies.description: Axcelis Technologies, Inc. is an American company that designs, manufactures, and services capital equipment for the semiconductor industry worldwide. It produces ion implantation and curing systems used in semiconductor chip fabrication. The company is headquartered in Beverly, Massachusetts and was incorporated in 1995.

companies.name: Azarab Industries Company
companies.description: AzarAb Industries is an Iranian manufacturing corporation located in Arak. It constructs power plants, factories, petrochemical plants, and refineries for sugar, oil, and gas. As of 2005, it employed more than 2,500 people.

companies.name: Azurix
companies.description: Azurix Corp. is a water services company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It owned and operated facilities in North America, Europe, and South America. In 2007, it was awarded a $165 million claim against the government of Argentina and is involved in a dispute over payment.

companies.name: BBVA Peru
companies.description: BBVA Perú is a Peruvian bank and a subsidiary of Holding Continental, which holds 92.08% of its equity. It operates in the banking sector in Peru.

companies.name: BE Aerospace
companies.description: B/E Aerospace, Inc. was a manufacturer of aircraft passenger cabin interior products for commercial and business jet aircraft markets. Based in Wellington, Florida, it served airlines, aircraft manufacturers, and leasing companies worldwide. The company held leading market shares in its major product lines.

companies.name: BGC Partners
companies.description: BGC Group, Inc. is a global financial services company based in New York City and London. It was originally part of Cantor Fitzgerald and became an independent entity in 2004. The company operates in the finance sector.

companies.name: BJ's Restaurant & Brewery
companies.description: BJ's Restaurants, Inc. is an American restaurant chain headquartered in Huntington Beach, California. It operates under several names including BJ's Restaurant & Brewery and BJ's Pizza & Grill. The company is part of the consumer goods and retail industry.

companies.name: CJ Group
companies.description: CJ Corporation, known as CJ Group, is a South Korean conglomerate headquartered in Seoul. It operates internationally across various industries including food, bio, logistics, retail, entertainment, and media. It originated from Cheil Jedang, Samsung's first manufacturing business founded in 1953.

companies.name: Vibra Energia
companies.description: Vibra Energia is the largest distributor and marketer of petroleum derivatives and biofuels in Brazil and Latin America. Headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, it was a Petrobras subsidiary until 2021 and operates over 8,000 gas stations in Brazil.

companies.name: Korea New Network
