companies.description: The Korea New Network (KNN) is the largest regional free-to-air commercial broadcaster based in Centum City, Busan, South Korea. Affiliated with SBS, it began official broadcasts in 1995 and produces about 35 percent of its own programming as of 2011.

companies.name: BWX Technologies
companies.description: BWX Technologies, Inc. is an American company headquartered in Lynchburg, Virginia. It supplies nuclear components and fuel internationally, operating in the renewables and utilities sector.

companies.name: BW Offshore
companies.description: BW Offshore Limited is a global owner and operator of floating production storage and offloading vessels. Headquartered in Singapore and Oslo, Norway, it operates internationally and is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange. BW Group Limited owns nearly half of the company.

companies.name: B&M
companies.description: B & M Retail Limited, trading as B&M, is a British multinational variety store and garden centre chain founded in 1978 and based in Liverpool, England. It is part of B&M European Value Retail plc, which also owns Heron Foods and operates B&M stores in France.

companies.name: B Communications Ltd
companies.description: Bezeq is an Israeli telecommunications company offering fixed-line, mobile telephony, high-speed Internet, fiber Internet transmission, and pay TV services. It operates in the telecommunications industry in Israel.

companies.name: Bachoco
companies.description: Industrias Bachoco, S.A. de C.V., known as Bachoco, is a Mexican poultry producer. It operates in preparing feed, breeding and growing chickens, and processing and distributing chicken products. The company also engages in swine farming.

companies.name: Backblaze
companies.description: Backblaze, Inc. is an American cloud storage and data backup company based in San Mateo, California. Founded in 2007, it provides services for both business and personal markets.

companies.name: Woori Financial Group
companies.description: Woori Financial Group is a Seoul-based banking and financial services holding company. It is recognized as the largest bank in South Korea.

companies.name: Gravity Corporation
companies.description: Gravity Co., Ltd. is a South Korean video game corporation. It is primarily known for developing the massively multiplayer online role-playing game Ragnarok Online.

companies.name: Boston Properties
companies.description: BXP, Inc., known as Boston Properties, is a publicly traded real estate investment trust in the United States. It invests in premier workplaces across major cities including Boston, Los Angeles, and New York City.

companies.name: Baillie Gifford Shin Nippon
companies.description: Baillie Gifford Shin Nippon is a publicly traded investment trust based in the United Kingdom. It invests in Japanese smaller companies and is managed by Edinburgh-based Baillie Gifford & Co Limited.

companies.name: Bajaj Electricals
companies.description: Bajaj Electricals Ltd. is an Indian consumer electrical equipment manufacturer headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra. It is part of the Bajaj Group and has diversified interests including lighting, appliances, and engineering projects.

companies.name: Bakrie Group
companies.description: The Bakrie Group is an Indonesian conglomerate founded in 1942 by Achmad Bakrie. It holds ownership in various industries such as mining, oil and gas, property development, and telecommunications.

companies.name: BancFirst
companies.description: BancFirst Corporation is a financial services holding company based in Oklahoma, United States. It operates three subsidiary banks including BancFirst, Pegasus Bank, and Worthington Bank.

companies.name: Banco Cruzeiro do Sul
companies.description: Banco Cruzeiro do Sul was a Brazil-based bank focused on consumer financing. The bank was declared bankrupt on August 11, 2015.

companies.name: Bank of Brasilia
companies.description: BRB Banco de Brasília S.A, commonly known as Banco de Brasília, is a state-owned Brazilian bank controlled by the Federal District government. It offers various financial products including savings accounts, credit cards, investment services, insurance, and loans. Founded in 1983, it is headquartered in Brasília, DF, and is listed on the B3 stock exchange in São Paulo.

companies.name: Cadence Bank
companies.description: Cadence Bank was a commercial bank with dual headquarters in Tupelo, Mississippi, and Houston, Texas. It operated in multiple states including Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Mississippi, Missouri, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Texas, and Illinois.

companies.name: Banco do Estado do Espírito Santo
companies.description: Banestes is a Brazilian state-owned bank responsible for public loan execution in the state of Espírito Santo. It serves as a major instrument for the state's economic development.

companies.name: Bangkok Land
companies.description: Bangkok Land Public Company Limited is a real estate company based in Thailand. It is known for developing Muang Thong Thani, a large residential project in Pak Kret, Nonthaburi Province, a northern suburb of Bangkok.

companies.name: BankAtlantic
companies.description: BankAtlantic was a US bank operating in Florida until its acquisition by BB&T Corporation in 2012. It provided consumer and business banking services throughout Florida.

companies.name: BankUnited
companies.description: BankUnited, Inc. is the holding company of BankUnited, N.A., a national bank founded in 1984 and headquartered in Miami Lakes, Florida. It operates in Florida and several other US regions including Atlanta, Dallas, Morristown, Charlotte, and the New York metropolitan area.

companies.name: Danamon of Indonesia
companies.description: PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk is an Indonesian bank established in 1956. It is the sixth largest bank in Indonesia by asset size.

companies.name: Bank Maskan
companies.description: Bank Maskan, also known as the Housing Bank, is a bank based in Iran.

companies.name: Bank Mellat
companies.description: Bank Mellat is an active Iranian bank established in 1980 through the merger of ten private banks. Its name means 'Bank of the Nation' and it started with a paid capital of 33.5 billion Rials.

companies.name: Bank Millennium
companies.description: Bank Millennium S.A. is a commercial bank based in Warsaw, Poland. It is considered one of the most systemically important banks in the country.

companies.name: Bank Ochrony Środowiska
companies.description: Bank Ochrony Środowiska S.A. is a Polish bank that started operations in 1991. It specializes in financing projects that contribute to environmental protection. The bank has allocated significant funds to support ecological projects, resulting in notable environmental impacts.

companies.name: Bank Pasargad
companies.description: Bank Pasargad is a major Iranian bank established in 2005 during the privatization of Iran's banking system. It offers retail, commercial, and investment banking services. The bank is also known by the acronym BPI.

companies.name: Woori Bank of Indonesia
companies.description: Bank Woori Saudara is an Indonesian financial institution founded in 1906 by merchants in Bandung, West Java. It provides banking products such as savings and checking accounts, fixed deposits, and credit loans. The bank serves customers across Indonesia.

companies.name: Bank of Florida
companies.description: Bank of Florida Corporation was a bank holding company based in Naples, Florida. It operated three separate banks serving different regions: Southwest, Southeast, and Tampa Bay. The company was focused on banking services within Florida.

companies.name: Bank of Hawaii
companies.description: The Bank of Hawaii Corporation is a regional commercial bank headquartered in Honolulu, Hawaii. It is the state's second oldest and largest locally owned bank, with the majority of voting stockholders residing in Hawaii. The bank operates four business segments including retail and commercial banking.

companies.name: Bank of New Orleans
companies.description: Bank of New Orleans was a bank headquartered in Metairie, Louisiana, and a subsidiary of Louisiana Bancorp, Inc. It operated four branches within Louisiana. In 2015, it was acquired by Home Bancorp, Inc.

companies.name: Bank of Ningbo
companies.description: Bank of Ningbo Co., Ltd. is a city-based commercial bank headquartered in Ningbo, Zhejiang, China. As of 2015, it operated 30 branches across cities in the Yangtze River Delta area and other major cities including Beijing and Shenzhen.

companies.name: BNC Bank
companies.description: BNC Bank was a bank based in High Point, North Carolina, United States. Before its acquisition in 2017, it operated numerous branches across North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, and Haiti. It was taken over by Pinnacle Financial Partners in 2017.

companies.name: Bank of Queensland
companies.description: The Bank of Queensland is an Australian retail bank headquartered in Brisbane, Queensland. Founded originally as a building society in 1874, it operates numerous branches and ATMs across Australia. The bank also owns Virgin Money Australia and ME Bank.

companies.name: Bank of Syria and Overseas
companies.logo_file: Bank Syria and Over seas logo.jpg
companies.description: Bank of Syria and Overseas is one of the first private banks established in Syria, starting operations in January 2004. It is part of the BLOM Bank Group. The bank provides various banking services within Syria.

companies.name: Bankers Petroleum
companies.description: Bankers Petroleum Albania Ltd. is the dominant oil operator in Albania and a subsidiary of China's Geo-Jade Petroleum. It operates the Patos-Marinza oil field, the largest in Albania and one of the largest onshore fields in Europe. The company produces 95% of Albania's crude oil.

companies.name: Banmédica
companies.description: Banmédica is a private health insurance company based in Chile. It operates in the health sector providing insurance services.

companies.name: Banner Bank
companies.description: Banner Bank is a commercial bank chartered in Washington, United States. Founded in 1890, it is headquartered in Walla Walla, Washington.

companies.name: Banpu
companies.description: Banpu Public Company Limited is an energy company based in Thailand. Its core businesses include energy resources, energy generation, and energy technology. In 2012, it was ranked among the Forbes Global 2000 largest public companies.

companies.name: Banque Bemo Saudi Fransi
companies.description: Banque Bemo Saudi Fransi is a private bank in Syria. It was the first operational private bank in Syria in nearly 20 years when it launched in 2004. Its main shareholders are Lebanese Banque Bemo S.A.L. and Saudi Banque Saudi Fransi.

companies.name: Banco do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul
companies.description: Banrisul is a Brazilian bank and the largest in Southern Brazil. It primarily operates in Rio Grande do Sul with a network serving over 365 cities and maintains agencies in Miami and Grand Cayman.

companies.name: KT Corporation
companies.description: KT Corporation, formerly Korea Telecom, is a South Korean telecommunications company and mobile network operator. It is a major wireless carrier in South Korea.

companies.name: Doosan Group
companies.description: Doosan Group is a South Korean multinational conglomerate and the oldest running company in South Korea. It is the parent company of Bobcat and Škoda Power and was ranked among the world's top 10 largest heavy equipment manufacturers in 2018.

companies.name: Barnes Group
companies.description: Barnes Group Inc. is a global industrial technology and aerospace manufacturer and service provider based in the United States.

companies.name: Bassett Furniture
companies.description: Bassett Furniture Industries, Inc. is a furniture manufacturer and retailer headquartered in Bassett, Virginia, United States. Founded in 1902, it is one of the oldest furniture manufacturers in Virginia.

companies.name: Shinhan Bank
companies.description: Shinhan Bank Co., Ltd. is a South Korean bank headquartered in Seoul. Founded in 1982, it merged with Chohung Bank in 2006 and traces its origins to Hanseong Bank, one of Korea's first banks. It is part of the Shinhan Financial Group, which also includes Jeju Bank.

companies.name: Alexandria Real Estate Equities
companies.description: Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. is a real estate investment trust based in Pasadena, California. It invests in office buildings and laboratories leased to life science and technology tenants, often near universities. The company owns major campuses including the Alexandria Center for Life Science in Manhattan and properties in the Boston area.

companies.name: Compass RE
companies.description: Compass, Inc. is a residential real estate brokerage company operating in the United States. It has approximately 340,000 agents and associates, mostly independent contractors, and operates under multiple brand names including Compass, Century 21, and Sotheby's International Realty.

companies.name: Duke Realty
companies.description: Duke Realty was a real estate investment trust based in Indianapolis, Indiana, focusing on industrial properties. As of late 2021, it owned or controlled 548 industrial properties. In October 2022, it was acquired by Prologis.

companies.name: PPG Industries
companies.description: PPG Industries, Inc. is an American supplier of paints, coatings, and specialty materials headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It operates globally in over 70 countries and is the second largest coatings company by revenue. Its headquarters is located in PPG Place, known for its glass facade designed by Philip Johnson.

companies.name: RPM International
companies.description: RPM International Inc. is an American multinational company that manufactures and markets specialty coatings, sealants, and building materials. Its industrial brands include Tremco and Carboline, while consumer brands include Rust-Oleum and DAP. The products serve professionals, DIY users, and hobbyists.

companies.name: Beacon Power
companies.description: Beacon Power, LLC is an American company headquartered in Tyngsboro, Massachusetts, specializing in flywheel-based energy storage. Founded in 1997, it is a wholly owned subsidiary of RGA Investments LLC and designs products for utility frequency regulation in power grid operations.

companies.name: Beasley Broadcast Group
companies.description: Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc. is a radio station owner and operator based in Naples, Florida. As of October 2026, it owns 47 radio stations under the Beasley Media Group name across the United States.

companies.name: Biocon
companies.description: Biocon Limited is an Indian biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Bengaluru with U.S. headquarters in Bridgewater, New Jersey. Founded in 1978, it manufactures generic active pharmaceutical ingredients and novel biologics, including biosimilar insulins and antibodies, sold in about 120 countries.

companies.name: Beazer Homes USA
companies.description: Beazer Homes USA, Inc. is a home construction company based in Atlanta, Georgia. In 2016, it was the 11th largest home builder in the United States by homes closed and operates in 13 states.

companies.name: Bebe Stores
companies.description: Bebe Stores, Inc. is a women's retail brand established in 1976 in the United States. It develops and produces women's apparel, accessories, and perfume fragrances marketed under the Bebe, Bebe Sport, and Bebe Outlet names.

companies.name: Desktop Metal
companies.description: Desktop Metal, Inc. is an American technology company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts. It designs and markets 3D printing systems and was named a Technology Pioneer by the World Economic Forum in 2017.

companies.name: Tyler Technologies
companies.description: Tyler Technologies, Inc. is a technology company based in Plano, Texas, that provides proprietary software to the U.S. public sector. It has offices in 17 U.S. states and one in Toronto, Canada.

companies.name: Behran Oil Company
companies.description: Behran Oil Company is an oil refining company headquartered in Tehran, Iran. It exports its products to more than 40 countries.

companies.name: Beijing Jingneng Power Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Beijing Jingneng Power Co., Ltd. is a coal power producer and district heating supplier based in Beijing, China. It is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Aphria
companies.description: Aphria Inc., headquartered in Leamington, Ontario, Canada, was an international producer and distributor of medicinal and recreational cannabis. It operated through retail and wholesale channels in Canada and internationally.

companies.name: HNA Technology Co., Ltd.
companies.description: HNA Technology Co., Ltd., formerly Tianjin Tianhai Investment Co., Ltd., is a Chinese holding company specializing in marine transportation services. It served as the investment vehicle of HNA Group to acquire Ingram Micro and is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

companies.name: goeasy
companies.description: goeasy Ltd. is a Canadian alternative financial services company based in Mississauga, Ontario. It operates three business units: easyfinancial for loans to non-prime borrowers, easyhome for lease-to-own furniture sales, and LendCare for point-of-sale consumer financing.

companies.name: Semrush
companies.description: Semrush Holdings, Inc. is an American software company and a wholly owned subsidiary of Adobe Inc. It provides a platform with tools for SEO, AI search visibility, competitor analysis, content marketing, paid advertising, and website auditing.

companies.name: Bellway
companies.description: Bellway plc is a residential property developer and housebuilder based in Newcastle upon Tyne, England. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Korea Aerospace Industries
companies.description: Korea Aerospace Industries, Ltd. is a South Korean aerospace and defense manufacturer. It was originally a joint venture of Daewoo Heavy Industries' aerospace division, Samsung Aerospace, and Hyundai Space and Aircraft. The company became more independent in 1999 after acquiring aerospace interests from its founding members.

companies.name: Benchmark Electronics
companies.description: Benchmark Electronics Inc. is an American engineering and manufacturing company headquartered in Tempe, Arizona. Founded in 1979, it provides engineering and manufacturing services to original equipment manufacturers in industries such as aerospace, defense, medical, and advanced computing.

companies.name: Bendigo Bank
companies.description: Bendigo and Adelaide Bank is an Australian financial institution primarily operating in retail banking. The company was formed by the merger of Bendigo Bank and Adelaide Bank in November 2007.

companies.name: Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group
companies.description: Chow Tai Fook group is a Hong Kong–based, privately owned conglomerate with holdings in jewellery, property development, hotels, and other sectors. It is partially listed on the stock market via associate company New World Development and subsidiary Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group Limited.

companies.name: Bennett Environmental
companies.description: Bennett Environmental Inc. was a Canadian company based in Oakville, Ontario. It specialized in recovering soils contaminated with chlorinated hydrocarbons, including PCBs, PCPs, dioxins, and furans.

companies.name: ESTsoft
companies.description: ESTsoft is a South Korean application software development company founded in 1993. It develops software ranging from desktop to business applications and provides AI-based services mainly in a Software-as-a-Service format. The company listed on the KOSDAQ market in 2008.

companies.name: Automatic Data Processing
companies.description: Automatic Data Processing, Inc. (ADP) is an American multinational company headquartered in Roseland, New Jersey. It provides cloud-based human resources management, payroll processing, and professional employer organization services.

companies.name: Berkeley Group Holdings
companies.description: The Berkeley Group Holdings plc is a British property developer and house-builder based in Cobham, England. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Naver Corporation
companies.description: Naver Corporation is a South Korean multinational internet conglomerate headquartered in Seongnam. It operates the search engine Naver and pioneered user-generated content with its online Q&A platform Knowledge iN.

companies.name: Herman Miller
companies.description: Herman Miller is an American furniture and design brand based in Zeeland, Michigan. It is known for its modern furniture designs created in collaboration with notable designers such as Charles and Ray Eames. The company is credited with inventing the office cubicle in 1968.

companies.name: Berry Plastics
companies.description: Berry Global Group, Inc. is a global manufacturer and marketer of plastic packaging products headquartered in Evansville, Indiana. It operates over 265 facilities worldwide and employs more than 46,000 people. The company was once a Fortune 500 entity.

companies.name: Best & Less
companies.description: Best & Less is an Australian retailer specializing in clothing and household linens. As of October 2022, it operates 182 stores and also offers products through an online platform. The company is based in Australia.

companies.name: Delphi Technologies
companies.description: Delphi Technologies was an independent automotive company in the United States from 2017 until its acquisition by BorgWarner Inc. in 2020. In 2023, BorgWarner spun off Delphi Technologies along with Delco Remy and Hartridge into a separate publicly traded company named PHINIA.

companies.name: NeoGenomics
companies.description: NeoGenomics Laboratories, Inc. is an American clinical laboratory specializing in cancer genetics diagnostic testing. It offers services including cytogenetics, FISH, flow cytometry, immunohistochemistry, anatomic pathology, and molecular genetics. The company is CLIA-certified.

companies.name: Berkshire Bank
companies.description: Berkshire Bank was an American bank headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, operating branches in New England and New York. It was the third largest regional bank based in Massachusetts before merging with Brookline Bancorp to form Beacon Bank.

companies.name: PagerDuty
companies.description: PagerDuty, Inc. is an American cloud computing company that provides a SaaS incident management platform for IT operations departments. The company specializes in technology solutions for managing IT incidents.

companies.name: Ichitan
companies.description: Ichitan Group Co., Ltd. is a Thai beverage company that produces green tea drinks, herbal drinks, fruit drinks, and energy drinks. It is based in Thailand and operates in the food and beverage industry.

companies.name: MNC Corporation
companies.description: PT MNC Asia Holding Tbk, known as the MNC Group, is an Indonesian conglomerate founded in 1989. It operates in mineral resources, mass media, and investment sectors. The company is based in Indonesia.

companies.name: Bharat Forge
companies.description: Bharat Forge Limited is an Indian multinational company involved in forging and various industries including automotive, energy, construction, mining, railways, marine, aerospace, and defense. It is based in India.

companies.name: Amorepacific Corporation
companies.description: Amorepacific Corporation is a South Korean beauty and cosmetics chaebol operating over 30 brands including Sulwhasoo and Laneige. Founded in 1945 by Sungwhan Suh, it is the largest cosmetics company in South Korea and among the top ten globally.

companies.name: CCB Brasil
companies.description: CCB Brasil, formerly BicBanco, is a mid-sized Brazilian bank founded in 1938 in Juazeiro do Norte. It is headquartered in São Paulo and was acquired by China Construction Bank in 2013 after the founding family sold their shares.

companies.name: Bic Camera
companies.description: Bic Camera, Inc. is a Japanese consumer electronics retailer with 45 stores across 17 prefectures. It owns 50% of Kojima and fully owns Sofmap, a computer store chain.

companies.name: Biffa
companies.description: Biffa Limited is a UK-based waste management company providing collection, landfill, recycling, and special waste services. Headquartered in High Wycombe, it was the UK's second-largest waste management firm in 2017 and was acquired by Energy Capital Partners in 2023.

companies.name: Big Lots
companies.description: Big Lots Stores, Inc. is an American discount retail chain specializing in closeout and overstock merchandise. Founded in 1967 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, it operates over 200 locations across the United States.

companies.name: Big Rock Brewery
companies.description: Big Rock Brewery is a Canadian public company and the largest brewery based in Calgary, Alberta. It is also Canada's largest craft brewery and distributes a variety of beers and ciders nationwide.

companies.name: Big Yellow Group
companies.description: Big Yellow Group plc is a self-storage company headquartered in Bagshot, England. It is the largest self-storage firm in the UK and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Bill Barrett Corporation
companies.description: Bill Barrett Corporation was an energy company based in Denver, Colorado, focused on natural gas and oil exploration and development in the Rocky Mountains region of the United States.

companies.name: Shinhan Financial Group
companies.description: Shinhan Financial Group Co., Ltd. is a financial holding company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Founded in 1982, it offers banking, securities, life insurance, and investment banking services and is one of Korea's Big Five financial groups.

companies.name: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Durham, North Carolina. It develops medicines for hereditary angioedema and rare diseases, with FDA-approved antiviral drugs peramivir and berotralstat.

companies.name: BioGaia
companies.description: BioGaia is a Swedish biotechnology company that develops, markets, and sells probiotic products. It has patented several Lactobacillus reuteri strains and offers products for gut, immune, and oral health. BioGaia's shares are listed on the NASDAQ OMX Nordic Exchange.

companies.name: Bioline Rx Ltd.
companies.description: BioLineRx Ltd. is a publicly traded drug development company headquartered in Israel. Its shares are traded on the NASDAQ Capital Market and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

companies.name: BioMarin Pharmaceutical
companies.description: BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc. is an American biotechnology company based in San Rafael, California. It focuses on enzyme replacement therapies and was the first to provide therapeutics for mucopolysaccharidosis type I and phenylketonuria.

companies.name: Korea Gas Corporation
companies.description: The Korea Gas Corporation (KOGAS) is a South Korean state-owned natural gas company established in 1983. It operates five LNG regasification terminals and pipelines supplying 216 cities and counties, making it one of the world's largest buyers of liquefied natural gas.

companies.name: Biohit
companies.description: Biohit Oyj is a Finnish company that develops, manufactures, and markets biotech and diagnostics products for research and healthcare use.

companies.name: Biotie Therapies
companies.description: Biotie Therapies Oyj was a Finnish biotechnology and pharmaceutics company focused on drugs for neurodegenerative, psychiatric, and liver diseases. It was headquartered in Turku, Finland, and was acquired by Acorda Therapeutics in 2016.

companies.name: Birdstep Technology
companies.description: Birdstep Technology is a public company founded in 1996 and headquartered in Oslo, Norway. It provides Smart Mobile Data and Secure Mobility solutions globally for operators, enterprises, and governments.

companies.name: Hanwha Life Insurance
companies.description: Hanwha Life Insurance is an insurance company and part of the Hanwha Group. It had total assets exceeding 100 trillion won as of the end of 2023.

companies.name: Nichirei
companies.description: Nichirei Corporation is a leading Japanese producer of frozen foods and cold storage warehousing based in Tokyo. It operates through about 80 subsidiaries worldwide and is involved in processed food, logistics, marine products, real estate, and biosciences.

companies.name: MCOT
companies.description: MCOT Public Company Limited is a Thai state-owned public broadcaster based in Bangkok. It owns and operates multiple radio and television stations in Thailand.

companies.name: Land and Houses
companies.description: Land and Houses Public Company Limited is a large real estate company based in Thailand. Founded in 1983 by Ms Piangjai Harnpanij and her son, Mr Anant Asavabhokhin, it was listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand in 1991. The largest shareholder group is Mr Anant Asavabhokin and his family.

companies.name: GMM Grammy
companies.description: GMM Grammy Public Company Limited is the largest media conglomerate entertainment company in Thailand. It operates in music, concert production, artist management, film and television production, and publishing. The company features top Thai artists such as Bird Thongchai and Tata Young.

companies.name: Weathernews
companies.description: Weathernews Inc. is a Japanese weather forecasting company headquartered in Mihama Ward, Chiba City. It operates Weathernews LiVE, a 24/7 online live stream, and claims to be the largest privately owned weather company in the world as of 2024.

companies.name: Doosan Enerbility
companies.description: Doosan Enerbility Co., Ltd., formerly Doosan Heavy Industries, is a heavy industrial company headquartered in Changwon, South Korea. It operates in the heavy industry sector.

companies.name: BluePhoenix Solutions
companies.description: BluePhoenix Solutions Ltd. was a publicly traded company headquartered in Israel that developed and sold modernization services for legacy IT systems. Its shares were traded on the NASDAQ Global Market exchange.

companies.name: Blue Bird Corporation
companies.description: The Blue Bird Corporation is an American bus manufacturer headquartered in Fort Valley, Georgia. It is best known for producing school buses and has also manufactured transit buses, motorhomes, and specialty vehicles like mobile libraries and police command centers.

companies.name: Blue Nile Inc.
companies.description: Blue Nile Inc. is an American jewellery company based in New York City. It became a subsidiary of Bain Capital in 2017 and was acquired by Signet Jewelers in 2022.

companies.name: Boardwalk Real Estate Investment Trust
companies.description: Boardwalk Real Estate Investment Trust is an open-ended real estate investment trust that owns Boardwalk Communities, Structures Metropolitaines, and Boardwalk Retirement Community. It operates in Canada.

companies.name: Boart Longyear
companies.description: Boart Longyear is an international mineral exploration company founded in 1890 in the United States. Headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, it provides mineral exploration services and drilling products for mining and other sectors worldwide.

companies.name: deCODE genetics
companies.description: deCODE genetics is a biopharmaceutical company based in Reykjavík, Iceland, founded in 1996 by Kári Stefánsson. It focuses on population-level genetics studies to identify genome variations linked to common diseases for treatment and prevention.

companies.name: Axos Financial
companies.description: Axos Financial, Inc. is an American bank holding company based in Las Vegas, Nevada. It is the parent company of Axos Bank, a direct bank listed among the largest banks in the United States. The company also offers registered investment adviser services and an electronic trading platform.

companies.name: Boingo Wireless
companies.description: Boingo Wireless, Inc. is an American company that designs, builds, and manages wireless networks including distributed antenna systems, small cells, and macro towers. It operates over one million Wi-Fi hotspots worldwide and serves locations such as airports, stadiums, and military bases. The company moved its headquarters to Frisco, Texas in December 2022.

companies.name: SSE plc
companies.description: SSE plc is a British multinational electricity company headquartered in Perth, Scotland. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: SK Inc.
companies.description: SK Inc. is the holding company of South Korea's SK Group, headquartered in Seoul. It operates through Investment and Business Divisions, covering industries such as petroleum, telecommunications, chemicals, semiconductors, and biotechnology. It holds major subsidiaries including SK Innovation and SK Telecom.

companies.name: Bonheur
companies.description: Bonheur ASA is a publicly traded Norwegian holding company headquartered in Oslo. It is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange and has interests in energy, real estate, shipping, and media sectors. Its largest divisions include Renewable Energy, Wind Service, and Cruise.

companies.name: HiteJinro
companies.description: HiteJinro Co., Ltd. is a South Korean multinational drink, brewing, and distilling company founded in 1924. It is the world's leading producer of soju, accounting for over half of domestic sales. The company also produces other alcoholic beverages and bottled water, with distilleries in Icheon, Cheongwon, and Masan.

companies.name: Booker Group
companies.description: Booker Group Limited is a British wholesale distributor and a subsidiary of Tesco PLC. Tesco purchased the company in 2018.

companies.name: Books-A-Million
companies.description: Books-A-Million, Inc., also known as BAM!, is a bookstore chain in the United States operating 260 stores across 32 states. Stores sell books, magazines, collectibles, toys, technology, and gifts, and most feature Joe Muggs cafés. The stores operate under several names including Books-A-Million and 2nd & Charles.

companies.name: Boral
companies.description: Boral Limited is an Australian building and construction materials company. It is owned by Seven Group Holdings.

companies.name: Bosideng
companies.description: Bosideng International Holdings Limited is the largest down clothing company in China. It sells down clothing under six core brands, including Bosideng and Snow Flying, targeting various consumer segments. In 2023, it was ranked 462nd in the World's 500 Most Influential Brands list by World Brand Lab.

companies.name: Bovis Homes Group
companies.description: Vistry Group PLC, formerly Bovis Homes Group PLC, is a British home construction company based in Kings Hill, England. It acquired Galliford Try's housing arm in 2020 and renamed the combined business Vistry. It is one of the biggest housebuilders in the UK.

companies.name: Box
companies.description: Box, Inc. is an American public company based in Redwood City, California, that develops cloud-based content management and file sharing tools for businesses. Founded in 2005, it shifted focus from consumers to business users around 2009-2010. Its software enables file storage, collaboration, and security across devices.

companies.name: Brandywine Realty Trust
companies.description: Brandywine Realty Trust is a real estate investment trust based in Philadelphia. It invests in office buildings located in Philadelphia, Washington, D.C., and Austin, Texas.

companies.name: British Energy
companies.description: British Energy was the UK's largest electricity generation company by volume before its 2009 takeover by Électricité de France (EDF). It operated eight former UK state-owned nuclear power stations and one coal-fired power station.

companies.name: Brewin Dolphin
companies.description: RBC Brewin Dolphin is a British wealth management firm with over 30 offices across the UK, Jersey, and Ireland. It provides investment management and financial planning services to individuals, companies, intermediaries, and charities.

companies.name: KB Kookmin Bank
companies.description: Kookmin Bank, also known as KB Kookmin Bank, is a bank headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. It was the largest bank in Korea and ranked 60th largest worldwide as of 2017. The name is a contraction of Citizens National Bank, a former English name.

companies.name: Bright Horizons
companies.description: Bright Horizons Family Solutions Inc. is a US-based child-care provider headquartered in Newton, Massachusetts. It is the largest provider of employer-sponsored child care and also offers back-up child care, elder care, tuition program management, education advising, and student loan repayment programs.

companies.name: Brightcove
companies.description: Brightcove, Inc. is an American software company based in Boston, Massachusetts, producing an online video platform. Founded in 2004, it went public in 2012 and was acquired by Bending Spoons in 2025.

companies.name: Briscoe Group
companies.description: Briscoe Group Limited is a major retail company based in New Zealand operating 92 stores nationwide under the Briscoes Homeware and Rebel Sport brands. Established in Dunedin in 1861, it originally supplied goods to gold miners during the Otago gold rush. It remains one of New Zealand's most prominent retail businesses.

companies.name: Bristow Helicopters
companies.description: Bristow Helicopters Limited is a British civil helicopter operator founded in 1955 in Scotland and originally based at Aberdeen Airport. It is part of the US-based Bristow Group Inc, headquartered in Houston, Texas. In 2020, Bristow Group merged with Era Helicopters, continuing to use the Bristow name.

companies.name: Britannia Industries
companies.description: Britannia Industries Limited is an Indian multinational food products company selling biscuits, breads, and dairy products. Founded in 1892, it is one of India's oldest companies and part of the Wadia Group. About 80% of its revenues come from biscuit products as of 2023.

companies.name: Britvic
companies.description: Britvic Limited is a British soft drinks producer based in Hemel Hempstead, Hertfordshire. It produces soft drinks under the Britvic name, including Britvic Orange and other brands. The company originated in the 1930s as the British Vitamin Products Company and became part of Allied Breweries in 1968.

companies.name: Broadridge Financial Solutions
companies.description: Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. is a public financial technology company headquartered in Lake Success, New York. Founded in 2007 as a spin-off from Automatic Data Processing, it supplies financial documents and shareholder communications solutions to companies in the financial industry.

companies.name: Broadway Federal Bank
companies.description: Broadway Federal Bank was a community-focused bank founded in 1946 and based in Los Angeles. As of 2020, it operated three traditional branches and one loan production office.

companies.name: Brookdale Senior Living
companies.description: Brookdale Senior Living Solutions owns and operates retirement homes across the United States. Established in 1978 and based in Brentwood, Tennessee, it is the largest operator of senior housing in the US with over 51,000 residents as of December 31, 2025.

companies.name: Hyundai Mobis
companies.description: Hyundai Mobis Company Limited is a South Korean public car parts company and member of Hyundai Motor Group. Founded in 1977, it serves as the parts and service arm for Hyundai Motor Company, Genesis Motors, and Kia Motors. As of 2025, it was the world's sixth largest automotive supplier.

companies.name: Brown & Brown
companies.description: Brown & Brown, Inc. is an American insurance brokerage firm headquartered in Daytona Beach, Florida. It is one of the largest independent insurance intermediaries in the US, providing risk management solutions, insurance products, and services to various clients including businesses and governmental institutions.

companies.name: Chenming Paper
companies.description: Shandong Chenming Paper Holdings Limited, known as Chenming Paper, is a Chinese company engaged in paper pulp manufacturing, papermaking, and power generation. Based in Shouguang, Shandong, it is the largest papermaking enterprise in China and among the top 50 paper producers worldwide. It operates eight paper mills across China.

companies.name: Brødrene Hartmann
companies.description: Brødrene Hartmann A/S is a Danish company that manufactures moulded-fibre packaging, including egg and fruit packaging. It is the world’s leading manufacturer of moulded-fibre egg packaging and the largest manufacturer of technology for producing moulded-fibre packaging.

companies.name: Bsquare corporation
companies.description: Bsquare was a technology company based in Seattle, Washington, providing Internet of Things (IoT) systems software, device management, and professional development services. It supported OEMs, ODMs, and enterprises with OS licenses and system integration.

companies.name: Buckeye Partners
companies.description: Buckeye Partners is a petroleum distributor operating in the East and Midwest United States. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, it is one of the largest independent oil pipeline companies and a descendant of Standard Oil.

companies.name: Buckle
companies.description: The Buckle, Inc. is an American fashion retailer selling clothing, footwear, and accessories for men, women, and children. It operates 451 stores across 42 U.S. states under the names Buckle and The Buckle.

companies.name: Buhler Industries
companies.description: Buhler Industries, Inc. is a Canadian company headquartered in Winnipeg, Manitoba, manufacturing machinery for farms and construction. It operates eight factories across Canada and the United States.

companies.name: Fuji Electric
companies.description: Fuji Electric Co., Ltd. is a Japanese electrical equipment manufacturer producing pressure transmitters, flowmeters, gas analyzers, controllers, inverters, pumps, generators, ICs, motors, and power equipment. It operates under the brand name FE.

companies.name: W. R. Grace and Company
companies.description: W. R. Grace and Company is an American chemical business based in Columbia, Maryland. It produces specialty chemicals and materials through its Performance Catalyst Solutions and Material Technologies divisions.

companies.name: Serco Group
companies.description: Serco Group plc is a British multinational company headquartered in Hook, Hampshire, England. It provides services in defence, health, space, justice, migration, customer services, and transport across Europe, the Middle East, Asia Pacific, and North America.

companies.name: Varian Medical Systems
companies.description: Varian Medical Systems is an American company based in Palo Alto, California, that manufactures radiation oncology treatment devices and software. Its products include linear accelerators and software for cancer treatment and clinic management, with manufacturing sites worldwide.

companies.name: Invacare
companies.description: Invacare is a global manufacturer and distributor of non-acute medical equipment such as wheelchairs and mobility scooters. Headquartered in Elyria, Ohio, it operates worldwide and emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2024.

companies.name: BurgerFuel
companies.description: BurgerFuel is a New Zealand-based burger restaurant and franchise with 72 locations across three countries, including 60 in New Zealand. It operates in the restaurant industry, focusing on burger offerings.

companies.name: Burlington
companies.description: Burlington Stores is an American off-price retailer with over 1,287 stores in 47 states and Puerto Rico. Headquartered in Burlington, New Jersey, it is a division of Burlington Coat Factory Warehouse Corporation and is the third largest off-price retailer in the U.S.

companies.name: DreamWorks Animation
companies.description: DreamWorks Animation L.L.C. is an American animation studio owned by Comcast's NBCUniversal. It has produced 54 feature films since its first release in 1998 and is part of Universal Filmed Entertainment Group.

companies.name: Busey Bank
companies.description: First Busey Bank is a financial institution headquartered in Champaign, Illinois, operating in 10 states. It is owned by First Busey Holding, a financial holding company.

companies.name: Bard
companies.description: C. R. Bard, Inc. was a medical technology company based in Murray Hill, New Jersey, specializing in vascular medicine, urology, oncology, and surgical specialties. It is known for introducing the Foley catheter in 1934.

companies.name: CBL Properties
companies.description: CBL & Associates Properties, Inc. is a real estate investment trust headquartered in Chattanooga, Tennessee. It invests primarily in shopping centers and malls in the Southeastern and Midwestern United States.

companies.name: CCL Industries
companies.description: CCL Industries, Inc. is an American-Canadian company founded in 1951 and described as the world's largest label maker. It operates five divisions and has 154 manufacturing facilities worldwide.

companies.name: CDI Corporation
companies.description: CDI Corporation was a privately held US company headquartered in Houston, Texas, providing engineering, procurement, construction management, and staffing services across various industries including energy and chemical manufacturing.

companies.name: CHS Inc.
companies.description: CHS Inc. is a Fortune 500 secondary cooperative based in Inver Grove Heights, Minnesota. It is owned by agricultural cooperatives and farmers, operating food processing, wholesale, farm supply, financial services, and retail businesses.

companies.name: CITIC Press Group
companies.description: CITIC Press Group is a Beijing-based publishing company founded in 1988 and a subsidiary of the state-owned CITIC Group. It engages in digital and physical book retail and provides professional education.

companies.name: CI Financial
companies.description: CI Financial is a Canadian investment management company based in Toronto, Ontario. It provides investment and wealth management services to high net worth retail investors, as well as brokerage and trading services to portfolio managers and institutional investors.

companies.name: CK Life Sciences
companies.description: CK Life Sciences International (Holdings) Inc. is a Hong Kong-based biotechnology company and a subsidiary of CK Hutchison Holdings. It focuses on research, development, commercialization, marketing, and sale of biotechnology products. The chairman is Victor Li Tzar-kuoi.

companies.name: CLECO
companies.description: Cleco Corporate Holdings LLC is an electric power company headquartered in Pineville, Louisiana. It operates Cleco Power, a regulated electric utility serving about 290,000 retail customers in Louisiana, and also runs an unregulated wholesale electricity business.

companies.name: CMC Electronics Inc.
companies.description: CMC Electronics Inc. is a Canadian avionics manufacturer with its main facility in Montreal, Quebec. It also has additional manufacturing locations in Sugar Grove, Illinois, and Reston, Virginia.

companies.name: CMS Energy
companies.description: CMS Energy Corporation is an American energy company based in Jackson, Michigan. Its main business is Consumers Energy, a public utility providing electricity and natural gas to over 6 million Michigan residents. Consumers Energy has been operating since 1886.

companies.name: CNA Financial
companies.description: CNA Financial Corporation is a financial company based in Chicago, Illinois. Its principal subsidiaries include Continental Casualty Company, founded in 1897, and The Continental Insurance Company, organized in 1853. CNA was incorporated in 1967.

companies.name: COSCO Shipping International (Hong Kong)
companies.description: COSCO Shipping International Co., Ltd. is a Hong Kong-listed company and an indirect subsidiary of COSCO Shipping. It engages in ship trading and supplying services and has been listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong since 1992.

companies.name: COSCO Shipping Ports
companies.description: COSCO Shipping Ports Limited is a Hong Kong-listed company and investor in ports. Formerly known as COSCO Pacific Limited, it is part of COSCO Shipping and is mainly engaged in container terminal operations, container manufacturing and leasing, shipping agency, and freight forwarding.

companies.name: CRA International
companies.description: CRA International, Inc. is a global consulting firm headquartered in Boston. It provides expert testimony, litigation support, strategic advice, and analysis to law firms, corporations, accounting firms, and governments.

companies.name: CRISIL
companies.description: CRISIL Limited is headquartered in Andheri, Mumbai, India. Established in 1987 as India's first credit rating agency, it is now a subsidiary of the American company S&P Global.

companies.name: CSG Holding
companies.description: CSG Holding Limited, formerly China Southern Glass Holding Limited, is the largest architectural glass manufacturer in China. It manufactures and sells various glass products including float, architectural, display, automotive, coated, mirrors, color filter, solar, and conservation glass.

companies.name: CSS Industries
companies.description: CSS Industries, Inc., founded in 1923 as City Stores Company, is headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The company designs, manufactures, and distributes seasonal and everyday greeting cards and novelties, with showrooms in New York City, Memphis, Minneapolis, and Hong Kong.

companies.name: CXense
companies.description: Cxense ASA was a technology company founded in Oslo, Norway in 2010 by John Markus Lervik. In 2019, it was acquired by Piano Software Inc. and subsequently removed from the Oslo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Zydus Cadila
companies.description: Zydus Lifesciences Limited, formerly Cadila Healthcare Limited, is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Ahmedabad, India. It primarily manufactures generic drugs and was ranked 100th in the Fortune India 500 list in 2020.

companies.name: CafePress
companies.description: CafePress, Inc. is an American online retailer offering a wide range of consumer items including clothing, home decor, drinkware, stationery, gifts, and customized on-demand products. Founded in San Mateo, California, it is now headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky, where its production facility is located. In 2001, CafePress.com won the People's Voice Webby Award in Commerce.

companies.name: Cahya Mata Sarawak Berhad
companies.description: Cahya Mata Sarawak Berhad (CMSB) is a Malaysian investment holding company listed on Bursa Malaysia. It operates in Sarawak and is involved in manufacturing cement and construction materials, road construction and maintenance, undersea pipeline laying, dam construction, smelting, property development, financial services, and education.

companies.name: Cal-Maine
companies.description: Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. is an American fresh egg producer based in Ridgeland, Mississippi. Founded in 1957 by Fred R. Adams, Jr., the company is the largest egg producer in the United States and sells eggs under various brand names including Egg-Land's Best and Land O'Lakes.

companies.name: Calfrac Well Services
companies.description: Calfrac Well Services Ltd. is an oilfield services company operating in Canada, the United States, and Argentina. It provides hydraulic fracturing, coiled tubing, cementing, and other well stimulation services to enhance oil and natural gas production.

companies.name: Calgon Carbon
companies.description: Calgon Carbon Corporation, based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, manufactures and markets products that remove contaminants and odors from liquids and gases. Its products, often using activated carbon, serve industrial, municipal, and consumer markets.

companies.name: Leidos
companies.description: Leidos Holdings, Inc. is an American defense, aviation, IT, and biomedical research company headquartered in Reston, Virginia. It provides scientific, engineering, systems integration, and technical services, and was formed by merging SAIC with Lockheed Martin's IT sector in 2016. Leidos contracts extensively with U.S. government agencies including the Department of Defense and Homeland Security.

companies.name: Calix
companies.description: Calix, Inc. is a telecommunications company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Jose, California. It specializes in providing software platforms, systems, and services to support the delivery of broadband services.

companies.name: Capricorn Energy
companies.description: Capricorn Energy plc is a British oil and gas exploration and development company based in Edinburgh, Scotland. It operates in the petroleum industry.

companies.name: Hammerson
companies.description: Hammerson is a major British property development and investment company that converted to real estate investment trust (REIT) status in the UK in January 2007.

companies.name: Lear Corporation
companies.description: Lear Corporation is an American manufacturer of automotive seating and electrical systems. It is recognized as a Fortune 500 company.

companies.name: Calpine
companies.description: Calpine Corporation was a Fortune 500 company based in Houston, Texas. It was the largest generator of electricity from natural gas and geothermal energy in the United States.

companies.name: Johnson Matthey
companies.description: Johnson Matthey plc is a British multinational speciality chemicals and sustainable technologies company headquartered in London, England. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Cambrex Corporation
companies.description: Cambrex Corporation is a contract manufacturing organization operating in the pharmaceutical industry.

companies.name: Camden Property Trust
companies.description: Camden Property Trust is a publicly traded real estate investment trust investing in apartments across the United States. It is the 14th largest owner of apartments in the country.

companies.name: ALS Limited
companies.description: ALS Limited is an Australian company headquartered in Brisbane that provides testing, inspection, certification, and verification services. It operates from over 370 sites across 65 countries. In 2012, ALS Limited was inducted into the Queensland Business Leaders Hall of Fame.

companies.name: Camurus
companies.description: Camurus AB is a Swedish research-based pharmaceutical and biotechnology company specializing in medicines for serious and chronic diseases. Founded in 1991, it is based in Lund, Sweden, within the Medicon Valley region. The company is publicly listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, Mid Cap.

companies.name: United Utilities
companies.description: United Utilities Group plc is the largest listed water company in the United Kingdom. Founded in 1995 from a merger, it manages the regulated water and wastewater network in North West England, serving over seven million people. Its service area includes Cumbria, Greater Manchester, Lancashire, Merseyside, Cheshire, and parts of Derbyshire.

companies.name: S&P/TSX 60
companies.description: The S&P/TSX 60 Index is a Canadian stock market index comprising 60 large companies listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange. Launched in 1998 by the Canadian S&P Index Committee, it covers nine sectors of the Canadian economy. It is part of the broader S&P/TSX Composite Index and the S&P Global 1200.

companies.name: Severn Trent
companies.description: Severn Trent plc is a water company based in Coventry, England. It supplies water to 4.6 million households and businesses across the Midlands, South West England, and Wales.

companies.name: Canterbury Park
companies.description: Canterbury Park is a horse racing track located in Shakopee, Minnesota, United States. It offers parimutuel wagering on live and simulcast horse races and operates a 24/7 card casino regulated by the Minnesota Racing Commission. The company is also developing approximately 140 acres of surrounding land for mixed-use projects.

companies.name: CapitalSource
companies.description: CapitalSource is a commercial lender in the United States and a division of Pacific Western Bank. It provides senior debt loans ranging from $5 million to $100 million to middle-market companies across various industries including technology, real estate, healthcare, and equipment leasing. The company operates 80 branches in California.

companies.name: Shaftesbury Capital
companies.description: Shaftesbury Capital, formerly Capital & Counties Properties plc, is a UK-based property investment and development company. It focuses on sites in London's West End, including Covent Garden, Chinatown, Carnaby Street, and Soho.

companies.name: Capital Cargo International Airlines
companies.description: Capital Cargo International Airlines was a cargo airline based in Orlando, Florida, operating from 1995 to 2013. It provided on-demand and wet lease aircraft charter services, with its main base at Orlando International Airport. The airline was owned by the Air Transport Services Group.

companies.name: Sonida Senior Living
companies.description: Sonida Senior Living, Inc. is a leading owner, operator, and investor in senior housing communities in the United States. Founded in 1990, it operates 96 senior housing communities across 20 states with a capacity of over 10,000 residents. The company owns 83 communities and manages 13 on behalf of third parties.

companies.name: Capitol Federal Savings Bank
companies.description: Capitol Federal Savings Bank is a federally chartered and insured savings bank headquartered in Topeka, Kansas. Founded in 1893, it operates 51 locations serving the Kansas City metropolitan area in both Kansas and Missouri. The bank is owned by Capitol Federal Financial Inc.

companies.name: Capstone Turbine
companies.description: Capstone Green Energy Corporation, formerly Capstone Turbine Corporation, is a California-based manufacturer of gas turbines specializing in microturbine power and cogeneration systems. Incorporated in 1988, its turbines use air bearings for maintenance-free operation and eliminate the need for cooling or secondary systems. The technology is fuel flexible and scalable for various applications.

companies.name: CarMax
companies.description: CarMax, Inc. is a used vehicle retailer based in the United States. It operates two business segments: CarMax Sales Operations and CarMax Auto Finance. The company started as a side business of Circuit City Corporation in 1993 and operates 263 locations as of November 2026.

companies.name: Carbonite
companies.description: Carbonite, Inc. is an American company providing online backup services for Windows and macOS users. Acquired by Canadian software company OpenText in 2019, it backs up documents, emails, music, photos, and settings. Carbonite was the first service to offer unlimited backup space for a fixed price.

companies.name: CareFusion
companies.description: CareFusion Corporation was a medical company specializing in reducing medication errors and preventing healthcare-associated infections.

companies.name: Cargills Ceylon PLC
companies.description: Cargills (Ceylon) PLC is a Sri Lankan consumer company listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange. It operates in modern retail, FMCG, and restaurants, and is also involved in banking, real estate, agriculture, and cinema. It runs the largest food-related supply chain in Sri Lanka.

companies.name: Carillion
companies.description: Carillion plc was a British multinational construction and facilities management services company headquartered in Wolverhampton, UK. The company was liquidated in January 2018.

companies.name: Carlisle Companies
companies.description: Carlisle Companies Incorporated supplies construction products that enhance building energy efficiency and resilience. It manufactures single-ply roofing products and accessories for commercial buildings. The company operates two segments and earns more than half its revenue in the United States.

companies.name: Carpenter Technology Corporation
companies.description: Carpenter Technology Corporation develops and manufactures stainless steels and corrosion-resistant alloys including nickel, copper, and titanium, as well as powdered alloys for 3D additive manufacturing. Its products serve aerospace, defense, medical, transportation, energy, and distribution industries.

companies.name: Carpetright
companies.description: Carpetright is a British carpet retailer founded in 1988 by Lord Philip Harris. It operates in the retail industry and is based in the United Kingdom. The company specializes in selling carpets and related flooring products.

companies.name: cars.com
companies.description: Cars.com is an automotive classified website focused on the United States, launched in June 1998. It is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, and is known for being the second largest automotive classified site and for having the most expensive domain ever sold.

companies.name: Carter's
companies.description: Carter's, Inc. is a major American designer and marketer of children's apparel. Founded in 1865 by William Carter, the company operates in the consumer goods and retail industry in the United States.

companies.name: Cascade Microtech
companies.description: Cascade Microtech is a semiconductor test equipment manufacturer based in Beaverton, Oregon, United States. Founded in 1983, it was formerly publicly traded and is now fully merged with FormFactor, Inc.

companies.name: Casella Waste Systems
companies.description: Casella Waste Systems, Inc. is a waste management company headquartered in Rutland, Vermont, United States. Founded in 1975, it provides integrated solid waste services including collection, disposal, recycling, and organics services primarily in seven northeastern states.

companies.name: FirstCash
companies.description: FirstCash Holdings, Inc. is an American pawnshop company headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas. It operates retail pawn stores in the U.S. and Latin America and is publicly traded on the Nasdaq stock exchange.

companies.name: Hibu
companies.description: Hibu Inc., formerly Yellowbook Inc., is a provider of web development, hosting, digital listings, reputation management, search engine and social media marketing, and digital advertisements. The company is headquartered in Cedar Rapids, Iowa.

companies.name: Destination XL Group
companies.description: Destination XL Group, Inc. is a retailer specializing in Men's Big and Tall apparel with 290 retail and outlet stores in the United States. Headquartered in Canton, Massachusetts, it also operates an e-commerce website and mobile apps serving multiple global markets.

companies.name: Catalyst Paper
companies.description: Catalyst Paper Corporation is a pulp and paper company based in Richmond, British Columbia, Canada. It operates five pulp and paper mills producing magazine paper and newsprint.

companies.name: Catamaran Corporation
companies.description: Catamaran Corporation, now part of UnitedHealth Group's OptumRx division, provides pharmacy benefit management and medical record keeping services in the United States. It operates independently of government and insurance companies and processes prescription drug claims online.

companies.name: Catlin Group
companies.description: Catlin Group Limited was a Bermuda-based specialty insurance and reinsurance company. It operated six underwriting hubs and more than 55 offices worldwide. Catlin owned the largest syndicate at Lloyd's of London based on 2011 gross written premiums and was acquired by XL Group plc in May 2015.

companies.name: Cavium
companies.description: Cavium, Inc. was a fabless semiconductor company based in San Jose, California. It specialized in ARM-based and MIPS-based network, video, and security processors and SoCs. The company offered processor- and board-level products targeting routers, switches, appliances, storage, and servers.

companies.name: Cedar Realty Trust
companies.description: Cedar Realty Trust, Inc. is a real estate investment trust investing in shopping centers, primarily in the Northeastern United States. It is a subsidiary of Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust and owned 19 properties as of December 31, 2022. Its notable property includes The Shoppes at Trexler.

companies.name: Cementos Pacasmayo
companies.description: Pacasmayo is the largest cement company in northern Peru with three cement plants in Piura, Pacasmayo, and Rioja. It has a total annual capacity of 4.9 million tons of cement. The company was founded by Luis Hochschild Plaut.

companies.name: Centamin
companies.description: Centamin is a gold mining and exploration company whose main operating asset is the Sukari gold mine in Egypt. It is wholly owned by AngloGold Ashanti plc. The company is based in Australia.

companies.name: Centene Corporation
companies.description: Centene Corporation is an American for-profit healthcare company based in Clayton, Missouri. It serves as an intermediary for government-sponsored and privately insured healthcare programs. Centene ranked No. 23 on the 2025 Fortune 500.

companies.name: Lonmin
companies.description: Lonmin plc, formerly Lonrho plc, was a British producer of platinum group metals operating in the Bushveld Complex of South Africa. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange with its registered office in London and operational headquarters in Johannesburg.

companies.name: Central Depository Services Limited
companies.description: Central Depository Services (India) Ltd. (CDSL) is an Indian central securities depository established in 1999. It is headquartered in Lower Parel, Mumbai. CDSL is the primary market infrastructure institution providing depository services in India.

companies.name: Central Pacific Bank
companies.description: Central Pacific Bank (CPB) is an American regional commercial bank operating throughout the state of Hawaii. It provides banking services to the local community.

companies.name: Land Securities
companies.description: Land Securities Group plc, trading as Landsec, is the largest commercial property development and investment company in the United Kingdom. It became a real estate investment trust in January 2007 and is headquartered in London. The company is traded on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Lumen Technologies
companies.description: Lumen Technologies, Inc. is an American telecommunications company headquartered in Monroe, Louisiana. It provides network, security, cloud, voice, and other managed communications services through fiber optic and copper networks, data centers, and cloud computing services. The company has been included in the S&P 600 index since March 2023.

companies.name: Ceragon
companies.description: Ceragon Networks Ltd. is an Israeli telecommunications equipment company that manufactures point-to-point and point-to-multipoint wireless connectivity systems. Its products are mainly used for wireless backhaul by mobile network operators, wireless service providers, and private network operators. Ceragon’s systems support transmission across microwave and millimeter wave frequency bands.

companies.name: Dayforce, Inc.
companies.description: Dayforce, Inc., formerly Ceridian, is an American human resources software and services company. It operates in the AI and software industry, providing solutions related to human resources management.

companies.name: Cerro Verde
companies.description: Cerro Verde is a Peru-based mining company founded in 1970. It focuses on the extraction, exploitation, and production of copper from a porphyry copper deposit near Arequipa. The company also holds copper and molybdenum sale agreements with Sumitomo Metal Mining and Climax Molybdenum Company respectively.

companies.name: Chadormalu Mining and Industrial Company
companies.description: The Chadormalu Mining and Industrial Company was established in June 1992 in Tehran, Iran. It operates in the mining industry, although specific activities are not detailed in the summary.

companies.name: Chang Hwa Bank
companies.description: Chang Hwa Bank is a Taiwan-based financial institution offering retail and commercial banking services to private and corporate customers. It operates within the banking sector providing various financial services.

companies.name: Changyou
companies.description: Changyou.com Ltd. operates online games, primarily massively multiplayer online games, in China. Originally part of Sohu, it was spun off and went public in 2009 through a Cayman Islands-based variable interest entity structure. The company claims independent operation from Sohu since 2007.

companies.name: Changyu Winery
companies.description: Changyu Pioneer Wine Co. Inc., located in Yantai, Shandong, is China's oldest and largest winery. Founded in 1892 by Cheong Fatt Tze, it operates in the agriculture and food industry focusing on wine production.

companies.name: Charles River Laboratories
companies.description: Charles River Laboratories International, Incorporated is an American life sciences company and contract research organization headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts. Founded in 1947, it supports drug, vaccine, and therapeutic development with research models, drug discovery, safety assessment, and manufacturing services across at least 20 countries.

companies.name: Chartwell Retirement Residences
companies.description: Chartwell Retirement Residences is the largest provider of seniors' housing in Canada, serving over 25,000 residents across Quebec, Ontario, Alberta, and British Columbia. It offers a range of seniors housing communities from independent living to assisted living.

companies.name: Checkpoint Systems
companies.description: Checkpoint Systems is an American company specializing in loss prevention and merchandise visibility for retail companies. It manufactures products like Electronic Article Surveillance systems, RFID hardware and software, and barcode labeling solutions. The company helps retailers manage inventory, prevent theft, and improve replenishment cycles.

companies.name: Chemtura
companies.description: Chemtura Corporation was a global specialty chemicals company headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, with an executive office in Middlebury, Connecticut. It served industrial sectors including transportation, energy, and electronics, operating manufacturing plants in 11 countries. In 2017, Chemtura was acquired by the German chemical company Lanxess.

companies.name: Chesapeake Utilities
companies.description: Chesapeake Utilities Corporation is an American diversified energy company founded in 1947 and headquartered in Delaware. It operates in the Middle-Atlantic, Southeast, and Midwest regions, providing natural gas distribution and transmission, electric distribution, and propane services. The company conducts its business through various operating divisions and subsidiaries.

companies.name: Givaudan S.A.
companies.description: Givaudan S.A. is a Swiss multinational company that manufactures flavors, fragrances, and active cosmetic ingredients. It is recognized as the world's largest company in the flavor and fragrance industry as of 2025.

companies.name: Chico's FAS
companies.description: Chico's FAS, Inc. is an American women's clothing and accessories retailer founded in 1983 on Sanibel Island, Florida. Headquartered in Fort Myers, Florida, it operates four brands: Chico's, White House Black Market, Soma, and TellTale.

companies.name: Chicony Electronics
companies.description: Chicony Electronics Co., Ltd. is a Taiwan-based multinational electronics manufacturer. Its products include input devices, power supplies, digital cameras, webcams, and motherboards for personal computers and notebooks.

companies.name: ChinaCache
companies.description: ChinaCache, Inc. is a Chinese company founded in 1998 that provides Internet content and application delivery services.

companies.name: China Automotive Systems
companies.description: China Automotive Systems, Inc. is a major Chinese supplier of power steering components and systems. Founded in 1993, it operates through joint ventures in China and a subsidiary in the United States, serving over 60 vehicle manufacturers including FAW Group and Dongfeng Group.

companies.name: China BlueChemical
companies.description: China BlueChemical Limited is the largest nitrogenous fertilizer manufacturer in mainland China by production volume and energy efficiency. Headquartered in Dongfang, Hainan, it processes natural gas to produce chemical fertilizers and other products. Its parent company is CNOOC, a major petroleum state-owned enterprise in China.

companies.name: Cosco Shipping Holdings Co., Ltd.
companies.description: China COSCO Shipping Corporation Limited is a Chinese state-owned multinational marine transportation conglomerate headquartered in Shanghai. Established in 2016 by merging China Ocean Shipping Company and China Shipping Group Company, it is owned and supervised by the State Council of China.

companies.name: China Communications Services Corporation
companies.description: China Communications Services Corporation Limited, known as China Comservice, is a subsidiary of China Telecommunications Corporation. It provides telecommunication infrastructure and outsourcing services to telecom operators and government organizations in China. The company operates within the telecommunications industry.

companies.name: China Sandi Holdings
companies.description: China Sandi Holdings Limited is a public company engaged in ecological forestry in China. It focuses on tree plantation and the manufacture and distribution of timber. The company was formerly known as China Grand Forestry Resources Group Limited.

companies.name: China Green Agriculture
companies.description: China Green Agriculture, Inc. is based in Xi'an, China, and produces humic acid based liquid compound fertilizer. It was the first Chinese company listed on the New York Stock Exchange and NYSE Euronext markets in 2009. The company became public in 2008.

companies.name: China Merchants Property
companies.description: China Merchants Property Development Co., Ltd., established in Shenzhen in 1984, is the real estate flagship of China Merchants. It offers residential properties in multiple Chinese cities including Shenzhen, Shanghai, and Beijing. The company operates in the real estate industry.

companies.name: China National Materials Group Corporation
companies.description: China National Materials Group, also known as Sinoma, was established in 1983 and is a central government-administered enterprise in China. It is the world's largest cement equipment and engineering service provider and leads China's non-metal materials manufacturing. The company holds core technologies and a complete innovation system in its industry.

companies.name: China Oilfield Services
companies.description: China Oilfield Services (COSL) is an oilfield services company majority owned by the Chinese state-owned CNOOC Group. It has a listed sister company in Hong Kong named CNOOC Limited. The company operates within the petroleum industry.

companies.name: China Power International Development
companies.description: China Power International Development Limited (CPID) is a Chinese electric power company incorporated in Hong Kong in 2004. It is now under the State Power Investment Corporation after a merger involving its former parent company. CPID operates in the electricity generation sector.

companies.name: China Resources Gas
companies.description: China Resources Gas Group Limited was incorporated in Hong Kong in 1994. It developed into a city gas distribution business after disposing of previous businesses by 2009. The company operates in the renewables and utilities sector.

companies.name: China Resources Cement
companies.description: China Resources Cement Holdings Limited, parented by China Resources, is a leading cement and concrete producer in Southern China. Established in 2003 and incorporated in the Cayman Islands, it is the largest NSP clinker and cement producer in Southern China by capacity and second largest concrete producer in China by sales.

companies.name: China Resources Land
companies.description: China Resources Land Limited is a property developer under China Resources Group. It develops and manages residential and investment properties in major Mainland China cities such as Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen. The company was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange as a red chip stock in 1996.

companies.name: China Sunergy
companies.description: China Sunergy CSUN is a Chinese solar cell products manufacturer based in Nanjing, Jiangsu. The company produces solar cells from silicon wafers and has an international customer base. It opened its first international manufacturing base in Turkey in 2013, which is the largest solar cell and module capacity in Turkey and Europe.

companies.name: China State Construction International Holdings Limited
companies.description: China State Construction International Holdings Limited is the largest construction contractor in Hong Kong. It mainly serves government projects, public organizations, and large private corporations. The company operates primarily through its subsidiaries China State Construction Engineering Limited and China Overseas Limited.

companies.name: China Travel International Investment Hong Kong
companies.wiki: China Travel International Investment Hong Kong
companies.description: China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Limited is an investment holding company engaged in travel, theme parks, hotels, resorts, passenger transportation, golf clubs, power generation, and freight forwarding. It was established and listed in Hong Kong in 1992 as a subsidiary of China Travel Service.

companies.name: China Water Affairs Group
companies.description: China Water Affairs Group Limited is a water supply company headquartered in Hong Kong. It was the earliest water company listed in Hong Kong and focuses exclusively on water supply business. The company was formerly an electronics company and changed its name to China Water Affairs Group Limited after restructuring in 2005.

companies.name: China Zhongwang
companies.description: China Zhongwang Holdings Limited is a Chinese industrial aluminium manufacturer headquartered in Liaoyang, Liaoning Province. It specializes in high-precision and large-section aluminium products for transportation, engineering, and industrial sectors. The company was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2009 but has had suspended trading since 2021.

companies.name: CTBC Financial Holding
companies.description: CTBC Financial Holding Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese holding company principally engaged in the finance industry through eight major subsidiaries. It was founded by Jeffrey Koo Sr., a member of the Koo family. The company originated under the Koos Group.

companies.name: Chong Hing Bank
