companies.description: Chong Hing Bank is a bank founded in Hong Kong in 1948 and headquartered in Central. Its back offices are located in Western District and Mong Kok. The bank was owned by the Liu family until it was acquired by the Chinese state-owned Yue Xiu Group in 2014.

companies.name: Chorus Limited
companies.description: Chorus is New Zealand's largest telecommunications infrastructure company. It builds and operates nationwide fibre broadband and copper telecommunication networks. The company is listed on the NZX and ASX stock exchanges and is part of the NZX 50 Index.

companies.name: Chow Tai Fook
companies.description: Chow Tai Fook group is a Hong Kong–based privately owned conglomerate with holdings in jewellery, property development, hotels, department stores, transportation, energy, telecommunications, ports, casinos, and other businesses. It has partial stock market listings through associate and subsidiary companies. New World Development, an associate, was ranked 47th-largest by market capitalization on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2018.

companies.name: Christopher & Banks
companies.description: Christopher & Banks, originally Brauns Fashions, is an American retail company specializing in women's clothing for ages 40 to 60. It was originally headquartered in Plymouth, Minnesota, a suburb of Minneapolis.

companies.name: Chrysalis Group PLC
companies.description: Chrysalis Group was a UK media company founded by Chris Wright and Terry Ellis. It focused on music publishing, recording, artist management, and entertainment product distribution. The music branch included labels such as The Hit Label, Echo, and Papillon Records.

companies.name: Church & Dwight
companies.description: Church & Dwight Co., Inc. is an American consumer packaged goods company headquartered in Ewing Township, New Jersey. It manufactures and markets household, personal-care, and specialty products internationally. The company is best known for its Arm & Hammer brand, which traces back to a business established in 1846.

companies.name: Churchill Downs Incorporated
companies.description: Churchill Downs Incorporated is an American company that owns racetracks, casinos, and an online wagering business. It originated from a single racetrack in Louisville, Kentucky, and has expanded across multiple states. The company is publicly traded and operates in the gambling industry.

companies.name: Chuy's
companies.description: Chuy's Opco, Inc. is an American Tex-Mex restaurant chain founded in 1982 in Austin, Texas. As of 2024, it operates 101 restaurants across 15 states including Texas, Florida, and Virginia. The chain was founded by Mike Young and John Zapp.

companies.name: Chyron Corporation
companies.description: The Chyron Corporation is an American broadcast graphics and real-time data visualization company based in Melville, New York. Founded in 1966, it designs software and hardware for television production, including character generators and virtual graphics. It merged with Hego AB in 2013 and returned to its original name in 2021.

companies.name: Ingenic Semiconductor
companies.description: Ingenic Semiconductor is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company founded in 2005 and based in Beijing. It designs CPU microarchitectures based on licensed MIPS architecture and system on a chip products. The company commissions fabrication of integrated circuits and sells them.

companies.name: Cia. Hering
companies.description: Companhia Hering is a Brazilian textile and retail clothing company founded in 1880 in Blumenau, Santa Catarina. It is the leading clothing textile company in Latin America with 805 stores. The company remains headquartered in Blumenau and is the major employer in the city.

companies.name: Cincinnati Financial
companies.description: Cincinnati Financial Corporation is a U.S. company offering property and casualty insurance through its subsidiaries. It holds 1.01% of the domestic property and casualty insurance premiums, ranking it as the 20th largest insurance company by market share in the United States.

companies.name: Citi Trends
companies.description: Citi Trends, Inc. is an American retail clothing chain that sells discounted products primarily targeted at African-American customers. It operates in the retail sector within the United States.

companies.name: Claro Colombia
companies.description: Claro Colombia is a telecommunications operator based in Colombia and owned by the Mexican group América Móvil. It is the largest provider of mobile phone services in Colombia, with a majority share of the country's mobile phone subscribers as of 2011.

companies.name: Clean Harbors
companies.logo_file: Clean Harbors Logo RED rgb H space.jpg
companies.description: Clean Harbors, Inc. is a waste management and industrial services provider headquartered in Norwell, Massachusetts, USA. It specializes in hazardous and non-hazardous waste services and owns Safety-Kleen, the largest used oil re-refiner and recycler in North America.

companies.name: Clearwater Paper
companies.description: Clearwater Paper Corporation is an American manufacturer of pulp and paperboard headquartered in Spokane, Washington. The company was established in 2008 as a spin-off from Potlatch Corporation.

companies.name: Clearwire
companies.description: Clearwire Corporation was a telecommunications operator providing mobile and fixed wireless broadband services in the US and parts of Europe. Founded from a spin-off in 1998, it moved its headquarters to Bellevue, Washington in 2012.

companies.name: ClickSoftware Technologies
companies.description: ClickSoftware was a US-based technology company providing field service management software from 1997 until its acquisition by Salesforce in 2019.

companies.name: Close Brothers Group
companies.description: Close Brothers Group plc is a UK merchant banking group offering lending, deposit taking, wealth management, and securities trading services. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Clyde Engineering
companies.description: Clyde Engineering was an Australian manufacturer specializing in locomotives, rolling stock, and other industrial products.

companies.name: Coca-Cola Consolidated, Inc.
companies.description: Coca-Cola Consolidated, Inc. is the largest independent Coca-Cola bottler in the United States, headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina.

companies.name: Cochlear Limited
companies.description: Cochlear Limited is an Australian medical device company that designs, manufactures, and supplies implantable hearing systems including cochlear implants and bone conduction hearing systems.

companies.name: Code Rebel
companies.description: Code Rebel Corporation was an American technology company based in Kahului, Hawaii. It developed and sold computer software, focusing on terminal services and virtualization software mainly for Apple products. The company was founded by Arben Kane.

companies.name: Codexis
companies.description: Codexis, Inc. is a protein engineering company based in the United States. It develops enzymes used in pharmaceutical, food, and medical applications. The company specializes in protein engineering technologies.

companies.name: Coinstar
companies.description: Coinstar, LLC is an American company that operates coin-cashing machines. It provides automated services for converting coins into cash or other forms of payment. The company is based in the United States.

companies.name: CollabRx
companies.description: CollabRx, Inc. was a company offering cloud-based expert systems for selecting clinical treatments for molecular diseases like cancer. Its technology used dynamically updated molecular disease models informed by a network of academic and medical advisors. The company focused on distilling clinically relevant therapy approaches from biological data.

companies.name: Colliers International
companies.description: Colliers International Group Inc. is a Canadian diversified professional services and investment management company. It has approximately 29,000 employees and operates in more than 400 offices across 65 countries. The company is based in Canada.

companies.name: Colonial Properties
companies.description: Colonial Properties Trust was a publicly traded diversified real estate investment trust headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama. In October 2013, it was acquired by Mid-America Apartment Communities. The company operated in the real estate investment sector.

companies.name: Comfort Systems USA
companies.description: Comfort Systems USA, Inc. is an American company providing mechanical and electrical contracting services. Its offerings include HVAC, plumbing, piping and controls, off-site construction, monitoring, fire protection, and electrical system installation and servicing.

companies.name: CommScope
companies.description: CommScope Holding Company, Inc. is an American network infrastructure provider based in Claremont, North Carolina. The company employs over 22,000 people and joined the Nasdaq stock exchange in 2013.

companies.name: CommVault Systems
companies.description: Commvault Systems, Inc. is an American publicly traded company specializing in cybersecurity and data protection software. Its services include data security, cloud management, and infrastructure management.

companies.name: Commerce Bancshares
companies.description: Commerce Bancshares, Inc. is a regional bank holding company headquartered in Missouri with principal offices in Kansas City and St. Louis. It is the parent company of Commerce Bank, which offers a diversified range of financial services including business and personal banking, wealth management, and investments.

companies.name: Commercial Bank of Ceylon
companies.description: Commercial Bank of Ceylon PLC is a licensed private commercial bank in Sri Lanka, listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange. It is the largest private bank in Sri Lanka by net worth and capital, and operates a network of 291 branches and around 948 ATMs across the country.

companies.name: Community Bank, N.A.
companies.description: Community Bank, N.A. is a commercial bank in the United States serving customers in Upstate New York, Northeastern Pennsylvania, Lehigh Valley, Vermont, and Massachusetts. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of Community Financial System, Inc. and is headquartered in DeWitt, New York.

companies.name: Companhia Brasileira de Aluminio
companies.description: Companhia Brasileira de Alumínio is the largest aluminium producer in Brazil. It claims an annual production of around 360,000 tonnes as of 2026.

companies.name: Compass Minerals
companies.description: Compass Minerals International, Inc. is an American company based in Overland Park, Kansas. It produces minerals such as salt, magnesium chloride, and sulfate of potash, supplying highway deicing salt in North America and the UK, as well as plant nutrition products worldwide.

companies.name: Lotte Corporation
companies.description: Lotte Corporation is a South Korean multinational conglomerate and the fifth-largest chaebol in South Korea. Founded in 1948 by Shin Kyuk-ho in Tokyo, it expanded to South Korea with the establishment of Lotte Confectionery in Seoul in 1967.

companies.name: Compugen Ltd.
companies.description: Compugen Ltd. is an Israeli clinical-stage drug discovery and development company focused on oncology and immunology. Established in 1993 as a computational drug discovery service provider, it is publicly traded on NASDAQ and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Starz Entertainment
companies.description: Starz Entertainment Corp. is a Canadian-American entertainment company headquartered in Santa Monica, California. Founded in 1997 by Frank Giustra, it was formerly known as Lions Gate Entertainment Corporation and is incorporated in Vancouver, British Columbia.

companies.name: SAP Concur
companies.description: SAP Concur is an American software as a service company headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. It provides travel and expense management services to businesses and was acquired by SAP SE in 2014.

companies.name: Conn's
companies.description: Conn's, Inc. was an American retail chain specializing in furniture, mattresses, electronics, and appliances. Headquartered in The Woodlands, Texas, it operated stores across multiple states including Texas, Alabama, Arizona, and others.

companies.name: Constant Contact
companies.description: Constant Contact, Inc. is an online marketing company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. It has additional offices in several US cities and internationally in Australia, Canada, and England. The company provides software as a service focused on online marketing.

companies.name: Continental Resources
companies.description: Continental Resources, Inc. is an American petroleum and natural gas exploration and production company based in Oklahoma City. Founded in 1967 as Shelly Dean Oil Company, it was renamed Continental Resources in 1990. The company uses hydraulic fracturing and directional drilling and was acquired by affiliates of its founder in 2022.

companies.name: Control4
companies.description: Control4 is a home automation brand offering customizable smart home systems that control devices like lighting, audio, and security. Founded in 2003 in Draper, Utah, it relocated to Lehi, Utah in 2023 and operates as a division of ADI Global Distribution. Control4's platform supports over 13,000 third-party products worldwide.

companies.name: ConvaTec
companies.description: Convatec Group plc is a medical products and technologies company based in London, England. It provides products and services in advanced wound care, ostomy care, continence care, and infusion care. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Cookpad Inc.
companies.description: Cookpad Inc. is a Japanese food tech company operating Japan's largest recipe sharing service, Cookpad. It has its global headquarters in Bristol, UK, and offices worldwide. The company went public on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in 2009 and hosts millions of user-created recipes.

companies.name: Cooper-Standard Automotive
companies.description: Cooper Standard Automotive Inc. is a global supplier of automotive systems and components headquartered in Novi, Michigan. Its products include rubber and plastic sealing, fuel and brake lines, and anti-vibration systems. The company operates manufacturing locations worldwide and has historical production of M1 Carbines during World War II.

companies.name: CoreSite
companies.description: CoreSite is a subsidiary of American Tower that owns carrier-neutral data centers. It provides colocation and peering services. The company operates in the real estate investment trust sector focused on data center properties.

companies.name: Core Laboratories
companies.description: Core Laboratories Inc is an American service provider specializing in core and fluid analysis for the petroleum industry. Established in 1936, it offers proprietary reservoir description and production enhancement services globally for oil and gas companies.

companies.name: Corficolombiana
companies.description: Corficolombiana is a Colombian financial products company serving some of the largest corporations in Colombia. It operates in the financial services sector within Colombia.

companies.name: Shimadzu Corp.
companies.description: Shimadzu Corporation is a Japanese company based in Kyoto that manufactures precision and measuring instruments as well as medical equipment. Established in 1875, it also has an American subsidiary, Shimadzu Scientific Instruments, founded in 1975.

companies.name: Costain Group
companies.description: Costain Group plc is a British construction and engineering company headquartered in London, England. It operates in the civil engineering sector.

companies.name: Countryside Properties
companies.description: Countryside Partnerships plc is a UK housebuilding and urban regeneration company operating mainly in London and the South East of England, with presence in the North West. It was formerly listed on the London Stock Exchange until 2022.

companies.name: Countrywide
companies.description: Countrywide is one of the UK's largest integrated property services groups, including residential property surveying and estate agency operations. It operates over 650 offices under more than 50 brands and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Connells Group.

companies.name: Coupa
companies.description: Coupa Software Incorporated is an American technology platform headquartered in Foster City, California, providing AI-driven total spend management and supply chain solutions. It has offices across Europe, Latin America, and Asia Pacific.

companies.name: Cousins Properties
companies.description: Cousins Properties Incorporated is an American publicly traded real estate investment trust investing in office buildings across several U.S. cities including Atlanta and Charlotte. It has developed notable properties such as CNN Center and 191 Peachtree Tower.

companies.name: Covanta
companies.description: Reworld, formerly known as Covanta, is a private energy-from-waste and industrial waste management company headquartered in Florham Park, New Jersey. It operates incineration facilities that generate electricity and metal slag from burning trash. The company charges fees for waste disposal and sells the byproducts of waste incineration.

companies.name: Covisint
companies.description: Covisint was an American information technology company acquired by Canadian firm OpenText in July 2017. OpenText's Business Network focuses on integrating, managing, and securely exchanging data across people, systems, and things. Covisint operated in the IT sector prior to its acquisition.

companies.name: Unisys
companies.description: Unisys Corporation is an American technology company founded in 1986 and based in Blue Bell, Pennsylvania. It provides cloud, artificial intelligence, digital workplace, logistics, and enterprise computing services. The company operates in the information and communications technology sector.

companies.name: Crane Co.
companies.description: Crane Co. is an American industrial products company headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut. Founded in 1855, it transitioned into a holding company with diverse segments including Aerospace & Electronics, Engineered Materials, Fluid Handling, and Controls. It serves industries such as chemical, construction, aviation, and power generation.

companies.name: Cranswick plc
companies.description: Cranswick plc is a United Kingdom-based food producer and supplier specializing in premium, fresh, and added-value food products. The company is publicly traded on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index. It operates within the food industry.

companies.name: Crawford & Company
companies.description: Crawford & Company is a claims management firm with over 700 offices across 70 countries. It provides services related to insurance claims management. The company operates in the insurance industry.

companies.name: Credit Corp Group
companies.description: Credit Corp Group is an Australian company specializing in debt collection and debt purchasing. It operates in Australia, New Zealand, and the United States. The company is part of the banking and fintech industry.

companies.name: Crest Nicholson
companies.description: Crest Nicholson is a British housebuilding company headquartered in Weybridge, Surrey, England. It is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange. The company operates in the house-building industry.

companies.name: Crombie REIT
companies.description: Crombie REIT is a Canadian publicly traded real estate investment trust based in New Glasgow, Nova Scotia. It trades on the Toronto Stock Exchange as an unincorporated open-ended REIT. The company operates in the real estate investment sector.

companies.name: Crown Castle International Corp.
companies.description: Crown Castle Inc. is a real estate investment trust based in Houston, Texas, that provides shared communications infrastructure in the United States. It owns, operates, and leases approximately 40,000 cell towers nationwide, supporting wireless connectivity for cities and communities across the country.

companies.name: Crown Holdings
companies.description: Crown Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational packaging company headquartered in Tampa, Florida. It designs and manufactures rigid-metal packaging such as aluminum beverage cans and metal food cans, and was founded in 1892 as the Crown Cork & Seal Company.

companies.name: Hallmark Media
companies.description: Hallmark Media is an American media production company headquartered in Studio City, California. It operates as a subsidiary of Hallmark Cards.

companies.name: Crumbs Bake Shop
companies.description: Crumbs Bake Shop is an online store and former bakery chain headquartered in New York City. Founded in 2003 as a small bakery on Manhattan's Upper West Side, it expanded to 79 locations across ten states and Washington, D.C.

companies.name: Trip.com Group
companies.description: Trip.com Group Limited is a multinational travel agency headquartered in Shanghai, China. It was the largest online travel service in the world in 2017.

companies.name: Cubist Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Cubist Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was an American biopharmaceutical company focused on targeting pathogens such as MRSA.

companies.name: Cuckoo Electronics
companies.description: Cuckoo Electronics Co., Ltd. is a home appliance maker headquartered in Yangsan, South Korea. Founded in 1978 as Sungkwang Electronics, it changed its corporate identity to Cuckoo in 2002, reflecting its major export brand name.

companies.name: Cumulus Media
companies.description: Cumulus Media, Inc. is a broadcasting company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It is the second largest owner and operator of AM and FM radio stations in the United States and owns Westwood One.

companies.name: Cvent
companies.description: Cvent Holding Corp. is a company based in Tysons Corner, Virginia, that provides software-as-a-service for meetings, events, and hospitality management.

companies.name: Cybozu
companies.description: Cybozu, Inc. is a Tokyo-based software company that provides web-based groupware services such as Cybozu Office and kintone. It has offices in Tokyo, Matsuyama, Osaka, and subsidiaries in Vietnam, China, Australia, and the United States. The U.S. subsidiary, kintone Corporation, is located in San Francisco.

companies.name: Cyclacel
companies.description: Cyclacel Pharmaceuticals Inc. is a biotechnology firm based in Dundee, Scotland, and Short Hills, New Jersey. It develops cancer drugs and treatments and was founded in 1996 by David Lane, Merlin Ventures, Cancer Research Campaign Technology, and the Universities of Dundee and Glasgow.

companies.name: Cynapsus Therapeutics
companies.description: Cynapsus Therapeutics Inc. is a specialty pharmaceutical company based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. It develops a drug to treat the motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease and was formerly named Cannasat Therapeutics before changing its name in 2010.

companies.name: CytRx
companies.description: CytRx Corp. is a biopharmaceutical research and development oncology company based in Los Angeles, California. It focuses on oncology-related biopharmaceutical research and development.

companies.name: Cytec Industries
companies.description: Cytec Industries Incorporated was a specialty chemicals and materials technology company based in Woodland Park, New Jersey. It produced resins, plastics, and composite materials, especially for aerospace and specialty material users, and was spun off from American Cyanamid Company.

companies.name: D-Box Technologies
companies.description: D-BOX Technologies Inc. is a Canadian haptic motion technology company based in Longueuil, Quebec. It designs and manufactures motion and haptic systems for entertainment, simulation, and training industries, with its seats installed in over 700 movie screens across 40 countries as of 2019.

companies.name: D. R. Horton
companies.description: D.R. Horton, Inc. is an American home construction company based in Arlington, Texas. Since 2002, it has been the largest homebuilder by volume in the United States, operating in 125 markets across 36 states.

companies.name: DASA S.A.
companies.description: Diagnósticos da América S.A. (DASA) is a Brazil-based clinical diagnostics company. It also operates units in food testing, advertising, publishing, human resources services, and research.

companies.name: DBV Technologies
companies.description: DBV Technologies SA is a publicly owned French biopharmaceutical firm headquartered in Bagneux, France. It is known for developing Viaskin technology for allergen administration to intact skin, with its Viaskin Peanut clinical development receiving Fast Track designation from the US FDA.

companies.name: DCC Energy plc
companies.description: DCC Energy plc is a multi-energy sales and distribution business operating in Europe and the United States. It focuses on energy sales and distribution across these regions.

companies.name: DELiA*s
companies.description: Delia's, Inc. was a lifestyle brand of apparel and accessories primarily targeting girls and young women in the United States. It focused on fashion products for a youthful demographic.

companies.name: DFCC Bank
companies.description: DFCC Bank is a development finance institution established in 1955 in Sri Lanka on the recommendation of the World Bank. It is one of the oldest development banks in Asia.

companies.name: DFS
companies.description: DFS Furniture plc, trading as dfs, is a furniture retailer operating in the United Kingdom and Ireland. It specializes in sofas and soft furnishings and is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: DLE
companies.description: DLE Inc. is a Tokyo-based animation and entertainment company founded in 2001 by former Sony executive producer Ryuta Shiiki. It is known for the animated series Eagle Talon and has partnerships across Asia and North America.

companies.name: DOF Group
companies.description: DOF ASA was the parent company of the DOF Group, a Norwegian supply shipping company. After bankruptcy proceedings in 2023, a new parent company DOF Group ASA was established, continuing global offshore services operations.

companies.name: AO World
companies.description: AO World plc, trading as ao.com, is an electrical retailer based in Bolton, England. It operates in the UK and formerly in Germany and the Netherlands, specializing in household kitchen appliances and electricals.

companies.name: DST Systems
companies.description: DST Systems, Inc. was an American company providing advisory, technology, and operations outsourcing services to financial services and healthcare industries. Founded in 1969, it was headquartered in Kansas City, Missouri, and acquired by SS&C Technologies in 2018.

companies.name: Designer Brands
companies.description: Designer Brands Inc. is an American retailer selling designer and name brand shoes and fashion accessories. It owns the Designer Shoe Warehouse (DSW) chain with over 500 stores in the United States and operates an e-commerce website.

companies.name: DS Smith
companies.description: DS Smith plc is a British multinational packaging business headquartered in London. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by International Paper in January 2025.

companies.name: DTE Energy
companies.description: DTE Energy is an American diversified energy company operating in the United States and Canada. Its units include an electric utility serving 2.2 million customers and a natural gas utility serving 1.3 million customers in Michigan.

companies.name: DaVita
companies.description: DaVita Inc. is an American health care company headquartered in Denver, Delaware. It provides kidney dialysis services through a network of outpatient centers in the United States and other countries. The company primarily treats end-stage renal disease requiring regular dialysis or kidney transplants.

companies.name: TBC
companies.description: The Taegu Broadcasting Corporation is a regional television and radio broadcasting company based in Daegu, South Korea. It operates as an affiliate of Seoul Broadcasting System and began official broadcasts in 1995, with FM broadcasts starting in 1997.

companies.name: Dah Chong Hong
companies.description: Dah Chong Hong Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong–based conglomerate engaged in motor vehicle sales and repair, air cargo equipment distribution, cosmetics, airport ground support equipment maintenance, food, logistics, and warehouse services.

companies.name: Dah Sing Bank Limited
companies.description: Dah Sing Banking Group Limited is a Hong Kong–based banking and financial company headquartered in Wan Chai. It operates through three main banking subsidiaries with a branch network across Hong Kong, Macau, and mainland China, and includes a securities trading company.

companies.name: Daily Journal Corporation
companies.description: Daily Journal Corporation is an American publishing and technology company headquartered in Los Angeles, California. It has offices in multiple U.S. cities and Melbourne, Australia. Under Charles T. Munger's leadership, its newspapers focus on reporting about the U.S. legal system.

companies.name: Dairy Crest
companies.description: Saputo Dairy UK, also known as Dairy Crest Limited, is a British dairy products company created in 2019 after being acquired by Canadian company Saputo Inc. It was originally formed in 1981 as a spin-off of the Milk Marketing Board and owns brands like Cathedral City and Country Life.

companies.name: Dalian Port (PDA) Company
companies.description: Liaoning Port Co., Ltd. operates the Port of Dalian in Liaoning, China. It provides container loading and discharging, storage for crude and refined oils and chemicals, container logistics, and operates container depots, warehouses, shipping agencies, cargo forwarders, and a bonded logistics park.

companies.name: Dana Corporation
companies.description: Dana Incorporated is an American supplier of axles, driveshafts, and various equipment for conventional, hybrid, and electric vehicles. Founded in 1904 and based in Maumee, Ohio, it serves light and commercial vehicle markets and operates in 33 countries.

companies.name: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group
companies.description: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group, Inc. is a Japanese financial holding company headquartered in Chiyoda, Tokyo. It offers financial products focusing on asset management, financial brokerage, and real estate services to retail and wholesale customers.

companies.name: MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings
companies.description: MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese insurance company that includes Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance and Aioi Nissay Dowa Insurance. It is publicly listed on the Nikkei 225 stock index.

companies.name: SOMPO
companies.description: SOMPO Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese insurance holding company formed in 2010 from the merger of Sompo Japan and Nipponkoa Insurance. It is one of the top three insurers in Japan and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange as part of the Nikkei 225 index.

companies.name: JGC Holdings Corporation
companies.description: JGC Holdings Corporation is a global engineering company headquartered in Yokohama, Japan. It was formerly known as JGC Corporation and before that as Japan Gasoline Co.

companies.name: F-Secure
companies.description: F-Secure Corporation is a Finnish global cybersecurity and privacy company based in Helsinki. It develops and sells antivirus, VPN, password management, and other consumer cybersecurity products for various devices, and offers several free tools on its website.

companies.name: Mandiant
companies.description: Mandiant, Inc. is a United States cybersecurity firm and a subsidiary of Google. It was acquired by FireEye in 2013, later sold to Symphony Technology Group, and then acquired by Google in 2022, becoming part of Google Cloud.

companies.name: Arkan By Aswa Development Company
companies.wiki: Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company
companies.description: Dar Al Arkan Real Estate (DAAR) is a Saudi Arabian property development company based in Riyadh. Established in 1994, it is the largest developer by market value in Saudi Arabia and has close ties to the Saudi government.

companies.name: Dart Group
companies.description: Jet2 plc is a British multinational airline company based near Leeds, Yorkshire. It owns the low-cost airline Jet2.com and the package holiday company Jet2holidays.

companies.name: Invesco
companies.description: Invesco Ltd. is an investment management company organized in Bermuda with principal offices in Atlanta, Georgia. It serves clients in 120 countries worldwide.

companies.name: Dashang Group
companies.description: Dashang Group is a retail company headquartered in Dalian, Liaoning Province, China. It operates department stores, supermarkets, and other retail businesses and is the largest retailer in Northeast China.

companies.name: Data I/O
companies.description: Data I/O Corporation provides manual and automated data programming and security provisioning systems for flash memory and other devices. Founded in 1969, it has developed equipment used in industries such as IoT, medical development, and consumer electronics.

companies.name: Dataram
companies.description: Dataram is a manufacturer of computer memory and software products headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey. Founded in 1967, it provides memory, storage, and services worldwide to OEMs, distributors, and enterprise customers.

companies.name: Datong Coal Industry
companies.description: Datong Coal Industry Co., Ltd., established in 2001 and headquartered in Datong City, China, is engaged in excavating, processing, and sales of coal. It is a subsidiary of Datong Coal Mining Group and operates in Shanxi Province, known for having the greatest coal deposits in China.

companies.name: Dave & Buster's
companies.description: Dave & Buster's Entertainment, Inc. is an American restaurant and entertainment business headquartered in Dallas, Texas. Founded in 1982, it combines a full-service restaurant, bar, and video arcade known as the "Million Dollar Midway". The company operates locations across the United States, Puerto Rico, Canada, and several international franchises.

companies.name: LiuGong
companies.description: LiuGong, officially Guangxi LiuGong Machinery Co., Ltd., is a Chinese multinational construction machinery manufacturer headquartered in Liuzhou, China. It is the world's 10th-largest construction equipment manufacturer by market share and the largest manufacturer of wheel loaders globally.

companies.name: Dechra Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Dechra is a company involved in the development and marketing of veterinary products based in Boston, Massachusetts. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until it was acquired by EQT AB in January 2024.

companies.name: Delcath Systems, Inc.
companies.description: Delcath Systems, Inc. is a specialty pharmaceutical and medical device company based in Queensbury, New York. It develops percutaneous perfusion technologies for targeted administration of high-dose chemotherapeutic agents, with its Percutaneous Hepatic Perfusion system undergoing Phase II and III trials for liver tumors.

companies.name: Fuller's Brewery
companies.description: Fuller's Brewery, located in Chiswick, west London, England, was the brewing division of Fuller, Smith & Turner PLC from its foundation in 1845 until it was sold to Japanese Asahi Breweries in 2019.

companies.name: Delta Djakarta
companies.description: PT Delta Djakarta is a brewing company founded in 1932 and headquartered in Bekasi, Indonesia. Its main brand is Anker, a pale lager, and it is partially owned by San Miguel Malaysia and the government of Jakarta.

companies.name: Deluxe Corporation
companies.description: Deluxe Corporation is an American financial services company providing payment processing, data services, checks, promotional products, and merchant services. It operates in four divisions and serves millions of small businesses and thousands of financial institutions.

companies.name: Leaf Group
companies.description: Leaf Group, formerly Demand Media Inc., was an American content company operating online brands such as eHow and livestrong.com. It provided social media platforms and content distribution tools and was known as a content farm. The company was created in 2006 by Shawn Colo and Richard Rosenblatt.

companies.name: Dendreon
companies.description: Dendreon Pharmaceuticals LLC is a biotechnology company known for its immunotherapy product Provenge for prostate cancer. Provenge uses a mixture of the patient's blood cells incubated with a fusion protein and received FDA approval in 2010 after successful Phase III trials.

companies.name: Denison Mines
companies.description: Denison Mines Corp. is a Canadian company specializing in uranium exploration, development, and production. Founded by Stephen B. Roman, it is known for uranium mining in Blind River and Elliot Lake. The company has also diversified into coal, potash, and other projects.

companies.name: SCA
companies.description: Svenska Cellulosa Aktiebolaget (SCA) is a Swedish manufacturer of timber, pulp, and paper products headquartered in Sundsvall. It is Europe's largest private owner of forest land, managing 2.7 million hectares. SCA's products include one-use paper items, containerboard, solid-wood products, pulp, and forest-based biofuel.

companies.name: Destination Maternity Corporation
companies.description: Destination Maternity Corporation is the world's largest designer and retailer of maternity apparel. The company is based in Moorestown, New Jersey, United States.

companies.name: Detour Gold
companies.description: Detour Gold Corporation was a Canadian gold mining company that operated the Detour Lake Mine in northeastern Ontario from 2006 to 2020. The mine began production in 2013 and was acquired by Kirkland Lake Gold in 2020. It used open pit mining with cyanidation and carbon in pulp processing.

companies.name: DCB Bank
companies.description: DCB Bank Limited is a private sector scheduled commercial bank headquartered in Lower Parel, Mumbai, India. It traces its origins to the 1930s and received its scheduled commercial bank license from the Reserve Bank of India on May 31, 1995.

companies.name: China Tower
companies.description: China Tower Corporation Limited is a state-owned telecommunications company in China. It provides telecommunication tower construction, maintenance, ancillary facilities management, and other related services across mainland China.

companies.name: Dialog
companies.description: Dialog Axiata PLC is the largest telecommunications service provider in Sri Lanka, holding nearly 67% of the mobile market share with around 19.6 million subscribers. It is a subsidiary of Axiata Group Berhad, which owns 73.75%, while Bharti Airtel owns 10.355%.

companies.name: Diamond Bank
companies.description: Diamond Bank Plc. was a Nigerian multinational financial service provider. It was acquired by Access Bank in December 2018 and fully merged with Access Bank on April 1, 2019, with the combined entity retaining the Access Bank name and adopting a logo inspired by Diamond Bank.

companies.name: Diamond Offshore Drilling
companies.description: Diamond Offshore Drilling, Inc. is an offshore drilling contractor headquartered in Katy, Texas, United States. The company has major offices in Australia, Brazil, Mexico, Scotland, Singapore, and Norway.

companies.name: Diamond Resorts
companies.description: Diamond Resorts is a timeshare and vacation ownership company based in the United States. It became a wholly owned subsidiary of Hilton Grand Vacations in 2021, with most resorts rebranded as Hilton Vacation Club properties while retaining the Diamond Resorts brand for some locations.

companies.name: Divi's Laboratories
companies.description: Divi's Laboratories Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Hyderabad. It produces active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediates, and also supplies nutraceutical ingredients through its subsidiary. It is India's fourth largest publicly listed pharmaceutical company by market capitalization.

companies.name: Digi International
companies.description: Digi International, Inc. is an American industrial Internet of Things technology company based in Hopkins, Minnesota. Founded in 1985, it initially manufactured multi-line serial data cards for PC clones and later shifted focus to network attached devices and industrial monitoring.

companies.name: Digital China
companies.description: Digital China is a company listed on the main board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong. It separated from the Legend Group in 2001.

companies.name: Digital Realty Trust
companies.logo_file: Digital Realty TM Brandmark RGB Black.svg
companies.description: Digital Realty is an American real estate investment trust that owns, operates, and invests in carrier-neutral data centers worldwide. Founded in 2004 by GI Partners, it offers data center, colocation, and interconnection services with over 300 facilities in more than 25 countries as of June 2023.

companies.name: Digital River
companies.description: Digital River, Inc. was a privately held company headquartered in Minnetonka, Minnesota, providing global e-commerce, payments, and marketing services. In 2013, it processed over US$30 billion in online transactions. The company filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy in May 2025.

companies.name: Dignity plc
companies.description: Dignity Group is a funeral-related service provider based in the United Kingdom.

companies.name: Dime Community Bank
companies.description: The Dime Commercial Bank is a local, FDIC-insured bank headquartered in Hauppauge, New York. Founded in 1864 and originally based in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, it moved its headquarters to Brooklyn Heights in 2017. In 2021, it merged with Bridge Bancorp Inc.

companies.name: Dine Brands Global
companies.description: Dine Brands Global, Inc. is a publicly traded food and beverage company based in Pasadena, California. Founded in 1958 as IHOP, it operates franchised and corporate owned restaurants including Applebee's, IHOP, and Fuzzy's Taco Shop.

companies.name: Diodes Incorporated
companies.description: Diodes Incorporated is a global manufacturer and supplier of application specific standard products in analog, discrete, power, logic, and mixed-signal semiconductor markets. It serves consumer electronics, computing, communications, industrial, and automotive markets.

companies.name: Diploma plc
companies.description: Diploma plc is a British business supplying specialised technical products and services, based in London, England. It is a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Direct Line Group
companies.description: Direct Line Insurance Group Ltd. is a British insurance company based in Bromley, England. It was formed in 2012 after being divested from The Royal Bank of Scotland Group's insurance division. The company owns several insurance subsidiaries, including Direct Line, Churchill Insurance, Darwin, and Green Flag, a roadside assistance provider.

companies.name: Disco Corporation
companies.description: DISCO Corporation is a Japanese company specializing in precision tools, particularly for the semiconductor production industry. It is based in Japan and focuses on manufacturing tools used in semiconductor fabrication.

companies.name: Discover Financial
companies.description: Discover Financial Services, Inc. was an American bank holding company offering consumer banking products. It owned Discover Card, Pulse, and Diners Club International. In May 2025, it was acquired by Capital One.

companies.name: Discovery Air
companies.description: Discovery Air was a specialized aviation company founded in 2004 that operated primarily in Canada. It focused on providing aviation services within the Canadian market.

companies.name: Distilleries Company of Sri Lanka
companies.description: Distilleries Company of Sri Lanka PLC is a diversified Sri Lankan conglomerate listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange. It was among the first Sri Lankan companies included in Forbes's list of non-US Best Managed companies valued under US$1 billion and has been recognized by Business Today as a top listed company in Sri Lanka.

companies.name: Chubu-Nippon Broadcasting
companies.description: Chubu-Nippon Broadcasting Co., Ltd. is a regional radio and television group serving Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. Its radio service is affiliated with the Japan Radio Network, and its television service is affiliated with TBS and the Japan News Network.

companies.name: SKF
companies.description: Aktiebolaget SKF is a Swedish company founded in 1907 in Gothenburg that manufactures and supplies bearings, seals, lubrication systems, and related products globally. It also provides maintenance products, mechatronics, power transmission products, and condition monitoring systems.

companies.name: Docusign
companies.description: Docusign, Inc. is an American software company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It provides products that help organizations manage electronic agreements and contract lifecycle processes, including electronic signatures and AI-supported data extraction across devices.

companies.name: Astellas Pharma
companies.description: Astellas Pharma Inc. is a Japanese multinational pharmaceutical company formed on April 1, 2005, from the merger of Yamanouchi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and Fujisawa Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry.

companies.name: Dolphin Entertainment
companies.description: Dolphin Entertainment, Inc. is an American entertainment marketing and production company based in Coral Gables, Florida. Founded in 1996, it produces television series and films primarily for children and young adults and has expanded into digital media including NFTs and influencer marketing.

companies.name: Domino's Pizza Group plc
companies.description: Domino's Pizza Group plc is a United Kingdom-based master franchise of the international fast food pizza delivery chain Domino's. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index. The company operates primarily in the food service industry.

companies.name: Domino Printing Sciences
companies.description: Domino Printing Sciences PLC is a British company that develops industrial and commercial printing technologies including inkjet, thermal transfer, and laser printing products. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Brother Industries in 2015.

companies.name: Domo
companies.description: Domo, Inc. is an American cloud software company based in American Fork, Utah. It specializes in artificial intelligence, business intelligence, and data visualization, providing real-time business data access with minimal IT involvement. The company operates as a software as a service venture.

companies.name: Domstein
companies.description: Domstein is a Norwegian fishing company headquartered in Måløy. The company is controlled by Rolf Domstein and operates within the fishery industry.

companies.name: Frontline
companies.description: Frontline PLC is an oil tanker shipping company based in Limassol, Cyprus. It is the world's fifth largest in its sector and is controlled by John Fredriksen. The company primarily transports crude oil and operates a large fleet of tankers including VLCC and Suezmax vessels.

companies.name: Donaldson Company
companies.description: Donaldson Company, Inc. is a filtration company based in the United States producing filtration products for various industries including aerospace, chemical, and pharmaceuticals. Its research division in Minneapolis has participated in defense-related military projects.

companies.name: DB Insurance
companies.description: DB Insurance Co, Ltd. is a non-life insurance company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. It operates within the insurance industry providing various non-life insurance products.

companies.name: KG Steel
companies.description: KG Steel Co., Ltd. is a South Korean multinational corporation that produces steel-related and cold-rolled products. The company operates in the iron and steel industry.

companies.name: Dongfang Electric
companies.description: Dongfang Electric Corporation is a Chinese state-owned manufacturer of power generators and power station project contracts. It was the second largest manufacturer of steam turbines worldwide in 2009-10 and operates the world's most powerful wind turbine at 18 MW capacity.

companies.name: Double Coin
companies.description: Double Coin is a Chinese manufacturer of radial tires for trucks headquartered in Shanghai. It is majority owned by Shanghai Huayi and produces Warrior brand tires in a joint venture with Michelin. Its North American subsidiary is China Manufacturers Alliance, LLC.

companies.name: Dover Downs
companies.description: Bally's Dover Casino Resort, formerly Dover Downs, is a hotel, casino, and racetrack complex located in Dover, Delaware. It features a harness horse racing track and is surrounded by Dover Motor Speedway, a NASCAR motor racing circuit. The complex is owned by Gaming and Leisure Properties and operated by Bally's Corporation.

companies.name: Doximity
companies.description: Doximity is an online networking service for medical professionals launched in 2010. The platform provides curated medical news, telehealth tools, and case collaboration features to its members. It operates primarily in the United States.

companies.name: Ascena Retail Group
companies.description: KnitWell Group, formerly known as Ascena Retail Group, Inc., is an American retailer of women's clothing. It owns brands including Ann Taylor, Loft, Lane Bryant, Justice, and Talbots. The company merged with Talbots and is a portfolio company of Sycamore Partners.

companies.name: Dresser-Rand Group
companies.description: Dresser-Rand is an American engineering and manufacturing company owned by Siemens Energy. It designs, manufactures, and services equipment used in petroleum and natural gas extraction. The company was formed in 1986 as a joint venture between Dresser Industries and Ingersoll Rand.

companies.name: Mytheresa
companies.description: Mytheresa.com is part of the listed e-commerce group LuxExperience B.V. and operates in the luxury fashion sector based in Munich, Germany. It sells ready-to-wear clothing, shoes, bags, accessories, lifestyle products, and jewelry globally for women, men, and children.

companies.name: Ducommun
companies.description: Ducommun Incorporated is a global provider of manufacturing and engineering services. It develops electronic, engineered, and structural solutions for aerospace, defense, and industrial markets. The company is based in the United States.

companies.name: Dundee Corporation
companies.description: Dundee Corporation is a public Canadian independent holding company based in Toronto, Ontario. It has holdings in wealth management, real estate, and resources. The company was founded in 1991 by Ned Goodman.

companies.name: Dunelm Group
companies.description: Dunelm Group plc, trading as Dunelm, is a British home furnishings retailer operating in Great Britain, Ireland, and Jersey. It is one of the largest homeware retailers in the UK with headquarters in Syston, England. The company was formerly known as Dunelm Mill until 2013.

companies.name: Dynamic Materials Corporation
companies.description: DMC Global Inc. owns and operates Arcadia, DynaEnergetics, and NobelClad, manufacturing businesses serving construction, energy, industrial processing, and transportation markets. Their products include architectural building products, engineered oil and gas perforation products, and explosion-welded clad metal plates.

companies.name: Dynamics Research Corporation
companies.description: Dynamics Research Corporation (DRC) was a publicly traded American engineering services company founded in 1955. It primarily served the U.S. Department of Defense, providing expertise in high-performance computing, cybersecurity, financial and regulatory reform, and IT modernization.

companies.name: Teledyne e2v
companies.description: Teledyne e2v is a UK-based manufacturer that designs and produces systems and components for healthcare, life sciences, space, transportation, defence, security, and industrial markets. Formerly known as English Electric Valve Company, it was acquired by US company Teledyne Technologies in 2017.

companies.name: ECOtality
companies.description: ECOtality, Inc. was an electric transportation and storage technologies company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It was the parent company of several subsidiaries including ECOtality North America and ECOtality Australia Pty Ltd.

companies.name: eHealthInsurance
companies.description: eHealthInsurance Services, Inc. is a US-based online marketplace specializing in health insurance. It acts as a licensed agency and advisor, helping customers compare plans from over 180 carriers, including Medicare options like Medicare Advantage and Medigap.

companies.name: eLong
companies.description: eLong, Inc. is a Chinese mobile and online travel agency operating the travel websites eLong.com and eLong.net. It provides travel booking services primarily in China.

companies.name: EN Bank
companies.description: EN Bank, also known as Eqtesad Novin Bank, is Iran's first private bank established in 2000. It offers retail, commercial, and investment banking services and was created as part of Iran's banking privatization efforts.

companies.name: EQT
companies.description: EQT Corporation is an American energy company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It is engaged in hydrocarbon exploration and pipeline transportation.

companies.name: EXASOL
companies.description: Exasol is a German company specializing in an in-memory, column-oriented relational database management system. Its analytics engine supports data warehouse deployments, analytics acceleration, and AI/ML model enablement.

companies.name: EZCorp
companies.description: EZCORP, Inc. is an American pawn shop operator based in Austin, Texas, providing services across the US and Latin America. It is publicly traded and is the second largest pawn shop operator in the US.

companies.name: EZchip Semiconductor
companies.description: EZchip Semiconductor Ltd. was an Israeli fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Yokneam. It developed and marketed Ethernet network processors before being acquired by Mellanox Technologies in 2016.

companies.name: Mitsubishi Electric
companies.description: Mitsubishi Electric Corporation is a Japanese multinational electronics and electrical equipment manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo. Founded in 1921 as a spin-off from Mitsubishi Shipbuilding's electrical machinery division.

companies.name: Esprit Holdings
companies.description: Esprit Holdings Limited is a global retail company incorporated in Bermuda with headquarters in North Point, Hong Kong. It offers clothing, accessories, footwear, jewelry, and housewares under the Esprit label. The company also has major locations in Germany, the Netherlands, and New York City.

companies.name: Eastern Bank
companies.description: Eastern Bank is a bank based in Boston, Massachusetts. It was the oldest and largest mutual bank in the United States before de-mutualizing in 2020. It is also the largest community bank in Massachusetts.

companies.name: Roivant
companies.description: Roivant Sciences Ltd. is an American multinational healthcare company focused on applying technology to drug development. Founded in 2014, it is headquartered in New York City with major offices in Boston and Basel. The company builds subsidiary life sciences and health technology companies.

companies.name: Guardant Health
companies.description: Guardant Health, Inc. is an American biotechnology company based in Palo Alto, California. It was co-founded by Helmy Eltoukhy and AmirAli Talasaz, who serve as co-chief executive officers.

companies.name: Eaton Vance
companies.description: Eaton Vance Corp. is an American investment management firm based in Boston, Massachusetts. It is one of the oldest investment companies in the United States, with a history dating back to 1924.

companies.name: Ebara Corporation
companies.description: Ebara Corporation is a publicly traded manufacturing company based in Tokyo, Japan. It produces environmental and industrial machinery such as pumps and turbines and owns companies in the US and Italy. Ebara also supplies clean drinking water in Kenya through its WaterKiosk partnership.

companies.name: Best Buy
companies.description: Best Buy Co., Inc. is an American multinational consumer electronics retailer headquartered in Richfield, Minnesota. Founded in 1966 as Sound of Music, it was rebranded as Best Buy in 1983 with a focus on consumer electronics.

companies.name: Edgewell Personal Care
companies.description: The Edgewell Personal Care Company is an American multinational consumer products company headquartered in Shelton, Connecticut. It was formed in 2015 following a corporate spin-off from Energizer Holdings, Inc.

companies.name: Einstein Bros. Bagels
companies.description: Einstein Bros. Bagels is an American chain of bagel cafes. In the 1990s, it acquired several regional bagel chains across the US. After filing for bankruptcy in 2000, it was bought by New World Coffee and became part of Panera Brands in 2021.

companies.name: El Paso Electric
companies.description: El Paso Electric is a Texas-based public utility company that generates, transmits, and distributes electricity in west Texas and southern New Mexico. Its energy sources include nuclear, natural gas, solar, and wind. The company owns six generating facilities and serves approximately 437,000 customers.

companies.name: Elbit Imaging Ltd.
companies.description: Elbit Imaging Ltd. is an Israeli holding company involved in real estate, medical imaging, hotels, shopping malls, and retail. It was formerly known as Elbit Medical Imaging Ltd. The company operates across multiple sectors beyond its original medical imaging focus.

companies.name: Elders Limited
companies.description: Elders Limited is an Australian agribusiness providing agricultural goods and services to primary producers in Australia. It has undergone several name changes including Elder, Stirling & Co. and Elder Smith & Co. Ltd. The company focuses on supporting the agricultural sector.

companies.name: Elecom
companies.description: Elecom Co., Ltd. is a Japanese electronics company founded in Osaka in 1986 by Junji Hada. It manufactures office and other furniture for electronics, computer peripherals, gaming peripherals, computer memory USB flash drives, keyboards, and related devices. The company operates in the information technology sector.

companies.name: Wacker Chemie AG
companies.description: Wacker Chemie AG is a German multinational chemical company founded in 1914 by Alexander Wacker. The Wacker family controls more than 50 percent of the shares. The company operates over 25 production sites across Europe, Asia, and the Americas.

companies.name: Electro Scientific Industries
companies.description: Electro Scientific Industries, Inc. (ESI) is an American high technology company headquartered in Beaverton, Oregon since 2021. Founded in 1944, it develops and supplies photonic and laser systems for microelectronics manufacturers. It is the oldest high-tech company in Oregon and part of the Silicon Forest technology cluster.

companies.name: RS Group plc
companies.description: RS Group plc is a distributor of industrial and electrical products based in London, England. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. The company operates in the industrials and chemicals sector.

companies.name: Electronics for Imaging
companies.description: Electronics for Imaging, Inc. (EFI) is an international company based in Silicon Valley, currently located in Fremont, California. It specializes in digital printing technology and expanded into textile printing with the acquisition of Reggiani Macchine in 2015 and Optitex in 2016.

companies.name: Elementis
companies.industry: manufacture of chemicals and chemical products
companies.description: Elementis plc is one of the UK's largest specialty chemicals and personal care businesses with extensive operations in the United States, Europe, and Asia. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index. The company operates in the chemicals manufacturing sector.

companies.name: Elio Motors
companies.description: Elio Motors was a US company founded in 2009 by Paul Elio to design and manufacture a three-wheeled, enclosed autocycle. It collected over US$28 million in customer deposits between 2013 and 2018 but later filed with the SEC expressing doubt about its financial viability.

companies.name: Elizabeth Arden
companies.description: Elizabeth Arden, Inc. is a major American cosmetics, skin care, and fragrance company founded by Elizabeth Arden. It is based in the United States and has been a wholly owned subsidiary of Revlon, Inc. since 2016.

companies.name: Elron Ventures Ltd
companies.description: Elron Ventures is an Israeli technology holding company based in Tel Aviv. Founded in 1962, it has been involved in setting up, funding, and developing over 30 companies across sectors including clean technology, software, semiconductors, medical technology, telecommunications, defence, and aerospace.

companies.name: EMCOR
companies.description: EMCOR Group, Inc. is an engineering, construction, and property management company headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut, United States. It operates in the engineering industry.

companies.name: Emera
companies.description: Emera Incorporated is a publicly traded Canadian multinational energy holding company based in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Created in 1998 during the privatization of Nova Scotia Power, it invests in regulated electricity generation, transmission, and distribution across North America and the Caribbean.

companies.name: Emergent BioSolutions
companies.description: Emergent BioSolutions Inc. is an American multinational specialty biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Gaithersburg, Maryland. It develops vaccines and antibody therapeutics for infectious diseases and opioid overdoses, and provides medical devices for biodefense purposes.

companies.name: Emeritus Assisted Living
companies.description: Emeritus Corporation, doing business as Emeritus Senior Living, was a provider of independent living, assisted living, Alzheimer's care, and skilled nursing for seniors in the United States. Founded in 1993, it was acquired by Brookdale Senior Living in 2014.

companies.name: Empire Company
companies.description: Empire Company Limited is a Canadian conglomerate headquartered in Stellarton, Nova Scotia, primarily engaged in food retail and corporate investments. It owns the Sobeys supermarket chain and other brands, and formerly owned Empire Theatres until 2013.

companies.name: Empire District Electric Company
companies.description: The Empire District Electric Company is an investor-owned utility providing electric, natural gas, and water services to customers in Missouri, Kansas, Oklahoma, and Arkansas. It also has a subsidiary providing fiber optic services.

companies.name: Empire Life
companies.description: The Empire Life Insurance Company, operating as Empire Life, is a Canadian life insurance and financial services company headquartered in Kingston, Ontario. Incorporated in 1923, it is a subsidiary of E-L Financial Corporation Limited and offers individual and group life, health, and investment products.

companies.name: Empire Resorts
companies.description: Empire Resorts is a gaming company headquartered in Monticello, New York. It owns and operates Resorts World Catskills and Monticello Raceway in the Catskill Mountains and is owned by affiliates of the Genting Group.

companies.name: EnQuest
companies.description: EnQuest plc is an independent petroleum exploration and production company based in the United Kingdom. It operates mainly in the United Kingdom Continental Shelf. EnQuest is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Encore Capital Group
companies.description: Encore Capital Group, Inc. is a publicly traded debt buyer headquartered in San Diego, United States. It operates throughout the U.S. and is listed on NASDAQ. The company is a component of the Russell 2000, S&P SmallCap 600, and Wilshire 4500 indices.

companies.name: Endo International plc
companies.description: Endo International plc is an American Irish-domiciled pharmaceutical company specializing in generics and specialty branded drugs. It generates most of its sales from the U.S. healthcare system. The company executed a corporate tax inversion to Ireland in 2013 to benefit from Ireland's tax system.

companies.name: Enel X
companies.description: Enel X Global Retail is a division of the Enel Group focused on energy supply, energy management services, and electric mobility. The company is based in Rome, Italy. It operates in both public and private sectors.

companies.name: Enerflex
companies.description: Enerflex Ltd. is a global supplier of products and services to the power generation and gas production industries. The company is headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. It serves clients worldwide.

companies.name: Energen
companies.description: Energen Corporation was a company engaged in hydrocarbon exploration in the United States. In 2018, it was acquired by Diamondback Energy. The company is no longer independent.

companies.name: EnergySolutions
companies.description: EnergySolutions is an American company specializing in processing low level waste. It is headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah. The company was formed in 2007 through the acquisition of three nuclear waste disposal companies.

companies.name: Energy Recovery Inc.
companies.description: Energy Recovery Inc. is an American manufacturer of energy recovery devices used in the water industry. The company focuses on technologies that improve energy efficiency. It operates within the United States.

companies.name: Energy Transfer
companies.description: Energy Transfer LP is an American company involved in pipeline transportation, storage, and terminaling of natural gas, crude oil, and related products. It is headquartered in Dallas, Texas, and was founded in 1996. The company is organized as a publicly traded limited partnership.

companies.name: Engineers India Limited
companies.description: Engineers India Limited (EIL) is an Indian public sector company providing industrial technology, engineering consultancy, and technology licensing. Established in 1965, it focuses on hydrocarbon projects and has diversified into metallurgy, infrastructure, water management, and fertilizers.

companies.name: Portuguese Investment Bank
companies.description: Banco BPI, formerly Banco Português de Investimento, is a Portuguese private investment bank headquartered in Porto. Founded in 1981, it serves companies, institutional, and private clients. It is the third largest private Portuguese financial group and is owned by CaixaBank.

companies.name: Valaris plc
companies.description: Valaris Limited is an offshore drilling contractor headquartered in Houston, Texas, and incorporated in Bermuda. It is the largest offshore drilling and well drilling company globally, owning 52 rigs including jackup rigs, drillships, and semi-submersible platform drilling rigs.

companies.name: Entegris
companies.description: Entegris, Inc. supplies materials for the semiconductor and other high-tech industries. The company operates globally with facilities in multiple countries and is headquartered in Billerica, Massachusetts.

companies.name: Enterprise Products
companies.description: Enterprise Products Partners L.P. is an American midstream natural gas and crude oil pipeline company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It acquired GulfTerra in 2004 and was ranked No. 89 in the 2026 Fortune 500 list.

companies.name: Entravision Communications
companies.description: Entravision Communications Corporation is an American media company based in Santa Monica, California. It primarily serves the Spanish-speaking Hispanic and Latino community and is the largest affiliate group of the Univision and UniMás television networks.

companies.name: Patterson Companies
companies.description: Patterson Companies, Inc. is an American company based in Mendota Heights, Minnesota. Established in 1877 as a dental company, it expanded into the animal health industry in 2001 and further grew with a 2015 acquisition.

companies.name: Epocrates
companies.description: epocrates is a mobile medical reference application providing healthcare professionals with clinical information at the point of care. Initially developed in 1998 for Palm Pilot, it assists in drug interactions, medical calculations, diagnosis, and treatment decisions.

companies.name: Equity Media Holdings
companies.description: Equity Media Holdings Corporation was a broadcasting company based in Little Rock, Arkansas, owning television stations across the United States. It focused on Hispanic and Asian American communities and operated English-language network affiliates in various markets.

companies.name: Equity One
companies.description: Equity One, Inc. was a real estate investment trust investing in shopping centers across major U.S. cities including New York, Boston, and Los Angeles. As of 2016, it owned 122 properties totaling 12.8 million square feet.

companies.name: MDC Partners
companies.description: MDC Partners Inc. is an advertising and marketing holding company based in New York City. It operates a partnership model acquiring majority stakes in partner agencies and has over 50 partner firms worldwide. In 2021, it merged with The Stagwell Group.

companies.name: Esperion Therapeutics
companies.description: Esperion Therapeutics, Inc. is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan. It focuses on developing bempedoic acid, an oral small molecule aimed at lowering elevated LDL cholesterol levels. The company is publicly traded.

companies.name: Estrela
companies.description: Estrela is a Brazilian toy manufacturer founded in São Paulo in 1937. It began producing dolls and wooden toy cars and became a publicly traded corporation in 1944. As of 2005, Carlos Tilkian was the CEO.

companies.name: SSAB
companies.description: SSAB AB is a Swedish steel-producing company formed in 1978. Its largest shareholders include the Swedish state-owned mining company LKAB and the Government of Finland. The company was formerly known as Svenskt Stål AB.

companies.name: Nielsen Company
companies.description: Nielsen Holdings plc is an American media audience measurement firm operating in over 100 countries. It employs approximately 15,000 people worldwide. The company is involved in the information industry.

companies.name: Orange Sky Golden Harvest
companies.description: Orange Sky Golden Harvest is a Hong Kong-based film production, distribution, and exhibition company. Previously known as Golden Harvest Entertainment Group until 2009, it dominated Hong Kong cinema box office sales in the 1970s and 1980s and helped introduce Hong Kong action films globally.

companies.name: Even
companies.description: Even is a Brazilian construction and real estate company listed on the São Paulo Stock Exchange (B3). It operates in the real estate sector in Brazil.

companies.name: Eventbrite
companies.description: Eventbrite is an American live events marketplace and website that allows users to browse, create, and promote local events. It enables publishing unlimited events of any size at no charge.

companies.name: Evercore Partners
companies.description: Evercore Inc., formerly Evercore Partners, is a global independent investment banking advisory firm founded in 1995. It has advised on over $4.7 trillion in merger, acquisition, and restructuring transactions since its founding.

companies.name: Everbright Securities
companies.description: Everbright Securities Company Limited is a securities brokerage based in Shanghai, China. Founded in 1996, it is controlled by the state-owned China Everbright Group.

companies.name: Evertz Microsystems
companies.description: Evertz Microsystems Limited is a Canadian multinational company developing software and hardware for the broadcast industry. It designs and markets video and audio infrastructure equipment and solutions for various sectors including television broadcast and telecommunications.

companies.name: Everyday Health
companies.description: Everyday Health is an American online publication focused on health news and information, medically reviewed by physicians and healthcare professionals. Founded in 2002 as Agora Media, it is now a subsidiary of the Everyday Health Group, a division of Ziff Davis, a digital media and internet company.

companies.name: Evia Oyj
companies.description: Evia Oyj was one of the largest Finnish marketing communication agencies, founded in 1955. It was originally known as Markkinointi Viherjuuri before changing its name to Evia Oyj in 2001.

companies.name: Exco Technologies
companies.description: Exco Technologies Limited is a Canadian global designer, developer, and manufacturer of dies, molds, components, assemblies, and consumable equipment for the die-cast, extrusion, and automotive industries. Founded in 1952, it is headquartered in Markham, Ontario, and operates 20 manufacturing locations in 10 countries.

companies.name: Exelixis
companies.description: Exelixis, Inc. is a genomics-based drug discovery company located in Alameda, California. It produces Cometriq, a treatment approved by the U.S. FDA for medullary thyroid cancer and has clinical activity in several other metastatic cancers.

companies.name: Expolanka Holdings
companies.description: Expolanka Holdings Limited is a diversified conglomerate based in Sri Lanka with interests in logistics, leisure, food, and technology. It has a global presence in 39 countries and over 100 cities.

companies.name: Exponent
companies.description: Exponent, Inc. is an American engineering and scientific consulting firm with a team of scientists, physicians, engineers, and business consultants. It performs research and analysis in more than 90 technical disciplines and operates 20 offices in the U.S. and five overseas.

companies.name: Extendicare
companies.description: Extendicare Inc. is a Canadian for-profit long-term care provider offering housing, care, and related services to seniors. Based in Markham, Ontario, it operates over 100 care facilities under the Extendicare, Esprit Lifestyle, and ParaMed brands with 23,000 employees.

companies.name: e.l.f. Cosmetics
companies.description: e.l.f. Beauty, Inc. is an American cosmetics brand based in Oakland, California, founded in 2004. It sells bath, skin-care, and makeup products in 18 countries through stores like Target, CVS, Sephora, Walmart, and its website, which also serves as a social networking site.

companies.name: FAW Car Company
companies.description: FAW Car Company Limited is a subsidiary of FAW Group based in Changchun, Jilin, China. It has been listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange since 1997 and produces passenger car marques including Hongqi, Bestune, FAW, and Oley.

companies.name: FBR Capital Markets
companies.description: FBR & Co. was a capital markets firm headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, founded in 1989. It provided investment banking, merger and acquisition advisory, institutional brokerage, and research services across multiple sectors before being sold to B. Riley Financial in 2017.

companies.name: Teledyne FLIR
companies.description: Teledyne FLIR LLC, formerly FLIR Systems Inc., is a United States-based company specializing in the design and production of thermal imaging cameras and sensors. It became a subsidiary of Teledyne Technologies in January 2021. The company serves mainly government customers, with about 31% of its 2020 revenues coming from the U.S. federal government and its agencies.

companies.name: FLY Leasing
companies.description: FLY Leasing is an aircraft leasing investment company based in Ireland. It focuses on leasing aircraft to various customers in the aviation sector.

companies.name: FNB Corporation
companies.description: FNB Corporation is a diversified financial services corporation headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It is the holding company for First National Bank and operates more than 355 offices across several major metropolitan areas in the United States. The company employs over 4,600 people.

companies.name: Christian Dior
companies.description: Christian Dior SE, commonly known as Dior, is a French multinational corporation and fashion house specializing in luxury goods. Founded in 1946 by Christian Dior, it produces haute couture items. Its clothing line is managed by Christian Dior Couture, a subsidiary of LVMH.

companies.name: FairPoint Communications
companies.description: FairPoint Communications, Inc. was an American telecommunications operator headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It provided local and long-distance phone service, data, internet, broadband, television, and fiber services across 31 markets in 17 states, mainly in rural areas. The company was involved in acquiring Verizon landline operations alongside Frontier Communications.

companies.name: Fairway Market
companies.description: Fairway Market is an American grocery chain founded in 1933 in New York City. After financial difficulties and two Chapter 11 bankruptcies, the brand was acquired by Wakefern Food Corporation. Four stores continue to operate under the Wakefern cooperative member Village Super Markets, including the flagship location in Manhattan.

companies.name: Salem Media Group
companies.description: Salem Media Group, Inc. is an American media company based in Irving, Texas. It operates as a radio broadcaster, internet content provider, and publisher of magazines and books. The company targets audiences interested in Christian values and family-themed conservative content.

companies.name: FalconStor Software
companies.description: FalconStor Software, Inc. is a data management software company headquartered in Austin, Texas. It operates in the software industry, providing data management solutions.

companies.name: Malvins Islands Holdings
companies.description: FIH Group plc, also known as Malvins Islands Holdings, is a British conglomerate operating in the Falkland Islands through the Falkland Islands Company. Its other businesses include the Portsmouth Harbour Ferry Company in England and a London-based art storage and transport company called Momart.

companies.name: Famous Dave's
companies.description: Famous Dave's of America, Inc. is a chain of barbecue restaurants primarily located in the Midwestern United States. Founded in 1994 near Hayward, Wisconsin, it serves pork ribs, chicken, beef brisket, and various barbecue sauces.
