The chain expanded across the U.S. and Puerto Rico, though Puerto Rico locations closed after Hurricane Maria. It has locations in 30 U.S. states and four international cities.

companies.name: Fantasia Holdings
companies.description: Fantasia Holdings Group Company Limited is a leading property developer in China. It operates in five segments including property development, investment, operation services, agency services, and hotel services. The company also provides tourism, entertainment, and interior design services.

companies.name: Far EasTone
companies.description: Far EasTone Telecommunications Co., Ltd., marketed as FET, is a telecommunications company based in Taiwan. It is the third largest telecommunications provider in Taiwan, following Chunghwa Telecom and Taiwan Mobile.

companies.name: Cintra
companies.description: Cintra, S.A. is one of the largest private developers of transport infrastructure globally, focusing on toll roads and car parks. It was formerly traded on the Madrid Stock Exchange and part of the IBEX 35 index before being reacquired by Ferrovial in 2009.

companies.name: Thai Rung Union Car
companies.description: Thai Rung Union Car, formerly Thai Motor Corporation, is the first Thai-based automobile manufacturer established in 1967. It assembles vehicles under various brands including Leyland, Isuzu, Toyota, Nissan, Chevrolet, and its own brand.

companies.name: Federal Agricultural Mortgage Corporation
companies.description: The Federal Agricultural Mortgage Corporation, also known as Farmer Mac, is a federally chartered corporation in the United States established in 1988. It creates a secondary market for agricultural real estate and housing mortgage loans to support farmers, ranchers, and rural communities.

companies.name: Cascades
companies.description: Cascades Inc. is a Canadian company producing, converting, and marketing packaging and tissue products mainly from recycled fibers. Founded in 1964, it operates over 70 units in North America and employs around 10,000 people.

companies.name: Federated Hermes
companies.description: Federated Hermes is an investment manager headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States. Founded in 1955, it offers a range of investment strategies including equity, fixed-income, and alternative markets to various clients including corporations and government entities.

companies.name: Ferguson Enterprises
companies.description: Ferguson Enterprises Inc. is the largest U.S. distributor of plumbing, HVAC, appliances, lighting, and water products. Headquartered in Newport News, Virginia, it operates numerous distribution centers and branches across the United States and Canada.

companies.name: Ferrellgas
companies.description: Ferrellgas Partners, L.P. is an American propane supplier founded in 1939 in Atchison, Kansas. The company is headquartered in Liberty, Missouri and operates nationwide.

companies.name: Ferrexpo
companies.description: Ferrexpo plc is a Swiss-based commodity trading and mining company, the third largest exporter of iron ore pellets worldwide. Its operations are based in central Ukraine, and its trading office is in London where it is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Ferro Corporation
companies.description: Ferro Corporation is an American producer of technology-based performance materials for manufacturers, focusing on performance colors, pigments, porcelain enamel, and tile coatings. Founded in 1919 by Harry D. Cushman in Cleveland, it is currently headquartered in Mayfield Heights, Ohio.

companies.name: Fiberhome Networks
companies.description: FiberHome Telecommunication Technologies Co., Ltd. is a Chinese networking and telecommunication equipment provider headquartered in Hongshan District, Wuhan, Hubei province. Founded in 1999, it is one of eight affiliated companies specializing in IP networks under FiberHome Company.

companies.name: Fidelity & Guaranty Life
companies.description: F&G Annuities & Life, Inc. is a public company founded in 1959 and headquartered in Des Moines, Iowa. It primarily provides annuities, life insurance, and pension buyout services.

companies.name: Financial Street Holding
companies.description: Financial Street Holding Company Limited is a listed company on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange that mainly sells and leases high-end business real estate in Beijing Financial Street area. It also develops high technology products and provides parking services.

companies.name: Fineos
companies.description: Fineos is a software development company founded in 1993 that provides enterprise software for insurance and government social insurance. The company is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, with offices in North America, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand.

companies.name: Finisar
companies.description: Finisar Corporation manufactures optical communication components and subsystems. Founded in 1987 in Menlo Park, California, it merged with Optium Corporation in 2008 and was acquired by II-VI Incorporated in 2019.

companies.name: Finish Line, Inc.
companies.description: Finish Line, Inc. is an American retail chain selling athletic shoes and related apparel. Founded in 1976 and headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, it operates stores in 40 states and Puerto Rico, as well as branded departments in Macy's stores.

companies.name: First American Corporation
companies.description: First American Financial Corporation is an American financial services company providing title insurance and settlement services to the real estate and mortgage industries.

companies.name: First Bancorp
companies.description: First Bancorp is an American bank holding company headquartered in Southern Pines, North Carolina. It operates as First Bank in North Carolina and South Carolina.

companies.name: First BanCorp
companies.description: First BanCorp is a publicly traded financial holding company located in San Juan, Puerto Rico.

companies.name: First Citizens BancShares
companies.description: First Citizens Bancshares, Inc. is a bank holding company based in Raleigh, North Carolina. It operates First Citizens Bank with over 500 branches in 23 states and owns Silicon Valley Bank with 39 offices in 15 states. It is one of the largest banks in the United States.

companies.name: First Commonwealth Bank
companies.description: First Commonwealth Financial Corporation is a financial services company based in Indiana, Pennsylvania. It primarily serves Western and Central Pennsylvania as well as Canton and Columbus in Ohio. The company operates in the banking sector.

companies.name: First Community Bancshares
companies.description: First Community Bankshares, Inc. is a bank holding company and parent of First Community Bank of Bluefield, Virginia. It operates 45 locations across Virginia, West Virginia, North Carolina, and two in Tennessee. As of 2023, it had $3.6 billion in assets.

companies.name: First Federal Bank of the Midwest
companies.description: Premier Financial Corp., headquartered in Defiance, Ohio, is the holding company for Premier Bank. Premier Bank operates 73 branches and 9 loan offices across Ohio, Michigan, Indiana, and Pennsylvania. It is a regional banking company.

companies.name: First Financial Bank
companies.description: First Financial Bank is a regional bank operated by First Financial Corporation based in Terre Haute, Indiana. It is the oldest national bank in Indiana and the fifth oldest in the United States. The corporation is Vigo County's only publicly traded company.

companies.name: First Internet Bank of Indiana
companies.description: First Internet Bank of Indiana is the sole subsidiary of First Internet Bancorp, headquartered in Fishers, Indiana. It was established as one of the first state-chartered banks to operate exclusively online and via telephone without physical branches.

companies.name: First Interstate Bank
companies.description: First Interstate BancSystem, Inc. is a financial holding company headquartered in Billings, Montana. It owns First Interstate Bank, a community bank with locations in 14 states across the Western and Midwestern United States. It is the largest bank based in Montana by total assets.

companies.name: First Merchants Corporation
companies.description: First Merchants Corporation is a financial holding company headquartered in Muncie, Indiana. It includes First Merchants Bank and First Merchants Private Wealth Advisors, offering commercial and personal banking as well as investment advisory services.

companies.name: First Midwest Bancorp
companies.description: First Midwest Bancorp, Inc. was headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, near O'Hare Airport. The company originated in Joliet, Illinois, and expanded to serve Chicago suburbs, northwest Indiana, downstate Illinois, southeast Wisconsin, and the Quad Cities area including Iowa.

companies.name: First National of Nebraska
companies.description: First National of Nebraska, Inc. is an interstate bank holding company based in Omaha, Nebraska. It is the parent company of First National Bank of Omaha and is primarily owned by the Lauritzen family. It is the oldest national bank headquartered west of the Missouri River.

companies.name: First Niagara Bank
companies.description: First Niagara Bank was a regional banking corporation headquartered in Buffalo, New York. It was insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation and was the 44th-largest bank in the United States by assets as of mid-2013. Its parent company was First Niagara Financial Group, Inc.

companies.name: First Horizon Bank
companies.description: First Horizon Corporation, formerly First Tennessee Bank, is a financial services company based in Memphis, Tennessee. It operates through its banking subsidiary, First Horizon Bank, providing services across 12 states in the Southeastern US. It is the fourth largest regional bank in that region.

companies.name: Anhui Conch Cement Co., Ltd.
companies.industry: cement industry in the People's Republic of China
companies.description: Anhui Conch Cement Co., Ltd., also known as Anhui Conch, is the largest cement manufacturer and seller in mainland China. The company is headquartered in Anhui Province and focuses on the manufacture and sales of cement and clinker.

companies.name: JAC Group
companies.description: JAC Group is a Chinese manufacturer of automobiles and commercial vehicles. The company is based in Hefei, China, and operates in the automotive industry.

companies.name: Five Below
companies.description: Five Below, Inc. is an American chain of specialty discount gift shops headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Founded in 2002, it targets tweens and teens with most products priced up to $5 and some up to $40. By 2014, it had over 1,850 stores across the United States.

companies.name: Flagstar Bank
companies.description: Flagstar Bank was an American commercial bank headquartered in Troy, Michigan, founded in 1987. It operated as a consumer and commercial bank and mortgage lender. After acquisition by New York Community Bancorp in 2022, the brand and corporate names underwent changes through 2025.

companies.name: BiondVax
companies.description: BiondVax Pharmaceuticals Ltd. is an Israeli biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and manufacturing immunotherapeutic products. Its primary focus is on treatments for infectious and autoimmune diseases.

companies.name: Intellia Therapeutics
companies.description: Intellia Therapeutics, Inc. is an American clinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel therapeutics using CRISPR-based technologies. Its programs include in vivo gene editing therapies and ex vivo engineered human cell therapies for cancer and autoimmune diseases.

companies.name: Abrdn
companies.description: Aberdeen Group plc, trading as Aberdeen, is a wealth and investment company headquartered in Edinburgh, Scotland. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index. The company's registered office is on George Street in Edinburgh.

companies.name: The Green Organic Dutchman
companies.description: BZAM Ltd., formerly The Green Organic Dutchman Holdings Ltd., is a Canadian recreational cannabis company headquartered in Mississauga, Ontario. It completed the largest cannabis industry IPO on the Toronto Stock Exchange in 2018. Its stock was suspended and delisted from Canadian exchanges in 2024.

companies.name: Texas Capital Bank
companies.description: Texas Capital Bank is a bank headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It operates branches in every major city in Texas and has an online-only banking division called Bask Bank. Its parent company is Texas Capital Bancshares.

companies.name: Metro City Bank
companies.description: Metro City Bank is a Korean-American bank based in Doraville, Georgia. It offers personal and commercial banking services and operates 19 branches across several states including Texas and New York. It is the largest Korean-American bank not based in Los Angeles.

companies.name: Jiangsu Sainty Corporation Limited
companies.description: Jiangsu Sainty Corporation Limited is a Chinese listed company based in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province. The company is involved in exporting clothes overseas.

companies.name: Flowers Foods
companies.description: Flowers Foods, Inc. is headquartered in Thomasville, Georgia, and produces and markets packaged bakery foods in the United States. It operates 44 bakeries across 19 states producing bread, snack cakes, tortillas, and pastries. It is the second-largest baking company in the U.S.

companies.name: Fong’s Industries Group
companies.description: CHTC Fong's Industries Co., Ltd., founded in 1963, focuses on designing, developing, manufacturing, and selling textile dyeing and finishing machinery. It was one of the first Hong Kong companies to enter the textile dyeing finishing market in China.

companies.name: Formula Systems (1985) Ltd.
companies.description: Formula Systems (1985) Ltd. is a publicly traded holding company headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel. It operates mainly in information technology through its subsidiaries. In 2010, Polish software maker Asseco acquired a majority stake in the company.

companies.name: Fortune Brands Home & Security
companies.description: Fortune Brands Innovations, Inc. is an American manufacturer of home and security products headquartered in Deerfield, Illinois. Its brands include Moen, Master Lock, and MasterBrand Cabinets. It is a Fortune 500 company and part of the S&P 400 Index.

companies.name: Foundation Coal
companies.description: Foundation Coal Holdings, Inc. was a large American coal mining company with offices in Linthicum Heights, Maryland. It operated coal mines in Pennsylvania, West Virginia, and Wyoming. It merged with Alpha Natural Resources in 2009 to form the third largest American coal company.

companies.name: Foxit
companies.description: Fujian Foxit Software Development Joint Stock Co., Ltd., known as Foxit Software, is a software developer based in Fuzhou, China. It develops PDF software and tools and has subsidiaries and offices in multiple countries including the United States and Germany.

companies.name: Foxtons
companies.description: Foxtons Group plc is a British estate agency company dealing with lettings and sales. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Planar Systems
companies.description: Planar Systems, Inc. is an American digital display manufacturer based in Hillsboro, Oregon. Founded in 1983 as a spin-off from Tektronix, it was the first U.S. manufacturer of electroluminescent digital displays. Since 2015, it has been an independent subsidiary of Leyard Optoelectronic Co.

companies.name: Franco-Nevada
companies.description: Franco-Nevada Corporation is a gold-focused royalty and streaming company based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. It has a diversified portfolio of cash-flow producing assets and is traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange and New York Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Ribbon Communications
companies.description: Ribbon Communications Inc. is a public company headquartered in Plano, Texas. It produces software, IP, and optical networking solutions for service providers, enterprises, and critical infrastructure sectors. The company was formed in 2017 from the merger of Genband and Sonus Networks.

companies.name: China Jinmao
companies.description: China Jinmao Holdings Group Limited is a real estate developer incorporated and headquartered in Hong Kong. It is a subsidiary of the state-owned Sinochem Corporation and operates mainly in Mainland China cities such as Shanghai, Beijing, and Zhuhai. The company was formerly known as Franshion Properties (China) Limited.

companies.name: Joby Aviation
companies.description: Joby Aviation, Inc. is an American aviation company developing an electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft intended for air taxi services. It is headquartered in Santa Cruz, California, with additional offices in San Carlos and Marina, California, as well as Munich, Germany.

companies.name: Fred's
companies.description: Fred's Inc. was a retail store chain headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee, operating in 15 southeastern U.S. states. It operated both pharmacies and discount general merchandise stores but announced multiple store closures in 2019, significantly reducing its number of locations.

companies.name: B&G Foods
companies.description: B&G Foods, Inc. is an American branded foods holding company based in Parsippany, New Jersey. It was formed in 1996 to acquire Bloch & Guggenheimer, a Manhattan-based producer of pickles, relish, and condiments founded in 1889.

companies.name: freelancer.com
companies.description: Freelancer is an Australian freelance marketplace website founded in 2009 and headquartered in Sydney. It allows employers to post jobs that freelancers can bid on. The company also has offices in Vancouver, London, Buenos Aires, Manila, and Jakarta.

companies.name: Wendy's
companies.description: Wendy's International, LLC is an American international fast food restaurant chain founded in 1969 in Columbus, Ohio. Its headquarters moved to Dublin, Ohio in 2006. In 2008, it merged with Triarc, the parent company of Arby's, and it is one of the world's largest hamburger fast-food chains.

companies.name: Freshii
companies.description: Freshii is a Canadian fast casual restaurant franchise founded in 2005 by Matthew Corrin. It serves burritos, wraps, soups, salads, and frozen yogurt, and has expanded to over 100 locations across multiple countries including Canada, the United States, and Sweden.

companies.name: Freshpet
companies.description: Freshpet, Inc. is an American pet food company that markets fresh cat and dog food products requiring refrigeration. It is publicly traded on the Nasdaq exchange under the ticker symbol FRPT.

companies.name: Full House Resorts
companies.description: Full House Resorts, Inc. is an American casino developer and operator based in Summerlin South, Nevada. The company operates five casinos and has had notable figures such as Allen Paulson and Lee Iacocca involved in its history.

companies.name: Fulton Financial Corporation
companies.description: Fulton Financial Corporation is an American regional financial services holding company headquartered in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.

companies.name: Funko
companies.description: Funko Inc. is an American company that manufactures licensed pop culture collectibles including vinyl figurines and bobbleheads. Founded in 1998 by Mike Becker, its first bobblehead was of the Big Boy restaurant mascot.

companies.name: Furukawa Electric
companies.description: Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company specializing in electric and electronics equipment.

companies.name: GAMCO Investors
companies.description: GAMCO Investors, Inc., formerly Gabelli Asset Management Company, is an American investment advice and brokerage services provider based in Rye, New York. It was founded and is majority owned by Mario Gabelli.

companies.name: GCI
companies.description: GCI Communication Corp is an Alaska-based telecommunications company providing Internet, landline, and cellular services. It operates through its own facilities and agreements and is a subsidiary of Liberty Capital Corporation.

companies.name: GMR Group
companies.description: GMR Group is an Indian multinational conglomerate headquartered in New Delhi, founded in 1978 by Grandhi Mallikarjuna Rao. It includes companies in infrastructure, energy, and airports, and operates projects in India and internationally.

companies.name: GRG Banking
companies.description: GRG Banking is a Chinese listed company specializing in financial self-service products. It develops, manufactures, sells, and services ATMs, automated fare collection systems, and currency recognition and processing equipment.

companies.name: International Game Technology
companies.description: International Game Technology PLC (IGT) is a multinational gambling company that produces slot machines and other gambling technology. It is headquartered in London and has offices in Rome, Providence, Rhode Island, and Las Vegas. The company is controlled with a 42 percent stake by De Agostini.

companies.name: GTx Incorporated
companies.description: GTx, Inc. was a pharmaceutical company focused on drugs in the selective estrogen receptor modulator (SERM) and selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) classes. Its drug development included enobosarm (ostarine) and GTx-758. The company was based in the United States.

companies.name: GVK
companies.description: GVK Industries Limited is an Indian conglomerate headquartered in Hyderabad with interests in energy, airports, hospitality, transportation, real estate, pharmaceuticals, and technology. It acquired Australian coal mines in Queensland and plans a $10 billion investment in mine, rail, and port projects. Its flagship company is GVK Power & Infrastructure Limited.

companies.name: Gaia
companies.description: Gaia, Inc. is an American media company founded in 1988 and based in Louisville, Colorado. It owns Gaia TV, a subscription video on-demand service featuring original and licensed alternative media documentaries on wellness, spirituality, and conspiracy theories.

companies.name: GAIN Capital
companies.description: GAIN Capital Holdings, Inc. was a US-based provider of online trading services headquartered in Warren, New Jersey. It offered market access and trade execution in foreign exchange, CFDs, and exchange-based products to retail and institutional investors. The company was acquired by StoneX Group in 2020.

companies.name: Lakefront Biotherapeutics
companies.description: Lakefront Biotherapeutics is a Belgian pharmaceutical research company founded in 1999. Its headquarters are in Mechelen, with additional locations in Leiden, Romainville, Basel, Milan, Madrid, Boston, and Zagreb.

companies.name: Galena Biopharma
companies.description: Galena Biopharma, Inc. was a publicly traded pharmaceutical company based in San Ramon, California. Founded in Worcester, Massachusetts, it moved to Oregon in 2011 and then to San Ramon in 2015. In 2017, it was acquired by Sellas Life Sciences Group Ltd. and renamed Sellas Life Sciences Group, Inc.

companies.name: Galliford Try
companies.description: Galliford Try plc is a British construction company based in Uxbridge, England. It was formed in 2000 by merging Try Group and Galliford. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Starwood
companies.description: Starwood Hotels and Resorts Worldwide, Inc. was a large company owning, operating, franchising, and managing hotels, resorts, spas, residences, and vacation ownership properties. Founded in 1969 as Hotel Investors Trust, it was acquired by Marriott International in 2016.

companies.name: Gas Malaysia
companies.description: Gas Malaysia Berhad is a natural gas distribution company headquartered in Shah Alam, Malaysia. It operates three regional offices in Prai, Gebeng, and Pasir Gudang, along with seven branch offices throughout Peninsular Malaysia.

companies.name: Gates Corporation
companies.description: Gates Industrial Corporation plc, based in Denver, Colorado, manufactures power transmission belts and fluid power products used in industrial and automotive applications. The company operates sales and manufacturing facilities across North and South America, Europe, Asia, Australia, and the Middle East.

companies.name: GenOn Energy
companies.description: GenOn Energy, Inc., headquartered in Houston, Texas, is an energy company supplying electricity to wholesale customers in the United States. It is one of the largest independent power producers in the country, operating power generation capacity using natural gas, fuel oil, and coal.

companies.name: Genel Energy
companies.description: Genel Energy plc is a publicly listed oil exploration and production company based in London, with offices in Istanbul and Hargeisa. It holds interests in the Tawke production sharing contract in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq and licenses in Somaliland and Oman.

companies.name: Generac Holdings Inc.
companies.description: Generac Holdings Inc., headquartered in Waukesha, Wisconsin, manufactures backup power generation products for residential, commercial, and industrial markets. Its power systems range from 800 watts to 250 kilowatts and are distributed through dealers, retailers, and wholesalers.

companies.name: General American Investors Company
companies.description: The General American Investors Company, Inc. is a closed-end fund managing a global portfolio primarily composed of United States securities, along with some international and private securities.

companies.name: Genesco
companies.description: Genesco Inc. is an American publicly owned specialty retailer and wholesaler of branded and licensed footwear and accessories. Its brand portfolio includes Dockers, Johnston & Murphy, Journeys, and Schuh.

companies.name: Genesis HealthCare
companies.description: Genesis HealthCare, headquartered in Kennett Square, Pennsylvania, provides short-term post-acute, rehabilitation, skilled nursing, and long-term care services. It owns or operates 290 skilled nursing facilities across 25 states and supplies rehabilitation therapy to about 1,700 healthcare providers in 45 states and D.C.

companies.name: Genesis Energy Limited
companies.description: Genesis Energy Limited is a New Zealand publicly listed company involved in electricity generation and retailing of electricity, natural gas, and LPG. It was formed during the 1998–99 reform of the New Zealand electricity sector and is 51% owned by the New Zealand Government.

companies.name: Genki Global Dining Concepts
companies.description: Genki Sushi is a Japanese chain of conveyor belt sushi restaurants established in 1990. The chain has expanded internationally with locations in Asia, Australia, and the United States, including California, Hawaii, and Washington.

companies.name: Gentex
companies.description: Gentex Corporation is an American electronics and technology company that designs and manufactures automatic-dimming rear-view mirrors and camera-based driver assistance systems for the automotive industry. It also produces dimmable aircraft windows and photoelectric smoke detectors for fire protection markets.

companies.name: Gentiva Health Services
companies.description: Gentiva Health Services is a provider of home health care, hospice, and related health services in the United States. It is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Before its acquisition by Kindred Healthcare in 2014, it was a Fortune 1000 company and part of the S&P 600 index.

companies.name: Genuine Parts Company
companies.description: Genuine Parts Company is an American distributor of automotive and industrial parts based in Atlanta, Georgia. Founded in 1928, it operates in multiple countries including the US, Canada, and several European nations. Its subsidiaries include Motion and NAPA Auto Parts.

companies.name: Genus plc
companies.description: Genus plc is a British company that sells elite genetics and biotechnology products to cattle and pig farmers. It is headquartered in Basingstoke, UK, and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: SiTime
companies.description: SiTime Corporation is a fabless chipmaker based in Santa Clara, California. It develops micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS) used for timing devices in electronics. The company is publicly traded.

companies.name: Viaplay Group
companies.description: Viaplay Group AB, formerly Nordic Entertainment Group AB, is a Swedish media and entertainment company headquartered in Stockholm.

companies.name: Marubeni
companies.description: Marubeni Corporation is a sōgō shōsha headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It is one of the largest general trading companies with leading market shares in cereal and paper pulp trading and a strong electrical and industrial plant business. It is a member of the Fuyo keiretsu.

companies.name: Ingersoll Rand
companies.description: Ingersoll Rand Inc. is an American multinational company providing industrial products. It was formed in 2020 through the spinoff of the industrial segment of Ingersoll-Rand plc and its merger with Gardner Denver.

companies.name: ASMPT
companies.description: ASMPT, formerly ASM Pacific Technology, is a Singapore-headquartered company listed in Hong Kong. It designs and manufactures machines and tools used in semiconductor and electronics assembly industries and was originally the Asia division of ASM International.

companies.name: Axiall Corporation
companies.description: Axiall Corporation manufactures and markets chlorovinyls and aromatics. After acquiring Royal Group Technologies, it also produces building materials such as piping, siding, window profiles, decking, and fencing.

companies.name: Georgia Power
companies.description: Georgia Power is an electric utility headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Established in 1902 as the Georgia Railway and Power Company, it began operations running streetcars in Atlanta as a successor to the Atlanta Consolidated Street Railway Company.

companies.name: Geron Corporation
companies.description: Geron Corporation is a biotechnology company based in Foster City, California. It specializes in developing and commercializing therapeutic products for cancer that inhibit telomerase.

companies.name: Gevo, Inc
companies.description: Gevo, Inc. is an American renewable chemicals and advanced biofuels company headquartered in Douglas County, Colorado. It develops bio-based alternatives to petroleum products using biotechnology and chemistry, focusing on sustainable raw materials like No. 2 dent corn to produce fuels and animal feed.

companies.name: Gezhouba Group
companies.description: China Gezhouba Group Company Limited is a Chinese construction and engineering company based in Wuhan, Hubei. It primarily constructs hydroelectric power plants, dams, roads, bridges, and other civil engineering projects in China and over 60 countries worldwide.

companies.name: GitLab Inc.
companies.description: GitLab Inc. is an American company that develops GitLab, an open-core DevOps software package. The software includes distributed version control, access control, bug tracking, task management, and wikis for projects.

companies.name: Energean Plc
companies.description: Energean plc is an international hydrocarbon exploration and production company focused on natural gas. It is listed on the London and Tel Aviv Stock Exchanges and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: FIGS
companies.description: Figs, Inc. is an American clothing company based in Santa Monica, California. It sells scrubs and other apparel products for healthcare professionals and was founded in 2013 by Heather Hasson and Trina Spear.

companies.name: Judo Bank
companies.description: Judo Bank is an Australian neobank that focuses on lending to small and medium-sized enterprises. It also offers personal term deposit products to consumers.

companies.name: MarketAxess
companies.description: MarketAxess Holdings Inc. is headquartered in New York City and operates electronic trading platforms for bonds and fixed income products. Its customers are institutional investors and broker-dealers.

companies.name: Okta
companies.description: Okta, Inc. is an American identity and access management company based in San Francisco. It provides cloud software for managing and securing user authentication across applications and devices.

companies.name: ASMedia
companies.description: ASMedia Technology Inc. is a Taiwanese integrated circuit design company. It designs USB, PCI Express, and SATA controllers, including most AM4 chipsets for AMD's Zen micro-architecture.

companies.name: Afterpay
companies.description: Afterpay Limited is an Australian technology company specializing in buy now, pay later lending. Founded in 2014, it is now owned by Block, Inc. Afterpay is one of the three most-used BNPL services globally.

companies.name: Bird
companies.description: Bird Global, Inc. is a micromobility company based in Miami, Florida, founded in 2017. It distributes electric scooters for short-term rental in over 350 cities. In 2024, it was acquired by Third Lane Mobility to avoid bankruptcy.

companies.name: Greene King
companies.logo_file: Greene King Brewery North Street Tavern Sudbury.jpg
companies.description: Greene King Limited is a British pub and brewing company founded in 1799 and based in Bury St Edmunds, Suffolk. It owns brands like Hungry Horse and Farmhouse Inns. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by CK Assets in 2019.

companies.name: Given Imaging
companies.description: Given Imaging Ltd. was an Israeli medical technology company producing diagnostic products for gastrointestinal disorders. It was dual-listed on NASDAQ and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Covidien in 2014, which later became part of Medtronic.

companies.name: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited is an Indian pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai. Founded in 1977, it manufactures generic drugs and active pharmaceutical ingredients. The company operates mainly in India, North America, and Europe and is publicly listed in India.

companies.name: Glentel
companies.description: Glentel Inc. is a Canadian telecommunications retailer based in Burnaby, British Columbia. It is jointly owned by BCE Inc. and Rogers Communications.

companies.name: Glimcher Realty Trust
companies.description: Glimcher Realty Trust was a real estate investment trust based in Columbus, Ohio, focusing on shopping mall investments. The company was acquired by Washington Prime Group in 2015.

companies.name: NextDC
companies.description: NextDC is an Australian data centre operator headquartered in Brisbane, Queensland. It is the largest listed developer and operator of data centres in Australia, operating 17 centres domestically and one in Malaysia as of 2026.

companies.name: Global Bio-Chem
companies.description: Global Bio-Chem Technology Group is a Chinese biotechnology company based in Hong Kong. It is owned by Changchun Dacheng Industry Group.

companies.name: Global Partners
companies.description: Global Partners LP is an American energy supply company organized as a master limited partnership. It focuses on importing and marketing petroleum products in North America, wholesaling crude oil, diesel, gasoline, heating oil, and kerosene.

companies.name: Global Payments
companies.description: Global Payments Inc. is an American multinational financial technology company that provides payment technology to merchants, issuers, and consumers. It processes payments made through credit cards, debit cards, and digital and contactless payments. The company was named to the Fortune 500 in June 2021.

companies.name: Globant
companies.description: Globant is an IT and software development company founded in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and later headquartered in Luxembourg. It operates internationally with significant revenue from North America, Latin America, Europe, and new markets. The company was formed in 2003 by four founders.

companies.name: GlobeImmune
companies.description: GlobeImmune, Inc. is a clinical-stage public biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Louisville, Colorado. It develops therapeutic vaccines to treat cancer and infectious diseases using its Tarmogen immunotherapy platform based on genetically modified yeast. As of August 2014, it had no marketed products.

companies.name: Globe Life
companies.wiki: Globe Life and Accident Insurance Company
companies.description: Globe Life is a life and health insurance provider based in McKinney, Texas, with executive offices also in Oklahoma City. It operates nationwide in the United States and is a subsidiary of Globe Life.

companies.name: Gloria Material Technology Corp.
companies.description: Gloria Material Technology Corp. is a specialty alloy manufacturer headquartered in Liouying industrial zone, Tainan, Taiwan. It is the only company in Taiwan with melting, forging, rolling, heat treating, and finishing processes for over 500 steel grades. Its main products include round and square bars.

companies.name: SenseTime
companies.description: SenseTime is a partly state-owned artificial intelligence company headquartered in Hong Kong. It develops technologies such as facial recognition, image recognition, autonomous driving, and medical image analysis. Since 2019, it has faced repeated U.S. government sanctions related to its facial recognition technology.

companies.name: Satrec Initiative
companies.description: Satrec Initiative Co., Ltd. is a South Korean satellite manufacturing company headquartered in Daejeon. Founded in 1999 by engineers who developed Korea's first satellite, it designs Earth observation satellites and provides space components. It has subsidiaries focused on satellite imagery and radiation monitoring solutions.

companies.name: London Stock Exchange Group
companies.description: London Stock Exchange Group plc is a British global provider of financial markets data and infrastructure headquartered in London, England. It owns the London Stock Exchange, Refinitiv, FTSE Russell, and majority stakes in LCH and Tradeweb.

companies.name: Shanda
companies.description: The Shanda Group is a privately owned multinational investment firm with offices in Shanghai, Singapore, Hong Kong, New York, and Redwood City. It invests in public markets, real estate, and venture capital, focusing on healthcare, financial services, media, and technology companies.

companies.name: Golar LNG
companies.description: Golar LNG is a Bermuda-based company that owns and operates marine LNG infrastructure. It has developed floating LNG liquefaction terminals and Floating Storage and Regasification Units by converting existing LNG carriers. The company is also exploring floating production of blue and green ammonia and carbon reduction in LNG production.

companies.name: Golden Entertainment
companies.description: Golden Entertainment, Inc. is an American gambling company based in Enterprise, Nevada. It operates casinos and taverns and was formed in 2015 by the merger of Golden Gaming and Lakes Entertainment. It is the largest tavern operator in Nevada and owns eight casino resorts in Southern Nevada.

companies.name: Golden Star Resources
companies.description: Golden Star Resources Ltd was a Canadian gold mining company that owned and operated the Wassa gold mine in Ghana. Headquartered in London with a registered office in Toronto, it was publicly listed on multiple stock exchanges. The company was acquired in 2022 by Chifeng Jilong Gold Mining.

companies.name: Good Energy
companies.description: Good Energy Group PLC is a British energy company based in Chippenham, Wiltshire. It provides services in transport electrification and decentralized renewable energy generation, including domestic solar panels. The company was founded by Juliet Davenport and sold its wind and solar generation portfolio in 2022.

companies.name: Graco
companies.description: Graco Inc. is an American manufacturer of fluid-handling systems and equipment headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Founded in 1926, it produces spray-finishing, pumping, dispensing, and lubrication equipment for industrial and contractor applications. The company is listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

companies.name: GrafTech
companies.description: GrafTech International Ltd. is a manufacturer of graphite electrodes and petroleum coke essential for electric arc furnace steel production. It is headquartered in Brooklyn Heights, Ohio, and operates manufacturing facilities in France, Spain, Mexico, and Pennsylvania.

companies.name: Grafton Group
companies.description: Grafton Group plc is a builders merchants business headquartered in Ireland, operating in both the United Kingdom and Ireland. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Grainger plc
companies.description: Grainger plc is a British residential property business headquartered in Newcastle upon Tyne. It is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Tenable Network Security
companies.description: Tenable Holdings, Inc. is a cybersecurity company based in Columbia, Maryland. It developed the Nessus vulnerability scanner software in 1998, widely used in the cybersecurity industry. As of the end of 2023, it served approximately 44,000 customers including 65% of the Fortune 500.

companies.name: Granite Construction
companies.description: Granite Construction Inc. is a civil construction company and aggregate producer founded and based in Watsonville, California. It is a member of the S&P 600 Index and owns or leases quarries in several Western states for extracting sands, gravel, and crushed stone.

companies.name: Graphic Packaging
companies.description: Graphic Packaging International is a Fortune 500 company based in Atlanta, Georgia. It designs and manufactures paperboard and folding cartons for consumer goods, especially beverages and packaged food. The company operates multiple paperboard mills across the United States that use recycled municipal wastewater in production.

companies.name: Gray Media
companies.description: Gray Media, Inc. is an American television broadcasting company headquartered in Atlanta. Founded in 1946, it is the third-largest TV station operator in the U.S., owning or operating 180 stations in 113 markets. Its stations range from large markets like Atlanta to small ones like North Platte, Nebraska.

companies.name: Great-West Lifeco
companies.description: Great-West Lifeco Inc. is a Canadian insurance-focused financial holding company operating in North America, Europe, and Asia through five subsidiaries. Its largest subsidiary is The Canada Life Assurance Company. The company is indirectly controlled by Paul Desmarais Jr. through Power Corporation of Canada.

companies.name: Great Plains Energy
companies.description: Great Plains Energy Incorporated was a holding company based in Kansas City, Missouri. It owned the electric utility Kansas City Power and Light Company and the energy management company Strategic Energy, LLC.

companies.name: Great Portland Estates
companies.description: Great Portland Estates plc is a British property development and investment company. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index. The company converted to Real Estate Investment Trust status in January 2007.

companies.name: Tencent Music
companies.description: Tencent Music Entertainment Group develops music streaming services for the Chinese market. Its apps include QQ Music, KuGou, Kuwo, and WeSing, with over 800 million active users. As of 2016, its services held an estimated 56% market share in China.

companies.name: Green Packet
companies.description: Green Packet is a technology company founded in 2000 by Puan Chan Cheong in Cupertino, California. It started as a software solutions company and later expanded into the broadband sector.

companies.name: Green Plains Renewable Energy
companies.description: Green Plains Inc. is an American ethanol fuel producer based in Omaha, Nebraska, founded in 2004. It is the third largest ethanol producer in North America, shipping about one billion gallons annually. The company was founded by Barry Ellsworth.

companies.name: Greencore Group
companies.description: Greencore Group plc is an Irish food company established in 1991 after the privatisation of Irish Sugar. It mainly produces convenience foods for Ireland and the UK and is the largest sandwich manufacturer worldwide. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: CJ ENM
companies.description: CJ ENM Co., Ltd is a South Korean entertainment and retail company founded in 1994.

companies.name: Grieg Seafood
companies.description: Grieg Seafood is an international seafood company based in Bergen, Norway. It operates fish farms in Norway, British Columbia, and Shetland, specializing in fresh Atlantic salmon. The company announced the sale of its Canadian salmon-farming operations to Cermaq in 2025.

companies.name: Grocery Outlet
companies.description: Grocery Outlet Holding Corp. is an American discount closeout retailer with supermarket locations across several U.S. states. It offers discounted, overstocked, and closeout products from name-brand and private-label suppliers. The company operates stores in states including California, Oregon, and Pennsylvania.

companies.name: Group 1 Automotive
companies.description: Group 1 Automotive, Inc. is an international automotive retailer headquartered in the United States. It operates dealerships and collision centers in the U.S. and the U.K., selling new and used vehicles and providing maintenance, repair, and financial services.

companies.name: Grupo Aeroportuario Centro Norte
companies.description: Grupo Aeroportuario Centro Norte, known as OMA, is a Mexican airport operator based near Monterrey. It manages 13 airports in central and northern Mexico and is the fourth largest airport services company in Mexico by passenger traffic, serving about 15 million passengers annually.

companies.name: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico
companies.description: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico (GAP) is a Mexican airport operator headquartered in Guadalajara. It operates 12 airports in central and northwestern Mexico and two airports in Jamaica.

companies.name: Grupo Nutresa
companies.description: Grupo Nutresa S.A. is a Colombian multinational food processing conglomerate headquartered in Medellín. It was formerly known as Grupo Nacional de Chocolates S.A.

companies.name: Guangdong Investment
companies.description: Guangdong Investment Limited is a Chinese company incorporated in Hong Kong. It operates in property, infrastructure, energy, water supply, hotel management, and department store operations in Hong Kong, Shenzhen, and Dongguan.

companies.name: CSSC Offshore & Marine Engineering Company
companies.description: CSSC Offshore & Marine Engineering (Group) Company Limited, formerly Guangzhou Shipyard International Company Limited, is a state-owned shipbuilding enterprise based in Southern China. It is the largest modern integrated shipbuilding company in the region.

companies.name: Guardian Capital Group
companies.description: Guardian Capital Group is a Canadian financial services company headquartered in Toronto. Founded in 1962, it provides investment management, financial advisory, mutual fund distribution, insurance, and corporate services. It has been publicly listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange since 1969.

companies.name: GuestLogix
companies.description: Guestlogix Inc. is a Toronto-based technology company providing onboard and off-board retail technology and merchandising systems. It was listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange but entered creditor protection in 2016. The company sold key assets and relaunched under new ownership in 2017.

companies.name: Guidewire Software
companies.description: Guidewire Software, Inc. is an American software company based in San Mateo, California. It provides an industry platform for property and casualty insurance carriers in the U.S. and worldwide. The company specializes in software solutions for the insurance sector.

companies.name: Gujarat Gas Limited
companies.description: Gujarat Gas Limited is an Indian natural gas distribution company headquartered in Gandhinagar. It operates primarily in Gujarat and is India's largest city gas distribution company. The company was established in 1980.

companies.name: Gulf Keystone Petroleum
companies.description: Gulf Keystone Petroleum Limited is an independent oil and gas exploration and production company operating in the Kurdistan region of Iraq. It is the operator of the Shaikan oil field and was listed on the London Stock Exchange in 2004.

companies.name: Gulf Power Company
companies.description: Gulf Power Company was an American electric utility headquartered in Pensacola, Florida. It provided electricity to over 450,000 customers in eight counties in the Florida panhandle and owned multiple power plants.

companies.name: Guoco Group
companies.description: Guoco Group Limited is an investment holding company operating mainly in Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, and Mainland China. Its subsidiaries engage in investment management, property development, stock and commodity broking, insurance, and banking. It is part of the Hong Leong Group conglomerate in Malaysia.

companies.name: Guosen Securities
companies.description: Guosen Securities Company Limited is a Chinese state-owned financial services company headquartered in Shenzhen. It operates more than 70 branches and provides services including sales and trading, investment banking, research, and asset management across China and Hong Kong.

companies.name: Guotai Haitong Securities
companies.description: Guotai Haitong Securities is a securities firm in China that became the country's largest securities brokerage by asset value following its acquisition of Haitong Securities.

companies.name: Nexon
companies.description: Nexon Co., Ltd. is a South Korean–Japanese video game developer and publisher headquartered in Japan. It specializes in live service games and has offices in South Korea, the United States, Taiwan, and Thailand.

companies.name: Jasic Technology
companies.description: Jasic Technology Company Ltd. is a Chinese corporation headquartered in Pingshan New District, Shenzhen, Guangdong province. The company operates out of China but no specific industry is mentioned in the summary.

companies.name: Wheels Up
companies.description: Wheels Up is a private aviation provider based in the United States. Founded in 2013 by Kenny Dichter, it operates using a membership and on-demand business model. Members can book private aircraft from the company fleet and third-party operators via a mobile app.

companies.name: Appian Corporation
companies.description: Appian Corporation is an enterprise software company headquartered in McLean, Virginia. It specializes in process automation and AI agent orchestrations, selling software to automate complex processes for large enterprises and governments worldwide.

companies.name: Peloton
companies.description: Peloton Interactive, Inc. is an American exercise equipment and media company based in New York City. It produces stationary bicycles, treadmills, and indoor rowers with internet-connected touch screens that stream live and on-demand fitness classes through a subscription service.

companies.name: Avanos Medical
companies.description: Avanos Medical, Inc. is a medical technology company in the United States that produces clinical medical devices. It operates two franchises focused on pain management and chronic care, aiming to reduce opioid use and help patients recover faster while preventing infection.

companies.name: H&R Block
companies.description: H&R Block, Inc. is an American tax preparation company founded in 1955 in Kansas City, Missouri. It operates in Canada, the United States, South Korea, and Australia, providing tax preparation services.

companies.name: H.R. Owen
companies.description: H.R. Owen is a luxury motor retailer headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It is one of the world's largest retailers of brands such as Rolls-Royce, Bentley, Ferrari, Aston Martin, Maserati, Lamborghini, and Bugatti, operating multiple sales and aftersales franchises.

companies.name: H2O Retailing
companies.description: H2O Retailing Corporation is a Japanese stock holding company and member of the Hankyu Hanshin Toho Group. Its subsidiary, Hankyu Hanshin Department Stores, owns two department store chains: Hankyu Department Store and Hanshin Department Store.

companies.name: Home Depot Supply
companies.description: HD Supply is a North American industrial distributor based in the United States. It provides a broad range of products and value-added services to professional customers in maintenance, repair, operations, infrastructure, power, and specialty construction sectors.

companies.name: HEICO
companies.description: HEICO Corporation is an American aerospace and electronics company headquartered in Hollywood, Florida. It designs, manufactures, and distributes components and systems for aviation, defense, space, medical, and telecommunications industries, operating through two main business segments.

companies.name: Hanwha Aerospace
companies.description: Hanwha Aerospace Co., Ltd. is a South Korean aerospace industrial company headquartered in Changwon. Established in 1977 as Samsung Precision, it is Korea's only gas turbine engine manufacturer, specializing in development, production, and maintenance of aircraft engines.

companies.name: BlackSky
companies.description: BlackSky Technology Inc. is an American company providing geospatial intelligence services including satellite imagery and data analytics. Headquartered in Herndon, Virginia, it operates small satellites in low Earth orbit and serves government and commercial customers through its imagery products and software platform BlackSky Spectra.

companies.name: HNI Corporation
companies.description: HNI Corporation is a major office furniture manufacturer and the world's leading hearth products company. Founded in 1944, it is headquartered in Muscatine, Iowa, with operations in the US and Asia. The company produces gas, electric, wood, and biomass burning fireplaces and related accessories.

companies.name: HSBC Bank
companies.description: HSBC Bank (Taiwan) Limited is a foreign bank incorporated in Taiwan since 2009. It is wholly owned by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, based in Hong Kong. The bank operates as part of the HSBC group in Taiwan.

companies.name: Haidilao
companies.description: Haidilao International Holding Ltd. is a Chinese hot pot restaurant chain founded in Jianyang, Sichuan in 1994 by Zhang Yong. It has grown into one of the world's largest hot pot restaurant brands, operating under the trade name Haidilao Hot Pot.

companies.name: MDTV Media Technologies
companies.description: PT MDTV Media Technologies Tbk is an Indonesian media company involved in television broadcasting, content production, artist management, and digital media. It is the holding company of MDTV and majority owned by MD Entertainment, led by producer Manoj Punjabi.

companies.name: Hain Celestial Group
companies.description: The Hain Celestial Group, Inc. is a US-based international food and personal-care company specializing in natural foods and organic personal-care products. Founded in 1993, it merged with Celestial Seasonings in 2000 and owns brands like Ella's Kitchen and Linda McCartney Foods.

companies.name: Halkbank
companies.description: Halkbank, officially Türkiye Halk Bankası, is a Turkish public bank established in 1933. It offers various loans including vehicle, housing, consumer, and commercial loans. The bank is publicly traded but majority-owned by the Turkish government and has faced scandals and executive arrests in the 2010s.

companies.name: Hanon Systems
companies.description: Hanon Systems Co., Ltd. is an automotive parts manufacturer headquartered in Daejeon, South Korea. It is one of the world's largest suppliers of automotive thermal management systems, serving the automotive industry globally.

companies.name: Halma plc
companies.description: Halma plc is a British global group of safety equipment companies based in Amersham, England. It produces products for hazard detection and life protection. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Haludovo Palace Hotel
companies.description: The Haludovo Palace Hotel is an abandoned resort hotel near Malinska on the island of Krk, Croatia. It was designed by Croatian architect Boris Magaš and constructed between 1969 and 1972 during the rapid expansion of tourism on the Yugoslav Adriatic. The hotel formed the architectural and social centre of the Haludovo tourist resort.

companies.name: Hamashbir 365 Ltd
companies.description: Hamashbir Lazarchan is an Israeli chain of department stores with 33 branches across the country. It operates as a retail department store chain serving customers throughout Israel.

companies.name: Hamilton Beach Brands
companies.description: Hamilton Beach Brands Holding Company is an American designer, marketer, and distributor of home appliances and commercial restaurant equipment. It markets products primarily in the United States, Canada, and Mexico, including blenders, mixers, toasters, slow cookers, clothes irons, and air purifiers.

companies.name: Hampden Bank
companies.description: Hampden Bank was a full-service bank headquartered in Springfield, Massachusetts, serving people and businesses in Hampden County and surrounding communities. Established in 1852, it had ten office locations before being acquired by Berkshire Bank in 2015.

companies.name: Hancock Whitney
companies.description: Hancock Whitney Corp. is an American bank holding company headquartered in Gulfport, Mississippi. It operates 180 banking locations across several southern states and is the official bank of the New Orleans Saints, LSU Athletics, and the Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns.

companies.name: Hanesbrands
companies.description: Hanesbrands Inc. is an American multinational clothing company based in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. It owns several clothing brands including Hanes, Playtex, Bali, and Wonderbra. The company was acquired by Gildan in 2025.

companies.name: Compass Pathways
companies.description: Compass Pathways is a British pharmaceutical company developing psychedelics as potential medicines. Its main drug candidate, psilocybin (COMP360), has completed phase 3 clinical trials for treatment-resistant depression and received breakthrough therapy status from the U.S. FDA.

companies.name: Hangzhou Zhongce Rubber Company
companies.description: Hangzhou Zhongce Rubber Co., Ltd. is China's largest manufacturer of automotive tyres. It produces tyres for various vehicles including cars, trucks, motorcycles, and bicycles under brands such as Chaoyang, Goodride, Westlake, Arisun, and Trazano.

companies.name: Hanil Cement
companies.description: Hanil Cement Co, Ltd. is a cement, concrete, and chemical company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Established in 1961, it produces portland cement products and cement under the brand Remital.

companies.name: Hanmi Bank
companies.description: Hanmi Bank Corporation is a community bank headquartered in Los Angeles, California. It operates 35 branches and eight loan production offices across California, Texas, Illinois, New York, New Jersey, and Virginia.

companies.name: Hanover Insurance
companies.description: The Hanover Insurance Group, Inc. is an insurance company based in Worcester, Massachusetts. Established in 1852, it was originally named Hanover Insurance and remained publicly traded under that name until the early 1990s when it changed to Allmerica Property & Casualty Companies.

companies.name: Hansen Medical
companies.description: Hansen Medical, Inc. is a medical robotics company headquartered in Mountain View, California. Founded in 2002, it designs and manufactures robotic systems for catheter positioning and control, including the Magellan and Sensei Robotic Systems.

companies.name: Hanwha Solutions
companies.description: Hanwha Solutions Corporation is a multinational company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, operating in energy services, petrochemicals, and real estate development. It was founded in 1965 as Hanwha Chemical and rebranded in 2020 after merging with Hanwha Q Cells & Advanced Materials.

companies.name: Harbin Electric
companies.description: Harbin Electric Company Limited is a Chinese enterprise specializing in research, manufacturing, and construction of power plant equipment. It is one of China's three largest manufacturers in this sector and was the second largest steam turbine manufacturer worldwide in 2009-10.

companies.name: Harbour Centre Development
companies.description: Harbour Centre Development Limited is a Hong Kong-based company operating hotels, restaurants, and property development in Hong Kong and Mainland China. It is a subsidiary of Wharf Real Estate Investment Company and was founded and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 1971.

companies.name: Hardinge, Inc.
companies.description: Hardinge, Inc. is a multinational machine tool builder headquartered in Berwyn, Pennsylvania, USA. Founded in 1890, the company is known for manufacturing both non-CNC and CNC lathes.

companies.name: Harel Insurance Investments & Financial Services Ltd.
companies.description: Harel Insurance Investments and Financial Services Ltd. is the largest insurance group in Israel. It is publicly traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and controlled by the Hamburger family, which owns 49.9% of shares.

companies.name: 10X Genomics
companies.description: 10x Genomics, Inc. is an American biotechnology company that designs and manufactures sequencing technologies for scientific research. Its products focus on single-cell and spatial omics development.

companies.name: Colt Technology Services
companies.description: Colt Technology Services Group Limited is a multinational telecommunications company headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Fidelity Investments in 2015. The name Colt stands for City Of London Telecommunications.

companies.name: Hastings Entertainment
companies.description: Hastings Entertainment was an American entertainment retail chain based in Amarillo, Texas. It operated 123 superstores mainly in the South Central, Rocky Mountain, Great Plains, and Midwestern United States, including many college towns.

companies.name: Luckin Coffee
companies.description: Luckin Coffee Inc. is a Chinese coffee company and coffeehouse chain founded in Beijing in 2017. It operates shops, stores, and kiosks offering coffee, tea, and food, generally at lower prices than competitors. The company is headquartered in Xiamen, Fujian, and by 2019, its stores outnumbered Starbucks locations in China.

companies.name: Havells
companies.description: Havells India Limited is an Indian multinational electrical equipment company based in Noida. It manufactures home appliances, lighting for various applications, LED lighting, fans, modular switches, wiring accessories, water heaters, circuit protection switchgear, cables, induction motors, and capacitors. Havells owns several brands including Havells, Lloyd, and Crabtree.

companies.name: Havertys
companies.description: Haverty Furniture Companies, Inc. (Havertys) is an American retail furniture company founded in 1885. Starting from a single store in downtown Atlanta, it has grown to become one of the top furniture retailers in the southern and central United States.

companies.name: Hawaiian Electric Industries
companies.description: Hawaiian Electric Industries, Inc. (HEI) is the largest electricity supplier in Hawaii, serving 95% of the state's population. It operates through its electric utilities: Hawaiian Electric Company on Oahu, Hawai'i Electric Light Company on The Big Island, and Maui Electric Company on Maui, Lanai, and Molokai.

companies.name: Bloomsbury Publishing
companies.description: Bloomsbury Publishing plc is a British worldwide publishing house of fiction and non-fiction. Its head office is located in Bloomsbury, London, with additional offices in New York City, New Delhi, Sydney, and Oxford. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Digital Domain
companies.description: Digital Domain is an American visual effects, computer animation, and digital production company headquartered in Culver City, California. It operates in the film industry providing digital production services.

companies.name: Headwaters Incorporated
companies.description: Headwaters Inc provides products, technologies, and services to the construction materials, coal combustion products, and alternative energy industries in the United States.

companies.name: Encompass Health
companies.description: Encompass Health Corporation, based in Birmingham, Alabama, is the largest provider of inpatient rehabilitative services in the United States. It operates 173 inpatient rehabilitation hospitals across 39 states and Puerto Rico, focusing on treatment for various conditions including stroke, neurological disorders, and orthopedic conditions.

companies.name: Heartland Payment Systems
companies.description: Heartland Payment Systems, Inc. was an American payment processing and technology provider founded in 1997. Its last headquarters were in Princeton, New Jersey, and it was acquired by Global Payments in 2016.

companies.name: Ansell
companies.description: Ansell Limited is an Australian company manufacturing gloves and personal protection equipment primarily from latex and rubber. Its products are designed for healthcare professionals, industrial workers, and end consumers.

companies.name: Hecla Mining
companies.description: Hecla Mining Company is a precious metals mining company based in Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, United States. Founded in 1891, it is the largest silver mining company in the U.S. and operates in the Silver Valley, an area designated as a Superfund site due to contamination from mining activities.

companies.name: Helen of Troy Limited
companies.description: Helen of Troy Limited is an American designer, developer, and marketer of consumer brand-name housewares, health, home, and beauty products. Headquartered in Hamilton, Bermuda, with U.S. operations in El Paso, Texas, it owns brands such as OXO International Ltd. and Kaz, Inc.

companies.name: SolarWorld Industries
companies.description: SolarWorld is a German company specializing in the manufacture and marketing of photovoltaic products worldwide. It integrates all components of the solar value chain, from polysilicon feedstock to module production and solar power system construction.

companies.name: Energy Vault
companies.description: Energy Vault is a Swiss global energy infrastructure company providing power and resilience through AI & Data Center Infrastructure, Utility Services, and Energy Storage businesses.

companies.name: Helix Energy Solutions Group
companies.description: Helix Energy Solutions Inc. is an American oil and gas services company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It provides offshore well intervention and remotely operated vehicle (ROV) operations for oil and gas fields worldwide.

companies.name: AntarChile
companies.description: AntarChile is the main holding company of the Angelini Group, one of South America's largest conglomerates. It has major investments in industrial, forestry, fisheries, and energy sectors in Chile.

companies.name: Hemas Holdings
companies.description: Hemas Holdings PLC is a diversified Sri Lankan corporation focused on consumer, healthcare, and mobility sectors. It is publicly listed and has expanded operations to Bangladesh.

companies.name: Henderson Group
companies.description: Henderson Group plc was a global investment management company based in the City of London. It merged with Janus Capital Group in 2017 to form Janus Henderson.

companies.name: Henderson Investment
companies.description: Henderson Investment Limited is a subsidiary of Henderson Land Development involved in property development, investment, and leasing in Hong Kong and Mainland China. It also operates department stores, infrastructure projects, and provides cleaning and security services.

companies.name: Hengan International
companies.description: Hengan International Group Company Limited is the largest producer of sanitary napkins and baby diapers in China. It manufactures sanitary napkins, disposable baby and adult diapers, and other personal hygiene products.

companies.name: Nordex SE
companies.description: Nordex SE is a European company that designs, sells, and manufactures wind turbines. Founded in 1985, it is headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, with production facilities in several countries including Brazil, India, and Spain. By the end of 2023, it had installed wind turbines with a total capacity of around 50 GW in over 40 countries.

companies.name: SBI Shinsei Bank
companies.description: SBI Shinsei Bank, Limited is a Japanese bank headquartered in Chuo, Tokyo. It operates as a subsidiary of SBI Holdings and is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: TUI Group
companies.description: TUI AG is a German multinational company specializing in leisure, travel, and tourism. It is the largest company in its industry worldwide and is headquartered in Hanover, Germany. The company was formerly known as Preussag AG until 1997 when it shifted its focus from mining to tourism.

companies.name: Merlin Entertainments
companies.description: Merlin Entertainments Limited is a global entertainment company based in London, England. It operates various theme park resorts and visitor attractions. The company is owned by the consortium Motion JVCO Ltd, which includes Kirkbi, Blackstone Inc, and CPP Investments.

companies.name: Heritage Foods
companies.description: Heritage Foods Limited is an Indian private sector dairy company primarily operating in South India. It is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

companies.name: Hhgregg
companies.description: hhgregg, Inc. is an American online retailer and former retail chain specializing in consumer electronics and home appliances. Founded in 1955 in Princeton, Indiana, it was headquartered in Indianapolis when it ceased physical operations and transitioned to online-only retail after bankruptcy in 2017.

companies.name: Hidili Industry International Development Limited
companies.description: Hidili Industry International Development Limited is a civilian-run enterprise in mainland China engaged in coal, coke, and coal-related chemical production. Founded in 2000, it operates in Sichuan and Guizhou provinces and was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2007. The founder and chairman is Xian Yang.

companies.name: HillRom
companies.description: Hill-Rom Holdings, Inc. is an American medical technology provider. It operates as a subsidiary of Baxter International.

companies.name: Himax
companies.description: Himax Technologies, Inc. is a fabless semiconductor manufacturer headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan. Founded in 2001, it is publicly traded on the Nasdaq Stock Market and functions as a holding company under Cayman Islands law.

companies.name: Hindustan Zinc Limited
companies.description: Hindustan Zinc Limited is an Indian integrated mining and resources company producing zinc, lead, silver, and cadmium. It is a subsidiary of Vedanta Limited and was formerly a Central Public Sector Undertaking before being sold in 2003. It is the world's second largest zinc producer.

companies.name: Poly Developments
companies.description: Poly Real Estate Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese real estate developer and a subsidiary of the state-owned China Poly Group. It focuses on the design, development, construction, and sale of residential and commercial properties, along with property management services in China.

companies.name: Hisamitsu Pharmaceutical
companies.description: Hisamitsu Pharmaceutical Co., Inc. is a Japanese multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Tosu and Tokyo. It develops and markets prescription and over-the-counter drugs, specializing in external pain relief products like transdermal patches, with expertise in transdermal drug delivery technology since 1903.

companies.name: Hisense Kelon
companies.description: Hisense Kelon, formerly Guangdong Kelon Electrical Holdings Company Limited, is a major Chinese manufacturer of white goods including refrigerators, air conditioners, and small electric appliances. The company is headquartered in Shunde, Foshan, Guangdong and is known under the Kelon and Ronshen brands in China.

companies.name: Pepco Holdings, Inc.
companies.description: Pepco Holdings, Inc. was a holding company for electric utilities in the Northeastern United States. It merged with Exelon in 2016.

companies.name: Getin Holding
companies.description: Getin Holding S.A. is a financial holding company founded in Warsaw, Poland in 1996. It began as an electronic business center and became a leader in IT solutions for small and medium-sized Polish businesses, offering IT, CRM, and ERP services.

companies.name: Powszechna Kasa Oszczędności Bank Polski
companies.description: Powszechna Kasa Oszczędności Bank Polski S.A. (PKO Bank Polski) is a multinational banking and financial services company headquartered in Warsaw, Poland. It is the largest universal bank in Poland and one of the largest financial institutions in Central and Eastern Europe, with origins dating back to 1919.

companies.name: Export Development Bank of Iran
companies.description: Export Development Bank of Iran is an Iranian government-owned policy bank that provides financial and conventional banking services to exporters and importers in Iran. It functions as Iran's export-import bank.

companies.name: Ibiden
companies.description: Ibiden Co., Ltd. is a Japanese electronics company headquartered in Ogaki, Gifu prefecture. It manufactures electronics-related products such as printed circuit boards and IC packaging, and also produces ceramics products including particulate filters for diesel engines, holding a 50% market share in Europe.

companies.name: Ningbo Bird
companies.description: Ningbo Bird, also known as Bodao, is a Chinese manufacturer of mobile phones. It was the largest mobile phone vendor in China from 2003 to 2005.

companies.name: Sojitz
companies.description: Sojitz Corporation is a Tokyo-based sogo shosha (general trading company) engaged globally in buying, selling, importing, exporting, manufacturing, and providing services. It operates in diverse sectors including automobiles, energy, minerals, chemicals, foodstuff, agriculture, consumer goods, and industrial parks, and also conducts financing activities.

companies.name: ABSA Group Limited
companies.description: Absa Group Limited is a multinational banking and financial services conglomerate based in Johannesburg, South Africa. It offers personal and business banking, credit cards, corporate and investment banking, wealth and investment management, and bank assurances. The company is listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Hitachi Construction Machinery
companies.description: Hitachi Construction Machinery Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company specializing in manufacturing, sales, and service of construction and transportation machinery. It was spun off from Hitachi in 1970. In August 2026, Hitachi sold its remaining shares, and the company will be rebranded as Landcros in 2027.

companies.name: Kanadevia Corporation
companies.description: Kanadevia Corporation, formerly Hitachi Zosen Corporation, is a major Japanese industrial and engineering corporation. It produces waste treatment plants, industrial plants, precision machinery, steel mill process equipment, construction machinery, tunnel boring machines, marine engines, and power plants.

companies.name: Games Workshop
companies.description: Games Workshop Group PLC is a British manufacturer of miniature wargames based in Nottingham, England. Its best-known products are Warhammer and Warhammer 40,000.

companies.name: Hobonichi
companies.description: Hobo Nikkan Itoi Shinbun, also known as Hobonichi, is a Japanese company that designs and produces daily life products such as T-shirts and notebooks. Founded by Shigesato Itoi in 1998, it started as a personal website and grew into one of Japan's most profitable websites focusing on goods sales.

companies.name: Hogg Robinson Group
companies.description: Hogg Robinson Group was a business active in insurance and corporate travel management sectors. It was acquired by American Express Global Business Travel in July 2018.

companies.name: Geox
companies.description: Geox S.p.A. is an Italian brand that manufactures shoes and clothing using breathable and waterproof fabrics.

companies.name: HF Sinclair
companies.description: HF Sinclair Corporation is an American energy company based in Dallas, Texas. It manufactures and sells products including gasoline, diesel fuel, jet fuel, renewable diesel, specialty lubricants, chemicals, and modified asphalt.

companies.name: Hologic
companies.description: Hologic, Inc. is an American medical technology company focused on women's health. It sells medical devices used for diagnostics, surgery, and medical imaging.

companies.name: Grupo Radio Centro
companies.description: Grupo Radio Centro is a Mexico City-based owner and operator of radio stations. It owns 30 radio stations across Mexico and the United States, including 8 in Mexico City.

companies.name: HomeAway
companies.description: HomeAway was an American vacation rental marketplace operating through 50 websites in 23 languages. It offered rentals of various property types including cabins, condos, castles, villas, barns, and farmhouses. The company specialized in vacation rental services.

companies.name: Homeserve
companies.description: HomeServe is a British multinational company based in Walsall, England, specializing in home emergency repairs and improvements. It operates in multiple countries including the UK, France, Spain, Japan, and Germany. The company focuses on home repair services.

companies.name: The Bank of New York Mellon
companies.description: The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation, known as BNY Mellon, is an American international financial services company headquartered in New York City. It provides a range of financial services globally. The company is a major player in the banking sector.

companies.name: HKBN Limited
companies.description: HKBN Ltd., known for its subsidiary Hong Kong Broadband Network Limited, is a Hong Kong-based internet, communication, and telecommunications company. Established in 1999, it is one of the largest providers of residential and enterprise internet and telecom services in Hong Kong.

companies.name: Hortonworks
companies.description: Hortonworks, Inc. was a data software company based in Santa Clara, California. It developed and supported open-source software designed to manage big data and related processing. The company specialized in big data software solutions.
