companies.name: Empresas ICA
companies.description: Empresas ICA is a Mexican construction company founded in 1947 by civil engineer Bernardo Quintana Arrioja. It has built notable landmarks in Mexico such as Estadio Azteca and the Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe, as well as international projects like the Aguacapa Dam in Guatemala.

companies.name: Barratt Developments
companies.description: Barratt Redrow plc is a British residential property development company operating across England, Wales, and Scotland. Originally based in Newcastle upon Tyne, it is now located in Coalville, England. The company is a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Hotel New Grand
companies.description: The Hotel New Grand is a historic hotel located in Yokohama, Japan, overlooking Yamashita Park. It opened in 1927, four years after the Great Kantō earthquake that devastated much of the city. The hotel is notable for its long history in the region.

companies.name: Howdens Joinery
companies.description: Howden Joinery Group Plc is a multinational company based in London, England, and the parent company of Howdens Joinery. It supplies kitchens and joinery products to the building trade and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Eizo
companies.description: Eizo Corporation is a Japanese visual technology company founded in 1968 and headquartered in Hakusan, Ishikawa Prefecture. It manufactures display products and solutions for markets including business, healthcare, graphics, air traffic control, and maritime.

companies.name: Itron
companies.description: Itron, Inc. is an American technology company headquartered in Liberty Lake, Washington. It provides products and services for energy and water resource management, including devices that measure and analyze electricity, gas, and water consumption. The company also offers control technology, communications systems, software, and consulting services.

companies.name: Croatian Postal Bank
companies.description: Hrvatska poštanska banka d.d. (HPB) is the largest Croatian-owned bank in Croatia. It ranks fifth in the country in terms of total assets. The bank operates within the Croatian banking sector.

companies.name: Huadian Power International
companies.description: Huadian Power International Corporation is the largest power producer in Shandong Province, China. It is a Hong Kong listed subsidiary of China Huadian, one of the five largest power producers in China. The parent company produces about 10% of China's power, with the subsidiary producing approximately another 5%.

companies.name: HudBay Minerals
companies.description: Hudbay Minerals Inc. is a Canadian mining company producing copper, gold, silver, zinc, and molybdenum. In 2024, copper sales represented the majority of its revenue, followed by gold and zinc. The company is active in the mining industry.

companies.name: National Iranian Oil Company
companies.logo_file: Flag of the National Iranian Oil Company.svg
companies.description: The National Iranian Oil Company is a government-owned oil and natural gas producer and distributor in Iran, operating under the Ministry of Petroleum. Established in 1951 and restructured in 1954, it is the world's second largest oil company after Saudi Aramco.

companies.name: Ayandeh Bank
companies.description: Ayandeh Bank was an Iranian bank established in 2013 by Ali Ansari. Its operating license was revoked in October 2025, and its operations were merged with Bank Melli Iran by the Central Bank of Iran.

companies.name: Shahr Bank
companies.description: Shahr Bank is a private Iranian bank that began operations in February 2009. Previously, it provided financial services under the names Honarvaran Shahr Cooperative and Shahr Credit Cooperative.

companies.name: Valin Steel
companies.description: Hunan Valin Steel Co., Ltd. is a Chinese state-owned company based in Changsha, founded in 1997. It engages in smelting, manufacturing, and selling iron, steel, and nonferrous metal products. The company was part of the SZSE 1000 Index as of 2016.

companies.name: Bank Day
companies.description: Bank Day is a non-state owned Iranian bank established in 2010. It operates under the guidelines and instructions of the Central Bank of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

companies.name: Hunting plc
companies.description: Hunting plc is a British manufacturer and supplier serving the oil and gas, aerospace, medical, and power generation sectors. The Hunting family owns 27% of the business. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Astrotech Corporation
companies.description: Astrotech Corporation, formerly Spacehab Inc., is a technology incubator headquartered in Austin, Texas. It funds, manages, and sells start-up companies using technology sourced internally and from research institutions. Its subsidiaries provide commercial products and services to NASA, the U.S. Department of Defense, and other space agencies.

companies.name: Hutchison Telecommunications Hong Kong Holdings
companies.description: Hutchison Telecommunications Hong Kong Holdings Limited is a telecommunications operator in Hong Kong. It operates GSM dual-band, 3G, 4G LTE, and 5G mobile services in Hong Kong and Macau under the licensed global Three brand.

companies.name: Warsaw Stock Exchange
companies.description: The Warsaw Stock Exchange (WSE) is a stock exchange located in Warsaw, Poland. Founded in 1817, it is the largest stock exchange in Central and Eastern Europe. It hosts over 400 companies and operates several important stock market indices including WIG20 and WIG30.

companies.name: Mattel
companies.description: Mattel, Inc. is an American multinational toy manufacturing and entertainment company headquartered in El Segundo, California. Founded in 1945, Mattel has a presence in 35 countries and sells its products in more than 150 countries worldwide.

companies.name: Tourism Bank
companies.description: Tourism Bank is a private Iranian bank established in 2010 by Mehdi Jahangiri. It primarily focuses on supporting Iran’s tourism industry and offers a variety of financial services aimed at promoting and developing the country's tourism sector.

companies.name: Hysan Development Company Limited
companies.description: Hysan Development Company Limited is a Hong Kong property investment, management, and development company listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong. Founded in 1923, it became the largest commercial landlord in the Causeway Bay area by 2018.

companies.name: IPARK Hyundai Development Company
companies.description: HDC Hyundai Development Company was created in 2018 through a spin-off from HDC Group's holding company. The South Korean company is active in real estate development, construction, and hospitality sectors.

companies.name: IberiaBank Corporation
companies.description: IBERIABANK Corporation was an American financial holding company headquartered in Lafayette, Louisiana. Founded in 1887, it was the largest bank based in the state with numerous branches and wealth management locations across 12 states.

companies.name: iCAD Inc.
companies.description: iCAD Inc. is a medical device manufacturer based in Nashua, New Hampshire, USA. The company offers computer aided detection technology to support detection of breast, prostate, and colorectal cancers. It also provides hardware and software for radiation therapy treatment.

companies.name: ICF International
companies.description: ICF International, Inc. is an American publicly traded consulting and technology services company based in Reston, Virginia. It provides professional services and technology solutions.

companies.name: ICG Group
companies.description: ICG Group, originally known as Internet Capital Group, Inc., was a venture capital firm based in the United States. It changed its name to Actua Corporation in 2014 and underwent liquidation in 2018. The company had a market capitalization of over $50 billion during the dot com bubble.

companies.name: ICU Medical
companies.description: ICU Medical, Inc. is a medical technology company based in San Clemente, California. It designs products to prevent bloodstream infections and protect healthcare workers from exposure to infectious diseases and hazardous drugs. Its product line includes intravenous therapy products, pumps, and needle-free vascular access devices.

companies.name: IDEC Corporation
companies.description: IDEC Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of automation and control products founded in Osaka in 1945. It produces electromechanical control products such as relays, timers, and switches, as well as automation products like programmable logic controllers and touchscreen displays.

companies.name: IDEX Corporation
companies.description: IDEX Corporation is a global industrial company based in Northbrook, Illinois. It develops, designs, and manufactures fluidics systems, optics systems, fire and rescue equipment, and other specialty engineered products. The company operates in approximately 20 countries.

companies.name: GKN
companies.description: GKN Ltd is a British multinational automotive and aerospace components business headquartered in Redditch, England. It traces its origins back to 1759 and was acquired by Melrose Industries plc in 2018. Melrose divested parts of GKN in 2023, listing them as Dowlais Group on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: IG Port
companies.description: IG Port, Inc. is a Japanese holding company established in 2007 from the merger of anime studio Production I.G and manga publisher Mag Garden. It operates in the video game and entertainment industry.

companies.name: Voya Financial
companies.description: Voya Financial is an American financial, retirement, investment, and insurance company based in New York City. It was spun off from ING Group in 2013 and rebranded as Voya Financial in 2014. Its predecessors entered the U.S. market in the 1970s through acquisitions.

companies.name: INOX Leisure Limited
companies.description: PVR INOX Limited is an Indian multiplex chain formed in 2023 by merging PVR Cinemas and INOX Leisure. PVR pioneered the multiplex revolution in India with the first modern multiplex in 1997. As of 2025, it operates 1,743 screens across 352 properties in India and Sri Lanka.

companies.name: ION Geophysical
companies.description: ION Geophysical was a technology-focused company based in the United States that provided advanced acquisition equipment, software, planning, and seismic processing services. It also offered seismic data libraries to the global oil and gas industry.

companies.name: IP Group
companies.description: IP Group plc is a British-based early-stage investor that backs IP-based technology companies. It is based in London, England, and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: IRC Limited
companies.description: IRC Limited is a Hong Kong-based mining company engaged in the production and development of industrial commodities, primarily iron ore. It operates in the Russian Far East near the border with China and is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

companies.name: IRESS
companies.description: Iress is an Australian technology company providing software to the financial services industry across Asia-Pacific, North America, Africa, and Europe. Its software supports over 500,000 users globally with more than 200 integrations and 300 data feeds.

companies.name: FXCM
companies.description: FXCM, also known as Forex Capital Markets, is a retail foreign exchange broker based in London. It offers trading on the foreign exchange market and provides contracts for difference on major indices and commodities such as gold and crude oil.

companies.name: ITT Technical Institute
companies.description: ITT Technical Institute was a private for-profit technical institute headquartered in Carmel, Indiana, with many campuses across the United States. Founded in 1969, it grew to 130 campuses in 38 states before closing in 2016.

companies.name: Avangrid
companies.description: Avangrid, Inc. is an energy services and delivery company serving about 3.1 million customers in New England and New York. Its subsidiaries include Central Maine Power, Rochester Gas and Electric, and New York State Electric & Gas.

companies.name: Icahn Enterprises
companies.description: Icahn Enterprises L.P. is an American publicly traded master limited partnership and conglomerate headquartered in Sunny Isles Beach, Florida. It has investments in energy, automotive, food packaging, metals, real estate, and home fashion, and is controlled by Carl Icahn.

companies.name: Ichibanya
companies.description: Ichibanya Co., Ltd. is a Japanese food services company based in Ichinomiya, Aichi. It operates in the food service industry in Japan.

companies.name: Iconix Brand Group
companies.description: Iconix Brand Group, Inc. is an American brand management company that licenses brands to retailers and manufacturers. It primarily operates in the apparel, footwear, and apparel accessory industries.

companies.name: Idacorp
companies.description: IDACORP, Inc is an electricity holding company incorporated in Idaho with headquarters in Boise. It comprises Idaho Power Company, IDACORP Financial, and Ida-West Energy and was formed on October 1, 1998.

companies.name: CA Technologies
companies.description: CA Technologies, formerly Computer Associates International, Inc., was an American multinational enterprise software developer and publisher from 1976 to 2018. It created system software for IBM mainframe, distributed computing, virtual machine, and cloud computing environments.

companies.name: Incyte
companies.description: Incyte Corporation is an American multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware. It operates manufacturing and R&D locations in North America, Europe, and Asia.

companies.name: Independent Financial
companies.description: Independent Bank is a bank headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan. It operates 62 branches, all located within Michigan.

companies.name: IndiaMART
companies.description: IndiaMART InterMESH Ltd is an Indian B2B online marketplace company headquartered in Noida. Founded in 1996, it operates the IndiaMART.com portal connecting Indian manufacturers with buyers.

companies.name: India Cements
companies.description: The India Cements Limited is a cement manufacturing company based in Chennai. It is the 9th largest listed cement company in India by revenue and was headed by former ICC chairman N. Srinivasan.

companies.name: India Infoline
companies.description: IIFL Finance Limited, also known as India Infoline Finance Limited, is an Indian diversified financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. Founded by Nirmal Jain, it is backed by investors including Prem Watsa and General Atlantic.

companies.name: Indocement
companies.description: PT Indocement Tunggal Prakarsa Tbk. is one of the largest cement producers in Indonesia. It operates multiple factories and business units covering cement manufacturing, sales, ready-mix concrete, aggregates, and trass.

companies.name: Indus Towers
companies.description: Indus Towers Limited is an Indian telecommunications infrastructure company that offers passive infrastructure services to mobile network operators and wireless service providers. It is headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana. The company was incorporated in 2007 by Bharti Infratel, Vodafone Essar, and Idea Cellular to provide shared telecom infrastructure on a non-discriminatory basis.

companies.name: Inergy
companies.description: Inergy, L.P. is an American supplier of propane based in Kansas City, Missouri. It serves 800,000 customers across 28 states and is the fourth-largest propane retailer in the United States. The company also operates a major salt mining business through its U.S. Salt LLC subsidiary, with salt caverns used for natural gas storage.

companies.name: Infinera
companies.description: Infinera Corporation was an American manufacturer based in San Jose, California, specializing in Wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM) packet optical transmission equipment. It served the telecommunications service provider market and was a pioneer in designing and manufacturing large-scale photonic integrated circuits (PICs).

companies.name: Cyient
companies.description: Cyient is an Indian multinational technology company focused on engineering, manufacturing, data analytics, networks, and operations. It was established in 1991 in Hyderabad as Infotech Enterprises Ltd and rebranded as Cyient in 2014.

companies.name: Inghams Enterprises
companies.description: Ingham's is a supplier and producer of poultry and fodder in Australia and New Zealand. Founded in 1918, it is one of the largest producers of chicken and turkey products in Australia. The company was family-managed until 2014 and was acquired by TPG Capital that year before being listed on the Australian Securities Exchange in 2016.

companies.name: Ingles
companies.description: Ingles Markets, Inc. is an American supermarket chain based in Black Mountain, North Carolina. It operates 198 supermarkets in the Appalachian region of the Southeastern United States. The company is publicly traded on NASDAQ and is part of the Global Select Market tier.

companies.name: Rami Levi Chain Stores Hashikma Marketing 2006 Ltd
companies.description: Rami Levy Hashikma Marketing is the third largest Israeli retail supermarket chain, founded in 1976 in the Mahane Yehuda Market district. It operates 44 discount supermarkets in Central and Northern Israel and the West Bank, and distributes wholesale to 450 stores. The company has diversified into clothing, real estate, and cellular communications.

companies.name: Innodata
companies.description: Innodata Inc. is an American company providing business process, technology, and consulting services. It offers products that help clients create, manage, use, and distribute digital information. The company was formerly known as Innodata Isogen, Inc.

companies.name: Inovalon
companies.description: Inovalon is an American technology company that provides cloud-based tools for the healthcare industry. It focuses on delivering technology solutions to support healthcare services.

companies.name: Insight Enterprises
companies.description: Insight Enterprises Inc. is a global technology company based in Arizona, United States. It focuses on business-to-business and information technology services for enterprises. The company operates in 19 countries and is listed on the Fortune 500.

companies.name: IRB(Re)
companies.description: IRB(Re), formally IRB-Brasil Resseguros S.A., is the largest reinsurance company in Brazil. It was founded as a state-owned enterprise and was the sole provider of reinsurance in Brazil for nearly seventy years until the market opened to private and foreign competition.

companies.name: Integrated Electrical Services
companies.description: IES Holdings, Inc., formerly Integrated Electrical Services, Inc., is a United States-based company that designs and installs integrated electrical and technology systems. It provides infrastructure products and services to data centers, residential housing, and commercial and industrial facilities.

companies.name: InterDigital
companies.description: InterDigital, Inc. is an American technology research and development company founded in 1972. It provides wireless and video technologies for mobile devices, networks, and services worldwide. The company is listed on Nasdaq and included in the S&P 600 index.

companies.name: Interactive Intelligence
companies.description: Interactive Intelligence, Inc. was a telecommunications software and cloud computing company based in the United States. It provided unified business communications solutions for call centers, Voice over IP companies, and business process automation.

companies.name: Intermap Technologies
companies.description: Intermap Technologies is a publicly traded company headquartered in Douglas County, Colorado, United States. It provides geospatial solutions and 3D terrain products used by GIS professionals in commercial and government sectors worldwide, including energy, engineering, and telecommunications.

companies.name: ICG plc
companies.description: ICG plc is a private equity investment firm headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It provides capital to help companies grow through private and public markets and offers various strategies and funds for institutional investors. The company is part of the FTSE 100 Index and has offices in 18 other countries.

companies.name: Tilray
companies.description: Tilray Brands, Inc. is an American pharmaceutical, cannabis-lifestyle, and consumer packaged goods company headquartered in New York City. It operates in Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Latin America, and has growing facilities in Germany, Portugal, and the United Kingdom.

companies.name: International Bancshares Corporation
companies.description: International Bancshares Corporation is a bank holding company based in Laredo, Texas, United States. Its primary subsidiary is International Bank of Commerce. The company operates 217 banking offices and 315 ATMs serving 88 communities in Texas and Oklahoma.

companies.name: International Bank of Commerce
companies.description: International Bank of Commerce (IBC) is a state-chartered bank headquartered in Laredo, Texas, United States. Owned by International Bancshares Corporation, it is one of the largest banks based in Texas and the largest minority-owned bank in the U.S.

companies.name: International Coal Group
companies.description: International Coal Group, Inc. is a coal mining company headquartered in Teays Valley, West Virginia. Incorporated in 2004, it operated 12 mining complexes in Appalachia and one in the Illinois Basin. In 2011, it became a subsidiary of Arch Coal, Inc.

companies.name: International Forest Products
companies.description: Interfor Corporation is one of the largest lumber producers globally, based in Vancouver, British Columbia. It operates sawmills with a large manufacturing capacity and sells lumber across North America, Asia-Pacific, and Europe. In 2014, it opened a corporate office in Peachtree City, Georgia for the US southeast region.

companies.name: TBS Holdings Inc.
companies.description: TBS Holdings, Inc. is a privately owned media company in Japan. It owns TBS Television and TBS Radio networks and operates the Japan News Network with 28 affiliates and the Japan Radio Network with 34 affiliates.

companies.name: International Road Dynamics
companies.description: International Road Dynamics Inc. is a Canadian company headquartered in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. It specializes in road traffic management systems including automated toll roads, commercial vehicle inspection systems, traffic data collection products, and traffic management software.

companies.name: İhlas Media Holding
companies.description: İhlas Holding A.Ş. is a Turkish conglomerate with media assets including the Türkiye newspaper and TGRT TV and radio networks. It also operates in construction, electrical appliances, trade, energy, mining, health, and education. The company has been listed on the Istanbul Stock Exchange since 1994.

companies.name: Pharmaniaga
companies.description: Pharmaniaga Berhad is Malaysia’s largest listed integrated healthcare company. It offers research and development, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution of pharmaceuticals and medical supplies.

companies.name: Intevac
companies.description: Intevac, Inc. was a producer of thin film deposition systems and equipment for manufacturing hard disk drives. It was headquartered in Silicon Valley, Santa Clara, California, with offices in China, Malaysia, and Singapore.

companies.name: IntraLinks
companies.description: Intralinks is an American financial technology provider founded in 1996. It focuses on enterprise collaboration and strategic transactions and was acquired by SS&C Technologies in 2018.

companies.name: Intrepid Potash
companies.description: Intrepid Potash, Inc. is a fertilizer manufacturer based in Denver, Colorado. It is the only producer of potassium chloride in the United States and owns three mines in the Western US near Carlsbad, New Mexico, Moab, Utah, and Wendover, Utah.

companies.name: Capita
companies.description: Capita plc is a business process outsourcing and professional services company headquartered in London. It is the largest in the UK with clients in government and private sectors and operates across Europe, Africa, and Asia. It also has a property and infrastructure consultancy division.

companies.name: Inversiones y Representaciones Sociedad Anónima
companies.description: Inversiones y Representaciones Sociedad Anónima is an Argentinian corporation engaged in the real estate business. It is 64% controlled by Cresud S.A.C.I.F. y A. The company operates with Argentinian capital.

companies.name: Investment AB Latour
companies.description: Investment AB Latour is a Swedish investment company controlled by businessman Gustaf Douglas and his family. Gustaf Douglas passed away on 3 May 2023. The company is based in Sweden.

companies.name: Ipca Laboratories
companies.description: Ipca Laboratories Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai. It manufactures over 350 finished-dosage formulations and around 80 active pharmaceutical ingredients, selling products in more than 100 countries.

companies.name: Iran Khodro Diesel
companies.description: Iran Khodro Diesel Company manufactures commercial vehicles in Iran and other countries in the Middle East, CIS, and Africa. It operates under license from Daimler-Benz of Germany and holds about 80% of the bus market in Iran.

companies.name: Iranian Aluminium Company
companies.description: Iranian Aluminium Company (IRALCO) is the largest aluminum producer in Iran, located in Arak. Its plant covers 232 hectares and produces various aluminum products including pure ingots and electrical conductors.

companies.name: Amigo Loans
companies.description: Amigo Holdings is a British public company formerly known as Amigo Loans, a guarantor loans provider. In 2018, it held approximately 88% of the UK guarantor loan market.

companies.name: Woolworths Group
companies.description: Woolworths Group Limited is an Australian multinational retail and financial services company headquartered in Bella Vista, New South Wales. It operates primarily in retail and financial services sectors.

companies.name: Arlo Technologies, Inc.
companies.description: Arlo Technologies is an American company that manufactures wireless surveillance cameras. It was formerly a brand of Netgear before its IPO on the New York Stock Exchange in August 2018.

companies.name: Appen
companies.description: Appen Limited is an Australian multinational company that develops datasets for artificial intelligence. It is publicly traded on the Australian Securities Exchange under the code APX.

companies.name: California Resources Corporation
companies.description: California Resources Corporation is an American energy company focused on hydrocarbon exploration in California. It is organized in Delaware and headquartered in Long Beach, California. The company holds the largest privately owned mineral acreage position in the state of California.

companies.name: CalAmp
companies.description: CalAmp Corporation is a provider of Internet of Things software applications, cloud services, and telematics products based in Irvine, California. Its technology includes edge computing devices and SaaS applications for fleet telematics. The company owns patents for the LoJack Stolen Vehicle Recovery System.

companies.name: Trade Desk
companies.description: The Trade Desk, Inc. is a multinational technology company headquartered in Ventura, California. It produces programmatic marketing automation software and operates as the largest independent demand-side platform globally. The company works with over 400 partners across more than 30 locations worldwide.

companies.name: Advanced Drainage Systems
companies.description: Advanced Drainage Systems, Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets plastic pipes, septic tanks, and drainage systems. Headquartered in Hilliard, Ohio, it is the largest maker of high-density polyethylene pipe in the United States. Most of its sales are within the US and Canada.

companies.name: Latitude Financial Services
companies.description: Latitude Financial Services is an Australian financial services company headquartered in Melbourne, also operating in New Zealand as Gem Finance. It specializes in consumer finance products including personal loans, credit cards, and car loans. It is the largest non-bank lender of consumer credit in Australia.

companies.name: Shiva Texyarn Limited
companies.description: Shiva Texyarn Limited is an Indian textile manufacturer based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. The company produces yarn, fabrics, garments, dry sheets, and home textiles within India.

companies.name: Intuitive Machines
companies.description: Intuitive Machines, Inc. is a space exploration company headquartered in Houston, Texas, founded in 2013. It provides lunar surface transportation, payload delivery, data transmission, and infrastructure services. NASA has awarded it multiple lunar surface delivery contracts under the Commercial Lunar Payload Services initiative.

companies.name: Urstadt Biddle Properties
companies.description: Urstadt Biddle Properties, Inc. was a real estate investment trust based in Greenwich, Connecticut. It primarily invested in shopping centers across New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut. The company merged with Regency Centers Corp in August 2023.

companies.name: LoopUp
companies.description: LoopUp is a global provider of cloud-based business telephony services. Its main product is a managed cloud telephony service for Microsoft Teams, offered as an alternative to multiple regional carriers. LoopUp delivers Teams calling through various Microsoft connectivity programs and carrier arrangements.

companies.name: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd.
companies.description: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. is a holding company based in the United States and domiciled in Bermuda. It operates three cruise lines: Norwegian Cruise Line, Oceania Cruises, and Regent Seven Seas Cruises. Combined, these subsidiaries form the third-largest cruise operator worldwide.

companies.name: Enviva
companies.description: Enviva Inc. is the world's largest producer of wood pellets used for energy production. The company is known for its role in the wood economy and has faced controversy regarding its sustainability practices. It is based in the United States.

companies.name: The Michaels Companies
companies.description: The Michaels Companies, Inc. is an American retail holding company headquartered in Irving, Texas. It operates the flagship brand Michaels and Artistree, a manufacturer of custom and specialty framing merchandise. The company was formed in 2014 and runs over 1,252 arts and crafts stores in the US and Canada.

companies.name: Isetan Mitsukoshi Holdings
companies.description: Isetan Mitsukoshi Holdings Ltd. is a holding company with Mitsukoshi and Isetan department stores as its wholly owned subsidiaries. It is based in Japan.

companies.name: Audax
companies.description: Audax Renovables, S.A., trading as Audax, is a Spanish electricity and natural gas company headquartered in Badalona, Catalonia. It supplies electricity and gas to customers in several European countries and generates electricity from renewable sources like wind and solar. It was formerly known as Fersa Energías Renovables.

companies.name: Bauer Hockey
companies.description: Bauer Hockey LLC is a North American manufacturer of ice hockey equipment, fitness and recreational skates, and apparel. Its products include helmets, gloves, sticks, skates, and protective gear. Some of its ice hockey skates are approved for use in ringette.

companies.name: Virgin Australia Regional Airlines
companies.description: Virgin Australia Regional Airlines (VARA) is an Australian regional airline based in Perth. It services key towns in Western Australia and interstate destinations such as Adelaide and Darwin. Formerly known as Skywest, it was purchased by Virgin Australia Holdings in April 2013.

companies.name: Ten Square Games
companies.description: Ten Square Games is a Polish mobile game developer headquartered in Wrocław with additional studios in Warsaw, Berlin, Bucharest, and Verona. The company focuses on hobby games using a pay-to-win model and has released over 200 games since 2011, including Let's Fish and Fishing Clash.

companies.name: Cadence Design Systems
companies.description: Cadence Design Systems, Inc. is an American multinational technology and computational software company headquartered in San Jose, California. It specializes in electronic design automation software and hardware for integrated circuits, systems on chips, and printed circuit boards. It also develops molecular modeling applications for pharmaceutical drug developers.

companies.name: Isrotel Ltd.
companies.description: Isrotel Ltd. is an Israeli hotel chain headquartered in Tel Aviv. It operates 21 hotels and resorts throughout Israel, mostly in and around Eilat.

companies.name: Issta Lines Ltd.
companies.description: Issta Lines is a publicly traded tourism company founded in 1956 and listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. The Issta Group operates over 60 branches, call centers, and online travel services throughout Israel and employs over 1000 permanent employees domestically and abroad.

companies.name: Şekerbank
companies.description: Şekerbank T.A.Ş. is a Turkish bank founded in 1953, originally named Sugar Beet Cooperative Bank. It provides consumer, vehicle, housing, and commercial loans. The bank is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey, and Dr. Hasan Basri Göktan is its chairman.

companies.name: Itautec
companies.description: Itautec is a Brazilian electronics company founded in 1979. It operates as a division of the Itaúsa group, a Brazilian business group. The company is involved in the software industry.

companies.name: Colgate-Palmolive Company
companies.description: The Colgate-Palmolive Company is an American multinational consumer products company headquartered in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. It specializes in household, health care, personal care, and veterinary products.

companies.name: Quiñenco
companies.description: Quiñenco S.A is a Chile-based holding company founded in 1957 by Andrónico Luksic. It invests in companies active in industrial and financial sectors and is controlled by Chile’s Grupo Luksic.

companies.name: Iwatsu Electric
companies.description: Iwatsu Electric, Co., Ltd. is a Japanese electronics manufacturer founded on August 14, 1938. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under the ticker 6704.

companies.name: JSW Steel Ltd
companies.description: JSW Steel Limited is an Indian multinational steel company based in Mumbai. It is the flagship company of the JSW Group and operates in the iron and steel industry.

companies.name: J & J Snack Foods
companies.description: J&J Snack Foods Corp. is an American manufacturer, marketer, and distributor of snack foods and frozen beverages. Headquartered in Mt. Laurel, New Jersey, it operates over 175 facilities across the US, Mexico, and Canada.

companies.name: Charoen Pokphand
companies.description: The Charoen Pokphand Group Company, Ltd. is a Thai conglomerate based in Bangkok. It is Thailand's largest private company and holds the largest privately held Royal Warrant of the Thai Royal Family, with investments in 21 countries.

companies.name: Pos Malaysia
companies.description: Pos Malaysia Berhad is the Malaysian national postal and courier service provider headquartered in Kuala Lumpur. Originally a government department from the early 1800s, it was corporatized in 1992 and now operates in postal, courier, aviation, logistics, and IT sectors.

companies.name: Jack Henry & Associates
companies.description: Jack Henry & Associates is an American financial technology company providing technology solutions and payment processing services to community and regional banks and credit unions. It serves about 7,200 financial institutions and offers products through various cloud and on-premises environments.

companies.name: Matahari Department Store
companies.description: PT Matahari Department Store Tbk, known as Matahari, is the largest retail platform in Indonesia. It operates stores across the country and has an online presence through Matahari.com. The company is based in Indonesia.

companies.name: Yuyuan Tourist Mart
companies.description: Shanghai Yuyuan Tourist Mart Co., Ltd. is the largest retailing conglomerate in China. The company operates in the retail sector and is based in China.

companies.name: Sunrise Senior Living
companies.description: Sunrise Senior Living is an American operator of senior living communities. It operates more than 240 communities across the United States and Canada and is the seventh-largest senior living provider in the U.S. The company is based in the United States.

companies.name: Major Cineplex
companies.description: Major Cineplex Group Public Co. Ltd. is the largest operator of movie theaters in Thailand and Laos. It operates 838 screens in 180 locations and owns Thailand's largest multiplex, Major Rangsit. The company is based in Thailand.

companies.name: Murata Manufacturing
companies.description: Murata Manufacturing Co., Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of electronic components based in Nagaokakyo, Kyoto. It produces ceramic passive electronic components and holds a majority market share worldwide in ceramic filters, high-frequency parts, and sensors. The company has 84 subsidiaries globally.

companies.name: James Fisher & Sons
companies.description: James Fisher and Sons plc is a British provider of marine engineering services and a major shipowner. The company is based in Barrow-in-Furness, United Kingdom, and is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: James Hardie
companies.description: James Hardie Industries plc is a global building materials company headquartered in Ireland. It is the largest global manufacturer of fibre cement products and is cross-listed on the Australian and New York Stock Exchanges. Its management team is based in Chicago, Illinois, United States.

companies.name: SamChunDang Pharm
companies.description: Sam Chun Dang Pharm Co., Ltd. (SCD) is a South Korean pharmaceutical company engaged in developing, manufacturing, and selling prescription medicines. Founded in 1943, it is headquartered in Seocho-gu, Seoul, with manufacturing in Hwaseong, Gyeonggi Province. The company is listed on the Korea Exchange.

companies.name: Taichung Commercial Bank
companies.description: Taichung Commercial Bank, officially Taichung Bank, is a public bank headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan. It operates in the banking sector within Taiwan.

companies.name: Media Asia Entertainment Group
companies.description: Media Asia Entertainment Group is a Hong Kong production company and film distributor for films made in Hong Kong and China. It is a subsidiary of Lai Sun Development Company Ltd. The company operates in the cinematography industry.

companies.name: Zenrin
companies.description: Zenrin Co. Ltd. is a Japanese map publishing company founded in 1948 in Beppu, Kyūshū. It specializes in residential maps and software for personal computers and automotive navigation systems. Zenrin is a leading company in Japan for mapping software production.

companies.name: Jarden
companies.description: Jarden was an American consumer products company formed from Ball Corporation's canning business. It became a conglomerate of consumer brands, especially in outdoors and home appliances. Jarden was acquired in 2016 by Newell Rubbermaid, which was renamed Newell Brands.

companies.name: Volcan
companies.description: Volcan Compañía Minera S.A.A. is a mining company based in Peru. The company operates in the mining industry within the country.

companies.name: JetForm
companies.description: JetForm Corporation was a Canadian software manufacturer based in Ottawa, Ontario. It was created by five consultants and produced an electronic form software product named JetForm.

companies.name: Apollo Global Management
companies.description: Apollo Global Management, Inc. is an American asset management firm investing primarily in alternative assets. It manages assets on behalf of pension funds, endowments, sovereign wealth funds, and other investors. Its investments include credit, private equity, and real assets like real estate and infrastructure.

companies.name: Jidong Cement
companies.description: Tangshan Jidong Cement Co., Ltd. is a Chinese cement manufacturer ranked as the 6th largest globally by 2011 data. It is part of the Jidong Development Group, which also has interests in machinery, real estate, and other construction materials.

companies.name: Jilin Aodong Medicine
companies.description: Jilin Aodong Medicine Industry Group Company Limited is a state-owned enterprise in Dunhua, Jilin, China. It manufactures and sells Chinese patent drugs and pharmaceutical packaging products, and is involved in toll collection and road engineering construction. It was established in 1993 and listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 1996.

companies.name: Jinchuan Group
companies.description: Jinchuan Group Co., Ltd. is a major Chinese mining company headquartered in Jinchang, Gansu Province. It is a state-owned enterprise and a leading global producer of nickel and cobalt, also producing other metals. The company operates in over 30 countries and ranked on several Fortune lists in 2024.

companies.name: Jinling Hotel
companies.description: Jinling Hotel Nanjing is a hotel located in Nanjing, China, near the Xinjiekou district. It was the city's first modern hotel managed by Chinese and was the tallest building in China until 1985. The hotel operates various businesses including restaurants, travel agency services, car rental, communications, and advertising.

companies.name: Jizhong Energy
companies.description: Jizhong Energy Group Company Limited is a state-owned coal mining company based in Hebei, China. It is one of the seven largest coal companies in China and the country's second-largest metallurgical coal miner after Shanxi Coking Coal Group.

companies.name: Impala Platinum
companies.description: Impala Platinum Holdings Limited, or Implats, is a South African holding company that owns mines producing platinum group metals, nickel, copper, and cobalt. Its key operations include the Impala mine in North West province and other mines in South Africa and Zimbabwe. The company also operates Impala Refining Services and formed Impala Canada in 2019.

companies.name: Jos. A. Bank Clothiers
companies.description: Jos. A. Bank is an American retailer specializing in men's suits and furnishings. Founded in 1905, it operates over 180 retail locations and three distribution centers. The company is headquartered in Fremont, California, and is part of Tailored Brands.

companies.name: Blink
companies.description: Blink Charging Co. is an American operator of electric vehicle charging networks headquartered in Bowie, Maryland. It is among the top three EV charging networks in the United States and has over 90,000 chargers across 25 countries globally.

companies.name: Weatherford International
companies.description: Weatherford International plc is an American multinational oilfield service company headquartered in the US. It operates in 75 countries providing technical equipment and services for drilling, evaluation, completion, production, and intervention on oil and gas wells.

companies.name: Grupo México
companies.description: Grupo México is a Mexican conglomerate operating through divisions including Mining, Transportation, Infrastructure, and its foundation. It is involved in multiple sectors with mining as a key industry.

companies.name: GS25
companies.description: GS25 is a South Korean convenience store chain operated by GS Retail, a subsidiary of GS Group. Headquartered in Seoul, it operated 13,899 stores as of mid-2020, with plans to increase to over 18,000 stores by the end of 2024.

companies.name: Samsung Life Insurance
companies.description: Samsung Life Insurance is a South Korean multinational insurance company headquartered in Seoul. It is a subsidiary of Samsung Group and is the largest insurance company in South Korea, also listed among the Fortune Global 500.

companies.name: KT Skylife
companies.description: KT SkyLife is a satellite broadcasting provider based in South Korea. It operates as a subsidiary of KT Corporation.

companies.name: KLA Corporation
companies.description: KLA Corporation is an American company headquartered in Milpitas, California, that manufactures wafer fabrication equipment. It supplies process control and yield management systems for semiconductor and nanoelectronics industries, covering all production phases from research to volume manufacturing.

companies.name: Ferguson Enterprises
companies.description: Ferguson Enterprises Inc. is the largest U.S. distributor of plumbing, HVAC, appliances, lighting, pipes, valves, fittings, and water products. It is headquartered in Newport News, Virginia, and operates primarily in the United States and Canada. The company manages a vast network including 11 regional distribution centers and nearly 1,750 branches.

companies.name: Netmarble
companies.description: Netmarble Corp. is a South Korean game developer and publisher founded in 2000 by Bang Jun-hyuk. The company operates in the video game industry and is based in South Korea.

companies.name: Aramark
companies.description: Aramark is an American food service and facilities services provider operating in North America and 14 other countries including the UK, Germany, and Spain. It serves clients in education, prisons, healthcare, business, and leisure sectors.

companies.name: LG Uplus
companies.description: LG Uplus Corp. is a South Korean mobile network operator owned by LG Corporation. Formerly known as LG Telecom, it is the second-largest wireless carrier in South Korea as of 2023.

companies.name: Makino
companies.description: Makino Milling Machine Co., Ltd., known as Makino, is a Japanese machine tool builder with global sales and service. The company is headquartered in Japan and operates in the industrial sector.

companies.name: HD Hyundai Mipo
companies.description: HD Hyundai Mipo is a South Korean shipbuilding company with the world's largest share in the PC segment. It delivers about 70 new ships annually and is a member of HD Hyundai, listed on KOSPI since 1983.

companies.name: HD Hyundai
companies.description: HD Hyundai Co., Ltd. is a large South Korean conglomerate engaged in shipbuilding, heavy equipment, machinery, and the petroleum industry. It operates across multiple industrial sectors.

companies.name: Dow Inc.
companies.description: The Dow Chemical Company is an American multinational chemical corporation headquartered in Midland, Michigan. It is one of the world's largest chemical producers and operates as a subsidiary of Dow Inc.

companies.name: Johannesburg Stock Exchange
companies.description: The JSE Limited is the largest stock exchange in Africa by market capitalization, located in Sandton, Gauteng, South Africa since 2000. It serves as a major financial market in the region.

companies.name: Jorudan
companies.description: Jorudan is a Japanese company headquartered in Shinjuku, Tokyo, involved in video game development and publishing since 1991. It also operates a public transport route navigation website.

companies.name: Autodesk
companies.description: Autodesk, Inc. is an American multinational software corporation headquartered in San Francisco, California. It provides software products and services for industries including architecture, engineering, construction, manufacturing, media, education, and entertainment. Autodesk has offices across the United States and Canada.

companies.name: Joyce Boutique
companies.description: Joyce Boutique Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based fashion retailer operating in Greater China. It franchises fashion, accessories, and cosmetics designer brands under the names JOYCE and mono brand freestanding stores. The company operates 40 points of sale including multi-brand boutiques and beauty store concepts.

companies.name: Julius Berger Nigeria
companies.description: Julius Berger is a Nigerian construction company headquartered in Abuja with additional permanent locations in Lagos and Uyo. It operates within Nigeria's construction industry.

companies.name: Jungo Connectivity Ltd
companies.description: Jungo Connectivity is an Israeli software company specializing in driver monitoring system software and device driver development. It operates within the software industry in Israel.

companies.name: Neinor Homes
companies.description: Neinor Homes S.A. is a Spanish real estate company headquartered in Bilbao. It specializes in the development, promotion, and management of residential properties across Spain.

companies.name: JustSystems
companies.description: JustSystems Corporation is a Japanese software development company known for products like the Ichitaro word processor and ATOK Japanese input method. In the 2010s, it shifted focus to correspondence education and enterprise software.

companies.name: KB Home
companies.description: KB Home is an American homebuilding company founded in 1957 in Detroit, Michigan. It was the first home builder traded on the New York Stock Exchange. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, California, with plans to move to Tempe, Arizona in 2027.

companies.name: KEC International
companies.description: KEC International Limited is an Indian multinational company headquartered in Mumbai. It is India's second largest manufacturer of electric power transmission towers and a major EPC company in power transmission, distribution, railways, solar, and infrastructure sectors. It operates across India, SAARC, EAP, Africa, Middle East, and the Americas.

companies.name: KEPCO Engineering & Construction Company
companies.description: KEPCO Engineering & Construction Company is a South Korean power plant design and engineering firm established in 1975. It designs, engineers, and constructs nuclear and fossil power plants and operates as a subsidiary of Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO).

companies.name: VIA Technologies
companies.description: VIA Technologies, Inc. is a Taiwanese fabless semiconductor company that manufactures integrated circuits including motherboard chipsets, CPUs, and memory. It was once the world's largest independent manufacturer of motherboard chipsets and outsources silicon manufacturing to third-party foundries like TSMC.

companies.name: National Bank of Canada
companies.description: The National Bank of Canada is the sixth largest commercial bank in Canada, headquartered in Montreal. It has branches across most Canadian provinces and serves 3.1 million clients. It is the largest bank in Quebec and the second largest financial institution in the province after Desjardins.

companies.name: Kagome
companies.description: Kagome Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company that manufactures and distributes tomato-based foods as well as fruit and vegetable juices. It operates in the agriculture and food industry in Japan.

companies.name: WEG Industries
companies.description: WEG S.A. is a Brazilian company headquartered in Jaraguá do Sul, operating worldwide in electrical engineering, power, and automation technology. It was founded in 1961 and serves various industrial sectors.

companies.name: Kaiser Aluminum
companies.description: Kaiser Aluminum Corporation is an American aluminum producer. It originated as a spinoff from Kaiser Aluminum and Chemicals Corporation, which itself was formed after the renaming of Permanente Metals Corporation.

companies.name: Kalbe Farma
companies.description: PT Kalbe Farma Tbk, known as Kalbe, is an Indonesian pharmaceutical, healthcare, and nutrition company established in 1966. It has grown through acquisitions and produces a range of products including prescription drugs, OTC drugs, energy drinks, and nutrition products.

companies.name: Oil Refineries Ltd.
companies.description: BAZAN Group, formerly Oil Refineries Ltd., is an oil refining and petrochemicals company based in Haifa Bay, Israel. It operates the country's largest oil refinery and provides products and services for industrial operations, agriculture, and transportation.

companies.name: Kapstone
companies.description: KapStone Paper & Packaging was an American pulp and paper company based in Northbrook, Illinois. Founded in 2005 as Stone, it became a subsidiary of WestRock Company in November 2018.

companies.name: Visteon
companies.description: Visteon Corporation is an American global automotive electronics technology company headquartered in Van Buren Township, Michigan. It designs, engineers, and manufactures vehicle cockpit electronics, connected car services, and electrification products for automotive manufacturers worldwide.

companies.name: PBG SA
companies.description: PBG SA is a Polish engineering company engaged in the design, execution, and repair of pipelines and equipment for transporting oil, natural gas, water, and wastewater. It also works on infrastructure for heating and fuel storage facilities.

companies.name: Arctic Cat
companies.description: Arctic Cat is an American brand that manufactures snowmobiles and all-terrain vehicles in Thief River Falls, Minnesota. Founded in 1960, the company designs, engineers, manufactures, and markets these vehicles.

companies.name: ZiL
companies.description: ZiL, or Public Joint-Stock Company – Likhachov Plant, was an automobile manufacturer based in the Danilovsky District of Moscow, Russia. It operated from 1916 to 2012 and was best known for producing limousines used by the Soviet Union elite, which led to the term 'ZiL lanes'.

companies.name: Bombay Stock Exchange
companies.description: The Bombay Stock Exchange is an Indian stock exchange located in Mumbai. Established in 1875, it is the oldest stock exchange in Asia and the tenth oldest in the world.

companies.name: Celesc
companies.description: Centrais Elétricas de Santa Catarina (Celesc) is an electricity utility serving the southern Brazilian state of Santa Catarina. Headquartered in Florianópolis, it operates 16 hydroelectric plants and manages an extensive distribution network.

companies.name: Kelso & Company
companies.description: Kelso & Company is an American private equity firm based in New York City. It focuses on leveraged buyouts, recapitalizations, and growth capital transactions across sectors including communication, manufacturing, and restaurants.

companies.name: Kemper Corporation
companies.description: Kemper Corporation is an American insurance provider headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It offers insurance products to individuals, families, and businesses.

companies.name: Kenneth Cole Productions
companies.description: Kenneth Cole Productions, Inc. is an American fashion house founded in 1982 by Kenneth Cole. It operates in the retail sector.

companies.name: La-Z-Boy
companies.description: La-Z-Boy Inc. is an American furniture manufacturer based in Monroe, Michigan. It produces home furniture including recliners, sofas, and sleeper sofas, employing over 11,000 people.

companies.name: Keshavarzi Bank
companies.description: Bank Keshavarzi, also known as Agribank, is a major Iranian bank specializing in agricultural finance. Established in 1933, it operates over 1800 branches nationwide and finances nearly 70% of Iran's agricultural sector.

companies.name: Key Energy Services
companies.description: Key Energy Services is an American company providing oilfield services. It operates within the oilfield service industry.

companies.name: Black Rifle Coffee Company
companies.description: Black Rifle Coffee Company is a coffee company based in West Valley City, Utah, founded in 2014 by former U.S. Army Green Beret Evan Hafer. It gained attention for pledging to hire veterans and military spouses.

companies.name: Khon Kaen Sugar
companies.description: Khon Kaen Sugar (KSL) is a sugar-manufacturing company based in Thailand. Its corporate headquarters are located in Bangkok, with principal manufacturing facilities in Khon Kaen, northeastern Thailand. The company operates in the food industry.

companies.name: Kid Brands
companies.description: Kid Brands, Inc. was a company that designed, developed, and distributed infant and juvenile branded products. These products were sold through various retail channels worldwide, including mass market, specialty, and e-commerce retailers. The company was based in the United States.

companies.name: Kintetsu Department Store
companies.description: Kintetsu Department Store Co., Ltd. is a department store chain headquartered in Abenosuji Itchome, Abeno-ku, Osaka, Japan. It operates in the Kansai region of Japan, serving retail customers.

companies.name: Kirkland's
companies.description: Kirkland's, Inc. is an American retail chain based in Brentwood, Tennessee. It sells home decor, furniture, textiles, accessories, and gifts through 317 stores across 35 states and an e-commerce website.

companies.name: Kitty Hawk Aircargo
companies.description: Kitty Hawk Aircargo was an American cargo airline based at Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport and in Grapevine, Texas. It operated domestic scheduled overnight freight services and air charter services, with a hub at Fort Wayne International Airport.

companies.name: Kogan.com
companies.description: Kogan.com is an Australian-Tasmanian portfolio of retail and services businesses founded in 2006 by Ruslan Kogan. Its operations include retail, marketplace, mobile, internet, insurance, travel, money, cars, energy, and other brands.

companies.name: Hawaiian Airlines
companies.description: Hawaiian Airlines, Inc. is a U.S. commercial airline headquartered in Honolulu and a wholly owned subsidiary of Alaska Air Group. It operated as an independent carrier from 1929 to 2025 and was the largest operator of commercial flights to and from Hawaiʻi.

companies.name: Kona Grill
companies.description: Kona Grill, Inc. is a casual restaurant company based in Denver, Colorado, serving American cuisine, sushi, and cocktails. It operates around 40 restaurants in 23 U.S. states and three international franchise locations. In 2019, it was purchased by One Hospitality Group.

companies.name: Kongzhong
companies.description: Kongzhong Corporation is a Chinese company providing value-added services including video games via the Internet and mobile networks. Its offerings include mobile web content, ring tones, ringback tones, mobile games, and Internet games.

companies.name: Konka Group
companies.description: Konka Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese electronics manufacturer headquartered in Shenzhen, Guangdong. The company is publicly listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange. It produces various electronics products.

companies.name: Lebedyansky
companies.description: Lebedyansky is a Russian multinational company that manufactures fruit juice, baby food, vegetable juice, and soft drinks. It is owned by PepsiCo and is the largest fruit juice manufacturer in Eastern Europe. The company has two major production centers in Lipetsk Oblast.

companies.name: KEPCO Plant Service & Engineering Co.
companies.description: KEPCO Plant Service & Engineering Co., Ltd. is a South Korean public enterprise established in 1974. It is a subsidiary of KEPCO and provides electronic power and industrial facilities. The company operates in the engineering sector.

companies.name: Kornit Digital
companies.description: Kornit Digital Ltd. is an Israeli-American manufacturing company producing high-speed industrial inkjet printers, pigmented ink, and chemical products. It serves the garment, apparel, home goods, textile accessories, and decorating industries.

companies.name: Aptiv
companies.description: Aptiv PLC is a supplier of automotive technology and components. It is organized in Jersey and has tax residency in Schaffhausen, Switzerland. The company operates 139 manufacturing facilities and 11 technical centers across 50 countries.

companies.name: Victorias Milling Company
companies.description: Victorias Milling Company is a publicly listed Philippine company established in 1919. It is the largest sugar producer in the country and one of Asia's largest sugar millers and refineries. Its plant facilities and headquarters are located in Victorias City, Negros Occidental.

companies.name: Kumagai Gumi
companies.description: Kumagai Gumi Co., Ltd. is a Japanese construction company founded in Fukui, Fukui Prefecture. While its registered headquarters remain in Fukui, the actual head office is located in Shinjuku, Tokyo.

companies.name: Kumari Bank Limited
companies.description: Kumari Bank Limited is the fifteenth commercial bank in Nepal, launched in 2001. At its establishment, it had an authorized capital of NPR 2 billion and a paid-up capital of NPR 1.83 billion.

companies.name: Kumho Engineering and Construction
companies.description: Kumho Engineering and Construction is a South Korean company specializing in civil engineering and construction. It is based in South Korea.

companies.name: Kura Sushi
companies.description: Kura Sushi, Inc. is a Japanese conveyor belt sushi restaurant chain headquartered in Sakai, Osaka Prefecture. As of October 2023, it operates 543 locations in Japan, 56 in Taiwan, and 69 in the United States, making it the second largest sushi chain in Japan.

companies.name: Kværner
companies.description: Kværner was a Norwegian engineering and construction services company that operated from 1853 until 2005. It was based in Norway and specialized in engineering and construction services. The company ceased to exist in 2005.

companies.name: Dean Foods
companies.description: Dean Foods was an American food and beverage company and the largest dairy company in the United States. It produced milk, ice cream, cheese, juice, and teas under various regional and national brands. Founded in 1925, it filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2019 and its assets were sold in 2020.

companies.name: Virgin America
companies.description: Virgin America Inc. was a low-cost airline headquartered in Burlingame, California, in the San Francisco Bay Area. It operated domestic and international flights with hubs in San Francisco and Los Angeles, focusing on West Coast cities and major metropolitan areas. It also had focus city operations in Dallas and New York.

companies.name: CJ Cheil Jedang
companies.description: CJ CheilJedang Corporation is a South Korean international food company based in Seoul. It manufactures food ingredients, packaged food products, pharmaceuticals, and biotechnology products. Its brands include Beksul, Bibigo, Gourmet, and Hetbahn, with Bibigo known globally for mandu.

companies.name: Kyodo Public Relations
companies.description: Kyodo Public Relations is the largest independent public relations agency in Japan. Founded in 1964 by Sakae Ohashi, it mainly serves enterprises and was listed on the JASDAQ stock market in 2005.

companies.name: The L. S. Starrett Company
companies.description: The L. S. Starrett Company is an American manufacturer of precision tools and instruments used by machinists, tool and die makers, and the construction industry. It produces around 5,000 variations of tools, gauges, measuring instruments, and saw blades as of 2025.

companies.name: LGI Homes
companies.description: LGI Homes is a Texas-based builder of new construction homes and housing developments, primarily in the southwestern United States. It is recognized as one of the largest home builders in the country. The company went public in 2013 and has shown growth in home sales and revenue.

companies.name: LIG Defense&Aerospace
companies.description: LIG Defense & Aerospace, formerly LG Innotek and LIG Nex1, is a South Korean aerospace and arms manufacturer established in 1976 as Goldstar Precision. It was previously owned by LIG Holdings and the LIG Group. In 2013, a consortium led by STIC Investments acquired a 49% stake in the company.

companies.name: Genasys
companies.description: Genasys Inc., based in San Diego, California, produces long-range acoustic devices used for hailing and mass notification. It offers software-as-a-service products for zone-based communication and secure messaging. The company was formerly known as American Technology Corporation and LRAD Corporation.

companies.name: LabCorp
companies.description: Labcorp Holdings Inc., operating as Labcorp, is headquartered in Burlington, North Carolina. It provides laboratory services for diagnosis and healthcare decisions and operates one of the largest clinical laboratory networks globally, with operations in over 100 countries, primarily in the U.S.

companies.name: Vueling
companies.description: Vueling S.A. is a Spanish low-cost airline based in Viladecans near Barcelona. It operates mainly from Barcelona–El Prat Airport and has secondary bases in several European cities. Since 2013, it has been part of International Airlines Group, which also owns British Airways and Iberia.

companies.name: Spire Inc.
companies.description: Spire Inc. is a regional public utility holding company headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. It provides regulated natural gas services primarily through its subsidiary Laclede Gas Company, the largest natural gas distributor in Missouri. The company also engages in other profit-making businesses.

companies.name: Lancashire Holdings
companies.description: Lancashire Holdings Limited is a Bermuda-incorporated insurance company with subsidiaries in Bermuda, London, the US, and Australia. It operates two syndicates at Lloyd’s of London and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation
companies.description: Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation (SMIC) is a Chinese semiconductor foundry company that is partially state-owned and publicly listed. It is the largest contract chip maker in mainland China.

companies.name: LATAM Airlines
companies.description: LATAM Airlines is a Chilean multinational airline headquartered in Santiago. It is the largest airline holding company in Latin America with subsidiaries in Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Paraguay, and Peru.

companies.name: LTM Limited
companies.description: LTM Limited is an Indian multinational information technology services and consulting company based in Mumbai. It is a subsidiary of Larsen & Toubro and was incorporated in 1996, employing over 87,950 people.

companies.name: ACC Limited
companies.description: ACC Limited is an Indian cement producer headquartered in Mumbai. It is a subsidiary of Ambuja Cements and part of the Adani Group. The company was established in 1936 and renamed ACC Limited in 2006.

companies.name: Law Debenture
companies.description: The Law Debenture Corporation plc is a British investment trust providing diversified investments and fiduciary services. It appoints agents, directors, and trustees for pension funds, trusts, and companies. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Planet 13
companies.description: Planet 13 Holdings, Inc. is a cannabis company based in Nevada, United States. It opened the world's largest cannabis dispensary in Las Vegas on November 1, 2018, covering 112,000 square feet.

companies.name: Geneva Cantonal Bank
companies.description: Banque Cantonale de Genève (BCGE) is a Swiss limited company established under public law from the merger of two Geneva-based banks. It is one of the 24 cantonal banks in Switzerland.

companies.name: Aérospatiale
companies.description: Aérospatiale was a French state-owned aerospace and defence corporation founded in 1970. It was created through the merger of three state-owned aerospace firms: Nord Aviation, SEREB, and Sud Aviation. The company was based in France and operated in the arms industry.

companies.name: Core & Main
companies.description: Core & Main is a U.S.-based distributor of products used for water, wastewater, storm drainage, and fire protection. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, it serves municipalities, private water companies, and contractors across 49 states. The company operates 370 branch locations nationwide.

companies.name: Le Château
companies.description: Le Château Inc. is a Canadian fashion company founded in 1959 in Montreal, Quebec. It designs, imports, and retails women's and men's apparel, accessories, and footwear. The company operates within Suzy Shier stores following its bankruptcy, having previously operated 123 retail stores in Canada and several in the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

companies.name: Mitsubishi Corporation
companies.description: Mitsubishi Corporation is a Japanese general trading company and a core member of the Mitsubishi Group. It has been the largest of the five major sogo shosha in Japan by revenue and profits for much of the post-war period. The company operates in the wholesale industry.

companies.name: Renewable Energy Group
companies.description: Renewable Energy Group is a biodiesel production company headquartered in Ames, Iowa. It operates 12 biorefineries and a feedstock processing facility. As of 2018, it was recognized as a Fortune 1000 corporation.

companies.name: Affirm
companies.description: Affirm Holdings, Inc. is an American financial technology company and point-of-sale lender founded in 2012 by PayPal co-founder Max Levchin. It is the largest U.S.-based buy now, pay later financier. The company operates in the fintech industry.

companies.name: El Pollo Loco
companies.description: El Pollo Loco, Inc. is a U.S.-based restaurant chain specializing in Mexican-style grilled chicken. Headquartered in Costa Mesa, California, it offers dine-in, take-out, and some drive-through services. The company operates about 500 company-owned and franchised restaurants in the Southwestern United States.

companies.name: The RealReal
companies.description: The RealReal, Inc. is an online marketplace headquartered in San Francisco that allows users to buy and sell authenticated luxury goods. Founded in 2011 by Julie Wainwright, the platform specializes in recommerce of high-end items.

companies.name: Diamondback Energy
companies.description: Diamondback Energy is an American hydrocarbon exploration company headquartered in Midland, Texas. It operates primarily in the Permian Basin. The company is part of the petroleum industry.

companies.name: Lechters Housewares
companies.description: Lechters Housewares was a U.S.-based national chain of kitchen-supply stores headquartered in Harrison, New Jersey. Many stores were located in malls, and the company owned the Costless Home Store and Famous Brands Housewares Outlet chains. Its store-brand products were sold under the name Cooks Club.

companies.name: LoanDepot
companies.description: LoanDepot is a nonbank holding company based in Irvine, California. It sells mortgage and non-mortgage lending products. The company is sometimes stylized as loanDepot.

companies.name: Glassbox Ltd
companies.description: Glassbox is an Israeli software company that provides digital analytics and tools to monitor user interactions on websites and mobile applications. Its platform captures, analyzes, and replays user sessions, supporting over one trillion digital interactions annually.

companies.name: Jana Small Finance Bank
companies.description: Jana Small Finance Bank is a small finance bank headquartered in Bangalore, India. It commenced banking operations on 28 March 2018. It is the fourth-largest small finance bank in India by asset size.

companies.name: Lee Enterprises
companies.description: Lee Enterprises, Inc. is an American media company based in Davenport, Iowa. It publishes 72 daily newspapers in 25 states and more than 350 weekly, classified, and specialty publications. The company was founded in 1890 by Alfred Wilson Lee.

companies.name: LegalZoom
companies.description: LegalZoom.com, Inc. is an American online legal technology and services company launched in 2001. It provides online legal services through an independent network of attorneys and its own law firm. Services include wills, business compliance, copyright registrations, and trademark applications.

companies.name: Legend Holdings
companies.description: Legend Holdings Corporation is a Chinese investment holding company with interests in finance, real estate, and information technology. It is the controlling shareholder of Lenovo Group. The company was formed by the Chinese Academy of Sciences and was originally named Legend Computer.

companies.name: Flagstar Financial
companies.description: Flagstar Bank, N.A. is an American regional financial services holding company headquartered in Hicksville, New York. In 2023, it operated 395 branches under various bank names, which were rebranded under the Flagstar name in February 2024.

companies.name: Leisure and Gaming
companies.description: Leisure and Gaming plc was a holding company based in London, United Kingdom. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange and had major assets in the global interactive betting and gaming industry. Its interests included software development and marketing.

companies.name: Lorena
companies.description: PT Eka Sari Lorena Transport Tbk is a publicly traded bus company in Indonesia. It provides inter-city transport buses with long distance routes. The company operates in the transport and logistics sector.

companies.name: Happen Bank
companies.description: Happen Bank Inc. is an American financial services company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It was the first peer-to-peer lender to register its offerings as securities with the SEC and to offer loan trading on a secondary market. It was once the world's largest peer-to-peer lending platform.

companies.name: Leon's
companies.description: Leon's Furniture Ltd. is a Canadian furniture retailer founded in 1909 in Welland, Ontario. The company operates stores across all Canadian provinces. The Leon family holds the controlling interest, while some shares are publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

companies.name: JKN Global Group
companies.description: JKN Global Group Public Company Limited is a Thai multinational conglomerate headquartered in the JKN Empire building in Samut Prakan, Thailand. Founded by Jakkaphong Jakrajutatip, it operates in diverse industries including foods, beverages, cosmetics, entertainment, mass media, and television programming.

companies.name: Jefferies Financial Group
companies.description: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. is an American financial services company based in New York City. It is publicly listed on the New York Stock Exchange and is part of the Fortune 1000.

companies.name: Lexicon Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Lexicon Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company founded in 1995 in The Woodlands, Texas. It develops treatments for human diseases using mouse gene knockout technology and has identified over 100 potential therapeutic targets. The company pursues drug targets in oncology, gastroenterology, immunology, metabolism, and ophthalmology.

companies.name: Lexington State Bank
companies.description: Lexington State Bank was a banking company based in Lexington, North Carolina, with 29 branches in the Piedmont Triad region. Its holding company was LSB Bancshares, Inc. In 2007, it merged with FNB Southeast to form NewBridge Bank.

companies.name: QVC Group
companies.description: QVC Group is an American media conglomerate controlled by chairman John C. Malone, who owns a majority of the voting shares.

companies.name: LifeLock
companies.description: LifeLock is identity theft prevention software originally sold by the LifeLock company and now by Gen. Marketed as NortonLifeLock after 2017, it is bundled with Norton 360 products and provides monitoring, alerts, and financial coverage for identity theft and scams.

companies.name: Life Time
companies.description: Life Time, Inc. operates a chain of athletic country clubs in the United States and Canada.

companies.name: Lifeboat Distribution
companies.description: Lifeboat Distribution is an international value-added distributor serving vendors specializing in virtualization, cloud computing, security, application and network infrastructure, business continuity, database management, and other technical products.

companies.name: Lightyear Capital
companies.description: Lightyear Capital is a private equity firm based in New York City, founded in 2000 by Donald Marron. It invests primarily in financial services, financial technology, healthcare, and business-services companies. Mark Vassallo has led the firm since 2019.

companies.name: Edgio
companies.description: Edgio, Inc., formerly Limelight Networks, was an American company providing content delivery network services for digital media content and software delivery. It operated in the digital distribution industry in the United States.

companies.name: Lincoln Electric
companies.description: Lincoln Electric Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational manufacturer of welding products and equipment headquartered in Euclid, Ohio. It operates globally with manufacturing locations and alliances in multiple countries and is a member of the Fortune 1000.

companies.name: Lindsay Manufacturing
companies.description: Lindsay Corporation, formerly Lindsay Manufacturing Co., is a manufacturer of Zimmatic brand center pivot irrigation systems based in Omaha, Nebraska. It also produces farm and construction machinery, as well as road and railroad infrastructure equipment.

companies.name: Lion Electric Company
companies.description: LION is a Canadian electric vehicle manufacturer headquartered in Saint-Jérôme, Quebec. Founded in 2011 as Lion Bus, it is known for being the first to mass produce fully electric yellow school buses.

companies.name: Lippo Cikarang
companies.description: Lippo Cikarang is an independent township developed by PT Lippo Cikarang Tbk, a subsidiary of Lippo Group, located in Cikarang, West Java, Indonesia. The township covers about 3000 hectares and includes over 14,000 houses and nearly 1,000 manufacturing companies.

companies.name: Panda Electronics
companies.description: Panda Electronics is a Chinese manufacturer and brand producing electronic products such as mobile phones, datacards, TV sets, set top boxes, administrative software, electronic instruments, and satellite and mobile communication devices.

companies.name: Bushiroad
companies.description: Bushiroad Inc. is a Japanese entertainment company founded in 2007 and headquartered in Tokyo. It produces collectible card games, trading cards, and mobile apps and games, and owns various media franchises.

companies.name: Automatic Bank Services
companies.description: Automatic Bank Services Ltd. is an Israeli company providing communications and computing services in the banking sector, specializing in clearing credit card transactions. Its offices are currently located in the Azrieli Holon center.

companies.name: DFI Retail Group
