companies.description: DFI Retail Group Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong–based retail company legally based in Bermuda and Singapore. It is a major East and Southeast Asian retailer involved in food and health and beauty product processing and wholesaling, and is a subsidiary of Jardine Matheson Group.

companies.name: Bangchak Petroleum Public Company Limited
companies.description: Bangchak Corporation Public Company Limited, formerly Bangchak Petroleum, is a petroleum and energy conglomerate in Thailand. Founded as a state-owned company in 1984, it operates in oil refining, retail, and sustainable energy through subsidiaries.

companies.name: PTT Exploration and Production Public Company Limited
companies.description: PTT Exploration and Production Public Company Limited, also known as PTTEP, is a national petroleum exploration and production company based in Thailand. It is a subsidiary of the state-owned PTT Public Company Limited and was founded on 20 June 1985.

companies.name: Nomura Group
companies.description: Nomura Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese financial holding company and a principal member of the Nomura Group, Japan's largest investment bank and brokerage group. It provides investment, financing, and related services globally with an emphasis on securities businesses.

companies.name: UAZ
companies.description: UAZ, or Ulyanovsky Avtomobilny Zavod, is an automobile manufacturer based in Ulyanovsk, Russia. It produces off-road vehicles, buses, and trucks and has been part of the Sollers automotive group since 2000.

companies.name: Garmin Group
companies.description: Garmin Ltd. is an American multinational technology company based in Olathe, Kansas. It designs, develops, manufactures, markets, and distributes GPS-enabled products and other navigation, communication, sensor-based, and information products for automotive, aviation, marine, outdoors, and sport markets.

companies.name: Isracard Ltd
companies.description: Isracard is an Israeli company composed of four companies including Isracard LTD and American Express Israel. It offers financial services such as credit card issuing, loans, credit services, and flexible payment options.

companies.name: SkyEurope Airlines
companies.description: SkyEurope Airlines was a low-cost airline headquartered in Bratislava, Slovakia, with bases in Bratislava and Prague. It operated short-haul scheduled and charter passenger services before filing for bankruptcy and suspending all flights in 2009.

companies.name: Ritek
companies.logo_file: Ritek logo 含網址及中文.jpg
companies.description: RITEK Corporation is a Taiwanese company that manufactures optical discs such as CDs, DVDs, and Blu-ray, as well as storage cards and flash drives. It also produces solar modules, touch panel products, and has launched products in nano- and biotechnology.

companies.name: Securitas
companies.description: Securitas AB is a Swedish group specializing in security services including guarding, mobile patrolling, monitoring, investigation, and consulting. Headquartered in Stockholm, it operates in 44 markets worldwide and is listed on Nasdaq OMX Stockholm.

companies.name: WABCO Vehicle Control Systems
companies.description: WABCO Holdings, Inc. was a U.S.-based provider of electronic braking, stability, suspension, and transmission automation systems for heavy-duty commercial vehicles. It was spun off in 2007 and acquired by ZF Friedrichshafen in May 2020.

companies.name: Straumann
companies.description: Straumann Group is a Swiss company based in Basel that manufactures dental implants and related technologies. It researches, develops, manufactures, and supplies dental implants, instruments, biomaterials, CADCAM prosthetics, digital equipment, software, and clear aligners for dentistry applications.

companies.name: Lithia Motors
companies.description: Lithia Motors, Inc. is an American automotive dealership group headquartered in Medford, Oregon. It operates 459 dealership locations across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Lithia is the largest automotive retailer in the United States by revenue as of 2025.

companies.name: RS Public Company Limited
companies.description: RS Group is a Thai entertainment and media company founded in 1982. It operates two main business groups: Commerce, including RS Mall and Lifestar Company Limited, and Media and Entertainment, which includes Channel 8, COOLism, and RS Music. The company is listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand.

companies.name: Littelfuse
companies.description: Littelfuse, Inc. is an American electronics manufacturing company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It produces circuit protection products, switches, automotive sensors, and microprocessors through its subsidiary Zilog. Littelfuse developed the first blade-type automotive fuse called AutoFuse.

companies.name: Cerebras
companies.description: Cerebras Systems Inc. is a company based in Sunnyvale, California, that develops semiconductors, supercomputers, and software for artificial intelligence deep-learning applications. Its products include wafer scale engine semiconductors, CS-3 supercomputers, and cloud APIs for AI inference and training. The company also builds data centers to provide cloud computing services.

companies.name: General Cable
companies.industry: manufacture of other electronic and electric wires and cables
companies.description: General Cable was an American multinational cable manufacturing company headquartered in Highland Heights, Kentucky. It manufactured and distributed copper, aluminum, and optical fiber cables. In 2018, it was acquired by the Italian group Prysmian.

companies.name: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce
companies.description: The Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce is a Canadian multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Toronto's Financial District. It was formed in 1961 through the merger of the Canadian Bank of Commerce and the Imperial Bank of Canada. It is one of the Big Five banks founded in Toronto.

companies.name: Workpoint Entertainment
companies.description: Workpoint Entertainment Public Company Limited is a Thai media company founded in 1989. It operates in television production, filmmaking, event management, animation, publishing, event marketing, and recording. The company went public on the Stock Exchange of Thailand in 2004 and has produced numerous television programs across various genres.

companies.name: Swiss Market Index
companies.description: The Swiss Market Index (SMI) is Switzerland's blue-chip stock market index composed of 20 of the largest and most liquid Swiss Performance Index stocks. It is the most followed stock market index in Switzerland and is a price index not adjusted for dividends.

companies.name: Loghman Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Loghman Pharmaceutical & Hygienic Co. is an Iranian pharmaceuticals company engaged in the discovery, development, manufacture, and marketing of drugs in Iran.

companies.name: Loma Negra
companies.description: Loma Negra Compañía Industrial Argentina S.A. is an Argentine manufacturer and the country's leading maker of cement, concrete, and lime. The company was established by Alfredo Fortabat, who also founded its sports club. After his passing, his wife Amalia Lacroze took over the business.

companies.name: Osotspa
companies.description: Osotspa Public Company Limited is a Thai beverage producer known for drinks such as M-150 and Shark Energy. The company is based in Bangkok, Thailand. It operates in the beverage industry.

companies.name: Clariant
companies.description: Clariant AG is a Swiss multinational specialty chemical company headquartered in Muttenz, Switzerland. It was formed in 1995 as a spin-off from Sandoz and has 68 subsidiaries in 36 countries. The company operates major manufacturing sites across Europe, the Americas, China, and India.

companies.name: Lookers
companies.description: Lookers is a British car dealership chain operating in the United Kingdom and Ireland. It represents multiple automotive brands and is based in Altrincham. The company was acquired by Global Auto Holdings in 2023.

companies.name: Thai President Foods
companies.description: Thai President Foods PCL is a Bangkok-based company established in 1972 that manufactures the internationally marketed instant noodle brand "MAMA." It is the largest instant noodle manufacturer in Thailand with over 50% market share as of 2020.

companies.name: Thai Oil
companies.description: Thai Oil Public Company Limited, also known as Thaioil, is a Thai public company and subsidiary of PTT Group. Founded in 1961 as Oil Refinery, Ltd., it is listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

companies.name: Lotte Chilsung
companies.description: Lotte Chilsung Beverage Co., Ltd. is a South Korean drink manufacturer affiliated with Lotte Corporation. The company's name means "Big Dipper" and its logo features seven stars aligned in a row. It operates in the agriculture and food industry.

companies.name: Luby's
companies.description: Luby’s Restaurant Corporation is a chain of cafeteria-style restaurants based in Texas, United States. It previously owned other restaurant chains including Fuddruckers, Koo Koo Roo, and Cheeseburger in Paradise. The company operates in the system catering industry.

companies.name: SGS S.A.
companies.description: SGS is a Swiss multinational company headquartered in Baar that provides inspection, verification, testing, and certification services. It operates a network of 2,600 offices and laboratories worldwide with nearly 100,000 employees. SGS has been ranked on the Forbes Global 2000 multiple times.

companies.name: Sulzer
companies.description: Sulzer Ltd. is a Swiss industrial engineering and manufacturing firm founded in 1775 and established as Sulzer Brothers Ltd. in 1834 in Winterthur, Switzerland. It operates about 180 manufacturing facilities and service centers globally. The company is publicly traded on the Swiss Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Lumber Liquidators
companies.description: Lumber Liquidators is an American retailer specializing in hard-surface flooring products such as hardwood, laminate, vinyl plank, tile, bamboo, and cork. The company also sells flooring tools and accessories. It filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in August 2024 but avoided liquidation after being acquired by its original founder.

companies.name: Lumos
companies.description: Lumos is a telecommunications company based in Waynesboro, Virginia, and High Point, North Carolina, United States. It offers residential and business fiber-optic internet services, VOIP telephone, web hosting, and digital television. The company merged with North State Communications effective August 15, 2022.

companies.name: Luoyang Glass
companies.description: Luoyang Glass Company Limited is a state-owned enterprise located in Luoyang, Henan, China. It produces and sells float sheet and flat glass and reprocesses automobile glass. The company operates in the glass industry.

companies.name: Luxempart
companies.description: Luxempart is a Luxembourg investment company listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. It specializes in direct investments primarily in Luxembourg, Belgium, France, and Germany, as well as investments in private equity funds. Luxempart is included in the LuxX Index, the benchmark index of the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Lynas
companies.description: Lynas Rare Earths, Ltd. is an Australian rare-earths mining company headquartered in Perth, Western Australia. It operates a mining and concentration plant at Mount Weld in Western Australia and the Lynas Advanced Materials Plant in Kuantan, Malaysia. The company was founded in the 1990s.

companies.name: MAPNA
companies.description: MAPNA Group is a group of Iranian companies involved in the development and execution of thermal and renewable power plants, oil & gas, railway transportation, and other industrial projects. It also manufactures main equipment including gas and steam turbines, electrical generators, and locomotives.

companies.name: MEG Energy
companies.description: MEG Energy is a Canadian oil sands producer focused on exploration in the Athabasca oil sands. It operates as a pure play company in the petroleum industry based in Canada.

companies.name: MFS Investment Management
companies.description: MFS Investment Management is an American global investment manager founded in 1924. It is one of the oldest asset management companies and pioneered the mutual fund, with its first fund still in operation today. The company was formerly known as Massachusetts Financial Services.

companies.name: MGE Energy, Inc.
companies.description: MGE Energy, Inc. is a utility holding company based in Madison, Wisconsin. Its main subsidiary, Madison Gas and Electric Co., produces and distributes electricity and distributes natural gas.

companies.name: MITIE Group
companies.description: Mitie Group PLC is a British strategic outsourcing and energy services company headquartered at The Shard in London. It provides infrastructure consultancy, facilities management, property management, energy, and healthcare services across the UK and Ireland. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: MTY Food Group
companies.description: MTY Food Group Inc. is a Canadian franchisor and operator of numerous casual dining, fast casual, and quick service restaurants under more than 70 brand names. It is headquartered in Saint-Laurent, Montreal, Quebec. The company owns the American division Kahala Brands, acquired in 2016.

companies.name: Publix
companies.description: Publix Super Markets, Inc. is an employee-owned American supermarket chain headquartered in Lakeland, Florida. Founded in 1930, it operates throughout the Southeastern United States with locations in multiple states including Florida, Georgia, and Kentucky. It is wholly owned by present and past employees and members of the Jenkins family.

companies.name: Macerich
companies.description: The Macerich Company is an American real estate investment trust that invests in shopping centers. It is headquartered in Santa Monica, California, and was founded in 1964.

companies.name: Macquarie Infrastructure Company
companies.description: Macquarie Infrastructure Holdings, LLC, formerly Macquarie Infrastructure Corporation, owned and operated a diversified group of infrastructure businesses in the United States. It was headquartered in New York City and managed by Macquarie Infrastructure Management (USA) Inc., part of Sydney-based Macquarie Group Limited.

companies.name: Mad Catz
companies.description: Mad Catz, Inc. is an American third-party manufacturer and brand of video gaming products and accessories. Originally a Chinese company until its 2017 bankruptcy, it was relaunched in 2018 and is now produced by Hong Kong-based Mad Catz Global Limited.

companies.name: Madeco
companies.description: Madeco S.A. is a Chilean diversified industrial group manufacturing flexible packaging, copper tubes, and aluminum and PVC window and door profiles. It operates in Chile, Argentina, Colombia, and Peru through its subsidiary Alusa.

companies.name: Maiden Holdings
companies.description: Maiden Holdings Ltd. is a Bermuda-based holding company with insurance subsidiaries providing specialty reinsurance products for the global property and casualty market. It has operating subsidiaries in the United States, Europe, and Bermuda.

companies.name: MainConcept
companies.description: MainConcept is a German software company providing video and audio codecs since 1993. Their products serve industries including video production, multimedia, broadcast, and gaming, and are used by organizations such as Adobe and Sony.

companies.name: Major Drilling Group International
companies.description: Major Drilling Group International Inc. is the world's largest mineral drilling company serving the mining industry.

companies.name: Bank BPH
companies.description: Bank BPH was a bank based in Kraków, Poland, established in 1988-1989 by spinoff from the National Bank of Poland. It merged with Bank PBK in 2001 and was later dismantled, with operations taken over by Bank Pekao and Alior Bank.

companies.name: Malakoff
companies.description: Malakoff Corporation Berhad is a Malaysian independent water and power producer focusing on power generation, water desalination, operation and maintenance, and waste management. It is the largest independent power producer in Malaysia with six power plants.

companies.name: Lonza Group
companies.description: Lonza Group AG is a Swiss multinational manufacturing company headquartered in Basel. It serves the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and nutrition sectors with product development services and custom manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals and detection systems.

companies.name: Mallinckrodt Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Mallinckrodt Pharmaceuticals plc is an Irish-American manufacturer of specialty pharmaceuticals, generic drugs, and imaging agents. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry with significant sales from the U.S. healthcare system.

companies.name: ManTech International
companies.description: ManTech International is an American defense contracting firm based in Herndon, Virginia. Founded in 1968, it uses technology to support government and industry clients.

companies.name: Mandarake
companies.description: Mandarake Inc. is a Japanese retail corporation operating a chain of used goods stores. Founded in 1980 as a used manga bookstore, it now sells a wide range of collectables and otaku-related goods including anime, manga, toys, and video games.

companies.name: Mannesmann
companies.description: Mannesmann was a German industrial conglomerate originally established in 1890 as a steel pipe manufacturer. It expanded into steel products, mechanical and electrical engineering, automotive, and telecommunications, with headquarters in Düsseldorf.

companies.name: MannKind Corporation
companies.description: MannKind Corporation is a biopharmaceutical company based in Danbury, Connecticut. Founded in 1991, it focuses on discovering, developing, and commercializing therapeutic products for diseases like diabetes and pulmonary arterial hypertension.

companies.name: Moody's Corporation
companies.description: Moody's Corporation is an American business and financial services holding company. It owns Moody's Ratings, a credit rating agency, and Moody's, a provider of financial analysis software and services.

companies.name: Marcus & Millichap
companies.description: Marcus & Millichap, Inc. is an American company providing real estate brokerage, mortgage brokerage, research, and advisory services in commercial property across the U.S. and Canada. It operates over 80 offices with more than 1,800 employees.

companies.name: Marin Software
companies.description: Marin Software Incorporated was an online advertising company based in San Francisco. Founded in 2006, it went public in 2013 and was dissolved in 2025 after declaring bankruptcy.

companies.name: Markel Corporation
companies.description: Markel Group Inc. is a group of companies originally founded in 1930 as an insurance company. It is headquartered in Richmond, Virginia, United States. The company has a long history in the insurance industry.

companies.name: Marketo
companies.description: Marketo, Inc. is an American software company headquartered in San Mateo, California. It develops and sells marketing automation software for account-based marketing and other marketing services including SEO and content creation.

companies.name: Okaya & Co.
companies.description: Okaya & Co., Ltd. is one of the oldest still functioning Japanese trade companies, founded in Nagoya city in 1669. It was established as Okaya in 1937 and is a family business with over 200 years of history, also a member of the Henokiens association.

companies.name: Marriott Vacations Worldwide Corporation
companies.description: Marriott Vacations Worldwide Corporation is a public timeshare company based in the United States. It operates more than 120 resorts and manages various vacation ownership brands including Marriott Vacation Club and The Ritz-Carlton Destination Club.

companies.name: Marshalls plc
companies.description: Marshalls plc is a United Kingdom based manufacturer of natural stone and concrete hard landscaping products. It supplies the construction, home improvement, and landscape markets and is based in Elland, West Yorkshire.

companies.name: Martha Stewart Living Omnimedia
companies.description: Martha Stewart Living Omnimedia Inc. is an American diversified media and merchandising company founded in 1997. It operates in publishing, Internet, broadcasting media platforms, and merchandising product lines, including print publications and e-commerce websites.

companies.name: Elevance Health, Inc.
companies.description: Elevance Health, Inc. is an American health insurance company formerly known as Anthem, Inc. It offers medical, pharmaceutical, dental, behavioral health, long-term care, and disability plans and is the largest for-profit managed health care company in the Blue Cross Blue Shield Association.

companies.name: Martin Marietta Materials
companies.description: Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. is an American company supplying aggregates, cement, asphalt, and heavy building materials. It operates in 26 states, Canada, and the Caribbean, providing resources for construction of roads, sidewalks, and foundations.

companies.name: MasTec
companies.description: Mastec, Inc. is an American infrastructure engineering and construction company based in Coral Gables, Florida. It provides engineering, building, installation, maintenance, and upgrade services for energy, utility, and communications infrastructure.

companies.name: Masco
companies.description: Masco Corporation is an American manufacturer of products for home improvement and new home construction markets. It operates nearly 80 manufacturing facilities worldwide and comprises more than 20 companies. Founded in the United States, it has been publicly traded on the NYSE since 1969.

companies.name: Menora Mivtachim Holdings Ltd
companies.description: Menora Mivtachim is an Israeli insurance company publicly traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. It operates within the insurance industry and is based in Israel.

companies.name: Materialise NV
companies.description: Materialise NV is a company headquartered in Leuven, Belgium, specializing in 3D printing and additive manufacturing. It operates in the technology sector focusing on innovative manufacturing solutions.

companies.name: Matson, Inc.
companies.description: Matson, Inc. is an American ocean transportation and logistics company headquartered in Honolulu, Hawaii. It provides shipping and logistics services primarily in the United States.

companies.name: Matsui Securities
companies.description: Matsui Securities is a Japanese financial company listed on the Nikkei 225. It operates in the banking and fintech industry and is based in Japan.

companies.name: Mattress Firm
companies.description: Mattress Firm, Inc. is an American mattress store chain founded in 1986 and headquartered in Houston, Texas. It became a subsidiary of Somnigroup International in 2025 following a merger with Temper Sealy.

companies.name: Maui Land & Pineapple Company
companies.description: Maui Land & Pineapple Company, Inc. is a land holding and operating company based in Kapalua, Hawaii. It develops and manages residential, resort, commercial, and industrial real estate, and operates retail and utility services at Kapalua Resort.

companies.name: Gotion
companies.description: Gotion High Tech, known as Gotion, is a Chinese manufacturer of lithium-ion batteries. As of 2025, it ranked fifth worldwide by battery capacity installed in electric vehicles.

companies.name: MaxLinear
companies.description: MaxLinear, Inc. is an American electronic hardware company founded in 2003. It provides integrated radio-frequency analog and mixed-signal semiconductor products for broadband communications and is traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Mettler Toledo
companies.description: Mettler Toledo is a multinational supplier of precision instruments and services focused on laboratory, industrial, product inspection, and food retailing applications. It serves various industries including life sciences and chemicals, with a global workforce and diversified sales.

companies.name: MeadWestvaco
companies.description: MeadWestvaco Corporation was an American packaging company based in Richmond, Virginia. It employed approximately 23,000 people and moved its corporate headquarters to Richmond in 2006. In 2008, it started using "MWV" as its brand while retaining its legal name.

companies.name: MedCath Corp.
companies.description: MedCath Corporation was an American cardiac health care company founded in 1988. It offered cath lab, nuclear cardiology, and sleep medicine services and operated acute care cardiac hospitals. After the passage of ObamaCare, it sold its health care assets and dissolved.

companies.name: Media Prima
companies.description: Media Prima Berhad is a Malaysian media company based in Bangsar, Kuala Lumpur. It is the largest media and entertainment conglomerate in Malaysia with interests in television, print, radio, advertising, content creation, and digital media. It employs over 6,000 staff and forms half of the country's mass media duopoly.

companies.name: Medibank Private
companies.description: Medibank, formally Medibank Private Limited, is an Australian publicly-traded insurance and health services company headquartered in Melbourne. It is Australia's largest health fund with millions of customers. It started as a government-owned not-for-profit insurer in 1976 and was privatised in 2014.

companies.name: MEDIDATA
companies.description: Medidata Solutions is an American technology company headquartered in New York City that develops and markets software as a service for clinical trials. It has locations in several countries including China, Japan, and the UK. Since 2019, it has been a subsidiary of Dassault Systèmes.

companies.name: Medifast
companies.description: Medifast, Inc. is an American nutrition and weight loss company based in Baltimore, Maryland. It produces, distributes, and sells weight loss and health-related products through websites, multi-level marketing, telemarketing, and franchised clinics.

companies.name: MeetMe
companies.description: The Meet Group, Inc. owns several dating app networking services including MeetMe, hi5, and Tagged. The company has offices in New Hope, Philadelphia, San Francisco, Dresden, and Berlin.

companies.name: Sigma-Aldrich
companies.description: Sigma-Aldrich is a brand within an American chemical, life science, and biotechnology company owned by Merck Group. In the United States, Merck Group's life sciences business operates as MilliporeSigma.

companies.name: Meidensha
companies.description: Meidensha Corporation is a Tokyo-based Japanese company engaged in manufacturing and selling water treatment, electronic, and information equipment. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and is part of the Nikkei 225 index.

companies.name: Melewar Industrial Group
companies.description: Melewar Industrial Group Berhad is a Malaysian manufacturing company owned by the family of its late founder from the Negeri Sembilan royal family. It manufactures and trades steel products and is listed on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange. Its products serve construction, furniture, automotive, bicycle, and engineering industries.

companies.name: Mellanox Technologies
companies.description: Mellanox Technologies Ltd. was an Israeli-American multinational supplier of computer networking products based on InfiniBand and Ethernet technology. It offered adapters, switches, software, cables, and silicon for markets including high-performance computing, data centers, cloud computing, computer data storage, and financial services.

companies.name: Meralco
companies.description: The Manila Electric Company, known as Meralco, is the largest electric power distribution company in the Philippines. It is the sole electric power distributor in Metro Manila and holds the power distribution franchise for 39 cities and 72 municipalities, including all of Metro Manila and the exurbs forming Mega Manila.

companies.name: Mercian Corporation
companies.description: Mercian Corporation is a Tokyo-based operating unit of Kirin, primarily engaged in the production and retail of wine and other alcoholic beverages. It operates in Japan and focuses on alcoholic beverage markets.

companies.name: Mercury Energy
companies.description: Mercury NZ Limited is a New Zealand electricity generation and multi-product utility retailer offering electricity, gas, broadband, and mobile telephone services. All its electricity generation is renewable, and it is the largest electricity retailer in New Zealand.

companies.name: Meritage Homes Corporation
companies.description: Meritage Homes Corporation is a publicly traded American real estate development company that constructs various single-family detached homes across the United States. It is the fifth largest home builder in the U.S. and also develops active adult communities and luxury real estate in Arizona.

companies.name: SuperValu
companies.description: SuperValu, Inc. was an American wholesaler and retailer of grocery products headquartered in Eden Prairie, Minnesota. Founded in 1926, it became a wholly owned subsidiary of United Natural Foods, Inc. (UNFI) in 2018.

companies.name: Meru Networks
companies.description: Meru Networks was a supplier of wireless local area networks (WLANs) serving healthcare, enterprise, hospitality, education, and other markets. Founded in 2002 and based in Sunnyvale, California, it went public in 2010 and was acquired by Fortinet in 2015.

companies.name: Nippon Sharyo
companies.description: Nippon Sharyo, Ltd., founded in 1896 and based in Nagoya, Japan, is a major manufacturer of rolling stock, heavy equipment, generators, special purpose vehicles, and bridges. It became a consolidated subsidiary of Central Japan Railway Company in 2008 and operated a U.S. facility in Illinois from 2012 to 2018.

companies.name: Pathward
companies.description: Pathward Financial, Inc. is a U.S.-based banking and financial services company. It adopted its current name in 2022 after its parent, Meta Financial Group, sold the "Meta" trademark to Meta Platforms.

companies.name: Yield10 Bioscience
companies.description: Yield10 Bioscience is a U.S. company developing new technologies aimed at improving crop yield to enhance global food security. Its focus is on agricultural innovation.

companies.name: Metro Bank
companies.description: Metro Bank PLC is a retail and commercial bank based in the United Kingdom. Founded in 2010 by Anthony Thomson and Vernon Hill, it was the first new high street bank to launch in the UK in over 150 years. The bank is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Byline Bank
companies.description: Byline Bank is a bank headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, United States. It is the primary subsidiary of Byline Bancorp, Inc., a bank holding company. Byline Bank is recognized as the fourth largest SBA 7(a) lender.

companies.name: Qimonda
companies.description: Qimonda AG was a German memory company headquartered in Munich, formed in 2006 as a spin-off from Infineon Technologies. It was the second largest DRAM company worldwide at the time and a top supplier of DRAM products for PC and server markets. The company also operated as a patent licensing firm before its patents were purchased by Micron and others.

companies.name: Kingfisher plc
companies.description: Kingfisher plc is a British multinational retailing company headquartered in London, England. It operates in the retail sector.

companies.name: Michaels
companies.description: Michaels Stores, Inc., known as Michaels, is an American privately held arts and crafts retail chain. It is North America's largest provider of arts, crafts, framing, floral and wall décor products. The company is headquartered in Irving, Texas, and operates stores in the U.S. and Canada.

companies.name: Temenos Group
companies.description: Temenos AG is a Swiss technology company specializing in enterprise software for banks and financial services. Founded in 1993, it is headquartered in Geneva and has been listed on the Swiss stock exchange since 2001.

companies.name: Microsemi
companies.description: Microsemi Corporation was a provider of semiconductor and system solutions based in Aliso Viejo, California. It served markets including aerospace & defense, communications, data center, and industrial sectors.

companies.name: Midland Holdings
companies.description: Midland Holdings Limited is one of the largest real estate brokerage companies in Hong Kong. It offers residential, industrial, and commercial property brokerage services in Hong Kong, Macau, and the People's Republic of China.

companies.name: Midwestone Financial Group
companies.description: MidWestOne Financial Group, Inc. is a bank holding company headquartered in Iowa City, Iowa. It operates 56 bank branches across Iowa, Minnesota, Wisconsin, Colorado, and Florida, and is the third-largest bank headquartered in Iowa.

companies.name: Migdal Insurance & Financial Holdings Ltd.
companies.description: Migdal Insurance and Financial Holdings Ltd. is an Israeli public holding company owning various companies in insurance and financial services, primarily the Migdal Insurance Company. Founded in 1974, its shares have been traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange since 1997 and are part of the TA-125 Index.

companies.name: Bank of Nanjing
companies.description: Bank of Nanjing is a Chinese joint-stock commercial bank founded in 1996 and headquartered in Nanjing, Jiangsu. Its largest single shareholder is BNP Paribas. The bank operates in the banking and fintech industry in China.

companies.name: The Navigator Company
companies.description: The Navigator Company is a Portuguese pulp and paper company. It operates in the pulp and paper industry and is based in Portugal.

companies.name: Transocean
companies.description: Transocean Ltd. is a Swiss offshore drilling company and the world's largest offshore drilling contractor by revenue. It has offices in 20 countries including Canada, the United States, and Brazil.

companies.name: Minor International
companies.description: Minor International is a Thai multinational company based in Bangkok. Its core businesses include hospitality, restaurants, and lifestyle brand distribution through subsidiaries Minor Hotels, Minor Food, and Minor Lifestyle.

companies.name: Miramar Hotel and Investment
companies.description: Miramar Hotel and Investment Company Limited operates hotels, serviced apartments, property rental, food and beverage, and travel services in Hong Kong and mainland China. It has been listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 1970 and is part of Henderson Land Group.

companies.name: Meade Instruments
companies.description: Meade Instruments Corporation was an American multinational company headquartered in Watsonville, California. It manufactured and distributed telescopes and related optical instruments for the consumer market and was once the world's largest telescope manufacturer.

companies.name: Encana
companies.description: Encana Corporation was a Canadian independent petroleum company from 2002 to 2020. Created by a merger, it was once the world's largest independent petroleum company and a leading energy company in Canada.

companies.name: Teck Resources
companies.description: Teck Resources Limited is a diversified natural resources company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. It engages in mining and mineral development including coal, copper, zinc, and energy products.

companies.name: Mobily
companies.description: Mobily, officially Etihad Etisalat Company, is a Saudi Arabian telecommunications services provider offering fixed line, mobile telephony, and Internet services.

companies.name: A1 Telekom Austria Group
companies.description: A1 Telekom Austria Group is a telecommunications provider headquartered in Vienna. It offers fixed-line, broadband Internet, multimedia, data, IT systems, and mobile payment services across seven European countries and is a subsidiary of América Móvil.

companies.name: Modernform Group
companies.description: Modernform Group Public Company Limited is a manufacturer and distributor of home and office furniture based in Thailand. The company is publicly listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand since March 11, 1992.

companies.name: Kudelski Group
companies.description: Kudelski SA is a Swiss company that sells digital television access and management systems, content protection, cybersecurity, IoT products, and public access infrastructure. It is headquartered in Cheseaux-sur-Lausanne, Switzerland, and Phoenix, Arizona. Its first successful product was the Nagra tape recorder, developed by founder Stefan Kudelski.

companies.name: Mohawk Industries
companies.description: Mohawk Industries is an American flooring manufacturer based in Calhoun, Georgia. It produces various floor covering products for residential and commercial use in North America and Europe, including soft and hard flooring, laminate, vinyl, natural stone, and quartz countertops. It operates globally with 40,500 employees.

companies.name: Mayr-Melnhof
companies.description: Mayr-Melnhof Karton AG is a manufacturer in the paper and packaging industry based in Vienna, Austria. The company is 65% family owned and publicly traded on the Vienna Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Armstrong World Industries
companies.description: Armstrong World Industries, Inc. is an international designer and manufacturer of wall and ceiling building materials headquartered in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. As of 2014, it had 3,100 employees and a global manufacturing network of 17 facilities.

companies.name: Molina Healthcare
companies.description: Molina Healthcare, Inc. is an American managed care company headquartered in Long Beach, California. It provides health insurance to individuals through government programs such as Medicaid and Medicare.

companies.name: Monex Group
companies.description: Monex Group, Inc. is a financial services company based in Tokyo, Japan. Its main subsidiary, Monex Inc., offers online securities trading with about 2 million accounts. The group also owns US-based TradeStation and acquired Japan's crypto exchange Coincheck in 2018.

companies.name: MONY Group
companies.description: MONY Group plc, trading as MoneySuperMarket, is a British company specializing in technology-led money-saving platforms including price comparison websites. It operates several subsidiaries and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: dormakaba Holding AG
companies.description: dormakaba Holding AG is a global security group based in Rümlang, Switzerland, formed from the merger of Kaba and Dorma in 2015. The company is publicly traded on the SIX Swiss Exchange.

companies.name: Monro Muffler Brake
companies.description: Monro, Inc. is an automotive services company headquartered in Rochester, New York, United States. It operates 1,260 locations, making it the second-largest automotive services company in North America by number of locations and revenue as of 2025.

companies.name: Gulf Space Technology
companies.description: Gulf Space Technology Public Company Limited is a Thai satellite operator providing satellite and telecommunication services since 1991. It operates a fleet of four satellites covering Asia, Oceania, and Africa. The company is a subsidiary of Intouch Holdings PCL, Thailand's largest telecommunications conglomerate.

companies.name: Axon Enterprise
companies.description: Axon Enterprise, Inc. is an American company based in Scottsdale, Arizona. It develops weapons and technology products for military, law enforcement, and civilian markets.

companies.name: Moog Inc.
companies.description: Moog Inc. is an American designer and manufacturer of electric, electro-hydraulic, and hydraulic motion controls and systems. Headquartered in Elma, New York, it serves aerospace, defense, industrial, and medical device markets with operations in 26 countries.

companies.name: Morinaga Milk Industry
companies.description: Morinaga Milk Industry Co., Ltd. is a Tokyo-based Japanese company producing milk products, drinks, candy, confectioneries, and infant formula. Founded in 1917, it has subsidiaries and distribution agreements with companies like Mondelez International.

companies.name: Mortgage Guaranty Insurance Corporation
companies.description: MGIC Investment Corporation is a provider of private mortgage insurance in the United States. The company is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.

companies.name: Moss Bros Group
companies.description: Moss Bros Group is a UK-based menswear retailer founded in 1851 and headquartered in London. It specializes in dresswear for formal occasions and operates 113 shops across the United Kingdom.

companies.name: Samvardhana Motherson
companies.description: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd is an Indian multinational automotive components manufacturer based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. Established in 1986 as a joint venture with Japan's Sumitomo Group, it produces wiring harnesses, plastic components, and rearview mirrors for passenger cars.

companies.name: Sollers JSC
companies.description: Sollers PJSC is a Russian holding company controlling shares in Ulyanovsk Automobile Plant, Zavolzhye Engine Factory, and Sollers - Naberezhnye Chelny. It operates well-known automobile brands with stable market positions.

companies.name: Mundial S.A.
companies.description: Mundial is a Brazilian multinational manufacturing company producing beauty care implements and apparel fasteners. It was formed from the merger of Eberle S.A. and Zivi-Hercules, companies founded in 1896 and 1931 respectively.

companies.name: Murray & Roberts
companies.description: Murray & Roberts Holdings Ltd is a major South African engineering and mining corporation. It operates in the resources, industrial, energy, water, and specialized infrastructure sectors. The company was listed on the JSE Limited.

companies.name: MusclePharm
companies.description: MusclePharm Corporation is an American nutritional supplement company founded in 2006 in Denver, Colorado, and headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada. It operates in the consumer goods and retail industry.

companies.name: The Swatch Group
companies.description: The Swatch Group Ltd is a Swiss manufacturer of watches and jewellery. Founded in 1983 through the merger of ASUAG and SSIH, it focused on manufacturing quartz-crystal watches to address the quartz crisis in the Swiss watchmaking industry.

companies.name: Mushkin
companies.description: Mushkin is an American computer hardware company known for producing computer memory modules (RAM). It offers products including solid-state drives, power supply units, and USB flash drives, catering to gamers and industry professionals.

companies.name: Vienna Insurance Group
companies.description: Vienna Insurance Group AG Wiener Versicherung Gruppe (VIG) is an international insurance group headquartered in Vienna, Austria. It is one of the largest insurance groups in Central and Eastern Europe with approximately 25,000 employees.

companies.name: Kyushu Electric Power
companies.description: Kyūshū Electric Power Co., Inc., abbreviated as Kyūden, is a Japanese energy company providing power to seven prefectures and parts of Hiroshima Prefecture. It operates in the electric power industry.

companies.name: NBG Radio Network
companies.description: NBG Radio Network was a syndicated American radio network based in Portland, Oregon. Founded by John A. Holmes, it created, produced, and distributed nationally syndicated radio programs and went public in 1998.

companies.name: NBT Bank
companies.description: NBT Bank, N.A. is an American financial institution headquartered in Norwich, New York. It operates through a network of 176 banking locations across several states in the northeastern United States.

companies.name: NL Industries
companies.description: NL Industries, formerly the National Lead Company, is a lead smelting company based in Dallas, Texas. It was one of the 12 original stocks included in the Dow Jones Industrial Average at its creation in 1896.

companies.name: NMC Health
companies.description: NMC Health was a healthcare chain and distribution business headquartered in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. It operated and managed over 200 facilities in 19 countries as of 2019.

companies.name: nTelos
companies.description: nTelos, Inc. was a wireless telecommunications company and PCS provider based in Waynesboro, Virginia. It served a service area covering 5.3 million people, making it the 9th largest provider of mobile broadband in the United States as of 2013.

companies.name: NVR, Inc.
companies.description: NVR, Inc. is an American home construction company headquartered in Reston, Virginia. It also operates mortgage banking and title services, primarily on the East Coast of the United States, covering 14 states and Washington, D.C.

companies.name: CTF Services Limited
companies.description: CTF Services Limited is a conglomerate with a diversified portfolio of market-leading businesses in Hong Kong and mainland China under Chow Tai Fook Enterprise. Its operations include toll roads, financial services, logistics, construction, and facilities management.

companies.name: NW Natural
companies.description: NW Natural, formerly Northwest Natural Gas Company, is a publicly traded utility headquartered in Portland, Oregon. It primarily distributes natural gas and also owns water utilities, servicing customers in Western Oregon and Southwest Washington.

companies.name: N Brown Group
companies.description: N Brown Group plc is an online retailer headquartered in Manchester, England. It offers clothing, footwear, and homewares, focusing on underserved customer groups. The company was taken private by the Alliance family in February 2025.

companies.name: Nakano Corporation
companies.description: Nakano Corporation is a Japanese multinational general construction contractor. It engages in design, construction, civil engineering, technical assistance, and real estate development projects for corporations, governments, and individuals.

companies.name: Namhae Chemical Corporation
companies.description: Namhae Chemical Corporation is a large South Korean company producing fertilizers and chemicals. Established in 1974, it is headquartered in Yeosu, Jeollanam-do, with a branch office in Jung-gu, Seoul.

companies.name: Nanjing Iron and Steel Company Limited
companies.description: Nanjing Iron and Steel Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded steel maker based in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, China. Its parent company is Nanjing Nangang Iron and Steel United Co., Ltd., a joint venture between Fosun International and Nanjing Iron and Steel Group.

companies.name: Napatech A/S
companies.description: Napatech is a Danish public company that develops and manufactures high speed network accelerators designed for real-time network monitoring and analysis. Its products are used across industries including financial services, telecom, cloud, e-commerce, and defense.

companies.name: Natera
companies.description: Natera, Inc. is a clinical genetic testing company based in Austin, Texas specializing in non-invasive, cell-free DNA testing technology. It operates CAP-accredited laboratories in San Carlos, California and Austin, Texas, focusing on women's health, cancer, and organ health.

companies.name: National Presto Industries
companies.description: National Presto Industries is a company founded in 1905 in Eau Claire, Wisconsin. It originally produced pressure canners and later introduced small home-use cooking appliances. The company was admitted to the New York Stock Exchange on March 3, 1969.

companies.name: National Retail Properties
companies.description: NNN REIT, Inc. is a real estate investment trust organized in Maryland with its principal office in Orlando, Florida. It primarily invests in restaurant properties under long-term triple net leases, often through leaseback arrangements.

companies.name: National Stock Exchange Of Australia Limited
companies.description: National Stock Exchange of Australia (NSX) is a stock exchange based in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia. It is owned and operated by NSX Limited, which is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange since January 13, 2005. The exchange was formerly known as the Newcastle Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Nations Trust Bank
companies.description: Nations Trust Bank is a Sri Lankan bank regulated by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and governed by the Banking Act. It commenced operations in July 1999 after acquiring the Colombo branch of Overseas Trust Bank. The bank has historically focused on corporate banking but aims to become a retail-focused commercial institution.

companies.name: CPC Corporation, Taiwan
companies.description: The CPC Corporation is a state-owned petroleum, natural gas, and gasoline company in Taiwan. It is the core of the Taiwanese petrochemicals industry.

companies.name: Evogene Ltd
companies.description: Evogene is an Israeli computational chemistry company specializing in the generative design of small molecules for pharmaceutical and agricultural industries. Its core technology is ChemPass AI, a proprietary generative AI engine that designs novel small molecules optimized across multiple parameters.

companies.name: Nearmap
companies.description: Nearmap is an aerial technology company headquartered in Australia that provides data and insights using proprietary AI from frequently-updated, high-resolution aerial imagery. Its location intelligence covers large portions of populations in Australia, the US, New Zealand, and Canada. It was publicly traded until taken private by Thoma Bravo in 2022.

companies.name: Yue Yuen Industrial Holdings
companies.description: Yue Yuen Industrial (Holdings) Limited is a Taiwanese footwear manufacturer headquartered in Hong Kong. It is the largest branded athletic and casual footwear manufacturer globally and serves as an OEM and ODM for major international brands like Nike, Adidas, and Puma.

companies.name: Caladrius Biosciences
companies.description: Lisata Therapeutics is an American clinical stage pharmaceutical company focused on oncology. It was formed in September 2022 through a merger of Cend Therapeutics and Caladrius Biosciences.

companies.name: Nepal Bangladesh Bank
companies.description: Nepal Bangladesh Bank Ltd. was a public commercial bank in Nepal established in 1994 as a joint venture with IFIC Bank of Bangladesh. It was acquired by Nabil Bank Ltd. in July 2022 and now operates under the name Nabil Bank Limited.

companies.name: Nepal Bank Limited
companies.description: Nepal Bank Limited is the first commercial bank of Nepal, established in 1937 by Juddha Shumsher. It marked the beginning of formal banking in Nepal and operates within the commercial banking industry.

companies.name: NetManage
companies.description: NetManage Inc. was a software company based in Cupertino, California, founded in 1990 by Zvi Alon. It had a development center in Haifa, Israel, and was acquired by Micro Focus International in 2008.

companies.name: NetScout Systems
companies.description: NETSCOUT Systems, Inc. is an American technology company headquartered in Westford, Massachusetts. Founded in 1984 as Frontier Software, it specializes in software observability, deep packet inspection, DDoS mitigation, and AIOps.

companies.name: Netwitness
companies.description: NetWitness is a network security company based in Riverside, California, providing real-time network forensics, automated threat detection, response, and analysis solutions. It was acquired by EMC Corporation in 2011 and later by Symphony Technology Group in 2020.

companies.name: Endeavor Streaming
companies.description: Endeavor Streaming is a multinational digital video distribution and streaming company. It collaborates with professional sports leagues and entertainment companies to distribute live and on-demand content and offers various business services.

companies.name: Neurocrine Biosciences
companies.description: Neurocrine Biosciences, Inc. is an American biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, founded in 1992. It develops treatments for neurological and endocrine-related diseases and had its drug valbenazine approved in the US in 2017.

companies.name: Neuronetics, Inc.
companies.description: Neuronetics is a publicly traded company based in Malvern, Pennsylvania, incorporated in 2003. It develops non-invasive neuromodulation treatments for psychiatric disorders resistant to traditional medicine.

companies.name: NewAlliance Bank
companies.description: NewAlliance Bancshares, operating as NewAlliance Bank, was the second largest Connecticut-based savings bank. It was formed in 2004 by merging The Savings Bank of Manchester, New Haven Savings Bank, and Tolland Bank.

companies.name: Trend Micro
companies.description: Trend Micro Inc. is an American-Japanese cybersecurity software company with R&D locations worldwide. It develops enterprise security software for servers, containers, cloud environments, networks, and endpoints, supporting major cloud platforms.

companies.name: Vision Values Holdings Limited
companies.description: Vision Values Holdings Limited is a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-listed company. It underwent two backdoor listings and was formerly known as New World Mobile Holdings, Asia Logistics Technologies, and Wah Yik Holdings.

companies.name: Stingray Radio
companies.description: Stingray Radio Inc. is a Canadian radio broadcasting conglomerate owned by Stingray Group. It operates 101 radio stations across Canada, primarily in Atlantic and Western regions, with significant presence in Alberta and Newfoundland. It once owned two now-defunct television stations in Lloydminster.

companies.name: Newfield Exploration
companies.description: Newfield Exploration Company was a petroleum, natural gas, and natural gas liquids exploration and production company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It was organized in Delaware and was acquired by Encana in February 2019.

companies.name: Husky
companies.description: Husky Energy Inc. was a Canadian petroleum company operating from 1938 to 2021. It conducted upstream and downstream operations in Western and Atlantic Canada, the United States, and the Asia Pacific region. It was ranked 1443rd in the 2020 Forbes Global 2000 list.

companies.name: Next Digital
companies.description: Next Digital Limited was a Hong Kong-based media company, previously known as Next Media Limited. It was the largest media company in Hong Kong before ceasing operations in 2021. Its newspaper Apple Daily was the most read in the city, and the company became defunct following legal and political actions.

companies.name: Tang Eng Iron Works
companies.description: Tang Eng Iron Works is a steelmaking company headquartered in Siaogang District, Kaohsiung, Taiwan. It operates in the iron and steel industry.

companies.name: Nib health funds
companies.description: nib Group is an Australian health care fund established in 1952 to provide health insurance for workers at the BHP Newcastle Steelworks. It has grown into a national and international operation with a significant share of the Australian private health cover market.

companies.name: Nichicon
companies.description: Nichicon Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of various types of capacitors and one of the largest capacitor manufacturers worldwide. Headquartered in Kyoto, Japan, it was established in 1950 after separating from Nii Works Co. and adopted the Nichicon name in 1961.

companies.name: Giant Bicycles
companies.description: Giant Manufacturing Co. Ltd. is a Taiwanese bicycle manufacturer recognized as the world's largest bicycle designer and manufacturer. It has manufacturing facilities in Taiwan, the Netherlands, China, and Hungary, with plans to expand to Vietnam.

companies.name: NH Foods
companies.description: NH Foods Ltd. is a food processing conglomerate headquartered in Umeda, Kita-ku, Osaka, Japan. It operates in the food industry.

companies.name: Nissui
companies.description: Nissui Corporation is a marine products company based in Tokyo, Japan. It was formerly known as Nippon Suisan Kaisha Ltd. from 1937 until it changed its name to Nissui in December 2022.

companies.name: Nisshinbo Holdings
companies.description: Nisshinbo Holdings Inc. is a Japanese company with diverse businesses including electronics, automobile brakes, mechatronics, chemicals, textiles, papers, and real estate. It was formerly listed on the Nikkei 225. The company operates in various industrial manufacturing sectors.

companies.name: Noble Corporation
companies.description: Noble Corporation plc is an offshore drilling contractor organized in London, England, with an affiliate organized in the Cayman Islands. It is the corporate successor of Noble Drilling Corporation. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

companies.name: Noodles & Company
companies.description: Noodles & Company is an American fast-casual restaurant chain headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado. Founded in 1995, it offers international and American noodle dishes, soups, and salads. The company went public in 2013 and had 458 locations across 31 states by mid-2022.

companies.name: Norbord
companies.description: Norbord Inc. was a Canadian company that manufactured wood-based panels and was the world's largest producer of oriented strand board (OSB). It also produced particleboard and medium-density fibreboard. Norbord operated 17 plants in the United States, Canada, and Europe.

companies.name: NorthWestern Energy
companies.description: NorthWestern Energy Group, Inc. is a utility company based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, serving South Dakota, Nebraska, and Montana. It has corporate headquarters in Sioux Falls and South Dakota operations headquarters in Huron. The company provides utility services to approximately 718,000 customers.

companies.name: North American Palladium
companies.description: North American Palladium Ltd. was a Canadian mining company operating from 1968 to 2019. It primarily mined palladium and also gold, platinum, silver, nickel, and copper as by-products. The company operated the Lac des Iles mine in Ontario and was acquired by Impala Platinum in 2019.

companies.name: North Drilling
companies.description: North Drilling Company is an Iranian company specializing in drilling oil and gas wells and providing related services globally. It was privatized in June 2009, and as of 2010, a quasi-government investment company owned 20% of its shares on the Tehran Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Northeast Bank
companies.description: Northeast Bank is a full-service financial institution based in Maine, USA. It offers personal and business banking through nine branches and nationwide commercial loan services. The bank also provides online savings products via its ableBanking division.

companies.name: Northland Power
companies.description: Northland Power is a Canadian-owned global power producer founded in 1987. It develops, owns, and operates a diversified mix of energy infrastructure assets including wind, solar, natural gas, and battery storage. The company also supplies energy through a regulated utility.

companies.name: Northwest Biotherapeutics
companies.description: Northwest Biotherapeutics, Inc. is a development-stage American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Maryland. Founded in 1996 by Alton L. Boynton, it focuses on developing immunotherapies against various types of cancer.

companies.name: Northwest Bank
companies.description: Northwest Bank is a bank headquartered in Warren, Pennsylvania. It is the leading subsidiary of Northwest Bancshares, Inc., a bank holding company. The bank operates 151 branches across Pennsylvania, Western New York, Northeast Ohio, Appalachian Ohio, and Indiana.

companies.name: Stanley Black & Decker
companies.description: Stanley Black & Decker, Inc. is an American manufacturer of industrial tools, household hardware, and security products. It is headquartered in New Britain, Connecticut. The company was formed by the merger of The Stanley Works and Black & Decker in 2010.

companies.name: Noveko International
companies.description: Noveko International was a Canadian corporation based in Boucherville, Quebec. It produced antimicrobial air filters, surgical masks, respirators, hand sanitizers, and portable ultrasound machines. The company held a patent for its antimicrobial technology and was involved in a legal dispute with former employees.

companies.name: NuScale
companies.description: NuScale Power Corporation is an American company headquartered in Tigard, Oregon. It markets proposed designs for small modular nuclear reactors (SMRs). The company is publicly traded.

companies.name: NuVasive
companies.description: NuVasive, Inc. is a medical devices company based in San Diego, California. Founded in 1997, it develops medical devices and procedures for minimally invasive spine surgery.

companies.name: Evergreen Marine
companies.description: Evergreen Marine Corporation is a Taiwanese container transportation and shipping company headquartered in Luzhu District, Taoyuan City, Taiwan. It operates over 150 container ships and is part of the Evergreen Group conglomerate.

companies.name: Nutrisystem
companies.description: Nutrisystem is a commercial provider of weight loss products and services headquartered in Fort Washington, Pennsylvania.

companies.name: NxStage
companies.description: NxStage Medical, Inc. is an American company that develops, manufactures, and markets systems for treating chronic kidney disease, acute kidney injury, and hypervolemia. It is a subsidiary of Fresenius Medical Care. Its primary product is System One, a portable hemodialysis system.

companies.name: O'Reilly Auto Parts
companies.description: O'Reilly Automotive, Inc., known as O'Reilly Auto Parts, is an American automotive parts retailer. Founded in 1957, it provides parts, tools, supplies, equipment, and accessories to professionals and do-it-yourself customers. The company operates more than 6,400 stores in the US, Puerto Rico, Mexico, and Canada.

companies.name: ODEL
companies.description: Odel is a public retail company in Sri Lanka and was the first department store in the country. It began as a single company focused on the retail garment trade and expanded over the years.

companies.name: OMNOVA Solutions
companies.description: OMNOVA Solutions, Inc. is a global manufacturer of laminates, performance films, and coated fabrics. Founded in 1999 after a spinoff from GenCorp, it is headquartered in Beachwood, Ohio. The company operates sales, manufacturing, and distribution locations across Europe and Asia.

companies.name: OSI Systems
companies.description: OSI Systems, Inc. is a California-based American company that develops and markets security and inspection systems, including airport X-ray machines and metal detectors, as well as medical monitoring and anesthesia systems. It includes subsidiaries such as Spacelabs Healthcare and Rapiscan Systems.

companies.name: OSK Holdings Berhad
companies.description: OSK Holdings Berhad is a publicly listed Malaysian company primarily focused on property development and manufacturing. It is majority-owned by individuals, with Executive Chairman Ong Leong Huat holding the largest share. The company has diversified from its original stockbroking and investment banking activities.

companies.name: Cinemark
companies.description: Cinemark Holdings, Inc. is an American movie theater chain headquartered in Plano, Texas. Founded in 1977, it operates hundreds of theaters across the Americas and is the largest movie theater chain in Brazil with a 30% market share.

companies.name: Ocado
companies.description: Ocado Group plc is a British company based in Hatfield, England, that licenses grocery technology. It owns a 50% share in the UK grocery retail business Ocado Retail Ltd and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Ocean Power Technologies
companies.description: Ocean Power Technologies is a U.S. publicly owned renewable energy company specializing in electric power and communications solutions for remote offshore applications. Its PowerBuoy wave energy technology is scalable and can supply energy to the grid via submarine cables, though economic viability has been challenging.

companies.name: Sculptor Capital Management
companies.description: Sculptor Capital Management is a global alternative asset management firm headquartered in New York City. It operates multiple investment strategies including multi-strategy, credit, and real estate, with offices in New York, London, and Hong Kong.

companies.name: Ohara Corporation
companies.description: Ohara Inc. is a Japanese global glass manufacturing company headquartered in Sagamihara. Founded in 1935, it has subsidiaries in several countries including the U.S., Germany, and China, with Ohara Corporation serving as its U.S. subsidiary.

companies.name: Oil India
companies.description: Oil India Limited is an Indian public sector company engaged in exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas. Headquartered in Duliajan, Assam, it operates under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas with offices in multiple Indian cities.

companies.name: Old National Bank
companies.description: Old National Bank is an American regional bank operated by Old National Bancorp, headquartered in Chicago and Evansville, Indiana. It has nearly 200 retail branches across several states and is one of the top 30 banking companies in the U.S.

companies.name: Old Republic International
companies.description: Old Republic International Corporation is an American company specializing in property and title insurance. It is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. The company operates within the insurance industry in the United States.

companies.name: Olin Corporation
companies.description: Olin Corporation is an American manufacturer producing ammunition, chlorine, and sodium hydroxide. It originated from two companies founded in 1892: Franklin W. Olin's Equitable Powder Company and the Mathieson Alkali Works. The company operates in the chemical manufacturing sector in the United States.

companies.name: Ryohin Keikaku
companies.description: Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd., known as Muji, is a Japanese retailer selling a wide variety of household and consumer goods. It is based in Japan and operates in the retail industry. The company is recognized for its diverse product offerings.

companies.name: Ollie's Bargain Outlet
companies.description: Ollie's Bargain Outlet is an American discount store chain founded in Mechanicsburg, Pennsylvania, in 1982. It sells a variety of discounted items, mostly overstock or closeout merchandise purchased in bulk from other retailers. The chain features caricatures of its namesake, Oliver "Ollie" Rosenberg, in its advertising.

companies.name: Olympic Steel
companies.description: Olympic Steel, Inc. is a metals service center based in Cleveland, Ohio. It processes and distributes various metals including carbon, coated and stainless steel, aluminum alloy, and tin plate primarily in the United States. The company serves the iron and steel industry.

companies.name: Omega Protein
companies.description: Omega Protein Corporation was a US company founded in 1913 as a fishing operation. It produced food ingredients, dietary supplements, and animal feed, including fish oil and fish meal. In 2017, it was acquired by Cooke Inc.

companies.name: Omnicare
companies.description: Omnicare, Inc. is an American healthcare company specializing in pharmacy services for nursing homes. It was established in 1981 as a spinoff from Chemed and W. R. Grace and Company. In 2015, Omnicare was acquired by CVS Health.

companies.name: Tatung Company
companies.description: Tatung Company is a Taiwanese multinational corporation established in 1918. It is headquartered in Zhongshan, Taipei, Taiwan. The company operates in the computer hardware industry.

companies.name: Onvia
companies.description: Onvia, Inc. is an American government business intelligence company offering software products such as government leads and relationship management tools. It provides databases of government contracts and notifications of business opportunities. The company operates in the business intelligence sector in the United States.

companies.name: Onyx Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Onyx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was a pharmaceutical company headquartered in South San Francisco, California, focused on developing and marketing cancer treatment medications. Founded in 1992, it was acquired by Amgen in 2013. The company also acquired Proteolix in 2009 to expand its biotechnology portfolio.

companies.name: Ooma
companies.description: Ooma, Inc. is an American telecommunications company based in Silicon Valley, California. It provides communications services including voice over IP (VoIP) calling for business, home, and mobile users. The company is publicly traded.

companies.name: Cheung Kong Holdings
companies.description: Cheung Kong (Holdings) Limited was a multinational conglomerate based in Hong Kong. It merged with its subsidiary Hutchison Whampoa on June 3, 2015, to become part of CK Hutchison Holdings. It was one of Hong Kong's leading multinational conglomerates.

companies.name: Ophir Energy
companies.description: Ophir Energy plc was an oil and gas exploration and production company based in London, United Kingdom. It owned operating and non-operating assets in Africa, Asia, and Mexico. The company focused on petroleum industry activities.

companies.name: Oppenheimer Holdings
companies.description: Oppenheimer Holdings Inc. is an American multinational independent investment bank and financial services company headquartered in New York City. It offers investment banking, financial advisory, capital markets, asset management, and wealth management services worldwide.

companies.name: Optical Cable Corporation
companies.description: Optical Cable Corporation is headquartered in Roanoke, Virginia, and manufactures fiber optical cable. Its products are used largely for telecommunications and sold in the US and over seventy other countries. It also produces military land tactical fiber optic cable for the U.S. military.

companies.name: Orient Overseas (International) Limited
companies.description: Orient Overseas (International) Limited (OOIL) is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company involved in international transportation, logistics, property investment, and development. It is the parent company of Orient Overseas Container Line (OOCL), a major container shipping company.

companies.name: OFG Bancorp
companies.description: OFG Bancorp is the financial holding company for Oriental Bank, headquartered in San Juan, Puerto Rico. Founded in 1964, it offers retail and commercial banking, lending, and wealth management primarily in Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands through its subsidiaries.

companies.name: Osiris Therapeutics
companies.description: Osiris Therapeutics, Inc. was an American company founded in 1993 following the identification of mesenchymal stem cells. It was launched with contributions from Dr. Arnold Caplan and investors, and relocated to Maryland in 1995 with state support. The company focused on biotechnology related to stem cells.

companies.name: Otter Tail Corporation
companies.description: Otter Tail Corporation is an electric power and manufacturing company based in Fergus Falls, Minnesota. Its subsidiaries include Otter Tail Power Company and several manufacturing firms. The company operates in the renewables and utilities sector.

companies.name: Owens Corning
companies.description: Owens Corning is an American company that develops and produces insulation, roofing, and fiberglass composites. Founded in 1935 as a partnership between Corning Glass Works and Owens-Illinois, it is the world's largest manufacturer of fiberglass composites. The company is known for its Pink Panther mascot featured in advertisements.

companies.name: Oxford Industries
companies.description: Oxford Industries, Inc. is a publicly traded American clothing company specializing in high-end apparel. It carries major labels such as Tommy Bahama, Lilly Pulitzer, Johnny Was, and Southern Tide. The company operates in the United States.

companies.name: Oxford Instruments
companies.description: Oxford Instruments plc is a UK-based manufacturing and research company that designs and produces tools and systems for industry and research. Headquartered in High Wycombe, England, it has sites across the UK, US, Europe, and Asia. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: PC Connection
companies.description: PC Connection, Inc., doing business as Connection, is headquartered in Merrimack, New Hampshire. The company employs over 2,600 people and sells more than 460,000 products. It operates in the technology sector.

companies.name: PDF Solutions
companies.description: PDF Solutions, Inc. is an American multinational software and engineering services company based in Santa Clara, California. It is publicly traded on the Nasdaq stock exchange under the ticker PDFS.

companies.name: PFSweb
companies.description: PFSweb, Inc. is an eCommerce fulfillment and logistics third-party service provider for business-to-business and direct-to-consumer companies. Its headquarters moved from Allen, Texas to Irving, Texas in 2022. The company operates distribution centers in the US, UK, Belgium, and Canada.

companies.name: Nankang Rubber Tire
companies.description: Nankang Rubber Tire Corp, Ltd is a Taiwanese manufacturer of automobile tires and synthetic rubber products. Its products include tires for cars, light trucks, SUVs, and snowfield vehicles. In 2006, it generated most of its revenue from automobile tires, with significant sales in the Americas and Europe.

companies.name: TXNM Energy
companies.description: TXNM Energy, Inc. is an energy holding company based in Albuquerque, New Mexico. Founded in 1917 as Albuquerque Gas and Electric Company, it owns PNM and Texas-New Mexico Power. In 2025, Blackstone Inc.'s infrastructure business agreed to acquire the company.

companies.name: PS Business Parks
companies.description: PS Business Parks, Inc. was a publicly traded real estate investment trust that owned and operated commercial properties, mainly multi-tenant industrial, flex, and office spaces. Its portfolio included 97 properties across several US states and 800 residential units in Virginia. In 2022, its holdings were transferred to Link Logistics Real Estate, affiliated with Blackstone Real Estate.

companies.name: EyePoint Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: EyePoint Pharmaceuticals Inc. is a company based in Watertown, Massachusetts, specializing in applying microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) and nanotechnology to drug delivery. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry.

companies.name: PTC Therapeutics
companies.description: PTC Therapeutics, Inc. is a U.S.-based pharmaceutical company that develops orally administered small molecule drugs and gene therapies targeting orphan diseases through post-transcriptional control mechanisms. The company focuses on altering gene expression to treat these conditions.

companies.name: PV Crystalox Solar
companies.description: PV Crystalox Solar plc is a United Kingdom-based supplier of multicrystalline silicon wafers used in solar electricity generation systems. It operates in Germany, the UK, and Japan, with its headquarters in the UK, and is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: PacSun
companies.description: Pacific Sunwear of California, LLC, known as PacSun, is an American retail clothing brand headquartered in Anaheim, California. It sells lifestyle apparel and accessories for teens and young adults and operates stores across the United States and Puerto Rico. The company went bankrupt in 2016 and is now owned by Golden Gate Capital.

companies.name: Frontera Energy
companies.description: Frontera Energy is a Canadian petroleum exploration and production company focused on heavy crude oil and natural gas in Colombia and Peru. It was formerly known as Pacific Rubiales and Pacific Exploration and Production before renaming itself in 2017 and relisting on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Pactera
companies.description: Pactera Technology International Ltd. is an IT consulting and outsourcing company headquartered in Beijing, China, with regional offices in North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. It serves sectors including technology, telecom, finance, insurance, energy, travel, manufacturing, retail, and logistics.

companies.name: PagBank
companies.description: PagBank is a financial services and digital payments company based in São Paulo, Brazil, incorporated in the Cayman Islands. Founded in 2006, it offers payment processing software for e-commerce, mobile apps, and point of sale terminals.

companies.name: Pakistan Tobacco Company
companies.description: Pakistan Tobacco Company Limited is a tobacco manufacturer based in Islamabad, Pakistan. It is a subsidiary of British American Tobacco and operates two factories in Akora Khattak and Jhelum, being the largest cigarette manufacturer in Pakistan.

companies.name: Banco Pan
companies.description: Banco Pan is a midsize commercial bank headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil. It focuses on consumer loans for lower to medium income individuals and offers credit cards, insurance, leasing, and group financial services.

companies.name: Panacea Biotec
companies.description: Panacea Biotec is an Indian pharmaceutical company with offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, and Lalru. It engages in research, development, manufacturing, and marketing of pharmaceutical formulations, vaccines, biosimilars, and natural products.

companies.name: Panera Bread
companies.description: Panera Bread Company is an American multinational bakery-cafe fast casual restaurant chain headquartered in Fenton, Missouri. It operates over 2,000 locations in the United States and Canada and is known as Saint Louis Bread Company in the Greater St. Louis area.

companies.name: Panin Sekuritas
companies.description: PT. Panin Sekuritas Tbk is a financial services company specializing in stock brokerage based in Jakarta, Indonesia. It is part of Panin Group and manages securities and mutual funds. The company was awarded Best Securities Company in 2006 and 2007 by Investor magazine.

companies.name: Panmure Gordon & Co.
companies.description: Panmure Gordon was a UK-based investment bank offering services including investment banking, trading, research, and sales across the UK, Europe, and the US. On July 1, 2024, it merged with Liberum Capital to form Panmure Liberum.

companies.name: Panorama9
