companies.description: Panorama9 is a cloud-based service focused on network management. It operates within the information technology management industry in the United States.

companies.name: Pangang Group Vanadium Titanium & Resources
companies.description: Pangang Group Vanadium Titanium & Resources Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company involved in manufacturing and selling iron, steel, and vanadium products. It is headquartered in Panzhihua, Sichuan, and is parented by Panzhihua Iron and Steel.

companies.name: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group
companies.description: The Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Limited (ANZ Bank) is a multinational banking and financial services company headquartered in Melbourne, Australia. It is one of the largest banks in Australia by assets and market capitalization.

companies.name: EVA Air
companies.description: EVA Airways Corporation is an international airline headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan. It operates passenger and cargo services to over 40 international destinations and is one of Taiwan's three largest airlines. Its hub is Taoyuan International Airport.

companies.name: Paylocity Corporation
companies.description: Paylocity Holding Corporation is an American company providing cloud-based payroll, spend management, and human capital management software. It operates in the United States.

companies.name: Peachtree Financial Solutions
companies.description: Peachtree Financial Solutions is a company based in Radnor, Pennsylvania, that provides cash to individuals with illiquid assets such as structured settlements, annuities, lottery winnings, and active lawsuits.

companies.name: Pegasystems
companies.description: Pegasystems Inc. is a global AI software company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, USA. It offers a low-code platform for workflow automation, business process management, and AI-powered decision-making. The company has been publicly traded since 1996.

companies.name: Pelwatte Sugar Industries PLC
companies.description: Pelwatte Sugar Industries PLC is a Sri Lankan sugar manufacturing company listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange. Its main factory is located in Buttala, Uva Province. The company was incorporated in 1981 and became a public limited company in 1982.

companies.name: Pengrowth Energy
companies.description: Pengrowth Energy Corporation was a Canadian oil and natural gas company based in Calgary, Alberta. Established in 1988, it was one of the largest Canadian royalty trusts with assets evenly split between oil and natural gas. The company was founded by entrepreneur James S Kinnear.

companies.name: Pennsylvania Real Estate Investment Trust
companies.description: PREIT Realty is a privately held company that owns and develops shopping centers, primarily in the Mid-Atlantic states of the United States. It operates in the real estate investment trust industry.

companies.name: Toyota Tsusho
companies.description: Toyota Tsusho Corporation is a sōgō shōsha and member of the Toyota Group based in Nagoya and Tokyo, Japan. It supports Toyota's automobile business and operates globally with over 150 offices and 900 subsidiaries. Its business spans industrial raw materials, agricultural products, and high technology.

companies.name: Pentair
companies.description: Pentair plc is an American water treatment company incorporated in Ireland with tax residency in the UK. Founded in the US, it has its main US office in Golden Valley, Minnesota. The company reorganized in 2014, shifting its corporate domicile from Switzerland to Ireland.

companies.name: People's United Financial
companies.description: People's United Financial, Inc. was an American bank holding company owning People's United Bank. It operated 403 branches across several northeastern US states and was the second-largest full-service bank in New England and 46th-largest in the US.

companies.name: Perficient
companies.industry: business and other management consultancy activities
companies.description: Perficient, Inc. is a global digital consultancy based in St. Louis, Missouri, USA. It offers services including enterprise mobile applications, creative services, marketing, digital strategy, Internet of Things, IT, management consulting, custom development, and platform implementations.

companies.name: Perpetual Limited
companies.description: Perpetual is an Australian investment fund and trustee group listed in the S&P/ASX 200. It provides investment products, financial advice, philanthropic, and corporate services to individuals, families, financial advisers, and organizations.

companies.name: Perry Ellis International
companies.description: Perry Ellis International is an American company headquartered in Doral, Florida, specializing in clothing, fashion, cosmetics, and beauty. It manages a portfolio of brands distributed worldwide, focusing mainly on sportswear and casual clothing for niche markets.

companies.name: Sumitomo Corporation
companies.description: Sumitomo Corporation is a large Japanese sōgō shōsha general trading company and diversified corporation. Incorporated in 1919, it is a member of the Sumitomo Group.

companies.name: Pet, Inc.
companies.description: Pet, Inc. was an American company known for being the first to commercially produce evaporated milk as a shelf-stable consumer product under the "PET Milk" brand. While popular before widespread refrigeration, evaporated milk sales peaked in the 1950s and now serve niche uses in baking and cooking.

companies.name: PetMed Express
companies.description: PetMed Express, Inc., also known as PetMeds, is an online pet pharmacy based in the United States. It sells prescription and non-prescription pet medication and is publicly traded. The company operates in the veterinary medicine industry.

companies.name: Petro Rabigh
companies.description: Rabigh Refining & Petrochemical Company is a Saudi Arabian petrochemical company founded in 2005 as a joint venture between Saudi Aramco and Sumitomo Chemical. It produces and markets refined hydrocarbons and petrochemicals and is the only producer of propylene oxide in the Middle East.

companies.name: Petronet LNG
companies.description: Petronet LNG Limited is an Indian oil and gas company formed by the Government of India to import liquefied natural gas and establish LNG terminals. It has set up LNG receiving and regasification terminals in Dahej, Gujarat, and Kochi, Kerala, and is promoted by major Indian energy companies.

companies.name: Pets at Home
companies.description: Pets at Home Group PLC is a British retailer selling pets, pet food, toys, bedding, and medication. It operates in the retail industry and is based in the United Kingdom.

companies.name: Pharmaceutical Product Development
companies.description: Pharmaceutical Product Development (PPD) is a global contract research organization providing integrated drug development, laboratory, and lifecycle management services. It became a wholly owned subsidiary of Thermo Fisher Scientific in December 2021. The company is based in the United States.

companies.name: Banque Saudi Fransi
companies.description: Banque Saudi Fransi is a Saudi Arabian bank established by Royal Decree No. M/23 in June 1977. It operates in the financial services sector and is based in Saudi Arabia.

companies.name: Philtrust Bank
companies.description: The Philippine Trust Company, known as Philtrust Bank, is one of the oldest private universal banks in the Philippines. Founded in 1916, it is the third bank established in the country and was owned by Chinese-Filipino businessman Emilio Yap.

companies.name: Phoenix Group
companies.description: Standard Life plc, formerly Phoenix Group Holdings plc, is a provider of insurance services based in London, England. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Photocure
companies.description: Photocure ASA is a Norwegian specialty pharmaceutical company that develops and sells pharmaceuticals and medical devices based on proprietary photodynamic technology. It focuses on bladder cancer diagnostics and cancer portfolio development.

companies.name: Phreesia Inc.
companies.description: Phreesia, Inc. is a software as a service company based in the United States that provides healthcare organizations with applications to automate and manage patient intake. It focuses on improving healthcare administration through technology.

companies.name: Amuse
companies.description: Amuse Inc. is a Japanese entertainment company that provides artist management services. Its roster includes idols, musicians, and other entertainers.

companies.name: Pinnacle Financial Partners
companies.description: Pinnacle Financial Partners, Inc. is an American bank headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee. It operates in Tennessee and several other states including Kentucky, Maryland, and Florida.

companies.name: Pixela Corporation
companies.description: Pixela Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of PC peripheral hardware and multimedia software headquartered in Osaka. It is known for its ImageMixer software series and manufacturing 1seg Tuners in Japan.

companies.name: Plains Exploration & Production
companies.description: Plains Exploration & Production was a petroleum and natural gas exploration company based in Houston, Texas. It was acquired by Freeport-McMoRan in May 2013.

companies.name: Planet Fitness
companies.description: Planet Fitness, Inc. is an American franchisor and operator of fitness centers based in Hampton, New Hampshire. It operates thousands of clubs internationally and targets casual and first-time gym users.

companies.name: Asahi Breweries
companies.description: Asahi Group Holdings, Ltd. is a Japanese beverage holding company headquartered in Tokyo. It is the largest beer brewer in Japan and holds significant market shares in Australia and several European countries.

companies.name: AGC

companies.name: Plug Power
companies.description: Plug Power Inc. is an American company that develops hydrogen fuel cell and electrolyzer systems to replace conventional batteries in electric equipment and vehicles. It is headquartered in Slingerlands, New York, with additional facilities in Spokane, Washington, and Rochester, New York.

companies.name: Pluri Inc.

companies.name: Pars Oil Company
companies.description: Pars Oil Company is an Iranian oil refining company headquartered in Tehran. It operates within the petroleum industry in Iran.

companies.name: Azrieli Group Ltd
companies.description: Azrieli Group is an Israeli real estate and holding company named after its founder David Azrieli. The company primarily develops and manages shopping malls and office buildings in Israel.

companies.name: SJM HOLDINGS LTD.
companies.description: Sociedade de Jogos de Macau, known as SJM Holdings Limited, is a Macau-based company that owns, operates, and develops casinos and integrated entertainment resorts in Macau. It is majority-owned by Sociedade de Turismo e Diversões de Macau (STDM) and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Avient Corporation
companies.description: Avient Corporation is a global materials solutions company headquartered in Avon Lake, Ohio, United States. It produces colorants, advanced composites, functional additives, and engineered materials.

companies.name: Polymet Mining Corporation
companies.description: PolyMet Mining Corporation was an American mineral exploration and mine development company based in Minnesota, with corporate headquarters in Toronto, Canada. It controlled rights to the NorthMet Deposit in the Mesabi Range.

companies.name: Føroya Banki
companies.description: Føroya Banki is a financial services company based in the Faroe Islands providing banking and insurance services. It also operates in Greenland as Bankivik and holds about 40% market share in the Faroe Islands.

companies.name: Poplar
companies.description: Poplar is a convenience store franchise chain operating in Japan.

companies.name: Popular, Inc.
companies.description: Popular, Inc., also known as Banco Popular de Puerto Rico, is a full-service financial services conglomerate headquartered in San Juan, Puerto Rico. Founded in 1893, it is the largest banking institution in Puerto Rico and has expanded into the Caribbean and Latin America.

companies.name: Port of Bar
companies.description: The Port of Bar is Montenegro's main sea port located in the city of Bar. It serves as a key maritime gateway for the country.

companies.name: Portland General Electric
companies.description: Portland General Electric is a publicly traded energy company based in Portland, Oregon. It generates, transmits, and distributes electricity, serving a large portion of Oregon's commercial and industrial sectors.

companies.name: Porto Seguro S.A.
companies.description: Porto Seguro is the third largest insurance company in Brazil, founded in 1945. It operates through subsidiaries in Brazil and Uruguay and is headquartered in São Paulo.

companies.name: Post Bank of Iran
companies.description: Post Bank of Iran is a banking institution based in Iran. It provides financial services within the country.

companies.name: Post Properties
companies.description: Post Properties, Inc. was a publicly traded real estate investment trust headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It invested in apartments and was acquired by Mid-America Apartment Communities in 2016.

companies.name: Potlatch Corp.
companies.description: PotlatchDeltic Corporation is an American diversified forest products company based in Spokane, Washington. It operates in the forest products industry.

companies.name: Powell Industries
companies.description: Powell Industries, Inc. is a Houston, Texas-based manufacturer of integrated solutions and electrical equipment. It focuses on monitoring and controlling electrical power distribution in commercial and industrial markets.

companies.name: Power Financial
companies.description: Power Financial Corporation is a Canadian multinational management and holding company founded in 1984. It has interests in financial services and asset management businesses across Canada, the US, and Europe.

companies.name: Preferred Bank
companies.description: Preferred Bank is a California state-chartered bank founded in 1991 to serve the Chinese American community in Southern California. It expanded through acquisition in 2015 after regulatory concerns in 2010.

companies.name: Premier Foods
companies.description: Premier Foods plc is a British food manufacturer headquartered in St Albans, Hertfordshire. It owns many well-known brands and produces cakes under the Cadbury's name under license.

companies.name: Premier Oil
companies.description: Premier Oil plc was an independent UK oil company with gas and oil interests in the United Kingdom, Asia, Africa, and Mexico. It focused on the upstream sector of the petroleum industry, involving the exploitation of oil and gas. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition and merger into Harbour Energy in March 2021.

companies.name: Premium Brands Holdings Corporation
companies.description: Premium Brands Holdings Corporation is a Canadian specialty food manufacturing and distribution company. It is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange. The company operates within the food manufacturing industry in Canada.

companies.name: Prestige Brands
companies.description: Prestige Consumer Healthcare Inc. is an American company marketing and distributing over-the-counter healthcare and household cleaning products. It was formed in 1996 by the merger of three companies and is headquartered in Tarrytown, New York, with a manufacturing facility in Lynchburg, Virginia.

companies.name: Phoenix Television
companies.description: Phoenix Television is a majority state-owned television network operating Mandarin and Cantonese-language channels serving mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and other Chinese-speaking regions. It is headquartered in Shenzhen and Hong Kong and registered in the Cayman Islands.

companies.name: priceline.com
companies.description: Priceline.com is an online travel agency headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut, United States. Founded in 1997, it offers discount rates for travel-related purchases and is wholly owned by Booking Holdings. The company operates globally with partnerships with over 400 airlines and 300,000 hotels.

companies.name: Primerica
companies.description: Primerica, Inc. is a multi-level marketing company providing insurance, investment, and financial services to middle-income families in the United States and Canada. It operates within the financial services industry.

companies.name: Innovate Corp.
companies.description: Innovate Corp. is an American public financial services company founded in 1994. It operates within the financial services sector in the United States.

companies.name: Procera Networks
companies.description: Procera Networks is a networking equipment company based in Fremont, California, United States. It designs and sells Network Intelligence solutions based on deep packet inspection technology to telecom operators, governments, enterprises, and network equipment vendors.

companies.name: Waste Connections of Canada
companies.description: Waste Connections of Canada Inc., formerly Progressive Waste Solutions, is a waste collection company providing non-hazardous solid waste collection, recycling, composting, renewable energy, and landfill disposal services. It is based in Toronto, Canada, with U.S. headquarters in The Woodlands, Texas.

companies.name: Prosperity Bancshares
companies.description: Prosperity Bancshares, Inc. is a bank holding company headquartered in Houston, Texas, with operations in Texas and central Oklahoma. It operates 285 branches across various regions including Houston, Dallas–Fort Worth, and Oklahoma.

companies.name: LifeVantage
companies.description: LifeVantage Corporation is a Utah-based multi-level marketing company that sells Protandim, a patented herbal dietary supplement. The product is marketed with unsupported claims about treating medical conditions. In 2017, the company received a warning letter from the FDA regarding illegal advertising claims on its websites.

companies.name: Protective Life
companies.description: Protective Life Corporation is a financial services holding company based in Birmingham, Alabama. Its primary subsidiary, Protective Life Insurance Company, was established in 1907 and operates in all 50 states. The corporation owns several subsidiaries including West Coast Life Insurance Company and MONY Life Insurance Company.

companies.name: Provida
companies.description: AFP Provida, or Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Provida, is the leading pension fund manager of the Chilean Pension Fund. It operates in Chile and manages pension funds for the country.

companies.name: Provident Bank of New Jersey
companies.logo_file: Provident Bank of New Jersey logo.svg
companies.description: Provident Financial Services, Inc. is the holding company for Provident Bank, established in 1839. The bank provides financial services to businesses and individuals in New Jersey, New York, and eastern Pennsylvania, offering deposit, loan, investment, trust, fiduciary, and wealth management products.

companies.name: Ashland Inc.
companies.description: Ashland, Inc. is an American chemical company headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware. Founded in 1924 as an oil refinery in Ashland, Kentucky, it moved to Wilmington in 1994. The company has five divisions including Chemical Intermediates and Solvents, and was the primary manufacturer of Valvoline until 2017.

companies.name: PulteGroup
companies.description: PulteGroup, Inc. is an American residential home-construction company based in Atlanta, Georgia. It is the third-largest home-construction company in the United States by number of homes closed and has built over 775,000 homes as of 2023.

companies.name: Rebl Group
companies.description: Rebl Group Plc is a Finnish media group headquartered in Joensuu. Its shares are listed on the Helsinki Stock Exchange. In January 2024, the Keskisuomalainen Group announced plans to buy PunaMusta Media’s newspapers and radio station, after which Rebl Group will focus on graphic and digital marketing communication services.

companies.name: QCR Holdings
companies.description: QCR Holdings, Inc. is a financial services company headquartered in Moline, Illinois. Founded in 1993, it provides commercial and consumer banking, trust, and asset management services to the Quad City and Cedar Rapids communities.

companies.name: Glatfelter
companies.description: Glatfelter was a global manufacturer of engineered solutions. It merged with Berry Global’s Health, Hygiene and Specialties Global Nonwovens and Films business to form Magnera Corporation, now the largest nonwovens company worldwide, providing specialty materials industry solutions.

companies.name: Qihoo 360
companies.description: Qihoo 360, also known as 360 Security Technology Inc., is a Chinese internet security company based in Chaoyang, Beijing. It develops antivirus software like 360 Safeguard and 360 Mobile Safe, as well as the 360 Secure Browser and 360 Mobile Assistant app store. The company was founded in June 2005 by Zhou Hongyi and Qi Xiangdong.

companies.name: Quad
companies.description: Quad is an American marketing services company headquartered in Sussex, Wisconsin. It offers print and marketing services supporting physical and digital media, including audience targeting, media planning, creative production, retail display, postal optimization, and consumer analytics. In 2025, it was one of the largest agency companies and commercial printers in North America.

companies.name: Qualys
companies.description: Qualys, Inc. is a technology firm based in Foster City, California, specializing in cloud security, compliance, and related services. The company focuses on providing security solutions in the cloud computing space.

companies.name: Qualtrics
companies.description: Qualtrics, LLC is an American experience management company with co-headquarters in Seattle, Washington, and Provo, Utah. It was founded in 2002 by Scott M. Smith, Ryan Smith, Jared Smith, and Stuart Orgill.

companies.name: Quanta Services
companies.description: Quanta Services is a U.S. corporation providing infrastructure services for electric power, pipeline, industrial, and communications industries. It has acquired over 200 companies and has been involved in data center construction related to artificial intelligence power needs in the 2020s.

companies.name: Quarto Group
companies.description: The Quarto Group is a global illustrated book publishing group founded in 1976. Although it operates globally, it is domiciled in the United States.

companies.name: Quest Diagnostics

companies.name: Questar Corporation
companies.description: Questar Corporation was a natural gas public utility based in Salt Lake City, Utah. In June 2024, it was acquired by Enbridge for $4.3 billion.

companies.name: QuinStreet
companies.description: QuinStreet, Inc. is a publicly traded online marketing company based in Foster City, California. It generates web traffic for clients through consumer websites in media, home, and financial services sectors.

companies.name: Qwest Corporation
companies.description: Qwest Corporation, doing business as CenturyLink QC, is a Regional Bell Operating Company owned by CenturyLink. It was formerly known as Mountain States Telephone and Telegraph Company and includes operations from Malheur Bell, Northwestern Bell, and Pacific Northwest Bell.

companies.name: R&F Properties
companies.description: R&F Properties is a Chinese property developer based in Zhujiang New Town, Guangzhou, Guangdong. Established in 1994, it is one of the largest real estate companies in Guangzhou. The company integrates real estate design, development, engineering supervision, sales, property management, and real estate intermediary services.

companies.name: Rada Electronic Industries Ltd
companies.description: RADA Electronic Industries Ltd. is an Israeli global defense technology company specializing in proprietary radar and legacy avionics systems. Founded in 1970, it develops, manufactures, and sells products primarily for the defense and aerospace markets. It has U.S.-based subsidiaries and has been traded on the NASDAQ Capital Market since 1985.

companies.name: RLI Corp.
companies.description: RLI Corp. is an American insurance company headquartered in Peoria, Illinois. It specializes in property and casualty insurance. The company operates within the insurance industry in the United States.

companies.name: Coach
companies.description: Coach New York, commonly known as Coach, is an American fashion house headquartered in New York City. It specializes in handbags, luggage, accessories, and ready-to-wear clothing. The company licenses its name for eyewear and fragrances and has had Stuart Vevers as executive creative director since June 2013.

companies.name: RMG Networks
companies.description: Korbyt, formerly known as RMG Networks, is an American workplace software and digital signage company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It provides a platform for content management, performance dashboards, and data visualization for desktops and mobile devices. The company traces its origins to Symon Communications from the early 1980s.

companies.name: RPS Group
companies.description: RPS Group Limited is a global professional services firm of consultants and service providers headquartered in Abingdon-on-Thames, England. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Tetra Tech in January 2023. The company operates in environmental consulting and related services.

companies.name: RPX Corporation
companies.description: RPX Corporation is an American company based in San Francisco that provides international risk management services for patents. Founded in 2008, it acquires patents that pose potential problems and provides litigation information to reduce patent assertions against its clients.

companies.name: Radcom Ltd
companies.description: RADCOM Ltd. is an Israeli provider of quality monitoring and service assurance software for telecommunications carriers. Founded in 1991, it has its U.S. headquarters in Paramus, New Jersey, and international headquarters in Tel Aviv, Israel. RADCOM is part of the RAD Group and is traded on the Nasdaq exchange.

companies.name: RadiSys
companies.description: Radisys Corporation is an American technology company based in Beaverton, Oregon. Founded in 1987 by former Intel employees, it produces technology used by telecommunications companies in mobile networks. The company went public in 1995.

companies.name: Radian Group

companies.name: Ramco Systems
companies.description: Ramco Systems Limited is an Indian multinational enterprise software product and platform provider. Founded in 1997, it is part of the Ramco Group and headquartered in Chennai, India. The company operates in the enterprise software sector.

companies.name: Ranhill Holdings Berhad
companies.description: Ranhill Utilities Berhad is a Malaysian conglomerate with interests in the environment and power sectors. companies.name: Rathbone Brothers
companies.description: Rathbones Group Plc is a UK provider of personalized investment management and wealth management services for private investors and trustees. Services include discretionary investment management, unit trusts, tax planning, and pension advice. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Ratos
companies.description: Ratos AB is a Swedish listed investment company founded in 1934, headquartered in Stockholm. It owns majority and minority holdings in Nordic companies and is listed on the Stockholm Stock Exchange. The company operates as a long-term investment company.

companies.name: Raven Industries
companies.description: Raven Industries, Inc. is an American company based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, that makes precision agriculture products and information management tools for growers. companies.name: Belo
companies.description: Belo Corporation was a Dallas, Texas-based media company owning 20 commercial broadcasting television stations and three regional 24-hour cable news channels. companies.name: Raymond James Financial
companies.description: Raymond James Financial, Inc. is an American multinational independent investment bank and financial services company headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida. companies.name: Real Goods
companies.description: Real Goods Solar Inc., doing business as RGS Energy, was a residential solar power integrator based in the United States. Founded in 1978, it sold some of the first retail solar panels in the country and served customers across all 50 states and 10 Canadian provinces. The company filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy in January 2020.

companies.name: Realty Income Corporation
companies.description: Realty Income Corporation is a real estate investment trust organized in Maryland with headquarters in San Diego, California. It invests in free-standing, single-tenant commercial properties across the United States, the United Kingdom, and six other European countries. These properties are subject to triple net leases (NNN Leases).

companies.name: Reata Pharmaceuticals

companies.name: Toei Animation

companies.name: Recipharm

companies.name: Redbubble

companies.name: Red Lion Hotels Corporation

companies.name: Red Robin
companies.description: Red Robin Gourmet Burgers, Inc. is an American casual dining restaurant chain founded in 1940 in Seattle, Washington. Headquartered in Greenwood Village, Colorado, it operates hundreds of restaurants specializing in classic American fare including burgers and fries.

companies.name: Redrow plc
companies.description: Redrow plc was a major British housebuilder based in Flintshire, Wales, with 12 operational divisions across the UK and 2,300 employees. In October 2024, it merged with Barratt Developments to form Barratt Redrow.

companies.name: Refah Bank
companies.description: Refah Bank, also known as Refah Kargaran Bank, is a major retail commercial bank based in Tehran, Iran. It is owned and controlled by the Social Security Organization of Iran and offers a range of financial products and services.

companies.name: Regal Rexnord

companies.name: Regal Hotels International
companies.description: Regal Hotels International is one of the largest hotel groups in Hong Kong. The company is incorporated in Bermuda and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Regency Centers
companies.description: Regency Centers Corporation is a real estate investment trust based in Jacksonville, Florida. It operates shopping centers anchored by grocery stores and owns notable properties including Serramonte Center and a 30% interest in Village District.

companies.name: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is an American biotechnology company headquartered in Westchester County, New York. Founded in 1988, it initially focused on neurotrophic factors and has expanded into cytokine and tyrosine kinase receptor research, producing a VEGF-trap product.

companies.name: Regis Corporation
companies.description: Regis Corporation is an American operator of hair salons headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota. As of August 2021, it operated over 5,800 salons including franchised and company-owned locations.

companies.name: Reliance, Inc.
companies.description: Reliance, Inc. is the largest metals service center operator in North America, headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona. It provides metals processing services and distributes a wide range of metal products to fabricators and manufacturers.

companies.name: Religare
companies.description: Religare Enterprises Limited is an Indian investment and financial services holding company headquartered in New Delhi. It is listed on the National Stock Exchange of India and Bombay Stock Exchange and registered with the Reserve Bank of India.

companies.name: ICR Inbursa
companies.description: Inbursa is a Mexican financial company providing banking and related services through subsidiaries. Its business lines include investment funds, insurance, mortgages, retirement funds, and commercial banking, and it is owned by billionaire Carlos Slim.

companies.name: Renishaw plc
companies.description: Renishaw plc is a British engineering company based in Wotton-under-Edge, England. It produces coordinate-measuring machines and machine tool products and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Rent The Runway
companies.description: Rent the Runway is an American e-commerce platform based in New York City that allows users to rent, subscribe, or buy designer apparel and accessories. It was founded in November 2009 by Jennifer Hyman and Jennifer Fleiss.

companies.name: Rentrak
companies.description: Rentrak Corporation is a global media measurement and research company serving the entertainment industry. It is headquartered in Portland, Oregon, with additional offices in the United States and worldwide.

companies.name: Repros Therapeutics
companies.description: Repros Therapeutics Inc. was a US-based development stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in The Woodlands, Texas. Founded in 1987 as Zonagen, it focused on developing oral small molecule drugs for male and female health but abandoned a vaccine-based contraceptive project after failed trials.

companies.name: Republic Bank & Trust Company
companies.description: Republic Bank & Trust Company is a bank based in Louisville, Kentucky, United States.

companies.name: Republic Services
companies.description: Republic Services, Inc. is an American waste disposal company providing non-hazardous solid waste collection, transfer, disposal, recycling, and energy services. It is the second largest waste disposal provider in the US and is partly owned by Bill Gates's Cascade Investment.

companies.name: ResMed
companies.description: Resmed Inc. is a medical equipment company based in San Diego, California, founded in Australia. It provides cloud-connectable devices for sleep apnea and respiratory conditions and produced ventilators to treat COVID-19 respiratory symptoms.

companies.name: The Restaurant Group
companies.description: The Restaurant Group plc is a British chain of restaurants and public houses, operating brands like Wagamama and Barburrito. It also runs pub restaurants and airport concessions and has been owned by US private equity company Apollo since 2023.

companies.name: Restoration Hardware
companies.description: RH is an American home furnishings company headquartered in Corte Madera, California. It sells merchandise through retail stores, catalogs, and online, operating galleries and outlet stores across the US and Canada.

companies.name: Carrier Corporation
companies.description: Carrier Global Corporation is an American multinational company based in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, manufacturing HVAC, refrigeration, and fire and security equipment. Founded in 1915, it expanded from HVAC systems to commercial refrigeration and fire technologies.

companies.name: RiT Technologies
companies.description: RiT Technologies Ltd. is a publicly traded Israeli company providing network management systems. Its shares are traded on the NASDAQ Capital Market.

companies.name: Ricegrowers Limited
companies.description: Ricegrowers Limited, known as SunRice, is one of the largest rice food companies globally and a leading branded food exporter based in Australia.

companies.name: Australian Securities Exchange

companies.name: Swvl

companies.name: Rigaku

companies.name: RingCentral

companies.name: Ringer Hut

companies.name: Comscore

companies.name: Rockhopper Exploration
companies.description: Rockhopper Exploration PLC is a UK-based oil and gas exploration company headquartered in Salisbury, owning offshore exploration and production licenses in the North Falkland Basin.

companies.name: Rockland Trust
companies.description: Rockland Trust is a commercial bank based in Rockland, Massachusetts, serving Southeastern and Coastal Massachusetts, Cape Cod, and Boston's MetroWest. It was established in 1907 as Rockland Trust Company.

companies.name: Rocksource
companies.description: Rocksource was a Norwegian technology-based exploration and production petroleum company listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange. It developed algorithms for processing Controlled Source Electromagnetic data for exploration and applied North Sea reservoir management techniques to onshore gas fields in east Texas.

companies.name: Rocky Brands
companies.description: Rocky Brands, Inc. is a United States company that designs, develops, manufactures, and markets outdoor, work, western, and military footwear along with apparel and accessories. Founded in 1932 in Nelsonville, Ohio, it maintains its corporate headquarters there.

companies.name: Rohto Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.

companies.name: Rollins Inc.

companies.name: Rosetta Genomics
companies.description: Rosetta Genomics Ltd. was a molecular diagnostics company with offices in Israel and the United States. It used microRNA biomarkers to develop diagnostic tests to differentiate various cancer types, submitting its first tests for regulatory approval in 2008.

companies.name: Rosetta Stone

companies.name: Roundy's Supermarkets, Inc. (Milwaukee)
companies.description: Roundy's Supermarkets, Inc. is an American supermarket operator owning stores under Pick 'n Save, Metro Market, and Mariano's Fresh Market. It operates supermarkets and pharmacies in Wisconsin and Illinois and is a subsidiary of Kroger since 2015.

companies.name: Rouse Properties
companies.description: Rouse Properties was a real estate investment trust headquartered in New York City. The company owned 35 shopping malls across 22 states, totaling approximately 24.5 million square feet of retail space.

companies.name: Royal Gold
companies.description: Royal Gold, Inc. is a precious metals stream and royalty company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Founded in 1981 as Royal Resources Corporation, it changed its name to Royal Gold in 1986.

companies.name: Onto Innovation
companies.description: Onto Innovation Inc. is an American semiconductor company formed in 2019 from the merger of Rudolph Technologies and Nanometrics Incorporated. It provides process and process control equipment and software for microelectronic manufacturing industries.

companies.name: Russel Metals
companies.description: Russel Metals Inc. is a Canadian metals distribution and processing company. It operates across Canada and the United States and is one of North America's largest metal distribution companies.

companies.name: Alteryx
companies.description: Alteryx, Inc. is an American computer software company founded in 1997 and based in Irvine, California. It develops products using data science and analytics and was acquired by private equity companies in December 2023.

companies.name: SATS Ltd
companies.description: SATS Ltd. is a Singaporean airport service company providing ground handling and in-flight catering at Changi Airport. It controls about 80% of the airport's ground handling and catering business.

companies.name: SBA Communications
companies.description: SBA Communications Corporation is a real estate investment trust owning and operating wireless infrastructure in the United States, Canada, Central America, South America, and South Africa. It was founded in 1989 by Steven Bernstein.

companies.name: SBI Life Insurance Company Limited
companies.description: SBI Life Insurance Company Limited is an Indian life insurance company started as a joint venture between State Bank of India and BNP Paribas Cardif.

companies.name: SCANA
companies.description: SCANA Corporation was an American regulated electric and natural gas public utility based in Cayce, South Carolina. It was acquired by Dominion Energy in January 2019 following the Nukegate scandal.

companies.name: Great Wall Pan Asia Holdings
companies.description: Great Wall Pan Asia Holdings Limited is a property investment company based in Hong Kong, China.

companies.name: SEI Investments Company
companies.description: SEI Investments Company is an American financial services company headquartered in Oaks, Pennsylvania. It provides financial technology, investment processing, operations, and asset management services to various financial clients.

companies.name: SIG plc
companies.description: SIG plc is a British-based international supplier of insulation, roofing, commercial interiors, and specialist construction products. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange. It operates primarily in the construction sector.

companies.name: SLC Agrícola
companies.description: SLC Agrícola is one of the largest Brazilian agricultural producers, founded in 1977 by the SLC Group. It operates 16 farms across six Brazilian states and was the first company in its sector to have shares traded on a stock exchange. The company focuses on crops like cotton, soybean, and corn.

companies.name: SL Green Realty
companies.description: SL Green Realty Corp. is a real estate investment trust primarily investing in office buildings and shopping centers in New York City. It owns interests in 39 properties mainly in Manhattan and is known as New York City’s largest office landlord.

companies.name: SMTC Corporation
companies.description: SMTC Corporation is a mid-size electronics manufacturing services company founded in 1985. It operates facilities in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and China, providing end-to-end electronics manufacturing services.

companies.name: SOHO China
companies.description: SOHO China is a Chinese building developer focused on office and commercial properties, with some residential and mixed-use developments. Founded in 1995, the company combines office and residential spaces to create comfortable and productive environments.

companies.name: AusNet Services
companies.description: AusNet is an Australian energy delivery services company owning and operating electricity and gas network assets. It was formerly listed on the Australian Securities Exchange and Singapore Exchange and is now a subsidiary of Brookfield Asset Management.

companies.name: SS&C Technologies
companies.description: SS&C Technologies Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational holding company headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut. It sells software and software as a service to the financial services industry and has offices worldwide.

companies.name: STV Group
companies.description: STV Group plc is a media company based in Glasgow, Scotland. Starting as a television broadcaster in 1957, it expanded into newspapers, advertising, and radio, and now focuses on broadcast television, video-on-demand, and television production.

companies.name: SUNeVision
companies.description: SUNeVision is the technology arm of Sun Hung Kai Properties and the largest data centre provider in Hong Kong. The company offers carrier and cloud-neutral data centre services.

companies.name: Erg
companies.description: Erg S.p.A. is an Italian energy company founded in 1938 and based in Genoa, Italy. The company operates in the energy industry.

companies.name: SEA Group
companies.description: SEA Group, founded in 1956, is one of Hong Kong's longest-established property developers. It operates more than 200 projects worldwide, making it a diversified multinational real estate enterprise. Several of its subsidiaries are listed in the United Kingdom, Australia, and New Zealand.

companies.name: Sedmoi Kontinent
companies.description: Sedmoi Kontinent is a major grocery retail chain headquartered in Moscow, Russia. It operates 140 stores in Russia and one in Belarus. The company is focused on retail grocery operations.

companies.name: Saipa Diesel
companies.description: SAIPA Diesel Company, originally branded Iran Kaveh, is an Iranian manufacturer of trucks and trailers. The company operates in the automotive industry and is based in Iran.

companies.name: Sally Beauty Holdings
companies.description: Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc. is an American international specialty retailer and distributor of professional beauty supplies. The company operates in the consumer goods and retail sector.

companies.name: bpost
companies.description: Bpost is the Belgian company responsible for mail delivery in Belgium and is part of the Belgian Post Group. It offers postal, courier, direct marketing, banking, insurance, and electronic services. Its headquarters are located in Brussels at the Monnaie Center.

companies.name: Samba Financial Group
companies.description: Samba Financial Group SJSC, formerly The Saudi American Bank, was a multinational banking firm based in Saudi Arabia. It operated 66 branches within the Kingdom.

companies.name: Sampath Bank
companies.description: Sampath Bank PLC is a licensed commercial bank incorporated in Sri Lanka in 1987. It operates 229 branches and 373 ATMs island-wide and has received awards such as the Bank of the Year by The Banker of Financial Times Limited.

companies.name: Sampo Corporation
companies.description: Sampo Corporation is a major Taiwanese manufacturer of household electrical items including televisions, air-conditioners, and washing machines. The company has collaborated with TCL and manufactures PDP-TVs for Thomson on a contract basis.

companies.name: Sampoerna
companies.description: PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna Tbk, known as Sampoerna, is an Indonesian tobacco company owned by Philip Morris International. It is the largest tobacco company in Indonesia and produces clove cigarettes known locally as kretek cigarettes.

companies.name: Progress Software
companies.description: Progress Software Corporation is an American public company that produces software for creating and deploying business applications. It was founded in Burlington, Massachusetts, and has offices in 16 countries as of 2024.

companies.name: Samsung SDS
companies.description: Samsung SDS Co., Ltd. is a South Korean IT services provider established in 1985 as a subsidiary of Samsung Group. It offers consulting, technical, and outsourcing services and is active in emerging IT technologies such as AI, Blockchain, and IoT. The company has headquarters in South Korea and eight overseas subsidiaries.

companies.name: Samyang Foods
companies.description: Samyang Roundsquare Co., Ltd. is a South Korean international food manufacturer and the first instant ramen company in South Korea. Founded in 1961 by Jeon Jung Yoon, it debuted the first Korean instant noodle in 1963.

companies.name: Covivio
companies.industry: rental of land and other real estate
companies.description: Covivio is a French real estate company founded in 1998. It operates in the rental of land and other real estate sector.

companies.name: SandRidge Energy
companies.description: SandRidge Energy, Inc. is a company engaged in hydrocarbon exploration in the Mid-Continent region of the United States. It is organized in Delaware and headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.

companies.name: Sandvine
companies.description: AppLogic Networks Corporation, formerly Sandvine Incorporated, is a Canadian application and network intelligence company based in Waterloo, Ontario.

companies.name: Sangamo Therapeutics
companies.description: Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. is an American biotechnology company based in Richmond, California. It develops cell and gene therapies for severe genetic diseases.

companies.name: Sanoyas Hishino Meisho
companies.description: Sanoyas Hishino Meisho Corporation is a Japanese company consisting of four principal business groups: Ship and Steel Structure, Parking System & Engineering, Construction Machines, and Leisure Business.

companies.name: Sansiri
companies.logo_file: โลโก้บริษัท แสนสิริ จำกัด (มหาชน).svg
companies.description: Sansiri is one of the largest real estate developers in Thailand. It was founded in 1984 by Srettha Thavisin, Apichat Chutrakul, and Wanchak Buranasiri.

companies.name: Darden Restaurants
companies.description: Darden Restaurants, Inc. is an American multi-brand restaurant operator headquartered in Orlando, Florida. It operates more than 2,100 restaurant locations and is the world's largest full-service restaurant company. The company began as an extension of Red Lobster, founded by William Darden.

companies.name: Sarmayeh Bank
companies.description: Sarmayeh Bank is an Iranian bank founded in 2005 as part of the government's privatization of the banking system. It operates within Iran's financial services sector and was established to support the privatization efforts in the banking industry.

companies.name: Hokkaido Electric Power Company
companies.description: Hokkaido Electric Power Co., Inc., also known as Hokuden, is the monopoly electric company serving Hokkaidō, Japan. It is traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and the Sapporo Securities Exchange, providing electricity generation services in the region.

companies.name: Sasken Communication Technologies
companies.description: Sasken Technologies is an Indian multinational company specializing in product engineering and embedded software. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, it operates in the AI and software industry, providing technology solutions globally.

companies.name: Saudi Advanced Industries Company
companies.description: Saudi Advanced Industries Company is an industrial investment vehicle formed in 1987 under the U.S. Peace Shield defense offset program. It invests in technology companies in Saudi Arabia and holds interests in AlSalam Aircraft Company and the Aircraft Accessories & Components Company.

companies.name: Saudi Research and Media Group
companies.logo_file: Saudi Research and Media Group New Logo.png
companies.description: Saudi Research and Media Group (SRMG) is a Saudi state-backed media company registered in Riyadh. It mainly publishes, prints, and distributes various publications and operates within Saudi Arabia's media sector.

companies.name: Schneider National
companies.description: Schneider National, Inc. is an American transportation company providing truckload, intermodal, and logistics services. Its offerings include regional, long-haul, expedited, dedicated, bulk, brokerage, and supply chain management services.

companies.name: Radius Recycling, Inc.
companies.description: Radius Recycling, Inc. is a scrap recycling and steel manufacturing company headquartered in Portland, Oregon. It operates metals recycling facilities and owns Cascade Steel Rolling Mills. The company was acquired by Toyota Tsusho in July 2025.

companies.name: Schrödinger
companies.description: Schrödinger, Inc. is an international scientific software and biotechnology company specializing in computational tools and software for drug discovery and materials science. It operates globally with a focus on scientific innovation.

companies.name: Light & Wonder
companies.description: Light & Wonder, Inc., formerly Scientific Games Corporation, is an American company providing gambling products and services. It is headquartered in Enterprise, Nevada, with a Las Vegas mailing address.

companies.name: Scottish American Investment Company
companies.industry: financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
companies.description: The Scottish American Investment Company is a publicly traded investment trust investing in a broad range of UK and international assets. Managed by Baillie Gifford & Co Limited in Edinburgh, it is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Scottish Mortgage Investment Trust
companies.industry: financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
companies.description: Scottish Mortgage Investment Trust is a publicly traded investment trust based in Edinburgh, United Kingdom. It invests globally in businesses with above-average returns and is managed by Baillie Gifford & Co Limited. The trust is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: StarHub
companies.description: StarHub Limited is a Singaporean multinational telecommunications conglomerate founded in 1998. It is one of the major telecommunications companies operating in Singapore and is listed on the Singapore Exchange (SGX).

companies.name: Sealed Air
companies.description: Sealed Air Corporation is an American packaging company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It is known for its Cryovac food packaging and Bubble Wrap cushioning packaging products. The company is led by president and CEO Dustin Semach.

companies.name: Secureworks Inc.
companies.description: Secureworks Inc. was an American cybersecurity company serving approximately 4,000 customers in over 50 countries. Its clients ranged from Fortune 100 companies to mid-sized businesses across various industries.

companies.name: Franklin Templeton Investments
companies.description: Franklin Templeton, Inc. is an American multinational investment management holding company founded in New York City in 1947. It operates globally in over 150 countries and was formed through a 1992 merger with Templeton, Galbraith & Hansberger.

companies.name: Sleep Number
companies.description: Sleep Number Corporation is an American manufacturer of adjustable beds, foundations, and bedding accessories. The company is based in Minneapolis, Minnesota, with manufacturing and distribution facilities in South Carolina and Utah.

companies.name: SIG (Company)
companies.description: PT Semen Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (SIG) is a state-owned holding company based in Indonesia providing building material solutions. It has 17 subsidiaries in Indonesia and Vietnam and operates mainly in the cement sector and related products across Asia, Australia, and Oceania.

companies.name: Semitool
companies.description: Semitool was a semiconductor manufacturing and capital equipment company founded in California in 1978 and based in Kalispell, Montana. The company was sold to Applied Materials in December 2009.

companies.name: Seneca Foods
companies.description: Seneca Foods Corporation is an American food processor and distributor headquartered in Fairport, New York. It primarily operates in food packaging, selling canned vegetables, fruit products, and frozen items under various brands and private labels.

companies.name: Lotte Chemical Titan
companies.description: Lotte Chemical Titan Holding Sdn Bhd is a Malaysian company operating polypropylene, polyethylene, ethylene cracker, and aromatic plants. It produces various types of polyethylene for applications ranging from household goods to automotive products and is based in Pasir Gudang, Malaysia.

companies.name: Senior plc
companies.description: Senior plc is a holding company for a global group of manufacturing and engineering firms headquartered in Rickmansworth, England. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange and was part of the FTSE 250 Index until its acquisition by Tinicum Inc. and Blackstone Private Investments Advisors in October 2026.

companies.name: Senomyx
companies.description: Senomyx is an American biotechnology company that develops food additives by reverse engineering human taste and aroma receptors. Founded in 1998 by Lubert Stryer and Paul Nevsky, it was acquired by the Swiss company Firmenich in September 2018.

companies.name: Sensient Technologies
companies.description: Sensient Technologies is a global manufacturer and marketer of colors, flavors, and fragrances based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Its products are used in foods, beverages, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and other industries. In 2021, it was ranked 10th on the Global Top 50 Food Flavors and Fragrances Companies list.

companies.name: Sevcon
companies.description: Sevcon Inc. was a company that manufactured controls for electric vehicles. It was acquired by BorgWarner in September 2017. The company was based in the United Kingdom.

companies.name: Seven Bank
companies.description: Seven Bank, Ltd. is a Japanese bank affiliated with Seven-Eleven Japan, which is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Seven & I Holdings. It operates in the financial services sector in Japan.

companies.name: Seven Group Holdings
companies.description: SGH Limited, known as Seven Group Holdings, is an Australian diversified operating company with businesses across industrial services, energy, and media sectors.

companies.name: Seven West Media
companies.description: Seven West Media Limited is an Australian diversified media business with a presence in broadcast television, radio, print, and online publishing.

companies.name: Shaftesbury plc
companies.description: Shaftesbury PLC was a British real estate investment trust focused exclusively on London's West End. Headquartered in London, it was listed on the London Stock Exchange until merging with Capital & Counties Properties to form Shaftesbury Capital in March 2023.

companies.name: Taylor Wimpey
companies.description: Taylor Wimpey plc is a home construction company in the United Kingdom formed by the merger of Taylor Woodrow and George Wimpey in 2007. It is headquartered in High Wycombe, England, and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Lattice Semiconductor
companies.description: Lattice Semiconductor Corporation is an American semiconductor company specializing in low-power field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs). Headquartered in Hillsboro, Oregon, it has operations worldwide and was founded in 1983. The company went public in 1989 and is traded on Nasdaq.

companies.name: Stora Enso
companies.logo_file: SE Color Small CMYK White Bground Clearspace.jpg
companies.description: Stora Enso Oyj is a Finnish and Swedish forest industry company that develops and produces various wood-based materials for multiple industries worldwide. It operates primarily in the pulp and paper industry and is known for its focus on sustainable wood products.

companies.name: National Iranian Petrochemical Company
companies.description: The National Petrochemical Company (NPC) is an Iranian government-owned entity responsible for developing and operating Iran's petrochemical sector. Founded in 1964, it began with a small fertilizer plant in Shiraz and operates under the Iranian Petroleum Ministry.

companies.name: China Resources Power
companies.description: China Resources Power Holdings Company Limited, incorporated in Hong Kong in 2001, is a subsidiary of China Resources Holdings. It invests in, develops, operates, and manages coal-burning power plants across multiple regions in China including Beijing and Guangdong.

companies.name: Shandong Molong Petroleum Machinery
companies.description: Shandong Molong Petroleum Machinery Company Limited is a private petroleum machinery manufacturer based in Shouguang, Shandong, China. It produces oil well pumps, sucker rods, and other drilling machinery, serving major customers like Petrochina and Sinopec.

companies.name: Shanghai Industrial Holdings
companies.description: Shanghai Industrial Holdings Limited, incorporated in Hong Kong in 1996, is a conglomerate listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. It is part of several stock indices including the MSCI China All Shares Small Cap Index and participates in the Shanghai-Hong Kong and Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect programs.

companies.name: Shanxi Coking Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Shanxi Coking Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded coke manufacturing conglomerate in China. The company is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange and operates within the coal industry.

companies.name: Sharecare
companies.description: Sharecare, Inc. is an American health and wellness company that provides personalized health information through its RealAge Test, a health risk assessment tool. It operates in the medical technology sector.

companies.name: Shenzhen Energy Group
companies.description: Shenzhen Energy Group Company Limited is a major power generation company based in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China. It develops various energy types and invests in new energy technologies, with Huaneng Power International as its second largest shareholder.

companies.name: Shenzhen International Holdings
companies.description: Shenzhen International Holdings Limited invests in, constructs, and operates logistics infrastructure and provides third-party logistics and information services. It is owned by Shenzhen Investment Holding Corporation and Cheung Kong Holdings.

companies.name: Shenzhen Investment
companies.description: Shenzhen Investment Limited is a property developer in Southern China partly owned by the Shenzhen Government. It also operates in infrastructure and cement sectors through other companies and has been listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 1997.

companies.name: Shenzhen Zhongjin Lingnan Nonfemet Company
companies.description: Zhongjin Lingnan Nonfemet Company Limited is a Chinese mining and metallurgy group headquartered in Shenzhen, Guangdong. It specializes in integrated mining, beneficiation, smelting, and trading of non-ferrous metals, mainly zinc and lead, with by-products including copper, silver, indium, and sulfuric acid.

companies.name: Sherritt International
companies.description: Sherritt International is a Canadian resource company based in Toronto, Ontario. It mines and refines nickel and cobalt and is the largest independent energy producer in Cuba.

companies.name: Shidax
companies.description: Shidax Corporation is a Japanese company providing food services and operating the largest karaoke shop chain in Japan.

companies.name: CSPC Pharmaceutical Group
companies.description: CSPC Pharmaceutical Group researches, develops, manufactures, and sells pharmaceutical products. The company is headquartered in Hebei Province, China.

companies.name: Shimizu Corporation
companies.description: Shimizu Corporation is a Japanese architectural, civil engineering, and general contracting firm. It is recognized as one of the top contractors in Japan and among the top 20 worldwide.

companies.name: Shoe Carnival
companies.description: Shoe Station Group, Inc., formerly Shoe Carnival Inc., is an American retailer of family footwear headquartered in Fort Mill, South Carolina. It operates 422 stores across 35 states and Puerto Rico under the Shoe Station and Shoe Carnival brands.

companies.name: Beijing North Star
companies.description: Beijing North Star Company Limited is a state-owned conglomerate enterprise based in Beijing, China. It engages in property management, property development, and retailing, with shares listed on the Hong Kong and Shanghai Stock Exchanges.

companies.name: Cabot Corporation
companies.description: Cabot Corporation is an American specialty chemicals and performance materials company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It operates in over 20 countries with multiple manufacturing plants, research facilities, and sales offices.

companies.name: ShoreTel
companies.description: ShoreTel, Inc. was a telecommunications vendor providing unified communications for business. The company was acquired by Mitel in 2017.

companies.name: Shanghai International Port
companies.description: Shanghai International Port (Group) Co., Ltd. is the exclusive operator of all public terminals in the Port of Shanghai. It is a majority state-owned company and part of several Chinese stock indices.

companies.name: Shoucheng Holdings
companies.description: Shoucheng Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company and a subsidiary of the Beijing-based state-owned Shougang Group. The company focuses on infrastructure asset management and intelligent infrastructure investment across mainland China. It is classified as a red chip stock.

companies.name: Astral Media
companies.description: Astral Media Inc. was a Canadian media conglomerate and the country's largest radio broadcaster with 84 stations across eight provinces. It also operated 23 specialty television channels, two conventional stations, and had a presence in out-of-home advertising. The company was a major player in premium and specialty television in Canada.

companies.name: Shutterfly
companies.description: Shutterfly, LLC is an American company headquartered in San Jose, California, specializing in photography products and image sharing. It is known for custom photo printing services including books, framed pictures, and other personalized items. The company operates several sub-brands such as TinyPrints, SnapFish, and Lifetouch.

companies.name: Sigma Designs
companies.description: Signet Jewelers Ltd., headquartered in Akron, Ohio and domiciled in Bermuda, is the world's largest retailer of diamond jewelry as of 2025. It operates in the middle-market jewelry segment and holds leading positions in the US, Canada, and UK specialty jewelry markets. The company owns brands including Blue Nile, Zales, Kay Jewelers, and Jared.

companies.name: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited
companies.description: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited operates various equity, commodity, fixed income, and currency markets through its wholly owned subsidiaries. These include The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited, Hong Kong Futures Exchange Limited, and the London Metal Exchange. The company is based in Hong Kong.

companies.name: Silicon Studio
companies.description: Silicon Studio Corporation is a Tokyo-based Japanese computer graphics technology company and HR services provider. It develops middleware software and real-time global illumination technology, and has developed video games for platforms including PlayStation 3, Nintendo 3DS, iOS, and Android. Notable products include YEBIS and Enlighten.

companies.name: SSR Mining
companies.description: SSR Mining Inc., formerly Silver Standard Resources, is a Denver-based producer of gold, silver, copper, lead, and zinc. It owns the largest silver mine in Argentina and engages in exploration across the Americas and Turkey. The company merged with Alacer Gold in 2020 and relocated its headquarters to Denver, Colorado.

companies.name: The Hong Kong and China Gas Company Limited
companies.wiki: The Hong Kong and China Gas Company
companies.description: The Hong Kong and China Gas Company Limited, trading as Towngas, is the sole provider of territory-wide town gas in Hong Kong. Founded in 1862, it is one of the oldest listed companies in the region. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

companies.name: Shenergy Company
companies.description: Shenergy Group Company Limited is a state-owned enterprise owned by the Shanghai government in China. It is the parent company of Shenergy Company Limited, which is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange. The company invests in electricity, petroleum, and natural gas in Shanghai and Eastern China.

companies.name: New World Development Company Limited
companies.description: New World Development Company Limited is a Hong Kong-based conglomerate focused on property, hotels, infrastructure, services, and department stores. Established in 1970 by Cheng Yu-tung, it has been publicly listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 1972. It was formerly part of the Hong Kong Hang Seng Index.

companies.name: Sims Metal Management
companies.description: Sims Metal is a global environmental services conglomerate with operations in the US, Australia, and the UK. It focuses on metal recycling, data destruction, electronic goods recycling, municipal waste recycling, and energy from gas and waste. Founded in 1917, it operates through multiple divisions.

companies.name: Simulations Plus
companies.description: Simulations Plus, Inc. is a US-based software company that develops ADMET modeling and simulation software for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and other industries. In 2014, it acquired Cognigen Corporation, which provides clinical trial data analysis and consulting services.

companies.name: Sing Tao News Corporation Limited
companies.description: Sing Tao News Corporation Limited is a Hong Kong media company incorporated in Bermuda. It was formerly known as Global China Group Holdings Limited.

companies.name: Sino-Ocean Group
companies.description: Sino-Ocean Group Holding Limited is a Chinese investment holding company engaged in property investment and development. It develops mid to high-end residential properties and invests in urban complexes and office buildings.

companies.name: Sino Hotels
companies.description: Sino Hotels (Holdings) Limited is a hotel operator based in Hong Kong and incorporated in the Cayman Islands. It is affiliated with Sino Land Company Limited in Hong Kong and the Far East Organization in Singapore.

companies.name: Sinopharm Group
companies.description: Sinopharm Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese pharmaceutical company. Its parent company is Sinopharm Industrial Investment, a joint venture between China National Pharmaceutical Group and Fosun Pharmaceutical.

companies.name: China Yangtze Power
companies.description: China Yangtze Power Co., Ltd., known as Yangtze Power, is a Chinese utilities company headquartered in Beijing. It is part of the SSE 180 Index and controlled by China Three Gorges Corporation, a state-owned enterprise.

companies.name: Sinotrans Shipping
companies.description: Sinotrans Shipping Ltd. is one of China's largest shipping companies, headquartered in Hong Kong and a subsidiary of China Merchants Group. It provides vessel chartering, freight forwarding, container line services, shipping agency, fleet management, and LNG shipping.

companies.name: Sirius XM Canada
companies.description: SiriusXM Canada Holdings Inc. is a Canadian broadcasting company that distributes American satellite radio provider SiriusXM's services in Canada.

companies.name: Founder Technology
companies.description: Founder Technology Group Corporation is a state-owned information technology enterprise based in Shanghai, China. It is a subsidiary of Founder Group from Peking University. The company develops personal computers, computer peripherals under the brand "Fang Zheng," and printed circuit boards.

companies.name: Atari SA
companies.description: Atari SA is a Luxembourgish holding company that owns video gaming-related interactive entertainment properties. It publishes games under labels including Atari, Inc., Nightdive Studios, and Digital Eclipse. The company also produces video game consoles such as the Atari VCS and owns intellectual property rights to many classic video game properties.

companies.name: Campari Group
companies.description: Campari Group, officially Davide Campari-Milano N.V., is an Italian company active since 1860 in the branded beverage industry. It produces spirits, wines, and non-alcoholic apéritifs. Its portfolio includes over 50 brands such as Campari, Aperol, SKYY vodka, and Wild Turkey.

companies.name: Hongkong Land
companies.description: Hongkong Land is a property investment, management, and development group with commercial and residential property interests across Asia. Headquartered in Bermuda, it owns and manages significant office and retail properties mainly in Hong Kong and Singapore. It is the largest landlord in Central, Hong Kong, and has a 50% interest in the World Trade Center Jakarta.

companies.name: Skyworth
companies.description: Skyworth Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese holding company headquartered in Shenzhen. Its subsidiaries design, manufacture, and sell televisions and other audio-visual products. The company also invests in properties and operates in locations including Hong Kong, Inner Mongolia, and Guangdong.

companies.name: Slater and Gordon
companies.description: Slater & Gordon Lawyers is an Australian law firm founded in Melbourne in 1935. It was established by Hugh Lyons Gordon and Bill Slater. Since April 2023, the firm has been owned by private equity firm Allegro Funds.

companies.name: Smith Micro Software
companies.description: Smith Micro Software, Inc. is a software developer and marketer headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1982, it offers enterprise and consumer-level software and services with offices in the United States, Europe, and Asia. The company focuses on digital lifestyle solutions and security technologies.

companies.name: Snyder's-Lance
companies.description: Snyder's-Lance, Inc. is the second largest salty snack maker in the United States. It was formed in 2010 by the merger of Lance Inc. and Snyder's of Hanover.

companies.name: SolarWinds
companies.description: SolarWinds Corporation is an American software company headquartered in Austin, Texas. It develops software to help businesses monitor and manage their networks, systems, and IT infrastructure. The company has sales and product development offices in the United States and other countries.

companies.name: TerraVia
companies.description: TerraVia Holdings, Inc. was a biotechnology company in the United States that used proprietary technology to convert plant-based sugars into high-value oils and algae ingredients. It supplied sustainable algae-based food ingredients to various brands and sold its own culinary algae oil under the Thrive Algae Oil brand. The company declared bankruptcy in 2017.

companies.name: Atlas Air
companies.description: Atlas Air, Inc. is a major American cargo and passenger charter airline based in White Plains, New York. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of Atlas Air Worldwide Holdings and is the world's largest operator of the Boeing 747 aircraft. The airline operates globally to more than 300 destinations in 70 countries.

companies.name: Southwestern Energy
companies.description: Southwestern Energy Company was a natural gas exploration and production company headquartered in Spring, Texas, and organized in Delaware. In October 2024, it merged into Expand Energy, ceasing to exist as an independent entity.

companies.name: Spacelabs Healthcare
companies.description: Spacelabs Healthcare is an American medical equipment manufacturer headquartered in Snoqualmie, Washington. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of OSI Systems and offers products in patient monitoring, connectivity, and diagnostic cardiology. The company employs over one thousand people worldwide.

companies.name: The Shyft Group
companies.description: The Shyft Group is an American automobile design company that designs, engineers, and manufactures specialty chassis, vehicles, truck bodies, and aftermarket parts. Its products serve the recreational vehicle, government services, and delivery and service markets.

companies.name: SpartanNash
companies.description: SpartanNash Company is an American food distribution and retail company headquartered in Byron Center, Michigan. Founded in 1917, it adopted its current name in 2013 following a merger with Nash Finch Company.

companies.name: Spectra Energy
companies.description: Spectra Energy Corp was a Houston, Texas-based company operating in natural gas transmission, storage, distribution, and processing. Formed in 2006 from a Duke Energy spin-off, it owned the Texas Eastern Pipeline and operated three oil pipelines. In 2017, it merged into the Canadian company Enbridge.

companies.name: Spectris
companies.description: Spectris plc is a supplier of precision instrumentation and controls based in the United Kingdom. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by KKR in December 2025.

companies.name: Spectrum Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Spectrum Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is an American biopharmaceutical company located in Boston, Massachusetts. It develops and markets drugs for hematology and oncology treatments.

companies.name: Spin Master
companies.description: Spin Master Corp. is a Canadian multinational toy and entertainment company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. It employs over 1,600 people globally and has offices in multiple countries including Australia, China, France, Germany, and the United States.

companies.name: UNISOC
companies.description: UNISOC (Shanghai) Technologies Co., Ltd. is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Shanghai. It designs semiconductor products for smartphones, IoT devices, automotive electronics, and other connected devices. UNISOC is part of Tsinghua Unigroup.

companies.name: Springs Global
companies.description: Springs Global is a Brazil-based multinational corporation that manufactures, markets, and sells packaged textile and non-textile home furnishings. It produces textile goods such as sheets, pillows, and towels under brands like Springmaid and Wamsutta. The company operates in several countries including Argentina, Mexico, Brazil, Canada, and the U.S.

companies.name: Sprouts Farmers Market
companies.description: Sprouts Farmers Market, Inc. is a supermarket chain headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, specializing in natural and organic foods. It offers fresh produce, bulk foods, packaged groceries, and other items including vitamins and natural body care products. The company operates more than 400 stores across 24 states in the U.S.

companies.name: SLTMobitel
companies.description: Sri Lanka Telecom PLC, known as SLTMobitel, is the national telecommunications provider in Sri Lanka. It offers fixed and wireless telephony, Internet access, and IT services to domestic and business customers. As of 2024, it was the country's second largest mobile network operator with 7.1 million subscribers.

companies.name: St. James's Place Wealth Management Group
companies.description: St. James's Place plc is a British financial advice and wealth management company headquartered in Cirencester, Gloucestershire. It operates as an adviser, fund manager, and life insurance business with multiple offices across the UK. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: St. Joe Company
companies.description: The St. Joe Company is a land development firm based in Panama City Beach, Florida. Founded in 1936, it focuses on real estate development and asset management, with land holdings mainly in Northwest Florida. The company develops land for residential, commercial, and medical uses and maintains a forestry division.

companies.name: St. Modwen Properties
companies.description: St. Modwen Properties Ltd. was a British property investment and development company specializing in regenerating brownfield land and urban environments. Headquartered in Birmingham, it operated regional offices across the UK. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by The Blackstone Group in August 2021.

companies.name: stamps.com
companies.description: Stamps.com, now known as Auctane, is an American company providing Internet-based mailing and shipping services. Its main offices are in Austin, Texas. Previously a public company traded on NASDAQ, it was originally founded and based in Los Angeles before merging with Thoma Bravo.

companies.name: StanCorp Financial Group
companies.description: StanCorp Financial Group, Inc. is an insurance and financial services company headquartered in Portland, Oregon. Founded in 1906, its main subsidiary is Standard Insurance Company. The company was publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange from 1999 until 2016.

companies.name: Standard Chartered Bank Nepal
companies.description: Standard Chartered Nepal is a banking and financial services company operating in Nepal as a subsidiary of Standard Chartered PLC. It is currently the only international commercial bank operating in the country.

companies.name: SP+
