companies.description: SP Plus Corporation is an American company providing parking facility management and related services such as baggage handling, ground transportation, and event logistics across the U.S. and Canada. It was formerly known as Standard Parking Corporation until December 2013.

companies.name: IWG plc
companies.description: International Workplace Group plc, formerly Regus, is a Swiss-based company providing serviced offices and coworking spaces under several brand names including Regus. Founded in Brussels, Belgium in 1989, it is registered in Jersey and headquartered in Zug, Switzerland. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Sterling Bank
companies.description: Sterling Bank was a subsidiary of Sterling Bankshares, Inc. based in Houston, Texas. Founded in 1974 as Jersey Village Bank, it operated 56 banking centers across Texas metropolitan areas including Houston, San Antonio, Dallas, and Fort Worth. The bank served various regions including the Texas Hill Country.

companies.name: Stewart Information Services Corporation
companies.description: Stewart Information Services Corporation is a real estate information, title insurance, and transaction management company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It operates through wholly owned subsidiaries and a network of independent agencies in the United States and abroad. The company employs approximately 6,350 people.

companies.name: Stillwater Mining Company
companies.description: Stillwater Mining Company was a palladium and platinum mining company headquartered in Littleton, Colorado. It was the only producer of these metals in the USA and was acquired in 2017 by Sibanye Gold Limited, now trading as Sibanye-Stillwater. It exists today as a division of Sibanye-Stillwater.

companies.name: SulAmérica Seguros
companies.description: SulAmérica is the second largest Brazilian insurance company, founded in 1895 and controlled by Rede D'or. It serves over 7 million customers through a network of more than 30,000 independent brokers. The company offers various insurance lines including health, dental, automobile, life, as well as private pension, investments, and capitalization.

companies.name: Sun-Rype
companies.description: Sun-Rype Products Ltd. is a Western Canadian manufacturer of fruit-based food and beverages. Founded in 1946, the company produces juices and fruit snacks and is based in Kelowna, British Columbia, in the Okanagan region.

companies.name: SunOpta
companies.description: SunOpta, Inc. is a multinational food and mineral company headquartered in Eden Prairie, Minnesota. It was founded in Canada in 1973 and operates in both the food and mineral industries.

companies.name: Sunrun
companies.description: Sunrun Inc. is an American company providing photovoltaic systems and battery energy storage products. It is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

companies.name: Sun Communities
companies.description: Sun Communities, Inc. is a publicly traded real estate investment trust investing in manufactured housing and recreational vehicle communities. As of December 31, 2025, it owned interests in 513 properties across the United States, Canada, and the UK.

companies.name: Sun Hung Kai & Co.
companies.description: Sun Hung Kai & Co. Limited is a principal-led alternative investment platform based in Hong Kong. Established in 1969, it has roots in wealth management and invests across alternative asset classes including hedge funds, private equity, private credit, and real assets.

companies.name: Capital Small Finance Bank
companies.description: Capital Small Finance Bank is an Indian small finance bank founded in April 2016. It is headquartered in Jalandhar, India. The bank focuses on providing financial services within the country.

companies.name: Sun National Bank
companies.description: Sun National Bank was an American bank owned by holding company Sun Bancorp, Inc. It was headquartered in Mount Laurel, New Jersey, and served consumers and businesses through more than 30 branch locations in New Jersey and commercial lending offices in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and New York.

companies.name: Sunday Communications Limited
companies.description: Sunday Communications Limited is a Cayman Islands incorporated holding company headquartered and listed in Hong Kong. It is the parent company of Mandarin Communications, a mobile network operator in Hong Kong.

companies.name: Sunland Group
companies.description: Sunland Group Limited is an Australian property development company headquartered in South East Queensland, Australia. Founded in 1983 by Iranian-Australian businessmen Soheil Abedian and Foad Fathi, it focuses on real estate development.

companies.name: Suominen Corporation
companies.description: Suominen Corporation is a Finnish company supplying nonwovens for consumer products worldwide. It is the global market leader in nonwovens for wipes and employs approximately 600 people across Finland, Italy, Spain, Brazil, and the United States.

companies.name: Obsidian Energy
companies.description: Obsidian Energy Ltd. is a mid-sized Canadian oil and natural gas production company based in Calgary, Alberta. It operates within the petroleum industry in Canada.

companies.name: Support.com
companies.description: Support.com is a technical support service for businesses and consumers offered by RealDefense LLC. It was headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, with an administrative office in Sunnyvale, California, providing remote support for various operating systems and smart devices.

companies.name: Supreme Industries
companies.description: Supreme Industries Limited is an Indian plastics company based in Mumbai. It manufactures a variety of products including industrial molded furniture, storage crates, multi-layer films, PVC pipes, and disposable containers.

companies.name: Susquehanna Bank
companies.description: Susquehanna Bank was a Lancaster, Pennsylvania-based bank operating over 260 branches in four states. Its parent company was Susquehanna Bancshares, Inc., a regional financial services holding company based in Lititz, Pennsylvania.

companies.name: Swire Properties
companies.description: Swire Properties Limited is a property developer, owner, and operator of mixed-use commercial properties in Hong Kong and mainland China. Founded in 1972 and headquartered in Hong Kong, it is a subsidiary of Swire Pacific Limited.

companies.name: Lotte Himart
companies.description: Lotte Hi-Mart is a South Korean retailer of electronic goods headquartered in Seoul. It was originally a unit of bankrupt Daewoo Electronics before being spun off in 1999. The company was taken over by Lotte Corporation in 2012.

companies.name: Synergy Health
companies.description: Synergy Health plc was a UK-based global company providing specialist outsourced services to healthcare markets worldwide. Its services included sterilization for medical device manufacturers and decontamination of surgical instruments. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Steris Corporation in 2014.

companies.name: Synlait
companies.description: Synlait Milk Ltd. is a New Zealand dairy processor headquartered in Dunsandel, Canterbury. It sells dairy and plant-based nutritional products, ingredients, and powders globally. The company operates manufacturing sites in Auckland and Pōkeno and has offices in Beijing and Shanghai.

companies.name: Synnex
companies.description: Synnex was an American multinational corporation providing IT services to businesses. Founded in 1980 and based in Fremont, California, it served original equipment manufacturers, software publishers, and resellers. Synnex merged with Tech Data to form TD Synnex.

companies.name: Synthomer
companies.description: Synthomer plc is a British-based chemicals business formerly known as Yule Catto & Co. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Syria International Islamic Bank
companies.description: Syria International Islamic Bank (SIIB) is a Syrian bank established in 2007 and headquartered in Damascus. It is a public company with capital held by Qatari and Syrian shareholders and has been listed on the Damascus Securities Exchange since 2009.

companies.name: Sysmex Corporation
companies.description: Sysmex Corporation is a Japanese healthcare company headquartered in Kobe. Originally called TOA Medical Electronics, it was established under the Sysmex brand in 1978 focusing on haematology analysers. The company was renamed Sysmex Corporation in 1998.

companies.name: Bucyrus International
companies.description: Bucyrus International, originally Bucyrus-Erie, was an American mining equipment company founded in 1880 in Ohio. It moved headquarters to Wisconsin in 1893 and merged with Erie Steam Shovel Company in 1927. The company was acquired by Caterpillar in 2011.

companies.name: T4F - Time For Fun
companies.description: T4F – Time For Fun is a Brazilian entertainment company operating in concerts, theaters, art events, family, and football sectors across Brazil, Argentina, and Chile. It is one of the largest live entertainment companies in Latin America and the world.

companies.name: TANLA
companies.description: Tanla Platforms Ltd is an Indian multinational communications platform as a service company based in Hyderabad. It provides value-added cloud communication services and has offices in Singapore and Dubai. The company is listed on Indian stock exchanges BSE and NSE.

companies.name: Tat Technologies Ltd
companies.description: TAT Technologies Ltd. is a publicly traded company headquartered in the United States. It provides environmental control products and services for the commercial and military aviation industries. The company’s shares are traded on the NASDAQ Capital Market and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

companies.name: TCF Financial Corporation
companies.description: TCF Financial Corporation was an American national bank based in Wayzata, Minnesota. It operated as a holding company until 2019, when it was acquired by Chemical Financial Corporation, which then adopted the TCF name.

companies.name: TD Ameritrade
companies.description: TD Ameritrade Holding Corporation was a stockbroker in the United States offering an electronic trading platform for financial assets. The company was acquired by Charles Schwab Corporation in 2020.

companies.name: TI Group
companies.description: TI Group plc was a holding company for specialized engineering companies based in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, United Kingdom. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange and was once part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: TPI Polene
companies.description: TPI Polene Public Company Limited is Thailand's third largest cement manufacturer. The company also produces petrochemicals such as low-density polyethylene and ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer.

companies.name: TSYS
companies.description: Total System Services, Inc. (TSYS) is an American financial technology company based in Columbus, Georgia. It provides payment processing, merchant services, prepaid debit cards, payroll cards, and demand deposit accounts to the underbanked.

companies.name: OMX Stockholm 30
companies.description: The OMX Stockholm 30 (OMXS30) is a stock market index representing the 30 largest and most traded stocks on the Nasdaq Stockholm stock exchange. It is a price return and modified free float capitalization-weighted index.

companies.name: Takara Holdings
companies.description: Takara Holdings is a Japanese company based in Kyoto. It is involved in the production of beverages, food, printing, and medical supplies.

companies.name: Express Scripts
companies.description: Express Scripts Holding Company is a pharmacy benefit management organization in the United States. Since December 2018, it has been a direct subsidiary of Cigna, based in Bloomfield, Connecticut.

companies.name: Morphosys
companies.description: MorphoSys AG is a German biopharmaceutical company headquartered near Munich. It develops proprietary and partnered drug candidates using antibody, protein, and peptide technologies, focusing on cancer and autoimmune diseases.

companies.name: Targanta Therapeutics Corporation
companies.description: Targanta Therapeutics Corporation was a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, with operations in Indianapolis, Montreal, and Toronto. It completed its initial public offering in 2007 and was acquired by The Medicines Company in 2009.

companies.name: Taseko Mines
companies.description: Taseko Mines Limited is a mid-tier copper producer located in British Columbia, Canada. It operates the Gibraltar Mine, the second largest open-pit copper mine in Canada, and is planning several other mines including Prosperity, Harmony, and Aley.

companies.name: Tassal
companies.description: Tassal is a Canadian-owned aquaculture company with main operations in Tasmania. Founded in 1986, it was the largest producer of Tasmanian grown Atlantic salmon and was acquired by Canadian seafood company Cooke Inc. in 2022.

companies.name: MSCI
companies.description: MSCI Inc. is an American finance company headquartered in New York City. It provides global equity, fixed income, real estate indices, portfolio analysis tools, and ESG and climate finance products, operating well-known indices like MSCI World and MSCI Emerging Markets.

companies.name: Taylor Morrison
companies.description: Taylor Morrison Home Corporation is a large home building company in the United States headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona. Formed in 2007 by the merger of Taylor Woodrow and Morrison Homes, it operates in twelve states building homes for sale and rent, including resort-style and build-to-rent communities.

companies.name: TechTarget
companies.description: TechTarget, Inc. is an American company that provides data-driven marketing services to business-to-business technology vendors.

companies.name: Tecumseh Products
companies.description: Tecumseh Products Company is an American manufacturer of hermetic compressors for air conditioning and refrigeration products. Its corporate offices are located in Ann Arbor, Michigan.

companies.name: Tejarat Bank
companies.description: Bank Tejarat is a significant bank in Iran headquartered in Tehran. It was formed in 1979 by merging several institutions, including Bank Bazargani, the domestic successor of the Imperial Bank of Persia since 1952.

companies.name: Tejon Ranch
companies.description: Tejon Ranch Company is based in Lebec, California, and is one of the largest private landowners in California. Incorporated in 1936, it consolidated ownership of a large tract of land acquired from four Mexican land grants dating back to the 1850s and 1860s.

companies.name: TTEC
companies.description: TTEC Holdings, Inc. is an American customer experience technology and services company headquartered in Austin, Texas.

companies.name: Telecom Plus
companies.description: Telecom Plus plc is a British multi-utility supplier offering gas, electricity, home insurance, and telecommunications services including landline, broadband, and mobile to residences and businesses. It operates under the consumer brand Utility Warehouse and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Teledyne Technologies
companies.description: Teledyne Technologies Incorporated is an American industrial conglomerate founded in 1960 by Henry Singleton and George Kozmetsky. The company operates in various industrial sectors and is based in the United States.

companies.name: Teleflex
companies.description: Teleflex Incorporated is an American medical device manufacturer headquartered in Wayne, Pennsylvania. It provides specialty medical devices for critical care and surgery, operates in 40 countries, and has undergone significant realignment to focus on its medical-device business.

companies.name: Telephone and Data Systems
companies.description: Telephone and Data Systems, Inc. is an American telecommunications service company offering broadband, cable, telephone, wireless services, and radio tower leasing through subsidiaries including TDS Telecom and Array Digital Infrastructure.

companies.name: Telesystems International Wireless
companies.description: Telesystem International Wireless was a Canadian holding company with global investments in mobile communications operators. Its shares were listed on the Montreal Exchange, Toronto Stock Exchange, and NASDAQ.

companies.name: Telos
companies.description: Telos Corporation is an information technology and cybersecurity company based in Ashburn, Virginia. It primarily serves government and enterprise clients, including military, intelligence, and civilian agencies of the U.S. government and NATO allies.

companies.name: Telus Digital
companies.description: Telus Digital is a Canadian business process outsourcing and technology company, subsidiary of Telus Corporation. It provides services in customer experience management, digital solutions, artificial intelligence, data, and trust, safety, and security.

companies.name: Xperi Corporation
companies.description: Xperi Inc. is an American multinational technology company headquartered in San Jose, California. It develops software for consumer electronics and connected cars, and media platforms for video service over broadband, with brands including DTS, HD Radio, and TiVo.

companies.name: Tetra Tech
companies.description: Tetra Tech, Inc. is an American consulting and engineering services firm based in Pasadena, California. It provides services in water, environment, infrastructure, resource management, energy, and international development.

companies.name: Texas Pacific Land Trust
companies.description: The Texas Pacific Land Corporation is a publicly traded real estate operating company based in Dallas, Texas. It owns over 880,000 acres in 20 West Texas counties and is one of the largest private landowners in Texas.

companies.name: Texas Roadhouse
companies.description: Texas Roadhouse is an American steakhouse chain specializing in Texan and Southwestern style steaks. It is a subsidiary of Texas Roadhouse Inc and is headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky. The chain operates over 800 locations, including domestic and international sites.

companies.name: Thai Rubber Latex Group PLC.
companies.description: Thai Rubber Latex Group is a manufacturer and exporter based in Thailand. The company produces latex concentrate, disposable rubber gloves, extruded rubber thread, talcum coated rubber thread, and various rubber products.

companies.name: Thai Union Group
companies.description: Thai Union Group PCL is a Thailand-based producer of seafood products. Founded in 1977, it was listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand in 1994.

companies.name: TheStreet
companies.description: TheStreet is a financial news and literacy website based in the United States. It is a subsidiary of The Arena Group and offers free content as well as subscription services like TheStreet Pro, a stock recommendation portfolio.

companies.name: The Andersons
companies.description: The Andersons, Inc. is an American agribusiness headquartered in Maumee, Ohio. Established in 1947, it operates in commodity merchandising, renewables, and plant nutrient sectors.

companies.name: Spectrum Brands
companies.description: Spectrum Brands Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational consumer products conglomerate headquartered in Middleton, Wisconsin. It was established in 2005 as the successor to Rayovac Corporation.

companies.name: The Bon-Ton
companies.description: Bonton Holdings Inc., operating as Bonton, is an American former department store chain founded in 1898. The name is now used for an e-commerce website.

companies.name: The Brick
companies.description: The Brick Ltd. is a Canadian retailer of furniture, mattresses, appliances, and home electronics. Founded by the Comrie brothers in 1971, it opened its first warehouse in Edmonton, Alberta, and later expanded to other locations.

companies.name: The Container Store
companies.description: The Container Store Group, Inc. was an American specialty retail chain offering storage and organization products and custom closets. It was acquired by Bed Bath & Beyond, Inc. in 2026 with plans to rebrand its locations.

companies.name: Univar Solutions
companies.description: Univar Solutions Inc. is a global chemical and ingredients distributor based in the United States. The company also provides value-added services.

companies.name: Yuexiu Property
companies.description: Yuexiu Property Company Limited is a property developer based in Guangdong, China. It is majorly owned by Guangzhou Yuexiu Holdings Limited, the investment corporation of the Guangzhou Government in Hong Kong. The company focuses on real estate development.

companies.name: The Fresh Market
companies.description: The Fresh Market, Inc. is an American supermarket chain headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina. It operates retail stores offering a variety of grocery products. The company is known for its supermarket operations in the United States.

companies.name: THG
companies.description: THG plc, originally The Hut Group, is a global retailer and brand owner headquartered in Manchester, England. It operates mainly online consumer businesses including THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. In 2025, it demerged its technology and logistics arm, THG Ingenuity, into a separate business.

companies.name: The J.M. Smucker Company
companies.description: The J.M. Smucker Company is an American food and beverage manufacturer headquartered in Orrville, Ohio. Founded in 1897, it produces consumer foods, pet foods, and coffee. Its flagship brand, Smucker's, is known for fruit preserves, peanut butter, and syrups.

companies.name: The Knot Worldwide
companies.description: The Knot Worldwide is a technology company operating platforms and brands such as The Knot, WeddingWire, and WeddingPro. It was formed by a merger between The Knot and WeddingWire and provides marketplaces, content, and tools for wedding planning and life celebrations.

companies.name: Grupo Bimbo
companies.description: Grupo Bimbo, S.A.B. de C.V. is a Mexican multinational food company operating in over 33 countries across the Americas, Europe, Asia, and Africa. It is listed on the Mexican Stock Exchange and is recognized as the largest bakery in the world.

companies.name: The North West Company
companies.description: The North West Company Inc. is a Canadian multinational grocery and retail company. It operates stores in western Canada, northern territories, parts of the United States including Alaska and Hawaii, and other countries in Oceania and the Caribbean.

companies.name: The Pantry
companies.description: The Pantry, Inc. was a publicly traded convenience store chain based in Cary, North Carolina. Founded in 1967, it operated Kangaroo Express stores and was publicly traded since 1999. The company had several CEOs including Edwin J. Holman and Dennis Hatchell.

companies.name: The Rouse Company
companies.description: The Rouse Company was a publicly traded shopping mall and community developer in the United States from 1954 until 2004. It was founded in 1939 by Hunter Moss and James Rouse and was acquired by General Growth Properties in 2004.

companies.name: The Vitamin Shoppe
companies.description: The Vitamin Shoppe is a New Jersey-based American retailer specializing in nutritional supplements. It operated stores in Canada under the name VitaPath from 2013 to 2016. The company focuses on health and wellness products.

companies.name: Thompson Creek Metals
companies.description: Thompson Creek Metals Company Inc. was a mining company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It produced copper, gold, and molybdenum, with principal operations including the Mount Milligan mine in British Columbia, Canada. The company owned several mining properties and development projects in North America.

companies.name: Thor Industries
companies.description: Thor Industries, Inc. is an American manufacturer of recreational vehicles headquartered in Elkhart, Indiana. It sells towable and motorized RVs through subsidiaries such as Airstream and Jayco. The company has manufacturing facilities across several U.S. states.

companies.name: Thoratec
companies.description: Thoratec Corporation was a U.S.-based company that developed and marketed medical devices for mechanical circulatory support, including ventricular assist devices for advanced heart failure patients. It specialized in healthcare technology for cardiac treatment.

companies.name: Tiangong International
companies.description: Tiangong International Limited is a Chinese company headquartered in Danyang, Jiangsu Province. It produces and sells specialty steel materials, including high-speed steel, die steel, cutting tools, and titanium alloys. Founded in 1984, it is publicly traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Tianjin Development
companies.description: Tianjin Development Holdings Limited is a Chinese conglomerate based in Tianjin. It operates in container terminal operations, toll roads, water supply, electric utilities, pharmaceuticals, and property development. In 2005, it spun off Tianjin Port Development for separate listing.

companies.name: Tianjin Port Development
companies.description: Tianjin Port Development Holdings Limited provides port services at Tianjin Port, including container stacking, warehousing, and stevedoring. It is a subsidiary of Tianjin Development and focuses on port operations in China.

companies.name: Tianjin TEDA Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Tianjin TEDA Co., Ltd. is a Chinese conglomerate based in Tianjin engaged in diverse businesses such as garments, ecological products, transportation, medicines, and nutrition products. It operates across multiple sectors within China.

companies.name: Tillys
companies.description: Tillys is an American retail clothing company headquartered in Irvine, California. It sells branded apparel, accessories, and shoes. The company operates in the retail sector focusing on fashion products.

companies.name: Atlantic Petroleum
companies.description: Atlantic Petroleum P/F is an oil and gas company based in Tórshavn, Faroe Islands, with technical offices in London and Bergen. It participates in exploration and production activities on the Faroese Continental Shelf and in the North Sea, including development projects.

companies.name: Titan Machinery
companies.description: Titan Machinery, Inc. is a major dealer of agricultural and construction equipment based in West Fargo, North Dakota. It operates locations across the Midwestern United States, Australia, and several European countries. The company is known as the largest dealer for CNH Industrial brands worldwide.

companies.name: Titan Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Titan Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It develops proprietary therapeutics mainly for central nervous system disorders. The company completed an IPO in 2018 and licenses intellectual property rights for its product Probuphine in Europe.

companies.name: Titan Tire Corporation
companies.description: The Titan Tire Corporation is an American manufacturer of off-road tires, founded in 1993. It expanded by acquiring assets from Pirelli Armstrong Tire Corporation and is one of the largest off-road tire producers in North America. It became a subsidiary of Titan International in 1997.

companies.name: Toagosei
companies.description: Toagosei Co., Ltd. is a Japanese chemical company known for producing cyanoacrylate adhesives since 1963. Its products include high purity gases, soda and chlorine products, and instant glue marketed as Aron Alpha in Japan and Krazy Glue in the United States.

companies.name: Tohoku Bank
companies.description: The Tohoku Bank Limited is a regional bank based in Morioka, Iwate prefecture, Japan. It operates in the Tohoku region and is considered one of the smallest regional banks in Japan.

companies.name: Toll Brothers
companies.description: Toll Brothers, Inc. is an American homebuilding company that constructs, markets, and finances residential and commercial properties across the United States. It was ranked as the fifth largest home builder in the U.S. by revenue in 2020 and is listed on the Fortune 500.

companies.name: Tolypers
companies.description: Tolypers is an Iranian chemical and consumer goods company producing laundry detergent under the same brand name. Its products are sold in Iran and 17 other countries.

companies.name: ICON plc
companies.description: Icon plc is a multinational clinical research organization headquartered in Ireland. It conducts clinical trials and provides drug development services for pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies.

companies.name: Tonghua Grape Wine
companies.description: Tonghua Grape Wine Company, Limited is a Chinese winemaker based in Tonghua, Jilin Province. Established in 1937, the company employs around 1,200 people.

companies.name: Tongling Nonferrous Metals
companies.description: Tongling Nonferrous Metals Group Holding Company Limited is a state-owned Chinese enterprise specializing in copper extraction and smelting of copper and other non-ferrous metals. Founded in 1949 in Tongling, Anhui, it is one of China's largest copper smelting companies.

companies.name: Bank of Ayudhya
companies.description: Bank of Ayudhya Public Company Limited, branded as Krungsri, is the fifth-largest bank in Thailand by assets, loans, and deposits. It is one of Thailand's six Domestic Systemically Important Banks and is a member of the Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group.

companies.name: Globe Life
companies.description: Globe Life Inc. is an American financial services holding company based in McKinney, Texas. It operates through subsidiaries providing life insurance, annuity, and supplemental health insurance products.

companies.name: Torrid
companies.description: Torrid Holdings Inc. is an American women's retail chain offering plus-size clothing and accessories for women size 10-30. It began operations in April 2001 and was formerly owned by Hot Topic, now owned by Sycamore Partners.

companies.name: Tourism Holdings Limited
companies.description: Tourism Holdings Limited is a New Zealand tourism company that started as a scenic helicopter sightseeing business called The Helicopter Line. It is now the world's largest provider of commercial RV rentals with operations in multiple countries and has been listed on the New Zealand Stock Exchange since 1986.

companies.name: Tower Bersama Infrastructure
companies.description: Tower Bersama Group is a telecommunications tower provider based in Indonesia.

companies.name: Tower Semiconductor Ltd.
companies.description: Tower Semiconductor Ltd. is an Israeli company that manufactures integrated circuits using specialty process technologies. It owns 51% of TPSCo, a joint enterprise with Nuvoton Technology Corporation Japan.

companies.name: Townsquare Media
companies.description: Townsquare Media, Inc. is an American radio network and media company based in Purchase, New York. It expanded into digital media in the late 2000s and is the third-largest AM–FM operator in the US, owning 349 radio stations in 74 markets.

companies.name: Toyo Suisan
companies.description: Toyo Suisan Kaisha, Ltd., known as Toyo Suisan, is a Japanese company specializing in ramen noodles through its Maruchan brand, seafood, and frozen and refrigerated foods. It is the fourth-largest transnational seafood corporation.

companies.name: Toyobo
companies.description: Toyobo Co., Ltd. is one of Japan's top makers of fibers and textiles, producing synthetic fibers and natural fibers such as cotton and wool.

companies.name: Tracker Fund of Hong Kong
companies.description: Tracker Fund of Hong Kong (TraHK) is an index exchange-traded fund that provides investment results corresponding to the performance of the Hang Seng Index in the Hong Kong stock market.

companies.name: TransUnion
companies.description: TransUnion is an American consumer credit reporting agency based in Chicago, Illinois. It collects and aggregates information on over one billion consumers across more than thirty countries. It is one of the three largest credit agencies, alongside Experian and Equifax.

companies.name: Broadspectrum
companies.description: Broadspectrum was an Australian and New Zealand company providing infrastructure maintenance services. Formerly listed on the Australian Securities Exchange, it was owned by Ferrovial before being acquired by Ventia. Ventia integrated Broadspectrum alongside Visionstream.

companies.name: Cleanaway Waste Management Limited
companies.description: Cleanaway Waste Management Limited is an Australian waste management company founded in 1979 by Brambles. It operates extensively in Australia with thousands of trucks and branches. It is the largest waste management business in Australia.

companies.name: TravelCenters of America
companies.description: TravelCenters of America LLC is a full-service truck stop and travel center company headquartered in Westlake, Ohio. It operates centers, convenience stores, and restaurants under several brands across 44 U.S. states. The company employs nearly 20,000 people as of 2021.

companies.name: TravelSky
companies.description: TravelSky Technology Limited is the dominant provider of IT services to the Chinese air travel and tourism industries. Its clients include airlines, airports, travel agencies, and cargo services. It is majority owned by the state-owned China TravelSky Holding Company and listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange.

companies.name: Travelzoo
companies.description: Travelzoo Inc. is an Internet company that publishes deals from over 2,000 travel, entertainment, and local businesses. It has 28 million members across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, and operates 25 offices worldwide.

companies.name: Tredegar corporation
companies.description: Tredegar Corporation is a publicly traded manufacturer of plastic films and aluminum extrusions headquartered in Richmond, Virginia. It was formed in 1989 from the spin-off of Ethyl Corporation's aluminium, plastics, and energy units. The energy assets were sold in 1994.

companies.name: Trevena Inc
companies.description: Trevena, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company based in Chesterbrook, Pennsylvania. Founded in 2007 with technology licensed from Duke University, it focuses on developing G-protein coupled receptor biased ligands. Its founders include Nobel Prize winner Robert Lefkowitz.

companies.name: TriNet HR Services
companies.description: TriNet Group, Inc. is a professional employer organization headquartered in Dublin, California. It provides payroll, health benefits administration, and employment law compliance services to small and medium-sized businesses. TriNet partners with organizations employing between 3 and 2,500 people.

companies.name: Trican Well Service
companies.description: Trican Well Service Ltd. is a Canadian oilfield services provider headquartered in Calgary, Alberta. It offers services including acidizing, coiled tubing, fracturing, nitrogen pumping, and cementing. Its operations cover Alberta, British Columbia, and Saskatchewan.

companies.name: Trinity Industries
companies.description: Trinity Industries Inc. is an American industrial corporation that owns various businesses providing products and services to the industrial, energy, transportation, and construction sectors. It is based in the United States and operates as a conglomerate.

companies.name: Trulia
companies.description: Trulia is an American online real estate marketplace and a subsidiary of Zillow. It helps buyers and renters find homes and neighborhoods across the United States using recommendations, local insights, and map overlays with details on commute, schools, and nearby businesses.

companies.name: Trupanion
companies.description: Trupanion, Inc. is a pet insurance provider headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Founded in 1998, it operates in the United States, Canada, Australia, and Puerto Rico, offering coverage for pets and is self-underwritten by the American Pet Insurance Company.

companies.name: AutoNation
companies.description: AutoNation, Inc. is an American automotive retailer based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Founded in 1996 by Wayne Huizenga, it provides new and pre-owned vehicles and related services across the United States with over 300 retail outlets.

companies.name: TrustCo Bank
companies.description: Trustco Bank is the sole subsidiary of Trustco Bank Corp NY, an American bank holding company based in Glenville, New York. Founded in 1902 in Schenectady, it operates 146 branches across New York, Florida, Massachusetts, New Jersey, and Vermont.

companies.name: Tsim Sha Tsui Properties Limited
companies.description: Tsim Sha Tsui Properties Limited is part of Sino Group, a Hong Kong-based conglomerate established in 1971. Sino Group includes three listed companies and private companies held by the Ng Family, operating in real estate.

companies.name: TubeMogul
companies.description: TubeMogul is an enterprise software company specializing in brand advertising. It is based in the United States and operates in the AI and software industry.

companies.name: Tuesday Morning
companies.description: Tuesday Morning Corporation is an American online household merchandise discount home goods store headquartered in Dallas, Texas. Founded in 1974, it once operated over 700 locations across the United States.

companies.name: Tufin
companies.description: Tufin is a network security policy management company founded in 2005 with operations in the United States and internationally. In 2022, it was acquired by Turn/River Capital and became a private company.

companies.name: Turtle Beach Systems
companies.description: Turtle Beach Corporation is an American gaming accessory manufacturer based in San Diego, California. Originating in the 1970s with sound cards and audio devices, it began producing gaming headsets in 2005.

companies.name: Tutor Perini
companies.description: Tutor Perini Corporation is one of the largest general contractors in the United States. Headquartered in Sylmar, California, it was formed by the merger of Perini Corporation and Tutor-Saliba Corporation in 2008. The company focuses on civil infrastructure, building infrastructure, and specialty contracting across North America and some international locations.

companies.name: Twilio
companies.description: Twilio Inc. is an American cloud communications and customer engagement company based in San Francisco, California. Founded in 2008, it provides programmable communication tools such as phone calls, text messaging, and conversational AI via web service APIs. Twilio has acquired companies including Authy and SendGrid since 2015.

companies.name: Twinbird Corporation
companies.description: Twinbird Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of household electric products founded in 1951. It is headquartered in Tsubame City, Niigata Prefecture, Japan. As of 2010, the company employed 284 people and was led by President Shigekatsu Nomizu.

companies.name: Tyro Payments
companies.description: Tyro Payments Limited is an Australian payments financial institution specializing in merchant credit, debit, and EFTPOS acquiring. It operates within the banking and fintech industry in Australia.

companies.name: U.S. Century Bank
companies.description: U.S. Century Bank is a community bank headquartered in Doral, Miami-Dade County, Florida. It operates as a Minority Depository Institution with a branch network in Miami-Dade and Broward counties. The bank is a member of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.

companies.name: UBC Media Group
companies.description: UBC Media Group was a production and content creation company that began as the Unique Broadcasting Company in 1989. In June 2014, it merged with 7digital to form 7digital Group Plc, a global digital music and radio platform.

companies.name: UBM Information Ltd.
companies.description: UBM plc was a British business-to-business events organizer headquartered in London, England. It operated in live media, communications, marketing services, and data provision, serving various industries. UBM was listed on the London Stock Exchange before its acquisition by Informa in 2018.

companies.name: UIL Holdings Corporation
companies.description: UIL Holdings Corporation was a diversified energy delivery company serving electric and natural gas utility customers in 66 communities across two states. It merged with Iberdrola USA in 2015 to form Avangrid.

companies.name: UMB Financial Corporation
companies.description: UMB Financial Corporation is an American financial services company headquartered in Kansas City, Missouri. It offers deposit solutions, credit services, investing, and wealth management to individuals, companies, and institutions in the U.S. and Ireland.

companies.name: Autogrill
companies.description: Autogrill S.p.A. is an Italian multinational catering company controlled by the Benetton family's Edizione Holding. It operates primarily in airport terminals and motorway service areas, which account for over 90% of its business.

companies.name: Autoliv
companies.description: Autoliv AB is a Swedish automotive safety supplier founded in 1953 and headquartered in Stockholm. It is the world’s largest supplier of automotive safety systems, producing airbags, seatbelts, and steering wheels for car manufacturers.

companies.name: BEA Systems
companies.description: BEA Systems, Inc. was a company specializing in enterprise infrastructure software products. It was wholly acquired by Oracle Corporation on April 29, 2008.

companies.name: UTStarcom
companies.description: UTStarcom Holdings Corp. is a Chinese global telecom infrastructure provider headquartered in Beijing. It supplies telecommunication devices to fixed and mobile network operators and enterprises, with markets in China, Japan, India, Africa, Central and Latin America, and the Middle East.

companies.name: Ulta Beauty
companies.description: Ulta Beauty, Inc. is an American chain of cosmetic stores headquartered in Bolingbrook, Illinois. It offers a wide range of cosmetics, fragrances, nail, bath and body products, beauty tools, and haircare products, with nearly every store featuring a full-service salon.

companies.name: UltraTech Cement
companies.description: UltraTech Cement Limited is an Indian multinational cement company based in Mumbai. It is the largest manufacturer of grey cement, ready-mix concrete, and white cement in India and ranks fifth largest worldwide.

companies.name: Ultrasis
companies.description: Ultrasis Group Plc was a UK-based healthcare company that developed computerized healthcare products based on Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT). The company was dissolved in 2017.

companies.name: Life Storage
companies.description: Life Storage, Inc. was a real estate investment trust headquartered in Williamsville, New York, investing in self storage units. The company was acquired by Extra Space Storage in July 2023.

companies.name: UniFirst
companies.description: UniFirst Corporation is an American uniform rental company based in Wilmington, Massachusetts. It manufactures, sells, and rents uniforms and protective clothing, operating over 260 facilities across the US, Canada, and Europe.

companies.name: Unify Corporation
companies.description: Unify Corporation, originally known as Daegis Inc., is a software company founded in 1980 and headquartered in Irving, Texas. It developed database management systems and 4th-generation programming language tools for Unix and later released a cross-platform development tool called VISION supporting Windows, Linux, and Unix.

companies.name: Union Gas
companies.description: Union Gas Limited was a major Canadian natural gas company based in Ontario. It serviced about 1.5 million customers in various regions of Ontario and has been a subsidiary of Enbridge since 2017 following a merger with Spectra Energy.

companies.name: United Community Bank
companies.description: United Community is an American bank headquartered in South Carolina and one of the largest full-service financial institutions in the Southeast. It operates 200 offices across six states and is the largest bank headquartered in South Carolina by total asset size.

companies.name: Cogeco
companies.description: Cogeco Inc. is a Canadian telecommunications and media company headquartered in Montreal, Quebec. It operates three business units providing cable television, radio and TV broadcasting, telephony, and Internet services in Ontario, Quebec, and thirteen U.S. states along the east coast.

companies.name: United Natural Foods
companies.description: United Natural Foods, Inc. (UNFI) is a natural and organic food wholesale distributor based in Providence, Rhode Island. It is the largest publicly traded distributor of health and specialty food in the U.S. and Canada and is a main supplier to Whole Foods Market.

companies.name: Rex Airlines
companies.description: Rex Airlines Pty Ltd is an Australian regional airline based in Mascot, New South Wales. It operates scheduled regional turboprop services and briefly operated jet services between major Australian cities. The airline entered voluntary administration in 2024 and exited after acquisition in 2025.

companies.name: Essendant
companies.description: Essendant Inc., formerly United Stationers, is a national wholesale distributor of office supplies headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois. It serves 30,000 reseller customers with over 160,000 products including office, janitorial, industrial, and technology supplies, and has operations in Dubai.

companies.name: Unitika
companies.description: Unitika Ltd is a Japanese company based in Osaka that produces textiles, glass, plastics, and carbon fiber products. It is also known for films used in consumer products such as athletic apparel and food packaging.

companies.name: Universal Forest Products
companies.description: UFP Industries, Inc. is a holding company headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan, serving retail, industrial, and construction markets. It operates 218 affiliated operations supplying tens of thousands of products across its retail, construction, and packaging segments.

companies.name: Upstart Holdings
companies.description: Upstart is a lending platform based in San Mateo, California, launched in 2012. Initially offering Income Share Agreements, it pivoted in 2014 to personal loan products including traditional 3-year and 5-year loans.

companies.name: UrtheCast
companies.description: Urthecast was a Canadian company specializing in satellite imaging, data services, and geo-analytics. It operated cameras on the International Space Station and satellites in low Earth orbit. The company filed for creditor protection in 2020 and led to the creation of EarthDaily Analytics in 2021.

companies.name: Utz Brands
companies.description: Utz Brands, Inc. is an American snack food company based in Hanover, Pennsylvania. It produces a variety of snacks including potato chips and pretzels, and supplies snacks to warehouse clubs and merchandisers.

companies.name: Avex Group
companies.description: Avex Inc. is a Japanese entertainment conglomerate headquartered in Tokyo, founded in 1988. It manages J-pop talents and has expanded into anime, video games, and live music events. The company is part of the Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group keiretsu.

companies.name: VSE Corporation
companies.description: VSE Corporation provides aftermarket distribution and repair services, enhancing productivity and longevity of business-critical assets. It operates aviation and fleet segments, offering parts distribution, maintenance, and supply chain management services.

companies.name: VWR International
companies.description: VWR International is an American distributor of research laboratory products headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. It serves government, biotechnology, life science, education, electronics, and pharmaceutical sectors, operating in 25 countries as of 2010.

companies.name: Vaalco Energy
companies.description: VAALCO Energy is a hydrocarbon exploration company organized in Delaware and headquartered in Houston, Texas. Its operations are primarily in the Etame Marin block offshore Gabon.

companies.name: Valley National Bank
companies.description: Valley National Bancorp, known as Valley Bank, is a regional bank holding company headquartered in Morristown, New Jersey. It operates over 230 branches across several U.S. states and is one of the largest commercial banks headquartered in New Jersey.

companies.name: Valmont Industries
companies.description: Valmont Industries, Inc. is a large American manufacturer of irrigation equipment, windmill support structures, lighting and traffic poles, and steel utility poles.

companies.name: Vector Group
companies.description: Vector Group Ltd. was an American diversified holding company with major businesses including Liggett Group (tobacco) and New Valley. In 2024, it was acquired by Japan Tobacco to become a wholly owned subsidiary.

companies.name: Vector Limited
companies.description: Vector Limited is a New Zealand energy company that operates a portfolio of businesses delivering energy and communication services across Australasia and the Pacific. Its primary business includes electricity and piped gas distribution. The company also owns a fibre optic cable network and offers cybersecurity services and a data platform.

companies.name: Vectren
companies.description: Vectren Corporation was a Fortune 1000 energy holding company based in Evansville, Indiana. It distributed natural gas and electricity to customers in Indiana and Ohio and operated coal-fired generating capacity. The company also provided energy-related products and services throughout the Midwest and Southeast.

companies.name: Veloxis Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Veloxis Pharmaceuticals A/S is a Danish pharmaceutical company focused on developing improved drug formulations using its MeltDose® technology. It is building a clinical and market-stage business around its transplant immunosuppression product candidate LCP-Tacro. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Hørsholm, Denmark.

companies.name: Vera Bradley
companies.description: Vera Bradley Sales, LLC is an American travel gear design company founded in 1982 and based in Roanoke, Indiana. It produces luxury cotton bags and has expanded into fashion, home accessories, office supplies, and patterned gifts. The company is known for its distinctive floral and geometric prints inspired by French Provençal fabrics.

companies.name: Verenium Corporation
companies.description: Verenium Corporation was a San Diego-based industrial biotechnology company founded in 2007 from a merger. It specialized in developing high performance enzymes for industrial applications such as biofuel generation and hydraulic fracturing. The company was acquired by BASF in 2013.

companies.name: Veresen
companies.description: Veresen Inc. was a Calgary, Alberta-based energy infrastructure company with businesses in pipelines, natural gas, and power generation. It was publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange and was formerly known as Fort Chicago Energy Partners L.P. In 2017, it was acquired by Pembina Pipeline.

companies.name: Verint Systems
companies.description: Verint Systems Inc. is a technology company based in Melville, New York, that provides products and services for customer experience automation. Its offerings include AI, advanced analytics, and automated workflows to analyze business intelligence from customer interactions across various channels. The company helps organizations improve productivity and service quality.

companies.name: Verisk Analytics
companies.description: Verisk Analytics, Inc. is an American multinational data analytics and risk assessment firm headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey. Its services cover fraud prevention, actuarial science, insurance coverage, fire protection, catastrophe and weather risk, and data management.

companies.name: Billerud
companies.description: Verso Corporation, now Billerud Americas Corporation, was an American producer of coated papers including coated groundwood and specialty products. The company restructured in 2016 following Chapter 11 bankruptcy and operated two paper mills in the U.S.

companies.name: Viasat
companies.description: Viasat, Inc. is an American satellite communications company headquartered in Carlsbad, California. It provides satellite broadband and narrowband connectivity and communications equipment for various sectors including commercial aviation, maritime, enterprise, consumer, military, and government. The company operates satellites in multiple frequency bands and uses partner satellite networks.

companies.name: Grupo Casas Bahia
companies.description: Grupo Casas Bahia is a Brazilian retail company formed in 2010 through the merger of Casas Bahia and Ponto, owned by the Klein family and Grupo Pão de Açúcar respectively. It operates in the retail sector in Brazil.

companies.name: Axfood
companies.description: Axfood AB is a Swedish retail company created in May 2000 by merging several grocery store chains including Hemköp and Spar Sverige. It operates primarily in Sweden's grocery retail market.

companies.name: Vicor Corporation
companies.description: Vicor Corporation is a manufacturer of power modules headquartered in Andover, Massachusetts, United States. It operates in the electronics industry.

companies.name: Victrex
companies.description: Victrex plc is a British supplier of high performance polymers with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in the UK. It serves industries such as aerospace, automotive, and medical across more than 40 countries.

companies.name: Vigor S.A.
companies.description: Vigor S.A. is a Brazilian dairy and food company headquartered in São Paulo. It is the sixth largest dairy company in Brazil and a subsidiary of Mexican firm Grupo Lala.

companies.name: Viktor Lenac Shipyard
companies.description: The Viktor Lenac Shipyard is located on the northern Croatian Adriatic coast near the largest Croatian port. Founded in 1896, it was among the first to perform ship lengthenings and is listed on the Zagreb Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Vinda International
companies.description: Vinda International Holdings Limited is a major Asian hygiene company specializing in tissue paper and personal care products. Founded in 1985, it operates in multiple Asian markets and several countries worldwide.

companies.name: Virtu Financial
companies.description: Virtu Financial, Inc. is an American electronic market making company headquartered in Manhattan, New York City. It operates in the financial services sector.

companies.name: Virtus Investment Partners
companies.description: Virtus Investment Partners, Inc. is an American multi-manager asset management company comprising affiliated managers with distinct investment processes and brands, as well as unaffiliated sub advisers.

companies.name: Vista Entertainment Solutions
companies.description: Vista Group International Limited is a multinational technology company providing software for film distribution, exhibition, and analytics. It has over 700 staff worldwide and its software is installed in cinemas across 116 countries.

companies.name: Vitacost
companies.description: Vitacost.com, Inc. is an American e-commerce company based in Boca Raton, Florida. It sells vitamins, supplements, and organic grocery products. The company was acquired by iHerb on January 8, 2026.

companies.name: Vitesse Semiconductor
companies.description: Vitesse Semiconductor was a fabless American semiconductor company based in Camarillo, California. It developed high-performance Ethernet integrated circuit solutions for carrier and enterprise networks. The company was acquired by Microsemi Corporation in 2015.

companies.name: Vivus
companies.description: Vivus is a small pharmaceutical company headquartered in Campbell, California. It specializes in obesity, sleep, and sexual health, and developed Avanafil, an FDA-approved erectile dysfunction drug sold under the name Stendra.

companies.name: VocalTec
companies.description: VocalTec Communications Inc. is an Israeli telecom equipment provider founded in 1985. The company patented the first Voice over IP audio transceiver and has supplied major customers such as Deutsche Telekom and Telecom Italia.

companies.name: Vringo
companies.description: Vringo was a technology company involved in worldwide patent litigation, including a notable 2012 lawsuit against Google. The company pursued intellectual property cases against multiple large corporations across various countries.

companies.name: Vulcabras
companies.description: Vulcabrasǀazaleia is a Brazilian footwear company founded in 1952 and currently headquartered in Jundiaí. It is the third largest footwear company in the domestic market and Latin America.

companies.name: Vuzix
companies.description: Vuzix Corporation is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Rochester, New York. It supplies smartglasses and augmented reality display technology for applications including gaming, training, and military use.

companies.name: WABCO Holdings, Inc.
companies.description: WABCO Holdings, Inc. was a U.S.-based provider of electronic braking, stability, suspension, and transmission automation systems for heavy-duty commercial vehicles. It was acquired by ZF Friedrichshafen in May 2020.

companies.name: WESCO International
companies.description: Wesco International, Inc. is a publicly traded American holding company for Wesco Distribution. It is an electrical distribution and services company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

companies.name: CNOOC Limited
companies.description: CNOOC Limited is China's largest producer of offshore crude oil and natural gas. It is a major subsidiary of China National Offshore Oil Corporation and has been listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 2001. The company was also listed on the New York and Toronto Stock Exchanges until 2021 and is part of the Hang Seng Index.

companies.name: Rinnai
companies.description: Rinnai Corporation is a Japanese multinational company based in Nagoya, Japan. It manufactures gas appliances including energy-efficient tankless water heaters, home heating and kitchen appliances, as well as commercial-use equipment like rice cookers and grillers.

companies.name: WNS Global Services
companies.description: WNS (Holdings) Limited is a global business process management company and a subsidiary of Capgemini. It operates in finance and accounting, customer service, procurement, and data analytics. The company is headquartered in New York, London, and Mumbai.

companies.name: WOW!
companies.description: WideOpenWest, Inc. is the eighth largest cable operator in the United States, with a network passing 1.9 million homes and businesses. The company offers landline telephone, broadband Internet services, and cable television.

companies.name: WPCS International
companies.description: WPCS International Incorporated is an American design-build engineering firm headquartered in Exton, Pennsylvania. It focuses on wireless network deployment and related services including site design, technology integration, electrical contracting, construction, and maintenance. WPCS serves sectors such as public services, healthcare, alternative energy, and commercial wireless carriers.

companies.name: Samsara
companies.description: Samsara Inc. is an American IoT company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It provides telematics software and insights for physical operations across North America and Europe. Samsara developed a connected operations cloud platform supporting industries like transportation, construction, energy, utilities, public sector, and retail.

companies.name: Tata Consumer Products
companies.description: Tata Consumer Products Limited is an Indian fast-moving consumer goods company and part of the Tata Group. Its registered office is in Kolkata and corporate headquarters in Mumbai. It is the world's second-largest manufacturer and distributor of tea and a major coffee producer.

companies.name: Sophia Genetics
companies.description: Sophia Genetics SA is a Swiss-founded data-driven medicine software company with headquarters in Rolle, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts. It also has offices in France and provides genomic, radiomic, and multimodal analysis for hospitals, laboratories, and biopharma institutions.

companies.name: Waddell & Reed
companies.description: Waddell & Reed Financial, Inc. was an American asset management and financial planning company founded in 1937 in Kansas City, Missouri. It operated asset management and distribution subsidiaries including Ivy Investment Management Company and Waddell & Reed Investment Management Company. The company was publicly traded from 1998 to 2021.

companies.name: São Paulo Stock Exchange
companies.description: B3 S.A. – Brasil, Bolsa, Balcão, formerly BM&FBOVESPA, is a stock exchange located in São Paulo, Brazil. It is the second oldest stock exchange in the country.

companies.name: Want Want China
companies.description: Want Want China Holdings Ltd. is a Chinese company that manufactures, distributes, and sells snacks, beverages, and other products. It is one of the largest rice cracker and flavored drink manufacturers in the world. The company is a subsidiary of Want Want Holdings Limited.

companies.name: Warby Parker
companies.description: Warby Parker Inc. is an American eyewear brand and retailer headquartered in New York City. It sells prescription glasses, contact lenses, and sunglasses, and also offers eye exams. The company was founded in 2010 as an online-only retailer but now generates most revenue from physical stores.

companies.name: Warnaco Group
companies.description: The Warnaco Group, Inc. was an American textile and clothing corporation that designed, sourced, marketed, licensed, and distributed underwear, sportswear, and swimwear worldwide. Its products were sold under brand names including Calvin Klein, Speedo, Chaps, Warner's, and Olga.

companies.name: S&P BSE Sensex
companies.description: The BSE SENSEX is an Indian stock market index of 30 well-established and financially sound companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange. It represents various industrial sectors of the Indian economy and has been published since January 1, 1986. It is regarded as the pulse of domestic stock markets in India.

companies.name: BTA Bank
companies.description: BTA Bank is a Kazakhstan-based bank headquartered in Almaty. It was the third largest lender by assets as of 2013. In 2009, the bank was involved in one of the world's biggest financial frauds totaling US$5 billion.

companies.name: BTG
companies.description: BTG Limited is a UK-based international specialist healthcare company developing and commercializing products targeting critical care, cancer, and other disorders. It adopted its current name in 1998 after changing from British Technology Group. BTG was part of the FTSE 250 Index until its acquisition by Boston Scientific in 2019.

companies.name: WaFd Bank
companies.description: WaFd Bank is a regional bank headquartered in Seattle, Washington, USA. It operates 210 branches across several states including Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Nevada, Utah, Arizona, New Mexico, California, and Texas. It is listed among the largest banks in the United States.

companies.name: Washington H. Soul Pattinson
companies.description: Washington H. Soul Pattinson and Company Limited, trading as Soul Patts, is an Australian investment company. It originated from pharmacy operations and has evolved into a diversified investment company with a portfolio across various asset classes.

companies.name: Watsco
companies.description: Watsco, Inc. is a US-based distributor of air conditioning, heating, and refrigeration equipment and related parts and supplies. Founded over 60 years ago as a manufacturer in the HVAC/R industry, it shifted to distribution in 1989 by acquiring Gemaire Distributors Inc., a Rheem distributor in South Florida.

companies.name: Babcock & Wilcox
companies.description: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises, Inc. is an American energy technology and service provider headquartered in Akron, Ohio. The company operates internationally and is historically known for its steam boilers.

companies.name: Mecklermedia
companies.description: Mecklermedia was a U.S.-based corporation headquartered in New York. Founded by Alan M. Meckler and Tristan Louis, it provided business-to-business services including recruitment and event promotion for creative, business, and IT professionals.

companies.name: Webjet Limited
companies.description: Webjet is an Australian online travel agency established in 1998 by former Jetset Travel executives. It allows users to book airline tickets and hotel reservations and is currently owned by Webjet Group after a 2024 demerger.

companies.name: Webster Bank
companies.description: Webster Bank is an American commercial bank based in Stamford, Connecticut. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of Santander Bank, N.A. since 2026, with branches and ATMs across several northeastern states.

companies.name: Weis Markets
companies.description: Weis Markets, Inc. is an American food retailer headquartered in Sunbury, Pennsylvania. It operates 200 stores with over 23,000 employees across multiple states including Pennsylvania, Maryland, and New York.

companies.name: WellCare
companies.description: WellCare Health Plans, Inc. is an American health insurance company providing managed care services primarily through Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, and Medicare Prescription Drug plans across the United States.

companies.name: WesBanco
companies.description: WesBanco, Inc. is a bank holding company headquartered in Wheeling, West Virginia. It operates over 200 branches in West Virginia, Ohio, Western Pennsylvania, Kentucky, Maryland, and Southern Indiana.

companies.name: West Coast Bancorp
companies.description: West Coast Bancorp was a publicly traded financial services holding company based in Lake Oswego, Oregon. Its main holding was West Coast Bank with 63 branches in Oregon and Washington before being acquired by Columbia Banking System in 2012.

companies.name: West Marine
companies.description: West Marine is an American company based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, operating a chain of boating supply and fishing retail stores. It has 247 stores in North America and runs Blue Future, a nonprofit organization.

companies.name: Evergy
companies.description: Evergy, Inc. is an American investor-owned utility headquartered in Topeka, Kansas, and Kansas City, Missouri. Formed from a merger, it is the largest electric company in Kansas serving over 1.7 million customers with more than 40 power plants.

companies.name: Westell Technologies, Inc.
companies.description: Westell Technologies, Inc. is an Aurora, Illinois company providing telecommunications equipment for wireless and site management solutions. It was the last U.S. manufacturer of DSL modems before announcing plans to outsource manufacturing in 2007.

companies.name: Western Refining
companies.description: Western Refining, Inc. is a Texas-based crude oil refiner and marketer operating mainly in the Southwestern, North-Central, and Mid-Atlantic regions of the United States. It is the fourth largest publicly traded independent refiner and marketer in the nation and has been listed on the New York Stock Exchange since 2006.

companies.name: Westport Fuel Systems
companies.description: Westport Fuel Systems Inc. is a Canadian company that develops alternative fuel and low-emissions technologies. It enables engines to operate on clean-burning fuels such as compressed natural gas, liquefied natural gas, hydrogen, and biofuels like landfill gas.

companies.name: Westshore Terminals
companies.description: Westshore Terminals is a tenant at Roberts Bank, a twin-terminal port facility located in Delta, British Columbia, Canada. The port opened in 1970 with Westshore Terminals as its only tenant and expanded with a second terminal in 1997.

companies.name: Widmer Brothers Brewery
companies.description: Widmer Brothers is a brewery founded in 1984 in Portland, Oregon, by brothers Kurt and Robert Widmer. It is part of the Craft Brew Alliance, which was the 12th largest brewing company in the United States in 2017.

companies.name: Willamette Valley Vineyards
companies.description: Willamette Valley Vineyards is an American winery located in Turner, Oregon, named after the Willamette Valley. It is the leading producer of Willamette Valley-appellated Pinot Noir and was the largest producer of Riesling wine in the Willamette Valley in 2016.

companies.name: Bahnhof
companies.description: Bahnhof is a Swedish Internet service provider founded in 1994 by Oscar Swartz in Uppsala, Sweden. It was the country's first independent ISP and is now represented in multiple Swedish cities. The company is listed on Nasdaq First North.

companies.name: Huayi Brothers
companies.description: Huayi Brothers Media Corp. is a Chinese entertainment conglomerate founded in 1994 by brothers Dennis Wang Zhongjun and James Wang Zhonglei. It became prominent through collaborations with director Feng Xiaogang and was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2009.

companies.name: Wilson, Sons
companies.description: Wilson Sons is a Brazilian shipping company headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. Founded in 1837 by two Scottish brothers, it is one of the oldest private enterprises in Brazil and was later managed by Edward Pellew Wilson Jr.

companies.name: Wing Tai Properties Limited
companies.description: Wing Tai Properties Limited is a Hong Kong-based property developer and hospitality operator. Founded in 1991 and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, it owns tailoring factories and operates hotels under the WingTai Asia and Lanson Place brands.

companies.name: Wingstop
companies.description: Wingstop Inc. is an American international fast food chain that primarily sells Buffalo wings. It operates in the restaurant industry.

companies.name: Winnebago Industries
companies.description: Winnebago Industries, Inc. is an American manufacturer of motorhomes and recreational vehicles. The company expanded into motorboat manufacturing in 2018 by acquiring Chris-Craft Corporation. It has also produced light-to-medium utility vehicles and other products.

companies.name: WisdomTree Investments
companies.description: WisdomTree, Inc. is a global asset manager and sponsor of exchange-traded funds (ETFs) headquartered in New York. It launched its first ETFs in 2006 and offers products across various asset classes and countries worldwide. WisdomTree is a major ETF provider in the United States.

companies.name: Wolfson Microelectronics
companies.description: Wolfson Microelectronics plc was a microelectronics and fabless semiconductor company based in Edinburgh, Scotland. It specialized in signal processing and mixed-signal chips for consumer electronics. The company was acquired by Cirrus Logic in 2014.

companies.name: Wolverine World Wide
companies.description: Wolverine World Wide, Inc. is an American footwear manufacturer headquartered in Rockford, Michigan. It produces footwear under its own brands like Wolverine Boots and Shoes, Hush Puppies, Chaco, and Merrell, as well as licensed footwear for other companies.

companies.name: Woodward
companies.description: Woodward, Inc. is a designer, manufacturer, and service provider of control systems for aircraft, engines, turbines, power generation, and industrial equipment. The company is based in Fort Collins, Colorado and also supplies military and defense equipment.

companies.name: Woolworths
companies.description: Woolworths is a South African multinational retail company headquartered in Cape Town. Founded in 1931, it owns the Woolworths department store and grocery chain, the Australian retailer Country Road, and South Africa's largest pet store chain, Absolute Pets.

companies.name: Workspace Group
companies.description: Workspace Group plc is a real estate investment trust based in London, England. Founded in 1987, it leases office, industrial, and workshop spaces to small and medium-sized enterprises. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Wright Express
companies.description: WEX Inc. provides payment processing and information management services to the commercial and government vehicle fleet industry. Headquartered in Portland, Maine, it operates in the United States, Canada, South America, Europe, Asia, and Australia.

companies.name: WuXi AppTec
companies.description: WuXi AppTec Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company providing contract research, development, and manufacturing services for the pharmaceutical and life-sciences industry. It is headquartered in Shanghai and operates facilities in Asia, North America, and Europe.

companies.name: XG Technology
companies.description: Vislink Technologies, Inc., formerly xG Technology, is an American technology company specializing in live video and data management. Founded in Florida in 2002, it is headquartered in Hackettstown, New Jersey, with offices worldwide. The company is publicly traded on NASDAQ.

companies.name: Xero Limited
companies.description: Xero Limited is a New Zealand technology company that provides cloud-based accounting software for small businesses. It operates on a software-as-a-service model and sells subscriptions based on the number and type of entities managed. The company has offices in multiple countries and its products are used in over 180 countries.

companies.name: AVIC Aircraft Corporation Ltd.
companies.description: AVIC Xi'an Aircraft Industry Group Company Ltd. is a publicly listed state-owned enterprise based in Xi'an, Shaanxi, China. It manufactures and markets structural parts and components for aircraft and automobiles. The company was founded and listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 1997.

companies.name: Xinjiang Xinxin Mining Industry Company
companies.description: Xinjiang Xinxin Mining Industry Company Limited is a major Chinese non-ferrous metals mining company headquartered in Fuyun County, Xinjiang. It is the second largest producer of electrolytic nickel in Mainland China and integrates mining, smelting, and refining for various strategic and rare metals.

companies.name: Xinyuan Real Estate
companies.description: Xinyuan Real Estate Co., Ltd. is a Chinese real estate company. The summary does not provide additional details about its operations or location.

companies.name: Xishan Coal and Electricity Power
companies.description: Shanxi Xishan Coal and Electricity Power Co., Ltd. was established in 1999 and listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2000. It operates 9 coal mines, 8 coal plants, and 13 holding companies.

companies.name: YNK Korea
companies.description: YNK Korea Inc. is a South Korean online game publisher and developer founded in 1998 with its head office in Seoul. Initially focused on game marketing and character licensing for Blizzard Entertainment, it later shifted to online game content publishing.

companies.name: Yapı ve Kredi Bankası
companies.description: Yapı Kredi is one of the first nationwide commercial banks in Turkey, established in 1944. It is the fourth largest private bank in Turkey by asset size and offers a range of financial services including loans, credit cards, leasing, and insurance through a network of 835 branches.

companies.name: Balfour Beatty
companies.description: Balfour Beatty plc is an international infrastructure group based in the United Kingdom. It provides construction services, support services, and infrastructure investments, operating across the UK, US, and Hong Kong. It was ranked as the biggest construction contractor in the UK by turnover in 2021.

companies.name: Yatai Group
companies.description: Jilin Yatai Group Company Limited is a private conglomerate based in Changchun, Jilin, China. Founded in 1993 and listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 1995, its core businesses include property development, cement manufacturing, and securities, with additional activities in coal mining, pharmaceuticals, and trading.

companies.name: Yext
companies.description: Yext is a New York-based enterprise marketing platform that helps brands deliver consistent and accurate information digitally from one central platform. Its platform is organized around the Knowledge Graph, a structured, machine-readable repository of brand data.

companies.name: PICC Property and Casualty Co. Ltd.
companies.description: PICC Property and Casualty Company Limited is the largest non-life insurance company in mainland China. It was incorporated in 2003 and is one of the three main subsidiaries of the People's Insurance Company of China. The company operates in the insurance sector.

companies.name: Youku Tudou
companies.description: Youku Tudou Inc., known as Youku, is a subscription video on-demand streaming television service based in Beijing, China. It was formerly a video sharing website and now operates as a subsidiary of Alibaba Group Holding Limited. The company is part of the media and entertainment industry.

companies.name: Baltona
companies.description: Baltona is a Polish company primarily operating in the duty-free market both in Poland and internationally. It focuses on retailing duty-free goods. The company is based in Poland and serves the retail sector.

companies.name: Younkers
companies.description: Younkers Inc. is an American online retailer and former department store chain founded in 1856 in Keokuk, Iowa. It expanded throughout Iowa and neighboring states over more than 150 years and was known for acquiring several rivals. The company transitioned ownership out of state in the late 1990s and closed its Des Moines headquarters by 2003.

companies.name: YuMe
companies.description: YuMe is a data analysis platform for television advertising founded in 2004 by Jayant Kadambi and Ayyappan Sankaran. The company was acquired by advertising technology firm RhythmOne plc in February 2018. YuMe operates in the AI and software sector.

companies.name: Yunnan Baiyao Group
companies.description: Yunnan Baiyao Group Co., Ltd is a Chinese pharmaceutical company engaged in developing, manufacturing, and wholesaling pharmaceutical products. It also operates retail pharmaceutical sales. The company is based in China and works within the pharmaceutical industry.

companies.name: Yunnan Tin Company Limited
companies.description: Yunnan Tin Group (Holding) Company Limited is the largest tin producer and exporter in China and worldwide. Headquartered in Kunming, Yunnan, it produces, processes, and exports tin metal and related chemicals. The company was established in 1883 by the Qing Dynasty government.

companies.name: Banca Rasini
companies.description: Banca Rasini was an Italian bank based in Milan, founded in the 1950s and acquired by Banca Popolare di Lodi in 1992. Notably, it had customers such as Pippo Calò, Totò Riina, Bernardo Provenzano, and Silvio Berlusconi, with Silvio's father Luigi Berlusconi employed there. The bank operated in the financial services sector.

companies.name: BPER Banca
