companies.description: BPER Banca S.p.A., formerly Banca Popolare dell'Emilia Romagna S.C., is an Italian banking group headquartered in Modena. It offers traditional banking services to individuals, corporations, and public entities and is directly supervised by the European Central Bank. The bank holds shares in several regional banks and is part of the FTSE MIB index.

companies.name: Yurun Group
companies.description: Yurun Group Limited is the largest meat supplier in mainland China, headquartered in Nanjing, Jiangsu. It operates in chilled, frozen, and processed meat sectors under brand names like Yurun, Furun, Wangrun, and Popular Meat Packing. The company is part of the agriculture and food industry.

companies.name: ZQGame
companies.description: ZQGame, based in Shenzhen, China, develops massively multiplayer online games along with browser and mobile games. It was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2010 and formed a joint venture with Shanda in the Shanghai Pilot Free-Trade Zone in 2013.

companies.name: Z Energy
companies.description: Z Energy is a New Zealand-based fuel distributor operating branded service stations. Since May 2022, it has been a subsidiary of Australian petroleum company Ampol and owns some former assets of Shell New Zealand and Chevron New Zealand.

companies.name: Bangkok Bank
companies.logo_file: Logo Bangkok Bank Public Company Limited.svg
companies.description: Bangkok Bank is one of Thailand's largest commercial banks with over 800 branches domestically and 32 international branches in 15 economies. It has wholly owned subsidiaries in Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, and China, and branches in London and New York.

companies.name: Bangkok Airways
companies.description: Bangkok Airways is a regional airline headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. It operates scheduled flights to destinations in Thailand and neighboring countries, with its main base at Suvarnabhumi Airport in Bangkok.

companies.name: Bank Mandiri
companies.description: Bank Mandiri, headquartered in Jakarta, is Indonesia's largest bank by assets, loans, and deposits. It has held this position since at least 2014 and remains the largest bank in Indonesia as of 2022.

companies.name: Bank Melli Iran
companies.description: Bank Melli Iran is a leading commercial bank based in Tehran, Iran. Established in 1928, it served as Iran's central bank until 1960 before becoming a commercial bank.

companies.name: Bank Leumi Le- Israel B.m.
companies.description: Bank Leumi is an Israeli bank founded in 1902 in Jaffa as the Anglo-Palestine Company. It is Israel's largest bank and maintains overseas offices in multiple countries including Luxembourg, the US, Switzerland, and China.

companies.name: Bank Polska Kasa Opieki
companies.description: Bank Polska Kasa Opieki, known as Bank Pekao S.A., is a universal bank headquartered in Warsaw, Poland. It is the second largest bank in Poland and has a diverse ownership including Powszechny Zakład Ubezpieczeń and the Polish Development Fund.

companies.name: Erste Bank Polska
companies.description: Erste Bank Polska is a Polish universal bank with offices in Wrocław, Poznań, and Warsaw. It is the third largest bank in Poland by assets and outlets, formed in 2026 by rebranding Santander Bank Polska after acquisition by Erste Group.

companies.name: Bank of Industry and Mine
companies.description: Bank of Industry and Mine is a government-owned specialized bank in Tehran, Iran. It focuses on promoting economic growth through the development of industry and mining sectors.

companies.name: Bank of East Asia
companies.description: The Bank of East Asia Limited is a public banking and financial services company headquartered in Central, Hong Kong. It is the largest independent local bank in Hong Kong and one of the two remaining family-run banks there. The bank continues to be managed by the 3rd and 4th generations of the Li family.

companies.name: Bank of Communications
companies.description: Bank of Communications is a Chinese multinational banking and financial services corporation established in 1908. It was one of the few domestic Chinese banks that issued banknotes in modern history. After 1949, its mainland operations merged into the People's Bank of China and People's Construction Bank of China, while its continuation in Taiwan became part of Mega International Commercial Bank.

companies.name: Bankia
companies.description: Bankia was a Spanish financial services company formed in 2010 by consolidating seven regional savings banks. It was partially nationalized in 2012 due to financial difficulties. In 2021, Bankia merged with CaixaBank to create a new entity initially preserving the Bankia name.

companies.name: Banorte
companies.description: Grupo Financiero Banorte, doing business as Banorte and Ixe, is a Mexican banking and financial services holding company headquartered in Monterrey and Mexico City. It is one of the four largest commercial banks in Mexico by assets and loans and the largest retirement fund administrator (AFORE).

companies.name: Zensho Holdings
companies.description: Zensho Holdings is a Japanese holding company that owns several restaurant chains in Japan. Its largest chain is Sukiya, which serves gyūdon, rice bowls with beef.

companies.name: Zevia
companies.description: Zevia is a Los Angeles-based company producing soft drinks, organic tea, energy drinks, and mixers sweetened with stevia. All products are zero-calorie, sugar-free, gluten free, vegan, kosher, and Non-GMO Project certified. In June 2021, Zevia filed to go public with an IPO.

companies.name: Zhaojin Mining
companies.description: Zhaojin Mining Industry Company Limited is a leading gold mining enterprise in China engaged in gold exploration, mining, processing, refining, and smelting. It is a joint venture between Zhaojin Group and Fosun International and is headquartered in Zhaoyuan, Shandong Province.

companies.name: Zhejiang Expressway Company
companies.description: Zhejiang Expressway Company Limited is an infrastructure company in China that invests in, develops, and operates expressways in Zhejiang Province. It also operates related businesses such as automobile servicing, gas stations, and billboard advertising along expressways.

companies.name: Zhongjin Gold
companies.description: Zhongjin Gold Corporation Limited is a major Chinese mining company primarily producing gold, copper, and other non-ferrous metals. The company is headquartered in Beijing and listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Zillow
companies.description: Zillow Group, Inc. is an American tech real-estate marketplace company founded in 2006 by former Microsoft executives and other tech entrepreneurs. The company operates in the real estate sector using technology to facilitate property transactions.

companies.name: Zions Bank
companies.description: Zions Bancorporation is an American national bank headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah. It operates as a national bank rather than a bank holding company and conducts business under seven brands including Zions Bank and Amegy Bank of Texas. It serves multiple states through its various regional banks.

companies.name: ZipRealty
companies.description: ZipRealty was a website offering real estate listings in the United States. It was acquired by Realogy in 2014 and later integrated into the Coldwell Banker subsidiary. The company operated in the real estate sector before its acquisition.

companies.name: Zoetis
companies.description: Zoetis Inc. is headquartered in Parsippany, New Jersey, and is the largest global producer of medicine and vaccinations for pets and livestock. Its products include vaccines, antiparasitics, and various therapeutics for animal health. The company operates in over 50 countries worldwide.

companies.name: Zomato
companies.description: Zomato is an Indian online food ordering and delivery service owned by Eternal Limited. Founded in 2008, it started as a restaurant aggregator and expanded to over 20 countries by 2015. Food delivery became its core business after entering the market in India in 2015.

companies.name: ZoomInfo
companies.description: ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. is a data broker registered in the United States that collects and sells personal and business data. It gathers information through data and web scraping and offers it for targeted marketing purposes. The company provides data on business entities and individuals.

companies.name: Zoom Telephonics
companies.description: Zoom Telephonics, Inc. was an American networking company founded in 1977 by two MIT graduates. After merging with Minim, Inc. in 2020, it moved its headquarters to Manchester, New Hampshire and focused on home networking products. In 2024, Minim was acquired by e2Companies, an energy management firm.

companies.name: Zscaler
companies.description: Zscaler, Inc. is an American cloud security company based in San Jose, California. It provides cloud-based services designed to protect enterprise networks and data. The company operates in the internet security sector.

companies.name: Zumiez
companies.description: Zumiez Inc. is an American multinational specialty clothing retailer founded in 1978 and based in Lynnwood, Washington. It sells apparel, footwear, accessories, and hardgoods focused on action sports like skateboarding and snowboarding. The company targets young men and women.

companies.name: Zuora
companies.description: Zuora, Inc. is an American enterprise software company headquartered in Redwood City, California. It provides software to help businesses launch and manage subscription-based services, automating billing, collections, quoting, and revenue recognition. Its applications focus on subscription metrics and management.

companies.name: Steris
companies.description: Steris plc is a medical equipment company specializing in sterilization, sterile processing, and surgical products for the US healthcare system. It is operationally headquartered in Mentor, Ohio, and legally registered in Dublin, Ireland for tax purposes since 2018. The company was previously registered in the UK from 2014 to 2018.

companies.name: Bath & Body Works
companies.description: Bath & Body Works, LLC is an American retail chain selling soaps, lotions, fragrances, candles, accessories, and hand sanitizers. Founded in 1990 in New Albany, Ohio, it has expanded across six continents. In 1997, it became the largest bath shop chain in the United States.

companies.name: Becton Dickinson
companies.description: Becton, Dickinson and Company is an American multinational medical technology company that manufactures and sells medical devices, instrument systems, and reagents. It also provides consulting and analytics services in certain areas.

companies.name: Bekaert
companies.industry: forging, pressing, stamping and roll-forming of metal; powder metallurgy
companies.description: N.V. Bekaert S.A. is a global company headquartered in Belgium, specializing in steel wire transformation and coatings. It operates in 45 countries and employs 28,000 people worldwide.

companies.name: Belden Incorporated
companies.description: Belden Inc. is an American multinational company headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. It designs, manufactures, and distributes networking, connectivity, cable, and security products serving industrial automation, enterprise, smart-building, and broadband markets.

companies.name: Bemis Company
companies.description: Bemis Company, Inc. was a global manufacturer of flexible packaging products and pressure-sensitive materials. Headquartered in Neenah, Wisconsin, it had divisions in 12 countries and distributed its packaging films and adhesive materials worldwide.

companies.name: MainSource Bank
companies.description: MainSource Bank was a community bank based in Greensburg, Indiana, operating in Indiana, Illinois, Kentucky, and Ohio. It was the operating subsidiary of MainSource Financial Group and was acquired by First Financial Bancorp in 2018, leading to the closure or rebranding of its locations.

companies.name: Shanghai Petrochemical
companies.description: Shanghai Petrochemical, a subsidiary of Sinopec, is one of the largest petrochemical enterprises in Mainland China. It produces ethylene, fiber, resin, and plastics and is registered in Shanghai.

companies.name: Shanghai Oriental Pearl Media
companies.description: Shanghai Oriental Pearl Media is a cultural company engaged in touring, radio and TV transmission, media investments, advertising, video game console manufacturing, software development, and real estate investments. It is recognized as one of the 50 pivotal large-scale enterprises by the Shanghai government.

companies.name: Atento
companies.description: Atento is a global provider of customer relationship management and business-process outsourcing services, including customer care, sales, collections, back office, and technical support. It was the largest provider in Latin America and among the top five globally by revenue in 2015.

companies.name: Hexagon AB
companies.description: Hexagon AB is a multinational industrial technology company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. Since 2000, it has focused on measuring technology and geospatial tools and software. The company has completed over 170 acquisitions and owns subsidiaries like Leica Geosystems and Infor EAM.

companies.name: Hiscox
companies.description: Hiscox Ltd. is an Anglo-Bermudan insurance provider listed on the London Stock Exchange. It underwrites at Lloyd's of London and specializes in niche insurance markets, including property, casualty, and coverage for risks like hacking and kidnapping.

companies.name: Rio Tinto Group
companies.description: Rio Tinto Group is a British–Australian multinational mining company headquartered in London and Melbourne. Founded in 1873, it has grown through mergers and acquisitions and produces commodities such as copper, iron ore, aluminium, and lithium.

companies.name: Alaska Airlines
companies.description: Alaska Airlines is a major U.S. airline headquartered in SeaTac, Washington. It operates a route network focused on connecting West Coast cities to over 100 destinations across the U.S., North America, Asia, Oceania, and Europe, partnering with Horizon Air and SkyWest Airlines.

companies.name: Nyrstar
companies.description: Nyrstar is an international producer of minerals and metals founded in August 2007. It was listed on the Euronext Brussels stock exchange in October 2007.

companies.name: GoTo
companies.description: GoTo Technologies USA, Inc., formerly LogMeIn Inc., is a software as a service company based in Boston, Massachusetts. Founded in 2003, it provides unified communication and IT management software and was rebranded to GoTo in 2022.

companies.name: PAREXEL
companies.description: Parexel is an American contract research organization that conducts clinical trials for pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients. Its services aim to expedite drug development and clinical trial progress.

companies.name: Ankai
companies.description: Anhui Ankai Automobile Co., Ltd. is a Chinese automotive manufacturer headquartered in Hefei, Anhui. It specializes in producing buses and coaches, including urban buses and sleeping berth coaches, and offers repair and maintenance services worldwide.

companies.name: Celsys
companies.description: Celsys is a Japanese graphics software company known for developing Clip Studio Paint, a software family used for digital comics, illustration, and 2D animation. The software is available on multiple platforms including macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android.

companies.name: Loews Corporation
companies.description: Loews Corporation is an American conglomerate headquartered in New York City. Its major holdings include CNA Financial Corporation, Boardwalk Pipelines, Loews Hotels, and Altium Packaging.

companies.name: Johnson Electric
companies.description: Johnson Electric is a China-based company providing motors, actuators, motion subsystems, and related electro-mechanical components for automotive, industrial, and medical applications. It operates manufacturing facilities in 22 countries.

companies.name: Ingredion
companies.description: Ingredion Inc. is a US-based food and beverage ingredient provider headquartered in Westchester, Illinois. It produces starches, non-GMO sweeteners, stevia, and pea protein from various plant sources for food, beverage, brewing, pharmaceutical, and industrial sectors.

companies.name: Forrester
companies.description: Forrester Research, Inc. is a US research and advisory firm headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. It provides research, consulting, and events services to large global business, technology, and consumer enterprises.

companies.name: Elekta
companies.description: Elekta AB is a Swedish medical technology company headquartered in Stockholm. It develops and produces equipment and software for radiation therapy and radiosurgery used in treating cancer and brain disorders.

companies.name: George Weston Limited
companies.description: George Weston Limited is a Canadian holding company founded in 1882. It controls Loblaw Companies Limited, Canada's largest supermarket retailer, and owns Choice Properties real estate investment trust. The company is majority owned by Wittington Investments, Ltd Canada.

companies.name: DrayTek
companies.description: DrayTek Corporation is a Taiwanese manufacturer of network equipment including firewalls, VPN devices, routers, managed switches, and wireless LAN devices.

companies.name: Adani Energy Solutions
companies.description: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd is an Indian electric power transmission and distribution company headquartered in Ahmedabad. It operates a transmission network of 26,696 circuit kilometers and is among the largest private sector power transmission companies in India.

companies.name: Adani Green Energy
companies.description: Adani Green Energy Limited is an Indian renewable energy company headquartered in Ahmedabad. Majority-owned by Adani Group and minority-owned by TotalEnergies, it operates the Kamuthi Solar Power Project, one of the largest solar photovoltaic plants worldwide.

companies.name: City Chic Collective
companies.description: City Chic Collective is an Australian retail clothing company headquartered in Alexandria, Sydney. Founded in 1992 and rebranded in 2006, it operates 90 stores in Australia and New Zealand and a global online store specializing in plus-sized women's clothing.

companies.name: Zakłady Azotowe Puławy
companies.description: Grupa Azoty Zakłady Azotowe Puławy PLC is a Polish chemical company based in Puławy, Lublin Voivodeship. It specializes in nitrogen fertilizer production and is one of the world's largest melamine producers, also producing caprolactam, hydrogen peroxide, AdBlue, and technical gases.

companies.name: Yamana Gold
companies.description: Yamana Gold Inc. was a Canadian mining company headquartered in Toronto that owned and operated gold, silver, and copper mines in Canada, Chile, Brazil, and Argentina. Founded in 1994, it became a gold producer after a 2003 restructuring and merged with several other mining companies. Yamana was acquired by Pan American Silver in March 2023.

companies.name: Raspadskaya
companies.description: OJSC Raspadskaya is a coal-mining company based in Russia and headquartered in Mezhdurechensk, Kemerovo Oblast. It is majority-owned by Evraz and produces 7 million tons of coal annually.

companies.name: EL5-Energo
companies.description: EL5-Energo is a Russian power generation company created from the reorganization of RAO UES. It is registered in Yekaterinburg with headquarters in Moscow, and Lukoil holds a majority stake of 80.49%.

companies.name: The Manitowoc Company
companies.description: The Manitowoc Company, Inc. is an American manufacturer founded in 1902 that produces cranes. It designs, manufactures, markets, and supports various types of cranes under multiple brand names through its wholly owned subsidiaries.

companies.name: Beijing Enterprises
companies.description: Beijing Enterprises Holdings Limited is a Chinese investment company formed with eight units of assets located in Beijing, China.

companies.name: Kobe Electric Railway
companies.description: The Kobe Electric Railway Co., Ltd., often called Shintetsu, is a Japanese private railway company operating in Kobe and surrounding cities. It is a subsidiary of the Hankyu Hanshin Toho Group.

companies.name: Newcrest Mining
companies.description: Newcrest Mining Limited is an Australian-based corporation engaged in exploration, development, mining, and sale of gold and gold-copper concentrate. It is Australia's leading gold mining company with operations extending internationally, including Indonesia. The company originated as a Newmont subsidiary in 1966 and took its current name in 1990.

companies.name: Hopewell Holdings
companies.description: Hopewell Holdings Limited is a major property developer established in 1972 and based in Hong Kong. The company is headed by Sir Gordon Wu.

companies.name: Link REIT
companies.description: Link Real Estate Investment Trust is a wholly-owned private real estate investment trust managed by Link Asset Management Limited. It is the first real estate investment trust in Hong Kong and the largest in Asia by market capitalization.

companies.name: Bakkt
companies.description: Bakkt Holdings, Inc. is a United States-based company providing a software as a service (SaaS) and API platform for owning and trading cryptocurrency. It also facilitates fiat-to-stablecoin conversion and is organized in Delaware with principal executive offices in New York City.

companies.name: Guangshen Railway
companies.description: Guangshen Railway Co., Ltd. operates the Guangzhou-Shenzhen Railway, a 152-kilometre railway link in Guangdong, China. The company provides passenger and freight transportation services and cooperates with Hong Kong's MTR Corporation on the Guangdong Through Train service.

companies.name: Hurtigruten
companies.description: Hurtigruten AS is a Norwegian coastal ferry and cruise line operator headquartered in Oslo. It is the larger of two companies operating the Hurtigruten coastal ferry service along the Norwegian coast.

companies.name: Domino's Pizza
companies.description: Domino's Pizza, Inc. is an American multinational pizza restaurant chain headquartered near Ann Arbor, Michigan. Founded in 1960, it operates thousands of stores worldwide across more than 83 countries and 5,701 cities.

companies.name: SMC Corporation
companies.description: SMC Corporation is a Japanese company specializing in pneumatic control engineering for industrial automation. Founded in 1959 and headquartered in Tokyo, it has a global engineering network and production facilities across multiple continents.

companies.name: Lands' End
companies.description: Lands' End, Inc. is an American retailer of clothing, baggage, and furniture headquartered in Dodgeville, Wisconsin. Founded in 1963 as a mail-order yachting supply company, it operates 26 domestic stores as of February 2024.

companies.name: Intercontinental Exchange
companies.description: Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. is an American multinational financial services company operating global financial exchanges and clearing houses. It also provides technology and services for mortgage loan origination, closing, and servicing.

companies.name: Sinofert Holdings
companies.description: Sinofert Holdings Limited is the largest all-rounded fertilizer enterprise in China. It engages in chemical fertilizer research and development, production, procurement, and distribution within China.

companies.name: Tongrentang
companies.description: Tong Ren Tang is a Chinese pharmaceutical company founded in 1669 and headquartered in Beijing. It is the largest producer of traditional Chinese medicine and operates drug stores mainly in Chinese-speaking regions.

companies.name: Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport
companies.description: Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport serves Shenzhen city in Guangdong, China. It is a hub for several airlines and underwent major expansions in the 2010s, including new runways and terminals.

companies.name: YTL Corporation
companies.description: YTL Corporation is a Malaysian multinational company focused on infrastructure, including power generation, water, and sewerage services. Founded in 1955, it is listed on multiple stock exchanges including Bursa Malaysia and the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Celgene
companies.description: Celgene Corporation is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Summit, New Jersey. It produces cancer and immunology drugs, with its major product being Revlimid, used to treat multiple myeloma and certain anemias. Since 2019, it has been a subsidiary of Bristol Myers Squibb.

companies.name: Nippon BS Broadcasting
companies.description: Nippon BS Broadcasting Corporation is a private satellite broadcasting station based in Kanda, Tokyo, Japan. It operates the BS11 channel and is a subsidiary of Bic Camera. The company was founded in 1999 and began high-definition broadcasts in 2007.

companies.name: Dillard's
companies.description: Dillard's, Inc. is an American department store chain headquartered in Little Rock, Arkansas. Founded in 1938, it operates approximately 271 stores across 30 states, with the largest number located in Texas and Florida.

companies.name: SKY Perfect JSAT Corporation
companies.description: SKY Perfect JSAT Corporation is a Japanese entertainment and broadcasting company based in Minato, Tokyo. Founded in 1994, it owns the DBS service SKY PerfecTV! and other businesses in the broadcasting sector.

companies.name: Calbee
companies.description: Calbee, Inc. is a Japanese snack food maker headquartered in Marunouchi, Tokyo. Founded in 1949 in Hiroshima, it holds about 70% of Japan's potato chip market and sells products across Asia and the United States. It has been listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange since 2011.

companies.name: AVEVA
companies.description: AVEVA Group plc is a British multinational information technology consulting company headquartered in Cambridge, England. It originated as the Computer-Aided Design Centre created in 1967 by the UK Ministry of Technology and Cambridge University.

companies.name: Origin Energy
companies.description: Origin Energy Ltd is an Australian integrated electricity generator and retailer headquartered in Sydney. It operates Australia's largest coal-fired power station, Eraring Power Station, and owns 20% of UK renewable energy retailer Octopus Energy.

companies.name: Hatena
companies.description: Hatena Co., Ltd. is a Japanese internet services company known for operating Hatena Bookmark, the most popular social bookmarking service in Japan. Founded in Kyoto in 2001, it has moved its headquarters between Kyoto and Tokyo over the years.

companies.name: Copa Airlines
companies.description: Compañía Panameña de Aviación, S.A., branded as Copa Airlines, is the flag carrier of Panama headquartered in Panama City. It is a member of the Star Alliance and owned by Copa Holdings, which also owns Colombian airline AeroRepública.

companies.name: Huntsman Corporation
companies.description: Huntsman Corporation is an American multinational chemical manufacturer headquartered in The Woodlands, Texas. It produces polyurethanes, performance products, and adhesives for various industrial and consumer customers and operates over 60 facilities worldwide.

companies.name: Gruppo Mondadori
companies.description: Arnoldo Mondadori Editore S.p.A. is a publishing company based in Italy. It operates in the publishing industry, distinct from retail chains. The company is recognized as a major player in the Italian publishing sector.

companies.name: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited
companies.description: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) is an Indian state-owned engineering and manufacturing company headquartered in New Delhi. It operates under the Ministry of Heavy Industries and produces equipment for power generation, transmission, transportation, defence, aerospace, oil and gas, and emerging energy technologies.

companies.name: Dow Chemical Company
companies.description: The Dow Chemical Company is an American multinational corporation headquartered in Midland, Michigan. It is one of the largest chemical producers globally and operates as a subsidiary of Dow Inc., a publicly traded holding company incorporated in Delaware.

companies.name: Bidvest Group
companies.description: Bidvest Group is a South African multinational services, trading, and distribution company headquartered in Johannesburg, Gauteng. Founded in 1988 and listed on the JSE, it operates over 250 businesses across multiple countries including South Africa, Australia, Singapore, Spain, Ireland, and the United Kingdom.

companies.name: One Medical
companies.description: Amazon One Medical is a primary care health service in the United States offering in-person care and online resources, including a mobile app. Founded by 1Life Healthcare, Inc. in 2007, it was acquired by Amazon in February 2023 and integrated into Amazon's Prime membership offerings.

companies.name: AboitizPower
companies.description: Aboitiz Power Corporation, also known as AboitizPower, is a Philippine holding company engaged in power distribution, generation, and retail electricity services. It is a subsidiary of Aboitiz Equity Ventures (AEV).

companies.name: Cava Group
companies.description: Cava is an American Mediterranean fast casual restaurant chain with locations across the United States. Owned by the publicly traded Cava Group, it acquired Zoës Kitchen in 2018 and is the largest operator in the Mediterranean restaurant category in the U.S. It also produces Mediterranean dips and dressings sold in grocery stores.

companies.name: Molten Ventures
companies.description: Molten Ventures, formerly Draper Esprit, is a British venture capital firm investing in high growth technology companies globally. It has offices in London, Cambridge, and Dublin, and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Hipgnosis Songs Fund
companies.description: Recognition Music Group is a London-headquartered investor and manager of music IP rights, formed in 2024 by combining assets from Blackstone's Hipgnosis Songs entities. It was rebranded in 2025, and its subsidiary Hipgnosis Songs Group was acquired by Sony Music Publishing in 2025, with Sony acquiring the full catalog in 2026.

companies.name: Iovance Biotherapeutics
companies.description: Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company based in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. It focuses on developing tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapies to treat cancer.

companies.name: Lodha Group
companies.description: Lodha Group, headquartered in Mumbai, India, is a multinational real estate and construction company founded in 1980 by Mangal Prabhat Lodha. It develops residential and commercial properties in multiple cities including Mumbai, Thane, Hyderabad, Pune, Bengaluru, and London.

companies.name: Meeza
companies.description: Meeza is an Egyptian electronic payment systems provider focused on domestic transactions within Egypt. Supported by the Egyptian government and regulated by the Egyptian Central Bank and the national Egyptian Banks Company, Meeza offers services similar to MasterCard and Visa but is limited to local use.

companies.name: Pakistan International Container Terminal
companies.description: Pakistan International Container Terminal (PICT) was a Pakistani container terminal operator managing berths 6 to 9 at the Port of Karachi under a 21-year BOT concession from 2002 to 2023. It operated as a subsidiary of ICTSI Mauritius Limited, part of the Philippines-based ICTSI group, from 2012 to 2023.

companies.name: Sezzle
companies.description: Sezzle is a financial technology company headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, operating in the United States and Canada. It provides an alternative payment platform offering interest-free installment plans at selected online stores.

companies.name: Smartsheet Inc.
companies.description: Smartsheet Inc. develops and markets Smartsheet, a software as a service (SaaS) platform for collaboration and work management. The software helps users assign tasks, track project progress, manage calendars, share documents, and manage other work using a tabular interface.

companies.name: Fujiya
companies.description: Fujiya Co. Ltd. is a nationwide chain of confectionery stores and restaurants in Japan. Its first shop was founded in 1910 in Yokohama.

companies.name: Nacon
companies.industry: wholesale (business-to-business) of computers, computer peripheral equipment and software
companies.description: Nacon SA is a French company based in Lesquin that publishes video games and manufactures gaming peripherals. It designs and distributes gaming accessories and video games for various platforms. In 2020, Bigben Group's gaming activities were consolidated to form Nacon.

companies.name: Farm Fresh
companies.description: Farm Fresh Berhad is a Malaysian dairy products company based in Sedili, Johor, founded in 2009. It operates two factories in Pahang and Johor with significant production capacity. The Malaysian sovereign wealth fund Khazanah Nasional was a substantial shareholder but divested its shares in September 2025.

companies.name: Vanke
companies.description: Vanke is a large residential real estate developer in China engaged in developing, managing, and selling properties across more than 60 mainland Chinese cities. Since 2012, it has expanded into Hong Kong, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Malaysia. Its largest shareholder is Shenzhen Metro.

companies.name: Grupo Éxito
companies.description: Grupo Éxito is a South American retail company operating 2,606 stores selling a wide range of food and non-food products. Originally a textiles maker and seller, it has diversified into a major grocer offering packaged foods, perishables, and department store products including electronics and furniture.

companies.name: Billabong
companies.description: Billabong International Limited is an Australian company specializing in surfing-related products, primarily clothing and accessories. Founded in 1973, it owns several brands including Von Zipper and Element. In 2018, it was acquired by Boardriders, Inc, owner of Quiksilver.

companies.name: Skycity Entertainment Group
companies.description: SkyCity Entertainment Group is a gambling and entertainment company based in Auckland, New Zealand. It owns and operates five casino properties in New Zealand and Australia, including restaurants, bars, hotels, a convention centre, and Auckland's Sky Tower.

companies.name: Biogen
companies.description: Biogen Inc. is an American multinational biotechnology company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. It specializes in treatments for neurological diseases and produces several drugs for multiple sclerosis, spinal muscular atrophy, and other conditions. The company collaborates with Genentech on several drugs.

companies.name: All in! Games
companies.description: All in! Games SA is a video game publisher based in Kraków, Poland. The company publishes games on all main gaming platforms and works on international projects.

companies.name: Vonage
companies.description: Vonage Holdings Corp. is an American cloud communications provider headquartered in Holmdel Township, New Jersey. Founded in 1998 as Min-X, it provides residential telecommunications services based on voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP). It operates as a subsidiary of Ericsson.

companies.name: LY Corporation
companies.description: LY Corporation, trading as LYC, is a Japanese internet company majority-owned by A Holdings, a joint venture between SoftBank Group and Naver Corporation. It was formed in 2023 through the merger of Z Holdings and four subsidiaries including Line Corporation and Yahoo! Japan.

companies.name: Kirkland Lake Gold
companies.description: Kirkland Lake Gold Inc. was a Canadian gold mining company based in Toronto. It owned and operated several gold mines in Canada and Australia before merging into Agnico Eagle in 2021.

companies.name: Hino Motors
companies.description: Hino Motors, Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of commercial vehicles and diesel engines headquartered in Hino, Tokyo. Established as a corporate spin-off in 1942, it produces, markets, and sells commercial vehicles and diesel engines.

companies.name: Mitsubishi Pencil
companies.description: Mitsubishi Pencil Company Limited is a Japanese manufacturer known for its Uniball and Uni brands of pens and pencils. The Uniball brand was introduced in 1979 as a rollerball pen and later expanded to other products.

companies.name: The Oriental Land Company
companies.description: The Oriental Land Co., Ltd. is a Japanese leisure and tourism company headquartered in Urayasu, Chiba. It owns and operates the Tokyo Disney Resort and operates in theme parks, hotels, and other businesses. Its largest shareholder is Keisei Electric Railway.

companies.name: Bunzl plc
companies.description: Bunzl Public Limited Company is a British multinational distribution and outsourcing company headquartered in London, England. It operates in the paper and publishing industry. The company is notable for its multinational presence and outsourcing services.

companies.name: Virgin Australia Holdings
companies.description: Virgin Australia Holdings Limited is an Australian holding company that owns and operates Virgin Australia and Virgin Australia Regional Airlines. Its head office is located in South Bank, Brisbane. It previously operated several other airlines that were absorbed into Virgin Australia in 2011.

companies.name: Toho
companies.description: Toho Co., Ltd. is a Japanese film production, distribution, and theater stage exhibition company headquartered in Chiyoda, Tokyo. It is known for producing and distributing many notable Japanese films and is the largest film importer in Japan through its subsidiaries.

companies.name: British Airways
companies.description: British Airways plc is the flag carrier airline of the United Kingdom, based in London, England. It is headquartered at the Waterside building near its main hub at Heathrow Airport. The company operates as a major airline in the UK.

companies.name: Bodycote
companies.description: Bodycote plc is a supplier of heat treatments, metal joining, hot isostatic pressing, and coating services. It is based in Macclesfield, United Kingdom, and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

companies.name: Bojangles' Famous Chicken 'n Biscuits
companies.description: Bojangles OpCo, LLC., doing business as Bojangles, is an American regional fast food chain specializing in Cajun-seasoned fried chicken and buttermilk biscuits. It primarily serves the Southeastern United States and was founded in Charlotte, North Carolina in 1977.

companies.name: Boliden AB
companies.description: Boliden AB is a Swedish multinational metals, mining, and smelting company headquartered in Stockholm. It produces zinc, copper, lead, nickel, silver, and gold, with operations in several European countries including Sweden, Finland, and Norway.

companies.name: Bombardier Recreational Products
companies.description: BRP Inc. is a Canadian manufacturer of snowmobiles, all-terrain vehicles, motorcycles, and personal watercraft. It was founded in 2003 after being spun off from Bombardier Inc., which was originally founded in 1942 in Quebec.

companies.name: Savencia Fromage & Dairy
companies.description: Savencia Fromage & Dairy is a French food company specializing in cheese production. It is an independent family group owned by the Bongrain family and includes brands such as Saint Agur Blue and Saint Albray. The company was formerly named Bongrain until 2015.

companies.name: Booz Allen Hamilton
companies.description: Booz Allen Hamilton Holding Corporation is an American government and military contractor specializing in intelligence, technology, and cybersecurity. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, it provides consulting, analysis, and engineering services to public- and private-sector organizations and nonprofits. The company has 80 additional offices worldwide.

companies.name: Borovo
companies.description: Borovo is a Croatian shoe manufacturer founded in 1931 in the village of Borovo near Vukovar. It gained significant success during the time of SFR Yugoslavia, known especially for its Borosana shoes. The company operates in the footwear industry.

companies.name: Boston Beer Company
companies.description: The Boston Beer Company is an American brewery founded in 1984 by James Koch and Rhonda Kallman. Its first brand was Samuel Adams, named after the American revolutionary patriot. The company has expanded to several other brands and merged with Dogfish Head Brewery in 2019.

companies.name: Boston Pizza
companies.description: Boston Pizza International Inc. is a Canadian multinational restaurant chain that owns and franchises locations in Canada, the United States, and Mexico. It operates in the system catering industry.

companies.name: Bouygues
companies.description: Bouygues S.A. is a French engineering group headquartered in Paris. It specializes in construction, real estate development, media, and telecommunications. The company is listed on the Euronext Paris exchange and is part of the CAC 40 stock market index.

companies.name: Eastman Chemical Company
companies.description: Eastman Chemical Company is an American chemical products manufacturer based in Kingsport, Tennessee. Founded in 1920 and formerly a Kodak subsidiary, it is now an independent global specialty materials company producing advanced materials, chemicals, and fibers. It operates 36 manufacturing sites worldwide.

companies.name: BRF
companies.description: BRF S.A. is a Brazilian food processing company with over 30 brands including Sadia and Perdigão. Its products are marketed in more than 150 countries across five continents. The company employs over 100,000 people and operates about 50 production facilities in eight countries.

companies.name: Brasil Telecom
companies.description: Brasil Telecom S.A. was a major Brazilian telecommunications company headquartered in Brasília. It emerged after the break-up of Telebrás and provided landline, mobile, and long-distance services in central and southern Brazil. Since 2009, it has been a subsidiary of Oi.

companies.name: Takeda Pharmaceutical Company
companies.description: The Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited is a Japanese multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Osaka. It is the largest pharmaceutical company in Japan and among the top 20 worldwide by revenue. The company focuses on oncology, rare diseases, neuroscience, gastroenterology, plasma-derived therapies, and vaccines.

companies.name: FMC Corporation
companies.description: FMC Corporation is an American chemical manufacturing company headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1883 as an insecticide producer, it diversified into other industries including manufacturing amphibious tracked landing vehicles during WWII. The company employs 7,000 people worldwide.

companies.name: HKTV
companies.description: Hong Kong Technology Venture Company Limited, known as HKTV, is a Hong Kong-based technology company primarily recognized for its e-commerce platform. It operates an over-the-top shopping and entertainment platform called HKTVMall and had plans to become a television station.

companies.name: Cardinal Health
companies.description: Cardinal Health is an American multinational health care services company headquartered in Dublin, Ohio. It specializes in distributing pharmaceuticals and medical products, manufacturing medical and surgical products, and operates a large network of radiopharmacies in the U.S.

companies.name: Potash Corporation of Saskatchewan
companies.description: The Potash Corporation of Saskatchewan, also known as PotashCorp, was a company based in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. It merged with Calgary-based Agrium to form Nutrien, with the transaction closing on January 1, 2018.

companies.name: Organon & Co.
companies.description: Organon & Co. is an American pharmaceutical company originally founded in Oss, The Netherlands, now headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey. It specializes in reproductive medicine, contraception, psychiatry, hormone replacement therapy, and anesthesia, producing all products outside the U.S.

companies.name: Eisai
companies.description: Eisai Co., Ltd. is a Japanese pharmaceutical company headquartered in Tokyo. It employs about 10,000 people, including 1,500 in research, and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange as part of the Topix 100 and Nikkei 225 indices.

companies.name: Adama Agricultural Solutions Ltd.
companies.description: ADAMA Ltd. is a global crop-protection company based in Israel that develops and distributes herbicides, insecticides, and fungicides. It operates internationally with a direct presence in 20 agricultural markets.

companies.name: Icl Group Ltd
companies.description: ICL Group Ltd. is a multinational manufacturing company from Israel producing fertilizers, metals, and specialty chemical products. It serves agriculture, food, and engineered materials markets and is a major producer of bromine and potash worldwide.

companies.name: Henry Schein
companies.description: Henry Schein, Inc. is an American distributor of health care products and services operating in 33 countries. It is the world's largest provider of health care solutions to office-based dental and medical practitioners.

companies.name: Cipla
companies.description: Cipla Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai. It focuses on medications for various diseases and conditions, operates 47 manufacturing locations worldwide, and sells products in 86 countries.

companies.name: CF Industries
companies.description: CF Industries Holdings, Inc. is an American manufacturer and distributor of agricultural fertilizers based in Northbrook, Illinois. Founded in 1946, it was originally a federation of regional agricultural supply cooperatives before becoming a publicly traded company.

companies.name: Orix
companies.description: ORIX Corporation is a Japanese diversified financial services group headquartered in Minato, Tokyo, and Osaka, Japan. It operates in various financial sectors, providing a wide range of services.

companies.name: Allergan plc
companies.description: Allergan plc is an American, Irish-domiciled pharmaceutical company that develops, manufactures, and markets brand name drugs and medical devices. It operates in areas such as medical aesthetics, eye care, central nervous system, and gastroenterology, and is known as the maker of Botox.

companies.name: Grasim Industries
companies.description: Grasim Industries Limited is an Indian manufacturing company based in Mumbai. Founded in 1947 as a textile manufacturer, it has diversified into textile raw materials, chemicals, cement, and financial services through subsidiaries like UltraTech Cement and Aditya Birla Capital.

companies.name: Tosoh
companies.description: Tosoh Corporation is a global chemical and specialty materials company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Founded in 1935 in Yamaguchi Prefecture as Toyo Soda Manufacturing Co., Ltd., it adopted its current name in 1987.

companies.name: Japan Post Bank
companies.description: Japan Post Bank Co., Ltd. is a Japanese bank headquartered in Tokyo. It is a corporation held by Japan Post Holdings, with the government of Japan holding a majority stake.

companies.name: Onex Corporation
companies.description: Onex Corporation is a Canadian investment management firm founded by Gerry Schwartz in 1984. It manages investments across various sectors and is based in Canada.

companies.name: Brookfield Corporation
companies.description: Brookfield Corporation is a Canadian multinational alternative investment management company headquartered in Toronto. It manages over US$1 trillion in assets, focusing on real estate, renewable power, infrastructure, credit, and private equity.

companies.name: Power Corporation of Canada
companies.description: Power Corporation of Canada is a Canadian holding company founded in 1925. It focuses on financial services across North America, Europe, and Asia, with holdings in insurance, retirement services, wealth management, and alternative investments.

companies.name: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories
companies.description: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company based in Hyderabad, with U.S. headquarters in East Brunswick, New Jersey. It produces pharmaceuticals, active pharmaceutical ingredients, diagnostic kits, and biotechnology products.

companies.name: Loblaw Companies
companies.description: Loblaw Companies Limited is a Canadian retailer established in 1919. It operates supermarkets, pharmacies, banking, and apparel under various banners and private labels, and is the largest Canadian food retailer controlled by George Weston Limited.

companies.name: CanSino Biologics
companies.description: CanSino Biologics, also known as CanSinoBIO, is a Chinese company specializing in vaccine development. It operates within the pharmaceutical industry and is based in China.

companies.name: Clorox
companies.description: The Clorox Company is an American multinational that manufactures and markets consumer and professional products. It is based in the United States and has been listed on the Fortune 500 list annually from 2000 to 2024.

companies.name: China Minsheng Bank
companies.description: China Minsheng Bank is a major Chinese bank founded in 1996 by Jing Shuping. It was the first bank in China established with private sector shareholders, reflecting economic reforms led by Premier Zhu Rongji.

companies.name: Howa Machinery
companies.description: Howa Machinery, Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer known internationally for producing military and civilian firearms. The company also produces machine tools, sweeping vehicles, windows, and doors.

companies.name: Québecor
companies.description: Québecor Inc. is a diversified media and telecommunications company based in Montreal, Canada, serving the Quebec region. The company changed its French spelling to include an acute accent in 2012.

companies.name: OTP Bank
companies.description: OTP Bank Group is Hungary's largest commercial bank and a leading independent financial service provider in Central and Eastern Europe. It offers banking and financial services across 10 countries in the region.

companies.name: Fiesta Restaurant Group
companies.description: Fiesta Restaurant Group is an American restaurant chain headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It primarily owns Pollo Tropical branded locations in Florida and was spun off from Carrols Restaurant Group in 2012.

companies.name: Daiwa House Industry
companies.description: Daiwa House Industry Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational construction company specializing in prefabricated houses. It also constructs factories, shopping centers, healthcare facilities, and manages resort hotels and golf courses.

companies.name: Alior Bank
companies.description: Alior Bank SA is a universal bank in Poland founded in 2008 and a subsidiary of insurance company PZU SA since 2015. It is among the top ten banking groups in Poland and is listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange.

companies.name: John Wood Group plc
companies.description: John Wood Group Ltd, known as Wood Group, is a British multinational engineering and consulting firm headquartered in Aberdeen, Scotland. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until May 2025 before being acquired by Sidara.

companies.name: Briggs & Stratton
companies.description: Briggs & Stratton Corporation is an American manufacturer of small engines headquartered in Wauwatosa, Wisconsin. The company specializes in mechanical engineering products.

companies.name: BBI Development NFI SA
companies.description: BBI Development NFI SA is a joint-stock company listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange that focuses on the real estate market in Warsaw, Poland.

companies.name: Bank Gospodarki Żywnościowej
companies.description: Bank Gospodarki Żywnościowej, known as BGZ Bank, was a significant bank based in Warsaw, Poland.

companies.name: TiVo Corporation
companies.description: TiVo Corporation, formerly Rovi Corporation and Macrovision Solutions Corporation, was an American technology company headquartered in San Jose, California. It licenses intellectual property in consumer electronics and provides analytics and recommendation platforms for the video industry.

companies.name: Regions Financial Corporation
companies.description: Regions Financial Corporation is an American bank holding company headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama. It provides retail and commercial banking, trust, stock brokerage, and mortgage services through its subsidiary Regions Bank.

companies.name: Brinker International
companies.description: Brinker International, Inc. is an American multinational hospitality company based in Dallas, Texas. It owns and operates restaurant chains including Chili's Grill & Bar and Maggiano's Little Italy worldwide.

companies.name: ALFA Group
companies.description: Alfa S.A.B. de C.V., known as Alfa, is a Mexican company headquartered in Monterrey. It transitioned from a multinational conglomerate to a pure play consumer packaged goods business.

companies.name: Imerys
companies.description: IMERYS S.A. is a French multinational company specializing in the production and processing of industrial minerals. It is headquartered in Paris and is part of the CAC Mid 60 index.

companies.name: Enel Américas
companies.description: Enel Americas is a conglomerate of electric energy companies operating in South and Central America, including Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Costa Rica, Panama, and Guatemala. It generates, transmits, and distributes electric power through its affiliates.

companies.name: British Land
companies.description: The British Land Company Plc is one of the largest property development and investment companies in the United Kingdom. Headquartered in London, it became a real estate investment trust in 2007 and is a founding member of the European Public Real Estate Association.

companies.name: SCOR SE
companies.description: SCOR SE is a French tier 1 reinsurance company providing Property and Casualty and Life reinsurance. Founded in 1970 with support from the French government, it was originally named Société Commerciale de Réassurance. In 2007, it became the first French listed company to use the SE acronym in its name.

companies.name: J. C. Penney
companies.description: JCPenney is an American department store chain founded in 1902 by James Cash Penney. Since 2025, it has been owned by Catalyst Brands, a joint venture between Authentic Brands Group, Brookfield Corporation, and Simon Property Group.

companies.name: Kindred Healthcare
companies.description: Kindred Healthcare is a healthcare company operating long-term acute-care hospitals and providing rehabilitation services across the United States.

companies.name: Qlik
companies.description: Qlik is an American information technology company offering a data integration, analytics, and artificial intelligence platform. Founded in 1993 in Lund, Sweden, it is now based in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania. The company was taken private by Thoma Bravo in 2016.

companies.name: Będzin Power Station
companies.description: Będzin Power Station is a cogeneration plant located in Będzin, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland.

companies.name: Ergis
companies.description: Ergis Spółka Akcyjna is a Polish chemical company that processes plastics and manufactures PVC, PET, and PE products. It is listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Arconic
companies.description: Arconic Corporation is an American industrial company specializing in lightweight metals engineering and manufacturing. Its products serve industries including aerospace, automotive, packaging, oil and gas, and defense worldwide.

companies.name: Crocs, Inc.
companies.description: Crocs, Inc. is an American footwear company based in Broomfield, Colorado, known for manufacturing and marketing foam footwear called "clogs." In 2021, it acquired the Italian footwear brand HEYDUDE.

companies.name: Fasing
companies.description: FASING Plc. is a Polish multinational metal industry corporation and one of the largest chain manufacturers globally. It is the largest producer of industrial chains in Central and Eastern Europe, supplying products used in mining, energy, fishing, and transport sectors.

companies.name: Seoul Broadcasting System
companies.description: Seoul Broadcasting System is a leading South Korean television and radio broadcaster. It legally adopted the name SBS in March 2000, and its flagship terrestrial television station broadcasts as channel 6 for digital and cable.

companies.name: Hot Topic
companies.description: Hot Topic, Inc. is an American fast fashion company specializing in counterculture-related clothing and accessories. It targets teens to young adults interested in alternative music, anime, horror, and video gaming. Most of its stores are located in regional shopping malls across the United States.

companies.name: FSP Technology
companies.description: FSP Technology Inc. is a global power supply unit manufacturer headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan. Founded in 1993, it started with PC power supplies and expanded into industrial, server, medical, telecommunications, and renewable energy systems.

companies.name: Williams Companies
companies.description: The Williams Companies, Inc. is an American energy company based in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Its core business includes natural gas processing and transportation, along with petroleum and electricity generation assets. It is a Fortune 500 company and part of the S&P 500 index.

companies.name: Cision
companies.description: Cision Ltd. is a public relations and earned media software company incorporated in the Cayman Islands and headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It offers services including PRNewswire, PRWeb, Brandwatch, and Canada Newswire.

companies.name: Zoom Corporation
companies.description: Zoom Corporation is a Japan-based audio company specializing in the design and development of electronic devices for music. Established in 1983, its products are sold worldwide and it is listed on the JASDAQ market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Huiyuan Juice
companies.description: China Huiyuan Juice Group Limited, headquartered in Beijing, is the largest privately owned juice producer in China. Founded in 1992, it manufactures and sells juice and other beverage products including fruit and vegetable juices, nectars, bottled water, tea, and dairy drinks.

companies.name: Sanok Rubber Company
companies.description: Sanok Rubber Company S.A. is a Polish company specializing in the production of rubber products. It is based in Sanok, Poland.

companies.name: Toro
companies.description: The Toro Company is an American firm based in Bloomington, Minnesota. It designs, manufactures, and markets lawn mowers, snow blowers, and irrigation system supplies for commercial, residential, agricultural, and public sector uses.

companies.name: Sea Ltd
companies.description: Sea Limited is a tech conglomerate headquartered in Singapore. It serves as a holding company for Garena, Monee, and Shopee, the largest e-commerce platform in Southeast Asia. It is listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Terna S.p.A.
companies.description: Terna S.p.A. is a transmission system operator based in Rome, Italy. It manages around 98% of the Italian high-voltage power transmission grid and operates in Peru and the USA through Terna Plus. It is listed on the Borsa Italiana and part of the FTSE MIB index.

companies.name: VIGO Photonics
companies.description: Vigo Photonics is a Polish electronics company specializing in photonic integrated circuits and epitaxial wafers. It operates within the semiconductor industry and is based in Poland.

companies.name: Wawel
companies.description: Wawel is a Polish confectionery company producing chocolates, wafers, chocolate bars, and snacks. It is a well-recognized candy brand in Poland.

companies.name: IBEX 35
companies.description: The IBEX 35 is the benchmark stock market index of the Bolsa de Madrid, Spain's main stock exchange. It includes the 35 most liquid Spanish stocks and is administered by Sociedad de Bolsas, a subsidiary of Bolsas y Mercados Españoles.

companies.name: Sina Corporation
companies.description: Sina Corporation is a Chinese internet and online media company known for operating the Sina.com portal and controlling Weibo Corporation. It was formed in 1999 and is headquartered in Beijing, incorporated in the Cayman Islands.

companies.name: Movado
companies.description: Movado is a luxury American watch brand originally founded in Switzerland in 1881. It is known for its minimalist style and the signature metallic dot at 12 o'clock on its watches.

companies.name: Fiat S.p.A.
companies.description: Fiat S.p.A., commonly known as Fiat Group, was an Italian holding company primarily involved in the automotive industry.

companies.name: Informatica
companies.description: Informatica Inc. is an American software development company founded in 1993 and based in Redwood City, California. Its core products include enterprise cloud data management and data integration.

companies.name: SpiceJet
companies.description: SpiceJet is an Indian low-cost airline headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana. It is the fourth largest airline in India by domestic passengers carried as of May 2025.

companies.name: AtkinsRéalis
companies.description: AtkinsRéalis Group Inc., formerly SNC-Lavalin Group Inc., is a Canadian company based in Montreal providing engineering, procurement, and construction services across various industries including mining, environment, infrastructure, and clean energy.

companies.name: Consol Energy
companies.description: Consol Energy Inc. is an American energy company focused on coal, headquartered near Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It employs over 1,600 people.

companies.name: Paychex
companies.description: Paychex, Inc. is an American company providing human resources, payroll, and employee benefits outsourcing services for small- to medium-sized businesses. Founded in 1971, it is headquartered in Rochester, New York, and serves approximately 800,000 payroll clients in the U.S. and Europe. It is ranked 681st on the Fortune 500 list of largest corporations by revenue.

companies.name: Fonterra
companies.description: Fonterra Co-operative Group Limited is a New Zealand multinational dairy co-operative owned by New Zealand farmers. It is responsible for about 30% of the world's dairy exports and is New Zealand's largest company. As of 2022, it is the sixth-largest dairy company globally and the largest in the Southern Hemisphere.

companies.name: Confluent Inc.
companies.description: Confluent, Inc. is an American technology company headquartered in Mountain View, California. The company operates in the technology sector.

companies.name: Fiat Industrial
companies.description: Fiat Industrial S.p.A. was an Italian company formed in 2011 by demerging Fiat S.p.A.'s non-automobile activities. It served as a holding company for truck manufacturer Iveco, an 89.3% stake in CNH Global, and FPT Industrial. Sergio Marchionne was the company's chairman.

companies.name: Murphy Oil
companies.description: Murphy Oil Corporation is an American energy company engaged in hydrocarbon exploration. It is headquartered in Houston, Texas, and is ranked 995th on the Fortune 500 list.

companies.name: Chiyoda Corporation
companies.description: Chiyoda Corporation is a global engineering company specializing in oil and gas midstream, downstream refinery, and petrochemicals facilities design and construction. It is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan, with engineering offices abroad. Most of its business occurs outside Japan.

companies.name: Suez Company
companies.description: The Suez Company, also known as the Suez Canal Company, was formed in 1858 to operate the concession for the Suez Canal, which it built between 1859 and 1869. Initially owned by French investors and Egypt's ruler, it operated the canal until 1956 when Egypt revoked its concession and transferred operation to the state.

companies.name: Bank JTrust Indonesia
companies.description: PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk is an Indonesian bank founded in 2015. The bank is based in Jakarta and operates in the banking sector.

companies.name: Playtika
companies.description: Playtika Holding Corp. is an Israeli digital entertainment company specializing in developing and publishing mobile games. In 2021, it had over 35 million monthly active users.

companies.name: Maruti Suzuki
companies.description: Maruti Suzuki India Limited is the Indian subsidiary of Suzuki Motor Corporation. It is the largest automobile manufacturer in India, specializing in small cars. Established in 1981 as a joint venture with Suzuki, it was the first major foreign automaker to invest in India.

companies.name: Amplify Energy
companies.description: Amplify Energy Corp is a crude oil company based in Houston, Texas, USA. Founded in 2017, it operates in the oil and gas industry and is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Camuzzi Gas
companies.description: Camuzzi Gas is an Argentine natural gas distribution company operating through subsidiaries in southern provinces and Buenos Aires province. It covers 45% of Argentina's concession areas and serves 2 million customers.

companies.name: GoHealth
companies.description: GoHealth, Inc. is a US-based marketplace for Medicare plans including Medicare Advantage, MediGap, and Medicare Part D. It also offers an online marketplace for individual and short-term health insurance.

companies.name: Idea Cellular
companies.description: Idea Cellular Limited was an Indian telecommunications company based in Mumbai, Maharashtra. It was an integrated GSM operator with 220 million subscribers as of June 2018.

companies.name: Kontoor Brands
companies.description: Kontoor Brands is an American company marketing clothing under the Wrangler and Helly Hansen brands. It also operates VF Outlet stores.

companies.name: Ninety One plc
companies.description: Ninety One, formerly Investec Asset Management SA, is a South African investment management company founded in 1991. It is headquartered in Cape Town and listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Opendoor
companies.description: Opendoor Technologies Inc. is a San Francisco-based online company that buys and sells residential real estate. It offers instant cash offers, repairs homes, re-lists them, and provides mobile app-based home buying and financing services.

companies.name: PharmaMar
companies.description: PharmaMar is a Spanish pharmaceutical company headquartered in Colmenar Viejo, Madrid. Founded in 1986, it absorbed its parent company Zeltia in 2015 and is part of the Madrid Stock Exchange General Index and IBEX 35 since 2020.

companies.name: Relaxo
companies.description: Relaxo Footwears Limited is an Indian multinational footwear company based in New Delhi. It is the largest footwear manufacturer in India by volume and second-largest by revenue, producing products under 10 brands including Flite and Sparx.

companies.name: Veritone Inc.
companies.description: Veritone, Inc. is an American artificial intelligence technology company founded in 2014 and based in Irvine, California. It provides AI software services to public and private sectors including media, government, and law enforcement.

companies.name: Jio Platforms
companies.description: Jio Platforms Limited is an Indian multinational technology company headquartered in Mumbai. It is a subsidiary of Reliance Industries and serves as a holding company for India's largest mobile network operator, Jio, along with other digital businesses of Reliance. The company was established in 2019.

companies.name: Banco Alfa
companies.description: Alfa Bank is a Brazilian commercial bank based in São Paulo. The bank's president is Aloysio de Andrade Faria. It operates within the financial sector in Brazil.

companies.name: Sohu
companies.description: Sohu, Inc. is a Chinese Internet company headquartered in the Sohu Internet Plaza in Haidian District, Beijing. It offers services including advertising, a search engine (Sogou.com), and online multiplayer gaming (ChangYou.com).

companies.name: THK
companies.description: THK Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company headquartered in Tokyo that provides machine elements and modules for mechanical engineering, robotics, and automation. Founded in April 1971, it has grown into an international company and has been listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange's first segment since 2001.

companies.name: ExOne
companies.description: ExOne was an American industrial additive manufacturing company specializing in the development and manufacture of binder jetting 3D printing systems for metal and sand applications.

companies.name: Bombril
companies.description: Bombril is a Brazilian manufacturer of household cleaning agents, best known for its fine-grade steel wool product marketed under the brand "Bom Bril." The company once held a 90% share of the Brazilian market for steel wool, and its brand name is commonly used as a metonym for steel wool in Brazil.

companies.name: Sears Holdings Corporation
companies.description: Sears Holdings Corporation was an American holding company headquartered in Hoffman Estates, Illinois. It was the parent company of Kmart and Sears stores, founded after Kmart purchased Sears in 2005. The company filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2018 and sold its assets to ESL Investments in 2019.

companies.name: Leap Wireless
companies.description: Leap Wireless International, Inc. was a telecommunications operator headquartered in San Diego, California. It provided wireless services through its subsidiary Cricket Communications and was the fifth largest in the U.S. Leap Wireless and Cricket Wireless are now subsidiaries of AT&T.

companies.name: Kohl's
companies.description: Kohl's Corporation is an American department store retail chain operating stores in every U.S. state except Hawaii. Founded by Maxwell Kohl in 1927 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, it expanded from a grocery store to department stores starting in 1962. The company went public in 1992 after several ownership changes.

companies.name: BAIC BluePark
companies.description: BAIC BluePark is a subsidiary of BAIC Group focused on the design, research, development, and sales of electric automobiles. It was restructured from Beijing Electric Vehicle Co., Ltd. and operates brands including Stelato, Arcfox, and EV models under the Beijing brand.

companies.name: Groupe Bruxelles Lambert
companies.description: Groupe Bruxelles Lambert (GBL) is a Belgian holding company that invests in both listed and private companies across multiple industries. It is chaired by Ian Gallienne with Johannes Huth as Managing Director. GBL manages a portfolio valued at billions of euros.

companies.name: Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken
companies.description: Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken AB (SEB) is a Swedish bank headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. It provides financial services primarily in Sweden.

companies.name: Ouster
companies.description: Ouster, Inc. is an American lidar technology company based in San Francisco, California. It designs and manufactures high-resolution digital 3D lidar and native colour lidar sensors for use in various sectors including industrial, robotics, drones, and autonomous vehicles.

companies.name: Sunnova
companies.description: Sunnova Energy International Inc. was an American energy company headquartered in Houston, Texas. Founded in 2012, it provided residential solar panel installations, battery storage, and repair services primarily in the United States.

companies.name: Vantage Towers
companies.description: Vantage Towers is a European infrastructure company headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany. It specializes in the construction, management, and leasing of towers, antenna masts, and related facilities to mobile network operators.

companies.name: Sanepar
companies.description: Sanepar is a Brazilian water supply and sewage company owned by the state of Paraná. It provides water and sanitation services to millions of customers across hundreds of cities and areas in Paraná and Santa Catarina states, including waste management and landfill operations.

companies.name: Mengniu Dairy
companies.description: Inner Mongolia Mengniu Dairy (Group) Limited is a Chinese company headquartered in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia. It manufactures and distributes dairy products and ice cream under the Mengniu brand.

companies.name: Postal Savings Bank of China
companies.description: Postal Savings Bank of China Co., Ltd. (PSBC) is a Chinese retail bank headquartered in Beijing. It provides basic financial services to small and medium enterprises, rural, and low-income customers, operating nearly 40,000 branches across China.

companies.name: Toppan Holdings
companies.description: Toppan Holdings Inc. is a Japanese global printing company founded in 1900 and headquartered in Tokyo. It operates in the printing industry worldwide.

companies.name: Arcturus Therapeutics
companies.description: Arcturus Therapeutics Holdings Inc. is an American biotechnology company specializing in RNA medicines. It focuses on developing therapeutics for rare and infectious diseases using proprietary lipid nanoparticle RNA technologies.

companies.name: QuantumScape
companies.description: QuantumScape Corporation is an American company based in San Jose, California, that researches and develops solid-state rechargeable lithium metal batteries for electric cars. Founded in 2010, it employs around 850 people. Major investors include Volkswagen Group and Bill Gates.

companies.name: Brother Industries
companies.description: Brother Industries, Ltd. is a Japanese multinational electronics and electrical equipment company headquartered in Nagoya, Japan. It produces printers, sewing machines, typewriters, fax machines, and other computer-related electronics, distributing products under its own name and OEM agreements.

companies.name: Brunswick Corporation
companies.description: Brunswick Corporation is an American company headquartered in Mettawa, Illinois, that has developed, manufactured, and sold a wide variety of products since 1845. It operates in 24 countries and owns brands including Mercury Marine.

companies.name: Canoo
companies.description: Canoo Inc. was an American automotive company based in Torrance, California, that developed and manufactured electric vehicles. Its research and development was in Michigan, with production in Texas. The company filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy on January 17, 2025.

companies.name: Cebu Pacific
companies.description: Cebu Air, Inc., operating as Cebu Pacific, is a Philippine low-cost airline based in Pasay, Metro Manila. Founded in 1988, it is the first low-cost carrier in Asia and the largest airline in the Philippines by fleet size, operating flights from five bases.

companies.name: Shanghai Electric
companies.description: Shanghai Electric is a Chinese multinational power generation and electrical equipment manufacturing company headquartered in Shanghai. The company traces its roots back to 1880.

companies.name: Broderbund
companies.description: Broderbund Software, Inc. was an American maker of video games, educational software, and productivity tools. Founded in Eugene, Oregon, it is known for titles like Prince of Persia and Myst. The company was acquired by The Learning Company in 1998.

companies.name: Sinotruk (Hong Kong) Limited
companies.description: Sinotruk Limited is a Hong Kong truck manufacturer incorporated in 2007. Its subsidiaries manufacture trucks in Mainland China. The parent company is China National Heavy Duty Truck Group, a Chinese state-owned heavy truck manufacturer headquartered in Jinan, Shandong Province.

companies.name: Bank of the Northeast
companies.description: Banco do Nordeste is a Brazilian regional development bank headquartered in Fortaleza, Ceará. Founded in 1952, it has 300 branches and operates in about 2000 cities across the Northeast region of Brazil and parts of the North region.

companies.name: Enel Distribuição São Paulo
companies.description: Enel Distribuição São Paulo is a major Brazilian power distributor in the state of São Paulo. It was created from the breakup of the old state-owned power company Eletropaulo, which monopolized electricity distribution in São Paulo from 1981 to 1999.

companies.name: EDP Brasil
companies.description: EDP Brasil is a major Brazilian electric utility company and a subsidiary of EDP - Energias de Portugal. Founded in 1996, it is based in São Paulo. The company operates in the renewables and utilities sector in Brazil.

companies.name: Azul Linhas Aéreas Brasileiras
companies.logo_file: Logo da Azul Linhas Aéreas Brasileiras.svg
companies.description: Azul Linhas Aéreas Brasileiras is a Brazilian airline headquartered in Barueri, São Paulo. Established in 2008 by David Neeleman, it focuses on providing frequent and affordable air service to underserved markets in Brazil. The airline began operations in December 2008.

companies.name: SurveyMonkey
companies.description: SurveyMonkey Inc. is an American software-as-a-service company providing online survey and forms tools. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Mateo, California, its platform is used globally across various sectors including business, education, and healthcare.

companies.name: J&F Investimentos
companies.description: J&F S.A. is a private investment holding company based in São Paulo, Brazil, founded in 1953. It operates in diverse industries such as agribusiness, manufacturing, electricity generation, and real estate. The company is owned by the Batista family.

companies.name: Sonatrach
companies.description: Sonatrach is Algeria's national state-owned oil company, founded in 1963. It is the largest company in Africa with 154 subsidiaries and is recognized as the first African oil major. In 2021, it ranked as the seventh largest gas company worldwide.

companies.name: Carrefour Brazil
companies.description: Grupo Carrefour Brasil, operating as Atacadão S.A., is a Brazilian retail company controlled by the French Carrefour group. It owns several brands including Atacadão, the largest wholesaler in Brazil, and is the largest food retail company in the country.

companies.name: Pemex
companies.description: Pemex is the Mexican state-owned petroleum corporation formed in 1938 by nationalizing private oil companies. It is managed by the Mexican government and is a symbol of Mexican nationalism. Pemex is one of Latin America's largest enterprises by revenue.

companies.name: Novonor
companies.description: Novonor, formerly Odebrecht S.A., is a Brazilian conglomerate headquartered in Salvador, Bahia. Founded in 1944, it operates in engineering, construction, chemicals, and petrochemicals across the Americas, Caribbean, Africa, Europe, and the Middle East.

companies.name: Comisión Federal de Electricidad
companies.industry: electric power generation, transmission and distribution
