companies.description: The Comisión Federal de Electricidad (CFE) is Mexico's state-owned electric utility responsible for the national electric industry. It operates under the Mexican constitution's mandate and is known for its slogan "Una empresa de clase mundial."

companies.name: Techint
companies.description: Techint is an Italian-Argentine conglomerate founded in 1945 by Agostino Rocca. It is headquartered in both Buenos Aires, Argentina, and Milan, Italy. The company operates in the metallurgy sector.

companies.name: Financial Group Banamex
companies.description: Grupo Financiero Banamex S.A. de C.V. is the holding company of Banco Nacional de México, known as Banamex. It is one of Mexico's largest banks and was acquired by Citigroup in 2001. The bank operated as a Citigroup subsidiary and was rebranded as Citibanamex until 2025, after which Citigroup sold portions to other investors.

companies.name: C&A
companies.description: C&A is a European designer and retailer specializing in fast fashion, focusing on casual wear. It operates approximately 1,250 stores in Europe and 330 in Brazil, with online shopping websites. In Brazil, it operates through a joint venture, and it licenses the C&A name for stores in Mexico and China under different ownership.

companies.name: Access Bank
companies.description: Access Bank Plc is a Nigerian multinational commercial bank owned by Access Bank Group. It is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria, the national banking regulator.

companies.name: General Motors do Brasil
companies.description: General Motors do Brasil is the largest subsidiary of General Motors in South America. It is one of the oldest and largest car producers in Brazil.

companies.name: Ecobank
companies.description: Ecobank Transnational Inc. (ETI) is a pan-African banking conglomerate with operations in 33 African countries. It is the leading independent regional banking group in West and Central Africa and has subsidiaries in Eastern and Southern Africa. It also maintains affiliates and representative offices in France, China, Dubai, South Africa, and the United Kingdom.

companies.name: De Beers
companies.description: De Beers Group is a British multinational diamond company specializing in mining, trading, and marketing diamonds. It operates in 35 countries with mining activities in Botswana, Namibia, South Africa, and Canada. It also runs an artisanal mining business called Gemfair in Sierra Leone.

companies.name: Banque Misr
companies.description: Banque Misr S.A.E. is a major Egyptian bank and one of Egypt's big five banks. Founded in 1920, it has branch offices across all Egyptian governorates and provides currency exchange and work permit offices for foreign workers. The bank was nationalized by the United Arab Republic government in 1960.

companies.name: Grupo Arcor
companies.description: Grupo Arcor is an Argentine food company specializing in confectioneries, founded in 1951 in Arroyito, Córdoba. It produces foodstuffs including sugar and chocolate confectioneries, cookies, and ice cream across 39 plants in Latin America. It is the world's top producer of hard candies and the largest processed food producer in Argentina, exporting to over 120 countries.

companies.name: Bank of Bogota
companies.description: Banco de Bogotá is a Colombian bank and the first commercial bank established in Colombia. It is one of the Big Four banks in the country.

companies.name: Elsewedy Electric
companies.description: Elsewedy Electric Co S.A.E. is an Egyptian multinational electrical company founded in 1938 by the Elsewedy family.

companies.name: ICR AT&T México
companies.description: AT&T Mexico is a Mexican mobile telephone operator and subsidiary of AT&T. It is headquartered in Mexico City and covers 90% of Mexico with its mobile network. AT&T Mexico is the third-largest wireless carrier in the country.

companies.name: Ford do Brasil
companies.description: Ford Motor Company Brasil Ltda. is the Brazilian subsidiary of the American automaker Ford Motor Company. Founded in 1919, it initially imported Ford Model T cars and Model TT trucks for assembly in Brazil. The Ford brand has been present in Brazil since 1904.

companies.name: ethio telecom
companies.description: Ethio telecom is an Ethiopian telecommunication company owned by the government. It serves as the major provider of internet, telephone, and digital services in Ethiopia. Based in Addis Ababa, it historically held a monopoly over telecommunication services in the country.

companies.name: EBX Group
companies.description: EBX Group was a Brazilian conglomerate founded by businessman Eike Batista. It included six companies listed on B3's Novo Mercado and invested in infrastructure, natural resources, real estate, technology, and other sectors. The group operated in Brazil, Chile, Canada, Colombia, and New York City.

companies.name: Mexican Red Cross
companies.description: The Mexican Red Cross is a non-governmental humanitarian organization affiliated with the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies. It provides aid in dangerous situations and health services, funded by volunteers and donations. It was established by presidential decree in 1910 and recognized internationally in 1912.

companies.name: Agrale
companies.description: Agrale is a Brazilian vehicle manufacturer producing tractors, commercial vehicles, military vehicles, bus chassis, and engines. It manufactures both self-developed tractor models and those based on Zetor designs. The company was previously known as Agrisa.

companies.name: Nigerian Postal Service
companies.description: The Nigerian Postal Service (NIPOST) is a government-owned corporation responsible for postal services in Nigeria. It employs over 12,000 people and operates more than 3,000 post offices across the country.

companies.name: Maroc Telecom
companies.description: Maroc Telecom is a telecommunications company in Morocco and the largest network in the country. It employs around 11,178 people and operates 8 regional delegations and 220 offices across Morocco. The company is listed on the Casablanca Stock Exchange and Euronext Paris.

companies.name: Embraco
companies.description: Embraco is a Brazilian manufacturer of compressors for refrigeration systems founded in 1971. It produces hermetic compressors, condensing units, and sealed units for both domestic and commercial use.

companies.name: Sonangol Group
companies.description: Group Sonangol is a parastatal that oversaw petroleum and natural gas production in Angola. It consisted of Sonangol E.P. and its subsidiaries, serving various clients. In 2023, Sonangol produced 202,000 barrels of oil.

companies.name: Zaffari
companies.description: Companhia Zaffari is a Brazilian company operating a chain of supermarkets and hypermarkets primarily in Rio Grande do Sul and São Paulo. It is recognized as the tenth largest company in Brazil. The company focuses on retail operations within the country.

companies.name: Air Algérie
companies.description: Air Algérie SpA is the flag carrier airline of Algeria, headquartered in Algiers. It operates scheduled flights to 33 domestic and 42 international destinations across multiple continents. The airline is fully owned by the Government of Algeria.

companies.name: Grupo Record
companies.description: Grupo Record is the third largest media company in Brazil, owning several television stations including Record and Record News. Founded in November 1989, it is owned by businessman and bishop Edir Macedo. The company operates within the Brazilian media industry.

companies.name: AJE Group
companies.description: Ajegroup, or AJE, is a Peruvian multinational company that manufactures, distributes, and sells alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. Founded in 1988 in Ayacucho, Peru, it is known for its flagship product Kola Real. The company operates in the beverage industry.

companies.name: Bradesco Seguros
companies.description: Bradesco Seguros is the largest insurance company in Brazil and Latin America, created in 1983 after Banco Bradesco acquired Atlântica Boavista de Seguros. The company is headquartered in Barueri, São Paulo, and operates in the financial services sector.

companies.name: Clarín Group
companies.description: Grupo Clarín S.A. is an Argentine media conglomerate headquartered in Buenos Aires. It operates in the mass media industry within Argentina. The company is a significant player in the country's media sector.

companies.name: Marjane Group
companies.description: Marjane Group is a Moroccan retail company operating a nationwide network of hypermarkets and supermarkets under the Marjane and Marjane Market brands. It is wholly owned by the Al Mada holding company. The company serves the retail market in Morocco.

companies.name: Eurofarma
companies.logo_file: (2018.05.16) Alunos do Senai fazem visita a Eurofarma.jpg
companies.description: Eurofarma is a Brazilian multinational biopharmaceutical company founded in 1972. It produces generic, oncologic, and veterinary medications and is one of the largest medicine producers in Brazil and Latin America. The company offers about 2000 products in Brazil.

companies.name: Société nationale d'électricité
companies.description: Société Nationale d'Électricité (SNEL) is the national electricity company of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, headquartered in Kinshasa. It operates the Inga Dam on the Congo River and thermal power stations. SNEL is responsible for electric power generation in the country.

companies.name: Administración Nacional de Usinas y Trasmisiones Eléctricas
companies.industry: electric power generation, transmission and distribution
companies.description: The National Administration of Power Plants and Electrical Transmissions, known as UTE, is Uruguay's government-owned power company. Established in 1912, it operates as a monopoly in electric power generation, transmission, and distribution. UTE was created following the approval of Law 4273.

companies.name: ANTEL
companies.description: Administración Nacional de Telecomunicaciones (ANTEL) is Uruguay's government-owned telecommunications company founded in 1974. It was spun off from UTE's telecommunications division and holds a monopoly on landline telephony and data services. ANTEL also provides mobile phone and Internet-related services in Uruguay.

companies.name: Politec
companies.description: Politec is an IT outsourcing service provider based in Brasília, Brazil. The company employs over 6,000 people and was acquired in 2011 by the Spanish company Indra Sistemas. Politec operates in the information technology sector.

companies.name: National Bank of Algeria
companies.description: Banque Nationale d’Algérie is a state-owned commercial bank headquartered in Algiers, Algeria. It is a leading bank in the country, providing financial services to private customers, companies, and public institutions. The bank is active in financing industry, agriculture, and foreign trade.

companies.name: Diários Associados
companies.description: Diários Associados, or Associated Dailies, is a union of Brazilian communication media. It was created by Assis Chateaubriand and operates in the mass media industry in Brazil.

companies.name: Movistar Argentina
companies.description: Movistar Argentina is an Argentine telecommunications company and a subsidiary of Telefónica Group. It has operated under various trade names including Miniphone and Unifón, and adopted the Movistar brand after merging with Movicom BellSouth in 2005.

companies.name: Alexbank
companies.description: Alexbank, formerly Bank of Alexandria, is a medium-sized Egyptian bank founded in 1957. Intesa Sanpaolo is the major shareholder. The bank operates in Egypt's financial sector.

companies.name: Alpargatas Argentina
companies.description: Alpargatas S.A.I.C. is an Argentine manufacturing company specializing in clothing and footwear. Established in 1885, it was the leading textile and footwear manufacturer in Argentina and became a subsidiary of Brazilian Alpargatas S.A. in 2007.

companies.name: TE Data
companies.description: Telecom Egypt is Egypt's primary telephone company, founded in 1854 with the first telegraph line in the country. It is the first telecommunications company in Africa and replaced the Egyptian National Telecommunication Organization (ARENTO) in 1998.

companies.name: First City Monument Bank
companies.description: First City Monument Bank (FCMB) is a financial services holding company headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. It has nine subsidiaries across commercial and retail banking, investment banking, and asset and wealth management. FCMB Group Plc is the parent company.

companies.name: Renault Argentina
companies.description: Renault Argentina is the Argentine subsidiary of the French car manufacturer Renault. Established officially in 1975, it is one of the oldest Renault operations worldwide and consistently ranks first in sales among local automakers in Argentina.

companies.name: Audi Brasil
companies.description: Audi Brasil Distribuidora de Veículos is a Brazilian company that imports and distributes Audi cars in Brazil. It was established in 2000 as a joint venture named Audi Senna.

companies.name: Productos Ramo
companies.description: Productos Ramo SA is a Colombian snack food company known for competing with multinational brands. Its popular products include Gala pastries, Chocoramo chocolate-coated cake, and snacks like Tostacos and Maizitos.

companies.name: Paz del Río Steel Mills
companies.description: Acerías Paz del Río is a Colombian steel and iron company controlled by Grupo Trinity S.A. It operates in the iron and steel industry within Colombia.

companies.name: Djezzy GSM
companies.description: Djezzy is one of Algeria's three main mobile network operators, covering 90% of the population. It was launched in 2002 and has been wholly owned by the Algerian state since 2022.

companies.name: Grupo Abril
companies.description: Grupo Abril is a Brazilian media conglomerate headquartered in São Paulo. It is the holding company of Editora Abril, publisher of the weekly newsmagazine Veja.

companies.name: Río Santiago Shipyard
companies.description: The Río Santiago Shipyard is a major shipyard located in Ensenada, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina. Founded in 1953 and owned by the provincial government, it has served naval, industrial, and railroad sectors.

companies.name: Banco de Seguros del Estado
companies.description: The State Insurance Bank is a government-owned insurance company in Uruguay. Established in 1911, it operates under the Ministry of Economy and Finance and functions as an autonomous state entity.

companies.name: Movitel
companies.description: Movitel is a mobile telecommunications operator based in Maputo, Mozambique. It operates through 12 subsidiaries across 11 provinces and is a partnership between Vietnamese company Viettel and Mozambique's SPI.

companies.name: Cervecería Nacional Dominicana
companies.description: Cervecería Nacional Dominicana is the primary beer producer in the Dominican Republic, founded in 1929. Owned by AmBev and Grupo León Jimenes, it was the first brewery in the country and produces brands like Presidente and Bohemia Especial.

companies.name: Sterling Bank
companies.description: Sterling Bank Ltd. is a Nigerian commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria. It is headquartered at Sterling Towers, 20 Marina, Lagos, and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc. The bank has sister subsidiaries including The Alternative Bank Limited and SterlingFI Wealth Management Limited.

companies.name: bmobile
companies.description: bmobile is a mobile phone, home security, and fixed wireless provider based in Trinidad and Tobago. It operates as a division of TSTT. The company offers various telecommunications services within the country.

companies.name: IMBEL
companies.description: Indústria de Material Bélico do Brasil (IMBEL) is a Brazilian Ministry of Defence quango founded in 1975. It coordinates industrial activity related to the planning and production of war material through technology transfer and financial and technical support for new military development.

companies.name: Unitel
companies.description: Unitel S.A. is a private Angolan mobile phone company established on 8 March 2001 as a joint-stock company. It is owned by the Angolan state after being nationalised in 2022. The company operates in the telecommunications industry in Angola.

companies.name: Boliviana de Aviación
companies.description: Boliviana de Aviación, stylized as BoA, is the flag carrier airline of Bolivia and is wholly owned by the government. Founded in October 2007 and headquartered in Cochabamba, it operates domestic flights mainly from Jorge Wilstermann International Airport and international flights from Viru Viru International Airport.

companies.name: Bob's
companies.description: Bob's is a Brazilian fast food chain founded in 1952 by American Brazilian tennis champion Bob Falkenburg. The first store opened in the Copacabana neighborhood of Rio de Janeiro. It is recognized as the first Brazilian fast food chain.

companies.name: Viettel Tanzania
companies.description: Viettel Tanzania Public Limited Company, trading as Halotel, is a mobile communications company in Tanzania. Owned by Viettel Global JSC from Vietnam, it provides voice, messaging, data, and communication services. It was the first company in Tanzania allowed to lay its own fiber optic cable, covering all 26 regions.

companies.name: Rede S.A.
companies.description: Rede S.A., also known as Redecard, is a Brazilian multi-brand acquirer with 25 brands for credit, debit, and benefit cards. It offers merchant acquiring, transaction processing, POS terminal rental, and loyalty programs. It is the largest company in its sector in Brazil.

companies.name: WOM
companies.description: WOM S.A. is a Chilean telecommunications company providing mobile telephony, Internet service, television service, and media streaming. It operates primarily in Chile's telecommunications market.

companies.name: Rawbank
companies.description: Rawbank is a regulated financial institution based in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Founded on 2 May 2002, it has grown to become the DRC's largest universal bank. The bank offers a range of financial services within the country.

companies.name: Gamtel
companies.description: Gamtel is the principal telecommunications company in the Gambia, established in 1984 as a state-owned enterprise. It oversees telecommunications and internet services and helped build the country's internet infrastructure. The company is 99% government-owned and operates from its main offices in Banjul.

companies.name: Inwi
companies.description: Inwi is a telecommunications company based in Morocco, founded in 2009. It operates as a subsidiary of the Moroccan holding Al Mada and the Kuwaiti group Zain.

companies.name: Indústria Naval do Ceará
companies.description: Indústria Naval do Ceará (INACE) is a shipbuilding company located in Fortaleza, Brazil. It specializes in shipbuilding activities within the country.

companies.name: Orange Morocco
companies.description: Orange Maroc, formerly known as Meditel, is one of the three major licensed telecommunications operators in Morocco. It offers mobile, fixed-line, cybersecurity, and mobile payment services.

companies.name: Compagnie minière d'Akouta
companies.description: COMINAK is a national uranium mining company based in Niger. It operates in the uranium mining industry within the country.

companies.name: Cervejas De Moçambique
companies.description: Cervejas de Moçambique (CDM) is a Mozambican beer brewing group and a subsidiary of Anheuser-Busch InBev. It holds all major Mozambican beer brands and controls approximately 94% of the local beer market.

companies.name: Telecom Namibia
companies.description: Telecom Namibia Limited is a telecommunications and ICT service provider operating in Namibia. Established in 1992, it is wholly government-owned and serves as the national telecommunications operator.

companies.name: AREP
companies.description: AREP is a multidisciplinary consultancy wholly owned by SNCF, founded in 1997 by architects and engineers. It employs 600 staff from about 15 countries and focuses on ecological design through the EMC2B approach.

companies.name: Botswana Telecommunications Corporation
companies.description: Botswana Telecommunications Corporation (BTC) is a converged telecommunications operator in Botswana, established in 1980 as a 100% government-owned entity. It offers fixed, mobile, broadband, cloud, and fintech services.

companies.name: Venezuelan Red Cross
companies.description: The Venezuelan Red Cross Society was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Avenida Andrés Bello in Caracas, Venezuela. Its first president was Briton Vincent Kennett-Barrington. It operates as an emergency and relief organization.

companies.name: Kenya Red Cross Society
companies.description: The Kenya Red Cross was established in 1965 and is part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. It supports various projects including famine relief, blood services, first aid, disaster and emergency services, and education in Kenya.

companies.name: Air Seychelles
companies.description: Air Seychelles is the national airline of the Republic of Seychelles. Its head office is located at Seychelles International Airport on the island of Mahé. The airline operates inter-island, international, and charter flights.

companies.name: Namibia Breweries Limited
companies.description: Namibia Breweries Limited is a brewery founded in 1920 and based in Windhoek, Namibia. In April 2023, Heineken completed the purchase of the company. It operates in the brewery industry.

companies.name: Egyptian Red Crescent Society
companies.description: The Egyptian Red Crescent Society is a humanitarian organization founded in 1911 by Sheikh Ali Youssef in Cairo, Egypt. It provides emergency medical services and humanitarian aid and is a member of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies.

companies.name: Helibras
companies.description: Helibras, or Helicópteros do Brasil S.A., is a Brazil-based helicopter manufacturer. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of Airbus Helicopters, a division of Airbus. The company operates in the aerospace industry.

companies.name: Endiama
companies.description: ENDIAMA E.P. is the state-run national diamond company of Angola. It holds exclusive mining rights for rough diamonds in Angola. The company operates in the mining industry.

companies.name: Westair Aviation
companies.description: Westair Aviation Limited is a Namibian aviation service provider and airline based at Eros Airport in Windhoek. It offers scheduled passenger services under the FlyNamibia brand, as well as cargo and ACMI services.

companies.name: Overland Airways
companies.description: Overland Airways is an airline based in Ikeja, Lagos State, Nigeria. Its main base is Murtala Muhammed International Airport in Ikeja, with a hub at Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport in Abuja.

companies.name: Zimbabwe Red Cross Society
companies.description: Zimbabwe Red Cross Society (ZRCS) is a humanitarian organization founded in 1981 by an act of the Zimbabwe Parliament. It is headquartered in Harare, Zimbabwe. The society focuses on emergency and relief efforts within the country.

companies.name: Airkenya Express
companies.description: Airkenya Express is an airline based in Nairobi, Kenya. It operates domestic scheduled and charter flights, as well as scheduled services to Tanzania. Its main base is Wilson Airport in Nairobi.

companies.name: Algerian Red Crescent
companies.description: The Algerian Red Crescent is a humanitarian volunteer organization in Algeria founded in 1957. It has been recognized by the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement since 1963. The organization focuses on emergency and relief activities.

companies.name: Rwandan Red Cross
companies.description: The Rwandan Red Cross (RRC) is a humanitarian organization established in July 1962 in Kigali, Rwanda. It provides emergency and relief services within the country. The organization is part of the global Red Cross movement.

companies.name: Sierra Leone Red Cross Society
companies.description: Sierra Leone Red Cross Society (SLRCS) is a national humanitarian organization established in 1962 by an act of the Parliament of Sierra Leone. It is headquartered in Freetown and focuses on emergency and relief efforts.

companies.name: Paradise Aircraft
companies.description: Paradise Industria Aeronautica Ltda is a Brazilian aircraft manufacturer founded in 2001 and based in Feira de Santana, Bahia State. The company specializes in designing and manufacturing light aircraft, particularly ready-to-fly models for the American light-sport aircraft category.

companies.name: Legit.ng
companies.description: Legit.ng, also known as Legit News, is a Nigerian digital media and news platform operated by Naij.com Media Limited. It is part of Legit (formerly GMEM) and provides news content primarily in Nigeria.

companies.name: The New Times
companies.description: The New Times is a national English-language newspaper in Rwanda established in 1995 shortly after the genocide against the Tutsi. It previously published a Kinyarwanda-language weekly called Izuba Rirashe. The newspaper serves as a key source of news in Rwanda.

companies.name: ACE Team
companies.description: ACE Team Software S.A. is a Chilean video game developer based in Santiago. Founded in the late 1990s by the Bordeu brothers, the company initially developed total conversions before moving to commercial game development. Operations were paused between 2003 and 2007 while two founders worked at Wanako Games.

companies.name: Gabon Telecom
companies.description: Gabon Telecom SA is the largest telecommunications company in Gabon. It manages the country's internet domain .ga and operates about 35,000 land lines. Its cellular phone service subsidiary, Libertis, serves 200,000 customers.

companies.name: Air Service Gabon
companies.description: Air Service Gabon was an airline based in Libreville, Gabon, established in 1965. It operated scheduled, passenger, and charter flights in West Africa. The airline ceased operations on August 3, 2010.

companies.name: Nouvelle Air Affaires Gabon
companies.description: Nouvelle Air Affaires Gabon is an airline based in Libreville, Gabon. It provides corporate and freight charter services. Its main base is Libreville International Airport.

companies.name: Afric Aviation
companies.description: Afric Aviation is a regional airline headquartered in Port Gentil, Gabon. Its primary hub is Port-Gentil International Airport. The airline operates within the region.

companies.name: Air Excellence
companies.description: Air Excellence was an airline based in Libreville, Gabon. It was established in 2002 and ceased operations in 2004.

companies.name: RegionAir
companies.description: RegionAir is an airline headquartered in Port-Gentil, Gabon. It focuses on regional flights in Central and West Africa and operates strictly as a charter airline for oil and gas companies. It does not sell tickets to the general public.

companies.name: Sky Gabon
companies.description: Sky Gabon was a cargo airline based in Libreville, Gabon, with its main base at Libreville International Airport. It was on the list of air carriers banned in the European Union and ceased all operations in 2019.

companies.name: AfriJet
companies.description: Afrijet Business Service is a Gabonese airline operating scheduled services to airports in Cameroon, Gabon, São Tomé, and the Republic of the Congo. It provides regional air transport services.

companies.name: Gambia Red Cross Society
companies.description: Gambia Red Cross Society, founded in 1966, originated as a branch of the British Red Cross in 1948. It was officially recognized by the International Committee of the Red Cross in 1974. The organization is headquartered in Banjul, The Gambia.

companies.name: Trust Bank Limited
companies.description: Trust Bank PLC (Gambia), formerly Trust Bank Ltd, is a private commercial bank in the Gambia. It is one of twelve commercial banks licensed by the Central Bank of the Gambia, the national banking regulator.

companies.name: New Millenium Air
companies.description: New Millennium Air Company was a Gambian airline based in Banjul, The Gambia. It operated as an airline within the country.

companies.name: Air Charter Africa
companies.description: Air Charter Africa was a charter airline based in Banjul, Gambia. It was established as Air Charter Express in 2007 and shortly renamed.

companies.name: Sonatel
companies.description: Sonatel is the principal telecommunications provider of Senegal, created in 1985. It offers fixed line and mobile telephony, internet service, television, and corporate telecommunications, and manages 2,200 kilometers of fiber optic cable in Senegal.

companies.name: Guinee Air Service
companies.description: Guinee Air Service was an airline based in Conakry, Guinea. Established in 1985, it operated domestic charter flights with its main base at Conakry International Airport.

companies.name: Correios da Guiné-Bissau
companies.description: Correios da Guiné-Bissau is the government-owned postal service company of Guinea-Bissau. Its headquarters is in the former colonial Post Office building in Bissau, and it joined the Universal Postal Union in 1974.

companies.name: Radiodiffusion télévision ivoirienne
companies.description: Radiodiffusion-Télévision ivoirienne (RTI) is the publicly owned radio and television authority of Côte d'Ivoire. It is financed through television and radio licenses, advertisements, and taxes.

companies.name: Bourse Regionale Des Valeurs Mobilieres
companies.description: The Bourse Régionale des Valeurs Mobilières (BRVM) is a regional stock exchange serving eight West African countries including Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, and Mali.

companies.name: Air Côte d'Ivoire
companies.description: Air Côte d'Ivoire is the flag carrier airline of Ivory Coast, based in Abidjan. It succeeded the former flag carrier Air Ivoire and started operations on November 12, 2012.

companies.name: Kiro'o Games
companies.description: Kiro'o Games, also known as Kiro'o Studios, is a privately held video game, animation, development, and publishing company headquartered in Yaoundé, Cameroon.

companies.name: Afriland First Bank
companies.description: Afriland First Group is a conglomerate with banks, insurance, and investment advisory businesses headquartered in Switzerland. Its flagship company, Afriland First Bank, is based in Yaoundé, Cameroon and was founded in 1987.

companies.name: Cameroon radio television
companies.description: Cameroon Radio Television (CRTV) is a major radio and television broadcasting company based in Cameroon. It operates terrestrial television and radio services across the country. CRTV is a key player in Cameroon's media landscape.

companies.name: Société Nationale des Hydrocarbures
companies.description: Société Nationale des Hydrocarbures (SNH) is Cameroon's national oil and gas company, established on 12 March 1980. It partners with international oil companies and manages the sale of the government's share of oil output. SNH also holds minor stakes in projects operated by international partners.

companies.name: Cameroon Red Cross Society
companies.description: The Cameroon Red Cross Society, established on 30 April 1960, is headquartered in Yaoundé. It is led by Léonie Cécile and focuses on emergency and relief efforts within Cameroon.

companies.name: Ministry of Justice of Cameroon
companies.description: The Ministry of Justice of Cameroon administers the country's justice system and prison system since early 2005. It also shares responsibility for human rights administration. The ministry operates within a complex legal framework including elements of Code Napoleon, Common Law, and customary law.

companies.name: Boissons du Cameroun
companies.description: Les Sociétés Anonymes des Brasseries du Cameroun is a brewing company with offices and a main factory in Douala, Cameroon. It has additional breweries in Bafoussam, Douala, Garoua, and Yaoundé. The company is majority-owned by Les Brasseries et Glacieres Internationales (BGI) and partly by Heineken.

companies.name: Camtel
companies.description: Camtel is Cameroon's national telecommunications and Internet service provider. It is focused on expanding its network, including CDMA access, digitizing telephone exchanges, and deploying optical fiber along key highways between Douala, Yaoundé, Kribi, and Lolodorf.

companies.name: Elysian Airlines
companies.description: Elysian Airlines is a cargo airline based at Yaoundé Nsimalen International Airport in Cameroon. Founded in January 2006, it had operations in Liberia and Guinea. The airline stopped scheduled operations in 2010 but resumed them in 2015.

companies.name: Camair-Co
companies.description: Camair-Co is the flag carrier airline of Cameroon, headquartered in Douala and operating from Douala International Airport. It succeeded the now-defunct Cameroon Airlines. The airline has struggled financially and currently has most of its aircraft grounded.

companies.name: Axis Lines International
companies.description: Axis Lines International was a planned start-up airline based in Douala, Cameroon. It intended to operate regional flights with McDonnell Douglas MD-80 aircraft and international flights to Brussels, Madrid, and Paris with a Boeing 767-300ER.

companies.name: Air Leasing Cameroon
companies.description: Air Leasing Cameroon is an air charter company based in Douala, Cameroon. It provides charter flight services within the region.

companies.name: Cargo Airways International
companies.description: Cargo Airways International was a cargo airline based in Douala, Cameroon. It operated from Douala International Airport as its main base. The airline specialized in cargo transport services.

companies.name: RecordTV Cabo Verde
companies.description: RecordTV Cabo Verde is a television channel in Cape Verde, launched on 31 March 2007. It is the first Brazilian-based channel to have its own version in Cape Verde. The channel is part of the Record network.

companies.name: ENAPOR
companies.description: ENAPOR is the Cape Verdean port authority responsible for managing ports, terminals, and port zones in Cape Verde. It is a public limited company fully owned by the State of Cape Verde. Jorge Pimenta Maurício is the current president.

companies.name: Red Cross of Cape Verde
companies.description: The Red Cross of Cape Verde, abbreviated CVCV, was founded in 1984. It is headquartered on Avenida Andrade Corvo in Praia, Cape Verde. The organization provides emergency and relief services.

companies.name: Correios de Cabo Verde
companies.description: Correios de Cabo Verde is the company responsible for postal services in Cape Verde. Its headquarters are located in the city centre of Praia at Rua Cesário Lacerda, nº 2. The company manages mail delivery across the country.

companies.name: Cabo Verde Express
companies.description: Cabo Verde Express is a regional airline headquartered in Espargos, Cape Verde. It operates domestic scheduled and charter flights from Amílcar Cabral International Airport. The airline focuses on regional air transport services.

companies.name: Banco Cabo-Verdiano de Negócios
companies.description: Banco Cabo-Verdiano de Negócios is a commercial bank based in Praia, Cape Verde. Its headquarters are located on Avenida Amílcar Cabral. Luís Vasconcelos Lopes is the current president of its board of directors.

companies.name: Econet Telecom Lesotho
companies.description: Econet Telecom Lesotho (ETL) is a telecommunications company in Lesotho co-owned by Econet Global and the Lesotho government. It is one of the two main wireless service providers in the country, alongside Vodacom Lesotho.

companies.name: Pick n Pay
companies.description: Pick n Pay is a major South African retail chain headquartered in Cape Town. Founded in 1967, it operates around 2,300 stores. The company is listed on the JSE Limited stock exchange.

companies.name: Lesotho Airways
companies.description: Lesotho Airways, formerly Air Lesotho, was the national airline of Lesotho based at Mejametalana Airport in Maseru. It operated international and domestic passenger services until 1997. The airline suspended international flights in 1996 and was acquired by Rossair Contracts Private Ltd in 1997.

companies.name: Libyan Foreign Bank
companies.description: Libyan Foreign Bank (LFB) is a Libyan bank established in 1972 in Tripoli. It was Libya's first offshore banking institution licensed to operate internationally. The Central Bank of Libya owns 100% of LFB, and its head office is located in Tripoli.

companies.name: Umma Bank
companies.description: Umma Bank was established on 14 April 1907 under an agreement between Italy and the Turkish Sultan. It was renamed Umma Bank in 1911 following a revolutionary decision to give commercial banks Arabic names. It is one of Libya's historic banks.

companies.name: General Posts and Telecommunications Company
companies.description: The General Posts and Telecommunications Company (GPTC) is a state-owned organization responsible for postal and telecommunication services in Libya. It manages fixed telephony, satellite communications, mobile telephony in partnership with Al Madar and Libyana, and other internet service providers.

companies.name: National Oil Corporation
companies.description: The National Oil Corporation (NOC) is Libya's national oil company dominating the country's oil industry. It oversees several subsidiaries, including the Waha Oil Company, Arabian Gulf Oil Company, Zueitina Oil Company, and Sirte Oil Company. It is led by Farhat Bengdara since July 2022.

companies.name: Arabian Gulf Oil Company
companies.description: The Arabian Gulf Oil Company is an oil company based in Benghazi, Libya. It engages in crude oil and natural gas exploration, production, and refining. It operates as a subsidiary of the state-owned National Oil Corporation.

companies.name: Sirte Oil Company
companies.description: Sirte Oil Company (SOC) is a Libyan oil and gas company operating under the state-owned National Oil Corporation. Located in Brega, SOC's operations include oil and gas exploration, production, and manufacturing.

companies.name: Libyana
companies.description: Libyana Mobile Phone is a Libyan mobile phone company established in 2004. It is state-owned via LPTIC and is one of the two major mobile phone operators in Libya. The company offers 4G+ and VoLTE coverage and is testing 5G technology.

companies.name: Libyan Arab Air Cargo
companies.description: Libyan Air Cargo was a cargo airline based in Tripoli, Libya, serving as the cargo division of Libyan Airlines. It operated all-cargo services with its main base at Tripoli International Airport, serving destinations across Africa, Europe, and Asia.

companies.name: Libyan Iron and Steel Company
companies.description: The Libyan Iron and Steel Company (Lisco) is one of the largest iron and steelmaking companies in North Africa. Based in Misrata, it is government-owned and was founded in 1979. In 2004, it was ranked third among the largest Arab iron and steel companies.

companies.name: Afriqiyah Airways
companies.description: Afriqiyah Airways is a Libyan state-owned airline based in Tripoli, established in 2001. It operates domestic and international flights with its main hub at Tripoli International Airport, serving destinations across Africa, the Middle East, and Europe.

companies.name: Air Libya
companies.description: Air Libya is a privately owned charter airline based in Benghazi, Libya. Established in 1996 as Tibesti Air Libya, it operates charter flights supporting oil field operations and some scheduled and ad hoc charter services. Its main base is Benina International Airport in Benghazi.

companies.name: Air One Nine Company
companies.description: Air One Nine Company was a charter airline based in Tripoli, Libya. The airline operated in the Libyan aviation sector but no further details are provided.

companies.name: Libyan Airlines
companies.description: Libyan Airlines is the flag carrier of Libya, based in Tripoli. It operates scheduled passenger and cargo services within Libya and to Europe, North Africa, and the Middle East, with Tripoli International Airport as its main base and Benina International Airport as a secondary base. The company is wholly owned by the government of Libya.

companies.name: Buraq Air
companies.description: Buraq Air is an airline headquartered at Mitiga International Airport in Tripoli, Libya. It operates a minor international scheduled network, charter services, and flights supporting CHC. The airline's base is Mitiga International Airport, and its Chairman and CEO is Captain Mohamed Bubeida, who is also an active pilot.

companies.name: Tobruk Air
companies.description: Tobruk Air Transport and Cargo, commonly known as Tobruk Air, was a cargo airline based in Libya. No additional operational details are provided.

companies.name: Petro Air
companies.description: Petro Air is a charter airline based in Tripoli, Libya. The airline is banned from flying into EU airspace.

companies.name: Madina Air
companies.description: Madina Air was a privately owned airline based in Tripoli, Libya, established in 2009. It operated charter flights supporting oil field operations and provided some scheduled and ad hoc charter services.

companies.name: Global Aviation and Services Group
companies.description: Global Aviation and Services Group is a Libyan charter airline based in Tripoli, founded in 2003. The airline is currently banned from flying in the EU.

companies.name: Libyan Wings
companies.description: Libyan Wings Airlines Co JSC, or Libyan Wings, is an airline headquartered in ben ashour, Tripoli, Libya. It started operations in September 2015 and operates four Airbus A319s to destinations in Libya, Tunisia, and Turkey.

companies.name: Jirama
companies.description: Jirama is a state-owned electric utility and water services company in Madagascar. It provides electric and water services as a public utility.

companies.name: High Constitutional Court of Madagascar
companies.description: The High Constitutional Court (HCC) is one of the five institutions of Madagascar established under Article 40 of the Constitution of the Fourth Republic. It serves as a constitutional law institution in Madagascar.

companies.name: Air Madagascar
companies.description: Madagascar Airlines is the flag carrier airline of Madagascar, based in Antananarivo. It operates international flights to Europe, Asia, and neighboring African and Indian Ocean islands, as well as an extensive domestic network from its main base at Ivato International Airport.

companies.name: Tiko Air
companies.description: Tiko Air is a charter airline based in Antananarivo, Madagascar. It operates charter flight services within Madagascar.

companies.name: Malawi Posts Corporation
companies.description: Malawi Posts Corporation (MPC) is the statutory corporation responsible for postal services and some financial services in Malawi.

companies.name: Ulendo Airlink
companies.description: Nyasa Express Limited, trading as FlyNyasa, is a Malawian charter airline operating from Kamuzu International Airport in Lilongwe. It began operations in 2011 under the name Ulendo Airlink and rebranded in February 2022.

companies.name: Malawi Airlines
companies.description: Malawi Airlines is the flag carrier airline of Malawi, based in Lilongwe with its hub at Kamuzu International Airport. Established in 2012 after Air Malawi's liquidation, it is operated under a management contract by Ethiopian Airlines, which owns 49 percent of the airline.

companies.name: Mauritanian Post Company
companies.description: La Société Mauritanienne des Postes, or Mauripost, is the official postal operator of Mauritania. Founded in 1999, it is responsible for postal services and became a regular member of the Universal Postal Union in 1967.

companies.name: Mauritel
companies.description: Mauritel is a principal telecommunications company in Mauritania, established in 1999 in Nouakchott. On January 1, 2021, it adopted the commercial name Moov Mauritel and launched Mauritania's first 4G network.

companies.name: Mauritania Airlines
companies.description: Mauritania Airlines, based in Nouakchott, is the flag carrier airline of Mauritania. Established in December 2010 after Mauritania Airways ceased operations, it rebranded in April 2018 and is the only airline flying domestically within Mauritania.

companies.name: Mauritius Telecom
companies.description: Mauritius Telecom (MT) is a telecommunications company in Mauritius. As of December 2019, it served hundreds of thousands of fixed line, mobile, fibre-ready, IPTV, and broadband internet customers.

companies.name: Air Mauritius
companies.description: Air Mauritius is the flag carrier airline of Mauritius, headquartered in Port Louis. It operates primarily from its hub at Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport. The airline represents the country as its national carrier.

companies.name: Bank of Africa
companies.description: Bank of Africa, formerly Banque Marocaine du Commerce Extérieur, is a Moroccan international financial services group. It is headquartered in Casablanca and provides a range of financial services internationally.

companies.name: BCP Group
companies.description: BCP Group, also known as Banque Populaire or Chaabi, is a Moroccan international financial services group. It is headquartered at the BCP Tower in Casablanca and offers various banking services.

companies.name: CIH Bank
companies.description: CIH Bank, formerly Crédit Immobilier et Hôtelier, is a Moroccan bank based in Casablanca. Initially focused on real estate and hospitality financing, it has expanded to offer universal banking services to individuals and businesses.

companies.name: Saham Bank
companies.description: Saham Bank is a Moroccan commercial bank headquartered in Casablanca. It was originally established in 1913 as the Moroccan subsidiary of the French banking group Société Générale.

companies.name: Al Mada
companies.description: Al Mada, formerly Société Nationale d'Investissement, is a private Moroccan holding company established in 1966. It is headquartered in Casablanca and mainly owned by the Moroccan royal family.

companies.name: OCP Group
companies.description: OCP Group, formerly Office Chérifien des Phosphates, is a Moroccan state-owned company specializing in phosphate rock mining, phosphoric acid manufacturing, and fertilizer production. Founded in 1920, it is the world's largest producer of phosphate and related products.

companies.name: Medi 1 TV
companies.description: Medi 1 TV is a news television network based in Tangier, Morocco. Launched in 2006 as a satellite broadcaster, it expanded to terrestrial and digital platforms and is part of Medi 1 News, which also operates a radio station founded in 1980.

companies.name: KITEA
companies.logo_file: Logo KITEA noir sans accroche MAJ-01 (2).jpg
companies.description: Kitea is a Moroccan furniture and home decoration retail brand founded in 1993 by Amine Benkirane. It operates 33 stores across 16 Moroccan cities and has expanded into Sub-Saharan Africa.

companies.name: Wafa Assurance
companies.description: Wafa Assurance is a Moroccan insurance company and subsidiary of Attijariwafa Bank. Founded in 1972 and headquartered in Casablanca, it offers life and non-life insurance services to individual and corporate clients and is part of the Al Mada holding group.

companies.name: Akwa Group
companies.description: Akwa Group is a private Moroccan conglomerate owned by the Akhannouch and Wakrim families. It operates in several key sectors including hydrocarbons, distribution, tourism, media, real estate, and renewable energy. The group is named after its founding families.

companies.name: Afriquia
companies.description: Afriquia is a Moroccan company engaged in the distribution of petroleum products. Founded in 1959, it is a subsidiary of the Akwa Group, a diversified Moroccan conglomerate.

companies.name: Caisse de dépôt et de gestion
companies.wiki: Caisse de Dépôt et de Gestion
companies.description: The Caisse de dépôt et de gestion is a state-owned financial institution in Morocco responsible for collecting, protecting, and investing long-term savings. It manages regulated funds and is an institutional investor in sectors like real estate, tourism, and infrastructure through its subsidiaries.

companies.name: Atlas Corporation Studios
companies.description: Atlas Studios is a film studio located near Ouarzazate, Morocco. Many movie sets remain on the property, which lies in the desert and mountains, and the studio operates guided tours, making it a popular tourist destination.

companies.name: Société Nationale de Radiodiffusion et de Télévision
companies.description: The National Company of Radio and Television is Morocco's public state-owned broadcaster. It operates as the country's official mass media organization.

companies.name: Marjane Market
companies.description: Marjane Market is a supermarket chain in Morocco. It is part of the Marjane Group and is fully owned by Al Mada, the holding company of King Mohammed VI.

companies.name: Koutoubia (brand)
companies.description: Koutoubia is a Moroccan agri-food company known for producing processed meats and charcuterie. Founded in 1985 in Mohammédia by Mohamed Belghiti Khennoussi, it was later acquired by entrepreneur Tahar Bimezzagh.

companies.name: Aïcha
companies.description: Aïcha is a Moroccan food brand known for jams, tomato sauces, oils, olives, canned tuna, and harissa. Founded in 1929 in Meknes by French entrepreneurs, it became iconic in Moroccan households with its mascot, the little girl "Aïcha."

companies.name: Somaca
companies.description: Somaca is a Moroccan car manufacturer founded in 1959 by Fiat company Simca. It is currently owned by the French company Renault.

companies.name: Renault Tanger Méditerranée
companies.description: Renault Tanger Méditerranée is an industrial site of the Renault Group located in Malloussa near Tangier, Morocco.

companies.name: Sonasid
companies.description: Sonasid is a Moroccan steel manufacturing company headquartered in Casablanca. It produces steel products mainly used in construction, such as rebar and wire rod. The company operates industrial plants in Nador and Jorf Lasfar.

companies.name: Hmizate.ma
companies.description: Hmizate is an e-commerce company based in Casablanca, Morocco, founded in January 2011. It has expanded into various verticals including travel, leisure, shopping, food delivery, and mobile payment.

companies.name: Air Arabia Maroc
companies.description: Air Arabia Maroc is a Moroccan low-cost airline headquartered in the Arrivals Terminal of Mohammed V International Airport in Nouaceur Province, Greater Casablanca. It was established as a joint venture between Moroccan investors and Air Arabia.

companies.name: Casa Air Service
companies.description: Casa Air Service was a Moroccan airline that began offering private air transport services in 1995. Prior to that, it was involved in agricultural air services for 40 years.

companies.name: Attijariwafa Bank
companies.description: Attijariwafa Bank is a Moroccan international financial services group headquartered in Casablanca. It was formed by merging Banque Commerciale du Maroc and Wafabank, becoming one of the largest financial institutions in Morocco.

companies.name: Royal Air Maroc
companies.description: Royal Air Maroc is the Moroccan national carrier and the country's largest airline. It is also among the largest airlines in Africa.

companies.name: CFG Bank
companies.description: CFG Bank, formerly Casablanca Finance Group, is a Moroccan bank founded in 1992. It was Morocco’s first investment bank and became a universal bank in 2015, offering services to the general public. The bank is listed on the Casablanca Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Royal Air Maroc Express
companies.description: Royal Air Maroc Express is a regional airline and wholly owned subsidiary of Royal Air Maroc based in Casablanca. It operates scheduled domestic and regional flights, including to Spain and the Canary Islands, and is based at Mohammed V International Airport.

companies.name: Banco Nacional de Investimento
companies.description: Banco Nacional de Investimento is a Mozambican state-owned development bank associated with the Ministry of Finance. It provides long-term financing for sustainable projects contributing to social and economic development in sectors like infrastructure, energy, agriculture, and transportation.

companies.name: Mozambique Stock Exchange
companies.description: The Mozambique Stock Exchange, known as Bolsa de Valores de Moçambique or Maputo Stock Exchange, is the first stock exchange in Mozambique. It opened in 1999 with support from the Lisbon Stock Exchange and the World Bank.

companies.name: LAM Mozambique Airlines
companies.description: LAM Mozambique Airlines, also known as Linhas Aéreas de Moçambique, is the flag carrier airline of Mozambique. Established in 1936 and based in Maputo, it operates scheduled services in Southern Africa with its hub at Maputo International Airport. The airline is a member of the International Air Transport Association and the African Airlines Association since 1976.

companies.name: Kaya Airlines
companies.description: Kaya Airlines is a regional airline based in Mozambique. It operates from its base at Maputo International Airport, serving regional routes within the country.

companies.name: Millennium bim
companies.description: Millennium bim is a Mozambican bank founded in 1995 through a partnership between Banco Comercial Português and the Mozambican state. It is one of the largest banks in Mozambique, providing various banking services.

companies.name: Moçambique Expresso
companies.description: Moçambique Expresso is an airline based in Beira, Mozambique. It operates domestic and regional scheduled and charter flights, with its main base at Maputo International Airport.

companies.name: Trustco Bank Namibia
companies.description: Trustco Bank Namibia Ltd., formerly FIDES Bank Namibia, was a commercial bank in Namibia owned by Trustco Group Holdings. Its primary activity was providing microfinancing services.

companies.name: Bank Windhoek
companies.description: Bank Windhoek Limited is a commercial bank licensed by the Bank of Namibia. It offers financial services including personal, commercial, and SME banking within Namibia.

companies.name: Bank BIC Namibia Limited
companies.description: Bank BIC Namibia Limited is a commercial bank licensed to operate in Namibia. It is a subsidiary of the Bank BIC Group, a financial services conglomerate based in Angola with subsidiaries in several countries.

companies.name: Namibia Airports Company
companies.description: The Namibia Airports Company is a state-owned enterprise managing eight of the largest airports in Namibia. It operates under the Ministry of Public Works and Transport and is a member of the Airports Council International.

companies.name: MTC Namibia
companies.description: Mobile Telecommunications Limited (MTC) is a mobile telecommunications company and internet service provider in Namibia. Established in 1995, it is the largest mobile carrier in the country with over two million active subscribers.

companies.name: NamPower
companies.description: Namibia Power Corporation, known as NamPower, is the national electric power utility company of Namibia. It is responsible for electricity generation, transmission, and distribution, regulated by the Electricity Control Board of Namibia.

companies.name: Namibia Red Cross Society
companies.description: The Namibia Red Cross Society is a humanitarian organisation headquartered in Windhoek, Namibia. It was founded in 1991 by an Act of Parliament and became a member of the International Federation of the Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies in 1993. It was formerly part of the South African Red Cross Society.

companies.name: Niger Poste
companies.description: Niger Poste is the government organisation responsible for the postal service in Niger. The country is a member of the West African Postal Conference. Niger Poste manages mail services across Niger.

companies.name: Société nigérienne du pétrole
companies.description: Société nigérienne du pétrole (SONIDEP) is a parastatal corporation in Niger founded in 1977 by government decree. It handles the importation, transportation, storage, refining, and marketing of petroleum products and operates retail sales stations nationwide.

companies.name: Timidria
companies.description: Timidria is a human rights NGO in Niger founded by Ilguilas Weila. The organisation is dedicated to eradicating slavery in Niger. It operates as a non-governmental organisation focused on social issues.

companies.name: Red Cross Society of Niger
companies.description: The Red Cross Society of Niger was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Niamey. It is part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, providing emergency and relief services in Niger.

companies.name: Niger Telecoms
companies.description: Niger Telecoms is the national telephone and telecommunications carrier of Niger, created in 2016 by merging SONITEL and SahelCom. The company was renationalised due to financial difficulties and operates telecommunications services across Niger.

companies.name: Escadrille Nationale du Niger
companies.description: Escadrille Nationale du Niger is the governmental airline of Niger based at Diori Hamani International Airport in Niamey. It operates as a state-owned airline serving the country.

companies.name: Niger Airlines
companies.description: Niger Airlines is the Nigerien flag carrier headquartered in Niamey and based at Diori Hamani International Airport. It serves as the national airline of Niger.

companies.name: Mavin Records
companies.description: Mavin Records is a Nigerian record label founded by Don Jazzy in 2012 after the closure of Mo' Hits Records. It houses various recording artists and producers and has released compilation albums including Solar Plexus and Chapter X.

companies.name: Kano River Project
companies.description: The Kano River Project is a large-scale integrated agricultural land use development in Northern Nigeria. It is a modern irrigation project developed under the Hadejia-Juma’are River Basin Development Authority. The project supports agricultural activities in the region.

companies.name: Lagos State Ministry of Science and Technology
companies.wiki: Lagos State Ministry of Science and Technology
companies.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Science and Technology is a government ministry in Lagos State, Nigeria. It is responsible for planning, devising, and implementing state policies related to science and technology. The ministry plays a key role in shaping the technological development of Lagos State.

companies.name: Radio Lagos
companies.description: Radio Lagos 107.5 FM is a state-owned FM radio station in Lagos State, Nigeria. It began operations in 1977 as an offshoot of the Nigerian Broadcasting Corporation. It is notable for being the first state-owned FM radio station in Lagos State.

companies.name: Silverbird Group
companies.description: The Silverbird Group is a diversified multimedia company headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. Founded in 1980 by Ben Murray-Bruce, it has holdings in radio, television, real estate, and cinemas. The group includes Silverbird Cinemas and organizes pageants such as Most Beautiful Girl in Nigeria and Mr Nigeria.

companies.name: Lagos State Ministry of Commerce and Industry
companies.wiki: Lagos State Ministry of Commerce and Industry
companies.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Commerce Cooperatives, Trade and Investment is a government ministry in Lagos State, Nigeria. It is responsible for planning, devising, and implementing policies on commerce, cooperatives, trade, and investment. The ministry aims to ensure business prosperity and consumer satisfaction in Lagos State.

companies.name: Lagos State Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives
companies.wiki: Lagos State Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives
companies.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives is a government ministry in Lagos State, Nigeria. It is charged with planning, devising, and implementing state policies on agriculture and cooperatives. The ministry focuses on agricultural development within Lagos State.

companies.name: Chicken Republic
companies.description: Chicken Republic is a Nigerian quick-service restaurant chain specializing in chicken-based meals and fast food. Founded in 2004, it is a subsidiary and flagship brand of Food Concepts Plc, headquartered in Lagos. The chain operates primarily in Nigeria and Ghana, including through franchising.

companies.name: Channels TV
companies.description: Channels Television is an independent 24-hour news and media television channel based in Lagos, Nigeria. Founded in 1992, it began broadcasting in 1995 following deregulation of the Nigerian broadcast media. The channel focuses on news and current affairs related to Nigerian domestic issues.

companies.name: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (Lagos)
companies.wiki: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (Lagos)
companies.description: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources is a Lagos State government ministry in Nigeria. It is responsible for planning, devising, and implementing state policies on energy and mineral resources. The ministry oversees energy-related development in Lagos State.

companies.name: Lagos Television
companies.description: Lagos Television is a state-owned television station located in Ikeja, Lagos, Nigeria. Established in October 1980, it was the first Nigerian television station to operate on both VHF and UHF frequencies. It was also the first state-owned TV station available on cable satellite platforms like DSTV and GoTV.

companies.name: Eko FM
companies.description: Eko FM is a radio station in Lagos, Nigeria, established in 1997. It serves as the sister station to Radio Lagos. The station is part of the Lagos State broadcasting services.

companies.name: Urban96 Radio Network
companies.description: Urban 96 Radio Network is a commercial English-speaking radio station based in Lekki, Lagos, Nigeria. It broadcasts an urban contemporary format including R&B, hip hop, and pop music. The station is owned by Alphavision Multimedia, a subsidiary of CMA Group.

companies.name: Innoson Motors
companies.description: Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing Co. Ltd. is a Nigerian automobile manufacturer headquartered in Nnewi, Anambra. Founded by Chief Innocent Chukwuma Nwala, it is nicknamed the Pride Of African Roads.

companies.name: Mikano International Limited
companies.description: Mikano International Limited is a Nigerian company operating in power generation, real estate, and construction sectors. It offers sales, maintenance, assembly, and distribution of power generation products, real estate development, and construction equipment sales.

companies.name: Lagos State Ministry of Works and Infrastructure
companies.wiki: Lagos State Ministry of Works and Infrastructure
companies.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Works and Infrastructure was established in 1967 and is considered a key driver of growth and development in Lagos State, Nigeria.

companies.name: Merchant Express Aviation
companies.description: Merchant Express Aviation was a cargo airline operating out of Lagos, Nigeria.

companies.name: First Bank of Nigeria
companies.description: First Bank of Nigeria is a multinational bank and financial services company headquartered in Lagos. Founded in 1894 by Sir Alfred Jones, it is owned by First HoldCo PLC with over 1.3 million shareholders.

companies.name: Oceanic Bank
companies.description: Oceanic Bank International was a Nigerian bank providing individual, commercial, and corporate banking services. It was among the top five leading banks in Nigeria.

companies.name: Babban Gona
companies.description: Babban Gona is a social enterprise in Nigeria that supports smallholder farmers to increase their profitability. Its name means "Great Farm" in Hausa.

companies.name: Africa Independent Television
companies.description: Africa Independent Television (AIT) is a privately owned Nigerian television broadcaster headquartered in Abuja. It operates the largest privately operated terrestrial TV network in Nigeria and is a subsidiary of DAAR Communications plc.

companies.name: Saipem Nigeria
companies.description: Saipem Nigeria is the Nigerian subsidiary of Saipem, providing services to the oil and gas industry including drilling, construction, engineering, and maintenance both onshore and offshore. It operates within Nigeria's energy sector.

companies.name: Lagos State Waste Management Authority
companies.description: The Lagos Waste Management Authority (LAWMA) is a government parastatal responsible for waste collection, transportation, and disposal in Lagos State. Its mission is to improve environmental health and sanitation conditions in Lagos.

companies.name: Lagos State Ministry of Finance
companies.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Finance is a government ministry responsible for planning and implementing financial policies for Lagos State, Nigeria. It manages the state's public finance operations.

companies.name: Mr Bigg's
companies.description: Mr Bigg's is a Nigerian fast food restaurant chain owned by United African Company of Nigeria PLC. It operates multiple locations including Nigeria's first drive-through restaurant and had a 49% stake acquired by Famous Brands in 2013.

companies.name: HiTV
companies.description: HiTV was a multi-channel digital satellite television service in Nigeria launched in 2007 by Entertainment Highway. It utilized Hypercable Digital Terrestrial and Direct to Home satellite technologies.

companies.name: Mo' Hits Records
companies.description: Mo'Hits Records was a Nigerian record label founded in 2004 by D'banj and Don Jazzy. Don Jazzy served as CEO and the label signed artists including Wande Coal, Dr SID, D'Prince, and K-Switch.

companies.name: Nigeria LNG
companies.description: Nigeria LNG Limited (NLNG) is a company producing liquefied natural gas and operates an LNG plant located on Bonny Island, Nigeria. It is involved in the liquefied natural gas sector.

companies.name: Cappa & D'Alberto PLC
companies.description: Cappa & D'Alberto LTD is a building and construction company headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. It was formerly listed on the Nigerian Stock Exchange but was delisted in 2009, with shares traded over the counter.

companies.name: Aiteo
companies.description: Aiteo is Africa's largest privately owned integrated energy company involved in oil and gas exploration, production, refining, and marketing. It operates across West and Southern Africa.

companies.name: Afribank
companies.description: Afribank PLC was a commercial bank, real estate, and insurance broker based in Lagos, Nigeria, established in 1959 by French investors. It operated over 250 branches and was among the region's major banks.

companies.name: Ensure
companies.description: Ensure is an American brand that produces nutritional supplements and meal replacements. It is manufactured by Abbott Laboratories. The brand is known for its dietary supplement products.

companies.name: Keystone Bank Limited
companies.description: Keystone Bank Limited is a commercial bank operating in Nigeria. It is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria, the national banking regulator. The bank provides various banking services within the country.

companies.name: Dangote Group
companies.description: The Dangote Group is a Nigerian multinational industrial conglomerate founded by Aliko Dangote. It is the largest conglomerate in West Africa and one of the largest in Africa. The group employs over 30,000 people.

companies.name: Shell Nigeria
companies.description: Shell Nigeria refers to Shell plc's operations in Nigeria, conducted through four subsidiaries including Shell Petroleum Development Company of Nigeria Limited. Royal Dutch Shell's joint ventures produce over 21% of Nigeria's total petroleum output. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

companies.name: South Atlantic Petroleum
companies.description: South Atlantic Petroleum, also known as SAPETRO, is a Nigerian oil and gas exploration and production company. It holds a stake in the Akpo deepwater field development near Port Harcourt. The company's chairman is Theophilus Danjuma.

companies.name: Port Harcourt Refining Company
companies.description: Port Harcourt Refining Company is a Nigerian oil and gas firm specializing in refining crude oil into petroleum products. It is headquartered in the Port Harcourt metropolitan area of Rivers State. The company is a subsidiary of the Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation.

companies.name: Defence Industries Corporation of Nigeria
companies.description: Defence Industries Corporation of Nigeria (DICON) is a state-run defence corporation operated by the Nigerian Armed Forces. It produces defence equipment as well as civilian products. The company serves Nigeria's defence sector.

companies.name: Intercontinental Bank
companies.description: Intercontinental Bank was a Nigerian commercial bank operating from 1989 until its acquisition by Access Bank plc in 2013. It was one of the twenty-four commercial banks licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria. The bank provided financial services in Nigeria.

companies.name: Ecobank Nigeria
companies.description: Ecobank Nigeria Limited is a commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria. It operates within Nigeria providing banking services. The bank is commonly known as Ecobank Nigeria.

companies.name: Fidelity Bank Nigeria
companies.description: Fidelity Bank Plc is a commercial bank headquartered in Victoria Island, Lagos, Nigeria. It is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria with international authorization. The bank offers various financial services.

companies.name: Union Bank of Nigeria
companies.description: Union Bank of Nigeria Plc is a commercial bank headquartered in Marina, Lagos Island, Nigeria. It has been operating in Nigeria since 1917.

companies.name: Lekoil
companies.description: LEKOIL is a Cayman incorporated company focused on African oil exploration and production, with interests in Nigeria and offshore Namibia. Founded in 2010, it was listed on the Alternative Investment Market of the London Stock Exchange in 2013.

companies.name: Lagos State Ministry of Environment
companies.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Environment is a state government ministry responsible for planning, devising, and implementing environmental management policies in Lagos State, Nigeria.

companies.name: Interswitch
companies.description: Interswitch is a Lagos-based integrated payment and digital commerce platform company founded in 2002. It started as a transaction switching and processing company and expanded to consumer financial services with products like Quickteller and Verve.

companies.name: Moniepoint Inc
companies.description: Moniepoint is a Nigerian fintech company based in Lagos that provides banking services and loans via an online app. It was founded in 2015, and in November 2024, Bayo Olujobi was appointed its CFO.

companies.name: Lagos State Ministry of Women Affairs and Poverty Alleviation
companies.wiki: Lagos State Ministry of Women Affairs and Poverty Alleviation
companies.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Women's Affairs and Poverty Alleviation was established in 1999 to address issues related to women's affairs and poverty reduction in Lagos State, Nigeria.

companies.name: TVC News
companies.description: TVC News is a Nigerian 24-hour television news channel based in Lagos. It broadcasts on platforms including British Sky Broadcasting in the UK, DStv and Startimes in Nigeria, and Multi TV in Ghana.

companies.name: Nigerian Red Cross Society
companies.description: The Nigerian Red Cross Society was founded in 1960 and has its headquarters in Abuja. It operates as an emergency and relief organization in Nigeria.

companies.name: Guinness Nigeria
companies.description: Guinness Nigeria is a set of breweries in Nigeria distributing products under the Guinness label. The company is owned by Tolaram.

companies.name: Globacom
companies.description: Globacom Limited, known as Glo, is a Nigerian multinational telecommunications company founded in 2003 by Mike Adenuga. It operates in the telecommunications industry and is based in Nigeria.

companies.name: Nigerian Telecommunications
companies.description: Nigerian Telecommunications Limited (NITEL) was a monopoly telephone service provider in Nigeria until 1992. It was formed in 1985 by merging two government entities and was state-owned, with sub-par performance during and after its monopoly.

companies.name: SunTrust Bank Nigeria Limited
companies.description: SunTrust Bank Nigeria Limited (STBNL) is a Nigerian financial services provider licensed as a commercial bank by the Central Bank of Nigeria. It operates within Nigeria's banking sector.

companies.name: Lagos State Ministry of Home Affairs and Culture
companies.wiki: Lagos State Ministry of Home Affairs and Culture
companies.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Home Affairs and Culture is a government ministry responsible for planning and implementing state policies on Home Affairs and Culture in Lagos State, Nigeria.

companies.name: Nigerian Library Association
companies.description: The Nigerian Library Association (NLA) is a professional organization for librarians and information science educators in Nigeria. Established in 1962, it is headquartered in Abuja and promotes cooperation and advocacy for libraries nationwide.

companies.name: Ebonylife TV
companies.description: Ebonylife TV is a Nigerian entertainment TV channel owned by Mosunmola Abudu. Launched on DSTV in 2013, it later moved to StarTimes network in 2018 to improve homegrown content accessibility across Africa.

companies.name: Ughelli Power Plant
companies.description: Transcorp Power Plc operates the Ughelli Power Plant, a gas-fired thermal plant in Delta State, Nigeria. Founded in 2012 as Transcorp Ughelli Power Limited, it is the largest fossil-fuel based power station in Nigeria.

companies.name: Chi Limited
companies.description: CHI Limited, also known as Chivita|Hollandia, is a Nigerian company producing locally made food and beverage products. Founded in 1980, it leads in fruit juice, dairy, and snack categories in Nigeria and Africa.

companies.name: African Food Network
companies.description: African Food Network, or Afri Food Network, is a Nigerian website and company dedicated to African food and lifestyle. It was launched in January 2017 by Kevin Eze in Abuja, Nigeria.

companies.name: TurnTable Certification System of Nigeria
companies.description: TurnTable Certification System of Nigeria (TCSN) is a music recording certification body founded by the Nigerian music magazine TurnTable. It certifies albums and singles based on paid streams and digital downloads upon request.

companies.name: Afrinvest
companies.description: Afrinvest Limited is a Nigerian capital market holding company. It operates within the financial services industry in Nigeria. The company is notable for its role in the Nigerian capital market.

companies.name: Verve International
companies.description: Verve International is a Nigerian Pan-African and multinational financial technology and payment card brand. It is owned by the Interswitch Group. The company operates in the financial services sector.

companies.name: Aero Contractors
companies.description: Aero Contractors Company of Nigeria Limited is a state-controlled Nigerian airline based at Murtala Muhammed International Airport in Ikeja, Lagos State. It operates helicopter services, fixed wing domestic and international scheduled passenger services, air charter, and third party aircraft operations, mainly supporting Nigeria's oil and gas industry.

companies.name: Chanchangi Airlines
companies.description: Chanchangi Airlines Nigeria Limited was a privately owned airline headquartered in Kaduna, Nigeria. It operated scheduled domestic passenger services with its main base at Murtala Mohammed International Airport, Lagos, and hubs in Kaduna, Abuja, and Port Harcourt.

companies.name: Arik Air
companies.description: Arik Air is a Nigerian airline operating mainly from hubs at Murtala Muhammed International Airport in Lagos and Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport in Abuja. Its head office is located at the Arik Air Aviation Center on the grounds of Murtala Muhammed International Airport in Ikeja. It serves regional and mid-haul destinations within Africa.

companies.name: Allied Air
companies.description: Allied Air is a cargo airline based in Lagos, Nigeria. It operates scheduled and charter services within Nigeria and throughout Africa. Its main base is Murtala Mohammed International Airport, Lagos.

companies.name: Dana Air
companies.description: Dana Air was a Nigerian airline headquartered in Ikeja, Lagos State. It was based at Murtala Muhammed International Airport in Lagos. The airline operated in the Nigerian aviation sector.

companies.name: IRS Airlines
companies.description: IRS Airlines Limited was an airline based in Abuja, Nigeria. It operated scheduled domestic passenger services with its main base at Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport. The airline was established in 2002 and ceased operations in 2013.

companies.name: First Nation Airways
companies.description: First Nation Airways Ltd. was a Nigerian airline headquartered in Lagos with its base at Murtala Mohammed Airport. It operated within the Nigerian airline industry.

companies.name: Max Air
companies.description: Max Air is a Nigerian airline operating domestic and international flights. Established in 2008 by Alhaji Dahiru Barau Mangal, its head office is located in Kano State with its base at Mallam Aminu Kano International Airport, Kano.

companies.name: Dornier Aviation Nigeria
companies.description: Dornier Aviation Nigeria is an airline based in Kaduna, Nigeria. It operates Dornier aircraft on a charter basis and provides services including agricultural flying, aerial photography, and emergency medical evacuation. Its main base is Old Kaduna Airport, and it participated in the 2015 Hajj airlift financed by Nigerian businessman Babangida Inuwa.

companies.name: Air Peace
companies.description: Air Peace Limited is a privately owned Nigerian airline founded in 2014 with its head office in Ikeja, Lagos State. It is the largest airline in West Africa, providing passenger and charter services to major Nigerian cities and international destinations including West Africa, the Middle East, the Caribbean, and the UK. It also has a subsidiary called Air Peace Hopper.

companies.name: Azman Air
companies.description: Azman Air Services Limited is a Nigerian domestic airline established in 2010 by Abdulmunaf Yunusa Sarina. It operates scheduled domestic passenger services with its main base at Mallam Aminu Kano International Airport in Kano.
