companies.description: Atlantis Diesel Engines (ADE) is a South African manufacturer of diesel engines and components. It serves industries such as mining, on and off road applications, and defense forces. The company operates from Germiston, Gauteng, South Africa.

companies.name: Nissan South Africa
companies.description: Nissan South Africa is an automotive company based in Centurion, Gauteng. Founded in 1966, it is a subsidiary of the Japanese automaker Nissan. The company operates within South Africa's automotive industry.

companies.name: Armscor
companies.description: Armscor is the arms procurement agency of the South African Department of Defence. Established in 1968, it was originally an arms production company created in response to UN sanctions against South Africa. It operates within the arms industry.

companies.name: Paramount Group
companies.description: Paramount Group is a South African aerospace and defense company established in 1994. It operates globally in internal security and peacekeeping, offering military aircraft, armored vehicles, maritime systems, equipment, and training to governments.

companies.name: Remgro
companies.description: Remgro Limited is a South African investment holding company based in Stellenbosch. It operates as a holding company within South Africa.

companies.name: Ceres Fruit Juices
companies.description: Ceres Fruit Juices Pty Ltd, trading as The Ceres Beverage Company, is a beverage company based in Ceres, South Africa. It produces fruit juice and other fruit-based products and is a subsidiary of Pioneer Foods.

companies.name: Aspen Pharmacare
companies.description: Aspen Pharmacare Holdings Limited is a multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in uMhlanga, South Africa. Founded in 1997, it is the largest pharmaceutical company in Africa, manufacturing branded pharmaceuticals and generic HIV/AIDS and cancer medications.

companies.name: Entertainment Monitoring Africa
companies.description: Entertainment Monitoring Africa (EMA) gathers and publishes airplay music charts in South Africa. It is part of the Times Media Group and provides weekly top 10 and top 100 airplay charts online.

companies.name: Vergelegen
companies.description: Vergelegen is a historic wine estate located in Somerset West, Western Cape province, South Africa. It operates within the winemaking industry.

companies.name: South African Breweries
companies.logo_file: SAB Logo Full colour RGB White(2).jpg
companies.description: South African Breweries is a major brewery headquartered in Johannesburg, South Africa. It was formerly a wholly owned subsidiary of SABMiller until its interests were sold to Anheuser-Busch InBev in 2016. It is now a direct subsidiary of Anheuser-Busch InBev SA/NV.

companies.name: Cell C
companies.description: Cell C Limited is a South African mobile telecoms operator headquartered in Sandton, Gauteng. It is the fourth-largest mobile provider in South Africa by customer base as of 2026. The company operates in the mobile phone industry.

companies.name: Mango
companies.description: Mango Airlines SOC Ltd, trading as Mango, was a South African low-cost airline based at O. R. Tambo International Airport. It was a subsidiary of South African Airways and has been grounded since July 2021, with its license suspended in August 2022.

companies.name: Civair
companies.description: Civair is an aircraft charter operator based in Cape Town, South Africa. Its core business is operating helicopter charters. The company operates in the airline industry.

companies.name: South African Airways
companies.description: South African Airways is the flag carrier airline of South Africa, founded in 1929 as Union Airways and rebranded in 1934. As of February 2026, it flies to 17 destinations with a fleet of 19 aircraft.

companies.name: Airlink
companies.description: Airlink is a regional airline based in Johannesburg, South Africa. It initially provided services between smaller towns and larger hub airports and has expanded to include larger mainline routes.

companies.name: Norse Air
companies.description: Norse Air is a South African charter airline headquartered in Sandton, Johannesburg, and based at Lanseria International Airport. It operates in the airline industry.

companies.name: Egoli Air
companies.description: Egoli Air was an airline based in Johannesburg, South Africa, operating charter flights domestically and throughout Africa. Its main base was OR Tambo International Airport.

companies.name: Phoebus Apollo Aviation
companies.description: Phoebus Apollo Aviation is a South African airline based in Johannesburg, Germiston. It operates passenger, charter, and cargo flights and also runs a flight school. The company serves multiple aviation needs from its location.

companies.name: Interair South Africa
companies.description: Interair South Africa was a privately owned airline headquartered in Johannesburg, South Africa. It operated scheduled passenger services from Johannesburg to regional African destinations, with its main base at O. R. Tambo International Airport. The airline focused on regional connectivity.

companies.name: Federal Air
companies.description: Federal Air is a South African airline headquartered at O. R. Tambo International Airport near Johannesburg. It specializes in flights to luxury safari lodges and operates air shuttle, scheduled, and charter services throughout Southern Africa. The airline targets niche tourism markets.

companies.name: Imperial Air Cargo
companies.description: Imperial Air Cargo was a cargo airline based in Johannesburg, South Africa. It operated domestic overnight express cargo services, focusing on fast cargo delivery within the country. The airline served the logistics sector.

companies.name: Safair
companies.description: Safair is an airline based at O.R. Tambo International Airport in Kempton Park, South Africa. It operates one of the world's largest fleets of civil Lockheed L-100 Hercules cargo aircraft. The airline is notable for its specialized cargo fleet.

companies.name: Global Aviation
companies.description: Global Aviation Operations (Pty) Ltd is a South African airline headquartered in Johannesburg and based at OR Tambo International Airport. The company provides aviation services from this major hub. It is part of South Africa's airline industry.

companies.name: National Airways Corporation
companies.description: National Airways Corporation (NAC) is a commercial aviation company headquartered at Lanseria Airport in Johannesburg, South Africa. It offers aircraft sales, maintenance, parts, charter, pilot training, and international operations. NAC operates multiple offices across South Africa and has a shareholding in a US-based company.

companies.name: Allegiance Air
companies.description: Allegiance Air is a charter airline based in Lanseria, South Africa. It provides charter flight services from its base. The company operates within the South African aviation sector.

companies.name: CemAir
companies.description: CemAir is a South African airline headquartered in Johannesburg. Founded in 2005, it operates scheduled domestic flights across South Africa and regional services within Africa. The airline serves both domestic and regional markets.

companies.name: Solenta Aviation
companies.description: Solenta Aviation is an airline based in Johannesburg, South Africa, with its maintenance base at OR Tambo International Airport. Founded in 2000, it operates cargo flights throughout Sub-Saharan Africa for DHL Aviation and provides passenger charter, cargo, and aircraft lease services, especially for the oil and gas industry.

companies.name: Star Air Cargo
companies.description: Star Air Cargo Pty Ltd, known as Star Air, is a South African airline that leases out passenger and cargo aircraft. It operates within South Africa's aviation sector, focusing on aircraft leasing services.

companies.name: Command Airways
companies.description: Command Airways was an airline based in Johannesburg, South Africa. It operated scheduled services from 1977 to 1980 and continued with non-scheduled services thereafter until it ceased operations.

companies.name: South African Red Cross Air Mercy Service
companies.wiki: South African Red Cross Air Mercy Service
companies.description: South African Red Cross Air Mercy Service (AMS) is an air ambulance service headquartered at Cape Town International Airport. It operates various bases across South Africa providing medical air transport services.

companies.name: FlySafair
companies.description: FlySafair is a South African international low-cost airline founded in 2013 and headquartered in Johannesburg. It operates flights to 15 destinations in Sub-Saharan Africa with a fleet of 36 aircraft.

companies.name: Hartlief Corporation Ltd
companies.description: Hartlief Corporation Ltd is a Namibian meat processing company specializing in fresh and processed meat products. It is part of the Ohlthaver & List group and supplies both local and export markets with a range of meat products.

companies.name: Exclusive Books
companies.description: Exclusive Books is one of South Africa's largest bookselling chains with stores throughout South Africa, as well as locations in Botswana and Namibia. It operates in the retail bookselling industry.

companies.name: Eskom
companies.description: Eskom Hld SOC Ltd is a South African state-owned electricity public utility established in 1923 as the Electricity Supply Commission. It represents South Africa in the Southern African Power Pool.

companies.name: Ster-Kinekor
companies.description: Ster-Kinekor is a South African-based cinema company and the country's largest movie exhibitor. Its head office is located at the Ster-Kinekor Office Park in Sandton, Johannesburg.

companies.name: Neotel
companies.description: Neotel, formerly SNO Telecommunications, was South Africa's second national operator for fixed line telecommunication services. Unveiled in 2006 in Midrand, it was the first direct competitor to the state-owned Telkom.

companies.name: Aerosud
companies.description: Aerosud is a South African aerospace engineering and manufacturing group headquartered in Centurion, Gauteng. It operates through Aerosud Holdings, Aerosud Aviation, and Aerosud Technology Solutions. The company is involved in the aerospace industry.

companies.name: Embassy of France, Pretoria
companies.description: The French embassy in South Africa, Lesotho, and Malawi is the main diplomatic mission of France in South Africa. It is located at 250 Melk Street in Pretoria. David Martinon was appointed French Ambassador to these countries in 2023.

companies.name: CapeNature
companies.description: CapeNature is a governmental organisation responsible for maintaining wilderness areas and public nature reserves in Western Cape Province, South Africa. It focuses on environmental conservation within the region.

companies.name: Southern African Foundation for the Conservation of Coastal Birds
companies.description: The Southern African Foundation for the Conservation of Coastal Birds (SANCCOB) is an international non-profit organisation dedicated to rescuing, rehabilitating, and releasing seabirds in Southern Africa. It operates from its headquarters at the Rietvlei Wetland Reserve in Table View, South Africa.

companies.name: MultiChoice
companies.description: MultiChoice is a South African company owned by French media conglomerate Canal+. It operates DStv, a major satellite television service in Sub-Saharan Africa, and GOtv, a terrestrial TV service in nine countries. It formerly operated Showmax, a subscription video on-demand streaming service.

companies.name: Public Establishment of Television
companies.description: Public Establishment of Television (EPTV) is a state-owned company managing television activities in Algeria, including production and broadcasting. It serves as the national television entity of the country.

companies.name: AL24news
companies.description: AL24 News is an Algerian public international news channel broadcasting in Arabic, French, and English. It began operations on 1 November 2021, providing multilingual news coverage.

companies.name: Echorouk Group
companies.description: Echourouk Group SA is an Algerian media company headquartered in Algiers. It operates generalist, information, and sports channels, including Echorouk TV, Echorouk News TV, and CBC Benna, a channel focused on women and cooking.

companies.name: Cevital
companies.description: Cevital is the largest private conglomerate in Algeria with interests in agri-food, retail, industry, and services. Founded by Issad Rebrab, it is headquartered in Kouba, Algeria, and is a founding member of the Desertec project.

companies.name: Télédiffusion d'Algérie
companies.description: Algerian Broadcasting Company (Télédiffusion d'Algérie) is a public industrial and commercial company managing radio and television broadcasting services in Algeria. It also offers internet, technical, and satellite services under the supervision of Algeria's Ministry of Communications.

companies.name: Etrag
companies.description: Etrag, short for Entreprise Publique Economique des Tracteurs Agricoles, is an Algerian company specializing in the development of agricultural machinery. It was created on June 29, 2009, following the split of the EPE CMT. The company focuses on agricultural equipment manufacturing.

companies.name: Cma Sampo
companies.description: Cma Sampo Spa is an Algerian joint venture specializing in the development of agricultural vehicles. Created in 2010, it is based in Sidi Bel Abbès and owned by Construction Agricultural Equipment (CMA), the Algerian firm PMAT, and Finnish partners. The company was formed after an agreement between the Algerian brand CMA and Finnish group Sampo-Rosenlew.

companies.name: Sonelgaz
companies.description: Sonelgaz is a state-owned utility in Algeria responsible for electricity and natural gas distribution. Established in 1969, it replaced Electricité et gaz d'Algérie and held a monopoly on natural gas distribution and electricity production. In 2002, it was converted into a private company and is scheduled to be split eventually.

companies.name: Asmidal
companies.description: Asmidal is an Algerian industrial group that manages a portfolio of companies involved in the development, production, and marketing of fertilizers and pesticides. It is a leader in its field within Algeria.

companies.name: Algerian Tractors Company
companies.description: Algerian Tractors Company (ATC Spa) is an Algerian agricultural machinery manufacturer. It was created on August 16, 2012, as a joint venture between Etrag and the American group AGCO. The company produces tractors in El Khroub, near Constantine, Algeria.

companies.name: Cebon
companies.description: Cebon is an Algerian foods company producing products under the El Mordjene brand. It is best known for its hazelnut spreads, which gained viral popularity in France in 2024.

companies.name: Algérie Ferries
companies.description: Algérie Ferries, also known as Entreprise Nationale de Transport Maritime de Voyageurs (ENTMV), is a state-owned Algerian shipping company. It operates passenger and freight services between Algeria, France, and Spain.

companies.name: SNVI
companies.description: SNVI, formerly the National Society of Mechanical Construction, is an Algerian automaker headquartered in Rouïba. Since 1967, it has produced trucks and buses and also manufactures Mercedes-Benz vehicles.

companies.name: Saidal
companies.description: Saidal Group is an Algerian pharmaceutical company established in 1982. It is the largest pharmaceutical company in Algeria and one of the largest in Africa.

companies.name: Algerian Petroleum Institute
companies.description: The Algerian Petroleum Institute (IAP) is a national graduate institute of petroleum engineering located in Boumerdès, Algeria. Established in 1965 in collaboration with the French Institute of Petroleum, it provides graduate engineers and technicians to Sonatrach, Algeria's national oil company.

companies.name: Banque extérieure d'Algérie
companies.description: Banque extérieure d'Algérie is a public bank established in 1967 and based in Bir Mourad Raïs, Algeria. It operates within the financial services sector in Algeria.

companies.name: Algerie Telecom
companies.description: Algeria Telecommunications Corporation is a state-owned company and the main telecommunications provider in Algeria. It is the sole operator of the fixed telephony network and broadband internet in the country.

companies.name: Ooredoo Algérie
companies.description: Ooredoo Algeria is a telecommunications company operating in Algeria. It provides telecom services within the country.

companies.name: ENMTP
companies.description: ENMTP is an Algerian state-owned company specializing in the development, manufacture, and distribution of machinery used in public works. It is fully owned by the Algerian government.

companies.name: ATM Mobilis
companies.description: ATM Mobilis, a subsidiary of Groupe Télécom Algérie, is one of the three major mobile operators in Algeria. It became independent in August 2003 and operates in the mobile phone industry.

companies.name: Crédit foncier d'Algérie et de Tunisie
companies.industry: financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
companies.wiki: Crédit Foncier d'Algérie et de Tunisie
companies.description: Crédit Foncier d'Algérie et de Tunisie was a French colonial bank operating in Algeria and Tunisia. It provided financial services excluding insurance and pension funding.

companies.name: Embassy of France, Algiers
companies.logo_file: Logo de l'ambassade de France en Algérie.svg
companies.description: The Embassy of France in Algiers is France's diplomatic mission to Algeria. Since Algeria's independence in 1962, its Chancery has been located in the Peltzer Park neighborhood of Hydra, a suburb of Algiers.

companies.name: Domestic Airlines
companies.description: Domestic Airlines, formerly Tassili Airlines, is an Algerian passenger airline based in Algiers. After a strategic restructuring in 2025, it operates as a wholly owned subsidiary of Air Algérie.

companies.name: Air Express Algeria
companies.description: Air Express Algeria is an Algerian charter airline primarily serving the oil and gas industries. It is based in Hassi Messaoud, Algeria. The airline focuses on providing specialized air transport services in this sector.

companies.name: Star Aviation
companies.description: Star Aviation is an airline based in Hassi Messaoud, Algeria. It operates domestic flights with its main base at Oued Irara–Krim Belkacem Airport. The airline serves the Algerian domestic market.

companies.name: Europactor Algeria
companies.description: Europactor Algeria Spa. is a manufacturer of compaction heavy equipment based in Algeria. It is a partnership between the Spanish firm Europactor S.L. and the Algerian Sofare Spa., a subsidiary of the ENMTP Group.

companies.name: Somatel Liebherr
companies.description: Somatel-Liebherr Spa is a publicly-owned heavy equipment manufacturer located in Constantine, Algeria. It is a joint venture between the German Liebherr Group and Somatel, an Algerian government-owned company. The company began production in 2013.

companies.name: Hochschild Mining
companies.description: Hochschild Mining plc is a British-based silver and gold mining company operating across the Americas. It is headquartered in Lima, Peru, with a corporate office in London. The company focuses on underground mining of narrow veins.

companies.name: Correos de Chile
companies.description: Correos de Chile is a Chilean state-owned enterprise providing mailing, money transfer, and courier services nationally and internationally. It also fulfills the functions of the Universal Postal Service in Chile.

companies.name: Banco Ripley
companies.description: Banco Ripley is a bank operating in Chile. It provides banking services within the Chilean financial sector.

companies.name: Codelco
companies.description: Codelco is a Chilean state-owned mining company and the largest copper mining company in the world. It operates in the mining sector focusing on copper extraction.

companies.name: S.A.C.I. Falabella
companies.description: Falabella S.A. is a Chilean multinational retail company operating department stores, shopping centers, supermarkets, banks, and home improvement centers. It is one of the largest retail companies in Latin America with operations in multiple countries.

companies.name: Easy
companies.description: Easy Hogar y Construcción is a South American chain of home centers founded by Chilean conglomerate Cencosud. It operates in Argentina, Chile, and Colombia, providing home improvement products and services.

companies.name: Jumbo
companies.description: Jumbo is a Chilean hypermarket chain operating in Chile, Argentina, and Colombia. Founded in 1976 by Horst Paulmann, it is a subsidiary of the Cencosud business consortium, which owns various supermarket and retail brands. Jumbo is a key part of Cencosud's retail operations.

companies.name: Lider
companies.description: Líder is a Chilean hypermarket chain originally owned by Distribución y Servicio (DyS). In 2009, it was sold to the American corporation Walmart. Líder operates in the retail sector in Chile.

companies.name: Falabella Bank
companies.description: Banco Falabella is a Chilean bank founded in 1998 and headquartered in Las Condes, Chile. It is a subsidiary of S.A.C.I. Falabella and has branches in Chile, Peru, and Colombia.

companies.name: State Bank of Chile
companies.description: Banco del Estado de Chile, known as BancoEstado, is the sole public bank in Chile, created by government decree in 1953. It provides financial services nationwide, focusing on the unbanked and small to medium enterprises. It is the largest mortgage lender and debit card issuer in Chile.

companies.name: Televisión Nacional de Chile
companies.description: Televisión Nacional de Chile (TVN) is a Chilean public service broadcaster founded by presidential order and launched nationwide in 1969. It operates under a public mission to promote national culture, democracy, human rights, and environmental care. TVN is governed by the National Television Council.

companies.name: TVU
companies.description: Televisión Universidad de Concepción (TVU) is a Chilean television channel broadcasting in Concepción on VHF channel 11. Its headquarters are located in the Universidad de Concepción in Chile.

companies.name: Copesa
companies.description: Copesa is a significant Chilean media conglomerate controlled by businessman Álvaro Saieh. It operates in the mass media industry in Chile.

companies.name: Radio Bío-Bío
companies.description: Radio Bío-Bío is a Chilean radio station with broad coverage across the country. It broadcasts news, sports, music, economics, and international relations content.

companies.name: CNN Chile
companies.description: Cable News Network Chile is a Chilean pay television news channel and news website launched in 2008. It was originally a joint venture between VTR Chile and WarnerMedia. The channel is based in Santiago, Chile.

companies.name: 24 Horas
companies.hq_city: Edificio Corporativo de Televisión Nacional de Chile
companies.description: 24 horas is the news brand of the Chilean public broadcaster Televisión Nacional de Chile. It began as a news program in 1990 and became a television channel called Canal 24 horas in 2009.

companies.name: Undurraga Winery
companies.description: Viña Undurraga is a Chilean producer of wines and sparkling wines located in Talagante, Maipo Valley near Santiago. Founded in 1885, it is one of the oldest wineries in Chile with vineyards across several valleys and exports most of its production.

companies.name: Kunstmann
companies.description: Kunstmann is a Chilean beer brand produced in Torobayo, Valdivia by Compañia Cervecera Kunstmann S.A. The company is led by CEO Armin Kunstmann.

companies.name: Santa Isabel
companies.description: Supermercados Santa Isabel is a Chilean supermarket chain owned by Cencosud. The stores typically have an average area of 1,500 square meters and operate throughout Chile.

companies.name: Sigdo Koppers
companies.description: Sigdo Koppers S.A. is a Chilean multinational industrial conglomerate founded in 1960 and headquartered in Santiago. It operates through subsidiaries and business units across multiple continents including the Americas, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Oceania.

companies.name: Colun
companies.wiki: Cooperativa Agrícola y Lechera de La Unión Limitada
companies.description: Cooperativa Agrícola y Lechera de La Unión Limitada, known as Colún, is a Chilean dairy cooperative based in La Unión. As of 2011, it was the second largest dairy company in Chile after Soprole.

companies.name: Soprole
companies.description: Soprole is a Chilean dairy product maker marketing yogurt, milk, desserts, jelly, and butter. It was part of Fonterra until 2022 and became a subsidiary of Grupo Gloria in 2023.

companies.name: ASMAR
companies.description: Astilleros y Maestranzas de la Armada (ASMAR) is a Chilean state-owned shipbuilding company providing services mainly to the Chilean Navy and other customers. It was restructured and adopted its current name in 1960, succeeding Arsenales de Marina created in 1895.

companies.name: FAMAE
companies.description: FAMAE is a Chilean state-owned firearms manufacturer. It produces various weaponry including carbines, submachine guns, sniper rifles, and revolvers. Its products are used by the Chilean armed forces and the Carabineros police force.

companies.name: Asenav
companies.description: Asenav is a Chilean shipbuilding company based in Santiago with main shipyards in Valdivia near the Pacific coast. It was established in 1974 by German immigrant Eberhard Kossmann. The company specializes in ship construction.

companies.name: ENAER
companies.description: ENAER is a Chilean aircraft manufacturer. The company operates in the aerospace industry, producing aircraft in Chile.

companies.name: Empresa Nacional del Petróleo
companies.description: Empresa Nacional del Petróleo is a state-owned Chilean company based in Las Condes. It is involved in exploration, production, refining, and marketing of hydrocarbons and their derivatives.

companies.name: IguanaBee
companies.description: IguanaBee is a Chilean video game company known for developing MonsterBag, a stealth video game released in 2015 for the PlayStation Vita. The company operates in the video game industry.

companies.name: Chilean Red Cross
companies.description: The Chilean Red Cross Society was founded in 1903 and is headquartered in Santiago. It was incorporated by law in 1923 and its volunteers respond to natural disasters such as volcano eruptions in Chile.

companies.name: Empresas CMPC
companies.description: Empresas CMPC S.A. is a Chilean pulp and paper company headquartered in Santiago. It is the largest paper manufacturer in Chile and one of the biggest worldwide according to Forbes Global 2000 in 2023.

companies.name: Bank of London and South America
companies.industry: financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
companies.wiki: Bank of London and South America
companies.description: The Bank of London and South America Limited was a British bank operating in South America from 1923 to 1971. It provided financial services in the region including Chile.

companies.name: Mallplaza
companies.description: Mallplaza S.A. is a Chilean chain of shopping malls operated in South America by Falabella. The company manages retail mall properties across the region.

companies.name: Sociedad Explotadora de Tierra del Fuego
companies.wiki: Sociedad Explotadora de Tierra del Fuego
companies.description: The Sociedad Explotadora de Tierra del Fuego was a historically important company in Patagonia, Chile and Argentina. Founded in 1893, it cultivated over 1,000,000 hectares for sheep farming and operated factories to process and export sheep meat.

companies.name: Aerocardal
companies.description: Aerocardal is an airline based in Santiago, Chile. It operates international and domestic passenger charter services as well as medical services. Its main base is Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport in Santiago.

companies.name: Aerovías DAP
companies.description: Aerovías DAP is a Chilean airline operating charter and scheduled flights, based in Punta Arenas, Chile. It is part of the DAP group, a consortium including several aviation-related companies such as AeroRescate and Antarctic Airways.

companies.name: LATAM Cargo Chile
companies.description: LATAM Cargo Chile is a cargo airline based in Santiago, Chile, and a freight subsidiary of the LATAM Airlines Group. It operates cargo flights within South America, Europe, and North America from hubs including Miami International Airport and Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport.

companies.name: Sky Airline
companies.description: Sky Airline is an airline based at Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport in Santiago, Chile. It is the country's second largest airline and the first to operate under a low-cost model. Sky Airline serves international routes in South America and operates charter and domestic flights.

companies.name: Banco BICE
companies.description: Banco BICE is a Chilean bank founded in 1979 and based in Santiago. It is controlled by the Matte family, with Bernardo Matte as president and Alberto Schilling Redlich as CEO.

companies.name: One Airlines
companies.description: One Airlines was a Chilean airline providing passenger and mining charter flights since 2013. It operated a small fleet including Boeing 737 aircraft and was headquartered at Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport in Santiago. The airline ceased all operations on June 24, 2020.

companies.name: Latin American Wings
companies.description: Latin American Wings (LAW) was a short-lived scheduled charter airline based at Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport in Santiago, Chile. It operated flights to six destinations using Boeing 737-300 aircraft before suspending operations.

companies.name: JetSmart
companies.description: JetSMART Airlines SpA is a Chilean ultra low-cost carrier controlled by US investment fund Indigo Partners. Its primary base is Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport in Santiago, and it owns JetSmart Argentina. The airline began scheduled operations in July 2017.

companies.name: América TV
companies.description: América TV is an Argentine television station broadcasting on channel 2 in La Plata, Buenos Aires Province. It is one of Argentina's five national television networks and is owned by Grupo América as its flagship television property.

companies.name: Underground contenidos
companies.description: Underground Producciones is a media producer in Argentina specializing in television and film production. The company was founded in 2006 by Sebastian Ortega and Pablo Culell.

companies.name: Ledesma S.A.A.I.
companies.description: Ledesma is a diversified agribusiness and manufacturing firm based in Argentina. It operates in food processing, fossil fuels, bioethanol production, and paper milling. The company is notable for its wide range of industrial activities within the chemical industry.

companies.name: Energía Argentina
companies.description: Energía Argentina Sociedad Anónima (ENARSA) is a state-owned company in Argentina engaged in petroleum and natural gas exploitation. It also produces, industrializes, transports, and trades petroleum, natural gas, and electricity. The company operates within the petroleum industry.

companies.name: Ualá
companies.description: Ualá is an Argentine fintech company providing a mobile app for managing a Mastercard prepaid debit card and other financial services. Founded by Pierpaolo Barbieri, it competes with digital banks like Brubank. The company operates in the banking sector.

companies.name: Fibertel telefónica telecom
companies.description: Fibertel was an Argentine Internet service provider that merged with Cablevisión in 2003, becoming part of Grupo Clarín. It served over a million clients and was the third largest ISP in Argentina. In 2018, it merged with Telecom Argentina.

companies.name: Telefe Rosario
companies.description: Telefe Rosario, known as Canal 5 de Rosario, is an Argentine television station broadcasting from Rosario, Santa Fe. It is owned by Grupo Televisión Litoral and serves Greater Rosario and northern Buenos Aires province. The station carries Telefe programming.

companies.name: El Nueve
companies.description: El Nueve is an Argentine free-to-air television network based in Buenos Aires. It focuses on general entertainment programming. The channel is known by its brand name El Nueve.

companies.name: Todo Noticias
companies.description: Todo Noticias is an Argentine pay and streaming news channel owned by the Clarín Group and Artear. It began broadcasting in 1993 and operates a news website ranked among the top in Argentina. It is the country's most watched news channel according to IBOPE.

companies.name: Tulio Crespi S.A.
companies.description: Tulio Crespi S.A. is an Argentine automobile manufacturer founded in 1962 by former racing driver Tulio Crespi. It has an industrial plant in Balcarce, Buenos Aires, producing automobiles and Formula racing vehicles. The company operates in the automotive industry.

companies.name: General Motors of Argentina
companies.description: General Motors de Argentina S.R.L. is the Argentine subsidiary of US-based General Motors. It is headquartered in Vicente López, Buenos Aires, with a factory in Alvear, Santa Fe Province. The company operates in the automotive industry.

companies.name: Mostaza
companies.description: Mostaza, SA is an Argentine fast food chain established in 1998. It specializes in hamburgers, sandwiches, desserts, and café items. It is the second largest fast food chain in Argentina after McDonald's.

companies.name: Motomel
companies.description: Motomel S.A. is an Argentine motorcycle brand based in Buenos Aires Province. It was founded in 1992 by the La Emilia investment group. The company specializes in manufacturing motorcycles.

companies.name: Arte Radiotelevisivo Argentino
companies.description: Arte Radiotelevisivo Argentino S.A., known as Artear, is an Argentine mass media company owned by the Clarín Group. It operates television stations and pay TV networks, produces content, and distributes it through digital platforms. Its flagship station is El Trece, based in Buenos Aires.

companies.name: Flow
companies.description: Flow is an Argentine company that provided cable television and internet services in Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay. As of 2021, it was integrated into DF Entertainment and Telecom Argentina S.A. The company operated in the mass media sector.

companies.name: Bersa
companies.description: Bersa is an Argentine arms manufacturer located in the city of Ramos Mejía, Argentina. The company operates in the arms industry, producing firearms.

companies.name: Werthein Group
companies.description: Grupo Werthein is a holding company founded in 1928 and based in Argentina. It has been led by members of the Werthein family since its origins. The company operates in the investment sector.

companies.name: Correo Oficial de la República Argentina
companies.description: The Official Post Service of the Argentine Republic is a state-owned company covering postal services in Argentina. It is a S.A. under the country's Office of the Cabinet Chief. The company operates in the mail industry.

companies.name: OCA
companies.description: Correo OCA is an Argentine company created in Córdoba in 1957 as a service management for Industrias Kaiser Argentina (IKA). It operates in the mail industry providing postal services.

companies.name: Sociedad Comercial del Plata
companies.description: Sociedad Comercial del Plata is a diversified Argentine holding company with interests in energy, rail transport, real estate, and tourism sectors. The company operates primarily in investment activities.

companies.name: Bridas Corporation
companies.description: Bridas Corporation is an Argentine independent oil and gas holding company based in Buenos Aires. Since March 2010, it has been 50% owned by China National Offshore Oil Corporation. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

companies.name: Nimble Giant Entertainment
companies.description: Nimble Giant Entertainment, SA is an Argentine video game developer located in Buenos Aires. The studio was acquired by Saber Interactive in 2020. It operates in the video game industry.

companies.name: Estudios San Miguel
companies.description: Estudios San Miguel was an Argentine film studio active in the 1940s and early 1950s, based in Buenos Aires. It was a major studio during the Golden Age of Argentine cinema, producing award-winning films like La guerra gaucha and Juvenilia. The studio ceased production after 1952 due to financial overextension.

companies.name: Supermercados Disco
companies.description: Disco is an Argentine supermarket chain and part of the Chilean retail conglomerate Cencosud since 2004. It operates alongside other Cencosud-owned chains in Argentina, including Jumbo and Vea. The company is involved in the retail sector.

companies.name: La Anónima
companies.description: La Anónima is an Argentine supermarket chain operating mainly in the Patagonia region. It is formally known as S.A. Importadora y Exportadora de la Patagonia. The company is part of the retail industry in Argentina.

companies.name: Alot (store)
companies.description: Alot, formerly Staples Argentina, is the Argentine and Brazilian subsidiary of the American office supply chain Staples. Headquartered in Buenos Aires, it is the largest office supply company in Argentina and among the top three in Brazil.

companies.name: Bank of the Argentine Nation
companies.description: Banco de la Nación Argentina is the largest bank in Argentina's banking sector. It operates as a financial institution within the country.

companies.name: Harrods Buenos Aires
companies.description: Harrods Buenos Aires was an Argentine retail company based in Buenos Aires, operating as a branch of the London-based Harrods. It opened in 1912 and closed in 1998, with multiple attempts to reopen since then.

companies.name: C5N
companies.description: Canal 5 Noticias (C5N) is an Argentine pay television news channel launched on August 6, 2007. It operates in the news and communication sector in Argentina.

companies.name: Fabricaciones Militares
companies.logo_file: Logo Fabricaciones Militares Sociedad del Estado.png
companies.description: Fabricaciones Militares S.A.U. is a state-owned Argentine arms manufacturer based in Buenos Aires. It was formerly a government agency known as Dirección General de Fabricaciones Militares.

companies.name: Patagonik Film Group
companies.description: Patagonik Film Group is an Argentine production company specializing in feature films and film production services. It is part of the Clarín Group and supports international film productions in Argentina.

companies.name: Banco Credicoop
companies.description: Banco Credicoop is the largest cooperatively-owned bank in Argentina. It operates within the country's banking and financial sector.

companies.name: Bank of the City of Buenos Aires
companies.wiki: Bank of the City of Buenos Aires
companies.description: The Bank of the City of Buenos Aires, known as Banco Ciudad, is a publicly owned municipal commercial bank based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Founded in 1878 as Monte de Piedad, it aimed to combat usury by providing loans at below-market interest rates to reduce social inequalities.

companies.name: Bank of the Province of Buenos Aires
companies.wiki: Bank of the Province of Buenos Aires
companies.description: The Bank of the Province of Buenos Aires, or Banco Provincia, is a publicly owned bank in Argentina. It is recognized as the second-largest bank in the country by value of assets and deposits.

companies.name: Transener
companies.description: Transener is an Argentine company specializing in the transmission of extra high voltage electric power. It is a leading firm in its sector within Argentina.

companies.name: Edesur
companies.description: Edesur is an electricity distribution company headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina. It operates as a public utility within the country.

companies.name: Ford Argentina
companies.description: Ford Argentina S.C.A. is the Argentine subsidiary of Ford Motor Company, founded in Buenos Aires in 1913. It initially assembled Model Ts from kits and is known for producing models like the Ford Focus and the Argentine-adapted Ford Falcon.

companies.name: Volkswagen Argentina
companies.description: Volkswagen Group Argentina is the Argentine subsidiary of the German automotive manufacturer Volkswagen Group. Established in 1980, it acquired Chrysler Fevre Argentina and its two plants in San Justo and Monte Chingolo.

companies.name: Banco Hipotecario
companies.description: Banco Hipotecario S.A. is an Argentine financial institution with majority state participation. Founded in 1886 as Banco Hipotecario Nacional, its initial purpose was to grant mortgage loans for home construction.

companies.name: Mercedes-Benz Argentina
companies.description: Mercedes-Benz Argentina S.A.U. is the Argentine subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz Group, producing and marketing utility vehicles. Established in 1951, it has an assembly plant in Virrey del Pino where trucks and buses are produced, and it imports luxury models including sedans and SUVs.

companies.name: Toyota Argentina
companies.description: Toyota Argentina S.A. is the Argentine subsidiary of the Japanese conglomerate Toyota and the first Japanese automotive company to produce in Argentina. Founded in 1994, it operates a manufacturing plant in Zárate, Buenos Aires, opened in 1997.

companies.name: Sero Electric
companies.description: Sero Electric is an Argentine manufacturer of electric microcars based in Buenos Aires. The company was founded in 2010 and focuses on producing electric vehicles.

companies.name: Telefónica Argentina
companies.description: Telefónica Argentina is a telecommunications company based in Argentina. It is a subsidiary of Telefónica Group and was founded in 1990 following the privatization of the National Telecommunications Company (ENTel).

companies.name: ENTel
companies.description: Empresa Nacional de Telecomunicaciones (ENTel) was an Argentine state-owned enterprise that held the monopoly on public telecommunications in Argentina.

companies.name: Editorial Ivrea
companies.description: Editorial Ivrea is an Argentine publisher specializing in manga and comics, operating in Argentina, Chile, Finland, and Spain. It also published Lazer, a magazine focused on anime and related media, which ended publication in 2009 due to copyright issues.

companies.name: Fábrica Argentina de Aviones
companies.description: Fábrica Argentina de Aviones SA is Argentina's main aircraft manufacturer located in Córdoba. Founded in 1927, it was known as Fábrica Militar de Aviones until its privatization in the 1990s and is now wholly owned by the Argentine government since 2009.

companies.name: Cicaré Helicópteros
companies.description: Cicaré S.A. is an Argentine helicopter manufacturer founded in the 1970s in Saladillo, Buenos Aires Province. It developed several prototypes, including one for the Argentine Air Force, and achieved success with the CH-7 light sporting helicopter in the 1990s.

companies.name: Tandanor
companies.description: Tandanor is an Argentine shipyard located south of Buenos Aires port. Along with Almirante Storni yard, it forms CINAR, which is dedicated to shipbuilding and ship repair.

companies.name: Siam
companies.description: SIAM is an Argentine home appliance brand owned by Grupo Industrial Newsan. Founded in 1911 as a mechanical bread machine manufacturer, it expanded into refrigerators, washing machines, vehicles, and industrial equipment, becoming South America's largest metalworking industry by the 1940s.

companies.name: Acindar
companies.description: Acindar is an Argentine company operating in steel, agribusiness, industrial, and construction sectors. Founded in 1942, it has headquarters in Villa Constitución and production plants in several Argentine cities.

companies.name: Chocolate Águila
companies.description: Chocolate Águila is an Argentine chocolate brand owned by Grupo Arcor. It originated from Saint Hermanos S.A., established in 1880, and was known for its chocolate bars under the Águila tradename.

companies.name: ICBC Argentina
companies.description: ICBC Argentina is an Argentine banking entity owned by the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China. It was founded in 2013 after acquiring Standard Bank Argentina and serves as the Argentine subsidiary of the Chinese bank.

companies.name: Naranja X
companies.description: Naranja X is an Argentine fintech company headquartered in Córdoba and Buenos Aires. Founded in 1985, it offers a variety of financial services including loans and credit cards within its ecosystem. The company operates primarily in the financial services sector in Argentina.

companies.name: Telecom Personal
companies.description: Telecom Personal is an Argentine telecommunications company providing Internet and mobile telephony services nationwide. It is a subsidiary of Telecom and since 2021 has combined broadband and mobile internet services under one brand. Personal is the second-largest mobile phone service provider in Argentina.

companies.name: Cris Morena Group
companies.description: Cris Morena Group is a Buenos Aires-based production company founded in 2002 by Cris Morena. It specializes in youth programming and also develops ancillary businesses such as CDs, magazines, licenses, musicals, and theatrical productions. It is a major production company in Argentina.

companies.name: CEATSA
companies.description: CEATSA is an Argentine high technology testing company providing environmental testing services to satellite, aeronautics, electronics, automotive, defense, and energy industries. It is jointly owned by government-owned ARSAT and public company INVAP. The company operates in the aerospace industry.

companies.name: Satellogic
companies.description: Satellogic Inc. is an Argentine-U.S. company specializing in Earth-observation satellites. Founded in 2010 by Emiliano Kargieman and Gerardo Richarte, it operates in the aerospace industry focusing on satellite technology.

companies.name: Scouts de Argentina
companies.description: Scouts de Argentina Asociación Civil is a national Scouting association in Argentina. Founded by Perito Francisco Moreno, it has had several names and was declared the National Institution of Argentine Scouting by presidential decree in 1917. It is a key organization in Argentine scouting.

companies.name: AeroDreams
companies.description: AeroDreams S.A. is a defense contractor based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Since 2001, it has developed unmanned aerial vehicles for military and non-military use. The company's CEO is Raúl Fernández.

companies.name: Nostromo Defensa
companies.description: Nostromo Defensa is a defense contractor headquartered in Córdoba, Argentina. Founded in 2006, it develops unmanned aerial vehicles for military and non-military applications. The CEO of the company is Marcelo Martínez.

companies.name: The Walt Disney Company Latin America
companies.wiki: The Walt Disney Company Latin America
companies.description: The Walt Disney Company Latin America is an international division of the Walt Disney Company. It manages the Disney brand and businesses throughout Latin America with offices in Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Mexico, and Miami.

companies.name: Yacimientos Carboníferos Río Turbio
companies.description: Yacimientos Carboníferos Río Turbio is an Argentine coal mining company created in 1994 to replace Yacimientos Carboníferos Fiscales. It extracts, ships, and sells coal from the Rio Turbio basin and is the only coal mine in Argentina. It is located in the southwestern extreme of the country.

companies.name: Aerolíneas Argentinas
companies.description: Aerolíneas Argentinas is the state-owned flag carrier and largest airline of Argentina. Founded in 1949 from the merger of several airlines, it is headquartered in Buenos Aires. The airline joined the SkyTeam alliance in 2012 and its cargo division joined SkyTeam Cargo in 2013.

companies.name: Andes Líneas Aéreas
companies.description: Andes Líneas Aéreas is an Argentine airline based in Salta. It operates regional and charter flights to tourist destinations in Argentina and Brazil. Its main hub is Martín Miguel de Güemes International Airport in Salta.

companies.name: Líneas Aéreas del Estado (LADE)
companies.description: Líneas Aéreas del Estado is an airline based in Comodoro Rivadavia, Argentina. Owned by the Argentine government and operated by the Air Force, it provides domestic scheduled services mainly in Patagonia.

companies.name: Aerochaco
companies.description: Aerochaco was an Argentine regional airline established in 1957 as a mixed-economy enterprise by the Chaco provincial government and Chaco Aero Club. It began operations in 1959 to improve connectivity between Chaco and northern provinces using de Havilland DHC-2 Beaver aircraft.

companies.name: Baires Fly
companies.description: Baires Fly S.A. is an airline based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, established in 1996. It operates passenger and cargo charter services from its main base at Aeroparque Jorge Newbery. The airline was reported to be used in a notable flight involving Flávio Bolsonaro.

companies.name: Avianca Argentina
companies.description: Avianca Argentina, legally Avian Líneas Aéreas S.A., was an Argentine airline headquartered in Buenos Aires with its hub at Aeroparque Jorge Newbery. It operated under the Avianca brand but was independent of Avianca Holdings. The airline ceased operations in June 2019.

companies.name: Líneas Aéreas Federales
companies.description: Líneas Aéreas Federales S.A. was a state-owned airline based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. It operated domestic services with flights carried out by other local airlines.

companies.name: SanCor
companies.description: SanCor was a leading dairy producer in Argentina, accounting for one fifth of the country's production and 90% of its dairy exports. It was a large cooperative based in the central milk basin near the Santa Fe and Córdoba provinces.

companies.name: Flybondi
companies.description: Flybondi, operated by FB Líneas Aéreas S.A., was Argentina's first ultra low-cost airline. It operated Boeing 737-800 aircraft from bases in Buenos Aires and Córdoba. The company used the slogan 'La libertad de volar'.

companies.name: Norwegian Air Argentina
companies.description: Norwegian Air Argentina S.A.U. was an Argentine low-cost airline operating Boeing 737-800 aircraft. Its bases were in Buenos Aires and Córdoba, and all aircraft were registered in Argentina.

companies.name: JetSmart Argentina
companies.description: JetSmart Airlines S.A., styled as JetSMART, is an Argentine airline owned by ultra low-cost carrier JetSmart, itself owned by Indigo Partners. It operates a fleet of Airbus A320 family aircraft with a base at Aeroparque Jorge Newbery in Buenos Aires. Its aircraft are registered in Argentina.

companies.name: Muky
companies.description: Muky was an Argentine brand of die-cast toy model cars popular in Argentina between the 1970s and the 1980s. Most models were diecast seconds or knockoffs of early Mattel Hot Wheels. The brand is no longer active.

companies.name: Unitán
companies.description: Unitán is an Argentine company producing quebracho tannins. It sells 40,000 tonnes of tannins used in the tanning industry, drilling industry, enological applications, and as animal food. The company operates within Argentina.

companies.name: Agrinar
companies.description: Agrinar SA is an Argentine agricultural machinery manufacturing company based in Granadero Baigorria, Santa Fe Province. It focuses on agricultural vehicles, producing mainly tractors, combine harvesters, and backhoe loaders. The company serves the agricultural sector in Argentina.

companies.name: Anglo-South American Bank
companies.industry: financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
companies.description: The Anglo-South American Bank was a British and Argentine bank established in 1900 with the acquisition of the Anglo-Argentine Bank by the Bank of Tarapacá and London. It was initially named Bank of Tarapacá and Argentina and renamed Anglo-South American Bank in 1907.

companies.name: La Serenísima
companies.description: Mastellone Hermanos S.A., known as La Serenísima, is an Argentine dairy company headquartered in General Rodríguez, Buenos Aires Province. Founded in 1929 by Antonino Mastellone, it is jointly owned by Grupo Arcor and the French multinational Danone.

companies.name: Tregar
companies.description: García Hermanos Agroindustrial S.R.L., known as Tregar, is an Argentine dairy company headquartered in Gobernador Crespo, Santa Fe Province. Established in the 1940s, it remains family-owned and operates two production plants in Gobernador Crespo and Calchaquí.

companies.name: Vassalli Fabril
companies.description: Vassalli Fabril S.A. is an Argentina-based company producing combine harvesters and farm implements under the brands Vassalli and Don Roque. It has three manufacturing plants in Firmat, Santa Fe Province, with a production capacity of 600 units a year.

companies.name: Argentine Rural Society
companies.description: The Sociedad Rural Argentina (SRA) is a landowners' association founded in 1866. It represents large agricultural producers in Argentina's Pampas region, focusing primarily on crop farming and livestock production.

companies.name: Ripio
companies.description: Ripio is an Argentine financial technology company focused on cryptocurrencies. Founded in Buenos Aires in 2013 as BitPagos, it started as a bitcoin payments processor and expanded into a cryptocurrency exchange, consumer wallet products, and institutional services.

companies.name: Argentine Red Cross
companies.description: The Argentine Red Cross is a humanitarian organization founded in 1880. It is headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina. The organization is involved in emergency and relief efforts.

companies.name: Grupo Telefe
companies.description: Grupo Telefe is an Argentine media company founded in 1989. It operates the license for LS84 TV Channel 11 in Buenos Aires and other stations in Córdoba and Santa Fe. The company is headquartered in Martínez, Buenos Aires Province.

companies.name: El Comercio Group
companies.description: El Comercio Group is a Peruvian media conglomerate owning multiple newspapers and television stations. It is the largest media conglomerate in Peru and one of the largest in South America. The group is owned by the Miró Quesada family.

companies.name: Empresa Nacional de Ferrocarriles del Peru
companies.wiki: Empresa Nacional de Ferrocarriles del Perú
companies.description: Empresa Nacional de Ferrocarriles del Perú (Enafer) is a public company managing the railway network of Peru. It ensures the management and commercial use of the country's railways.

companies.name: Nexa Resources
companies.description: Compañía Minera Atacocha, known as Atacocha, is a Peruvian mining company focused on exploration and exploitation of mine concessions. Since 2009, it operates under Nexa Resources Atacocha and is listed on the Peruvian exchange.

companies.name: Minsur
companies.description: Minsur is a Peru-based mining company engaged in extracting and refining tin and copper. It also explores for new mineral deposits including gold, silver, lead, and zinc ores.

companies.name: Grupo Breca
companies.description: Grupo Breca, also known as Grupo Brescia, is a Peruvian business conglomerate founded over 130 years ago. It operates in Peru and other Latin American countries. The name 'Breca' reflects the founders' surnames Brescia and Cafferata.

companies.name: Bembos
companies.description: Bembos is a Peruvian fast food restaurant chain founded in 1988 by Carlos Camino and Mirko Cermak. It is known for its hamburgers with Peruvian-influenced variations and distinctive restaurant architecture.

companies.name: Plaza Vea
companies.description: Supermercados Peruanos S.A., trading as Super Food Holding, is a Peruvian company owning several supermarket chains. Founded in 1979, it adopted its current name in 2004 after acquisition by Interbank. It operates supermarkets and discount stores.

companies.name: Supermercados Wong
companies.description: Wong is a supermarket chain in Peru, originally known as E. Wong until 2005. It began as a small store in 1942 founded by Chinese Peruvians in the San Isidro District of Lima.

companies.name: Intercorp
companies.description: Intercorp Perú Ltd. is a Peruvian business conglomerate and multinational corporation founded in 1994. It operates primarily through two holding companies, Intercorp Financial Services and Intercorp Retail. Its headquarters are located in Santa Catalina, Lima, in the same building as its subsidiary Interbank.

companies.name: D'Onofrio
companies.description: D'Onofrio is a Peruvian brand specializing in confectionery products, founded in 1897 by Pietro D'Onofrio. It is currently owned by Nestlé Perú and sells its products within Peru to a wide market of all ages.

companies.name: Agroindustrial Pomalca
companies.description: Empresa Agroindustrial Pomalca is a leading agribusiness company based in Chiclayo, Peru. It is a major sugar producer with over 15,000 hectares of sugar cane and exports refined sugar to the United States. The company produces sugar, molasses, bagasse, and other agricultural exports.

companies.name: Aenza
companies.description: Aenza is a Latin American company originally founded in 1933 as a real estate and construction firm, now the oldest and largest in Peru. It operates in construction, energy, mining, sanitation, and highway services. The company changed its name from Graña y Montero to Aenza in 2020 following corruption scandals.

companies.name: Interbank
companies.description: Interbank, formally Banco Internacional del Perú Service Holding S.A.A., is a Peruvian financial services provider. It operates in the banking sector within Peru.

companies.name: Credit Bank of Peru
companies.description: Banco de Crédito del Perú is the largest bank in Peru by total assets and the main subsidiary of Credicorp, the country's largest financial holding company. It provides integrated financial services across Peru.

companies.name: Lima Airport Partners
companies.description: Lima Airport Partners S.R.L. is a limited liability company operating Jorge Chávez International Airport in Callao, near Lima, Peru. Founded in 2001, it holds a 30-year concession and is majority owned by Germany's Fraport AG.

companies.name: Caja Trujillo
companies.description: Caja Trujillo is a Peruvian bank based in Trujillo city, focusing on financial services for entrepreneurs in the SME sector. It is the largest financial company in its region with branches across coastal and highland areas of Peru.

companies.name: Petroperú
companies.description: Petróleos del Perú, known as Petroperú, is a state-owned enterprise dedicated to transportation, refining, distribution, and commercialization of fuels and petroleum products. Owned by the State of Peru since 1969, it employs over 2,500 people.

companies.name: Modasa
companies.description: MODASA is a Peruvian bus manufacturer located in Ate District. It produces buses, cars including pick-up trucks, and offers automobile conversions to natural gas. The company also manufactures generators and mobile generators.

companies.name: Backus and Johnston Brewery
companies.description: Backus and Johnston is the largest brewery in Peru and part of the Bavaria Brewery, itself under the international AB InBev group. Its main brewery is located in the Ate District of Lima. The company produces beer, soft drinks, and bottled water, holding a near monopoly on Peruvian beer brands.

companies.name: Arca Continental Lindley
companies.description: Arca Continental Lindley S.A. is a Peruvian company that manufactures, distributes, and markets nonalcoholic beverages. It is the official bottler and distributor of Coca-Cola products in Peru and was formed in 2015 by merging Mexico-based Arca Continental and Peru-based Lindley S.A. The company is known for creating and marketing Inca Kola.

companies.name: Servicios Industriales de la Marina
companies.description: Servicios Industriales de la Marina S.A. (SIMA) is a Peruvian state-owned shipyard established in 1950, continuing the activities of the former Naval Factory founded in 1845. It pioneered shipbuilding in South America and manufactures large metalworking structures, serving the Peruvian Navy and private clients.

companies.name: National Society of Industries
companies.description: The National Society of Industries (Sociedad Nacional de Industrias - SNI) is a private organization that unites the business community of the Peruvian manufacturing industry.

companies.name: Flora Tristan Center of Peruvian Women
companies.description: The Flora Tristán Peruvian Women's Center is a feminist non-governmental organization established in Lima in 1979. It focuses on defending women's human rights and promoting equality.

companies.name: Embassy of France, Lima
companies.logo_file: Logo de l'ambassade de France au Pérou.svg
companies.description: The Embassy of France in Peru is the permanent diplomatic mission of France located at 3415 Arequipa Avenue, San Isidro District, Lima.

companies.name: Aero Cóndor
companies.description: Aero Cóndor S.A., also known as Aero Cóndor Peru, was an airline based in Lima, Peru. Founded in 1975, it provided domestic charter flights, cargo, scenic, and air ambulance services with its main hub at Jorge Chávez International Airport.

companies.name: Peruvian Airlines
companies.description: Peruvian Air Line S.A. was a Peruvian airline based in Lima operating from 2009 to 2019. It primarily offered domestic flights from its main base at Jorge Chávez International Airport before ceasing operations due to liquidity issues.

companies.name: LATAM Airlines Peru
companies.description: LATAM Airlines Perú is the flag carrier airline based in Lima, Peru, and a subsidiary of Chile's LATAM Airlines Group. It operates scheduled domestic and international flights with its main hub at Jorge Chávez International Airport and holds a dominant position in Peru's domestic market.

companies.name: Avianca Peru
companies.description: Avianca Perú S.A. was a Lima-based airline operating domestic and international services from Jorge Chávez International Airport. Part of the Synergy Group and Avianca Holdings, it operated flights under TACA Airlines' codes before ceasing operations in May 2020.

companies.name: Star Perú
companies.description: Star Perú is a Peruvian airline based at Jorge Chávez International Airport in Lima. Founded in 1997, it operates passenger and cargo flights mainly within Peru and South America. The airline primarily serves domestic routes and also offers international charter flights.

companies.name: Air Perú
companies.description: Air Perú International S.A.C. was a proposed airline based in Lima, Peru. It planned to operate scheduled domestic and international flights to Asia, Europe, South America, and the United States. Its main base was intended to be Jorge Chávez International Airport.

companies.name: Aviandina
companies.description: Aviandina was a small Peruvian airline operational from 1999 to 2003. It was a subsidiary of Aero Continente. The airline is no longer active.

companies.name: Servicios Aéreos de los Andes
companies.description: Servicios Aéreos de los Andes is a Peruvian airline operating fixed-wing aircraft and rotorcraft. Founded in 2005 as a charter airline, it specializes in transporting personnel for mining and oil and gas industries. In 2014, it began commercial flights between Lima, Jauja, and Cusco.

companies.name: Viva Air Peru
companies.description: Viva Air Perú S.A.C. was a Peruvian ultra low-cost carrier created by Irelandia Aviation. It is related to Viva Air Colombia and Mexico's VivaAerobús, although the latter has no legal affiliation with the other Viva brands.

companies.name: Red Cross of Chad
companies.description: The Red Cross of Chad was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in N’Djamena, Chad. It operates as a humanitarian organization providing emergency and relief services.

companies.name: SotelTchad
companies.description: Societe des Telecommunications Internationales du Tchad (SotelTchad) is a Chadian telecommunications parastatal providing landline and Internet services. Created in 2000, it was privatized in 2010 and later returned to state control. It partnered with ITXC in 2001 to offer international phone service via Internet telephony.

companies.name: Mid Express Tchad
companies.description: Mid Express Tchad was a cargo airline based in N'Djamena, Chad. Established as AMW Tchad in 2007, it was rebranded as Mid-Express Tchad in 2008. The airline focused on cargo transport.

companies.name: LASER Airlines
companies.description: LASER Airlines is a regional airline based in Caracas, Venezuela. It operates scheduled and charter passenger services within Venezuela, the Caribbean, and South America. Its main hub is Simón Bolívar International Airport.

companies.name: Conviasa
companies.description: Línea Aérea Conviasa is the flag carrier and largest airline of Venezuela, headquartered at Simón Bolívar International Airport near Caracas. It operates domestic and international flights to the Caribbean and South America. Conviasa is noted for establishing routes for political reasons.

companies.name: Avior Airlines
companies.description: Avior Airlines C.A. is an airline based in Barcelona, Venezuela. It operates scheduled and charter services within Venezuela and the southern Caribbean from its main hub at Generál José Antonio Anzoátegui International Airport. It is the largest private capital airline in Venezuela by fleet, destinations, and employees.

companies.name: Cervecería Polar
companies.description: Empresas Polar, also known as Cervecería Polar, is a Venezuelan corporation founded in 1941 in Caracas. It started as a brewery and is the largest and best known brewery in Venezuela. The company has diversified into food processing and packaging, serving markets domestically and abroad.

companies.name: RUTACA Airlines
companies.description: RUTACA Airlines is an airline headquartered in Ciudad Bolívar, Venezuela. Its home base is Tomás de Heres Airport, with a hub at Simón Bolívar International Airport in Caracas. It operates as a Venezuelan airline serving these locations.

companies.name: Venezolana
companies.description: Venezolana - Rutas Aéreas de Venezuela S.A. is a charter airline headquartered in Maracaibo, Venezuela. It operates as a Venezuelan airline providing charter services.

companies.name: Aeropostal Alas de Venezuela
companies.description: Aeropostal Alas de Venezuela C.A. is a state-owned airline based in Caracas, Venezuela. It operates domestic and Caribbean international services from its main base at Simón Bolívar International Airport. The airline ceased operations in 2017 but announced resumption of scheduled service in 2018.

companies.name: Aero Ejecutivos
companies.description: AeroEjecutivos C.A. was a Venezuelan scheduled and charter regional airline headquartered in Maiquetia. It was based at Óscar Machado Zuloaga International Airport and operated regional flights.

companies.name: Banco Industrial de Venezuela
companies.description: Banco Industrial de Venezuela, or BIV, was a Venezuelan state bank. It operated as a financial institution in Venezuela.

companies.name: Banco Digital de los Trabajadores
companies.description: BDT Banco Digital de los Trabajadores, Banco Universal C.A., is a bank based in Caracas, Venezuela. It was created in 2009 through a merger of several state-owned banks following a banking crisis. The bank holds around 20% of Venezuelan bank deposits.

companies.name: Avior Regional
companies.description: Avior Regional was a Venezuelan regional airline and a subsidiary of Avior Airlines. It began operations in March 2015 with flights from Caracas to Barinas, Valera, and Curaçao.

companies.name: Albatros Airlines
companies.description: Albatros Airlines is a Venezuelan charter airline with private capital. It is authorized to carry out flights for the transfer of passengers and cargo within Venezuela.

companies.name: Turpial Airlines
companies.description: Turpial Airlines C.A. is a Venezuelan airline based at Arturo Michelena International Airport in Valencia. It operates a fleet of three Boeing 737-400 aircraft authorized for passenger, cargo, and mail flights both domestically and internationally.

companies.name: National Commission of Telecommunications
companies.description: The National Commission of Telecommunications is a Venezuelan government agency responsible for regulating, supervising, and controlling telecommunications in the country.

companies.name: Grupo Cisneros
companies.description: Grupo Cisneros is a privately held, family-owned conglomerate headquartered in Coral Gables, Florida, with historical roots in Venezuela. It focuses on media entertainment, digital media, property investment, tourism development, and consumer products, reaching 550 million Spanish and Portuguese-speaking consumers worldwide.

companies.name: The Women's Development Bank
companies.description: The Women's Development Bank was established in Venezuela in 2001 to address political, economic, and social disadvantages faced by women. It provides small, low-interest loans and administrative training, offering both financial and non-financial services to women.

companies.name: TeleSUR
companies.description: Telesur is a Latin American terrestrial and satellite news television network headquartered in Caracas, Venezuela. It is sponsored by the governments of Venezuela, Cuba, and Nicaragua.

companies.name: Globovisión
companies.description: Globovisión is a 24-hour television news network broadcasting over-the-air in several Venezuelan regions and available nationwide via cable and satellite. It also reaches audiences in the United States and multiple Latin American countries through various cable packages.

companies.name: Central Madeirense
companies.description: Central Madeirense is a Venezuelan supermarket chain founded in 1949 by families from Madeira, Portugal. Its first store was in Caracas, and at its peak, it operated 53 stores in 38 cities, becoming the largest chain in the country.

companies.name: Compañía Anónima Venezolana de Industrias Militares
companies.description: CAVIM (Compañía Anónima Venezolana de Industrias Militares) is a Venezuelan state-owned firearms manufacturer established on April 29, 1975.

companies.name: BDV | Banco de Venezuela
companies.description: Banco de Venezuela is an international universal bank based in Caracas. It was the market leader in Venezuela until 2007 and had 285 branches as of June 2008, competing with Banesco, Banco Mercantil, and BBVA Banco Provincial.

companies.name: Banco Occidental de Descuento
companies.description: Banco Occidental de Descuento (BOD) was a Venezuelan bank that held around 6.6% of the market, making it the fifth-largest bank in Venezuela in 2009.

companies.name: Banesco
companies.description: Banesco Banco Universal C.A. is a Venezuelan financial institution headquartered in Caracas. It operates as a bank and is a member of the Asociación Bancaria de Venezuela. The bank serves customers primarily within Venezuela.

companies.name: BBVA Provincial
companies.description: BBVA Provincial is a financial institution operating in Venezuela. It was formerly known as BBVA Banco Provincial. The bank provides various financial services within the country.

companies.name: Banco Venezolano de Crédito
companies.description: Banco Venezolano de Crédito is a Venezuelan bank based in Caracas, founded in 1925 as the oldest private bank in the country. It operates a network of branches across Venezuela and has an international branch in the Cayman Islands established in 1998.

companies.name: Venirauto
companies.description: Venirauto Industrias C.A. is an automobile manufacturing company based in Venezuela. It produces vehicles within the country as part of the automotive industry.

companies.name: Empresas Polar
companies.description: Empresas Polar is a Venezuelan corporation founded in 1941 in Caracas, originally as a brewery known as La Polar. It is the largest brewery in Venezuela and has diversified into food processing and packaging, also serving markets abroad.

companies.name: Record Report
companies.description: Record Report is the official singles chart for Venezuela, established in 1990. It ranks songs based on airplay within the country, serving as a music industry chart.

companies.name: Monte Ávila Editores
companies.description: Monte Ávila Editores is the largest publishing house in Venezuela. Between 1980 and 2000, it published over 300 titles, mainly by Venezuelan authors, producing more than 1.2 million copies.

companies.name: Síragon
companies.description: Síragon, C.A. is a Venezuelan manufacturer and assembler of computer hardware and electronic products including digital cameras, tablets, computers, and LCD televisions. The company designs and manufactures its own RAM, flash memory, and printed circuit boards, with a plant located in Valencia, Venezuela.

companies.name: VIT, C.A.
companies.description: VIT, C.A. is a Venezuelan manufacturer of desktop computers and laptops, supported by the Venezuelan government and Chinese IT company Inspur. Their first computer was the Computador Bolivariano, which came with the Kubuntu Linux operating system.

companies.name: SIDOR
companies.description: Siderúrgica de Orinoco "Alfredo Maneiro" SIDOR C.A. is the largest steel corporation in Venezuela. It is located in an industrial zone in Ciudad Guayana, Bolívar State, near the Orinoco River. SIDOR is a key player in the Venezuelan iron and steel industry.

companies.name: Sivensa
companies.description: Sivensa is the second largest steel producer in Venezuela and the largest in the private sector as of 2008. Founded in 1948, it operates in the Venezuelan iron and steel industry. SIDOR, which was nationalized in 2008, is the largest steel producer overall in the country.

companies.name: Inter
companies.description: Inter is a Venezuelan television broadcaster and telecommunications provider headquartered in Barquisimeto, Lara. Founded in 1996 as InterCable, its fiscal name is Corporacion Telemic C.A. The main shareholder of Inter is the investment fund HM Capital Partners.

companies.name: Great Mission Housing Venezuela
companies.description: Great Mission Housing Venezuela is a government program launched in 2011 to provide housing for people living in precarious conditions. It is part of the Bolivarian missions and has delivered millions of houses since its inception. The program is a key social housing initiative in Venezuela.

companies.name: Ediciones Ekare
companies.description: Ediciones Ekare is a Venezuelan children's book publisher based in Caracas. Founded in 1978, it aims to publish books reflecting Venezuelan and Latin American culture. The publisher's catalog includes original works and translations, supporting reading promotion through the Banco del Libro organization.

companies.name: CANTV
companies.description: CANTV is the state-run telephone and internet service provider in Venezuela. Founded in 1930, it was privatized in 1991 and re-nationalized in 2007. It is the largest telecommunications provider in the country.

companies.name: Digitel
companies.description: Digitel is a Venezuelan mobile phone company known for being the first to deploy a GSM network and establish per second charging. As of early 2007, it had over 3 million subscribers and ranks third behind Movilnet and Movistar in the country.

companies.name: Alcasa
companies.description: C.V.G. Aluminio del Caroní S.A., known as Alcasa, is a state-owned aluminium producer in Venezuela. Founded in 1960 and operational since 1967, it is part of the Corporación Venezolana de Guayana and one of the world's largest aluminium producers.

companies.name: Empresas 1BC
companies.description: Empresas 1BC is a privately owned Venezuelan media corporation headquartered in Caracas. It operates various media enterprises including Radio Caracas Televisión and Radio Caracas Radio. The conglomerate is headed by Marcel Granier.

companies.name: Regional Brewery
companies.description: Cervecería Regional C.A. is a Venezuelan brewery founded in 1929 with headquarters in Maracaibo, Zulia. It produces beer and malt-based beverages and is considered the oldest and most traditional brewery in Venezuela.

companies.name: Mercantil Bank
companies.description: Mercantil Banco is a financial institution based in Venezuela with over 100 years of banking activity. It operates as a subsidiary of Mercantil Servicios Financieros. The bank has a long-standing presence in the Venezuelan financial sector.

companies.name: De Surinaamsche Bank
companies.description: De Surinaamsche Bank is the largest bank in Suriname, providing retail banking products such as transaction accounts, loans, mortgages, and credit and debit cards. It also offers business loans. The bank plays a key role in Suriname's financial industry.

companies.name: Telesur
companies.description: Telesur is the government-owned telecommunications service provider in Suriname. It offers telephone, internet, and wireless services including CDMA, GSM, UMTS, HSPA+, and LTE networks. Telesur operates multiple frequency bands such as 900/1800 MHz GSM and 2100 MHz HSDPA.

companies.name: Blue Wing Airlines
companies.description: Blue Wing Airlines is a Surinamese airline headquartered at Zorg en Hoop Airport in Paramaribo. It operates charter and scheduled flights to destinations in Suriname's interior, Guyana, Brazil, Venezuela, and the Caribbean. The airline has been banned from operating in the European Union due to safety violations.

companies.name: Surinam Airways
companies.description: Surinam Airways, also known as SLM, is the flag carrier airline of Suriname based in Paramaribo. It operates regional and long-haul scheduled passenger services with its hub at Johan Adolf Pengel International Airport. The airline is wholly owned by the Government of Suriname.

companies.name: Caricom Airways
companies.description: Caricom Airways was a regional airline headquartered in Paramaribo, Suriname. It primarily operated charter flights from Zorg en Hoop Airport to destinations within Suriname's interior, the Caribbean, and northern Brazil. The airline served regional travel needs before ceasing operations.

companies.name: Fly All Ways
companies.description: Fly All Ways is a regional airline based in Paramaribo, Suriname, which began operations in January 2016. It offers commercial and charter flights to destinations including São Luís in Brazil, Barbados, Curaçao, Sint Maarten, and Guyana. The airline plans to expand service across the Caribbean and South America.

companies.name: Bolsa de Valores de Asunción
