companies.description: The Bolsa de Valores de Asunción (BVA) is a stock exchange located in Asunción, the capital city of Paraguay. It serves as a financial market platform within Paraguay. The exchange facilitates securities trading in the country.

companies.name: Petróleos Paraguayos
companies.description: Petróleos Paraguayos is the national oil company of Paraguay. It owns the Villa Elisa Refinery, the country's only refinery, along with a LNG plant, a biodiesel plant, and several storage facilities. The refinery is located in Villa Elisa and has a capacity of 7,500 barrels.

companies.name: Banco Itaú Paraguay S.A.
companies.description: Banco Itaú Paraguay S.A. is a financial institution in Paraguay founded in 1978 as Interbanco SA. It was acquired by Unibanco Group in 1995 and renamed Banco Itaú Paraguay S.A. in 2010 after a merger. It is considered the largest bank in Paraguay and appointed its first Paraguayan CEO in 2020.

companies.name: LATAM Airlines Paraguay
companies.description: LATAM Airlines Paraguay, officially Transportes Aéreos del Mercosur S.A., is the flag carrier and national airline of Paraguay. It is headquartered in Asunción and operates flights from Silvio Pettirossi International Airport. The airline is a subsidiary of the Chilean LATAM Airlines Group.

companies.name: Roraima Airways
companies.description: Roraima Airways is a regional airline based in Guyana with its main hub at Eugene F. Correia International Airport. Founded in 1992, the airline is named after Mount Roraima. It provides regional air services within Guyana.

companies.name: Trans Guyana Airways
companies.description: Trans Guyana Airways Limited is a Guyanese airline that began operations in 1956 in Georgetown with a single float airplane. It has since expanded its fleet to provide domestic and regional transportation, including service to remote areas of Guyana.

companies.name: Ecua-Andino Hats
companies.description: Ecua-Andino Hats is an Ecuadorian company that produces and exports Panama hats. It was founded in 1985 by Alejandro Lecaro and Édgar Sánchez. The company specializes in fashion accessories from Ecuador.

companies.name: Pichincha Bank
companies.description: Banco Pichincha is the largest private-sector bank in Ecuador by capitalization and number of depositors. It is the main bank of the Pichincha Group, which includes related companies such as Diners Club of Ecuador and Teleamazonas. The group is associated with Fidel Egas Grijalva and his family.

companies.name: EP Petroecuador
companies.description: EP Petroecuador is the national oil company of Ecuador and a significant part of the country's economy. Ecuador is a member of OPEC and produced 531,000 barrels of crude oil per day in 2019. The company is involved in producing refined petroleum products and the government relies heavily on energy sector revenues.

companies.name: Avianca Ecuador
companies.description: Avianca Ecuador S.A. is an airline based in Quito, Ecuador. It operates passenger and cargo flights within Ecuador, including routes to the Galápagos Islands, and international flights to Colombia. It is part of the Avianca Group of Latin American airlines.

companies.name: LATAM Airlines Ecuador
companies.description: LATAM Airlines Ecuador is a subsidiary of LATAM Airlines Group of Chile, based in Quito, Ecuador. It is owned by Translloyd (55%) and LATAM Airlines (45%). The company operates in the airline industry within Ecuador.

companies.name: SAEREO
companies.description: SAEREO was a regional airline based in Quito, Ecuador. It operated charter and domestic passenger services, as well as medivac flights. The airline served the Ecuadorian market before ceasing operations.

companies.name: DHL Ecuador
companies.description: DHL Ecuador (TransAm) Ltda. was a cargo airline based in Guayaquil, Ecuador, established in 1991. It was wholly owned by Deutsche Post and served the DHL logistics network in Ecuador. The airline suspended operations on July 14, 2025, and was replaced by DHL Aero Expreso.

companies.name: Línea Aérea Cuencana
companies.description: Línea Aérea Cuencana (LAC) was a regional airline based in Cuenca, Ecuador. The airline ceased all operations in 2018. It operated within the Ecuadorian airline industry.

companies.name: AV Villas Bank
companies.description: Banco AV Villas is a medium-range Colombian bank and one of the four banks forming Grupo Aval. It operates in the financial sector in Colombia.

companies.name: Banco de Occidente
companies.description: Banco de Occidente is one of the largest banks in Colombia and part of the Grupo Aval financial conglomerate. It is owned by Luis Carlos Sarmiento Angulo, a prominent Colombian financier.

companies.name: COLTEL
companies.description: Telefónica Colombia is the largest telecommunications company in Colombia, established in 1947 by Mariano Ospina Pérez. It is owned by the Spanish company Telefónica and the Colombian government, which holds a 32.5% stake. The company is headquartered in Bogotá.

companies.name: NTN24
companies.description: NTN24 is a Colombian cable television news channel owned and operated by RCN Televisión. It operates within the journalism and media sector in Colombia.

companies.name: Cable Noticias
companies.description: Cable Noticias is a Colombian 24-hour cable television news channel owned by Global Media, based in Medellín. Alberto Federico Ravell purchased the channel in 2011, and it operates out of Bogotá, Colombia.

Servicios Postales Nacionales operates Colombia's official postal service under the name 4-72. It took over operations from the liquidated Adpostal in 2006 and provides national and international mail, express courier, and postal payment services. The company is associated with the Ministry of Information Technologies and Communications.

companies.name: Grupo Argos
companies.description: Grupo Argos S.A is a Colombian conglomerate with significant investments in cement and energy. Its cement operations span Colombia, the United States, Panama, Honduras, and the Caribbean. The company also invests in port facilities and real estate within Colombia.

companies.name: Grupo Aval
companies.description: Grupo Aval is a Colombian holding company involved in financial activities including banking, telecommunications, and real estate across Colombia and Central America. It is controlled by Luis Carlos Sarmiento, who owns about 80 percent of its shares.

companies.name: Davivienda
companies.description: Davivienda is a Colombian bank founded in 1972 that serves individuals, companies, and the rural sector. It is part of Grupo Bolivar and ranks as the second-largest bank in Colombia by assets and profits.

companies.name: Odinsa
companies.description: Odinsa S.A is a Colombian publicly traded company specializing in construction and infrastructure development, including roads, airports, and railways. It operates in Colombia and the Caribbean, and also develops real estate projects through its subsidiary Odinsa Holding Inc.

companies.name: Tía SA
companies.description: Tiendas Industriales Asociadas S.A., known as Tía, is a South American retail brand founded in 1940. Its divisions in Ecuador and Uruguay operate under several brands and are the largest discount retailers there. The Colombian Tía operations closed in 2017 due to poor sales.

companies.name: Bavaria Brewery
companies.description: Bavaria Brewery, founded in 1889 by German immigrant Leo S. Kopp, is a Colombian brewery company. It became a subsidiary of SABMiller in 2005 and was the second-largest brewery in South America before the merger.

companies.name: Sofasa
companies.description: Sociedad de Fabricación de Automotores (SOFASA) is a Colombian company assembling imported Renault vehicles and formerly Toyota and Daihatsu models. It was the first to produce the Renault Logan in the Americas and exports to the Andean Community while supplying Colombia's national market.

companies.name: Auteco
companies.description: Auteco is a Colombian manufacturer of motor vehicles and was the first motorcycle assembler in the country.

companies.name: Busscar de Colombia
companies.description: Busscar de Colombia is a Colombian bus manufacturer headquartered in Pereira, Risaralda. It was a subsidiary of a parent company based in Joinville, Brazil.

companies.name: Indumil
companies.description: INDUMIL is a Colombian military weapons manufacturer operated by the Colombian government. It specializes in producing arms and is based in Colombia.

companies.name: COTECMAR
companies.description: COTECMAR is a Colombian state-owned defense, shipbuilding, and engineering company. It serves the Ministry of National Defense of Colombia and other customers, operating major facilities in Cartagena de Indias.

companies.name: Crepes & Waffles
companies.description: Crepes & Waffles is the third largest restaurant chain in Colombia. It was founded by university students working on a project and operates in the gastronomy sector.

companies.name: Alpina Productos Alimenticios
companies.description: Alpina Productos Alimenticios is a Colombian dairy, food, and beverage company founded in 1945 and based in Bogotá. It operates in Colombia and the United States, producing a variety of dairy and food products.

companies.name: Postobón
companies.description: Postobón is the largest beverage company in Colombia and one of the largest in South America. It offers a wide range of products including soft drinks, fruit juices, bottled water, tea, energy drinks, and coffee.

companies.name: National-Report
companies.description: National-Report is a Colombian company that tracks music singles popularity charts based on radio play. It monitors data in Colombia, Venezuela, and Ecuador, providing weekly chart rankings.

companies.name: Escobar Inc
companies.description: Escobar Inc is a company registered in Puerto Rico associated with scams involving branded smartphones and flamethrowers. It was established in 2015 and linked to Roberto de Jesús Escobar Gaviria.

companies.name: Terpel
companies.description: Terpel is a Colombian oil and gas company formerly known as Organización Terpel S.A. It operates in the petroleum industry within Colombia.

companies.name: Grupo Sura
companies.description: Grupo de Inversiones Suramericana is a multilatin financial services company founded in 1945 in Colombia. It is listed on the Colombia Stock Exchange and included in the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices.

companies.name: Colombia Móvil
companies.description: Colombia Móvil S.A., marketed as Tigo, is the third largest mobile phone company in Colombia headquartered in Bogotá. It provides telecommunications services nationally and internationally under the Tigo and Orbitel brands.

companies.name: Avianca
companies.description: Avianca S.A. is the largest airline in Colombia and the second largest in South America. Headquartered in Bogotá with its registered office in Barranquilla, it operates a vast network of destinations in the Americas. Avianca has been the flag carrier of Colombia since 1919 and uses a codesharing system among its group of airlines.

companies.name: Aeroasis
companies.description: AerOasis was a startup airline based at El Dorado International Airport in Colombia. It operated in the airline industry with a focus on passenger air transport. The company was headquartered at one of Colombia's main international airports.

companies.name: Central Charter de Colombia
companies.description: Central Aerospace is a Colombian charter airline and aerospace services company based at El Dorado International Airport in Bogotá. It provides both air transport and aerospace-related services. The company operates within Colombia's aviation sector.

companies.name: Helicol
companies.description: Helicol S.A.S. is a helicopter operator based at El Dorado International Airport in Bogotá, Colombia. It specializes in helicopter services within the aviation industry. The company is located at a major Colombian international airport.

companies.name: SADELCA
companies.description: SADELCA Ltda. is a cargo airline based at El Dorado International Airport in Bogotá, Colombia. It focuses on air cargo transport services. The company operates from one of Colombia's principal airports.

companies.name: SARPA
companies.description: SARPA S.A.S. is an air charter and air ambulance operator with its main base at El Dorado International Airport in Bogotá and an auxiliary base in Medellín. It provides specialized air transport services in Colombia. The company operates in the aviation sector.

companies.name: Viva Air Colombia
companies.description: Fast Colombia S.A.S., trading as Viva Air Colombia, was a Colombian ultra low-cost airline based in Rionegro, Antioquia. It was a subsidiary of Irelandia Aviation and was the third largest airline in Colombia before ceasing operations in 2023. The airline had a codeshare agreement with Mexico's Viva Aerobus.

companies.name: Wingo
companies.description: AeroRepública, S. A., trading as Wingo, is a low-cost airline owned by Copa Holdings. It was created in 2016 to replace most of Copa Airlines Colombia's business. The company appointed Carolina Cortizo as managing director in 2019.

companies.name: AerCaribe
companies.description: AerCaribe S.A. is a Colombia-based carrier operating domestic and Americas-wide executive, charter, and cargo services, including specialized fuel and military transport. It is based at El Dorado International Airport in Bogotá with a secondary base in Lima. The company operates a fleet of turboprop and jet aircraft.

companies.name: Unitel
companies.description: UNITEL is a Bolivian commercial television network headquartered in Santa Cruz de la Sierra, La Paz, and Cochabamba. Founded in 1997 from the association of several stations, it broadcasts sports, entertainment, political, and news programs nationwide. It is owned by businessman Osvaldo Monasterio Nieme.

companies.name: Corporación Minera de Bolivia
companies.description: The Mining Corporation of Bolivia is a state-owned enterprise managing national mining operations. Established in 1952, it was the largest state company after the Bolivian National Revolution. After inactivity during the 1980s, it was reactivated in 2006 and remains important in Bolivia's economy.

companies.name: National Bank of Bolivia
companies.description: Banco Nacional de Bolivia S.A. (BNB) is a Bolivian bank and financial institution headquartered in Sucre, Bolivia. Founded in 1871, it is one of Bolivia's oldest banks and the country's second largest bank by total assets.

companies.name: Banco Union
companies.description: Banco Unión S.A. is a Bolivian state bank based in La Paz. Founded on November 5, 1981, it is one of the country's main financial institutions.

companies.name: Entel Bolivia
companies.description: Entel S.A. is a major Bolivian state-owned telecommunications company headquartered in La Paz, Bolivia.

companies.name: Viva (Bolivia)
companies.description: Empresa de Telecomunicaciones Nuevatel PCS de Bolivia S.A., known as VIVA, is a Bolivian wireless network operator and telecommunications company founded in 1999. It is among the largest companies in Bolivia and the third-largest wireless carrier with a 12.9% market share.

companies.name: YPFB
companies.description: Yacimientos Petrolíferos Fiscales Bolivianos (YPFB) is a Bolivian state-owned enterprise focused on oil and natural gas exploration, refining, distribution, and commercialization. Created in 1936, it is one of the biggest corporations in Bolivia.

companies.name: Bolivian Red Cross
companies.description: The Bolivian Red Cross is the national Red Cross society for Bolivia, affiliated with the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies. It was founded in La Paz by Juan Manuel Balcázar on May 15, 1917.

companies.name: Línea Aérea Amaszonas
companies.description: Línea Aérea Amaszonas S.A., later known as Amas Bolivia, was a regional airline based in Bolivia with headquarters in Santa Cruz de la Sierra and an administrative center in La Paz. It operated short-haul passenger flights within Bolivia and to neighboring countries, with its hub at El Alto International Airport.

companies.name: Aerocon
companies.description: Aero Comercial Oriente Norte Ltda., operating as Aerocon, was a Bolivian airline with its national office located in Hangar 93 at El Trompillo Airport in Santa Cruz de la Sierra.

companies.name: EcoJet
companies.description: Línea Aérea EcoJet S.A. is a Bolivian domestic airline headquartered in Santa Cruz de la Sierra. It began scheduled passenger operations in 2013, linking Cochabamba with nine major domestic destinations and competing with the state-owned Boliviana de Aviación.

companies.name: Republic Bank
companies.logo_file: Logo of Republic Bank of Trinidad and Tobago.svg
companies.description: Republic Bank Limited is a Caribbean financial institution headquartered in Trinidad and Tobago with operations across multiple Caribbean countries and Ghana. It was formerly a division of Barclays Bank in Trinidad and Tobago.

companies.name: House of Angostura
companies.industry: distilling, rectifying and blending of spirits
companies.description: The House of Angostura, also known as Angostura Limited, is a Trinidad and Tobago company known for producing Angostura bitters and is the major rum producer in the country. It has expanded internationally through acquisitions in the US, Canada, The Bahamas, and Suriname. The company is part of CL Financial's international expansion strategy.

companies.name: Caribbean Airlines
companies.description: Caribbean Airlines Limited is the state-owned flag carrier of Trinidad and Tobago and Jamaica, headquartered in Piarco. It operates flights across the Caribbean, North America, and South America from its base at Piarco International Airport. It is the largest airline in the Caribbean by employment.

companies.name: Tobago Express
companies.description: Tobago Express was a scheduled passenger airline based in Trinidad and Tobago, operating as a sister airline to BWIA West Indies Airways. It provided service between Tobago's Arthur Napoleon Raymond Robinson International Airport and Trinidad's Piarco International Airport.

companies.name: Carib Brewery
companies.description: The Carib Brewery Limited is a Trinidad and Tobago-based company producing Carib and Stag beers along with shandy products. Its main brewery is in Champs Fleurs, Trinidad, with additional breweries in Saint Kitts and Nevis, Grenada, and a US affiliate in Florida.

companies.name: Jamaica Red Cross
companies.description: The Jamaica Red Cross Society is a humanitarian aid agency operating in Jamaica. It provides emergency and relief services within the country.

companies.name: Desnoes & Geddes
companies.description: Desnoes and Geddes Limited is a Jamaican brewer and beverage producer best known for Red Stripe lager. Founded in 1918, it started by producing soft drinks and distributing imported alcohol before opening the Surrey Brewery in Kingston.

companies.name: International AirLink
companies.description: AirLink Express is a Jamaican air charter airline based at Sir Donald Sangster International Airport in Montego Bay. It offers charter and scheduled services to all airports in Jamaica and operates aircraft including the Cessna 208B Grand Caravan.

companies.name: Sandals Resorts
companies.description: Sandals Resorts is a Jamaican operator of all-inclusive couples resorts in the Caribbean. Part of Sandals Resorts International, it was founded in 1981 and is based in Montego Bay, managing development, service standards, and operations of its resorts.

companies.name: Banred
companies.description: Banred is a network of automated teller machines in Uruguay with over 330 locations. It was formed by the merger of two separate ATM networks, RedBanc and Bancomat, in 2005.

companies.name: Banco Hipotecario del Uruguay
companies.description: The Mortgage Bank of Uruguay is a state-owned bank in Uruguay. It provides financial services related to mortgages within the country.

companies.name: HSBC_Bank Uruguay
companies.description: HSBC Bank Uruguay S.A. was the principal HSBC operating company in Uruguay. It provided a full range of banking and financial products and services, including commercial, consumer, and corporate banking. As of 2025, it was the fifth-largest bank in Uruguay.

companies.name: Effa Motors
companies.description: Effa Motors is a Uruguayan automobile and commercial vehicle manufacturer headquartered in San José de Mayo. Founded in 2006 by Eduardo Effa, it constructs vehicles imported as CKD kits. Effa Motors is a subsidiary of the Aler Group.

companies.name: BBVA Uruguay
companies.description: BBVA Uruguay is a financial institution and subsidiary of the Spanish bank Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria. It underwent several mergers throughout the 20th century before being acquired by BBVA in 2000. It operates in Uruguay's financial sector.

companies.name: ANCAP
companies.description: ANCAP is a state-owned company in Uruguay created in 1931. It holds the monopoly on national alcohol, fuel, and portland cement, and operates the only oil refinery in Uruguay located in La Teja. ANCAP imports, refines, and sells petroleum derivatives.

companies.name: Obras Sanitarias del Estado
companies.description: The National Administration of State Sanitary Works (OSE) is the state-owned water utilities company in Uruguay. It is responsible for water supply services across the country.

companies.name: Cinemateca Uruguaya
companies.description: Cinemateca Uruguaya is a non-profit cinematheque based in Montevideo, Uruguay, established in 1952. It supports the cultural development of cinema and art, and is a member of international film archive organizations.

companies.name: State Railways Administration of Uruguay
companies.description: The State Railways Administration of Uruguay (AFE) is an autonomous agency responsible for rail transport and maintenance of railways in Uruguay. It manages the country's rail infrastructure and services.

companies.name: Uruguay Northern Railway
companies.description: The Uruguay Northern Railway was one of the five original rail systems in Uruguay. Registered in London in 1887, it was part of the early development of the country's rail infrastructure.

companies.name: Cámara Uruguaya de Productores de Fonogramas y Videogramas
companies.wiki: Cámara Uruguaya de Productores de Fonogramas y Videogramas
companies.description: Cámara Uruguaya de Productores de Fonogramas y Videogramas, also known as Cámara Uruguaya del Disco, is a non-profit organization established in 1960. It administers the economic rights of Uruguayan phonographic producers and is linked to the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry.

companies.name: Air Class
companies.description: Air Class Líneas Aéreas is a cargo airline based in Montevideo, Uruguay. It operates freight and scheduled or charter passenger services, with its main base at Carrasco International Airport.

companies.name: Aeromás
companies.description: Aeromás is a cargo and private jet charter airline based at Carrasco International Airport in Montevideo, Uruguay. It operates in the commercial air transport market primarily in Uruguay and Mercosur. The company began commercial aviation activities in 1983 with banner towing and expanded to passenger and cargo air transport in 1988.

companies.name: Amaszonas Uruguay
companies.description: Amaszonas Uruguay was the flag carrier airline of Uruguay, operating commercial passenger services from hubs at Carrasco International Airport and Laguna del Sauce International Airport. It served major South American destinations and several secondary locations in the Southern Cone.

companies.name: BAC Credomatic
companies.description: BAC Credomatic is a financial group operating in Central America with presence in Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Panama, Grand Cayman, The Bahamas, and the United States. It provides financial services across these regions.

companies.name: Tigo Guatemala
companies.description: TIGO, Comunicaciones Celulares, S.A., also known as COMCEL, is a mobile phone service provider in Guatemala owned by the international company Millicom. In 2004, COMCEL rebranded to TIGO, introducing GSM technology, new phones, expanded coverage, and new plans.

companies.name: Avianca Guatemala
companies.description: Aviateca S.A., branded Avianca Guatemala, is a regional airline headquartered in Guatemala City and serves as the flag carrier of Guatemala. It was government-owned until 1989, then privatized and joined the Grupo TACA alliance, later merging with Avianca.

companies.name: DHL de Guatemala
companies.description: DHL de Guatemala S.A. is a cargo airline based in Guatemala City, wholly owned by Deutsche Post. It operates services for the DHL-branded logistics network in Guatemala with its main base at La Aurora International Airport.

companies.name: ARM Aviación
companies.description: ARM Aviación is a private charter airline based in Zone 13, Guatemala City, Guatemala. Its main hub is La Aurora International Airport.

companies.name: FxPro
companies.description: FxPro is a London-based global online brokerage offering contracts for difference in forex, stocks, futures, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and precious metals. It has offices in London, Cyprus, UAE, and The Bahamas and serves over two million clients worldwide.

companies.name: Bahamasair
companies.description: Bahamasair Holdings Limited, operating as Bahamasair, is the flag carrier airline of The Bahamas headquartered in Nassau. It operates scheduled services to 32 domestic and regional destinations in the Caribbean and the United States from its base at Lynden Pindling International Airport.

companies.name: SkyBahamas
companies.description: Sky Bahamas was an airline based in Nassau, Bahamas. The summary does not provide further details about its operations or status.

companies.name: Southern Air Charter
companies.description: Southern Air Charter is an airline and air charter company operating in the Bahamas. It mainly provides air charter services but also offers some scheduled inter-island flights within the Bahamas. The company is based in the Bahamas.

companies.name: Aviatsa
companies.description: Aviatsa S.A. de C.V. is a Honduran charter airline established in 2015 after receiving certification from Honduran Aviation Authorities. In early 2024, it announced plans to open a commercial route between Havana, Cuba and San Pedro Sula, Honduras. The airline is based in Honduras.

companies.name: Rosario Mining Company
companies.description: The New York and Honduras Rosario Mining Company was an American-owned corporation operating the Rosario mine, which produced gold and silver in central Honduras and Nicaragua. It was involved in mining activities in Honduras.

companies.name: Lacthosa
companies.description: Lacthosa is a Honduran company producing food and beverage products, with a focus on dairy and fruit juices. It is the leading dairy producer in Honduras. The company is based in Honduras.

companies.name: Banco de Occidente
companies.description: Banco de Occidente is a commercial bank headquartered in Santa Rosa de Copan, Honduras. It operates 170 branches nationwide, providing banking services across the country.

companies.name: Honduran Red Cross
companies.description: The Honduran Red Cross is a non-profit social and voluntary organization providing aid to at-risk populations and disaster victims. It is part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. The organization operates in Honduras.

companies.name: Hondutel
companies.description: Hondutel is the telecommunications company owned by the Honduras government. It holds a monopoly on international calls in Honduras.

companies.name: Aerolíneas Sosa
companies.description: Aerolíneas Sosa S.A. de C.V. is an airline based in La Ceiba, Honduras, established in 1976. It operates domestic scheduled flights to four destinations and offers charter services, with its main hub at Golosón International Airport.

companies.name: Avianca Honduras
companies.description: Avianca Honduras, branded by Isleña de Inversiones S.A. de C.V., is a regional airline based in San Pedro Sula, Honduras. It operates scheduled and charter passenger flights from Ramón Villeda Morales International Airport and is part of the Avianca Group.

companies.name: EasySky
companies.description: EasySky was a low-cost airline based in Honduras with its head office in Tegucigalpa. Since 2015, its main operational base was Toncontín International Airport in Tegucigalpa.

companies.name: Central Romana
companies.description: Central Romana Corporation, Ltd. is an agro-industrial and tourism company based in the Dominican Republic. It operates in agriculture and tourism sectors within the country.

companies.name: Corporación Estatal de Radio y Televisión
companies.wiki: Corporación Estatal de Radio y Televisión
companies.description: Corporación Estatal de Radio y Televisión is a public radio and television network operating from Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic. It is owned by the Dominican government and broadcasts nationwide on channel 4.

companies.name: Claro República Dominicana
companies.description: Claro Dominicana, known as Claro, is the largest telecommunications company in the Dominican Republic. It provides local, long-distance, wireless voice, Internet, and IPTV services to millions of customers.

companies.name: Altice Dominicana
companies.description: Altice Dominicana, operating as Altice, is the second largest landline service provider in the Dominican Republic. It offers HDTV cable TV, landline, wireless voice services, and high-speed internet as part of the French Netherlands-based Altice group.

companies.name: Caribair
companies.description: Caribair was an airline based in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic. It operated scheduled services within the Dominican Republic and Haiti, as well as charter and air taxi flights throughout the Caribbean.

companies.name: Aeronaves Dominicanas
companies.description: Volo Airways Dominicana is a charter airline with facilities at Las Americas International Airport and offices in Santo Domingo. Founded in 1980, it is the longest-lived airline in the Dominican Republic and underwent ownership changes in 2023/2024.

companies.name: Air Century
companies.description: ACSA - Air Century, S.A. is a Dominican airline operating charter and scheduled services from La Isabela International Airport. Founded by Captain Omar Chahin, it began operations in 1992 and is the longest-running active Dominican airline.

companies.name: Servicios Aéreos Profesionales
companies.description: Servicios Aéreos Profesionales, S.A. (SAP) was a charter airline headquartered and based at La Isabela International Airport in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic.

companies.name: Arajet
companies.description: Arajet, S.A., trading as Arajet, is the flag carrier and largest airline of the Dominican Republic headquartered in Santo Domingo. It offers low-cost flights across North America, the Caribbean, Central America, and South America, starting operations in September 2022.

companies.name: SKYhigh Dominicana
companies.description: Sky High Aviation Services S.A., operating as SKYhigh Dominicana, is an airline based in the Dominican Republic. It operates scheduled flights within the Caribbean region.

companies.name: EFG Holding
companies.description: EFG Holding S.A.E. is an Egyptian financial services company operating in the Middle East, North Africa, Sub-Saharan Africa, and South Asia. It specializes in securities brokerage, asset management, investment banking, private equity, and other financial services. The company serves a diverse client base including sovereign wealth funds and high-net-worth individuals.

companies.name: Egyptian Television Network
companies.description: The Egyptian Television Network is a television service run by the National Media Authority in Egypt. It began programming on 21 July 1960 and currently operates more than fifteen national channels along with several satellite broadcast channels.

companies.name: Sono Cairo
companies.description: Sono Cairo is a multimedia company owned by the Egyptian government. It operates within Egypt's mass media industry.

companies.name: Nile News
companies.description: Nile News is an Egyptian state-funded Arabic-language news television network headquartered in 6 October, Giza. Founded in 1998 as a 24-hour news network, it gained popularity in the Arab world for its journalistic professionalism.

companies.name: Salah Zulfikar Films Company
companies.description: Salah Zulfikar Films Company is a film production company established in 1962 in Cairo, Egypt. It operated in the Middle East and North Africa from 1962 until 1978.

companies.name: Tarek Nour Communications
companies.description: Tarek Nour Communications is a global marketing and communications company headquartered in Giza, Egypt. It is recognized as one of the largest advertising agencies in the Middle East.

companies.name: Manufacturing Commercial Vehicles
companies.description: Manufacturing Commercial Vehicles (MCV) is an Egyptian manufacturer of buses and trucks. Its manufacturing plant is located in El Salheya El Gedida, with the head office in Obour City near Cairo. The company owns trademark rights for brands including ECHOLINE and MCV.

companies.name: GB Corp
companies.description: GB Corp, formerly Ghabbour Group, is an Egyptian manufacturer of automobiles, buses, trucks, and motorcycles. The company is located in Cairo and operates within the automotive industry.

companies.name: Egyptian German Automotive Company
companies.description: The Egyptian German Automotive Company (EGA) is an Egyptian car assembler located in 6th of October City, Cairo. Founded in 1996 as a joint venture to assemble Mercedes-Benz vehicles, it is managed by Daimler AG.

companies.name: MCV Bus and Coach
companies.description: MCV Bus and Coach is an Egyptian manufacturer of bus bodies founded in 2002. The company was established when Manufacturing Commercial Vehicles acquired some design rights from the defunct English bus builder Marshall Bus. It operates in the automotive industry in Egypt.

companies.name: African Export-Import Bank
companies.description: African Export–Import Bank, also known as Afreximbank, is a pan-African supranational multilateral financial institution created in 1993 under the African Development Bank. It is headquartered in Cairo, Egypt, and was officially launched at its first general meeting in Abuja, Nigeria.

companies.name: Housing and Development Bank
companies.description: The Housing and Development Bank is a major Egyptian bank traded on the Egyptian Exchange. It operates within Egypt's financial services sector and is recognized by its Reuters code HDBK.CA.

companies.name: Suez Canal Bank
companies.description: Suez Canal Bank is a major Egyptian bank headquartered in Cairo. It provides financial services to individual and corporate clients in Egypt and has a branch in Tripoli, Libya.

companies.name: Credit Agricole - Egypt Bank (S.A.E.)
companies.description: Crédit Agricole Egypt is a medium-sized Egyptian bank and subsidiary of Crédit Agricole. It offers financial services to individuals, businesses, and the rural sector, operating approximately 86 branches and serving over 393,000 customers across Egypt.

companies.name: Cook Door
companies.description: Cook Door is a chain of fast food restaurants based in Cairo, Egypt. It is one of the country's notable fast food chains alongside Smiley's Grill and Mo'men.

companies.name: Sout El-Hob Records
companies.description: Sout El-Hob Records is an Egyptian record label founded in 1972 by Atef Montasser. It holds the fourth largest Arabic music catalog in the Middle East and North Africa and has distributed many movies domestically and internationally.

companies.name: City Centre Alexandria
companies.description: City Centre Alexandria is a shopping mall located in Alexandria, Egypt, opened in January 2003. Developed and managed by Majid Al Futtaim Properties, it houses over 160 retail stores including anchor tenants like Debenhams, Zara, Max, H&M, and a Carrefour Hypermarket.

companies.name: National Bank of Egypt
companies.description: National Bank of Egypt S.A.E. is a major Egyptian bank founded in June 1898. It is the country's largest bank by assets, deposits, loans, capital, branches, and employees, ranking among the big five banks in Egypt.

companies.name: Arab African International Bank
companies.description: Arab African International Bank (AAIB) is a major Egyptian bank and one of the big five banks in Egypt. It operates not only in Egypt but also has branches in the United Arab Emirates and Lebanon.

companies.name: Kyriazi freres
companies.description: Kyriazi Freres was a cigarette manufacturing company established in 1873 in Egypt. It was founded by Ioannis Kyriazis and his brothers, who all played active roles in the company. The company operated in the tobacco industry.

companies.name: Studio Misr
companies.description: Studio Misr is a major Egyptian film studio founded in 1935 by economist and industrialist Talaat Harb. It was the cinema project of Banque Misr, Egypt's first national bank, and is the oldest surviving film studio in Egypt and Africa. It is currently owned by the Egyptian Ministry of Culture.

companies.name: Al Arabia Cinema Production & Distribution
companies.description: Al Arabia Cinema Production & Distribution is an Egyptian film distribution and production company based in Cairo with an office in Dubai. Founded in 2000, it operates Renaissance Cinemas with 21 cinemas in Egypt and is part of the Mediterranean Distribution Network. The company has produced and distributed over 100 movies.

companies.name: New Century Production
companies.description: New Century Production is an Egyptian film production company established in 2004 by Walid Al Kurdi. It is a new production branch of Dollar Film, which was originally founded in 1949. The company operates in the film industry.

companies.name: Abu Zaabal Engineering Industries
companies.description: The Abu Zaabal Engineering Industries Company, also known as Military Factory 100, is an Egyptian government joint-stock company affiliated with the Ministry of Military Production. Established in 1974 and reopened in 1983, it is located in Abu Zaabal, Qalyubia Governorate, and produces artillery for the Egyptian Armed Forces.

companies.name: Abu Zaabal Specialized Industries
companies.description: The Abu Zaabal Specialized Industries Company, or Military Factory 300, is an Egyptian government joint-stock company affiliated with the Ministry of Military Production. Established in 2016 and located in Abu Zaabal, Qalyubia Governorate, it produces small and medium weapons and various types of ammunition.

companies.name: Juhayna Food Industries
companies.description: Juhayna Food Industries is an Egyptian food and beverage company established in 1983. It began producing dairy, yogurt, and juice products in 1987 and merged with Juhayna Dairy in 2004 to consolidate operations. The company specializes in milk, dairy products, and juices.

companies.name: Ezz Steel
companies.description: Ezz Steel is the largest steel company in Egypt, the Middle East, and North Africa. Headquartered in Cairo, it produces about 7 million metric tons of steel annually and operates four steel plants in Alexandria, Sadat City, Suez, and 10th of Ramadan City.

companies.name: Egyptian Media Production City
companies.description: Egyptian Media Production City Co SAE (EMPC) is an information and media complex located in 6th of October City, Giza Governorate, Egypt. It is listed on the Egyptian Exchange, with most shares owned by the Government of Egypt through the National Media Authority and other state-owned enterprises. The complex covers about 35 million square meters.

companies.name: Egyptian Commission for Rights and Freedoms
companies.wiki: Egyptian Commission for Rights and Freedoms
companies.description: The Egyptian Commission for Rights and Freedoms (ECRF) is a human rights organisation based in Cairo, Egypt. It reports on human rights abuses and coordinates campaigns for victims of torture and disappearance. The organisation operates despite continuous harassment by Egyptian authorities.

companies.name: Arab British Helicopter Company
companies.description: The Arab British Helicopter Company (ABHCO) is an Anglo-Italiano-Egyptian joint venture specializing in helicopter manufacturing. It operates in the aerospace industry.

companies.name: Institut Français d'Archéologie Orientale
companies.industry: Research and development in humanities and social sciences
companies.description: The Institut français d'archéologie orientale is a French research institute based in Cairo, Egypt. It focuses on archaeology, history, and languages of Egypt's various civilizational periods.

companies.name: Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation
companies.description: The Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation (EGPC) is Egypt's national oil company. Its operations include crude oil exploration, refining, storage, lubricant and grease production, and services for oil and gas projects.

companies.name: Egyptian Natural Gas Company
companies.description: Egyptian Natural Gas Company (GASCO) is a subsidiary of the Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company. Established in 1997, it operates natural gas transmission, distribution, and processing, managing a gas grid extending 22,000 kilometers and connected to neighboring countries via the Arab Gas Pipeline.

companies.name: Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company
companies.description: The Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company (EGAS) is a state-owned holding company in Egypt. Established in 2001, it owns and manages state stakes in gas projects and issues natural gas exploration licenses.

companies.name: Orascom Construction Industries
companies.description: Orascom Construction PLC is an engineering, procurement, and construction contractor based in Cairo, Egypt. It was Egypt's first multinational corporation and operates in more than 25 countries.

companies.name: Arab Contractors
companies.description: The Arab Contractors, known locally as Al Mokawloon Al Arab, is a regional construction and contracting company based in Egypt.

companies.name: Dar El Shorouk
companies.description: Dar El Shorouk is an Arabic publishing house based in Beirut and Cairo. It publishes books in politics, biographies, memoirs, history, philosophy, social sciences, religion, nationalist thought, art, and children's literature.

companies.name: AMC Airlines
companies.description: AMC Airlines is a charter airline based in Cairo, Egypt. It operates charter flights from Egypt's tourist destinations to Europe, the Middle East, and domestic locations. The airline also provides VIP and military transport services, with its main base at Cairo International Airport.

companies.name: EgyptAir
companies.description: EgyptAir is the state-owned flag carrier of Egypt headquartered at Cairo International Airport. It operates scheduled passenger and freight services to 84 international and nine domestic destinations across 56 countries. EgyptAir is a member of Star Alliance and the only carrier in the MENA region to belong to this alliance.

companies.name: Air Arabia Egypt
companies.description: Air Arabia Egypt is an Egyptian low-cost airline based in Alexandria and a subsidiary of Air Arabia. Its head office is located in Heliopolis, Cairo, Egypt. The airline focuses on providing affordable air travel options within the region.

companies.name: Nile Air
companies.description: Nile Air is an Egyptian airline based at Cairo International Airport operating scheduled services to destinations in Egypt, the Middle East, the Persian Gulf, Southern Europe, Asia, and Africa. It is the largest private airline in Egypt and the second largest overall. Nile Air operates a fleet of Airbus A320-200s and A321-200s.

companies.name: Petroleum Air Services
companies.description: Petroleum Air Services (PAS) is an airline based in Cairo, Egypt, providing helicopter services to support the oil industry. It also operates commercial passenger services within Egypt and regional cities. Its main base is Cairo International Airport.

companies.name: AlMasria Universal Airlines
companies.description: AlMasria Universal Airlines is a private Egyptian airline operating scheduled and charter services from Egypt. The name 'AlMasria' is derived from the Arabic word for 'Egyptian'.

companies.name: Cairo Aviation
companies.description: Cairo Aviation was a former charter airline based in Cairo, Egypt. It no longer operates.

companies.name: Air Cairo
companies.description: Air Cairo is an airline based in Cairo, Egypt, part owned by EgyptAir. It operates scheduled flights to the Middle East and Europe and charter flights to Egypt from Europe. Its bases include Cairo International Airport, Sharm El Sheikh International Airport, and Hurghada International Airport.

companies.name: EgyptAir Cargo
companies.description: Egyptair Cargo is the cargo division of EgyptAir, the Egyptian national airline. It operates using dedicated cargo aircraft and the cargo capacity of its sister passenger airline. Its main base is Cairo International Airport.

companies.name: Alexandria Airlines
companies.description: Alexandria Airlines is an Egyptian airline headquartered in Cairo. It provides air transport services within the region.

companies.name: Air Sinai
companies.description: Air Sinai was an airline based in Cairo, Egypt. It operated as a 'paper airline' for its parent company Egyptair, serving flights exclusively between Egypt and Israel under a wet lease-like agreement.

companies.name: Smart Aviation Company
companies.description: Smart Aviation Company is a corporate airline operator based in Egypt. It launched operations in 2007 from its base at Cairo International Airport.

companies.name: Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt
companies.description: Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt SAE is a major Egyptian shariah-compliant financial institution. Incorporated in 1977 and operating since 1979, it offers various commercial banking products and services in Egypt and internationally.

companies.name: Luxor Air
companies.description: Luxor Air was a privately owned charter airline based in Cairo, Egypt. It operated charter flights mainly to Europe from its main base at Cairo International Airport.

companies.name: QNB Egypt
companies.description: QNB Egypt, formerly known as QNB Al Ahli until 2024, is a major Egyptian bank and a local subsidiary of the Qatar National Bank Group. It is among the largest five banks in Egypt with approximately 2 million customers.

companies.name: Air Leisure
companies.description: Air Leisure was an Egyptian charter airline headquartered in Cairo and based at Cairo International Airport. It connected several Asian cities, mainly in China, with Egyptian leisure destinations.

companies.name: Agricultural Bank Of Egypt
companies.description: Agricultural Bank of Egypt (ABE) is a medium-sized public bank in Egypt. It specializes in agricultural banking within the country.

companies.name: Societe Arabe Internationale de Banque
companies.description: Societe Arabe Internationale de Banque, also known as Saib Bank, is a medium-sized Egyptian bank.

companies.name: Brasserie Nationale d'Haiti
companies.description: Brasserie Nationale d'Haïti, S.A. (BRANA) is a brewery and bottler in Haiti. It manufactures Prestige beer, an American-style lager produced in the Caribbean.

companies.name: Comme il faut
companies.wiki: Compagnie des Tabacs Comme Il Faut, S.A.
companies.description: Compagnie des Tabacs Comme Il Faut, S.A. is an international tobacco company based in Port-au-Prince, Haiti. Owned by Luckett, Inc., it is the only cigarette maker in Haiti with its Comme Il Faut and Point brands marketed locally.

companies.name: Unibank
companies.description: Unibank, S.A. is one of Haiti's two largest private commercial banks. Founded in 1993 by Haitian investors, it is the main company of Groupe Financier National (GFN). The bank opened its first office in downtown Port-au-Prince and had 51 branches across Haiti by the end of 2017.

companies.name: Balistrad
companies.description: Balistrad is a Haitian online newspaper founded in 2018 by Fincy Pierre. It publishes content in French and Haitian Creole and operates as an independent media company producing web content.

companies.name: Sunrise Airways
companies.description: Sunrise Airways S.A. is a Haitian regional airline established in 2010. It provides scheduled passenger and charter flights to nine domestic and international destinations and operates a fleet of ten aircraft as of January 2024.

companies.name: Grupo Poma
companies.description: Grupo Poma is a family-owned conglomerate based in El Salvador and one of the 50 largest companies in Central America. Led by Fernando Poma, its business activities include automobile dealerships, real estate development, industrial manufacturing, hotels, telecommunications investments, and non-profit organizations.

companies.name: Telecorporación Salvadoreña
companies.description: Telecorporación Salvadoreña (TCS) is a television network corporation in El Salvador comprising channels 2, 4, 6, and SV+. It operates both analog and digital broadcasts and shares some programming across its channels, using the network name when linked together.

companies.name: Bank of Costa Rica
companies.description: Banco de Costa Rica (BCR) is a state-owned commercial bank headquartered in San José, Costa Rica. Established in 1877 and nationalized in 1948, it is an autonomous state institution and one of the strongest banks in Costa Rica and Central America.

companies.name: Nature Air
companies.description: Nature Air was a regional airline headquartered in San José, Costa Rica, offering scheduled and charter services to destinations in Costa Rica, Panama, and Nicaragua. It claimed to be the world's first carbon neutral airline and ceased operations in January 2018 following a fatal accident.

companies.name: SANSA
companies.description: SANSA is a regional airline based in San José, Costa Rica. It operates scheduled passenger services as part of the former TACA Regional system and was a subsidiary of Avianca Holdings. Its main hub is Juan Santamaría International Airport.

companies.name: Ticos Air
companies.description: Ticos Air was a planned Costa Rican airline that never commenced operations.

companies.name: Avianca Costa Rica
companies.description: Avianca Costa Rica S.A., using the callsign LACSA, is the national airline of Costa Rica based in San José. It operates international scheduled services to over 35 destinations in the Americas and became part of the Avianca Group after the purchase of Grupo TACA in 2013.

companies.name: Volaris Costa Rica
companies.description: Vuela Aviacion S.A., operating as Volaris Costa Rica, is a low-cost airline based at Juan Santamaría International Airport in San José, Costa Rica. It is a subsidiary of the Mexican airline Volaris. The airline began operations in November 2016 with flights to Guatemala City.

companies.name: Florida Ice & Farm Co.
companies.description: Florida Ice and Farm Company S.A. is a Costa Rican food and beverages company headquartered in Heredia, Costa Rica. It offers a catalog of over 2000 products sold in more than 15 countries. The company operates in the beverage industry.

companies.name: Fonotica
companies.wiki: Asociación Costarricense de la Industria Fonográfica y Afines
companies.description: The Asociación Costarricense de la Industria Fonográfica y Afines (FONOTICA) is a non-profit trade group of multinational and national record companies in Costa Rica. It serves as the affiliate member of the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry (IFPI) in Costa Rica and acts as the national ISRC agency.

companies.name: Aeroperlas
companies.description: Aeroperlas was a regional airline based in Panama City, Panama. It was the third largest airline in the country and operated over 50 daily scheduled flights to 15 domestic destinations from its hubs. Aeroperlas was part of the Grupo TACA regional airlines system.

companies.name: DHL Aero Expreso
companies.description: DHL Aero Expreso S.A. is a cargo airline based in Panama City, Panama. Partly owned by the DHL Group, it operates DHL-branded parcel and express services in Central and South America. Its main base is Tocumen International Airport in Panama City.

companies.name: Air Panamá
companies.description: Air Panama is a regional airline based at Albrook "Marcos A. Gelabert" International Airport in Panama. It is the second-largest air carrier in the country and offers scheduled and charter passenger flights to more than 31 destinations from its hub.

companies.name: Air Nicaragua
companies.description: Air Nicaragua was a proposed airline intended to be the national flag carrier of Nicaragua. Its main base was planned to be Augusto C. Sandino International Airport. The airline was never established.

companies.name: La Costeña
companies.description: Aerotaxis La Costeña S.A. is a regional airline based in Managua, Nicaragua. It operates passenger services from Managua and Bluefields to three domestic destinations. Its main hubs are Augusto C. Sandino International Airport and Bluefields Airport.

companies.name: Orange Mali
companies.description: Ikatel was a telecommunications company in Mali affiliated with France Telecom. Since 2003, it was Mali's second mobile phone operator and was renamed Orange Mali on November 30, 2006.

companies.name: Sotelma
companies.description: Sotelma is a private telecommunications company based in Bamako, Mali. It provides local and international telephony, internet service, and mobile telephone service through its subsidiary Malitel. Sotelma is also the official registry of the .ml country code domain.

companies.name: Mali Development Bank
companies.description: Banque du Développement du Mali is a bank based in Mali. It operates within the banking sector in the country.

companies.name: Xuly Bët
companies.description: XULY.Bët is a luxury clothing line designed by Malian-Senegalese fashion designer Lamine Badian Kouyaté. It is a fashion brand associated with Mali.

companies.name: Mali Red Cross
companies.description: Mali Red Cross, founded in 1965 and headquartered in Bamako, provides aid related to armed conflict, nutrition, health, and food shortages. It is recognized by the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies as Mali's national society.

companies.name: Embassy of France, Bamako
companies.description: The Embassy of France in Bamako is France's diplomatic mission to Mali, located in the capital city. In 2022, the French ambassador was expelled by Mali for diplomatic reasons.

companies.name: Air Mali
companies.description: Air Mali was an airline based in Mali, formed in April 2005 by the Aga Khan Fund for Economic Development and the government of Mali. It operated in the aviation sector.

companies.name: Mali Airways
companies.description: Mali Airways was an airline founded in Mali in 2015. However, it never commenced operations.

companies.name: Banco Económico
companies.description: Banco Económico is an Angolan bank based in Luanda, renamed in 2015 after the bankruptcy of its Portuguese parent bank. It was formerly known as Banco Espírito Santo Angola and is a subsidiary of Espírito Santo Financial Group.

companies.name: Savings and Credit Bank
companies.description: Banco de Poupança e Crédito is a government-owned full-service bank in Angola with the largest branch network in the country, including a branch in Cabinda.

companies.name: Correios de Angola
companies.description: Empresa Nacional de Correios e Telégrafos de Angola, operating as Correios de Angola, is the state-owned company responsible for postal services in Angola.

companies.name: SODIAM
companies.description: Sociedade de Comercialização de Diamantes is Angola's national diamond trading company, partly owned by ENDIAMA. It markets diamonds from partnered mines and artisanal miners to national and international markets.

companies.name: Sociedade de Desenvolvimento Mineiro
companies.wiki: Sociedade de Desenvolvimento Mineiro de Angola
companies.description: Sociedade de Desenvolvimento Mineiro (SDM) is an Angolan public mining company holding mining rights in a 2,950 km2 concession in Lunda Norte Province. It is a joint venture between the Angolan public company Endiama and the Brazilian private company OMSI.

companies.name: Boavida Group
companies.description: Grupo Boavida is an Angolan business conglomerate headquartered in Luanda, founded in 1996. It started in engineering and civil construction and expanded into real estate, agribusiness, and project management, leading large-scale residential and commercial projects.

companies.name: Angola Telecom
companies.description: Angola Telecom is a telecommunications and Internet service provider wholly owned by the Angolan state. It operates as a public company serving Angola.

companies.name: Movicel
companies.description: Movicel Telecomunicações S.A. is the smaller of two Angolan mobile phone companies, originally created as a subsidiary of Angola Telecom. Since 2010, 80% of its capital is privately owned, with the remainder held by state-owned companies.

companies.name: Banco Angolano de Investimentos
companies.description: Banco Angolano de Investimentos (BAI) was the first private bank in Angola, founded in 1996. It operates as a full-service bank with a nationwide network of branches across all provinces.

companies.name: Multicaixa
companies.description: Multicaixa (MCX) is the only brand for debit cards issued in Angola and operates the sole interbank network of ATMs and point of sale terminals. The network is operated by EMIS and regulated by national laws governing payment systems.

companies.name: Edições Novembro
companies.description: Edições Novembro E.P. is the state-owned newspaper publishing company of Angola.

companies.name: Angola Red Cross
companies.logo_file: Emblem of the Angola Red Cross.svg
companies.description: The Angola Red Cross, founded in 1978, is a humanitarian organization with its headquarters in Luanda, Angola.

companies.name: Aeronáutica
companies.description: Aeronáutica was an airline based in Luanda, Angola, operating domestic chartered freight and passenger flights from Quatro de Fevereiro Airport.

companies.name: Angola Air Charter
companies.description: Angola Air Charter is a charter airline based in Luanda, Angola, operating cargo charters in Africa from Quatro de Fevereiro Airport. It is banned in EU airspace and other regions.

companies.name: SonAir
companies.description: SonAir Airline Services, S.A., commonly known as SonAir, is an Angolan airline established on 10 October 1979. It is a venture of the Angolan national petroleum company Sonangol Group.

companies.name: Heli Malongo Airways
companies.description: Heli Malongo Aviação e Serviços de Angola, Lda is an air charter operator based in Luanda, Angola. It provides onshore and offshore flights supporting the oil industry from its base at Cabinda Airport.

companies.name: TAAG Angola Airlines
companies.description: TAAG Angola Airlines E.P. is the state-owned flag carrier airline of Angola, based in Luanda. It operates domestic, medium-haul African, and long-haul international flights, using Dr. Antonio Agostinho Neto International Airport as its hub.

companies.name: Diexim Expresso
companies.description: Diexim Expresso Aviaçao was an airline based in Luanda, Angola, operating scheduled, VIP, and charter flights within Angola and to Namibia. Its main base was Quatro de Fevereiro Airport, Luanda, and it was on the list of air carriers banned in the EU.

companies.name: Tanzania Broadcasting Corporation
companies.description: The Tanzanian Broadcasting Corporation is Tanzania's national television network. It is government-owned and operated.

companies.name: Tanga Cement
companies.description: Tanga Cement Public Limited Company is a cement manufacturer in Tanzania. Its shares are publicly listed on the Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange under the symbol TCCL.

companies.name: Tanzania Electric Supply Company Limited
companies.description: The Tanzania Electric Supply Company Limited (TANESCO) is a Tanzanian government-owned parastatal established in 1964. Its operations are regulated by the Ministry of Energy and Minerals.

companies.name: CRDB Bank
companies.description: CRDB Bank Plc is a commercial bank in Tanzania licensed by the Bank of Tanzania. As of September 2022, it was the largest commercial bank in the country.

companies.name: NMB Bank Plc
companies.description: NMB Bank Plc is a commercial bank in Tanzania licensed by the Bank of Tanzania, the national banking regulator.

companies.name: Tanzania Agricultural Development Bank
companies.description: The Tanzania Agricultural Development Bank (TADB) is a bank in Tanzania dedicated to farmers. The government has pledged $500 million as working capital for the bank.

companies.name: ZanAir
companies.description: ZanAir Limited is a domestic airline based in Zanzibar, Tanzania. Founded in 1992, it operates within Tanzania and is currently listed among airlines banned in the European Union.

companies.name: Regional Air Services
companies.description: Regional Air Services is an airline based in Arusha, Tanzania. It is the Tanzanian division of Airkenya and operates domestic and charter flights across East and Southern Africa.

companies.name: Auric Air
companies.description: Auric Air Services Limited is a privately owned airline based in Tanzania. It operates scheduled flights to 42 destinations within East Africa and offers private non-scheduled air charters from multiple airports including Dar-es-salaam and Arusha.

companies.name: Coastal Aviation
companies.description: Coastal Aviation operates out of Julius Nyerere International Airport in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. It provides air services within Tanzania and to neighboring countries such as Kenya and Rwanda.

companies.name: Safari Plus
companies.description: Safari Plus Limited is an air charter company based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. It is included on the list of airlines banned in the European Union.

companies.name: Tropical Air
companies.description: Tropical Air is an airline based in Zanzibar, Tanzania, founded in 1999 by Farouk Othman Daud. It was the first locally owned airline in Zanzibar and operates in Pemba, Dar es Salaam, and other Tanzanian areas.

companies.name: As Salaam Air
companies.description: As Salaam Air is an airline based in Zanzibar, Tanzania, offering private charters and scheduled flights within Tanzania. The airline operates two Embraer 120 aircraft.

companies.name: Air Centrafrique
companies.description: Air Centrafrique was the flag carrier airline of the Central African Republic from 1966 to the late 1970s. It operated domestic services and was headquartered in Bangui.

companies.name: Karinou Airlines
companies.description: Karinou Airlines was an airline based in Bangui, Central African Republic. It operated scheduled passenger services to various destinations across Africa.

companies.name: Central African Red Cross Society
companies.description: The Central African Red Cross Society (CRCA) was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Bangui, Central African Republic. It operates in the emergency and relief sector.

companies.name: Togolese Red Cross
companies.description: Togolese Red Cross is an emergency and relief organization established in 1959. It is headquartered in Lomé, the capital city of Togo. The organization provides humanitarian aid and disaster relief services within the country.

companies.name: Télévision Togolaise
companies.description: Télévision Togolaise is the national broadcaster of Togo, based in the capital city, Lomé. It serves as the primary television service provider for the West African nation. The company operates within the communication industry.

companies.name: Asky Airlines
companies.description: ASKY Airlines is a private multinational passenger airline headquartered in Lomé, Togo. It serves West and Central Africa with its hub at Lomé–Tokoin International Airport. The airline operates in the aviation sector.

companies.name: Monoprix
companies.description: SNMVT Monoprix is a chain of grocery stores in Tunisia with its head office in Mégrine. It is operated by Groupe Mabrouk and has been listed on the Bourse de Tunis since April 1995. The company is a key player in the Tunisian retail market.

companies.name: Wallyscar
companies.description: Wallyscar is a Tunisian car manufacturer founded in 2006 and based in Ben Arous. The company produces about 600 vehicles per year, selling mainly in Africa, Europe, and the Middle East. It collaborates with Peugeot and uses PSA engines in its cars.

companies.name: Compagnie des phosphates de Gafsa
companies.description: Compagnie des phosphates de Gafsa (CPG) is a Tunisian phosphate mining company based in Gafsa, established during the French colonial era. It merged with Groupe chimique tunisien in 1994 to form CPG-CGT. The company was once the fifth largest phosphate producer globally.

companies.name: Tunisian Beverage Manufacturing Company
companies.description: The Tunisian Beverage Manufacturing Company, formerly known as the Tunis Frigorific and Brewery Company until 2012, is a Tunisian food industry group. It focuses on producing four main products within the agribusiness sector.

companies.name: Arab International Bank of Tunisia
companies.description: Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie (BIAT) is the largest private sector bank in Tunisia. It is publicly listed on the Tunisian Stock Exchange and operates within the banking industry.

companies.name: National Agricultural Bank
companies.description: Banque Nationale Agricole (BNA) is a state-controlled bank in Tunisia. It is listed on the Bourse de Tunis and serves the banking sector within the country.

companies.name: Ooredoo Tunisia
companies.description: Ooredoo Tunisia is a private telecommunications company founded in 2002 with capital of 330 million Tunisian dinars. It is part of the Ooredoo Group and is the largest operator in Tunisia with over 7.5 million subscribers.

companies.name: Tunisie Telecom
companies.description: Tunisie Telecom is the incumbent telecom operator in Tunisia. It serves more than 6 million subscribers in fixed and mobile telephony both within Tunisia and abroad. The company is a key player in the Tunisian telecommunications industry.

companies.name: Amen Bank
companies.description: Amen Bank is a private sector bank based in Tunisia. It operates in the financial services industry and is listed on the Bourse de Tunis. The bank is part of Tunisia's banking sector.

companies.name: Tunisian Company of Electricity and Gas
companies.wiki: Tunisian Company of Electricity and Gas
companies.description: The Tunisian Company of Electricity and Gas (STEG) is a Tunisian public company established in 1962. It is responsible for the production and distribution of electricity and natural gas throughout Tunisia. In 2009, STEG was the second-largest Tunisian company by revenues.

companies.name: Tunis Afrique Presse
companies.description: Tunis Afrique Presse (TAP) is a news agency based in Tunisia. It operates in the news media industry, providing news services within the country. TAP is a key source of news in Tunisia.

companies.name: Tunisian National Oil Company
companies.description: The Tunisian National Oil Company, known as ETAP, is a state-owned industrial and commercial company in Tunisia. It manages the petroleum sector and oversees the state's partnerships with foreign exploration and production operators. ETAP plays a central role in Tunisia's petroleum industry.

companies.name: Embassy of France, Tunis
companies.logo_file: Logo de l'ambassade de France en Tunisie.svg
companies.description: The Embassy of France in Tunis is France's diplomatic mission to Tunisia. It operates in the foreign affairs sector and represents French interests in Tunisia. The embassy is located in Tunis.

companies.name: Orange Tunisia
companies.description: Orange Tunisia is a mobile phone operator that acquired a license in Tunisia in 2010. It became the leading 3G mobile operator and the second landline operator in the country. The Tunisian State confiscated 51% of the company in 2011 due to fraudulent licensing terms.

companies.name: Tunisian Red Crescent
companies.description: The Tunisian Red Crescent is a humanitarian association founded in 1956 after Tunisia's independence. It is a national affiliate of the International Movement of the Red Cross and Red Crescent. The organization was led by Brahim El Gharbi until 2018.

companies.name: Tunisian Confederation of Industry, Trade and Handicrafts
companies.wiki: Tunisian Confederation of Industry, Trade and Handicrafts
companies.description: The Tunisian Confederation of Industry, Trade and Handicrafts (UTICA) is an employers' organization representing industrial, trade, and craft sectors in Tunisia. In 2015, UTICA was part of the National Dialogue Quartet awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for contributing to democracy after the Jasmine Revolution.

companies.name: Nouvelair
companies.description: Nouvelair is a Tunisian airline with its registered office in Tunis and head office in Monastir. It operates tourist charter flights from European cities to Tunisian holiday resorts. Its main bases include airports in Monastir, Tunis, and Djerba.

companies.name: Tunisair Express
companies.description: Tunisair Express is an airline based in Tunis, Tunisia, founded on August 1, 1991. It was formerly known as Tuninter and SevenAir and is a subsidiary of the national carrier Tunisair. The airline operates domestic flights within Tunisia and international services to Italy, France, and Malta.

companies.name: Banque de Tunisie
companies.description: Banque de Tunisie is a bank in Tunisia and was the first modern bank established in the country. It has been publicly listed on the Bourse de Tunis since 1990. The bank operates within the financial sector of Tunisia.

companies.name: Tunisair
companies.description: Tunisair, officially La Société Tunisienne de l'Air, is the national airline of Tunisia, established in 1948. It operates scheduled international flights to four continents and is based at Tunis–Carthage International Airport. The airline's head office is located in Tunis near the airport.

companies.name: Arab Tunisian Bank
companies.description: Arab Tunisian Bank (ATB) is a Tunisian commercial bank created on June 30, 1982, through the integration of a branch of Arab Bank Tunis with Tunisian individuals. Its mission focuses on contributing to the economic and financial development of Tunisia.

companies.name: Banque Zitouna
companies.description: Banque Zitouna is the first Islamic bank in Tunisia and the Maghreb region. It has a capital of $30 million and aims to develop Islamic loan and saving products for both businesses and individuals.

companies.name: BH Bank
companies.description: BH Bank is a state-controlled bank in Tunisia. It is publicly listed on the Bourse de Tunis and operates within the country's banking sector.

companies.name: Union bancaire pour le commerce et l'industrie
companies.wiki: Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et l'Industrie
companies.description: Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et l'Industrie is a bank based in Tunis, Tunisia, formed in 1961 by merging prior operations of Banque Nationale pour le Commerce et l'Industrie. It was controlled by BNP Paribas until 2021, when it was acquired by Tunisian insurer CARTE, controlled by the Doghri family.

companies.name: Société Tunisienne de Banque
companies.description: Société Tunisienne de Banque is a state-controlled bank in Tunisia, listed on the Bourse de Tunis. Its capital participation includes public and semi-public sectors, private sector, and foreign actors.

companies.name: Banque de Tunisie et des Emirats
companies.wiki: Banque de Tunisie et des Emirats
companies.description: Banque de Tunisie et des Emirats (BTE) is a bank in Tunisia that is publicly listed on the Bourse de Tunis. It operates within the Tunisian banking sector.

companies.name: Tunisavia
companies.description: Tunisavia is a charter airline based in Tunis, Tunisia. Its main base of operations is Tunis-Carthage International Airport.

companies.name: QNB Tunisia
companies.description: QNB Tunisia, formerly known as Tunisian Qatari Bank, is a medium-sized bank based in Tunisia. It operates as a subsidiary of the Qatari QNB Group. The bank serves the Tunisian market within the banking and fintech industry.

companies.name: Express Air Cargo
companies.description: Express Air Cargo is an airline based in Tunis, Tunisia, founded in 2015. It operates within the airline industry, providing air cargo services. The company is part of Tunisia's aviation sector.

companies.name: Zambia National Commercial Bank
companies.description: Zambia National Commercial Bank, commonly called Zanaco, is a commercial bank licensed by the Bank of Zambia. It operates in Zambia's financial services sector and was the first bank in Zambia to register a profit after tax of ZMW1bn in 2021.

companies.name: Standard Chartered Zambia
companies.description: Standard Chartered Zambia, officially Standard Chartered Bank Zambia Plc, is a commercial bank in Zambia and a subsidiary of Standard Chartered. It is licensed by the Bank of Zambia, the country's central bank and regulator.

companies.name: ZESCO
companies.description: ZESCO is a state-owned power company in Zambia and the largest power producer in the country. It generates approximately 80% of Zambia's electricity consumption and represents Zambia in the Southern African Power Pool.

companies.name: Zamtel
companies.description: Zamtel, officially Zambia Telecommunications Company Limited, is a government-owned telecommunications service provider in Zambia. It is one of three mobile phone networks operating in the country alongside Airtel and MTN.

companies.name: Zambia Airways
companies.description: Zambia Airways is the flag carrier airline of the Republic of Zambia. It is based in Lusaka with its hub at Kenneth Kaunda International Airport, serving the country's air transport needs.

companies.name: Proflight Zambia
companies.description: Proflight Zambia is an airline based in Lusaka, Zambia, serving business and tourism sectors. It operates the largest fleet and route network in Zambia and is IOSA certified, providing both scheduled and charter flights.

companies.name: Zambia Skyways
companies.description: Zambia Skyways was an airline based in Lusaka, Zambia, originally known as Eastern Air. It began operations in 1993 and expanded its fleet in 1997 with the addition of a Let 410 aircraft.

companies.name: Mahogany Air
companies.description: Mahogany Air is a regional airline based in Lusaka, Zambia, with its hub at Lusaka International Airport. Its corporate headquarters are located at East Park Mall on Great East Road in Lusaka.

companies.name: Royal Zambian Airlines
companies.description: Royal Zambian Airlines is a regional airline based at Kenneth Kaunda International Airport in Zambia. It operates as a subsidiary of Royal Air Charters, a Lusaka-based charter company. The airline connects Zambia with neighboring countries to facilitate business and tourist travel.

companies.name: Zambia Red Cross Society
companies.description: The Zambia Red Cross Society is a humanitarian organization established in 1966 by an act of the Zambian Parliament. It originated as a branch of the British Red Cross and is headquartered in Lusaka, Zambia.

companies.name: Willowvale Motor Industries
companies.description: Willowvale Motor Industries (Pvt.) Ltd. is an automobile and commercial vehicle manufacturer based in Zimbabwe. It operates within the automotive industry.

companies.name: Zimbabwe Defence Industries
companies.description: Zimbabwe Defence Industries (Pty) Ltd is a state-owned arms manufacturing and procurement company headquartered in Harare, Zimbabwe. It focuses on sporting and military ammunition and has historically produced various military equipment. The company has also been involved in arms deals and currently exports second-hand military equipment.

companies.name: Air Zimbabwe
companies.description: Air Zimbabwe (Pvt) Ltd is the flag carrier airline of Zimbabwe, headquartered at Robert Gabriel Mugabe International Airport in Harare. It operates domestic and regional flights, with a history of financial difficulties causing intermittent service suspensions and resumptions.

companies.name: South Sudan Broadcasting Corporation
companies.description: The South Sudan Broadcasting Corporation (SSBC) is the national public service broadcaster of South Sudan. It provides radio and television services via analogue transmitters in Juba and broadcasts globally through multiple satellites.

companies.name: South Sudan Red Cross
companies.description: The South Sudan Red Cross Society was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Juba, South Sudan. It operates as a humanitarian organization providing emergency and relief services.

companies.name: Golden Wings Aviation
companies.description: Golden Wings Aviation South Sudan was a privately owned airline based in Juba, South Sudan. It operated regionally as an affiliate of South African carrier Golden Wings Aviation under a South African Air Operator's Certificate.

companies.name: Grupo MVS mi vrga
companies.description: Grupo MVS is a Mexican media conglomerate owning various media assets including MASTV, MVS Radio with four national networks, MVS Televisión with seven pay TV networks, E-Go wireless broadband, and Dish México.

companies.name: Ánima Estudios
companies.description: Ánima Estudios is a Mexican animation studio founded in 2002 and based in Mexico City. Its first film, Magos y Gigantes, was released in November 2003.

companies.name: Huevocartoon
companies.description: Huevocartoon Producciones is a Mexican animation studio and multimedia entertainment company founded in 2001. It produces a web series, six feature films, a video game, a television special, and advertisements featuring anthropomorphic eggs. The company is based in Mexico.

companies.name: Izzi
companies.description: izzi is a Mexican telecommunications company owned by Grupo Televisa and operated by Televisión Internacional, S.A. de C.V. It provides telephone, Internet, cable TV, and mobile services to individuals and companies in cities across Mexico. izzi is listed on the Mexican Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Claro TV
companies.description: Embratel TVsat Telecomunicações S.A. operates pay television services in Latin America under the brands Embratel and Claro. It uses Star One C4 satellite and a DTH transmission system in Ku Band with encrypted channels. The company authenticates subscribers via conditional access cards.

companies.name: Cablemás
companies.description: Cablemás was a Mexican regional telecommunications company owned by Grupo Televisa. It offered a triple play service including subscription television, phone line, and broadband internet in a single package. The company was headquartered in Mexico City.

companies.name: Megacable
